title: SnowReports
description: Lightweight, customizable player reporting plugin.
body:
# SnowReports

Lightweight, customizable player reporting plugin.

[![Paper](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/paper_vector.svg)](https://papermc.io/)
[![Modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/snowreports)

## Features

- **Report Reason Presets** with auto-completion
- **Multiple Storage Methods** MySQL, SQLite, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, H2
- **Intuitive GUI** for viewing and managing reports
- **Discord Integration** via webhooks
- **Automatic Update Checking**
- **Highly Customizable** settings and messages
- **Cross-server support** while using a remote storage method with the velocity plugin
- **Chat History** stored for each report

## Usage

### Commands

| Command                                    | Description                                 | Permission                                 |
|--------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| `/snowreports`                             | Main command                                | `snowreports.command.snowreports`          |
| `/deleteallreports [confirm]`              | Delete all reports                          | `snowreports.command.deleteallreports`     |
| `/deleteallreportsfrom <player> [confirm]` | Delete all reports made by a player         | `snowreports.command.deleteallreportsfrom` |
| `/deletereport <id> [confirm]`             | Delete a specific report                    | `snowreports.command.deletereport`         |
| `/myreports [page]`                        | View reports you've made                    | `snowreports.command.myreports`            |
| `/report <player> [reason]`                | Report a player                             | `snowreports.command.report`               |
| `/reports [player/page]`                   | View all reports or player-specific reports | `snowreports.command.reports`              |
| `/setstatus <id> <status> [confirm]`       | Set the status of a report                  | `snowreports.command.setstatus`            |

### Permissions

| Permission                                   | Description                                         |
|----------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| `snowreports.command.<command>`              | Give permission to a certain command                |
| `snowreports.command.<command>.<subcommand>` | Give permission to a certain subcommand             |
| `snowreports.alerts`                         | Receive an alert when a player is reported          |
| `snowreports.bypass.cooldown`                | Bypass the report cooldown                          |
| `snowreports.bypass.report`                  | Makes a player immune to reports                    |
| `snowreports.update`                         | Get notified if an update is available when joining |

### Placeholders

Requires [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)

| Placeholder                        | Description                         |
|------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| `%snowreports_reports_total%`      | Total number of reports             |
| `%snowreports_reports_open%`       | Total number of open reports        |
| `%snowreports_reports_inprogress%` | Total number of in progress reports |
| `%snowreports_reports_resolved%`   | Total number of resolved reports    |

## License

SnowReports is licensed under the [GPL-3.0 license](LICENSE).

Hazmat

Unethical "fixes" to random crash issues.

Datapack Filter Fix
-------------------
`LifecycledResourceManagerImplMixin=false` in the config to disable. Fixes Mojang's fucked up pack.mcmeta filtering system, since they somehow forgot to make the namespace filter actually do anything.

Force Attribute
---------------
`DefaultAttributeContainerMixin=false` in the config to disable. Will prevent any crashes due to entities not having attributes set.

Packet Fucker
-------------
`DecoderHandlerMixin=true` in the config to enable. Will prevent any crashes due to invalid server-sent packets. NOT GOOD FOR GENERAL USE. This was implemented as a temporary flag to go into broken worlds to manually remove broken blocks or items.

Player Backup x7

body:
# Eggcat Mod

The Eggcat Mod is a simple Minecraft mod that adds a new decorative block to the game: the Eggcat. This block serves as
a light source that can be turned on and off by clicking it.

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

To use the Eggcat Mod, you will need the following:

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

### Installing

1. Download and install Fabric Loader following the instructions on the [Fabric website](https://fabricmc.net/use/).
2. Download the Eggcat Mod JAR file from the [releases page](https://modrinth.com/mod/eggcat/versions).
3. Move the JAR file to the `mods` folder in your Minecraft installation directory.
4. Launch Minecraft with the Fabric profile.

### Crafting the Eggcat Block

Once you have installed the mod, you can find the Eggcat block in the creative inventory or craft it in a crafting table
like the pattern specified below:

```
   | |O| |
   |O|i|O|
   |O|O|O|
   
   O = Egg
   i = Redstone Torch
```

To turn the light on or off, simply right-click the block.

## Source Code

The source code can be found on [GitHub](https://github.com/WinterWolfSV/eggcat) under
the [CC-BY-NC 4.0 License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). More information about the license can be
found under the [License](#license) section.

## License

The Eggcat Mod is released under the [CC-BY-NC 4.0 License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). This
license allows you to use, modify, and distribute the mod for non-commercial purposes, as long as you credit the
original author and include a copy of the license in any redistributed versions.

## Bugs and Feedback

Bug reports can be submitted either through the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/WinterWolfSV/eggcat/issues) page of
the Eggcat Mod repository or by contacting me
personally over Discord (WinterWolfSV#9577). Please provide as much information as possible, including steps to
reproduce the
issue, error
messages, and any relevant screenshots or log files. Your feedback is greatly appreciated and will help improve the mod
for all users.

title: GVault
description: Server-side mod adding vaults, ender-chest-style inventories.
body:
# GVault

![gunpowder required](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gunpowder-Required-important?style=for-the-badge)

A Gunpowder add-on which adds *vaults*, per-player end-chest-style inventories which can be accessed via commands.

## Commands

| Command                           | Permission node    | Action                                   |
|-----------------------------------|--------------------|------------------------------------------|
| `/vault <number>`                 | `gvault.viewVault` | Shows vault `#number` to yourself.       |
| `/vault showto <target> <number>` | `gvault.showTo`    | Shows `target` their own vault `#number` |
| `/vault spy <target> <number>`    | `gvault.spy`       | Shows you `target`'s vault `#number`     |

## Config

```yaml
vaultCount: 3 # How many vaults does each player have access to?
isDoubleChest: no # Are vaults double-size?
configGroups: [] # A list of Config Groups
```

## Config Groups

A config group looks like:
```yaml
name: special
vaultCount: 5
doubleChest: yes
```

Then, if a player has the permission node `gvault.group.special`, they will have 5 double-size vaults.

title: Serverauth Mod
description:
A purely server-side Fabric login module, where the administrator has full control over accounts. Forced login, automatic binding, AFK timeout, and position restoration provide a complete securi
纯服务端 Fabric 登录模组，管理员完全掌控账号。强制登录、自动绑定、挂机超时，为服务器提供完整的安全验证体系
body:
#  **ServerAuth Login Module —— Feature Overview**
**This is a pure server-side Fabric mod (1.20.x-1.21.x) that provides your server with a comprehensive security verification system, including forced login, automatic binding, session management, and anti-idling measures.**

## Core Design Principles
## 
· Full admin control over accounts: Only OP (permission level 4) can create/delete accounts; regular 

players cannot register themselves.

· Mandatory Login Verification: Unauthenticated players cannot move or interact (teleported to void 
space with black screen hover).

· Device-Bound Auto-Login: Players may opt to bind their account to their device's UUID for automatic 

login upon future server access.

· Login Location Restoration: Upon successful login, players are teleported back to their initial spawn point.

· Dual Timeout Mechanism:
  
  · Idle Timeout: Forced logout after a set number of minutes of inactivity post-login, requiring re-login.
  
  · Auto-login validity period: After binding an account, auto-login becomes invalid if no login occurs within a set number of days. Manual password entry is required for subsequent logins.

· Add 6 languages, only administrators can use/change chinese|english|spanish|french|russian|arabic to switch between Chinese and English and Spanish and so on, the default language for mods is Chinese

## Player Experience (Player-facing features)
1. First Server Entry
· Upon entering the game, players find themselves in the Void (black screen), suspended, and unable to move.
· A prompt will appear in the chat bar instructing players to use the /login command to log in.
2. Login Command
/login <username> <password>
· Enter the username and password provided by the administrator to log in.
· After successful login:
  · Players will be instantly teleported back to their entry location (spawn point or coordinates at entry).
  · The game mode will switch to Survival Mode, allowing normal gameplay.
3. Bind Device (Auto-Login)
/login <username> <password> -b or
/login <username> <password> --bind
· Adding the -b parameter during login permanently binds the account to the player's UUID (unique identifier for verified accounts).
· The player will automatically log in upon subsequent server entries without any action required.
4. Manual Logout
/logout
· Players can manually log out to return to the void state.
Unbind Device
/unbind
· Use this command to unbind the current account from the device (e.g., when switching players).
· After unbinding, manual login is required for the next entry.
Administrator Functions (OP Exclusive)

All admin commands begin with /auth.
Command Description Example

/auth create <username> <password> Create a regular player account

 /auth create <username> <password> -admin Create an administrator account (with OP privileges) 

/auth delete <username> Delete specified account 

/auth unbind <username> Force unbind specified account (for players switching devices)

/auth list List all accounts and binding status 

/auth kickall Kick all unlogged-in players (clear the server) 

**⚠️ Note: Before using /auth commands, administrators must grant themselves OP permissions via the console or other methods (op [playername]).**
**Configurable Options (config/serverauth/config.json)
The configuration file is automatically generated upon server startup. You can modify and save it at any time without restarting (the mod periodically re-reads settings).**

json
{

  “requireLogin”: true,                // Require login (recommended to keep true)
 
  “kickOnFailedLogin”: true,            // Kick player on login failure
  
  “maxLoginAttempts”: 3,                // Maximum login attempts (counting not yet implemented)
 
  “enableSession”: true,                // Enable session functionality
 
  “sessionTimeout”: 30,                  // Reserved field, unused
 
  “sessionTimeoutMinutes”: 30,           // Idle timeout (minutes). Forced logout after inactivity exceeding this duration (0=no timeout)
  
  “autoLoginExpiryDays”: 30              // Auto-login validity period (days). Accounts bound for longer than this period require manual password entry upon login (0=permanent validity)

· To prevent idle timeouts: “sessionTimeoutMinutes”: 0

· To enable permanent account binding: “autoLoginExpiryDays”: 0

**All account information (including password hashes, bound UUIDs, creation times) is stored in:
[server root directory]/config/serverauth/accounts.json

· Password storage: Uses SHA-256 hashing, which cannot be reverse-engineered.

· Binding relationships: Based on Minecraft UUIDs (fixed for official accounts; generated from player names in offline mode).
**



# **中文:**
# ServerAuth 登录模组 —— 功能详解
**这是一个 纯服务端 Fabric 模组（1.20.x-1.21.x），为你的服务器提供了强制登录、自动绑定、会话管理、防挂机等完整的安全验证体系。**

## **核心设计理念**

· 管理员完全控制账号：只有 OP（权限等级4）可以创建/删除账号，普通玩家无法自行注册。

· 强制登录验证：未登录的玩家无法移动、无法交互（被传送到虚空，黑屏悬浮）。

· 绑定设备自动登录：玩家登录时可选择将账号与自己的 UUID 绑定，以后进入服务器自动登录。

· 登录位置恢复：登录成功后，玩家会被传送回刚进服时的位置。

· 双重超时机制：
 
  · 在线挂机超时：登录后超过设定分钟无操作，强制登出，需重新登录。
  
  · 自动登录有效期：绑定账号后，若超过设定天数未登录，自动登录失效，下次需手动输入密码。

·添加6种语言，只有管理员可用/change chinese|english|spanish|french|russian|arabic 来回切换中文,英文，西班牙语，俄语，阿拉伯语，法语，mod初始语言是中文

## **玩家体验（玩家视角的功能）**

1.首次进入服务器

· 进入游戏后，玩家会发现自己处于 虚空（黑屏）、悬浮、无法移动 的状态。

· 聊天栏会显示提示信息，要求使用 /login 命令登录。

2.登录命令

/login <账号> <密码>

· 输入管理员发放的账号密码即可登录。

· 登录成功后：
  · 瞬间传送回进入服务器时的位置（出生点或进入时的坐标）。
  · 游戏模式切换为生存模式，可以正常游玩。
3.绑定设备（自动登录）

/login <账号> <密码> -b或

/login <账号> <密码> --bind


· 登录时添加 -b 参数，会将当前账号与玩家的 UUID（正版账号唯一标识） 永久绑定。

· 以后该玩家每次进入服务器都会自动登录，无需任何操作。

4.手动登出

/logout

· 玩家可以主动登出，回到虚空状态。

解绑设备

/unbind

· 如果玩家想要解除当前账号与设备的绑定（例如换人玩），可以使用此命令。

· 解绑后，下次进入需要手动登录。

管理员功能（OP专用）
所有管理员命令都以 /auth 开头。

命令 说明 示例

/auth create <账号> <密码> 创建普通玩家账号

/auth create <账号> <密码> -admin 创建管理员账号（拥有OP权限）

/auth delete <账号> 删除指定账号

/auth unbind <账号> 强制解绑指定账号（玩家换设备时用）

/auth list 列出所有账号及绑定状态 

/auth kickall 踢出所有未登录玩家（清场）

**⚠️ 注意：使用 /auth 命令前，管理员必须在控制台或通过其他方式给自己 OP 权限（op 玩家名）。
可配置选项（config/serverauth/config.json）
服务器启动后自动生成配置文件，你可以随时修改并保存，无需重启（模组会定期重新读取）。**

json
{

  "requireLogin": true,                // 是否强制登录（建议保持true）

  "kickOnFailedLogin": true,            // 登录失败是否踢出玩家

  "maxLoginAttempts": 3,                // 最大登录尝试次数（暂未实现计数）

  "enableSession": true,                // 是否启用会话功能

  "sessionTimeout": 30,                  // 保留字段，未使用

  "sessionTimeoutMinutes": 30,           //  在线挂机超时（分钟），超过此时间无操作强制登出（0=永不超时）
 
  "autoLoginExpiryDays": 30              // 自动登录有效期（天），绑定账号后超过此天数未登录需手动输密码（0=永久有效）

· 想让玩家永不挂机超时："sessionTimeoutMinutes": 0

· 想让绑定账号永久有效："autoLoginExpiryDays": 0

所有账号信息（含密码哈希、绑定UUID、创建时间）都保存在：

[服务器根目录]/config/serverauth/accounts.json

· 密码存储：使用 SHA-256 哈希，无法逆向破解。

· 绑定关系：基于 Minecraft UUID（正版账号固定，离线模式由玩家名生成）

title: KarpInfo
description: Client-Side QoL mod for the server KobbledKarp. Offers HUDs, reminders, a stats tracker and more.
body:
# KarpInfo

Client-side quality-of-life mod specifically for the server KobbledKarp.

This mod reads information (like timers) from server chat and keeps track of them by displaying them in HUDs or by scheduling reminders. 

Timers include those for legendary spawns, Battle Tower, STS, and more. You won’t miss important information anymore, even if you don’t constantly read chat, and you no longer need to track multiple timers yourself.

For the mod to detect a timer, it must first appear in chat. So use `/legendinfo` once for the legendary timer, or for activities like the Battle Tower, complete them once to start tracking them.

Many features can be configured with `/karpinfo config`.

**Disclaimer:**
This is an unofficial mod made by me. The server admins allowed me to upload it, but they are not affiliated with it, so please contact me for support instead of the server staff.
This mod does not automate gameplay, give information that are not visible to the palyer, or send any packets to the server.

## Features

**Various HUDs** – most are only shown when needed or when the "HUD Details Key" (default: Alt) is pressed:
- `Main HUD`: Shows timers for the next legendary spawn, STS, and daycare, as well as Vote Party progress and the current time.
- `Tasks Cooldown HUD`: Shows when daily/weekly tasks like the Battle Tower, Kits, or Distortion Gyms are ready.
- `Server Timer HUD`: Shows item clear, server restart, and raid join timers.
- `Raid HUD`: Shows real-time raid rankings.
- `Legend Info HUD`: Shows current conditions for legendary spawns and conditions for the next legendary spawn.

**Notifications and Reminders** with optional sounds:
- Reminders 1 and 3 minutes before legendary spawns
- Notifications when a Vote Party is about to complete
- STS reminder (more precise than the existing one)
- Raid start notification and reminder
- Breeding notification sounds

**Stats Tracking** – displays custom KobbledKarp stats `/karpinfo stats`
- Number of legendary spawns witnessed and obtained
- Number of scam parties witnessed
- Money made and spent with `/shops`, `/pay`, `/sts`
- Money made with chest shops and `/gts` while online (can’t track while offline)
- Total GTS tax paid
- Number of raids participated in, times placed in the top 3, and average position
- Vote/Raid crates opened and Leg/Tex keys won
- Eggs bred and hatched
- Pokemon caught

And detailed breakdowns:
- Chest Shop tracking for all transaction types and what products made/cost how much
- Balance tracking when doing `\balance`, graph that shows your balance over time

**Legendary spawn helper**
Commands that tell you which Legendary Pokémon can spawn for you:
- `/checklegend now` tells you all legendaries that could spawn for you right now
- `/checklegend next` same, but uses the time of the next legendary spawn instead
- `/checklegendfilter` allows you to check for other times, biomes, and weather

**Dex helper** helps with completing the Pokedex
- Notifications when a wild pokemon that is not in your Pokedex is nearby.
- Also makes pokemon not in your dex glow (no esp they only glow when you can see them)
- A custom Pokedex UI `\dexhelper` where you can filter by uncaught pokemon
  - Clicking on a pokemon wil open its Bulbapedia page.
  - You can copy a list of your missing pokemon to share with others for touch trades

**Card Collection Tracking**
needs you to open each card page once for it to know what cards you already have
- Adds a green marker to collected cards and a red marker to cards you are still missing
- In the binder pages shows card school icon and a "+" icon tho cards that can be added
- Command `/karpinfo missingcards` copies all cards you are missing to sahre for trading

**Local friends tracking**
Allows you to add friends with `/friend add <name>`, which provides some useful features:
- When joining the server, a list of all online friends will be displayed
- `/friend online` shows which friends are online and their AFK status
- `/friend list` shows all your friends and when you last saw them online
- Optional notification sounds when friends join or leave
- `/friend remove <name>` removes a friend

**Lots of config options** use `/karpinfo config` or the ModMenu mod:
- Disable HUDs, notifications, or sounds
- Adjust HUD positions, backgrounds, and scale
- Disable the "Shiny Boost" Boss Bar for less HUD clutter
- Show an icon for plushies in GTS to distinguish them from Pokemon
- Hide plushies on the Minimap
- Configure when HUDs or specific entries are shown

title: Enuberium Enhanced
description: An optimal modpack uses vulkan to optmize minecraft with the help of another mods.
body:
---

## **Enuberium – Optimization Minecraft Modpack**

**Enuberium** is a high-performance Minecraft modpack designed to maximize framerate and responsiveness using Vulkan and other cutting-edge optimization mods. Built for Fabric and tailored to Minecraft **1.21.10**, Enuberium focuses on client-side performance improvements without sacrificing visual quality. 

### **What Makes Enuberium Special**

Enuberium combines advanced rendering optimization with intelligent culling and lightweight performance enhancements to deliver a smoother gameplay experience on a wide range of systems.

### **Core Mods Included**

* **VulkanMod** — Provides a Vulkan-powered rendering backend for improved efficiency and performance. 
* **Lithium** — Enhances game logic and reduces CPU overhead. 
* **FerriteCore** — Improves memory utilization and reduces lag spikes. 
* **Entity Culling** & **More Culling** — Prevents off-screen objects from rendering unnecessarily. 
* **Flyspeed (Creative Flight)** — Offers optimized creative flight mechanics. 
* **Cloth Config API** & config libs — For easy configuration and customization. 
* **Fabric API** — Core Fabric support for mod functionality. 

### **Experience Highlights**

* **Massive FPS boosts** thanks to Vulkan and smart culling
* **Reduced CPU and memory load** for smoother performance
* **Minimalistic yet powerful setup** focused entirely on optimization

**Enuberium** is ideal for players who want a **clean, highly optimized Minecraft experience** with modern rendering enhancements and minimal performance overhead. ([Modrinth][2])

title: Simple Death Coordinates
description: Never lose your items again. Logs your death coordinates and distance in chat, click to copy for quick navigation.
body:
# Never lose your items again.
This lightweight mod automatically logs your death coordinates and distance in chat upon respawn, featuring a click-to-copy function for quick and easy navigation.

![message in chat image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c639ba37f8351082f627924231b92c5a9eaf637_0.webp)

## ✨ Features
- **Vanilla Style Integration:** The notifications are designed to mimic the look and feel of native /locate or game system messages. Keeping your HUD clean and authentic.

- **Instant Coordinates:** Automatically displays your exact XYZ location the moment you respawn.

- **Distance Tracker:** Shows exactly how far you are from your death point so you can plan your recovery.

- **Click-to-Copy:** Simply click the chat message to copy your coordinates to the clipboard for easy use with waypoints or teleports.

- **Lightweight:** No extra menus, no clutter—just the information you need, exactly when you need it.

## 🧩 How to use
1. Die in the game while exploring or building.

1. Upon respawning, check your chat for the automatically generated death message, styled just like a standard system notification.

1. Click on the coordinates in the chat to copy them to your clipboard.

1. Paste the coordinates into your favorite waypoint mod, map tool, or use them to teleport back if you have the necessary permissions!

## ⚙️ Compatibility & Technical Details
- **Vanilla-Friendly:** The UI does not use custom inventory screens or complex pop-ups. It utilizes the standard Minecraft chat component system, ensuring full compatibility with other mods and custom chat interfaces.

- **Performance:** Optimized for minimal resource usage, ensuring zero impact on your FPS or game logic.
 
- **Version Support:** Works on any server (even if it's not installed on the server-side), making it the perfect tool for survival multiplayer and single-player worlds alike.

title: SCP-2863, Starving Skeletons
description: Adds giant skeletons that hunt you during the night
body:
Starving Skeletons adds a new terrifying monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-2863, also known as Starving Skeletons.


These giant, 23-block-tall skeletons rise from the ground during the night. SCP-2863 appears in four variations: the standard skeleton, a version without teeth, one with holes in its bones, and a burned variant. Each of these hungry skeletons will trampling anyone in their path. SCP-2863 is particularly vulnerable to strong sources of light. Powerful light can even destroy these creatures temporarily, but beware, they will return, rising again from the ground when night falls.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-2863 spawn?

SCP-2863 can spawn on the surface in the overworld during the night like a normal monster. There can be multiple instance of SCP-2863.

</details>



![SCP-2863](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5181dc9e7323318aabf66d2f46615d3a9c9c19df.png)

SCP-2863 are massive 23-block tall skeletons that emerge from the ground at night. There are four distinct variants of SCP-2863: Normal, Toothless, Hollow-Boned, and Burned. These skeletons can be heard from a distance, especially the scratching or clinking sound of their teeth. SCP-2863 are extremely dangerous, possessing high durability and the ability to perform stomp attacks that can kill players. They can also pick the player up and consum them, leding to an instant death. If you damage SCP-2863 while it picks you up, it will let you go. However, light is their weakness. If SCP-2863 is in an area with a light level above 4, it will become weakened. If the light level exceeds 10, it will take fatal damage. When SCP-2863 dies, it dissolves into ash.

 

- Config File not inculed.
- You are all allowed to use this mod in your modpacks!
- Do not port my mods without permission!

title: The Grass Requiem
description: The Grass Requiem is a mod that overhauls how grass and wheat farming works.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a92d1cbd816ee581f4b03e9c5c4a23913cdda94.png)

## About The Grass Requiem

The Grass Requiem is a mod that overhauls how grass works as well as add a lot of features related to grass and wheat in a way that makes Wheat and Grass more interesting and less static, ~~while also letting you touch grass.~~

This mod is made as a submission to the MCreative Discord Server's Nature-themed mod jam.

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Quick Summary of Features

- Dirt will turn into Grassy Dirt before turning into Grass Block.
- Tall Grass grows over time.
- Scythes (Harvesting tool that can also be used in combat)
- Wheat Seeds replaced with edible Wheat Grains.
- Tall Grass is now farmable and can be used as a cheap food source for Animals.
- Straws, the Byproduct of extracting Wheat Grains can be used as a compact fuel and used to make building blocks.

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Grass Growth & Grassy Dirt Block

Dirt blocks adjacent to Grass blocks will first turn into "Grassy Dirt" block. The Grassy Dirt block then would act like a grass block, where it would convert adjacent dirt blocks into Grassy Dirt too. Leave Grassy Dirt for long enough, and it would turn into a full grass block.

The grass foliage you see in the world will now spawn in randomized ages, where some are short and some are half, and some fully grown. Cutting it with your bare hand will not drop anything, but using a Hoe or a Scythe (tool that is going to be explained later) will drop "Cut Grass" and will leave a small grass that will slowly grow back later. 

The Cut Grass is an item that can be used as a cheap, low quality drop for breeding animals. Cut Grass does not tempt animals, and the Grass you obtain it from grows twice as slow as normal crops.

![Grass Growing into dirt](https://i.imgur.com/OiWITIZ.png)

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Wheat Farming Overhaul

You can no longer get Wheat Seeds from grass. Instead, you will need to find Wild Wheat, which is found in the Plains, Sunflower Plains, Savanna, and Meadow biomes. Harvesting them, will most of the time will give you Plain-old Wheat, but sometimes give you Straw and Wheat Grains. 

![Wild Wheat](https://i.imgur.com/7w9HGBW.png)

Wheat is no longer used to craft food items, and instead you have to extract the Wheat Grains from it by holding the wheat in your main hand, a hoe or scythe in your off-hand, then right-clicking, which would use up the Wheat and give you Straw and Wheat Grains. 

Wheat Grains (Formerly known as Wheat Seeds in Vanilla Minecraft) is a low nutrition food source on their own, but you can craft bread, cake, cookies, as well as Cereal from them (which is a good food source).

![Cereal Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a04e328700bb7c518281b60f2b76fe844a5e9034.png)

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Scythes

The Scythe is a Tool set that can be made from ranging between wooden all the way to Netherite, which is a Harvesting Farm tool used to quickly clear out foliage and crops within an area. Grass, Tall Grass, Fern, and Large Fern now take time to remove, having a Hoe and Scythe is important to have in order to clear them out. All Scythes below Diamond tier would clear out 3x3 area of foliage and crops, while diamond tier or above would clear out 5x5 area.

![Scythe Tiers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/311042c7e9c4f6b0567f7c778081bcae3f75650e.png)

The Scythes can also be used in combat as it gives an extra 1.5 Block and Entity Reach as well as give you an attack speed of 2.6, which would elevate combat by having high-speed attacks. (Using it with Strength II potion will make it incredibly powerful due to high attack speed)

![Netherite Scythe being used to clear out grass](https://i.imgur.com/pgEOL6Y.png)

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Straw and its uses

Straw is a quite useful byproduct of extracting Wheat Grains from Wheat. First, you could use it to make a Straw Hat you can wear, cus why not? You can also use it as a highly compact furnace fuel source. 

On its own, it can only smelt 1.25 items per Straw, which is not that much. But you could convert 9 of them into 1 Straw Bale, in which the Straw Bale would last 9x as long as plain straw so it would smelt 11.25 items per Straw Bale. We are not done compacting the fuel source! You can Compact 4 Straw Bales into 2 Straw Blocks, which would allow you to smelt 22.5 items per Straw Block.

A Straw Block as described earlier is a high density furnace fuel source. That's not its only use though. Straw blocks double as a decorative block in which you can craft them into blocks like slabs and stairs and use them to build whatever you like.

Lastly Packed Mud used to require Wheat, and now would require Straw instead so it makes sense.

![Straw Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f818bba825429b5225d74cfbf6791e5cf49ed11.png)
![Straw Bale and Grass Bale](https://i.imgur.com/ReEJHiR.png)

![separator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95d21aa4393cf17acf2cb3df73ca45013a3cc63e.png)

## Other small Additions and Features
- Added bunch of villager trades involving all the new added content.
- JEI compatibility, where you could see information on how to extract Wheat Grains from Wheat.
- Advancements has been added to help guide the player.
- Grass Bales exist as a way to store a lot of cut grass.
- You can use Cut Grass and Grass Bales as a fuel source instead of a cheap breeding food; though they're weaker than straw.

title: All In One
description: All in One is a mod for Minecraft that merges multiple reworked mods into one connected experience, adding new ores, a custom dimension, advanced tools, and balanced progression features.
body:
---

![All in One Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df6de4973bd2207af74e3723176a62be74aa975e.png)

**All in One** is a mod focused on recreating, reformulating, and integrating various projects into a single cohesive system. Based on the original descriptions published on CurseForge and Modrinth, the goal is to unify mechanics, resources, and progressions into a modular and interconnected experience.

The concept works as an **integrated mini modpack**, where each system communicates with the others, avoiding redundancies and creating a balanced, continuous progression.

This mod was made in MCreator and I have plans to port it to other Minecraft versions, but honestly I'm quite lazy and have no team whatsoever. It's just me.

*(This project was made to train my programming skills, and to add things I wished existed in vanilla Minecraft.)*

---

![Silver Ore Kit Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/616003981ccf5013a56675f0f5f1e04d57bed89b.png)

Adds **Silver** to the game, an intermediate ore between Iron and Diamond that can mine Obsidian and any block that requires Diamond-tier tools, such as Netherite. Also includes silver tools, weapons, and armor.

The mod also adds the **Potion of Luna's Wrath**, which grants bonus damage against undead enemies, serving as a specialized alternative to the Strength Potion.

---

![Easy Smithing Template Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5506aebab833f8726bd70f7ed5e7bca3d7aff43.png)

Lets you craft an **Empty Smithing Template** using Silver, which can then be converted into any Armor Trim at the Stonecutter. Reduces the need for excessive exploration to obtain templates.

The Silver Smithing Template can also be used as an armor trim decoration, in addition to being converted into other templates.

---

![Furious Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6662d4367a900ab7f9d3f1166d312b21f6d439a6.png)

Furious was the one I spent the most time making, and it holds a special place for me. The mod is centered around its dimension, **Tetracorea**, accessed via the Fusion Staff, an item that can only be obtained through trades with the Goblin Mercenary, a new mob found in the Overworld.

The dimension has four biomes with unique ores, new wood types, and capybaras. Staying in the dark deals continuous damage, so lighting is essential, but the entire dimension has no hostile mobs, making darkness the only real threat. Dimensional gear is stronger than Netherite but not the top tier of the mod, sitting firmly in the mid-game.

---

![Just Some Curios Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4c733d4c52f5716d713f29c880446cc1dbd47fb.png)

Adds **rings and accessories** equippable via Curios. Rings (Fire, Nature, Ocean, Sky, and Eternity) grant passive effects like speed, night vision, and slow falling. Balls and Chains remove unwanted effects such as levitation.

Everything is crafted with Tetracorea materials dropped by the Dimensional Boss, a mob many players already know: the Illusioner, the mob that was never officially added to Minecraft.

---

![Ultra's Silly Uranium Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/879e0e82f2e6bfcea952069c3c6fe967afe137f3.png)

Adds **Uranium and Steel**, two new material tiers. Steel sits between Diamond and Netherite. Uranium is obtained by upgrading Netherite at a Smithing Table, making it nearly the pinnacle of progression. The Wither drops Wither Bones, used to craft Wither Bone Meal, which is then used to produce Steel.

Additionally, the mod adds **Sulfur and Cinnabar**, inspired by the recent Minecraft update. Both can be found in the Nether.

---

![Quin's Weird Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c887f24f26be77c9a218dc69c8cda3dc8764f12.png)

A mod focused on **magma and "souls"**. Adds Hammers that break a flat 3x3 area and can also be used to crush blocks, with many recipes compatible with Create. Magma tools come with built-in auto-smelting and Fire Aspect by default.

On the soul side, a Phantom Sickle has a 10% chance to capture mobs as Spawn Eggs, which can then be used to craft **Pendant Necklaces**, each with unique effects like creative flight, invisibility, and item attraction. The mod also adds the **Astral Plane Clock**, an item that accelerates everything around the player, including furnaces, mob spawners, amethyst buds, and more. It works with Create machines, though they tend to behave unexpectedly.

On top of all that, it adds an enchantment called **Creator's Touch**, which allows you to pick up spawners, as well as blocks that normally have no drop, such as amethyst geodes.

---

![New Structures Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a2f957e08c921645b81f64f863a946b31db3672.png)

Adds three structures to the Overworld: **Ruins** (archaeology with a Brush), **Obelisk** (Ancient Scarab spawner), and **Forest Temple** (where the mini-boss Breeck is summoned).

Includes four Runes with utility effects, like granting potion effects or toggling rain on and off, and the Runic Totem of Undying, a reusable version of the classic totem with 3 uses.

---

![Nordic Holds Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eeab339d9c36b7b9f8088e92ebbad3e960bd3dc3.png)

Brings Viking and Nordic culture to Minecraft, adding a new structure, mobs, and blocks that make snowy biomes feel more alive. Explore new handcrafted Viking structures, fight unique mobs with their own loot, and expand your building palette with Nordic-themed blocks.

The mod also adds two new metal alloys: **Fool's Gold**, which counts as gold for Forge tags but performs like regular iron, and **Bog Iron**, a combat-focused metal with iron-level durability that deals significantly higher damage.

---

![Bagulho Craft Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5382b4b8609c02291d994ead036fbe74756e38e3.png)

Brings a more logical and efficient approach to Minecraft's progression, adding new recipes and mechanics that make item acquisition more intuitive and less reliant on luck or grinding. From alternative crafting methods to rebalanced resources, everything feels more coherent and practical.

Key additions include new materials like **White Glue**, **Crying Obsidian Powder**, and **Cave Roots**, plus new ways to obtain essentials like glowstone dust, ender pearls, flint, leather, and string.

It also adds two enchantments: **Expanded Impact**, which increases your pickaxe's mining area to a flat 3x3, and **Blessing of Eternity**, an enchantment similar to Mending that automatically repairs the item as long as it is equipped or held in your hand (with planned support for Curios slots in the future).

---

![Legendary Blue Horse](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/baf7bf4bc5cdb67f288d28437d238da35be350c2.png)

Takes you back to a forgotten era when the **Legendary Blue Horse** dominated the Overworld. This ancient species, surprisingly the original inventor of wine, went extinct long ago, but left traces behind in cold biomes and dark oak forests, where trees preserved their DNA inside mosquitoes trapped in amber.

The mod adds two new "ores": **Amber**, which generates in dirt, and **Bluestone**, which generates in tuff. Use amber to restore the legendary blue horse, and bluestone to craft ancient metal alloys from a time long past.

---

![Blood Birch Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d56ef028f26a2759157d808160510717bb4598bd.png)

Adds a rare and eerie tree to birch forest biomes, the **Blood Birch**, inspired by the iconic "eyes" meme and the game Bloodbark. These unsettling trees come with new plants and a sap collection mechanic, with more content planned for the future.

Honestly, the mod was remade mostly as an excuse to add a **Blood Armor** set. It integrates with the rest of the pack, brings new plants (some textures kept and improved from the [original mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/blood-birch)), and adds a dark, organic aesthetic to an otherwise peaceful biome.

---

![Forgotten Death Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72c5feece9b58552bec69064bb9d27e7f86db1c9.png)

An unpublished mod made by me during a phase where I was deeply into programming and death-themed mods. It adds new weapons that represent the top tier of the entire pack, an alternative way to capture mobs as Spawn Eggs beyond the Phantom Sickle, and a magic book that lets you cast various "spells".

The mod also features a unique armor set, a fusion of the **Legendary Blue Horse** and **Blood Birch** armors, granting permanent potion effects to whoever wears it. The rest of the items are left for you to discover and figure out on your own.

Description

BloodMoon is a simple horror-themed Minecraft plugin that occasionally turns a normal night into a terrifying “Red Moon” event.

When night falls, there is a random chance that the moon will turn red. During this time, the world becomes more dangerous and oppressive. Players will experience unsettling sounds, stronger mobs, and a constant feeling of being watched.

Features
Random Red Moon Event
A Blood Moon can start at sunset with a configurable chance. A subtle message warns players that something is wrong.
Horror Atmosphere
Ambient sounds like distant growls and strange noises play around players to create tension.
Enhanced Mobs
Hostile mobs become stronger, faster, and more aggressive during the event.
Shadow Creatures
Rare, fast, and nearly invisible enemies may appear and hunt players in the dark.
Player Pressure
Small negative effects (like slight slowness or reduced regeneration) increase the difficulty and fear factor.
Optimization

The plugin is lightweight and optimized:

Uses scheduled tasks with low frequency
Limits special mob spawns
Automatically disables during daytime
Goal

Create a simple but effective horror experience that makes every night feel unpredictable and dangerous, without impacting server performance.

title: Simple Block Replacer
description: A simple mod to replace blocks with other blocks.
body: ## Due to a lack of time, I am no longer updating this mod **Block Replacer** is a mod that lets you replace blocks in the world (upon chunk generation) with another block. The main intention of this mod is block deduplication. Imagine you have Biomes O' Plenty and Regions Unexplored at the same time. Well, you'd have 2 different sets of multiple wood types which is inconvenient, with this mod, you can only keep one set by replacing the other. All info on how to replace a block is located in the `blockreplacer.json5` config. **NOTE:** This mod has no retroactive capibilities, it will only replace newly placed/generated blocks since it's install. ## **Performance** I tested a config that replaces all stone blocks in the world with blocks of diamond and the performance hit was negligable. This is partially due to the fact that the mod intercepts the methods that sets the blocks during chunk generation and do the replacement directly there so it's almost as if nothing changed. ## **Modpack Usage** You may include this mod into your own modpacks as long as it is distributed through CurseForge, Modrinth, or any other recognized mainstream modding platforms that may exist in the future. ## **Is this not just [Block Swap](https://modrinth.com/mod/block-swap)?** Not quite. This mod is significantly simpler in implementation as all it does is replace blocks. It doesn't have a state swapper, or an ID remapper. Currently, Block Swap is getting a revamp for 1.21.1 but since the Author is busy and the scope of the mod has increased, it will be quite a while before that happens. I would like to state that this is **not a port of blockswap nor is it a good alterative for it.** I only made this mod because I needed a block replacer.

description: A server side resource generator mod
body:
# Resource Generator

This is a server side mod to place resource generators. Suitable for minigames, skyblock and so on.

## Configuration

This mod use command `/resgen` to control, need permission 0 in local game and permission 2 on dedicated server.

`/resgen <pos> add|remove|info|list|highlight`

- `...add <interval> (item <item> <count>|itemTag <tag>|block <block state>|blockTag <tag>|lootTable <loot table>`

Place a resource generator.

Note: For block & block tag, interval is count after broken the block.

- `...remove`

Remove a resource generator.

- `...info`

Get all info of a specific generator.

- `...list (chunk|range <distance>`

List generators in specific range.

- `...highlight (chunk|range <distance>`

Highlight generators with particles in specific range.

title: Scoreboard Pay
description: Pay by scoreboard 1.18+ Paper Spigot Bukkit
body:
# 💰 PayCommand

![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/API-Paper%2FSpigot%2FBukkit-blue)
![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.18--1.21.5-green)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow)
![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0-lightgrey)

---

## 🌍 English Description

**PayCommand** — a lightweight plugin that adds a `/pay` command using the **Minecraft scoreboard** as a currency system.

When launched for the first time, the plugin automatically creates:

plugins/PayCommand/config.yml

You can edit all text messages and the scoreboard name inside this file.

✅ Works on **Paper**, **Spigot**, and **Bukkit** servers  
✅ Supports **Minecraft 1.18+**

### 💸 Command:
/pay <nickname> <amount>

---

## 🇷🇺 Описание на русском

**PayCommand** — лёгкий плагин, добавляющий команду `/pay`,  
которая использует **scoreboard** в качестве системы перевода денег между игроками.

При первом запуске плагин автоматически создаёт:

plugins/PayCommand/config.yml

Ты можешь менять любые тексты и имя scoreboard в этом файле.

✅ Работает на **Paper**, **Spigot**, и **Bukkit**  
✅ Поддержка **Minecraft 1.18+**

### 💸 Команда:
/pay <ник> <число>

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

```yaml
# Example config.yml

# Scoreboard objective name
scoreboard-name: Money

# Messages
messages:
  only-player: "&cThis command is available only to players!"
  no-permission: "&cYou do not have permission to use this command!"
  usage: "&eUsage: /pay <player> <amount>"
  player-not-found: "&cPlayer not found!"
  self-pay: "&cYou cannot transfer money to yourself!"
  valid-number: "&cEnter a valid number!"
  valid-amount: "&cAmount must be greater than 0!"
  not-enough: "&cInsufficient funds!"
  send: "&aYou transferred &e%amount% &acoins to player &e%target%!"
  received: "&6You received &e%amount% &6coins from &e%player%!"
```
## 🔑 Permissions
Permission	                Description
paycommand.use	Allows the player to use the /pay command

If you use LuckPerms, give access with:


```
/lp user <player> permission set paycommand.use true
```


🧩 Compatibility
Minecraft Version	Paper	Spigot	Bukkit
1.18 – 1.21.5	     ✅	      ✅	  ✅

## 🧱 Installation
- Download the latest PayCommand.jar
  
- Place it into your server’s plugins folder
  
- Start the server — a config file will be generated
  
- Edit config.yml to customize messages and scoreboard

## 🧠 Notes
The plugin uses the Minecraft scoreboard system to store player balances

Make sure you have a scoreboard objective created (Money by default)

Compatible with most scoreboard-based economy setups

This project is licensed under the MIT License.
You can freely use, modify, and include it in your server packs.

title: TumiTranslator
description: Displays different messages depending on the language of each player
body:
# TumiTranslator

Add rich translations to you Minecraft Server or Proxy

## Installation
- Install [MiniPlaceholders](https://modrinth.com/plugin/miniplaceholders)
- Drag and drop on your plugins folder
- Start the server

## Features
- Add the translations you want, and use them anywhere on your server.
- Support for MiniPlaceholders placeholders. (Full support anywhere for global placeholders; 
for player placeholders, requires plugins compatible with MiniMessage using the latest version)

## Placeholders

In addition to providing translations that can be used anywhere on your server,
TumiTranslator also provides placeholders for using your translations.
This is the recommended way to use translations, usable in plugins compatible with MiniPlaceholders.

- `<tumi_translation:"tumi.welcome">`

Returns a translation in the language of the target/executor.
If the translation does not exist in the specified language,
it will attempt to use the translation in the configured default language.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SpH1UuKm/images/6dc93e5f95816b0963159d37f1466ef058367c3d.png)

- `<tumi_translation_by_locale:"tumi.welcome":ES>`

Returns a translation in the specified language.
If the translation does not exist in the specified language,
it will attempt to use the translation in the default language configured.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SpH1UuKm/images/3c39bfb4a252aca38ac87559e4394df1d0aa7ea1.png)

## Usage in General Translations

The recommended use of TumiTranslator is through its MiniPlaceholders placeholders.
But if you want to use them anywhere else, it is possible. Here are some examples.

Please note that player placeholders are not yet supported in this way of displaying placeholders.
[This feature will be applied to MiniMessage in future versions.](https://github.com/KyoriPowered/adventure/pull/1300)

### Lang Tag

- `<lang:"tumi.welcome":ES>`

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SpH1UuKm/images/b8b08bdee11d9b2d46518eaf6ef15255fb24970c.png)

title: EcoCraft [LITE]
description: [LITE VERSION] A modpack with dinosaurs, machines, trains and all kinds of sorts. Have a completely different origin, upgrade your path and level up before your enemies do. Features powerful bosses and weapons to fight them! Recommended with friends!
body:
![EcoCraft Long Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e36c445216615770b20c0bc1d97eef2a76c0ecd_0.webp)

## 🌿 EcoCraft LITE

**MineWorks: EcoCraft LITE** is a performance-friendly version of the original *EcoCraft* experience — designed for players with **low to mid-end PCs** who still want to enjoy everything this **RPG-meets-cooperative-survival** modpack has to offer.

It keeps all the core systems: **races, jobs, classes, seasons, party gameplay, automation, exploration, and building**, while removing heavier visual and audio mods for a **smoother experience**.

And best of all: it's **100% compatible with the full version** — so you can still play with your friends on the same world or server.

### **_Not recommended to use this version as a host, some world-generation and mechanics may break!_**

---

### 🧬 Play Your Role. Choose Your Race. Level Your Class.

Just like in the full version, players choose a **unique race (Origins)** and combine it with a **profession and RPG class** using **RPG Series**, **JobsAddon**, and **LevelZ**.

🎯 Whether you're a **Fairy Alchemist**, a **Fox Rogue**, or a **Druid Warrior**, the Lite version lets you experience all the class-based and race-based gameplay **without compromise**.

---

### 🌍 A World Worth Exploring — Light and Efficient

The Lite version keeps the stunning world generation from **Terralith**, **Tectonic**, **Better Nether**, **Better End**, and **YUNG’s structures**, ensuring every biome, cave, and ruin is still there, ready for exploration and settlement.

🌾 The **Serene Seasons** system is also present, preserving survival depth and biome interaction — crops, food, and weather still matter.

🏙️ You can still build immersive towns using core **decorative mods**, just with less rendering overhead.

🏺 **Archaeology**: Discover ancient ruins and unearth hidden treasures. Let your shovel guide you to forgotten history.

🧟 **New Creatures and Mobs**: From wild beasts to fantasy monsters - the world is more alive (and deadly) than ever.

🏯 **Dungeons and Ruins**: Explore new dangerous dungeons filled with traps, lore, and loot - now lighter but just as thrilling.

---

### 🔄 Smarter Early-Game, Deeper End-Game

* 🪓 **Early-Stage Mod**: Early game has been redesigned — you’ll start with simpler tools and work your way up through a more immersive, slower-paced tech tree.
* 🎣 **Fishing Mini-Game**: Fishing is now an interactive skill — and a fun way to relax while progressing.
* 💎 **TLOTD – Beyond Diamond**: In the late game, surpass traditional vanilla limits by crafting gear stronger than diamond and exploring a **new dimension** packed with resources and threats.

---

### ⚙️ Automation & Organization Included

🚂 Full support for **Create** and **Tom's Simple Storage** means you can still build amazing machines, factories, and storage systems.

🤝 The **party system** remains fully functional, with **shared XP, buffs, and collaboration tools**.

---

### 💻 Optimised for Lower-End PCs

The LITE version removes around 60 heavier mods, including:

* Physics-based sound and ambient audio systems
* Visual shaders, detailed animations, environmental effects
* Extra immersive UI and rendering-based enhancements

This improves performance **without affecting gameplay**.

---

### 💬 Still Multiplayer-Ready

* 🧩 Fully compatible with the **Essential Mod** for easy world hosting and co-op play
* 🎙️ **Voice Chat mod included**, so you can communicate in-game
* 🤝 Cross-compatible with the **full version** of EcoCraft — just make sure you're using the same world/mods on the server

---

### ⚠️ System Requirements & Tips

This is a **demanding** modpack. Make sure to:

* Use **at least 8GB RAM** (12GB recommended, 5GB minimum allocated to Minecraft) (-1GB if not hosting)
* Play with **8+ render distance** for optimal immersion
* Disable shaders manually if needed
* Lower-end PCs should avoid this pack, or expect real-world suffering

---

### 🔧 Ideal For:

* Players with **lower-spec PCs or laptops**
* Those wanting a **smoother FPS** while keeping the **core experience intact**
* Friends who want to play **cross-version** without losing compatibility

- 🔗 Fully compatible with the full *MineWorks: EcoCraft* modpack
- 🚀 Optimised for performance and stability
- 🎤 Voice chat and multiplayer included
- 🧩 Essential Mod ready

title: SilenceVS
description: Server-side mod that filters out annoying console log spam from other mods
body:
SilenceVS is a lightweight server-side mod designed to clean up your server console by filtering out repetitive and annoying log messages.

### Features:
- Server-side only - no client installation needed
- Configurable filters via simple text file
- Hot reload without server restart
- Default filter for Valkyrien Skies collision warnings
- Support for custom patterns and regex

### Commands:
_/silencevs reload_ - Reload filter config (requires OP)

### Configuration:
Add patterns to filter in config/silencevs/logs-filter.txt, for example:


```
Collision box is too big!
Cannot keep up! Is the server overloaded?
```


More information can be found on the github repo.

body:
As the name suggests, Kai Fixes Granite improves the texture of granite and polished granite in Minecraft to make them more usable as building blocks. 
________________________________________________________________________________________________

This resource pack is a small part of a much larger resource pack being worked on called Kai Fixes Minecraft.

The concept behind what Kai Fixes Minecraft is bringing to the table is:
- Significantly reduce redundancies within the block textures

- Greatly increase the building opportunities from blocks that often get overlooked

- Reduce the unintentional texture repetition effect without heavy reliance on noise or random block variants by focusing on patterns that seamlessly splice together and proper shading

- Identify colors missing from the game and the best texture to go with that color while maintaining balance with what feels appropriate for the block in accordance with its fit in the game

- Maintain the highest quality of block textures in the Minecraft ecosystem

title: Soulbound Remnants
description: Keep some items on death, like armor and tools.
body:
**Overview**
-
This mod let's you keep some items on death. Includes armor, tiered items (tools, weapons) and rare items. 

**How it works**
-
When you open a new world the *keepInventory* gamerule is set to true. If you die, instead of keeping the whole inventory, only armor, tools, rare items and configured items will be kept, everything else is copied, cleared from you inventory and spawned into the world at the location you died.

title: Sculk Virus
description: The player will be able to get infected with a strange sculk virus. The virus will evolve and eventually give different buffs and debuffs. Is it a gift or a virus? It's up to you.
body:
# Virus
## Stage 1
The player receives particles and a darkness effect every 8 minutes
## Stage 2
The player receives the mining fatigue effect
The effect of darkness every 8 minutes
Lives are reduced to 9
## Stage 3
The player receives the slowness effect
The effect of weakness every 10 minutes
Lives are reduced to 8
## Stage 4
Lives are reduced to 7
The player receives one of three debuffs
1. Water causes damage to the player
2. The shield imposes a nausea effect and totem of undying imposes a hunger effect on the player
3. All the arrows disappear from the player and because of this he cannot shoot
## Stage 5
All lives are returned to the player
Slowness,weakness and mining fatigue remove from the player
The player gets the hero of the village effect
## Stage 6
The player gets one of the five buffs and its particles
The potion that treats the virus does not work on the player
1. The player recovers lives from damage
2. When running, the player accelerates and takes less damage
3. The player gets the effect of fire resistance and resistance
4. The player gets 4 extra lives and a resistance and regeneration effect if an infected player or a warden is next to him
5. The player gets the effect dolphins grace and conduit power
# Crafts
## How to craft items
To craft items, you need to take one item in the main hand and the second item in the second hand
## Virus Potion
It needs an echo shard and a potion, an explosive potion or an arrow
## A Healing Potion
It needs an echo shard and a golden apple or enchanted golden apple and arrow
The antidote cures the virus
## The antidote
It needs heart of the sea and sculk catalyst
The antidote cures the virus and gives it immunity
## A reset Potion
He needs a golden apple and a enchanted golden apple.
The potion changes the debuff of 4 stages

title: Coloful Lighting (Glowworks)
description: A helper mod to create an emitters.json and filters.json with all of detected blocks
body:
<center>

# Colorful Lighting: Glowworks

## 📖 About 📖

</center>

Are you fed up with adding 25–100 blocks or more to emitters.json or filters.json for Colorful Lighting? That is what this mod is for!

This Mod serves as an addon to [Colorful lighting Sodium Compat](https://modrinth.com/mod/colorful-lighting-sodium-compat).
 This is more of a "helper" mod in that it can identify every light 
block (LightType) and glass block (GlassType) in any mod. It will be 
added to a configuration file, which lets you set the color of one or 
more blocks. This will relieve you of the heavy work. 
There are 3 configs:
- `glowworks-blacklist.toml` - where GlassType or LightBlock can be excluded from the config. The emitters.json and filters.json are also excluded, too.
- `glowworks-emitter.toml` - where you can configure the LightType's color
- `glowworks-filter.toml` - where you can configure the GlassType's color

There will be examples in these three files. I advise you to read the 
explanation of Colorful Lighting in order to comprehend the function of 
emitters.json & filters.json

<center>

# ❓ F. A. Q.❓

</center>

#### Do I have permission to include this mod in my modpack?

Feel free to add this mod to your modpacks. This mod will be helpful for any modpack DEV to develop their modpack.

#### How to get the Glowworks to generate the `emitter.json` & `filters.json` for me to add to the resource pack?

Go to configs folder & Find glowworks-client.toml to set save_debug_resources to TRUE. The files will be saved in `~/.minecraft/debug/generated_resource_pack/glowworks/...`.

Do not worry about it, it's defaulted to TRUE since v1.0.4 BUT if you are planning to keep using Glowworks, then you can set it to FALSE and use it as is. ﻿

#### What if I remove Glowworks, will it works as before?

These files (emitters.json & filters.json) will not be saved unless you did above and know how to add these files to a custom resource pack.

<center>

# 📦Dependencies📦

</center>

#### Required Dependencies: 
- [Colorful-Lighting (Sodium Compat)](https://modrinth.com/mod/colorful-lighting-sodium-compat)
- [Moonlight Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/moonlight)

title: MessageCooldownPRO
description: Adds a cooldown to messages based on rank
body:
MessageCooldownPRO
The Ultimate Message Cooldown Solution for Your Minecraft Server

MessageCooldownPRO is a powerful, lightweight plugin designed to prevent chat spam on your Minecraft server. With its intuitive permission-based cooldown system, you can effectively manage how frequently players can send messages, creating a cleaner, more enjoyable chat experience for everyone.
Key Features

⏱️ Tiered Cooldown System

Default tier: 5-second cooldown for regular players

Premium tier: 3-second cooldown for donators or trusted players

VIP tier: 1-second cooldown for your most valued players

Bypass permission: No cooldown for staff members

🛠️ Advanced Configuration

Fully customizable cooldown times for each permission tier

Personalize cooldown messages with color codes

Custom formatting with eye-catching divider lines

Simple, clean notification design

💼 Administrative Tools

Reset cooldowns for individual players

Clear all active cooldowns at once

Hot-reload configuration without server restart

Comprehensive permission system

⚡ Performance Optimized

Minimal CPU usage

No database required

Efficient player tracking system

Compatible with all major Minecraft versions (1.20+)

Why Choose MessageCooldownPRO?

🔹 Simple Yet Powerful

While other anti-spam plugins come with complicated setups and features you'll never use, our plugin focuses on doing one thing exceptionally well. It stops chat spam without the bloat.

🔹 Player-Friendly Design

The clear, customizable cooldown notifications ensure players always know exactly how long they need to wait, reducing frustration and confusion.

🔹 Reward Your Supporters

With the tiered permission system, you can offer faster message rates as a perk for donors or long-time members, creating an additional incentive for supporting your server.

🔹 Perfect for All Server Types

Whether you're running a survival, creative, minigame, or roleplay server, MessageCooldownPRO adapts perfectly to your needs. It's especially valuable on high-population servers where chat can quickly become overwhelming.
Commands

/msgcooldown reload - Reload the plugin configuration
/msgcooldown reset <player> - Reset cooldown for a specific player
/msgcooldown reset all - Reset cooldowns for all players

Permissions

msgcooldown.default - Access to default cooldown (5 seconds)
msgcooldown.premium - Access to premium cooldown (3 seconds)
msgcooldown.vip - Access to VIP cooldown (1 second)
msgcooldown.bypass - Bypass cooldown completely
msgcooldown.admin - Access to administrative commands

Installation

Download MessageCooldownPRO.jar

Place it in your server's plugins folder

Restart your server or use a plugin loader

Configure settings in the config.yml file (optional)

Assign permissions to your players ( for example for vip just put whatever type of cooldown u want )

Support and Feedback

We're dedicated to making MessageCooldownPRO the best chat cooldown plugin available. If you have suggestions, encounter any issues, or just want to share your experience, please reach out through our support channels.

MessageCooldownPRO - ~~Chat Management Made Simple~~

This modpack uses the [Vulkan graphics API](https://modrinth.com/mod/vulkanmod), offering significantly better performance and smooth gameplay compared to the traditional OpenGL renderer. Thanks to modern management of graphic resources and more efficient use of multithreading, the pack significantly reduces lag, increases frames per second (FPS) and improves the game's responsiveness - especially on low-end and mid-range computers.

Additional advantages:

- Faster loading of worlds and chunks

- More stable work with shaders and advanced textures

- Better compatibility with modern graphics cards

**Ideal for players who want to squeeze the maximum performance from Minecraft without sacrificing graphic quality.**

title: Hwyala
description: A fork of Hwyla that fixes the Comparison Contract Violation.
body:
**I only made this because I was tired of rolling bad RNG for the random chance for HWYLA to crash your pack on startup while testing my modpack.**

 
**HWYALA** (pronounced "Hwhy-a-la", a la "Coo-Hwhip") - a fork of [HWYLA](https://github.com/TehNut-Mods/HWYLA) by [TehNut](https://github.com/TehNut-Mods), which is itself a fork of WAILA by [ProfMobius](https://minecraft.curseforge.com/members/ProfMobius).

## What does this fork do?
There's a bug in HWYLA that will occasionally cause a crash on launch due to a violation of the transitive property (a>b,b>c => a>c) that is enforced by the general Java contract for comparison methods.
This fork fixes that bug by adding 4 lines of code.

## Notable Lesser-Known Features
- If JEI/HEI is installed, you can use Numpad 3 and Numpad 4 to look up the recipe of blocks in the world.
- You can change the colors and text formatting of the tooltip by navigating to the in-game config, opening the "Waila" options screen, and selecting "Format content...".
- If you are having issues with tooltip handlers added by mods, you can run "/dumphandlers" which will produce a text file with all registered handlers and what types they are registered to.
- The Narrator can be toggled for the tooltip. This will use the system's text-to-speech library to tell you what you're looking at.
- If you think having the item being displayed in the tooltip is redundant, you can disable that.

---

I have no plans of actively maintaining this fork as the mod is on the whole hilariously stable, but feel free to PR with any fixes you come up with and I might merge if they don't make anything explode.

 

Any and all plugins/addons/compatibilities/what-have-you created with the original mod are 100% compatible with this fork.

 

_This fork is permitted under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license._

 

Usage of this mod is allowed for all packs.

 

I have no interest in any other version of Minecraft and will not be forking any other versions of HWYLA.

title: MiguelCrates
description: Inject excitement into MiguelEconomy with fully customizable, animated loot crates! creating a unique reward system for your server
body:
# MiguelCrates

MiguelCrates turns simple item giving into an event. It adds fully animated, exciting lootboxes to your world that hook into your economy and keep players coming back for "just one more spin."

---

## How to Create Your Own Custom Crate

User the online Crate Builder : https://miguel-economy-builder.vercel.app/crate-builder

OR


1.  **Find the Folder:** Go to your server’s config folder (`config/migueleconomy/crates`).
2.  **Copy & Paste:** Take an existing file (like `common.json`) and copy it. Rename it to something like `vip_crate.json`.
3.  **Edit the Details:** Open it with any text editor (like Notepad).
    * Change the **Name** to "VIP Crate".
    * Pick a **Texture** (color) for how it looks.
    * **List your Rewards:** Simply type in the items you want (e.g., `"minecraft:diamond"`), how many to give, and how rare they should be.
    * *Tip: You can even make it run commands (with custom icons!) or give money.*
4.  **Restart:** Restart your server, and your new crate is ready to be placed!


<details>
<summary>Comple Crate Guide</summary>

# Creating and Editing Crates

MiguelCrates uses JSON configuration files to define crates. This allows you to easily create new crates or modify existing ones without changing the mod code.

## Location

Crate configuration files are located in the `config/migueleconomy/crates/` directory of your Minecraft instance.

- **Server/Client**: `config/migueleconomy/crates/`

Each crate is a separate `.json` file. The file name determines the unique ID of the crate (e.g., `common.json` -> `common`).

## Crate Structure

The basic structure of a crate JSON file is as follows:

```json
{
  "display_name": "My Custom Crate",
  "description": "A description of what's inside.",
  "icon": "minecraft:chest",
  "texture": "miguelcrates:block/common_crate",
  "rewards": [
    ...
  ],
  "obtain": {
    "sources": [
      ...
    ]
  }
}
```

### Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `display_name` | String | The name shown in GUIs and items. |
| `description` | String | Description text shown in tooltips. |
| `icon` | String | The Item ID used to represent the crate (e.g., `minecraft:chest`). |
| `texture` | String | Path to the texture for the custom renderer (usually `miguelcrates:block/<name>`). |
| `rewards` | List | A list of possible rewards (see below). |
| `obtain` | Object | (Optional) Defines how players can get this crate (see below). |

### Simplified Enchantments (Recommended)
Instead of using complex NBT strings, you can use the `enchantments` block to add enchantments to an item. This works for both books and tools.

```json
{
    "item": "minecraft:enchanted_book",
    "quantity": 1,
    "enchantments": {
        "minecraft:sharpness": 5,
        "minecraft:unbreaking": 3
    },
    "weight": 10
}
```

### Advanced NBT
For more complex data (attributes, names, etc.), you can still use the `nbt` field.
```json
{
    "item": "minecraft:diamond_sword",
    "nbt": "{display:{Name:'{\"text\":\"Excalibur\"}'}}",
    "weight": 5
}
```

## Rewards

The `rewards` list contains objects defining what players can win.

```json
"rewards": [
  {
    "item": "minecraft:diamond",
    "quantity": 2,
    "weight": 10
  },
  {
    "command": "give @p minecraft:stone 64",
    "weight": 50
  },
  {
    "item": "minecraft:experience_bottle",
    "command": "xp add @p 5 levels",
    "weight": 10
  },
  {
    "item": "migueleconomy:money",
    "nbt": "{MoneyValue:100L}",
    "weight": 20
  }
]
```

- **`item`**: Resource location of the item (e.g., `minecraft:iron_sword`). If used with `command`, it acts as the icon.
- **`command`**: Command to execute. Use `@p` for the player opening the crate.
- **`name`**: (Optional) Custom display name for the reward (e.g. "5 Levels of XP").
- **`quantity`**: (Optional, default 1) Number of items to give.
- **`nbt`**: (Optional) NBT data string for the item.
- **`weight`**: The chance weight. Higher weight = higher chance.
  - Probability = `weight / total_weight_of_all_rewards`

## Obtain Methods

The `obtain` section defines how crates are generated in the world. It contains a list of `sources`.

### 1. Crafting (`craft`)

Allows players to craft the crate in a crafting table.

```json
{
  "type": "craft",
  "recipe": {
    "type": "minecraft:crafting_shaped",
    "category": "misc",
    "pattern": [
      "AAA",
      "ABA",
      "AAA"
    ],
    "key": {
      "A": { "item": "minecraft:planks" },
      "B": { "item": "minecraft:chest" }
    },
    "result": {
      "id": "miguelcrates:crate",
      "count": 1,
      "components": {
        "minecraft:custom_data": { "CrateId": "your_crate_id" }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### 2. Mob Drops (`kill`)

Drops when a specific entity is killed.

```json
{
  "type": "kill",
  "entity": "minecraft:zombie",
  "chance": 0.05
}
```

- **`entity`**: Entity ID (e.g., `minecraft:creeper`, `minecraft:ender_dragon`).
- **`chance`**: Probability from 0.0 to 1.0 (0.05 = 5%).

### 3. Loot Tables (`loot_table`)

Injects the crate into vanilla loot tables (chests).

```json
{
  "type": "loot_table",
  "id": "minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon",
  "chance": 0.1
}
```

- **`id`**: The Loot Table ID to inject into.
- **`chance`**: Probability the crate will appear in the chest.

## Example File (`example.json`)

```json
{
  "display_name": "Example Crate",
  "description": "An example configuration.",
  "icon": "minecraft:barrel",
  "texture": "miguelcrates:block/common_crate",
  "rewards": [
    {
      "item": "minecraft:apple",
      "quantity": 5,
      "weight": 50
    },
    {
      "item": "minecraft:golden_apple",
      "weight": 10
    }
  ],
  "obtain": {
    "sources": [
      {
        "type": "kill",
        "entity": "minecraft:skeleton",
        "chance": 0.02
      }
    ]
  }
}
```


</details>



---

## In-Game Commands (Admin)

Use these commands to manage crates.

### Give a Crate
` /miguelcrates give <player> <crate_id> [amount]`

* **Example 1 (Give yourself a Rare Crate):**
    `/miguelcrates give @p rare`
* **Example 2 (Give a player 5 Common Crates):**
    `/miguelcrates give PlayerName common 5`

### Restore Default Crates
`/miguelcrates default <name|all>`
* **Restores missing or deleted default crates.**
* Example: `/miguelcrates default all` (Restores all 20+ themed crates)
* Example: `/miguelcrates default miner` (Restores just the Miner crate)

### Reload Config
`/miguelcrates reload`
* Refreshes the mod if you edited the JSON files while the server was running.

### Open Menu (Shortcuts)
`/crates`, `/crate`, or `/box`

![ROADMAP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/609942d2b545a3d286d0b0fc63027a22e9b6010a.png)

title: Excavate
description: Area mining enchantment for all tools | 3x3 | 5x5
body:
# Excavate

Area mining enchantment for NeoForge 1.21.1.

![Mod preview, Excavation II](https://github.com/TophC7/Excavate/raw/main/public/preview.webp)

**Excavation I** affects a 3x3 area.
**Excavation II** affects a 5x5 area.
Crouch to use single-block interactions.

## How it works

- Enchant any pickaxe, axe, shovel, or hoe
- Mine a block and the surrounding area breaks as well
- Hoe tilling, shovel pathing, and axe stripping also affect the surrounding area
- Each block drops its own correct loot
- Only blocks your tool can actually mine are affected
- Tool takes durability per block broken and stops if it breaks
- Unbreakable blocks (bedrock, etc.) are never affected

### Crop harvesting

Hoes with Excavation harvest mature crops in an area. Auto-replant is
enabled by default and one seed is consumed from each crop's drops to replant it.
If no seed drops, that crop is left empty. You can toggle auto-replant in the config screen.

## Configuration

Open the config screen from the Mods menu. Settings:

| Setting              | Scope  | Default | Description                                                  |
| -------------------- | ------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Show Highlight       | Client | On      | Show the area outline preview                                |
| Auto-Replant         | Common | On      | Replant crops automatically when area-harvesting             |
| Area Hoe Tilling     | Common | On      | Let hoes till dirtlike blocks in an area                     |
| Area Shovel Pathing  | Common | On      | Let shovels create dirt paths in an area                     |
| Area Axe Actions     | Common | On      | Let axes strip logs and apply other right-click axe actions in an area |

## Getting the enchantment

- **Enchanting table** - rare (same weight as Fortune)
- **Villager trades** - available from librarians
- **Commands** - `/enchant @s excavate:excavation 2`

## Compatibility

- Works with any modded tool that uses vanilla tool tags
- Supports [Enchantment Descriptions](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/enchantment-descriptions) for in-game tooltip text
- Requires NeoForge 21.1.219+

## License

GPL-3.0-or-later
