title: AwesomeNeeded
description: The ultimate all-in-one Essentials replacement with full in-game UIs, economy, shops, claims, kits, crates, rewards, RTP, TPA, scoreboards, messages, moderation tools, and so much more — all in one plugin.
body:
# AwesomeNeeded - All-in-One Essentials Framework

**The ultimate essentials plugin for Minecraft servers with full in-game GUI support!**

AwesomeNeeded is a comprehensive, feature-rich essentials framework designed for Minecraft 1.19.x - 1.21.x servers running Paper, Spigot, or Bukkit. Built from the ground up with performance and usability in mind, it provides everything you need to run a professional Minecraft server.

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🎮 **Player Features**
- **Teleportation System** - TPA requests, random teleport (RTP), spawn points, homes, and warps
- **Economy System** - Built-in economy with Vault integration for compatibility
- **Shop System** - Fully customizable in-game shop with GUI interface
- **Kits** - Timed kits with cooldowns and permissions (includes 3 default kits)
- **Crates** - Reward crate system with animations (includes 3 default crates)
- **Claims** - Land protection system with trust management
- **Homes & Warps** - Multiple home locations and server-wide warp points
- **Backpacks** - Extra inventory space for players
- **Achievements** - Custom achievement system with rewards

### 👑 **VIP Features**
- **Fly Time** - Timed flight system with automatic management
- **Nicknames** - Custom display names with color support
- **Daily/Weekly Rewards** - Scheduled rewards for player retention
- **Boosters** - XP and money multipliers
- **Custom Heads** - Access to custom player head database

### 🛡️ **Moderation Tools**
- **Punishment System** - Mute, ban, kick, warn with duration support
- **Anti-Cheat** - Built-in cheat detection system
- **Action Logging** - Comprehensive logging of player actions
- **Admin Tools** - Invsee, freeze, vanish, and more
- **Chat Management** - Chat filters, formatting, and moderation

### 📊 **Server Management**
- **Scoreboard** - Dynamic sidebar with live player stats
- **Tab List** - Customizable player list formatting
- **Performance Tools** - Anti-lag features and resource monitoring
- **Module System** - Toggle features on/off as needed
- **World Manager** - Multi-world support and management
- **Region Titles** - Location-based title messages

### 🔧 **Utility Commands**
- `/workbench` - Open crafting table anywhere
- `/anvil` - Open anvil interface
- `/enderchest` - Access your ender chest
- `/hat` - Wear any item as a hat
- `/trash` - Disposable trash GUI
- `/heal` - Heal yourself or others
- `/feed` - Restore hunger
- And 30+ more utility commands!

---

## 🎯 What Makes AwesomeNeeded Different?

### **All-in-One Solution**
Stop juggling multiple plugins! AwesomeNeeded combines 40+ essential features into one optimized package.

### **GUI-First Design**
Every feature has an intuitive in-game GUI - no need to memorize complex commands or edit config files in-game.

### **Performance Focused**
- Efficient database handling with HikariCP connection pooling
- Async operations where possible
- Minimal server impact with optimized code

### **Highly Configurable**
- 6 configuration files for complete customization
- JSON-based data persistence for transparency
- Module system to enable/disable features

### **Modern & Maintained**
- Built with Adventure API for modern text components
- Supports latest Minecraft versions (1.19.x - 1.21.x)
- Regular updates and bug fixes

---

## 📦 Default Content Included

### **Kits (3 Pre-configured)**
- **Starter Kit** - Stone tools, food, basic supplies (24h cooldown)
- **VIP Kit** - Iron gear, better items (12h cooldown)
- **MVP Kit** - Diamond gear, premium items (6h cooldown)

### **Crates (3 Pre-configured)**
- **Common Crate** - Diamonds, emeralds, gold, iron
- **Rare Crate** - Diamond blocks, netherite scraps, totems
- **Epic Crate** - Netherite ingots, elytra, beacons

---

## 🔌 Integration Support

### **Optional Dependencies (Soft Dependencies)**
- **Vault** - Economy integration (has built-in fallback)
- **PlaceholderAPI** - Dynamic placeholder support
- **LuckPerms** - Advanced permission integration

All integrations are optional - AwesomeNeeded works perfectly standalone!

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

1. Download `AwesomeNeeded-1.0.0.0.jar`
2. Place in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Start/restart your server
4. Configuration files auto-generate in `plugins/AwesomeNeeded/`
5. Customize configs to your liking
6. Use `/awesome` to access the main control panel

---

## 🎮 Command Overview

**Teleportation:** `/tpa`, `/tpaccept`, `/tpdeny`, `/rtp`, `/spawn`, `/home`, `/warp`, `/back`

**Economy:** `/balance`, `/pay`, `/shop`, `/eco`

**Features:** `/kit`, `/crate`, `/claim`, `/fly`, `/daily`, `/weekly`

**Social:** `/nick`, `/afk`, `/msg`, `/reply`

**Moderation:** `/ban`, `/kick`, `/mute`, `/warn`, `/freeze`, `/invsee`

**Utilities:** `/workbench`, `/anvil`, `/heal`, `/feed`, `/hat`, `/trash`

**Admin:** `/setspawn`, `/setwarp`, `/eco`, `/module`, `/awesome admin`

And many more! Full command list in documentation.

---

## 📋 Permissions

All permissions follow the format: `awesome.<feature>`

- `awesome.user` - Basic player features
- `awesome.vip` - VIP features (fly, nicknames, etc.)
- `awesome.admin` - Administrative commands
- `awesome.*` - All permissions

Granular permissions available for every feature!

---

## 💾 Data Storage

- **Configuration:** YAML files for easy editing
- **Player Data:** JSON files for transparency and portability
- **Database:** MySQL or SQLite support with HikariCP pooling
- **Automatic Backups:** Configurable data backup system

---

## 🌐 Server Compatibility

- **Minecraft Versions:** 1.19.x, 1.20.x, 1.21.x
- **Server Software:** Paper (recommended), Spigot, Bukkit
- **Java Version:** Java 17 or higher
- **Dependencies:** None required (all optional)

---

## 📊 Statistics

- **40+ Manager Systems** - Comprehensive feature coverage
- **40+ Commands** - With tab completion support
- **6 Config Files** - Complete customization
- **4.7 MB** - Lightweight and optimized
- **Zero Dependencies Required** - Works standalone
- **1.19+ Support** - Modern Minecraft compatibility

---

## ⚡ Performance

AwesomeNeeded is designed with performance in mind:

- Optimized database queries with prepared statements
- Async operations for I/O-heavy tasks
- Efficient event handling with minimal overhead
- Smart caching to reduce redundant operations
- Resource monitoring and anti-lag features included

Suitable for servers of all sizes - from small community servers to large networks!

---

## 🎨 Customization

Every aspect is customizable:
- Custom messages in `messages.yml`
- Feature toggles in `config.yml`
- Shop items in `shop.yml`
- Kit contents in `kits.yml`
- Crate rewards in `crates.yml`
- Module states in memory

Make it yours!

---

## 🏆 Why Choose AwesomeNeeded?

✅ **Complete Solution** - Everything you need in one plugin
✅ **User-Friendly** - Intuitive GUIs for all features
✅ **Performance** - Optimized for minimal server impact
✅ **Flexible** - Enable/disable features as needed
✅ **Modern** - Built with latest APIs and best practices
✅ **Supported** - Active development and updates
✅ **Free** - Open source and free to use

---

## 📝 License

AwesomeNeeded is open source software.

---

## 🙏 Support the Project

If you enjoy AwesomeNeeded:
- 📢 Share with other server owners
- 🐛 Report bugs to help us improve
- 💡 Suggest features you'd like to see
- 📝 Write a review on Modrinth

---

**Ready to transform your Minecraft server? Download AwesomeNeeded today!**

title: Origins:Aquanoid
description: An ancient race whose bodies are composed of condensed moisture. They thrive in the aquatic realm of the Edge but suffer discomfort and slowed movement in the fiery Lower World.
body:
Aquanoid — an ancient race of aquatic beings

Aquanoid is an ancient race whose existence is intrinsically bound to the aquatic element. Their bodies are composed of condensed moisture, enabling them to feel completely at home in the aqueous expanses of the End—a dimension reminiscent of their native habitat. Their forms and physical structure are exquisitely adapted to aquatic life, rendering them remarkably agile and swift in watery environments.

However, the Nether, with its fiery and arid nature, induces physical discomfort in them and significantly hinders their mobility. Their bodies experience a profound dissonance within this dimension, adversely affecting their physical capabilities and overall condition.

Abilities and Traits:

Alien Dimension: In the Nether, Aquanoids suffer from Slowness I, diminishing their speed and reaction time due to environmental incompatibility.

Native Habitat: While in the End, they benefit from continuous health regeneration, allowing swift recovery from injuries and sustained combat effectiveness.

Unstable Anatomy: Their maximum health is reduced by two hearts, a consequence of their fluid nature and mutable physical form.

Spatial Fluidity: Their hitbox is perpetually reduced due to involuntary spatial distortion, granting them enhanced evasion during dodges and attacks. Size modifier: 0.8.

Dietary Specialization: They can only consume cooked or raw salmon and chorus fruit, reflecting their natural dietary restrictions.

Water Droplets: The character is perpetually surrounded by dripping water particles, emphasizing their aquatic essence.

Spatial Instability: Upon activation, they teleport three times at varying intervals, creating an effect of unpredictable movement.

Salmon Dash: A rapid forward dash that grants Strength, Speed, Jump Boost III, Resistance I, and Regeneration I for 20 seconds—ideal for swift advancement or evading attacks.

Hydrodynamic Form: Their aquatic nature allows them to remain submerged twice as long as ordinary beings, making them exceptionally effective in underwater environments.

Made for Kikosikus

title: Kindred Souls
description: Protect or be protected
body:
# 🌙 Kindred Souls  
*A Minecraft mod about eternal bonds between two connected spirits.*

---

## 🕊 Overview
**Kindred Souls** explores the sacred connection known as **soulbinding** — a supernatural bond linking two players, the **Guardian** and the **Ward**.  
Their lives are intertwined, their pain and healing shared. When one suffers, the other feels it.

This mod is designed for **multiplayer** or **Essential singleplayer**, where cooperation and trust shape your destiny.  
Your strength lies not in solitude — but in your bond.

---

## 💞 Gameplay
When you first join a world, you’ll face a divine choice:

### ✨ Choose Your Role
- **Guardian** – The protector. When your Ward is harmed, you share their pain.  
- **Ward** – The protected. Your life is linked to your Guardian, your strength flowing through the bond.

Once bonded:
- **Damage Sharing:** When the Ward takes damage, the Guardian also takes equal damage.  
- **Healing Sharing:** When the Ward heals, the Guardian heals too.  
- **Lethal Bond:** If the **Ward** dies, their **Guardian** dies as well — but the Ward survives if the Guardian falls.  
  - If both are bound using `/soulboundtwoway`, their fates become *mutually fatal.*

Your destinies are forever intertwined — **two souls, one heartbeat.**

---

## 🔮 Ability & Addon System (New!)
Inspired by the *Origins* mod, **Kindred Souls** introduces an expandable **Ability System** that allows for endless creativity and personalization.

- **Ability Registry:**  
  A brand-new system lets developers register their own *Ability Types* (e.g. “Flame Guardian”, “Shadow Ward”, “Spirit Weaver”) — each with custom names, icons, and abilities.

- **Ability Selection GUI:**  
  After two players soulbind, a sleek **Ability Selection Screen** appears, letting them choose from all available Ability Types for their role.  
  If only one type exists, it’s assigned automatically.

- **Forge Event Hooks:**  
  The API introduces a powerful set of events for mod developers to expand gameplay:
  - `SoulbindHurtEvent` – Triggered when a Ward takes damage.  
  - `SoulbindHealEvent` – Triggered when shared healing occurs.  
  - `SoulbindPlayerTickEvent` – Fires once per second for each bound player; great for passives or effects.  
  - `SoulbindActiveAbilityEvent` – Base event for keybind-triggered custom abilities.

> 🧩 *Our ability framework takes inspiration from the beloved Origins mod, but reimagines it through the lens of shared souls rather than individual powers.*

---

## 🧭 Soulmate Tracker (New HUD Feature)
A new **action bar HUD** now displays your soulmate’s location and dimension, updating every second:

- Guardians see:  
  `Ward is at X, Y, Z in [Dimension]`
- Wards see:  
  `Guardian is at X, Y, Z in [Dimension]`

If your partner is offline, it clearly displays **"[Offline]"**.

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility
Kindred Souls fully supports:
- **Multiplayer servers**
- **Singleplayer with [Essential](https://essential.gg/)** (for friend-based connections)

> ⚠️ Playing entirely solo defeats the purpose — Kindred Souls is about connection, not isolation.

---

## 🧙 Admin / Dev Commands
| Command | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/soulbound unbind` | Breaks an existing soul link. |
| `/soulboundtwoway (Bugged)({playername}` | Creates a two-way soulbind — both players act as Guardian *and* Ward, making the bond mutually fatal. |
| `/soulbound {playername}` | Binds you as the specified player's Ward. |

---

new command /skills ADMIN only command. is useless in base mod and really only works if an addon registers some custom skills

## 🧩 Configuration
Customize how bonding works through the configuration file:

- `randomSelection = true` **  
  - Displays a **role selection GUI** on first world join (Guardian or Ward).

- `randomSelection = false` *(default)* 
  - Disables automatic selection and enables **manual soulbinding requests** instead.  
  *(Note: visibility improvements for pending invites are planned in a future update.)*

---

## 🛠️ Technical Notes
- **Cross-Dimensional Support:** Soulbind mechanics (damage, healing, and death link) now function flawlessly across all dimensions, including modded ones.  
- **Server-Safe Design:** All client code (GUIs, keybinds, visuals) is properly separated to prevent crashes on dedicated servers.  
- **Addon-Ready API:** Built for modders — create, register, and expand the Kindred Souls system with ease.

---

*Two souls, bound by trust. When the Ward falls, the Guardian follows — but their courage endures beyond death.*

Stop waiting for drowned to drop it like you’re begging for loot charity.

* **Smelting & Blasting** recipes to refine your Fragile Trident into the real deal.

Everything integrates into a dedicated **Craftable Trident Item Group**, clean and intuitive.

This mod keeps the game balanced:

* You earn the real trident through effort, not RNG.
* Recipe difficulty aligns with mid-game progression.

title: Schedule Shutdown
description: Shut down your server after a duration of time has passed.
body:
# Schedule Shutdown

A Minecraft data pack containing functions that will stop the server after a duration of time.

**Important**: To use this datapack, you need to be running a dedicated server with `function-permission-level` in `server.properties` to `4`. This datapack **will not function** (get it? :D) in a singleplayer world.

**Important**: Except for `NO_AUTO_SHUTDOWN.zip`, all versions will automatically shut down the server after the specified length of time. See [Auto-Shutdown](#auto-shutdown) for an explanation of what this means and why I did it like that.

Below is a list of available delays. Each one triggers the one below it. (I did this in a not dumb way, with 5hrs triggering 1hr after 4hrs, 1hr trigger 15min after 45min, etc.)

- 5hrs
- 1hr
- 15min
- 5min
- 1min

Any scheduled shutdowns are cancelled upon starting the server.

## Examples

```mcfunction
# Shut down the server in 5hrs. See src/data/schedule_shutdown/functions/delay/* for function names.
function schedule_shutdown:delay/five_hours

# Cancel a scheduled shutdown.
function schedule_shutdown:clear_all
```

## Auto-Shutdown

I originally made this datapack because I had figured out how to host a Minecraft server in GitHub Actions, but needed the server to automatically close with enough time left to save the server state to the repo. That's why there is a 5 hour version (max GitHub workflow run time is 6 hours). The files with a name like `length_of_time.zip` will automatically run the function `schedule_shutdown:delay/length_of_time` when the server loads (using Minecraft's `load.json`). Unless you want your server to automatically shut down after a length of time, use `NO_AUTO_SHUTDOWN.zip`.

## FAQ/Troubleshooting

<details>
  <summary>Failed to load function schedule_shutdown:shutdown</summary>

  Same as `Couldn't load tag schedule_shutdown:all_shutdown as it is missing following references: schedule_shutdown:shutdown`.
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Couldn't load tag schedule_shutdown:all_shutdown as it is missing following references: schedule_shutdown:shutdown</summary>

  Make sure you set the `function-permission-level` in `server.properties` to `4` and try starting the server again. If you still have this error, please open an issue in the GitHub repo.
</details>

title: CustomClientBlocker
description: A simple plugin that kicks player using specific client brand
body:
# CustomClientBlocker

A simple plugin that kicks player using specific client brand

## Usage

### Configuration

You can configure this plugin by editing `plugins/CustomClientBlocker/config.yml`

```yaml
# The list of clients to block
blacklist:
  - forge
# Kick message
kickMessage: Using %client% is not allowed!
```

### Commands

The base command is `/clientblocker` or `/ccb`

And base permission is `customclientblocker.command`

| Command | Description                                      | Permission                                                                     |
|---------|--------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| players | Lists players, but the connected client is shown | `customclientblocker.command.players`                                          |
| list    | Lists which clients are blocked                  | `customclientblocker.command.list`                                             |
| block   | Adds an entry to client blacklist                | `customclientblocker.command.block` or `customclientblocker.command.modify`    |
| unblock | Removes an entry to client blacklist             | `customclientblocker.command.unblock`  or `customclientblocker.command.modify` |
| reload  | Reloads the setting from config file             | `customclientblocker.command.reload`                                           |

### Bypassing specific players

You can add an except by adding permission `customclientblocker.bypass` to a player

Firework Delay is a lightweight client-side mod that reduces the delay when using Firework Rockets caused by network latency.

Players with higher ping often experience a noticeable delay before a Firework Rocket activates. This mod minimizes that delay, making Firework usage feel faster, smoother, and more responsive while keeping the experience simple and lightweight.

## Features

- 🚀 Reduces Firework Rocket use delay.
- ⚡ Improves responsiveness on high-ping connections.
- 🪶 Lightweight with no unnecessary features.
- 🔧 Easy to install and use.

## Compatibility

- Client-side mod.
- Works best on servers where latency causes noticeable Firework delay.

title: AntiNbtKick
description: A mod that prevents your player from picking up items that exceed the NBT data limit and prevents being kicked in general.
body:
# AntiNbtKick

A Fabric mod that prevents players from getting kicked due to oversized NBT data in their inventory. This mod intelligently monitors and restricts inventory size to keep you safe from server kicks while still allowing you to manage your items effectively.

## Features

### 🛡️ Inventory Size Protection
- **Smart Size Checking**: Accurately calculates the byte size of items using Minecraft's CODEC-based encoding
- **Maximum Limit**: Enforces a 1,777,777 byte limit for total inventory data (includes all slots and metadata overhead)
- **Metadata Accounting**: Each slot accounts for 128 bytes of overhead for proper size tracking

### 📦 Comprehensive Inventory Monitoring
The mod tracks and checks:
- Main inventory slots (36 slots)
- Hotbar (9 slots)
- Offhand slot
- Armor slots (4 slots)
- All NBT data and item attributes

### 🚫 Multi-Mode Protection

**Ground Item Pickup:**
- Prevents picking up items that would exceed inventory limit
- Silently blocks oversized items from being collected

**Container Interactions (Survival & Creative):**
- **Shift-Click**: Blocks moving items FROM containers INTO your inventory if it would exceed the limit
- **Single Click**: Prevents placing items into your inventory that are too large
- **Drag Operations**: Blocks dragging items into your inventory when it would exceed the limit
- **Container Depositing**: Allows you to freely move items FROM your inventory INTO containers, even when over the limit

**Creative Mode Protection:**
- Blocks creative mode item placement if it would exceed the limit
- Prevents creative mode dragging/painting that would overflow your inventory
- Blocks creative mode cloning (middle-click) of oversized items

### 🎮 Easy Toggle Commands

Control the mod with simple chat commands:

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/apk` | Show current mod status |
| `/apk toggle` | Toggle mod on/off |
| `/apk on` | Enable the mod |
| `/apk off` | Disable the mod |
| `/apk status` | Display detailed status |

Status messages use color coding:
- 🟢 **GREEN**: Mod is enabled
- 🔴 **RED**: Mod is disabled

## How It Works

### Size Calculation
The mod uses Minecraft's native `ItemStack.CODEC` to accurately encode items into NBT format and measures their serialized size in bytes. This matches how the server calculates inventory data size, ensuring consistency.

### Smart Blocking
The mod intelligently:
1. ✅ **Allows** picking up items from the ground (unless already at limit)
2. ✅ **Allows** depositing items into containers (cleaning your inventory)
3. ✅ **Allows** moving items within your own inventory
4. ❌ **Blocks** adding new items that would exceed the limit
5. ❌ **Blocks** dragging items into your inventory from containers
6. ❌ **Blocks** creative mode placement of oversized items

### Configuration
- **Default State**: Enabled on startup
- **Togglable**: Use `/apk toggle` to enable/disable on-the-fly
- **No Config Files**: Works out of the box with sensible defaults

## Installation

1. Download the mod JAR file
2. Place it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder
3. Launch Minecraft with Fabric Loader
4. The mod will be active by default

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.21.4 or later
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.16.4 or later
- **Java**: 21 or later
- **Fabric API**: Any version compatible with your Minecraft version

## Troubleshooting

**Q: I can't place items in my inventory**
A: Your inventory is likely at or near the 1,777,777 byte limit. Use `/apk off` to disable the mod, or deposit items into a container.

**Q: Can I drag items into containers?**
A: Yes! You can always move items FROM your inventory INTO containers, even when over the limit. This is the intended way to clean up.

**Q: Does this affect multiplayer?**
A: Yes, the mod protects you on any server. It prevents you from reaching the server-side NBT size limits that would cause kicks.

**Q: Can I disable the mod?**
A: Yes! Use `/apk off` to disable all protections. Use `/apk on` to re-enable.

## Credits

- **Original Author**: UnicornMaster-Dev
- **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.4

**Stay safe from NBT kicks!** ✨

# Nature's Appetite

# Overview

Nature's Appetite is a Forge 1.20.1 mod that automates animal feeding and breeding:

- Animals can seek and eat dropped breeding food automatically.
- Adult feeding is gated by breeding cooldown (`age == 0`) to prevent continuous waste.
- Baby animals can continuously eat (configurable) to speed up growth.
- Food quality is data-driven and can add healing, love-time bonus, growth bonus, extra baby chance, herd signals, and temporary special drops.

### Current Features

- Auto-feed goal injection for whitelist animals.
- Tag-driven whitelist/blacklist control.
- Owner attribution for breeding credit.
- Reloadable JSON-based quality system (`data_maps/item/food_quality.json`).
- Per-level dropped-item candidate tracker for better farm performance.
- GameTest + unit test scaffolding.

### Server Config Keys

Main keys in `natures_appetite-server.toml`:

- `enableAutoFeed`
- `enableAdultContinuousFeeding`
- `enableBabyContinuousFeeding`
- `scanRadius`
- `scanIntervalMin`
- `scanIntervalMax`
- `maxCandidatesPerScan`
- `pathTimeoutTicks`
- `ownerAttributionRange`
- `enableQualitySystem`
- `enablePackBehavior`
- `enableSpecialDrops`

### Datapack Tags

Only entities in whitelist are enabled; blacklist always overrides whitelist.

`data/natures_appetite/tags/entity_type/auto_feed_animals.json`

```json
{
  "replace": true,
  "values": [
    "minecraft:cow",
    "minecraft:sheep",
    "minecraft:pig",
    "minecraft:chicken"
  ]
}
```

`data/natures_appetite/tags/entity_type/auto_feed_blacklist.json`

```json
{
  "replace": true,
  "values": [
    "minecraft:pig"
  ]
}
```

Apply datapack changes:

```mcfunction
/reload
/datapack list
```

title: IceAndFire ATM Compatibility
description: Fixed compatibility issues of IceAndFire Community Edition on the ATM-10 integration package.
body:
**Most issues have been fixed in ATM-10 v6.0 and later.**

This project is open-source under the dual licenses of LGPL-3.0-or-later and 0BSD, and it is free software.

1. Amphitheres are difficult to spawn in "The Other: Desert"
The main reason is that Ice and Fire hardcoded the spawning logic to only allow spawning on Grass Blocks or Jungle Leaves.
The solution is to trigger the hooked logic if the original method returns false; if the block beneath is Sand, it returns true.

2. Dragons do not drop Dragon Bones
The reason is that ATM uses the legacy Ice and Fire datapack structure, whereas the Ice and Fire Community Edition rewrote this structure and changed the Dragon Bone item ID.
The solution is to register an original datapack function to redirect the logic to the new datapack function, while checking if the item ID is the legacy version and replacing it with the new ID.

3. Siren kill quest from Ice and Fire cannot be completed
The reason is that the ATM-10 kill quest incorrectly assigned the entity ID to the Siren from Elemental Craft (an Ars Nouveau extension).
The solution is to intercept the quest validation logic via Mixin; when the code detects a quest where the target is an Elemental Craft Siren but the icon is an Ice and Fire Siren, it automatically counts the Ice and Fire Siren kill toward the progress.

4. Other Fixes
- ATM-10 quests referenced removed legacy texture assets.

title: FFA Streaks
description: A simple plugin to automate FFA healing, kits, teleporting and streaks.
body:
# FFAStreaks

A comprehensive Free-For-All (FFA) plugin for Paper/Spigot servers that adds killstreak tracking, healing on kill, kit management, and teleport systems.

## Features

### Core Features
- **Killstreak Tracking**: Tracks player killstreaks and resets on death
- **Highest Streak**: Records each player's best killstreak ever
- **Heal on Kill**: Automatically heals and feeds players when they get a kill
- **Streak Rewards**: Configurable rewards (broadcasts, potion effects) at specific streak milestones
- **Anti-Farm Protection**: Prevents players from farming the same victim repeatedly
- **No Drops**: Prevents inventory and XP drops on death
- **World Whitelist**: Enable/disable the plugin in specific worlds

### Kit System
- Create, delete, and manage kits
- Simple `/kit <name>` command for players
- Full inventory, armor, and offhand support
- Admin kit management commands

### Teleport System
- Set teleport points for FFA arenas
- Link kits to teleport points (auto-given on teleport)
- Full heal and feed on teleport
- Simple `/ffago go <type>` command

### PlaceholderAPI Integration
- `%ffastreaks_streak%` - Current killstreak
- `%ffastreaks_highest_streak%` - Best killstreak ever
- `%ffastreaks_kills%` - Total kills
- `%ffastreaks_enabled%` - Whether FFA is enabled in current world

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21.x or compatible
- Java 21
- PlaceholderAPI (optional, for placeholders)

## Installation

1. Download the latest JAR from the releases page
2. Place `FFAStreaks-1.0.0.jar` in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Start or restart your server
4. Configure `plugins/FFAStreaks/config.yml` to your preferences
5. Reload with `/ffastreaks reload` or restart the server

## Configuration

### config.yml

```yaml
enabled_worlds:
  enabled: true
  worlds:
    - world
    - arena

heal_on_kill:
  enabled: true
  amount: 6.0  # 1.0 = half-heart, 20.0 = 10 hearts

anti_farm:
  enabled: true
  same_victim_cooldown_seconds: 20

messages:
  prefix: "&d[FFA]&f "
  disabled_world: "&cFFAStreaks is disabled in this world."
  streak_self: "&aYour current streak: &e%streak%"
  streak_other: "&a%player%'s streak: &e%streak%"
  top_header: "&6Top killstreaks:"

rewards:
  "3":
    broadcast: "&e%killer% &fhas a &a3&f kill streak!"
    effects:
      - "SPEED 10 0"
  "5":
    broadcast: "&e%killer% &fhas a &a5&f kill streak!"
    effects:
      - "STRENGTH 8 0"
  "10":
    broadcast: "&e%killer% &fis on a &c10&f kill streak!"
    effects:
      - "RESISTANCE 10 0"
      - "REGENERATION 4 1"
```

### Configuration Options

**enabled_worlds**
- `enabled`: Enable world whitelist (false = all worlds)
- `worlds`: List of world names where FFA features are active

**heal_on_kill**
- `enabled`: Enable healing and feeding on kill
- `amount`: Health amount to restore (1.0 = half heart)

**anti_farm**
- `enabled`: Enable anti-farm protection
- `same_victim_cooldown_seconds`: Cooldown before same victim can be farmed again

**rewards**
- Configure rewards at specific streak milestones
- Format: `"streak_number": { broadcast: "message", effects: ["EFFECT seconds amplifier"] }`
- Effects format: `"EFFECT_NAME seconds amplifier"` (e.g., "SPEED 10 0")

## Commands

### Player Commands

**/streak [top|player]**
- View your current killstreak
- `/streak top` - View top 10 killstreaks
- `/streak <player>` - View another player's streak

**/kit <name>**
- Get a kit by name
- Example: `/kit warrior`

**/ffakits list**
- List all available kits

**/ffakits give <name>**
- Get a kit for yourself
- Example: `/ffakits give warrior`

**/ffago go <type>**
- Teleport to a teleport point
- Automatically gives linked kit if configured
- Fully heals and feeds player
- Example: `/ffago go spawn`

**/ffago list**
- List all available teleport points

### Admin Commands

**/ffastreaks reload**
- Reload the plugin configuration
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin`

**/ffakits create <name>**
- Create a kit from your current inventory
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin`

**/ffakits delete <name>**
- Delete a kit
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin`

**/ffakits give <name> [player]**
- Give a kit to yourself or another player
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin` (to give to others)

**/ffago set <type>**
- Set a teleport point at your current location
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin`

**/ffago link <type> <kit>**
- Link a kit to a teleport point
- Permission: `ffastreaks.admin`

## Permissions

**ffastreaks.kit**
- Allows players to get kits using `/kit` or `/ffakits give`
- Default: `true` (all players)

**ffastreaks.go**
- Allows players to use `/ffago go` and `/ffago list`
- Default: `true` (all players)

**ffastreaks.admin**
- Full admin access to all FFA commands
- Default: `op` (operators only)

## Usage Examples

### Setting Up an FFA Arena

1. Create a kit:
   ```
   /ffakits create warrior
   ```

2. Set a spawn point:
   ```
   /ffago set spawn
   ```

3. Link the kit to spawn:
   ```
   /ffago link spawn warrior
   ```

4. Players can now use:
   ```
   /ffago go spawn
   ```
   This will teleport them, give them the warrior kit, and fully heal/feed them.

### Creating Streak Rewards

Edit `config.yml` to add rewards at specific streaks:

```yaml
rewards:
  "5":
    broadcast: "&e%killer% &fhas a &a5&f kill streak!"
    effects:
      - "STRENGTH 8 0"
      - "SPEED 10 0"
```

The `%killer%` placeholder is automatically replaced with the player's name.

## PlaceholderAPI

If PlaceholderAPI is installed, the following placeholders are available:

- `%ffastreaks_streak%` - Current killstreak
- `%ffastreaks_highest_streak%` - Highest killstreak ever achieved
- `%ffastreaks_kills%` - Total kills
- `%ffastreaks_enabled%` - Whether FFA is enabled in current world (true/false)

### Example Usage in Scoreboards

```
&eKill Streak: &f%ffastreaks_streak%
&eBest Streak: &f%ffastreaks_highest_streak%
&eTotal Kills: &f%ffastreaks_kills%
```

## How It Works

### On Player Death
- Inventory is kept (no drops)
- XP level is kept (no XP drops)
- Killstreak is reset to 0
- If killed by a player:
  - Killer's streak increments
  - Killer is healed and fed (if enabled)
  - Streak rewards are applied (if configured)
  - Anti-farm protection is checked

### On Kill
- Health restored by configured amount
- Food level set to 20
- Saturation set to 20.0
- Exhaustion reset to 0
- Kill count increments
- Streak increments
- Highest streak updated if new record

### Anti-Farm System
- Tracks last kill time for each killer-victim pair
- Prevents rewards if same victim is killed within cooldown period
- Configurable cooldown in seconds

## File Structure

```
plugins/FFAStreaks/
├── config.yml          # Main configuration
└── kits.yml            # Kit and teleport storage (auto-generated)
```

## Troubleshooting

**Plugin not working in a world:**
- Check `enabled_worlds` in config.yml
- Ensure world name matches exactly (case-sensitive)

**Kits not saving:**
- Check file permissions in `plugins/FFAStreaks/`
- Ensure server has write access

**Placeholders not working:**
- Install PlaceholderAPI plugin
- Use `/papi reload` after installing FFAStreaks
- Check placeholder syntax: `%ffastreaks_streak%`

**Commands not working:**
- Check permissions with `/lp user <player> permission info`
- Default permissions should be `true` for players
- Admin commands require `ffastreaks.admin` permission

## API

### Public Methods

```java
// Get current streak
int getStreak(UUID uuid)

// Get total kills
int getKills(UUID uuid)

// Get highest streak ever
int getHighestStreak(UUID uuid)

// Check if enabled in world
boolean isEnabledInWorld(World world)
```

## Version

Current Version: 1.0.0

## Support

For issues, feature requests, or questions, please open an issue on the project repository.

## License

This plugin is provided as-is for use on Minecraft servers.

## Credits

Developed for Paper 1.21.x servers with support for PlaceholderAPI integration.

body:
A secondary non-transfer,non-tradable currency directly hook with Luckperms with PlaceholderAPI. This plugin is useful for those people who wants to make rank shop with different non-tradable currency.
It has customisable config.yml.(currency name is changeable).

In config.yml if u want to change rank then please change key to that rank name too.

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1ac155d4f76a9b9e2ebbe1d2484650680f461cc.jpeg)

## **Features:**
Placeholders supported       
No vault required                
Direct hook with Luckperms                
Untradable currency              
Custom currency                                      
Paper & Spigot supported

![Dependencies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/300def3e0a60eef626d31300de06e6c525cd2c44.jpeg)

## **Dependencies:**
Paper or Spigot 1.21.X, Luckperms, PlaceHolderAPI

##  **Commands:**
/rankshop: opens rank shop gui
/rankshopbal: admin command to add,remove,set currency balance

##  **PlaceHolderAPI:**
%rankshop_balance%: current balance of player

##  **Permissions:**
rankshop.open: open rankshop
rankshop.admin: admin permission to add balance

title: Sword Storm
description: The Sword Storm Enchantment for Minecraft 1.21 Fabric Mod adds wind-element abilities to all types of swords (Diamond Sword, Netherite Sword, etc.) with levels ranging from I to V. In Survival Mode, it can be obtained via Enchanting Table (consuming 50% mo
body:
Sword Storm Enchantment (1.21 Fabric Mod)
When the power of steel merges with that of wind, it gives birth to this experience-redefining sword enchantment – Sword Storm. Tailored for all types of swords (Diamond Sword, Netherite Sword, etc.), it unlocks five core wind-manipulating abilities as you progress from Level I to V, turning every sword swing into a wild rhapsody of wind.
**

![Sword Storm Enchantment Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2b5ac6953256a9225517347eed572e8babc6907_0.webp)  


Basic Info
Applicable Weapons: All types of swords
Level Range: Level I to V; the higher the level, the more violent the wind power
Acquisition Methods:
Survival Mode: Obtain via Enchanting Table (costs 50% more XP than "Sharpness" of the same level) or villager trading.
Creative Mode: Directly take from the "Enchanted Books" category, or acquire via commands.
Five Wind Abilities
1. Wind Projectile Barrage
Lightly right-click with the enchanted sword equipped, and a translucent white wind projectile will howl forward (speed: 0.8 blocks per tick). It deals 3 base damage, increasing with each level (up to 5 damage at Level V), and inflicts an additional 20% damage to undead mobs. The projectile can also pierce 1 entity.
As the level rises, the firing interval shortens significantly – from 1.2 seconds (24 ticks) at Level I to 0.1 seconds (2 ticks) at Level V. This near-machine-gun-like wind pressure suppression leaves enemies nowhere to hide.
**

![Wind Projectile Barrage Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8c3aaacb95eb0d73866d1ef92129ba459b27a76.png)  


2. Area Charged Burst
Hold the right mouse button to enter the charging state: the player is forced to crouch (unable to move or turn), and circular wind particles spawn around the sword (particle density and rotation speed increase with charging, featuring 3 levels of visual effects). A gradually intensifying wind sound plays every 0.3 seconds.
The charging duration extends with the level (from 1.5 seconds at Level I to 3.5 seconds at Level V). You can release the burst early by letting go of the right-click, or it will trigger automatically when fully charged.
Upon burst, the area of effect, damage, and knockback surge with the level and charge phase: At Level V + Full Charge (Level 3), it covers a 4-block radius, deals 24 damage, and knocks enemies back 3 blocks. Non-solid blocks (leaves, glass, etc.) will be blown away by the wind, creating a spectacular "wind sweeping away the clouds" visual.
**

![Area Charged Burst Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34c58ba8d3c73a2065d0c387641f870b83bfc7bf.png)  

3. Aerial Multi-Jump
When in the air (before landing), right-click on empty space to trigger an extra jump using wind power (white wind particles spawn under your feet, accompanied by a wind sound). Level I allows double jumps, while Level V unlocks up to six jumps – letting you move as freely in the sky as on the ground.
After each extra jump, you need to wait 0.2 seconds (4 ticks) to trigger another. The jump count resets when you land, enabling flexible movement across terrain.
** 

![Aerial Multi-Jump Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab99f8b184fc0ef392d122acf253f86541f24b46_0.webp)  


4. Charged Sword Qi
Hold Left Ctrl + Right-Click to enter the charging state, during which you can move slowly. The charging duration increases from 1.0 second (20 ticks) at Level I to 3.0 seconds (60 ticks) at Level V. Damage is linked to the charge progress – at Level V with full charge, it deals 20 base damage.
It also features an 11-block range (with an extra 20% range at full charge) and a 3×3 cone-shaped area of effect. Wherever the wind blade passes, enemies will be knocked back up to 5.4 blocks, showcasing the overwhelming power of cutting wind pressure. After release, it only has a 0.5-second (10-tick) cooldown, which is independent of the wind projectile’s cooldown.
** 

![Charged Sword Qi Attack Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9462255ba11ef96263da98926ff322d87cee1427.png)  

5. Projectile Immunity & Reflection
When holding the enchanted sword in your main hand or offhand, you automatically gain projectile immunity (arrows, snowballs, fire charges, tridents, etc., have no effect) and can reflect projectiles: When a projectile touches your hitbox, it will bounce back at a random angle within ±30° of your line of sight. The reflected projectile retains its original properties (e.g., a fire arrow still ignites targets) and travels at 70% of its original speed. This combines offense and defense, nullifying long-range threats entirely.
From precise wind projectile suppression to large-area storm bursts, from aerial mobility to long-range sword qi, and even perfect defense against projectiles – the Sword Storm enchantment uses wind as its brush, painting diverse combat possibilities for your sword. With each level up, the power of wind becomes purer. Now, it’s time to unleash your very own Sword Storm in the blocky world of Minecraft.

title: Dynamic Trees - Tensura
description: Adds Dynamic Trees compatibility for the Tensura: Reincarnated mod, introducing a dynamically growing version of its Sakura tree. Includes integration with the Tensura-BYG compatibility patch to correctly spawn dynamic Sakura in BYG biomes when installed
body:
🌳 Dynamic Trees - Tensura

 

This addon brings the beauty of Dynamic Trees to the Tensura: Reincarnated mod, starting with its iconic Sakura tree. Watch as the static Sakura trees are replaced with living, growing versions that evolve from sapling to mature tree, complete with falling petal particles thanks to custom leaf properties.

 
✨ Features

 

    Dynamic Sakura: Replaces the standard Sakura tree from Tensura: Reincarnated with a fully dynamic version.

    Realistic Growth: Trees grow progressively over time, developing unique shapes.

    Falling Petals: Enjoy the aesthetic of gently falling Sakura petals, adding life to your biomes.

    World Generation: Automatically replaces static Sakura trees during world generation.

    Bee Nests: Has a chance to generate bee nests naturally on the branches.

 
🧩 Smart Compatibility

 

This addon is designed to work seamlessly with or without the Tensura-BYG compatibility patch:

    Tensura + Dynamic Trees - Tensura (Only)

        Dynamic Sakura trees will fully replace the original static trees in the tensura:sakura_forest biome.

    Tensura + Tensura-BYG + BYG + Dynamic Trees - Tensura

        The original tensura:sakura_forest biome will not generate (as handled by Tensura-BYG).

        Instead, Dynamic Sakura trees will be added to the byg:cherry_blossom_forest biome from Oh The Biomes You'll Go

title: Deaths Accounted For (DAF)
description: A lightweight mod focused on tracking kills, deaths, and enforcing a configurable death limit for competitive or hardcore servers.
body:
Tired of your friends claiming they’re the “_best PvPer on the server_” with nothing to back it up? Or maybe you just want to know who really gets wrecked in fair fights (spoiler: still probably you).

**Deaths Accounted For** keeps track of every glorious victory and every not-so-glorious defeat — but only when another player is involved. Creepers don’t count here. No more excuses, no more “_lag got me_” — the stats don’t lie.

Whether you’re running a hardcore challenge, a PvP tournament, or just want to roast your friends with cold, hard numbers, this mod’s got you covered.

 

### **✨ Features**
- **Kills & Deaths Tracking** – Records only player-caused kills and deaths, complete with player names and timestamps.
- **Player Stats Command** – Run /stats to check your own stats. Admins can peek at everyone else’s, but normal players only see their own.
- **Leaderboard Command** – Shows the top players ranked by kills only. Simple, clean, and ruthless.
- **Configurable Death Limit** – Want hardcore mode with a twist? Set a death cap — when players reach it, they’re automatically banned. (Don’t worry, you can tweak or disable it in the config.)
- **Reloadable Config and Stats** – Change settings without restarting the server. Because who has time for restarts?
- **Death and Ban Logs** - Keep track of every kill and bans with timestamps available in the Log file.



### **🎮 Server Use Cases**
- **PvP Arenas** – Track who’s truly the champion.
- **Hardcore SMPs** – Add accountability and spice with a configurable death cap.
- **Events & Tournaments** – Make competitions fair with a visible leaderboard.
- **Friendly Chaos** – Or just keep it around to remind your friends who the real “PvP god” is.

title: Redstone Redmeption
description: A modpack  focused around adding content from the Red Dead Redemption series
body:
### **Disclamer!**
This Modpack is more roleplay focused than gameplay but it is possible to play in survival just don't expect me to fix any flaws in the modpack unless they are a big problem.

**There are already keybinds set up by me but feel free to tailor them to your liking.**

## **Core Elements:**
- **Terrain Generation** - 
Mods such as [Lithosphere](https://modrinth.com/datapack/lithosphere) allow for huge, cinematic terrain while [Biome Replacer](https://modrinth.com/mod/biome-replacer) is used to make sure only biomes that fit the the Red Dead Redmeption series can generate, such as: swamps, badlands and forests.

- **Weapons** - 
[Vic's Point Blank](https://modrinth.com/mod/vics-point-blank), paired with [Red Dead Weaponry](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/customization/red-dead-weaponry), allows for smooth and fun gunplay that makes you feel like a true outlaw. The Original content from [Vic's Point Blank](https://modrinth.com/mod/vics-point-blank) has also been disabled so that we dont get cowboys running around with fully automatic rifles but you can change this in the configs.

- **Deadeye** - 
The [Deadeye Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/deadeye-mod) adds exactly what's written on the tin. Deadeye. When playing with friends, I recomend using the configs to turn off "Deadeye Slowdown" for obvious reasons.

- **Animals** - 
I decided on the [Naturalist](https://modrinth.com/mod/naturalist/versions) mod for the animals, since it was for Fabric 1.20.1 and configured it to remove unwanted mobs.

- **Other** - I have included a few other mods just to add decorations and building materials such as [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped) and [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries).

title: OnlyTPNext
description: Teleport anywhere or to anyone with a single command—no cheats, no client mods.
body:
🚀 Release v1.0.0 – onlytpnext

A lightweight, server-side only Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that lets anyone teleport—no cheats required!    
Inspired by Onlytp, but not built from Onlytp.

---

✨ Key Features

- ✅ No OP needed – every player can use it without elevated permissions  
- ✅ One command – `/otp <x> <y> <z>` or `/otp <player>`  
- ✅ Server-side only – clients don’t need to install anything; just drop into `mods`  
- ✅ Zero extra deps – works with Fabric API alone

---

🎯 Usage Examples

```bash
# Teleport to coordinates (100, 64, -200)
/otp 100 64 -200

# Teleport to player Steve
/otp Steve
```

---

📦 Installation

1. Download `onlytpnext-1.0.0.jar`  
2. Place it in the server’s `mods` folder  
3. Start or restart the server—start teleporting!

---

🔧 Technical Details

Minecraft	1.21.1	  
Fabric Loader	≥0.17.0	  
Fabric API	0.116.4+1.21.1	  
	

---

📄 License

MIT – feel free to modify, distribute, or use in commercial packs.

---

Found a bug or have an idea? Open an Issue anytime!

title: Stardew Valley Fishing
description: Fishing like in stardew valley.
body:
## Stardew Valley fishing minigame.
_This plugin change the default **fishing** experience into a minigame from **Stardew Valley**._
Once you start fishing, everything appears normal until you hook a fish. At that moment, a new fishing ui appears just above the hotbar, featuring three elements: water, a green catch zone, and fish itself.
![hook a fish](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c53ee5189ab46a08e9d6153fcf6ffcde5a9a521.gif)

To successfully catch the fish, you must keep the green zone over the moving fish for a specified duration (default is 4 seconds). Use your left mouse button (LMB) to move the green zone by one cell to the right. If you stop clicking, the zone will slowly slide back to the left. The time requirement is co~~~~nfigurable.
![fishing ui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24e3cfcc3286745330b5f4fda9021e67a503f06c.gif)

Each fish you catch comes with randomized attributes: name, rarity, weight and length. All of these properties can be customized in the config file.

![icy clown](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0daa17aac190fac9aa9203ef09f2107db26525e.jpeg)

Create and its powerful addons like Create: Steam Rails, Create Deco, Create Addition, and Slice and Dice deliver fully mechanical automation—no magic, just gears and steam!

Tom's Storage adds a functional and scalable storage solution that integrates seamlessly with Create.

Biomes O' Plenty, Better Nether, and Better End overhaul the world and dimensions with stunning new biomes.

Dungeons Arise, Seven Seas, and Dungeons & Taverns add sprawling structures, massive ships, fortified outposts, and reimagined strongholds and cities.

Underground Villages and Create Better Villagers make villages feel fresh and alive underground or above.

👷 Gameplay Enhancements
Jobs+ introduces RPG-style progression and professions.

Essential Commands and Waystones provide helpful quality-of-life teleports and home commands.

Mineable Spawners, CarryOn, and VeinMining streamline exploration and mining.

🛡️ Combat & AI
Better Combat redefines fighting with smoother animations and mechanics.

Guard Villagers and Villager Drops bring defense and reward to village protection.

🎨 Building & Aesthetics
Adorabuild, Camps, Castles, & Carriages, and Fetzisa’s Asian Deco expand your decorative options.

Visual Workbench, Double Doors, and Quartz Elevators enhance usability and design potential.

🧠 Performance & UI
Starlight, LazyDFU, Clumps, and Memory Leak Fix drastically improve server and client performance.

Continuity, Enhanced Block Entities, and 3D Skin Layers polish your visual experience.

Zoomify, FPS Display, and Smooth Scroll provide cleaner UI and better control.

🔧 Utilities & Extras
WorldEdit with a hang-fix for reliability.

Controlling, Searchables, Macro Keybinds, and Highlight boost player control.

Naturalist, Animal Feeding Trough, and Farmers Delight enrich farming and animal behavior.

Ideal for both solo adventurers and small multiplayer servers, this pack prioritizes performance and versatility for all playstyles!

**Disclaimer**: This modpack is designed for our private server and is listed publicly on Modrinth solely for convenience, allowing server members to access updates easily via the Modrinth launcher. While you are welcome to download and test the modpack for personal use, please note that no support will be provided for issues encountered outside our private server. Use at your own discretion.

body:
**This set of resources replaces the standard totem of Immortality in Minecraft with a charming model of Mini Tails, a favorite character from the Sonic the Hedgehog series.**

title: Daisy SMP Tweaks
description: Tweaks for the Daisy SMP
body:
Daisy SMP Tweaks

Adds various tweaks for the Daisy SMP!

This mod adds various items, like the metal scaffolding, or others reserved for the server staff, and game mechanics like getting the regeneration effect when near campfires (the area becomes bigger when there's a hay block under it). --- ## Features - **Metal Scaffolding:** This block will be able to go further out than regular scaffolding can. - **Nether lantern:** A block that stores a beacon energy to be used later on, this block is capable of storing up to 5 hours of beacon charge. - **Block Detector:** If the blocks on the faces of the detector are the same and have the same blockstate the block detector outputs a redstone signal from every side except it's faces. - **Amethyst Bulb:** Basically a backport of the copper bulb from 1.21. - **Ladybrine Scythe:** This custom weapon is designed exclusively for server administrators to effectively manage disruptive behaviour. - **Campfires:** Users who approach campfires gain the regeneration effect. The area surrounding the campfire expands when hay bales are placed beneath it. - **Secret Spectator:** Spectators are not visible to non-operating players. - **Chat Minigames:** Randomly generated minigames are displayed on chat. These minigames include scramble, fill-in-the-blank, reverse word, and datapack. The datapack questions can be configured via the `data/daisy/chat_minigame_questions` directory, the chat minigames can be configured in `daisy/chat_minigames.json`. - **Anticheat:** really primitive but detects flagged mod ids and reports them to moderators through a discord webhook, the anticheat can be configured in `daisy/anticheat.json`. - **Homes:** The `/home`, `/sethome`, `/delhome`, `/homes`, `/setmaxhomes`, and `/spawn` commands are added, providing self-explanatory options for players to create and manage their homes. These homes are stored as components from the Cardinal Components API within each player’s data. - **TPA:** The `/tpa`, `/tpahere`, and `/tpaccept` commands enable players to request and accept teleportation requests from others. A 60-second cooldown is implemented for these commands via a gamerule. - **Warp:** The `/warp`, `/setwarp`, and `/removewarp` commands facilitate the management of warp portals. Operators can create and manage these portals, and players can teleport to them using the warp command. Warp portals are stored as components from the Cardinal Components API within the world’s (level) scoreboard. --- ## Support If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to: - Open an issue on GitHub. - Send me a DM on Discord @macuguita - You are free to use this mod in any Modpack in this platform --- ## Credits - Developer: macuguita

title: CustomRarity
description: Define item rarity with NBT or config
body:
# CustomRarity

Allows pack makers to define [Item Rarity](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Rarity) by either NBT or config file. Requires ClothConfig and has optional ModMenu integration.
Best for use with mods like Legendary Tooltips and Immersive UI. 

### Examples
#### Define by NBT:

```/give @p stick{CustomRarity:"Epic"}```

This mod also comes with Item Modifiers:
```/item modify entity @p container.0 customrarity:rare```
will modify the item in the first slot of your hotbar. Item Modifiers can be used in loot tables.

#### Define by config:
```
	"uncommons": [
		"minecraft:diamond"
	],
```

NBT has precedence over config, and config has precedence over vanilla rarity value.

description: The official modpack for the Vinland server, for Fabric!
body:
# Vinland Enhanced
A modpack designed to **improve your gaming experience** on the Vinland server, as well as for enjoyable play on **other servers or in the local Minecraft world**. This modpack is made with four main features (**Optimization, Visual and gameplay enhancements, Improved RP Experience, Tools for Content Makers**) in mind that will greatly improve your gaming experience. **Everything** is already set up to make your game as **comfortable** as possible. **You just need to install this build and enjoy the game!**

## Main Features:

### Optimization
**Modpack "Vinland Enhanced"** includes a number of optimizations that guarantee **stable and smooth game play** even on servers with high load. The modpack also supports almost **all OptiFine features**, **including shaders**, **capes**, **zoom**, and **support for resourcepacks that require OptiFine**. We pay special attention to performance optimization to ensure **the most comfortable gaming environment**.

<details>
<summary>Included mods</summary>

- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium/version/mc1.20.4-0.5.8) (A modern rendering engine for Minecraft which greatly improves performance)
- [Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options/version/mc1.20.4-1.7.2) (Alternative Options Menu for Sodium)
- [Indium](https://modrinth.com/mod/indium/version/1.0.30+mc1.20.4) (Sodium addon providing support for the Fabric Rendering API, based on Indigo)
- [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra/version/mc1.20.4-0.5.4) (A Sodium addon that adds features that shouldn't be in Sodium.)
- [MoreCulling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling/version/0.24.0) (A mod that changes how multiple types of culling are handled in order to improve performance)
- [PurpurClient](https://modrinth.com/mod/purpurclient) (Fixes client-side vanilla bugs)
- [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast/version/1.2.14+1.20.4-fabric) (Speed up immediate mode rendering in Minecraft)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config/version/13.0.121+fabric) (Configuration Library for Minecraft Mods)
- [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) (A builder-based configuration library for Minecraft.)
- [Starlight (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/starlight/version/1.1.3+1.20.4) (Rewrites the light engine to fix lighting performance and lighting errors)
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin/version/1.10.20+kotlin.1.9.24) (This is a mod that enables usage of the Kotlin programming language for Fabric mods.)
- [CICADA](https://modrinth.com/mod/cicada/version/0.7.2+1.20.2-1.20.4) (Confusing, Interesting and Considerably Agnostic Development Aid)
- [Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps/version/3.4.3) (Minecraft is in the background or idle.)
- [Bobby](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby/version/5.1.0+mc1.20.4) (Allows for render distances greater than the server's view-distance)
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling/version/1.6.4-1.20.4) (Using async path-tracing to hide Block-/Entities that are not visible)
- [Memory Leak Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/memoryleakfix/version/v1.1.5) (A mod that fixes random memory leaks for both the client and server)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.97.0+1.20.4) (Lightweight and modular API providing common hooks and intercompatibility measures utilized by mods using the Fabric toolchain.)
- [Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric/version/0.2.0+alpha.11.67+1.20.4) (A Fabric mod designed to improve the chunk performance of Minecraft.)
- [Remove Reloading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrls/version/4.0.3+mc1.20.4-fabric) (Makes resource packs load in the background, allowing you to do other things while waiting!)
- [oωo (owo-lib)](https://modrinth.com/mod/owo-lib/version/0.12.6+1.20.3) (A general utility, GUI and config library for modding on Fabric and Quilt)
- [Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton/version/0.2.6) (A mod to optimize the Minecraft networking stack)
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium/version/mc1.20.4-0.12.1) (No-compromises game logic/server optimization mod)
- [No Telemetry](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-telemetry/version/1.8.0) (Disable the telemetry introduced in 21w38a)
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core/version/6.0.3-fabric) (Memory usage optimizations)
- [Very Many Players (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/vmp-fabric/version/0.2.0+beta.7.139+1.20.4) (A Fabric mod designed to improve server performance at high playercounts.)
- [M.R.U](https://modrinth.com/mod/mru/version/0.4.0+1.20.4) (Mineblock's Repeated Utilities)


</details>



### Visual and gameplay enhancements
Through various shaders, resource packs, and mods, we've given the world of Minecraft more **vibrant, detailed imagery and improved gameplay**. From high-quality textures to new game mechanics and improved atmosphere, every aspect of visual and gameplay design has been carefully crafted to create an **immersive gaming experience**.

<details>

- [Harvest](https://modrinth.com/mod/harvest/version/1.3.1) (Break fully grown crops by right-clicking them)

title: Luafy
description: Adding the Lua Scripting language to datapacks
body:
# Luafy

_Adding the Lua Scripting Language to Minecraft datapacks, entirely server sided._

## What?
Lua is a easy, simple to use and easy to learn scripting language used by many games to add custom content to games. Luafy is a mod that adds that to Minecraft datapacks, entirely server sided.

**For more information on the mod and how to use, please read the [Documentation](https://github.com/diamonddevv/luafy/wiki).**

## Why? (Yapping)
I've always loved the amount of extensibility datapacks give to Minecraft through the use of Functions, but I never really liked mcfunctions that much. Where in recent updates to the game they have become more and more powerful, I've always hoped for (since my own days of making datapacks before I learned to mod Minecraft) some form of complete scripting.
Recently, within personal and unrelated projects I have been fiddling about with Lua, a programming language that is powerful, easy to learn and easy to integrate. Lua is commonly used within games such as Roblox or Garry's Mod to add player-generated content (including in the case of why I have been using it; I have spent the last few months working with Lua in C# using a library called Moonsharp. Like c'mon.. I just wanna make a game, but I gotta spend months hacking in file management). I figured that it would be a truly worthwhile candidate to put in Minecraft. In fact, I'm not the first to this idea: the popular mod [Figura](https://modrinth.com/mod/figura) has used Lua to add support for scripting their avatar system, and Luafy actually makes use of the same libary to add Lua (Thank you FiguraMC for maintaining LuaJ!). Instead of waiting for Mojang to add a Scripting language to Minecraft other than MCFUNCTION, I did what Thanos suggested, and did it myself.

## Disclaimer
Lua is a powerful language, and in its current state **there is NO sandboxing in the Luafy Lua Engine.** Please excercise common internet safety, and **do not run any datapacks containing Lua code that you do not trust.** I am not responsible for any content this mod allows to run.

title: MCPF
description: A mod adding new items and a unique leveling system
body:
**MCPF Mod**

This mod is designed for players looking for longer gaming experiences. I’m one of those players, and after defeating the dragon, I don’t have much to do, so I stop playing on that save. My mod offers gameplay that lasts at least a dozen hours of acquiring new weapons, tools, and other items to enhance the gameplay. It also introduces new challenges, such as battling new enemies and bosses


The mod is a fusion of my favorite universes from games and movies. It’s also a combination of all the mods I’ve released so far because it was created before them. All the mods I’ve released to date have borrowed solutions from it

[**Attention! This mod requires the installation of another modification called AttributeFix[link]**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/attributefix)


## [**I credit all the creators whose work I used in my mod under this link. Thank you all once again!**](https://amibartek.com/mcpf-main-paige/mcpf-creators/)


### What exactly does the mod offer?
## Special leveling system
By pressing the G key, you can open the menu where your current level is displayed. To increase your level, defeat more enemies

![Main menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1de7e3b2bef9c5685b6708205366f9bce6e26f44.webp)


## 25 different melee weapons with a new damage mechanic
The mod offers 6 sets of melee weapons, each set unlocking at a specific level

![Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2896094a85a6d6c81a4ea6022463e3dfe91ba695.webp)
![Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a0eba4780f0759061c1cd55c6d9ecc7ade27ca9.webp)
![Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56891808684f1f9884a0d4c4fe6d0e7b52e80e76.webp)

## 20 different firearms and other thrown weapons
In the mod, the higher your level, the greater terror you can unleash with firearms. Starting from classic pistols and rifles, and ending with miniguns, flamethrowers, and homing rocket launchers

![Rifle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c8b8a44b7078ef51bec5125004e06bdb2c02b51.webp)
![Minigun](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40cedb2e61b84ad2b8ad5b1bb1260ea5029a1835.webp)
![Shotgun](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff674ce595e515029c622cd63f04504656e824e4.webp)
![Javelin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6ee3da37747402f3b703041e3110cc94a3bfde0.webp)

## 10 different elixirs
At some point, you are able to learn how to brew potions and drink them without killing yourself. They provide powerful bonuses to the player, making it easier to defeat enemies

## Many new vehicles
In the mod, you can create tanks, agricultural machinery, tractors, or cars. Everyone will find something for themselves; you can cultivate wheat, drive a car, or destroy enemies using tanks

![Car](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4bd0a9cbc255c68f6efd34c89a782bfd2d8e646.webp)
![Tks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/751d971e62792a55e6f4e5dd650a040181012a1c.webp)
![Tractor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ec4b103d93ea94882b2cc0a2b8b8ab60e2f9ac0.webp)


![Vehicles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fac6f79c064a8f049544c3f0ab6b3abb3a827914.webp)

## 14 types of new ores
In the mod, there is a variety of ores found in different parts of the world. Additionally, there is a smelting furnace where you can mix these ores to obtain further metal derivatives

![Ores](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/133feef4e0c0b0a255e487838de1f759e72a738f.webp)

## 16 different types of functional machines/blocks
In the mod, there are various machines available, such as an air compressor for filling air tanks, a refinery for producing various products from oil, a generator for generating electricity, and a whole bunch of other machines

## Dragon coins
In the mod, there is a special currency called Dragon Coins that you can use to buy new weapons, construction schematics, armor, materials, vehicles, and many other things. You can earn Dragon Coins by selling heads of defeated enemies, selling grain, selling materials, or looting safes of defeated enemies

## A huge variety of new enemies
The higher your level, the more challenging enemies you can encounter. The enemies available in the mod are truly diverse; you can encounter knights, bandits, hussars, soldiers, mages, paladins, assassins, cursed beings, and so on

![Enemies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d0e8be665a7c0c1fbf033de23aaf665905de881.webp)

## 16 different types of manual tools, plus 3 electric tools
Besides the 6 sets of weapons available at specific levels, the same applies to tools. In the mod, you can craft a whole variety of picks, shovels, axes, and hoes. Additionally, at higher levels, you'll be able to make chainsaws or mining drills

![Chainsaw](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33969cf6011c571ea8909128c6c0daef27eaa596.webp)


## New armor repair system
In my mod, no weapon is completely destroyed. If the durability of a tool/weapon/armor part drops to 0, you can repair it where it was created

## 9 new types of armor
In addition to having better tools and weapons, you gain the ability to create increasingly effective armor

![Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b465d98db8a4056b71f32e35c1875fec9335e40.webp)

## Many new structures filled with enemies
You'll find here knights' castles, military bases, magical fortresses, castles, desert cities, towers, and much more

![Castle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e6450054c0ef63d3625bd9126454107688b9a640.webp)
![Castle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c67caa4e041d8aa820998b5a096448a691385b17.webp)


## And a whole bunch of other things!


[Minecraft MCPF mod - All weapones showcase](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3o3JsZRujA4&ab_channel=Bartek)

[MCPF mod - Vehicles guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6_1qKyqnPP4&t=138s&ab_channel=Bartek)

[Minecraft - MCPF Mod - All workstations showcase](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zPyqgvEIqOY&t=44s&ab_channel=Bartek)

[MCPF Minigun Guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rc8JCokAUzg&t=13s&ab_channel=Bartek)

[MCPF Mod - Harvesting Wheat](https://youtu.be/MbRVcdaV5F4?si=iQB-BQb0UuiB86-i)

[MCPF Mod - Javelin guide](https://youtu.be/nxKKK9KzUiM?si=kGnFuC8-6AFfLA2g)


In the mod, there’s a special leveling system that increases as you defeat progressively tougher enemies. With each unlocked level, you gain access to more powerful and gameplay-enhancing items, weapons, vehicles, tools, machines, armor, and much more. The complete list of items you unlock as you progress in the game is available[​here]



The mod is really extensive, so to make it easier to find information, I’m providing links to useful resources that will help you navigate the world of MCPF
If you don’t find a topic below that addresses your concern, feel free to ask me a question at rojdanbw@gmail.com

title: KeepResourcePackOnProxiedServerSwitch
description: Prevent proxied server switched from reloading resources twice -> not at all
body:
# Dankness

tldr: **Instead of seeing the resource reloading screen _twice_ sometimes when switching a proxied server with a network-wide pack, you _won't see it at all_.**

1.20.2 introduced a new protocol phase, being the configuration phase. In it, you can send the client resource packs
*before* they enter the world and also better communicate server switches. Unfortunately, the 1.20.2 client forcefully
unloads the current resource pack, which means on server networks with network-wide resource packs, the pack will have
to be resent on every server switch, resulting in *two* loading screens.

... This mod hackily "fixes" that by just not reloading the resource manager when re-entering the configuration phase,
as well as ignoring packs that have the same hash as the already loaded one.

## Even less loading
If you want to get rid of the resource pack fade effects and other screens, you might want to check out this as well: https://modrinth.com/mod/forcecloseworldloadingscreen

## Description

Tempered Glass adds a glass block type with related construction blocks and their respective crafting recipes.
Tempered Glass has the mining hardness of nether brick and the blast resistance of obsidian.

### Blocks:
- Block (standard block)
- Slab
- Pane
- Rod (like End Rod)
- Trapdoor
- Fence
- Fence Gate

### Items:
- Dowel (crafting material)

### Blast Furnace Recipes
- Glass -> Tempered Glass

### Stone Cutter Recipes
- Tempered Glass -> 2x Tempered Glass Slab, 4x Tempered Glass Pane, or 6x Tempered Glass Dowel
- Tempered Glass Slab -> 2x Tempered Glass Pane or 3x Tempered Glass Dowel

### Crafting Recipes
- Tempered Glass Slab + 2x Tempered Glass Dowel + 4x Glowstone Dust (custom arrangement, see below) -> Tempered Glass Rod
- 4x Tempered Glass + 2x Tempered Glass Dowel (fence arrangement) -> 3x Tempered Glass Fence
- 4x Tempered Glass Dowel + 2x Tempered Glass (fence gate arrangement) -> Tempered Glass Fence Gate
- 4x Tempered Glass (square arrangement) -> Tempered Glass Trapdoor

### Tempered Glass Rod Recipe

![Tempered Glass Rod crafting recipe](https://mw-dropshare.s3.amazonaws.com/TemperedGlassRodRecipe.png)

Relativizes the costs of enchanting and anvil combining.

- Enchanting tables consume the points cost between the minimum required level and the subtraction of the level cost
  - For example, a level 30 enchant requiring 3 levels will cost 306 points (points between level 27 and 30)
- Anvils consume the  points cost between level 0 and the level cost
  - For example, an 8 level operation will cost 112 points (points between level 0 and 8)

**SolverMOTD** is a plugin for Spigot servers that allows server owners to display a customized welcome message (MOTD) with a uniform format. The plugin supports color codes, dynamic placeholders through PlaceholderAPI, and **MiniMessage** formatting.

Server administrators can use features like hot reload to change the MOTD without restarting the server. It supports placeholders like %server_online%, %time%, and more, making server list customization simple and flexible.

SolverMOTD provides a centralized configuration, with easy-to-use commands. The plugin offers straightforward customization for Minecraft server owners looking to personalize their server's first impression.

title: Ping It!
description: Adds a smart ping system for easier communication. You can now point at a location, mob or item
body: **Ping It!** is a utility mod that introduces a convenient pinging and marking system to Minecraft. It allows players on a server to easily point out locations, blocks, containers, items, and entities to each other without using chat or voice communication. ## Key Features * **Quick World Pings**: Place markers on block coordinates, ores, mobs, and dropped items instantly by pressing the hotkey (default: V). Hostile mobs are highlighted as danger, and blocks like signs have their text displayed on the ping card. Pinging fluids is also supported. * **Interactive Radial Menu**: Hold down the hotkey (default: V) to open a wheel selection where you can select the ping type (Look, Alert, Danger) or choose from a customizable pool of quick chat phrases. * **Container Inventory Pings**: Press the hotkey (default: V) while hovering over slot items inside chests, hoppers, or your player inventory to cycle between different alert types (Look, Alert, Danger) and share the item details. * **Smart Raycasting**: Raycasts automatically ignore grass, flowers, and vines. You can configure the mod to ignore glass, torches, and barrier blocks. * **Waypoint Routes (in beta)**: Connect multiple coordinates into a custom route to guide your team through cave systems or build areas. Press the route key (default: B) to start and publish routes. * **Creative Teleportation**: Creative and spectator mode players can middle-click an active ping on their screen to teleport safely to its location. * **Top Compass HUD**(our ~~flagman~~ feature): A horizontal compass bar showing direction headings and nearby ping markers... * **Off-screen Indicators**: Arrow, sonar, and distance indicators at screen edges for pings outside your field of view. * **And Much More!** ## How to Use * **Press Key**: Send a quick ping at your crosshair. * **Hold Key**: Open the radial menu to select a specific ping type, customize labels, or choose a quick chat phrase. * **Press Key on Container Slot**: Highlights the specific item in the chest or inventory slot. ## Configuration Almost every aspect of the mod is fully customizable to suit your gameplay preferences. The mod features a fully translated, comprehensive configuration screen, with presets, UI styles (including Vanilla-style (20/80) HUD), color adjustments, block outlines, fading options, and distance-based sound volume falloff. _This mod works fully client-side when playing on vanilla servers (only you will see your pings), but will synchronize with other players if installed on the server._ ## Credits * **[Noxbane](https://github.com/NoxbaneSudo)** - Developer * **Kylon** - Artist **Testers** * **VenTylator**
