title: RiverInJungle
description: Adds wide, natural vanilla-style rivers to jungle biomes — real carved riverbeds, sandy banks, and water that flows seamlessly into the sea.
body:
[![JOIN OUR DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/JOIN%20OUR%20DISCORD-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA)

Adds wide, natural-looking rivers that generate as a real part of the terrain inside jungle biomes. Instead of placing a channel on top of finished ground, the river valleys are carved into the world the same way vanilla makes its rivers — so you get a proper sunken riverbed, sand and dirt banks, water filled to sea level, and clean merges wherever a river runs into the ocean or into another biome. The goal is simple: make jungles feel alive with big, Amazon-style waterways that look like they were always meant to be there.

![River in jungle generated by mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2b9e4fee07274e4158be6f6dda426af20142dae_0.webp)

> 📦 **Install on the server (or in singleplayer)**. River generation is server-side worldgen. Vanilla clients can connect and explore the rivers with no extra setup.
>
> ⚠️ **Only affects newly generated chunks**. Already-explored jungle won't change — travel to fresh terrain (or start a new world) to see the rivers. Everything outside jungle climate stays byte-for-byte identical to vanilla.
>
> 🎮 **Singleplayer note**: Works perfectly in singleplayer — just drop it into your mods folder as usual.

Please report any bugs, errors, or feature suggestions on Discord: https://discord.gg/4XUPywnEyE

**What it does:**
- **Real terrain rivers**: River valleys are part of the landscape itself — carved bed, sloped banks, water at sea level. No floating grass, no exposed-stone trenches, no artificial channels.
- **Wide & winding**: Rivers use a flat-bottomed, wide profile so they read as large waterways you can actually canoe down and spot from a distance — not thin ditches.
- **Seamless merges**: Where a river reaches the coast it flows straight into the sea; where it meets a lake or low valley it blends in with no walls or seams.
- **Natural banks**: Surface rules lay sand and dirt along the water's edge (no grass underwater), exactly like vanilla rivers and beaches.
- **Jungle wildlife**: Tropical fish and salmon spawn in the new rivers, so they feel populated instead of empty.
- **Vanilla-faithful & lightweight**: Pure data-driven worldgen — no new blocks, no extra config to babysit, and zero changes to non-jungle terrain.

🌍 **Where rivers appear**: Wide rivers form in flat, low-lying jungle (near sea level), where water can actually pool — this is where you get the full Amazon look. Coastal jungle gets rivers that empty into the ocean. High mountain-jungle and small island-jungle stay mostly dry, because real flowing water can't sit perched on a slope — same physical rule vanilla rivers follow.

title: Smart Moving Reforged
description: Enriches character movement with climbing, crawling, sliding, head jumps and more.
body:
# Smart Moving

**Smart Moving** brings rich, fluid character movement to Minecraft.  
Climb, crawl, slide, head-jump and more — a faithful Fabric 1.21.1 port of the classic **Smart Moving** mod.

***

## ✨ Features

*   **Climbing** – Grab and climb blocks, ladders, vines, fences, and iron bars. Free-climb up surfaces and even traverse ceilings.
*   **Crawling** – Squeeze into 1-block-high gaps by lying down and crawling.
*   **Sliding** – Slide forward to move quickly through tight spaces.
*   **Head Jump** – Launch yourself with a dynamic head-first jump.
*   **Smooth Animations** – Climbing, falling, flying, and movement all come with hand-crafted animations faithful to the original mod.
*   **Multiplayer Support** – All movement and animations are synchronized for other players to see.

***

## 📦 Requirements

*   **Minecraft 1.21.1**
*   **Fabric Loader**
*   **Fabric API** _(required — install it alongside this mod)_

***

## 🔧 Installation

2.  Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and place it in your `mods` folder.

title: Shatter
description: A simple vein-mining enchantment that supports Auto-smelting and Fortune.
body:
Shatter adds a custom enchantment that enables vein mining for blocks. When a block is broken the mod recursively detects and destroys connected blocks of the same type up to a limit of 16 (configurable). It ensures full compatibility with Auto-smelting features and Fortune drops. Tool durability is consumed for each individual block broken to maintain game balance. The effect applies to both mineral veins and trees. Players can **bypass** the mechanic by sneaking while mining.

title: Safe Drop
description: Never accidentally drop your best sword into lava again! This minimalist Mod requires a quick double-tap to drop enchanted or custom-named items.
body:
# ⚛️ Atomic SafeDrop

![Demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/atomic-mods/safedrop/443ff303e988ba31bc211f58ad59b2139245f75a/media/Safedrop%20Demonstration.png)

**Never lose your best gear to a misclick again.**

We’ve all been there: you’re bridging over a lava lake in the Nether or dodging attacks in the End, and a sudden slip of the finger makes you yeet your fully enchanted Netherite sword into the abyss. 

**Atomic SafeDrop** is a lightweight, strictly focused mod that elegantly solves this exact pain point without cluttering your game with unnecessary menus or bloated code.

### ✨ How It Works

SafeDrop acts as a smart safety net for your most precious items:
* **Valuables are Protected:** If the item you are holding is **enchanted** or has a **custom name**, the single drop key input is completely ignored. 
* **Intentional Dropping:** To actually drop a valuable item, you simply **double-tap the drop key** within a 500ms window.
* **Normal Behavior for Junk:** Standard items like dirt, cobblestone, or basic tools drop normally with a single press, ensuring your inventory management speed isn't slowed down.

title: More Recipes: Change Golden Apple
description: Restore the Golden Apple recipe from 1.1-1.6.
body:
Recipe downloads have been split into their own projects for better Modrinth App compatibility.\
Links to all recipes in description

This project restores the 1.1 - 1.6 Golden Apple Recipe using Gold Nuggets.


#### Installation:
- Put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/saves/[Your World Here]/datapack" folder.
- ***DO NOT put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/resourcepacks" folder.***
- If you changed where Minecraft loads from, find that location and use that "saves" folder.
- For servers, put it in your world folder that matches where your server.properties file says.

#### For advanced users:
- IF you want to store it in your ".minecraft" folder, CREATE a folder called "datapack" and put it there.
- From there, when you create a world and go to add datapacks, you can simply go to this folder and grab what you need.
- For identical recipes in multiple data packs, load desired recipes AFTER their duplicates

Datapack version is formatted as A.B.C
- A marks breaking changes to how the data pack is written
- B marks changes in either the "Pack Format" version or the game version itself (major update)
  - Special Note: as of 5.5.0 (1.21.9), pack formating now has minor versions. All minor versions for any given major versions are intended to fully compatible (i.e. - 88.0, 88.1, etc.) and listed as only the major version (i.e. - 88).
- C marks minor changes or fixes

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
  - ex: see changes in 25w31a

Major breaking changes to each version:
 - 2.0.0 MC 1.17: Advancement Format change - custom recipe "condition" ("items")
 - 3.0.0 MC 1.20.5: Recipe Format change - recipe "result"
 - 4.0.0 MC 1.21: Folder Name change

title: Civilizations999
description: Civilizations is a robust Minecraft faction management system that enables players to form organized groups, set territories, and collaborate with team-based features.
body:
The Civilizations plugin is designed to enhance multiplayer gameplay in Minecraft by allowing players to create and manage their own civilizations. This plugin introduces a structured system for players to form factions, manage members, and engage in cooperative gameplay. With features like customizable civilization names, spawn points, and exclusive commands, players can enjoy a rich and immersive experience.

Features
Civilization Creation: Players can create their own civilizations with unique names and descriptions.
Member Management: Leaders can invite players, kick members, and manage ranks within their civilization.
Spawn Points: Each civilization can set a designated spawn point for its members.
Private Chat: Toggle chat visibility so that only civilization members can see messages.
GUI Interface: A user-friendly graphical interface to view civilization information and members.
Friendly Fire Prevention: Automatically prevents damage between members of the same civilization.
Configurable Limits: Set maximum members per civilization and default spawn locations.
Persistent Data Storage: All civilization data is saved in a YAML configuration file.
Commands
/civilizations create <name> [description]: Create a new civilization with an optional description.
/civilizations invite <player>: Invite a player to join your civilization.
/civilizations join: Accept a pending invitation to join a civilization.
/civilizations leave: Leave your current civilization.
/civilizations setspawn <civilization>: Set the spawn point for your civilization (Leader only).
/civilizations info [civilization]: View information about a specific civilization or all civilizations.
/civilizations myciv: View your civilization's members and leader.
/civilizations rename <newname>: Rename your civilization (Leader only).
/civilizations kick <player>: Kick a player from your civilization (Leader only).
/civilizations chat: Toggle chat visibility for your civilization.
/civilizations disband: Disband your civilization (Leader only).
/civilizations config reload: Reload the configuration file (OP only).
Permissions
civilizations.create: Allows players to create civilizations.
civilizations.invite: Allows players to invite others to their civilization.
civilizations.join: Allows players to join a civilization.
civilizations.leave: Allows players to leave their civilization.
civilizations.setspawn: Allows leaders to set the spawn point for their civilization.
civilizations.info: Allows players to view civilization information.
civilizations.myciv: Allows players to view their own civilization's details.
civilizations.rename: Allows leaders to rename their civilization.
civilizations.kick: Allows leaders to kick members from their civilization.
civilizations.chat: Allows players to toggle private chat for their civilization.
civilizations.disband: Allows leaders to disband their civilization.
civilizations.config: Allows OPs to reload the configuration file.
Conclusion
The Civilizations plugin is perfect for Minecraft servers looking to enhance community interaction and teamwork. With its robust features and easy-to-use commands, players can immerse themselves in a world of collaboration and strategy, making every gameplay session unique and engaging.

title: Simple Playtime Command
description: A simple mod that adds a /playtime command.
body:
# Playtime Mod (Fabric)

A lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.X that adds a simple `/playtime` command to show your total playtime in `hh:mm`.

## Features
- ⏱️ Quick Command: `/playtime` displays your total playtime.
- ✅ Vanilla-Accurate: Reads the built-in `Stats.PLAY_TIME` stat.
- 🧮 Clean Formatting: Converts ticks → seconds → `hh:mm`.
- 🌐 Works Everywhere: Singleplayer and Fabric servers.
- 🧩 Zero Config: No GUI, no mixins, minimal footprint.

## Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.X.
2. Download and install Fabric API (for 1.21.X).
3. Place the mod JAR into your `mods` folder.
4. Launch Minecraft with the Fabric profile.

## Usage
- In chat, run: `/playtime`
- Example output: `Playtime: 12:34`
- Available to all players by default.

## Compatibility
- Minecraft: 1.21.X
- Loader: Fabric
- Side: Client or Server (command executes on the server)
- Dependencies: Fabric API, Fabric Loader


## License
MIT License.

description: Rare swords with unique powers!
body:
Inspired by The Eight Fabled Blades mod for 1.12, this mod adds eight uncraftable swords with unique abilities and uses. Instead of crafting these swords, you must find them in vanilla structures like Strongholds or Nether Fortresses.

Location List:

**Arrow Render**: Dungeons and Abandoned Mineshafts
**Sentinel Sword**: Nether Fortresses and Dungeons
**Leg Breaker**: Strongholds and Woodland Mansions
**Light Bringer**: Desert Temples and Jungle Temples
**Gaia Blade**: Jungle Temples and Abandoned Mineshafts
**Blood Gorger**: Bastions and Nether Fortresses
**Armor Piercer**: Strongholds and Desert Temples
**Dark Deceiver**: Woodland Mansions and Bastions
Each sword is extremely rare and can only be repaired with Netherite, so use them wisely.

Sword Abilities:

**Arrow Render**: Hold right-click to block with the sword; nearby projectiles are slashed and destroyed.
**Sentinel Sword**: Hold right-click to block with the sword; briefly become invincible and immovable.
**Leg Breaker**: Hold right-click to charge up an attack; release to knock enemies back.
**Light Bringer**: Hits against undead have a chance to cause a holy explosion that applies "Holy fire" to undead. Undead kills always cause an explosion.
**Gaia Blade**: Full swings fire a wave in front of the player that pierces mobs.
Blood Gorger: Stores a percentage of damage dealt. Right-click to restore health with the stored damage.
**Armor Piercer**: Hold right-click to charge forward with increasing speed. Release to attack and apply "Armor Pierced" to the target.
**Dark Deceiver**: Right-click to summon a clone that draws enemy aggro. The player gains invisibility.
Sword Debuffs:

**Armor Pierced**: Removes 20% of armor and armor toughness by default. Stacks twice.
**Holy Fire**: Burns undead for 3% of their max health per second for 5 seconds.
Config:

Config options allow you to adjust ability damages, cooldowns, chance percentages, charge times, and loot table spawn chances.

title: Origins: Stack of Bees
description: A hive mind entity of Bees, stacked together, resembling a player. (For Fabric, Requires Pehkui)
body:
# Stack of Bees
_"A hive mind entity of Bees, stacked together, resembling a player."_

`Made for Fabric, Minecraft version 1.20.2, Origins version 1.12.4) impact: 3, Icon: Bee Nest, Requires Pehkui`

### "I <3 Bees"(Passives):
- [-+] My maximum health is equal to the amount of Bees in my body.
- [=] (0.5 hearts per Bee, up to 32 Hearts at the maximum 64 Bees)
- [-+] My size is equal to my Bees. 
- [=] (0.05 Block height per Bee.)
- [=] (0.05 at one Bee, up to 6 Blocks tall at the maximum 64 Bees.)
- [+]  I regen one Bee every 30 seconds.
- [-+] I count as an Arthropod, and the Bane of Arthropods enchantment can be used against me and my kind.
- [+] All of my attacks inflict 10 seconds of Poison
- [-] Whenever I damage something, one of my bees die as a consequence of losing their stinger

### "Scatter!"(Primary Active Ability, Default keybind = G):
- [+] I can drop 3 Bees from my body.
- [-] Dropping Bees reduces my maximum health pool.(with this ability = 1.5 hearts)

### "Reassemble!"(Sneak Ability, Default keybind = Shift):
- [+] I can collect nearby Bees.
- [+] They enter our system. + 0.5 Maximum hearts per Bee picked up.
- [+] Doing this gives me regen for 3 seconds.

### "Hive Mind Tactics"(Secondary Active Ability):
- [+] I can command nearby Bees to attack a target.
- [+] Passives:
- [+] When I am attacked, Bees will try to defend me.
- [+] When I attack, Bees will also attack with me.
- [+] Bees don't bother me.

### "Bee Flight"(Creative Flight Passives)
_"Together we can fly about as fast as human sprints"_
- [+] I don't take fall damage, unless I am near campfires or wearing too much armor.
- [-] I can't sprint while flying.
- [-] I can't fly or sprint anywhere near campfires and I become very slow and sleepy.
- [-] I cannot swim at all! Very difficult to enter flight or leave water!
- [-] I can't fly with better armor than full iron.

### "Weaknesses":
- [-] I start with only 10 Bees (5 hearts)
- [-] When I take damage, I drop Bees equal to the amount of damage taken.
- [=] This means that I also lose maximum health equal to the amount of damage taken.
- [-] PvP Opponents can counter this origin by placing water or campfires.
- [-] This origin can't fly and becomes greatly slowed when within 16 blocks of any Campfire.

_Origin by Frucs, inspired by and made for The Pollen Party Jam! A spinoff of the similar Origin Stack of Silverfish that I also made._

title: Location Logger
description: Allows the logging of players locations
body:
Location Logger logs the XYZ coordinates and current dimension of all players currently within the server and sends it to console at a set period, the default is 10 minutes. There is also a command to forcibly log everyone or to log a specific person.

If you have a problem or suggestion for the plugin, make sure to check out the [GitHub](https://github.com/1ByteBit/Player-Location-Logger)! (Currently, this plugin only works on paper and its forks)

### Commands:

/loglocations
/locations
/forcelog
- Permission: locationlog.forcelog
- Optional argument: <player>
- Logs all player locations before the set timer

/logadd <player>
- Permission: locationlog.listadd
- Adds specified player to the whitelist/blacklist

/logremove <player>
- Permission: locationlog.listremove
- Removes specified player to the whitelist/blacklist

/setlisttype <whitelist/blacklist>
/changelisttype <whitelist/blacklist>
- Permission: locationlog.setlisttype
- Changes between blacklist/whitelist

### Misc Permissions:

locationlog.viewlog
- People with this permission will be able to see the log of any specific person with /forcelog (This doesn't give them permission to use that command)

locationlog.viewautolog
- Not granted to OPs
- People with this permission will be able to see the automated logs in-game (May lead to spammy messages)

locationlog.exempt
- Not granted to OPs
- People with this permission won't be logged by the automated logger

### Default Config:
```
version: 1
# Don't touch the version number
settings:
  checkhours: 0
  checkminutes: 10
  checkseconds: 0
  # Setting all to zero will disable the automatic logger
  # Default is 10 minutes
  listtype: blacklist
  # Whether to use a blacklist or a whitelist, default is blacklist.
  # Blacklist prevents players from being logged, if whitelist is enabled then only specified people are logged
  shorten-log: false
  # Shortens the sentences of the logs
  bstats: true
specified-players:
```

title: Dyeable
description: A vanilla-style mod that gives the player the ability to mix dyes to create millions of unique colors, paint blocks, and make wallpapers.
body:
# Dyeable

This mod introduces a _"vanilla-style"_ way to mix dyes to create millions of unique dye colors and paint nearly **any** block in the game!

![3 Dye vats sit in a room with spruce and dark oak walls and flooring. The vats are made of wood.  The vats have shovels in them, and the water in them is colored - from left to right - burgundy, purple, and orange. Above the vats are stained glass blocks with various shades of orange. 2 banners can be seen on the wall, one is rose colored with an orange cross and white dot. One is purple with a cyan diagonal cross with a fuchsia diamond in the middle. There are 2 sheep in a pen to the left, colored light yellow and rose. Lanterns hang from the ceiling, colored red. Big text on the wall above the glass read "DYEABLE" with each letter being a tile.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1a28553fa90f64d4ecccafb6f6c3f1b59ca783e.png)

# Features

## Dye Vat

The _Dye Vat_ is used to mix dyes and dye items. Using the Dye Vat requires 3 things to function:
- Water input
- Shovel
- 2 or more input items

Water is replenished by filling the block with a water bucket, similarly to a cauldron. A shovel can be placed in the shovel slot. Shovels lose durability as they mix, and better shovels mix faster, increasing further with efficiency.

![A menu for a dye vat is on screen in the minecraft UI style. it has an inventory below, with 3 slots above with paint palette icons on them. On the left of the UI is a big water droplet shape with a bucket icon above it. On the right of the UI is a slot with a shovel icon in it. The three slots lead with an arrow to another empty slot below it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f287f0bcfbf93999fe869053eeb76de75de1c62_0.webp)

## Dye Mixing

2 or more dyes can be mixed together in the vat at a time to create a unique _Mixed Dye_. A Mixed Dye can only have a total of 10 colors or additives put into it; any more, and it no longer accepts them.

![Same UI as before, but the water drop is full of blue. A green dye is in the first slot and a blue dye in the second slot, the arrow is half-filled with white now. The shovel slot has a stone shovel in it. The output slot has a mixed dye with a blue-greenish grey color](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9daebca2f17b27a4fbe9cc59815856513a7051a_0.webp)

 Additives are items that don't directly affect the dye's hue in the mixing process, but instead alter its brightness or saturation:

- Glowstone is used to make dyes more saturated and colorful
- Glow Ink Sacs are used to make dyes brighter without totally washing them out.
- Ink Sacs are used to make dyes darker.
- Gunpowder is used to make dyes dull and less colorful.

![Same UI as before, but the water drop is filled halfway blue. A pale purple Mixed Dye is in the first slot, a Glow Ink Sac is in the second slot, and Glowstone is in the third slot. The arrow is half-filled with white now. The shovel slot has a netherite shovel in it. The output slot has a slightly more colorful purple Mixed Dye](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa2e12147ec93be00c9567993fa0975d96cbf93a_0.webp)

## Item Dyeing

Blocks and items can also be put in the Dye Vat, and can be mixed with multiple dyes at a time. Only one type of dyeable item can be dyed at a time; any attempts will be unsuccessful. The current dyeable items are:
- Wool
- Carpets
- Concrete
- Concrete Powder
- Terracotta
- Glass / Stained Glass
- Glass Panes / Stained Glass Panes
- Banners (only affects base color when put in vat)
- Beds
- Shulker Boxes

![Same UI as before, but the water drop is nearly full of blue. A blue-greenish grey Mixed Dye is in the first slot, a blue dye is in the second slot, and a glass pane is in the third slot. The arrow is partly filled with white now. The shovel slot has a stone shovel in it. The output slot has a stained glass pane with a dark pale blue.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/111e9e3196958669b911c4ad86f06995992c7f7b.png)

## Paint Mixing

By putting any type of dye, a clay ball, and a bucket in the input of the Dye Vat, the output will result in a _Paint Bucket_ given the pigment of your input's dye. Each Paint Bucket has 64 uses and will convert to a regular bucket once empty; Paint Buckets cannot be refilled or mixed with other paints.

![vat ui with paint in output slot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a298f8178f97264b327a7ddc219f9548692693d_0.webp)

## Block Painting

Nearly any block in the game can be painted, as long as you have a Paint Bucket and a _Paintbrush_. To paint a block, put the paint of your choice in your offhand and the Paintbrush in your main hand; Right-clicking will paint that block. You can use the _Paint Scraper_ to remove paint from any painted objects. (Due to limitations in rendering pipelines, any greyscale paints like greys or white do not affect the saturation of a texture, only brightness)

![Various minecraft blocks colored various other colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f219b07ca0abbff1e45f9a2fa27a66b540b9134b.png)

Currently, painting only supports Indigo (fabric) and Sodium renderers.

## Wallpaper Crafting

_Wallpapers_ are placeable items that are very similar to how banners function. A base Wallpaper can be crafted by putting paper and any dye(s) in the Dye Vat, making 4 at a time per piece of paper.

![vat ui with paper and purple dye making purple wallpaper. wallpaper item is just a square at an angle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61d0825785bcf889dca9e22896a7336caa4b02ae_0.webp)

A wallpaper can be put into the _Paper Press_ to add up to 16 patterns on its face; dyes are used to color patterns. Any pattern can be rotated in 90-degree intervals, flipped horizontally and vertically, and shifted by pixels in any direction; shifted patterns can also be wrapped around to the other side. Certain types of blocks can be put in the block slot to add an overlay.

![UI similar to loom. is a orange polka dot pattern with purple circle wallpaper slot and white dye in dye slot; Block slot has pale oak log. There is a preview with a grid of 4 patterns, the same pattern in the wallpaper slot. There are buttons on the side for rotating, flipping, wrapping, and moving the wallpaper pattern. The pattern list has various wood log textures.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb797181708fbc5f92b45ac8e4316b51da769537.png)

## Wallpaper Usage

Wallpapers can be placed on any solid 16x16 face, whether it's on walls, floors, or ceilings. Wallpapers aren't actually blocks, so they don't take up a block's space, allowing for the placement of torches, fences, doors, buttons, levers, etc. on them. Wallpaper is also completely immune to water and lava.

![a bunch of wallpapers with different designs on oak planks. there is a torch, 2 buttons, a trapdoor, and 2 cobble walls against the wall.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c51d3186f81839fe8f762fea1f956d8ca989a268.png)

## Banner Making

While certainly not a new feature, this mod allows Mixed Dyes to be used as a pattern color source in a Loom, increasing the original 809 quadrillion amount of possible banners to somewhere over one quinvigintillion (1 followed by 78 zeroes) banners (Note: this is mostly a guess, im not sure exactly how many of the 16,777,216 RGB colors are possible in my system, i just made a rough estimate).

![UI of the Loom with a red banner and a vibrant purple mixed dye being used for a gradient pattern.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3451bab758052b85ca4e96ed7e3ab56fb2038439_0.webp)

## Sheep Dyeing

Again, not a new feature, but mixed dyes can be used on sheep for an infinite wool source. Breeding mixed dyed sheep results in a baby with the exact mix of the wool colors of the 2 parents, no estimation.

## For Modders

I have made a mod template for an easy way to add more wallpaper patterns to the mod here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Jl2YZBgZqonhi4Zlz1O8kZJPcQsvB5ZU/view?usp=sharing


## End
I hope you find this mod useful for building, and if you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please let me know @ urixmusic on discord and other socials! Thank you.

title: Area Hints
description: A mod that displays the domain name which could be written by players when you enters an area
body:
---

# 🏷️ Area Hints Mod

**Add immersive area name popups to your Minecraft world!**
When entering custom regions, elegant area titles appear at the top of your screen. Supports multi-level nesting, dimension default names, and easy creation tools—making exploration feel truly meaningful.

---

## 📖 Overview

Areas Hint allows players to define regions (called “domains”) using polygons and display custom names upon entry. All calculations are handled client-side with multithreaded optimization, placing almost zero load on the server. Say goodbye to complex commands and use intuitive tools to mark your world with ease.

---

## ✨ Features

* **Player Customization**: Freely name regions, define boundaries and height.
* **High Performance**: Zero server load, with client-side optimization and multithreading.
* **Automatic Area Titles**: Enter places like “Elven Forest” or “Dark Castle” and see smooth title animations appear on screen.
* **Multi-level Regions**: Supports nested regions (e.g., “Kingdom” → “Throne Room”) with elegant transitions or combined displays.
* **Dimension Default Names**: Displays the dimension name (e.g., “Wilderness Continent”) when outside all regions.
* **Easy Creation Tool**: Use `/areahint easyadd` for an interactive setup—just walk and click to create areas.
* **Fully Customizable**: Modify names, colors, heights, split or merge regions anytime.
* **Beautiful & Smooth UI**: RPG-style title display (inspired by Genshin Impact), with adjustable styles and smooth animations.
* **No Claim Restrictions**: Mark any place freely—explore without limits.

---

## 🎯 Why Choose Areas Hint?

* **Player-Friendly**: No admin permissions required for creating area markers.
* **Optimized Performance**: Client-side processing keeps multiplayer smooth.
* **Plug and Play**: Install and start marking areas with simple commands.
* **Highly Compatible**: Works seamlessly with minimaps, shaders, and optimization mods.

---

## 🛠️ Features Overview

* Polygon-based region definition with multi-level domains (top-level / subdomains).
* Ray-casting detection to determine player position.
* Multiple rendering methods (CPU, OpenGL, Vulkan).
* Rich subtitle style customization.
* Full command system for configuration and management.
* Interactive domain creation tool **EasyAdd**, designed for ease of use.

---

## 📋 Command System

### Basic Commands

| Command | Description | Common Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/areahint help` | Show all commands and usage | Everyone |
| `/areahint reload` | Reload configuration and area files | Admin |
| `/areahint on` | Enable client-side area hints | Everyone |
| `/areahint off` | Disable client-side area hints | Everyone |

### Area Viewing & Management

| Command | Description | Common Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/areahint check` | List all joint areas | Everyone |
| `/areahint check <joint area>` | View details of a specific joint area | Everyone |
| `/areahint delete` | Start interactive area deletion | Everyone (usually only for areas you can operate) |
| `/areahint tcp [area]` | Teleport to a safe location near the area's center | Teleport permission |
| `/areahint udp [area]` | Teleport to a random safe location inside the area | Teleport permission |
| `/areahint settp [command prefix]` | Set the command prefix used for teleporting, e.g., `tp` or `minecraft:tp` | Teleport settings permission |

### Area Creation & Editing

| Command | Description | Common Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/areahint add <JSON>` | Add an area via JSON (kept for compatibility; `easyadd` recommended) | Admin |
| `/areahint easyadd` | Start interactive area addition | Everyone |
| `/areahint addarea` | Full alias for `easyadd`, supports the same interactive subcommands | Everyone |
| `/areahint rename` | Start interactive area renaming | Everyone |
| `/areahint addsignature` | Add an extended signature to an area | Admin or signature operators |
| `/areahint deletesignature` | Delete an area's extended signature | Admin or signature operators |

### Area Geometry Editing

| Command | Description | Common Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/areahint expandarea` | Select an area from a list to expand | Everyone |
| `/areahint expandarea <area>` | Directly specify an area to expand (recommended) | Everyone |
| `/areahint shrinkarea` | Select an area from a list to shrink | Everyone |
| `/areahint shrinkarea <area>` | Directly specify an area to shrink (recommended) | Everyone |
| `/areahint dividearea` | Start interactive area division | Everyone |

### Single Vertex Editing

| Command | Description | Common Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/areahint addhint` | Start interactive vertex addition | Everyone |
| `/areahint deletehint` | Start interactive vertex deletion | Everyone |

### Style & Display Settings

| Command | Description | Common Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/areahint recolor` | Start interactive area recoloring | Everyone |
| `/areahint sethigh` | Start interactive area height setting | Everyone |
| `/areahint hintrender` | View current rendering mode | Everyone |
| `/areahint hintrender <cpu\|opengl\|vulkan>` | Set rendering mode | Everyone |
| `/areahint titlestyle` | Start interactive area title style selection | Everyone |
| `/areahint titlesize` | Start interactive area title size selection | Everyone |
| `/areahint addsubtitle` | Add or replace the area subtitle | Admin or signature operators |
| `/areahint replacesubtitle` | Alias for `addsubtitle` with replace semantics | Admin or signature operators |
| `/areahint deletesubtitle` | Delete the area subtitle | Admin or signature operators |
| `/areahint replacesubtitlecolor` | Change the area subtitle color | Admin or signature operators |
| `/areahint replacesubtitlesize` | Change subtitle size for this client | Everyone |
| `/areahint frequency` | Show current detection frequency | Everyone |
| `/areahint frequency <1-60>` | Set detection frequency (supports decimals) | Everyone |

### Description System

| Command | Description | Common Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/areahint adddescription` | Add a normal area description | Admin or signature operators |
| `/areahint replacedescription` | Replace a normal area description | Admin or signature operators |
| `/areahint deletedescription` | Delete a normal area description (only deletes the description file) | Admin or signature operators |
| `/areahint adddimensionalitydescription` | Add a dimension area description | Admin or dimension area signers |
| `/areahint replacedimensionalitydescription` | Replace a dimension area description | Admin or dimension area signers |
| `/areahint deletedimensionalitydescription` | Delete a dimension area description (only deletes the description file) | Admin or dimension area signers |

### Dimension Area Management

| Command | Description | Common Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/areahint dimensionalityname` | Start interactive dimension area name management | Depends on server configuration |
| `/areahint dimensionalitycolor` | Start interactive dimension area color management | Depends on server configuration |
| `/areahint firstdimname <name>` | Set the dimension area name when entering a new unnamed dimension for the first time | Everyone |
| `/areahint firstdimname_skip` | Skip the first-time dimension area name setting | Everyone |

### Other Features

| Command | Description | Common Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/areahint replacebutton` | Start interactive key binding replacement | Everyone |
| `/areahint boundviz` | Toggle boundary visualization | Everyone |
| `/areahint language` | Start interactive language selection | Everyone |
| `/areahint debug` | Toggle debug mode | Admin |
| `/areahint debug on` | Enable debug mode | Admin |
| `/areahint debug off` | Disable debug mode | Admin |
| `/areahint debug status` | View debug status | Admin |
| `/areahint serverlanguage <language code>` | Set server-side log language | Console / High permission |

---

## 🏰 Use Cases

* **RPG Servers**: Name towns, dungeons, and wilderness areas to enhance immersion.
* **Adventure Maps**: Add story-driven area titles or hidden location names.
* **Building Servers**: Label large builds with names or authors.
* **Singleplayer Worlds**: Mark your base, farms, mines—create your own journey log.

---

## ✅ Compatibility

Areas Hint is fully compatible with the following mods (tested):

*(Keep your original compatibility list as-is, since mod names remain unchanged.)*

---

## 🌟 Final Words

Areas Hint is more than just a mod—it’s the “place naming system” of your Minecraft world. It makes every journey feel meaningful and immersive. Whether you're building an epic RPG server or documenting your personal creations, it adds a whole new layer of experience.

**Try it now and give your world its own identity!**

title: CRM
description: API mod that provides various utilities for using CometRenderer within Minecraft.
body:
CRM (CometRenderer Mod) is a library that provides various utilities for using CometRenderer within Minecraft.

## Whats CometRenderer?
CometRenderer is an optimized, customized and full independent rendering system for OpenGL. This provides a wide range of tools that can be used to easily render your projects.

In the context of Minecraft, its main feature is that over 80% of all rendering code will be identical for all versions of Minecraft for which there is a CRM. This means that when you port your mod from one Minecraft version to another, almost all of the rendering-related code will remain identical.

## Documentation
The project has [documentation](https://ferra13671-dev.gitbook.io/projects/main/cometrenderer-documentation/crm/about) that contains various information about using CometRenderer and CRM.

## FAQ
### Can it replace Sodium or Optifine?
No. CRM provides an various utilities for using CometRenderer in Minecraft, without changing Minecraft's rendering.
### Does this library have a Forge version?
No. I don't currently have any plans to port it to Forge, but I might do so in the future.

title: Enchanting-Plus+
description: Enchanting Plus is a Vanilla+ enchanting overhaul that adds enchantment previews, rerolls, reusable enchanting fuel, powerful catalysts, and potion-based enchanting luck while preserving Minecraft's vanilla balance.
body:
# Enchanting Plus

Enchanting Plus is a Vanilla+ Fabric mod that expands and improves Minecraft's enchanting system without replacing or trivializing vanilla mechanics. Instead of adding overpowered enchantments or complex magic systems, the mod focuses on solving the most frustrating parts of enchanting while keeping the experience balanced, rewarding, and familiar.

Have you ever spent dozens of levels rerolling enchantments, wished you could see the hidden enchantments before committing, or been blocked by the dreaded "Too Expensive!" message? Enchanting Plus addresses these problems with a collection of carefully designed tools and mechanics that integrate naturally into survival gameplay.

## Features

### 🔮 Enchantment Lens

Reveal every enchantment that will be applied before enchanting. Hold the Enchantment Lens in your offhand while using an enchanting table to view the complete list of enchantments hidden behind each offer. No more guessing whether that Sharpness IV enchantment also contains Looting III or Unbreaking III.

### 🎲 Enchantment Rerolls

Unhappy with your current enchantment offers? Reroll all available enchanting table options for a small XP cost instead of wasting levels enchanting disposable items just to refresh the table.

### 💎 Catalyst

Replace lapis lazuli with Catalyst, a reusable enchanting fuel crafted from lapis and amethyst. Each Catalyst contains multiple charges and can be used for several enchantments before being consumed, making enchanting more convenient while remaining balanced.

### ✨ Focus Catalyst

A powerful consumable that transforms all enchanting table offers into maximum-tier enchantments. Focus Catalysts also allow already-enchanted equipment to receive additional compatible enchantments directly through the enchanting table, giving new life to gear that would otherwise rely solely on anvils and villagers.

### 🍀 Lucky Enchanter Potions

Brew special potions that increase the quality of enchantments generated by the enchanting table. Lucky Enchanter potions improve the chances of receiving stronger enchantments, additional enchantments, and better enchantment combinations while fully respecting vanilla enchantment limits and compatibility rules.

### 🏺 Ancient Catalyst

A rare treasure hidden within end-game structures. Holding an Ancient Catalyst while using an anvil allows you to bypass Minecraft's infamous "Too Expensive!" restriction and continue upgrading your gear. The item is consumed upon use and remains a valuable late-game resource for players pursuing perfect equipment.

## Designed for Vanilla+

Enchanting Plus is built around a simple philosophy: improve enchanting without breaking Minecraft's progression.

The mod:

* Does not add overpowered enchantments.
* Does not exceed vanilla enchantment limits.
* Respects vanilla enchantment compatibility rules.
* Preserves the importance of exploration and resource gathering.
* Works naturally alongside vanilla survival progression.

Instead of replacing Minecraft's enchanting system, Enchanting Plus enhances it with better information, improved quality of life, and meaningful end-game progression.

Whether you're a casual survival player, a technical Minecraft enthusiast, or someone chasing the perfect set of gear, Enchanting Plus makes enchanting more rewarding, less frustrating, and significantly more enjoyable while staying true to the spirit of vanilla Minecraft.

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API

Thank you for trying Enchanting Plus, and happy enchanting!

title: MCA Hat Layer Fix
description: Suppresses the MCA Reborn villager hat skin layer when a helmet is equipped, eliminating z-fighting and texture flickering.
body:
# MCA Hat Layer Fix

A small NeoForge mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that fixes a visual issue with [MCA Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-comes-alive-reborn) villagers.

## The Problem

MCA Reborn villager skins frequently include a hat layer (the outer head overlay in the standard 64×64 skin format). When a villager is equipped with a helmet, both the hat layer and the helmet render in the same space, causing the textures to overlap and flicker.

## The Fix

When a villager has any item in their head equipment slot, the hat skin layer is suppressed for that render frame. When no helmet is present, the hat layer renders normally, so hairstyles and accessories that use the overlay are unaffected when no headwear is equipped.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.230+
- MCA Reborn 7.7.7+

## Installation

Drop the jar into your `mods/` folder alongside MCA Reborn

title: Bliss Maces
description: The 3 maces and mega mace from bliss smp
body:
![Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df9f28a60cb059fb48c7af78015b042fe739548a.png)

# BlissMaces

A Paper plugin that turns the vanilla Mace into a server-wide mythic artifact. Built for the Bliss SMP — only **three** individual maces and one Mega Mace can ever exist on your server, gated behind a finite, craftable currency.

## Overview

- **3 individual maces** ever, server-wide. Persistent across restarts.
- **24 Energy Tokens** ever, the sole resource that crafts maces.
- **Mega Mace** assembled from all three — splits back to 3 on the holder's death.
- **Cooldown + enchant restrictions** on individual maces.
- **Storage lockdown** — restricted maces can't be hidden in chests, ender chests, shulker boxes, hoppers, etc.
- **Indestructible** — unbreakable in hand, immune to fire / lava / explosions / void as a dropped item entity.

## Recipes

The vanilla mace recipe is removed. Maces can only be crafted through this chain.

### Energy Token

![Energy Token Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a4b30efdb36b6c10f2976b6c94871e1b6647f83.png)

Yields 1 Energy Token — an Amethyst Shard with custom NBT, purple display name, and a subtle glow.

### Individual Mace (numbered 1, 2, then 3)

![Mace Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c8d8034d7118174718e4bae6a4072673a6ba5bc.png)

8 Energy Tokens around 1 Heavy Core. The first craft produces Mace #1, the second Mace #2, the third Mace #3. Crafting after that fails — the cap is permanent.

### Mega Mace

![Mega Mace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25a74a40c26359c8ed6fc63a71c0e0c99d526249.png)

Place all three individual maces in any crafting grid (shapeless). One player must hold all three at once. Crafting a Mega Mace is broadcast server-wide.

## Mace mechanics

### Individual maces
- **1-minute cooldown** between successful hits, per mace, persisted on the item.
- **No damage enchantments** — Sharpness, Smite, Bane, Density, Breach, and Fire Aspect are stripped at the anvil and enchanting table, and re-scrubbed every time the mace is used.
- Action-bar countdown shows on each blocked hit attempt.

### Mega Mace
- No cooldown, no enchantment restrictions.
- Carries a permanent glow and `Unbreakable: true`.
- On the holder's death, splits back into the three individual maces and drops as loot. Broadcasts to the server.

### Indestructibility
All four mace variants are:
- **Unbreakable** in hand — no durability decay.
- **Damage-immune** as dropped item entities — fire, lava, cactus, explosions, and the void all cancel.
- **Combust-immune** — they never visually catch fire.

### Storage restriction
Restricted maces may only enter these inventories:

- Player inventory
- 2×2 crafting grid + crafting table
- Anvil
- Enchanting table
- Grindstone

They are blocked from chests, ender chests, shulker boxes, barrels, hoppers, droppers, dispensers, furnaces, brewing stands, and anything else. Click, drag, hopper transfer, and hopper pickup are all intercepted with a clear action-bar warning.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/mace give <1\|2\|3\|mega> [player]` | Spawn a tagged mace. |
| `/mace token give <amount> [player]` | Spawn Energy Tokens (admin / testing). |
| `/mace state` | Show current counters vs. hard caps. |
| `/mace set <tokens\|maces> <count>` | Override the persisted counters. |
| `/mace fix [player\|all]` | Re-issue tagged maces in inventories + ender chests using the current formatting. Preserves mace number and cooldown state. |
| `/mace reload` | Reload `config.yml` and `state.yml`. |

All commands require `blissmaces.admin` (default: op).

## Configuration

`config.yml` keys, with defaults:

```yaml
cooldown-seconds: 60
blocked-enchantments:
  - sharpness
  - smite
  - bane_of_arthropods
  - fire_aspect
  - density
  - breach
max-tokens: 24
max-individual-maces: 3
individual-name-format: "&6Mace &e#{number}"
mega-mace-name: "&5&lMega Mace"
cooldown-actionbar: "&cMace cooldown: &e{seconds}s"
enchant-blocked-message: "&cThat enchantment is not allowed on an individual mace."
mega-craft-broadcast: "&5&l{player} &dhas forged the &5&lMega Mace&d!"
mega-death-broadcast: "&d{player} &7died holding the &5&lMega Mace&7 - it split back into 3 maces."
individual-craft-broadcast: "&6{player} &eforged &6Mace #{number}&e!"
```

Persistent state — `tokens-crafted` and `maces-crafted` — lives in `plugins/BlissMaces/state.yml`. Edit the file or use `/mace set` to reset.

## Requirements

- **Paper 1.21.x** (Purpur and other forks also fine; not Folia-compatible)
- **Java 21**

## Installation

1. Drop `blissmaces-X.X.X.jar` into your server's `plugins/` folder.
2. Restart the server.
3. Defaults are production-ready. Tune `config.yml` if you want different caps, messages, or blocked enchants.

## Notes

- The plugin removes the vanilla `minecraft:mace` recipe and additionally voids any third-party recipe that would produce an untagged mace, so the token chain is the only path on your server.
- Maces issued through `/give minecraft:mace ...` are plain vanilla maces and do not participate in the cooldown, enchant, or storage logic. Always use `/mace give` instead.
- Caps are persistent. Once 24 tokens have been crafted, no more can ever be made (unless you reset `state.yml` or run `/mace set tokens 0`).

title: Keep Inventory Plus
description: Nerfed keep inventory in minecraft. Modifications to how experience, hunger and items are handled upon death
body:
# KeepInvPlus

A highly configurable death penalty plugin for Paper servers that adds meaningful 
consequences on top of the `keepInventory` gamerule — without taking everything away.

## Overview
Vanilla `keepInventory` is all-or-nothing. KeepInvPlus lets server admins define 
nuanced death penalties across three attributes: **XP levels**, **hunger**, and **items** — 
all configurable live via commands with no server restart required.

Every attribute shares the same powerful two-tier logic:

**Tier 1 — Conditions:** All active conditions must pass for the default outcome to apply.  
**Tier 2 — Exceptions:** If any condition fails, exceptions are checked in the order they 
were added. The last matching exception wins. If no exception matches, the penalty applies.  
If all conditions pass, exceptions are skipped entirely.

---

## Features

### ⚔️ XP Penalties
Stack multiple penalties applied in the order they were added:
- `SUBTRACT` — lose a configurable number of levels (negative values *grant* levels)
- `HALVE` — levels cut in half
- `REMOVE_ALL` — lose all levels
- `PERCENTAGE` — lose a configurable percentage of current levels
  - Negative percentage grants levels on death
  - Values over 100% can push levels into the negative
  - Optional `zero_cap` prevents levels from going below 0

### 🍖 Hunger System
Rather than punishing death, KeepInvPlus **rewards good play**. Players respawn with 
their pre-death hunger unless they meet all configured replenishment conditions:
- `TIME_ALIVE` — must have survived a minimum number of seconds
- `BAR_CONSUMED` — must have consumed at least one hunger bar before dying

### 🎒 Item Penalties
- `GAMBLE` — each non-gear item has a configurable chance of being lost on death
- `LOSE_NON_GEAR` — lose all items except tools and armor

### 🔀 Exceptions (XP, Hunger & Items)
All three attributes support a shared exception system as a fallback when conditions fail:

**XP & Items exceptions** (`APPLY` / `SKIP`):
- `PVP_DEATH` — trigger when killed by another player
- `SUICIDE` — trigger when the player kills themselves

**Hunger exceptions** (`REPLENISH` / `DENY`):
- `PVP_DEATH` — being killed by another player can force full replenishment
- `SUICIDE` — self-kills can force hunger denial regardless of other results

Exceptions are evaluated in the order they were added — **last matching exception wins**, 
giving server admins fine-grained control over edge cases.

---

## Example Configurations

**Hardcore economy server:** Subtract 10 levels on death, skip penalty if killed by a player.
```
/kip set xp enabled true
/kip set xp type add SUBTRACT
/kip set xp subtract_amount 10
/kip set xp exception add PVP_DEATH SKIP
```

**PvP event server:** Grant levels on death to incentivise fighting.
```
/kip set xp enabled true
/kip set xp type add SUBTRACT
/kip set xp subtract_amount -5
```

**Survival server:** Replenish hunger only if you survived long enough and ate well.
```
/kip set hunger enabled true
/kip set hunger condition add TIME_ALIVE
/kip set hunger condition add BAR_CONSUMED
/kip set hunger min_seconds_alive 120
/kip set hunger exception add PVP_DEATH REPLENISH
/kip set hunger exception add SUICIDE DENY
```

---

## Commands
```
/kip set xp enabled <true|false>
/kip set xp type add <SUBTRACT|HALVE|REMOVE_ALL|PERCENTAGE>
/kip set xp type remove <SUBTRACT|HALVE|REMOVE_ALL|PERCENTAGE>
/kip set xp subtract_amount <number>
/kip set xp percentage <number>
/kip set xp zero_cap <true|false>
/kip set xp exception add <PVP_DEATH|SUICIDE> <APPLY|SKIP>
/kip set xp exception remove <PVP_DEATH|SUICIDE>

/kip set hunger enabled <true|false>
/kip set hunger condition add <TIME_ALIVE|BAR_CONSUMED>
/kip set hunger condition remove <TIME_ALIVE|BAR_CONSUMED>
/kip set hunger min_seconds_alive <seconds>
/kip set hunger exception add <PVP_DEATH|SUICIDE> <REPLENISH|DENY>
/kip set hunger exception remove <PVP_DEATH|SUICIDE>

/kip set items enabled <true|false>
/kip set items type <NONE|GAMBLE|LOSE_NON_GEAR>
/kip set items gamble_chance <0.0-1.0>
/kip set items exception add <PVP_DEATH|SUICIDE> <APPLY|SKIP>
/kip set items exception remove <PVP_DEATH|SUICIDE>

/kip get <xp|hunger|items|all>
/kip reload
```

## Permissions
| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `keepinvplus.admin` | Access to all /kip commands | OP |

## Requirements
- Paper 1.21+
- Java 21+
- `keepInventory` gamerule must be enabled (`/gamerule keepInventory true`)

## Additional remarks
- Plugin tested on Paper server 1.21.11
- COULD be compatible with Spigot/Bukkit/Other platforms mentioned but try at your own risk
- Have fun :)

title: The Midnight Pristine
description: Expands on The Last Voyage of the Harpy Express modpack by adding a new map to be used. It also adds some QoL mods.
body:
![The new station for The Midnight Pristine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1360628b06dba33df7005b6cc4023c48a665d4c0.png)
# The Midnight Pristine
_"A Last Voyage of the Harpy Express Map"_

This pack aims to expand on [The Last Voyage of the Harpy Express](https://modrinth.com/modpack/harpy-express) modpack made by [@doctor4t](https://modrinth.com/user/RAT) and their team by adding a new custom made map to be used instead of the original map. Alongside that, the pack also adds some QoL mods and resource packs both with the goal to further smooth out the visuals. This includes things like improved player animations and eating animations.

Instead of boarding the Harpy Express, the participants now board the Midnight Pristine, a train designed by Le Drapé, a well-known train company in the 1950's. This new train has a fully revamped interior and exterior, the only thing it has in common with the Harpy Express is the locations of snack- and drinktrays, bedrooms and places to get fresh air (Check the gallery for a quick rundown). The station where the participants board the train has also been completely revamped, making it feel more alive and industrial.

### A train murder social game
Six people must board the train in the lobby to start the game, the game can also be started by ringing the horn in the engine. If you do not wish to participate in the game, simply do not board the train.

### Important Information for hosting
In order to use this map on a server, the world file of the server has to be replaced with the save file called 'The Midnight Pristine' provided by modpack. The modpack installed on the server can either be [The Last Voyage of the Harpy Express](https://modrinth.com/modpack/harpy-express), [The Harpy Express: Extended](https://modrinth.com/modpack/the-harpy-express-extended) or this modpack. The server should also use the exact same settings as the original [The Last Voyage of the Harpy Express](https://modrinth.com/modpack/harpy-express) modpack uses for hosting. Lastly, I'd recommend checking that the world being used has its setting configured to be in peaceful mode, adventure mode, enable PvP and enable Command Blocks, otherwise the map won't work.

## Credits

Credits for the original modpack used for making this map: [The Last Voyage of the Harpy Express](https://modrinth.com/modpack/harpy-express) modpack go to [@doctor4t](https://modrinth.com/user/RAT).

InventoryLink is a lightweight Minecraft mod that syncs players’ inventories in real-time, no matter the world, server, or chunk loading. Perfect for multi-instance setups or anyone who wants reliable inventory updates without hassle.

# **Chickoin: The Ultimate In-Game Economy Mod!**

## **Greetings, Adventurer!**

Tired of simple bartering? Dive into a **fully functional economic system** that brings sophisticated banking, secure storage, and even a bit of risk to your Minecraft world! **Chickoin** is more than just a currency—it's the complete infrastructure you need to build and manage your wealth. Get ready to trade, save, and secure your funds!

## 💰 **Core Economic Features**

**The Chickoin Currency**: Our visually refreshed currency is the new standard for wealth! Use Chickoins for all **player-to-player trading and payments**.

**The Wallet**: A safe and portable inventory slot for carrying your hard-earned Chickoins anywhere you go.

**The Secure Safe**: Protect your valuables! This high-security storage unit is secured with a **personal password**, ensuring only you can access your savings. The safe features a **robust, secure design**.

**The Classic ATM**: We've designed a reliable **MinecraftCard-ATM system** from the ground up. Use your **MinecraftCard** to seamlessly **deposit or withdraw** your Chickoins.

title: AE2 Pattern Counter
description: AE2 Pattern Counter adds specialized monitoring blocks that display the number of specific pattern types stored in your AE2 network. Perfect for tracking your automation setup at a glance.
body:
# AE2 Pattern Counter

**Monitor your Applied Energistics 2 pattern inventory in real-time!**

AE2 Pattern Counter adds specialized monitoring blocks that display the number of specific pattern types stored in your AE2 network. Perfect for tracking your automation setup at a glance.

## Features

### Five Specialized Counters
- **Crafting Pattern Counter** - Monitors standard crafting patterns
- **Processing Pattern Counter** - Tracks processing patterns
- **Fluid Pattern Counter** - Counts fluid crafting patterns
- **Smithing Pattern Counter** - Displays smithing table patterns
- **Stonecutting Pattern Counter** - Shows stonecutter patterns

### Visual Feedback
- **Real-time Count Display** - See your pattern count directly on the monitor face
- **Power Status Indicator** - Bright texture when powered, dark when off
- **Offline Detection** - "OFFLINE" message with smooth blinking animation when no channel is available
- **Color-Coded** - Each pattern type has its own unique color scheme

### Easy to Use
- Place on any AE2 cable like other AE2 parts
- Automatically connects to your ME network
- No configuration needed - just place and monitor
- Works on all block faces and orientations

## Requirements

### Forge
- **Minecraft**: 1.20.1
- **Forge**: 47.3.0+
- **Applied Energistics 2**: Required
- **Architectury API**: Required

### Fabric
- **Minecraft**: 1.20.1
- **Fabric Loader**: Latest
- **Applied Energistics 2**: Required
- **Architectury API**: Required
- **Fabric API**: Required

## Installation

1. Download the mod JAR for your loader (Forge or Fabric)
2. Install Applied Energistics 2 and Architectury API
3. Place all mod files in your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft

## Usage

1. Craft the pattern counter you want to monitor
2. Place it on any AE2 cable or network block
3. The counter will automatically display the number of patterns of that type in your network
4. If "OFFLINE" appears, check your network channel allocation

## Compatibility

- **Multi-platform**: Works on both Forge and Fabric
- **Optional Mods**: Compatible with Jade/HWYLA/WTHIT for additional tooltips
- **AE2 Addons**: Compatible with other AE2 addon mods

## License

This mod is licensed under LGPLv2.1

## Support

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Open an issue on the GitHub repository!

## Credits

Created by Madgique

# RealMobSize

Generate your mobs with real-life scale

## Features

- Generate Minecraft mobs that exist in real life with a more realistic size.

  For example, bees in Minecraft are 30 times larger than in real life. In RealMobSize, their scale is reduced to make them as realistic as possible.
- Compatible with projects that define their own mob sizes
- Ability to configure the size at which entities will be generated.
  
  By default, RealMobSize has predetermined sizes, but through its configuration, you can modify the scale at which they will spawn.

  The available types can be found here https://jd.papermc.io/paper/1.21.10/org/bukkit/entity/EntityType.html,
  but keep in mind that you can only modify the scale of mobs that spawn normally or that can be generated,
  such as sheep or zombies (most already have a default configuration).
  In other words, you cannot modify the scale of entities such as Minecarts or fireballs.

## Compatibility
- Paper 1.21+

title: birthday-fabric
description: A birthday celebration mod designed for Minecraft servers, allowing each player to set their birthday and receive gifts and warm wishes from others on their special day!
body:
## Description

A birthday celebration mod designed for Minecraft servers, allowing each player to set their birthday and receive gifts and warm wishes from others on their special day!

## Features

- Players can set their birthday (MM-DD format)
- Players can modify their birthday up to 3 times (configurable)
- Admins can set/modify birthdays for other players
- Birthday info persists across server restarts
- Players can say "Happy Birthday" or "生日快乐" in chat to receive a cake
- Special birthday message and cake for the birthday player
- Automatic birthday detection (checks daily)

## Commands

- `/birthday <MM-DD>` - Set your birthday date (e.g. `/birthday 05-20`)
- `/birthday info` - Check your current birthday setting
- `/birthday list` - List all players with birthdays today
- `/birthday for <player> <MM-DD>` - Set birthday for another player (OP required)
- `/birthday reload` - Reload configuration (OP required)

## Configuration

Mod configuration file is located at `./config/birthdaymod/config.json`. Here's the default configuration with explanations:

### Default Config

```json5
{
  // Player settings
  "maxModifications": 3,                 // Maximum number of times a player can change their birthday
  "announceCooldownHours": 4,            // Minimum hours between birthday announcements
  
  // Message templates (use %s for dynamic values)
  "birthdaySet": "§6Your birthday: §e%s", // Message when player sets their birthday
  "birthdayAdminSet": "§6Set birthday for §b<%s> §6to: §e%s", // Admin sets birthday for another player
  "birthdayTodayPlayers": "§dToday's birthday players: §a<%s>", // List of today's birthdays
  "birthdayReminder": "§eYou haven't set your birthday yet. Use §b/birthday MM-DD §eto set it.", // Reminder for unset birthdays
  "birthdayCakeReceived": "§dYou received a birthday cake from §b<%s>", // Cake reward message
  "birthdayInvalid": "§cInvalid date format! §7Please use §eMM-DD§7 (e.g. §a05-20§7)", // Invalid date format error
  "birthdayWarning": "§cYou've modified your birthday too many times! §7Please contact an admin if you need further changes.", // Modification limit warning
  
  // System messages
  "birthdayAnnouncement": "§a[System] §6Today is §e<%s>§6's birthday (‾◡◝). §aLet's all wish them a happy birthday! §7(Type §b'Happy Birthday' §7in chat to receive a birthday cake!)", // Server-wide birthday announcement
  "birthdayMessage": "§a[System] §e(｡･∀･)ﾉﾞ Hi §b%s§e, happy birthday! §aPlease check your inventory for a special gift from us. §dThank you for your continued support. May you find happiness under every starry sky!", // Personal birthday message
  
  // Chat triggers
  "rewardKeywords": [                    // Phrases that trigger cake rewards when said in chat
    "Happy Birthday",                    // Default English trigger
    "生日快乐"                           // Default Chinese trigger
  ]
}
```

## License

MIT

title: JamesHouse
description: A carefully handpicked modpack that preserves vanilla gameplay while empowering small communities to thrive together — welcome to James' House.
body:
# 🏠 James' House

*Welcome, guest! I'm James' interpreter — I handle the technical, the administrative, and the tedious so James can focus on the vision. What you're stepping into is not just a modpack — it's James' House. And in this house, we honor vanilla Minecraft.*

**James' House** is a handpicked collection of mods curated by James himself, designed to stay true to the spirit of vanilla while giving small communities the tools they need to thrive. Think of it as *vanilla turned up just a notch* — refined, respectful, and never disruptive.

Built for servers with around 10–20 players, every mod is selected to enhance the multiplayer experience without overwriting the charm of the original game. **No backpacks. No overpowered automation. No vanilla obsolescence.** Just a better way to play together.

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🔧 Quality-of-Life, Not Life Hacks  
Mods like **Mouse Tweaks**, **Right Click Harvest**, and **PickUpNotifier** improve the experience without changing the gameplay loop. Minecraft still feels like Minecraft — just with fewer frustrations.

### 🧱 Visuals That Respect Vanilla  
Thanks to **Complementary Shaders**, **Fresh Animations**, **Visuality**, and **Enhanced Block Entities**, the world looks stunning without looking like another game entirely.

### 👥 Built for Community  
With tools like **Litematica**, **ReplayMod**, **Scribble**, and **Visual Workbench**, you'll find it easier than ever to collaborate, plan, and create shared goals in survival.

### 🗺️ A World Worth Exploring  
Mods like **Oh The Biomes You’ll Go**, **Better Nether/End**, and **Dungeons & Taverns** deepen the world without rewriting its rules. Every discovery still feels earned.

### 📦 Storage with Integrity  
Yes, we have **Iron Chests** and **Easy Shulker Boxes**, but *no* to backpacks. James has spoken. Shulkers remain king.

### 🚀 Server Performance, Tuned  
Powered by **Sodium**, **VMP**, **FerriteCore**, **C2ME**, and others, the pack is optimized for smooth server play with minimal performance costs.

---

## 🧭 James' Philosophy

> "Vanilla is sacred. Mods are for flavor, not domination." – James (loosely paraphrased by me)

- **No vanilla item or block is made obsolete**  
  Every mod is chosen to complement—not compete with—the core game.

- **Approachable for all**  
  Whether you're a Minecraft veteran or a casual builder, you'll find comfort in this world. Nothing’s locked behind wikis or spreadsheets.

- **Multiplayer is the goal**  
  James loves community, and this pack reflects that. It’s meant for town projects, server events, co-op survival, and shared memories.

---

## 🧰 Server Recommendations

- **Players:** 10–20  
- **RAM:** 4–6 GB  
- **Great for:** Private SMPs, friend groups, small public servers

---

## 🎙️ Final Words from the Interpreter

This is James' House. We just help keep it running.

If you're here, you're welcome. Just remember: the vision is sacred, the shulkers are essential, and no one touches the configs without asking James first.

---

*– James' Interpreter, keeper of logs and loader of datapacks*

title: RealRegions
description: GUI based World and Region management plugin
body:
# RealRegions Plugin

Welcome to the **RealRegions** plugin page!  
RealRegions is a brand-new GUI-based World and Region management plugin.  
**Note:** To use this plugin, you will need **FAWE** or **WorldEdit**.

## Statistics  
[Plugin Statistics on bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/RealRegions/19311)

## Found an Issue?  
Report it [here](https://github.com/joserodpt/RealRegions/issues) or message me on Discord.  

**Discord:** [Join the Discord Server](https://discord.gg/SK7M7f2YkV)

## Features  
- **Integration with RealMines**: Automatically creates a region for a mine.  
- **Integration with RealPermissions**: Sync up permissions easily.  
- **YAML Configuration** for easy customization.  
- **Simple and Performant GUI Interface** for seamless management.  
- **Flag Toggling by GUI** for easy control.  
- **Console Commands** supported for advanced usage.  
- **Permission Bypass** for region flags.  
- **World Management**: Create, import, unload, and manage worlds using commands or GUI.

## Commands & Permissions

### 1. Default Command
- **Command:** `/realregions` or `/rr`  
- **Function:** Displays plugin information, such as the plugin name and version.

### 2. Reload Command
- **Command:** `/realregions reload` or `/rr reload`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Reloads the configuration files and updates the plugin settings.

### 3. Worlds Command
- **Command:** `/realregions worlds` or `/rr worlds`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Lists all registered worlds and their load status. Opens a GUI for players.

### 4. Create Command
- **Command:** `/realregions create <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Creates a region by selecting a WorldEdit region and associates it with the specified name.

### 5. Create World Command
- **Command:** `/realregions createw <name> <worldtype>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Creates a new world with the specified name and world type.

### 6. Region Command
- **Command:** `/realregions region <name>` or `/rr reg <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Displays detailed information about the specified region and opens a GUI for management.

### 7. World Command
- **Command:** `/realregions world <name>` or `/rr w <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Displays detailed information about the specified world and opens a GUI for management.

### 8. Teleport World Command
- **Command:** `/realregions tp <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Teleports the player to the specified world.

### 9. Teleport Region Command
- **Command:** `/realregions tpr <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Teleports the player to the specified region.

### 10. View Command
- **Command:** `/realregions view <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Toggles the visibility of region boundaries for the specified region.

### 11. Unload Command
- **Command:** `/realregions unload <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Unloads the specified world.

### 12. Load Command
- **Command:** `/realregions load <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Loads the specified world.

### 13. Unregister Command
- **Command:** `/realregions unregister <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Unregisters the specified world from the plugin.

### 14. Import Command
- **Command:** `/realregions import <name> <worldtype>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Imports a world with the specified name and world type.

### 15. Delete Region Command
- **Command:** `/realregions delete <name>` or `/rr del <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Deletes the specified region.

### 16. Entities Command
- **Command:** `/realregions entities <name>` or `/rr ents <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Displays a GUI showing entities present in the specified world.

### 17. Delete World Command
- **Command:** `/realregions deleteworld <name>` or `/rr delw <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Deletes the specified world.

### 18. Players Command
- **Command:** `/realregions players <name>` or `/rr plrs <name>`  
- **Permission:** `realregions.admin`  
- **Function:** Displays a GUI showing players present in the specified world.

## Support  
If you have any issues with the plugin, contact me via DM on Here or join the Discord server.

## Like the Plugin?  
Don't forget to give it a **heart**!

title: DisableFrontView
description: The DisableFrontView mod enhances gameplay immersion by disabling the front-facing third-person camera view.
body:
The DisableFrontView mod enhances gameplay immersion by disabling the front-facing third-person camera view (front perspective). When toggling the third-person perspective using the F5 key, this mod ensures you can only switch between the first-person view and the rear-facing third-person view.

This mod is ideal for players who prefer a streamlined and consistent camera experience or find the front perspective distracting during gameplay.

Additionally, the mod includes a fully customizable configuration GUI that allows you to toggle the mod's functionality on or off without restarting the game.

**Features:**

- Disables front-facing third-person perspective (F5 key).
- Fully customizable configuration via in-game GUI.
- Simple and lightweight design compatible with Forge 1.8.9.
