It brings the popular "steal hearts on kill" mechanic without the bloat of databases or complex setups.
### ⚡ Features * **Performance First:** Zero database requirements. Uses native Minecraft files for maximum speed. * **❤️ LifeSteal Mechanics:** Kill players to gain hearts, lose hearts on death. * **🛠️ Custom Crafting:** Fully configurable crafting recipes for Heart Capsules (via `config.yml`). * **🚫 Native Ban System:** Automatically bans players when they run out of hearts using the vanilla ban system. * **⏱️ Ban Timer:** Configurable ban duration with live countdown timer on login attempt. * **🛡️ Anti-Abuse:** Farming prevention system to stop players from exploiting kills.
--- ### 📜 Commands | Command | Description | Permission | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/ls withdraw ` | Withdraw hearts into physical items. | `lifesteal.use` | | `/ls give ` | Give heart items to a player. | `lifesteal.admin` | | `/ls reset ` | Reset a player's health to default. | `lifesteal.admin` | | `/ls unban ` | Unban a player and restore their hearts. | `lifesteal.admin` | | `/ls purgebans` | Unban everyone (Server Wipe). | `lifesteal.admin` | | `/ls recipe` | Toggle the crafting recipe on/off instantly. | `lifesteal.admin` | | `/ls reload` | Reload the configuration file. | `lifesteal.admin` | ### 📸 Preview ![commands-preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8192352fa6d94b1b680810b9418f36a20e1ab62.png) --- ### 🔧 Config Everything is customizable! You can change: * Starting hearts & Max hearts. * Ban duration & Ban messages. * Crafting recipe shape & ingredients. * Heart item name & material. **Ready to start your SMP? Download LifeSteal Lite now!** ![Ban Screen Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c56e9f5227cd236b25b54f93969649898c78cec9_0.webp) ### 📜 Default Config
Click to view config.yml ```yaml # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- # LifeSteal Lite - Configuration File # A lightweight, performance-focused heart system designed to preserve the vanilla feel. # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- settings: # The number of hearts a new player starts with. (1 Heart = 2 HP) starting-hearts: 10 # The maximum number of hearts a player can achieve. # Players cannot use heart items if they reach this limit. max-hearts: 20 # The minimum number of hearts a player can drop to. # Players cannot withdraw hearts if it would put them below this limit. min-hearts: 1 # What action should be taken when a player loses all their hearts (or reaches the min limit)? # Options: # NONE - Nothing happens (Vanilla behavior). # BAN - The player is banned for the duration specified below. # SPECTATOR - The player is put into spectator mode. min-health-action: NONE # If 'BAN' is selected above, how many minutes should the ban last? ban-duration-minutes: 60 # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Crafting System (Dynamic) # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- recipe: # Enable or disable the crafting recipe for Heart Capsules. enabled: true # The crafting shape (3 lines). # Use characters to represent items defined in the 'ingredients' section below. # Space " " counts as an empty slot. shape: - "DGD" - "GTG" - "DGD" # Define what item each character represents. # Use valid Bukkit Material names (e.g., DIAMOND_BLOCK, TOTEM_OF_UNDYING, NETHERITE_INGOT). ingredients: T: TOTEM_OF_UNDYING D: DIAMOND_BLOCK G: GOLD_BLOCK # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Gameplay Mechanics # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- gameplay: # If true, players will lose a heart from environmental deaths (lava, fall damage, drowning). # If false, players only lose hearts when killed by another player (PvP). environment-heart-loss: false # If true, players drop their inventory when they die (Vanilla style). # If false, keep-inventory is enabled for deaths. drop-items-on-death: true # Security measure to prevent players from killing the same player repeatedly to farm hearts. prevent-farming: true # The cooldown time (in seconds) before a player can gain a heart from the same victim again. farm-cooldown-seconds: 300 # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Item Customization # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- item: # The display name of the heart item. Supports color codes (&). heart-item-name: "&c&lHeart Capsule" # The material of the heart item. (e.g., RED_DYE, NETHER_STAR, APPLE) heart-item-material: RED_DYE # Should the item have an enchantment glow effect? heart-item-glow: true # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Language & Messages # Supports legacy color codes (&a, &c, &l, etc.) # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- messages: # Gameplay Messages heart-gained: "&a[+1 Heart] &7You defeated an opponent!" heart-lost: "&c[-1 Heart] &7You lost a heart..." withdraw-success: "&aHeart withdrawn successfully!" withdraw-fail: "&cYou do not have enough health to withdraw!" max-hearts-reached: "&eYou have reached the maximum heart limit." # BAN Messages ban-reason: "&c&lGAME OVER\n\n&7Your final heartbeat has faded into the void.\nThe LifeSteal curse has consumed your soul.\n\n&cYou are no longer welcome among the living." ban-remaining: "&e&lRemaining Time: &f{time}" # Admin & Error Messages no-permission: "&cYou don't have permission to do this." player-not-found: "&cPlayer not found." reload-success: "&aConfiguration reloaded successfully!" reset-success: "&aPlayer's health has been reset to default." give-success: "&aYou gave {amount} heart(s) to {player}." give-received: "&aYou received {amount} heart(s) from an admin!" # Unban & Purge Messages unban-success: "&aPlayer {player} has been unbanned." unban-fail: "&cCould not unban {player}. Are they banned?" purge-success: "&aAll bans have been purged! Everyone can join." # Recipe Toggle Messages recipe-enabled: "&aHeart crafting recipe has been ENABLED!" recipe-disabled: "&cHeart crafting recipe has been DISABLED!" # Help Menu help-header: "&8&m--------&c LifeSteal Lite &8&m--------" help-withdraw: "&7/ls withdraw &8- &fWithdraw hearts." help-give: "&7/ls give &8- &fGive heart items (Admin)." help-reset: "&7/ls reset &8- &fReset player's health (Admin)." help-unban: "&7/ls unban &8- &fUnban a specific player (Admin)." help-purgebans: "&7/ls purgebans &8- &fUnban everyone (Admin)." help-recipe: "&7/ls recipe &8- &fToggle crafting recipe (Admin)." help-reload: "&7/ls reload &8- &fReload config (Admin)."

title: Better Compass Azimut
description: 🧭 Better Compass  Better Compass is a lightweight and fully configurable Minecraft mod that adds a modern compass HUD at the top of the screen. It displays the cardinal directions (N • E • S • W) along with the exact facing angle in degrees
body:
🧭 Better Compass

Better Compass is a lightweight and fully configurable Minecraft mod that adds a modern compass HUD with directional indicators, coordinates display, biome info, and dimension tracking. It features a complete theming system with multiple pre-designed themes and full server-client configuration management.

⚠️ By default, a compass must be present in the player's inventory for the HUD to work (configurable via server or client settings).

✨ Features

📍 **Directional Indicators** - Shows 8 cardinal directions (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW)  
🎯 **Facing Angle** - Displays exact facing direction in degrees with smooth animation  
📐 **Coordinates Display** - Real-time X, Y, Z coordinates with customizable position and scale  
🌍 **Dimension Info** - Shows current dimension (Overworld/Nether/End)  
🗺️ **Biome Display** - Displays current biome name  
🎨 **Theme System** - 4 pre-built themes (default, compact, colorful, immersive) with full customization  
⚙️ **Custom Themes** - Create unlimited custom themes with 50+ configurable parameters  
🔧 **Hot-Reload** - Reload themes without restarting with `/bettercompass theme reload`  
🌐 **Full Customization** - Configure colors, positions, sizes, and animations via TOML files  
📡 **Server Override** - Servers can force themes and settings on all connected clients  
🧭 **Compass Requirement** - Toggle compass requirement at server or client level  
🚀 **Lightweight** - Optimized for minimal performance impact  
💻 **Multi-Platform** - Available for both Forge and Fabric

⚙️ Configuration

The mod uses TOML configuration files for complete customization:

**Client Configuration** (`config/bettercompass/compass.toml`):

```
requireCompass = false
currentTheme = "default"
```

*   `requireCompass`: If true, HUD only appears with a compass in inventory
*   `currentTheme`: Selected theme (default, compact, colorful, immersive, or custom)

**Server Configuration** (`server_config.toml`):

```
serverForceTheme = false
serverTheme = "default"
requireCompass = "client"
```

*   `serverForceTheme`: If true, forces all clients to use the specified theme
*   `serverTheme`: Theme to enforce on all players (ignored if serverForceTheme = false)
*   `requireCompass`: "client" (player chooses), "true" (required), "false" (optional)

🎨 Theme System

Themes are stored in `config/bettercompass/themes/` as TOML files. Each theme contains:

*   **Colors**: Primary, secondary, background, text, border (ARGB format)
*   **Dimensions**: Compass size, text scale, padding, border width
*   **Positions**: X, Y coordinates for each HUD element
*   **Coordinates Display**: Position, scale, and visibility
*   **Dimension Display**: Position, scale, and visibility
*   **Biome Display**: Position, scale, and visibility
*   **Animation**: Smooth rotation speed and other effects
*   **Metadata**: Theme name, author, and description

**Supported Color Formats:**

*   ARGB: `0xAARRGGBB` (e.g., `0xFF00FF00` for opaque green)
*   Hex: `#RRGGBB` (e.g., `#00FF00`)
*   RGB: `rgb(255, 0, 0)`
*   RGBA: `rgba(255, 0, 0, 128)`

**Example Theme** (`config/bettercompass/themes/custom.toml`):

```
# Better Compass Theme: default
# Classic Better Compass theme

[metadata]
name = "default"
description = "Classic Better Compass theme"
author = "Better Compass"
version = "1.0"

[position]
hudPosition = "top-center"
hudOffsetX = 0
hudOffsetY = 0

[compass]
width = 400
height = 20
spacing = 90
scale = 1.0

[colors]
background = 0x80000000
border = 0xFFFFFFFF
text = 0xFFFFFFFF
direction = 0xFFAAAAAA
north = 0xFFFF0000
east = 0xFFFFFFFF
south = 0xFFFFFFFF
west = 0xFFFFFFFF
playerDirection = 0xFFFFFFFF
coordinates = 0xFFFFFFFF
dimension = 0xFFFFFFFF
biome = 0xFFFFFFFF

[playerDirection]
position = "center"
offsetX = 0
offsetY = 0

[coordinates]
show = true
position = "bottom-center"
offsetX = 0
offsetY = -15
format = "X: %d Y: %d Z: %d"

[dimension]
show = false
position = "below-coordinates"
offsetX = 0
offsetY = 12

[biome]
show = false
position = "below-dimension"
offsetX = 0
offsetY = 12

[appearance]
showBorder = false
borderWidth = 1
borderRadius = 3
showBackground = false
backgroundPadding = 4
textScale = 1.0
textShadow = false

[animation]
smoothRotation = false
rotationSpeed = 0.3
```

Simply create a new TOML file in `config/bettercompass/themes/` with your own theme configuration. The theme will be automatically loaded and available through commands.

All commands support Tab-completion for theme names.

*   `/bettercompass theme list` - Display all available themes with the current one marked
*   `/bettercompass theme set <name>` - Switch to a specific theme (saved to config)
*   `/bettercompass theme current` - Show the currently active theme and its properties
*   `/bettercompass theme reload` - Hot-reload all themes from disk (useful for developers)

🌐 Server Compatibility

Better Compass features complete server-client integration:

*   **Client-only mode**: Works seamlessly in single-player
*   **Server mode**: Administrators can enforce themes and settings across all players
*   **Real-time sync**: Configuration changes sync immediately when players join
*   **Override system**: Server theme forcing takes priority over client preferences
*   **Flexibility**: Individual settings can be left to client choice or forced server-wide

🎯 Default Themes

1.  **default** - Balanced, clean design suitable for most playstyles
2.  **compact** - Optimized for smaller screens and minimal HUD footprint
3.  **colorful** - Vibrant colors for better visibility and visual appeal
4.  **immersive** - Subtle and elegant design for atmosphere preservation

💡 Creating Custom Themes

Simply create a new TOML file in `config/bettercompass/themes/` with any name. Themes are automatically loaded and available through commands. The theme system provides 50+ customizable parameters to match any player preference or server aesthetic.

🎯 Mod Goal

Better Compass enhances navigation with a modern, highly customizable interface while maintaining vanilla-friendly balance. Whether you prefer a subtle compass or a feature-rich HUD, the extensive theme system accommodates every playstyle in both single-player and multiplayer environments.

title: Emergence
description: Gives Villagers entirely new jobs to supplement their economy, as a bonus gives you new workstations!
body:
# Emergence
Emergence is a Vanilla+ Mod that attempts to make the villager economy more sustainable, as well as make trading an often better way to make things. This comes with the added bonus of new workstations to play around with!

Many villagers have the ability to create something you can't using the workstations, making them actually remarkably useful!

## Professions
There are currently two professions in the mod;

### Lumberjack
The Lumberjack is a villager that will trade in any goods related to trees & wood, their expertise can be handy to have around when you want to get more planks for your logs.

### Florist
The Florist is a villager that trades in grasses, mosses, bees, & plants, and their expertise will teach you how to get higher yields out of your dyes!

## Workstations
There are currently two workstations in the mod;

### Chopping Block
#### (Player Functionality WIP)
The Chopping Block is a workstation that allows you to do most of the wood recipes more efficiently.

### Botany Table
#### (Player Functionality WIP)
The Botany Table is a workstation that allows you to get a higher yield from dyes & get multiple colours from one flower.

body:
# Coordinates HUD

A highly customizable coordinates display mod that provides a clean, feature-rich alternative to the F3 debug screen. Configure every aspect through an intuitive GUI!

## ✨ Key Features

### 🎨 Visual Customization
- **Rainbow Mode** - Animated cycling rainbow colors with adjustable speed
- **Gradient Mode** - Smooth color transitions across display lines
- **Dynamic Colors** - Colors that change based on Y-level, biome, or dimension
- **Text Styling** - Bold, italic, shadow, and outline effects with custom colors
- **Background & Borders** - Fully customizable with opacity, padding, and corner radius
- **Layout Control** - Horizontal or vertical layouts with adjustable spacing and alignment

### 📍 Positioning
- **Drag-and-Drop Editor** - Visual positioning with grid snap and preset guides
- **9 Position Presets** - Top/Middle/Bottom × Left/Center/Right
- **Anchor Points** - 7 anchor modes for responsive HUD placement across screen sizes
- **HUD Scaling** - Scale from 0.5x to 3.0x to fit your preferences

### 📊 Display Options
- **Coordinate Formats** - Labeled, comma-separated, slash-separated, or fully custom
- **Additional Info** - Dimension name, biome, direction (4/8-way, degrees, arrows), light levels, movement speed
- **Nether/Overworld Conversion** - Automatic coordinate conversion
- **Selective Display** - Show/hide X, Y, Z independently with 0-3 decimal places

### ⚙️ Behavior & Performance
- **Visibility Rules** - Auto-hide with F3, in GUI, spectator mode, or specific dimensions
- **Hold-to-Show Mode** - Temporarily display HUD while holding keybind
- **Smooth Transitions** - Fade animations when toggling visibility
- **Smart Caching** - Optimized biome lookups with configurable cache duration
- **Update Frequency** - Adjust from 1-20 ticks for performance vs responsiveness
- **Debug Mode** - Display FPS, update rate, and performance metrics

### 🎛️ Configuration
Access everything through **Mod Menu** with 5 organized tabs:
1. **Display Settings** - What to show and format options
2. **Position & Layout** - HUD placement and visual layout
3. **Colors & Style** - Color customization and special effects
4. **Visibility & Behavior** - When and how the HUD appears
5. **Advanced** - Performance tuning and debug options

Every setting includes helpful tooltips! All keybinds start unbound - configure them in Controls.

## 📦 Requirements

- **Fabric Loader** 0.16.0+
- **Fabric API** (any version)
- **Mod Menu** 11.0.0+
- Cloth Config (bundled - no separate download needed)

## 🆘 Support

Need help? Have suggestions? **[Join our Discord!](https://discord.gg/M5snvUMkQC)** 

**Enjoy your new customizable coordinates HUD!** 🎉

title: Golden Days+
description: Relive the nostalgia of old Minecraft with Golden Days+, a faithful throwback modpack.
body:
**Golden Days+ – Relive the Classics**

Golden Days+ is a carefully crafted nostalgia-driven modpack designed for players who long for the classic charm of Minecraft’s earliest days but still want the smooth, stable experience of the modern game. Instead of bombarding you with heavy shaders or ultra-modern changes, this pack focuses on capturing the feeling of Minecraft Alpha and Beta — when every tree chopped, every cave explored, and every mob encountered felt new and exciting.

This modpack is built around the idea that less is more. You won’t find overwhelming menus, complicated tech trees, or futuristic content that takes away from the original Minecraft soul. Instead, Golden Days+ enhances the core gameplay loop of survival, building, and exploration by carefully adding lightweight mods and resource tweaks that bring you back to the roots of the game. The textures, sounds, and atmosphere feel old-school, while the quality-of-life improvements make it comfortable to play on modern versions.

One of the biggest appeals of this pack is its faithful simplicity. Unlike many nostalgia-themed projects that drown in unnecessary extras, Golden Days+ gives you a streamlined experience. The pack replaces the modern, polished textures with carefully chosen retro-style visuals that echo Minecraft’s early charm without being clunky or broken. The mobs, items, and blocks look closer to their original designs, creating an immediate wave of familiarity the moment you load up a new world.

Golden Days+ is also multiplayer-friendly. You can start a small survival world with friends and enjoy the throwback atmosphere together without worrying about lag or overcomplication. Thanks to lightweight optimizations (not shaders), the pack runs well even on low-end systems, making it accessible to everyone — just like the original game was back in the day.

Whether you’re a veteran player who started during Alpha or Beta, or a newcomer curious about what Minecraft used to feel like, this modpack bridges the gap between the golden past and the stable present. You’ll notice how the skies look simpler, the grass feels warmer, the caves have an old echo of danger, and the villages carry a rustic charm. All of this combines into an experience where every block feels more meaningful and every structure tells a story of when Minecraft was young.

Golden Days+ is not about overwhelming you with endless content, but about taking you back to the essence of Minecraft — a world of survival, creativity, and endless adventure, wrapped in nostalgia yet stable for modern play.

**⚒️ Perfect for players who want:**

A retro-inspired survival experience

Nostalgic textures and sounds (without shaders)

Multiplayer-friendly and lightweight performance

A return to the simplicity of old-school Minecraft

body:
🏠 Home Coordinate Save
Wandered too far and lost your home? Not anymore.

This simple yet life-saving Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 lets you save your home coordinates with a single keypress — and recall them anytime you need. No need for waypoints, no messy notes, just quick access when you need it most.

🎮 How it works:

title: ItemQuickStack
description: QuickStack — transfers items to nearby chests.
body:
# 📦 QuickStack Plugin

**QuickStack** is a lightweight and functional Minecraft plugin that lets players automatically deposit matching items from their inventory into nearby chests with a single command.

---

## ✨ Features

- Automatically transfers stackable items to nearby chests
- Configurable search radius (`config.yml`)
- Works with both single and double chests
- Customizable messages and permissions
- Supports tab completion for commands

---

## 🔧 Commands

### `/quickstack stack`
Transfers matching items from the player’s inventory into nearby chests.

- **Permission**: `quickstack.stack`

### `/quickstack reload`
Reloads the configuration file without restarting the server.

- **Permission**: `quickstack.admin` or `*`

---

## 🧪 Permissions

| Permission           | Description                          |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------|
| `quickstack.stack`   | Allows use of `/quickstack stack`    |
| `quickstack.admin`   | Allows use of `/quickstack reload`   |
| `*`                  | Grants all permissions               |

---

## 🔄 Tab Completion

Supports tab completion for:
- `stack`
- `reload` (admin only)

---


## ✅ Requirements

- Minecraft server with Bukkit, Spigot, or Paper support
- Java 17+

---

# 🏭 Industrium

**Fabric | Minecraft 1.21.0 – 1.21.1**

**Industrium** is the next-gen industrial mod for Minecraft — a bold evolution inspired by the **Create mod**, but reimagined for **Fabric**. Whether you’re into mining, building, automating, or experimenting with a bit of chaos, **Industrium** gives you the tools to reshape your world.

---

## ⚙️ Key Features

### 🛠️ Tool Revolution

* **Hammer**: Break entire **3x3 areas** at once — mine faster, smarter.
* **Chisel**: Transform blocks into **new forms and decorative styles** instantly.
* **Tiered Toolsets** from brand-new ores with custom stats and progression.

### ⛏️ Ores & Materials

* Unique **new ores** to find, mine, and process.
* Used for tools, machines, blocks, and automation systems.

### 🧱 Modular Blocks

* Craft and build with:

  * **Fences**, **Doors**, **Walls**, **Buttons**
  * **Industrial-style blocks** and **decorative variants**
* Designed to support automation and redstone integration.

### 💧 Fluids & Piping

* Full **fluid system support**
* **Pipes** for transporting fluids between containers, machines, and magic devices.
* Future-ready for automation and mod integration.

### 🎲 Magic Block – The Gamble Cube

* Introduces **randomized rewards** and risk-taking to mining.
* Drop an item in... and maybe get rare ores — or nothing at all.
* Balances **luck, strategy, and surprise**.

---

## 🌐 Why Choose *Industrium*?

> "If Create gave you motion, Industrium gives you momentum."

* Built natively for **Fabric**
* Compatible with **Minecraft 1.21.0 – 1.21.1**
* Lightweight, modular, and **designed to work alongside other tech & magic mods**

Whether you're digging deep, building big, or automating everything, **Industrium** is your new go-to for industrial-scale Minecraft.

---

## 📥 Installation

1. Requires **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API**
2. Drop `Industrium` into your `/mods` folder
3. Launch and enjoy!

---

## 🧪 Work in Progress

This is an early release with **many more features planned**, including:

* Machines
* Energy systems
* Advanced automation
* Mod compatibility extensions

---

**Industrium**
*Build smarter. Mine deeper. Automate everything.*

title: Erosion
description: Configurable mod that causes blocks to change into other blocks when under water and other conditions
body:
Certain blocks will erode when there is water above them.

When under flowing water, stone will become gravel, dirt will become sand, and undyed hardened clay will become red sand.

When under still water, sand will become clay.

Also, Cobblestone and Stone Bricks will grow moss when adjacent to water.

As of 2.2, rain will turn hardened clay soft, and the sun will bake soft clay into hardened clay.

The original purpose of this mod was to add a renewable source of sand and gravel. It has since been expanded with powerful configuration options.

Note: because of the way this mod is programmed, no erosion will occur until the erosion is triggered. Erosion will never trigger if there are no players nearby. Once erosion is triggered, it will spread to adjacent blocks.

New in 2.2: Configuration expanded with weather, light, and multiple-block requirements.

Configuration
---

This mod can be configured to erode any block into any other block.

To add a new erosion type to this mod, it must be added to the register list in the main section. It can be named what ever you want, but the name must match the section we're about to create.

To create a new section, it's best to copy and paste one of the existing sections and edit it. Change the name to match the name you added to the register list. Each section has six fields.

- condition is what condition will trigger the block to erode. These must be defined in the erosion_conditions.cfg file.
- fromBlock is the block we are eroding from. This must be a valid resource location.
- fromMeta A comma-separated list of acceptable metadata values. If you prepend it with an exclamation point, it will blacklist these values instead. Set to "any" or "-1" to mean any metadata value.
- intoBlock is the block we are eroding into. Again this must be a valid resource location.
- intoMeta is the metadata of the block we are eroding into. Must be between 0 and 15.
- time is how many game ticks it takes to erode the block.


Defining custom erosion conditions works exactly the same way, but with these 3 fields instead:

- conditionBlock the block that will cause erosion. This is usually a liquid, but it can be any block.
- conditionMeta A comma-separated list of acceptable metadata values. Uses the same syntax as the fromMeta field above.
- checkPositions A list of relative positions that will be checked for the condition block. If the condition block is found in any of these positions, then erosion will occur.


Version 2.2 adds some new configuration options.

First of all, erosion conditions can now depend on the weather and light.

requireLight takes an operator(< or >) and a number. For example, >12 means require a light level greater than 12. It can also be set to just a number to require exactly that light level.

requireWeather can be set to any, clear, rain, snow, or thunder. Any weather other than "any" will require sky access. If set to thunder, then a lightning bolt will be summoned when the erosion occurs.

Finally, you can now require that a certain number of positions match the conditions using the checksRequired option (previously only one of the locations needed to match).

In the position list, a fourth argument can now be used to require a different type of block. A fifth argument can be used to specify the meta of the required block.

title: Marriageyou
description: A marriage plugin that adds player-to-player marriages with proposals, divorces.
body:
# Marriageyou

**Marriageyou** is a marriage plugin for Paper/Spigot/Purpur servers that adds player-to-player relationships.  
Players can send marriage proposals, accept or deny them, divorce.

---

## 💍 Features

- 🤝 **Marriage proposals**
  - Send a proposal to another player.
  - The target player can accept or deny the request.

- 💔 **Divorce system**
  - Clean separation with configurable messages.

- 🧾 **Easy-to-read information**
  - Commands or GUI menu to see info about your current partner.
  - All messages configurable via config files.

- 🌐 **Multi-language support**
  - Available languages: Ukrainian, English and French.

---

## ⌨️ Example commands

- `/marry <player>` – send a marriage proposal.
- `/marry accept <player>` – accept a proposal.
- `/marry deny <player>` – deny a proposal.
- `/marry divorce` – request divorce confirmation.
- `/marry divorce confirm` – confirm divorce.
- `/marry info` – show all available commands.
- `/marry gui` – open the marriage menu.
- `/marry kiss` – send a kiss to your partner.
- `/marry hug` – hug your partner.
- `/marry gift` – give the item in your hand to your partner.
- `/marry anniversary` – show your marriage date and time together.
- `/marry gender <male|female|none>` – set your gender.
- `/marry gender info` – show your current gender.
- `/marry reload` – reload the plugin configuration.

## 🔖 Placeholders

- `%marriageyou_married%`
- `%marriageyou_partner%`
- `%marriageyou_gender%`
- `%marriageyou_married_since%`
- `%marriageyou_married_time%`
- `%marriageyou_status%`
- `%marriageyou_partner_online%`

---

## 📦 Compatibility

- **Core:** Paper, Spigot, Purpur (1.21.x)
- **External dependencies:** none required (plugin runs independently).

title: Brittle Bedrock
description: Weaken bedrock with dense TNT explosions. Adds Dense TNT which weakens bedrock when placed against it.
body:
# Brittle Bedrock
Weaken bedrock with dense TNT explosions.

## Content
- Craft _Dense TNT_ with 9 normal TNT.  
  ![Crafting Recipe: 9 TNT in Crafting Table = 1 Dense TNT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukasstorck/brittle-bedrock/refs/heads/main/docs/media/crafting.png)
- Place _Dense TNT_ on bedrock to weaken it.

## Technical Concept
- The advancement is triggered when a TNT item is placed on a bedrock block, but only if the TNT item has the custom data component added by the crafting recipe.
- Then, the advancement triggers a raycast from the player's head to determine the position of the newly placed TNT block.
- The TNT is replaced with primed TNT with a 0-tick fuse (instant explosion), and all neighboring bedrock blocks are replaced with obsidian.
- The raycast extends up to 5 blocks (normal placement range) in 0.1 block increments, for a maximum of 50 steps.
- There can be instances where the raycast does not find the TNT block. For example, this can happen when the cursor is at the very edge of the Bedrock block, and the 0.1-block steps are not fine-grained enough.
- When custom TNT is placed (not against bedrock), broken, and picked up again, it reverts to normal TNT, losing the custom data component.

title: Sophie's Alloys
description: A mod designed to revamp how tool progression works in Minecraft, while also giving options to mix and match what materials you wish to use.
body:
Sophie's Alloys is designed to revamp how tool progression operates within vanilla Minecraft.  Bountiful amounts of new materials can be found within the Overworld, Nether, and even the End to craft your tools and armors, incentivising mixing and matching those materials to create better sets of equipment to aid on your adventures.  Perhaps one may wish to use Mithril Boots over Diamond Boots, but a Diamond Helmet over a Mithril one?

This mod also heavily relies on Create and improves upon the automation and resource generation systems that Create provides.  This mod is designed for modpacks in mind and has massive out of box support for mods via excessive data driven interactions and tagging.  If this mod is to be used in modpacks, please look at the license contained within the mod's `.jar`.

I heavily recommend using a recipe viewer mod such as REI or JEI until I properly set up recipe advancements and the GitHub wiki.  This will help a lot with figuring out how to upgrade your tools.

### This mod is currently in 1.21.1 (Neoforge) beta development.

title: ResourceTracker
description: Client-side Fabric HUD for tracking item collection goals across Minecraft 1.21.x and 26.1.
body:
# Resource Tracker

  Resource Tracker is a client-side Fabric mod for tracking item collection goals on your HUD.

  Use it for survival builds, farms, storage projects, map art, technical projects, or any task where you need exact item
  targets. Create lists in-game, add items, set target counts, and watch your progress update while you play.

  ## Features

  - Track multiple item lists for different projects.
  - Show progress directly on the HUD.
  - Count items in your inventory, containers, shulker boxes, and bundles.
  - Choose between progress mode and remaining-items mode.
  - Move each HUD list with drag and drop.
  - Customize scale, columns, text color, title color, background color, and icons.
  - Search items by translated name or item id.
  - Use separate lists per world or server.
  - Edit list files manually as `.txt` files in the config folder.
  - Reload edited lists from disk without restarting the game.
  - English and Russian localization included.

  ## Controls

  - `M` by default: open the Resource Tracker menu.
  - Use the `+` button to create a list.
  - Click a list to edit items, targets, colors, scale, and layout.
  - Use **Move HUD Elements** to drag lists into place.
  - Hold `Shift` and click delete to remove a list.

  ## Display modes

  Resource Tracker supports two HUD modes:

  - **Progress**: shows your current amount, for example `35/128`.
  - **Remaining**: shows how many items you still need, for example `Need: 93`.

  ## Compatibility

  - Loader: Fabric
  - Environment: client-side
  - Minecraft support:
    - 1.21.0-1.21.4
    - 1.21.5
    - 1.21.6-1.21.8
    - 1.21.9-1.21.11
    - 26.1

  You do not need to install this mod on a server.

  ## Installation

  1. Install Fabric Loader.
  2. Install Fabric API.
  3. Download the Resource Tracker file for your Minecraft version.
  4. Put the `.jar` file into your `mods` folder.
  5. Launch the game and press `M`.

title: Farmer's Attributes
description: A mod that adds some player attributes related to farming and cooking.
body:
# Farmer's Attributes
[![Minecraft Versions](https://img.shields.io/badge/MC-1.21.1-green?style=flat&logo=minecraft&logoColor=white)](#)
[![Server Side](https://img.shields.io/badge/Side-Server%26Client-orange?style=flat)](#)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/medi-torimorta/farmers-attributes?style=flat&color=purple)](https://github.com/medi-torimorta/farmers-attributes/?tab=MIT-1-ov-file#)

This mod aims to enhance farming experience in minecraft by adding multiple player attributes related to farming and cooking.

![Huge vegetables built with large crop blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98bf4fd674b37568c8b672e668ad043b329b0896_0.webp)

## Usage
Farmland protection and right-click harvesting/replanting can be turned on for all players in the config.  
The other features are best used in conbination with other mods that make use of the attributes, as this mod doesn't add a way to increase the player attributes by itself.  
You can also use commands to set your attributes.  
ex.  
`/attribute @s farmers_attributes:crouch_bonemeal_chance base set 0.5`

## Contents
### Attributes

**anti_farmland_trampling**  
If True (non-zero), prevents farmlands from being trampled by the player.  

**easy_harvest**  
If True (non-zero), allows for harvesting crops by right clicking, sending the drops directly to the player's inventory. Uses seeds from the drop content or the player's inventory for replanting.  
Also works on kelps and sugarcanes (and similar modded plants) leaving the bottom block. This harvests connected blocks as well, only searching upwards.  

**crouch_bonemeal_chance**  
Chance (0.0-1.0) for the bonemeal effect to be applied to nearby crops and saplings when the player spams or holds crouch.  

**green_thumb**  
Chance (0.0-1.0) for crops planted by the player to become their Large variants upon reaching max growth state, or give double drops upon harvesting if a large variant is unavailable.  
Large variants can only appear when grown naturally (no bonemeal)  

**zesty_culinary**  
If 1+, gain the Appetite MobEffect for 30 seconds upon crafting food.  
Cooking with the campfire will grant this effect for all players in a radius.  
The attribute also gives AoE when the player places a placeable food block (e.g.cake).  
The level of the effect will be equal to the attribute value's Integer, and the fraction(Decimal) will be used to determine the effect duration.  
The formula is as follows:  
Attribute value = `(effect level)` + `(durationSeconds/300-0.1)`  
ex. Attribute of `1.0` will give Appetite I for 30 seconds, `3.23` III for 99 seconds, `2.9` II for 5min.  
Basically, it gives base 30secs + additional 30 seconds per 0.1 attribute value.  

**short_order_cooking**  
Multiply cooking speed for Smokers and Campfires in a small radius around the player.  
e.g. 0 to completely stop progress, 2 to double cooking speed.  
Cooking with multiple players will multiply all of their values.  

**farmers_weapon**  
When using farmer's weapons (e.g. Sharp Carrot), the player gains extra damage equal to the attribute value.  

**farmers_armor**  
For each farmer's armors (e.g. Carved Pumpkin) piece, the player gains extra armor equal to the attribute value.  

### MobEffects  
**Appetite**  
at level 1 : Allows the player to eat even when they're full  
at level 2+: when the player gains any other positive food effects, adds x0.5(configurable) of the original duration per (level-1)   

### Items & Blocks
- Large BeetRoot
- Large Carrot
- Sharp Carrot

## Configuration
The following can be configured in the farmers_attributes-server.toml, unless otherwise specified.

**anti_farmland_trampling**  
Can be enabled for all players, ignoring their attribute values.  

**easy_harvest**  
Can be enabled for all players, ignoring their attribute values.  
Crops can be blacklisted.  
Whole-plant harvesting for kelp/sugarcane type plants can be disabled.  

**crouch_bonemeal_chance**  
The range and cooldown (in ticks, when holding crouch key) is configurable.  
The affected blocks are defined by the tag `#farmers_attributes:crouch_bonemeal_whitelist`.

**green_thumb**  
Affected crops and possible large variants can be blacklisted.  
Drop multiplier for non-large crops is configurable.  

**zesty_culinary**  
The duration of the Appetite given per level is configurable.  
The items that are not treated as "cooking" results (does not give effect) are defined by the tag: `#farmers_attributes:source_foods`  
The blocks that gives the effect when placed are defined by the tag: `#farmers_attributes:delicious_smelling_blocks`  

**short_order_cooking**  
The range to apply the speed modifier is configurable.  

**farmers_weapon**  
Farmer's weapons are defined by the tag: `#farmers_attributes:farmers_weapon`  

**farmers_armor**  
Farmer's armors are defined by the tag: `#farmers_attributes:farmers_armor`  

**Appetite Effect**  
The multiplier for extended food effect duration is configurable.  

## Integration
### Farmer's Delight
**zesty_culinary**  
Works with skillets and cooking pots.  
The skillet will apply the Appetite effect in an a radius like the campfire.  
The food blocks from Farmer's Delight (e.g. stuffed pumpkin) are included in the delicious_smelling_blocks tag by default.  

**short_order_cooking**  
Works on cooking pots and skillets.  
Values lower than 0.001 doesn't work on hand-held skillet cooking and will be handled as 0.001.  

**farmers_weapon**  
Skillets and knives are included in the farmers_weapon tag by default.  

### Pufferfish's Skills
**easy_harvest**  
Harvested crops count as "broken" blocks in experience source contexts.  

## Installation
Needed on both server and client.  

## Credits
Large crop textures by [@Siina__Makoto](https://x.com/Siina__Makoto)

title: Hardcore plus
description: Hardcore Plus is a Minecraft hardcore modpack designed to enhance the Hardcore experience without significantly altering vanilla features. It provides a more intense and challenging survival experience while staying true to classic Minecraft gameplay.
body:
The Hardcore plus is built to provide the most stable, consistent, and reliable foundation for Hardcore play — without artificially increasing difficulty or altering core survival mechanics. Instead of making the game harder, the goal is to make every Hardcore world as smooth, fair, and technically robust as possible.

This pack focuses on performance, world consistency, bug reduction, and gameplay clarity. By combining well-researched technical, optimization, and stability-oriented mods, it ensures that every Hardcore run is defined by your decisions — not by lag spikes, world hiccups, or unpredictable technical issues.

Hardcore plus is intentionally minimalistic. There are no gameplay overhauls, no difficulty boosters, and no intrusive features that alter the vanilla balance. You’re free to add whatever quality-of-life, visual, or personal mods you prefer — the pack exists purely as a clean, reliable backbone for long-term Hardcore survival.

Its lightweight structure makes updates fast and easy. Performance improvements, stability patches, and compatibility fixes can be applied rapidly, ensuring the pack stays relevant across new Minecraft versions with minimal delay.

Derivative Packs
You may use the configuration files from Hardcore plus in your own modpack as long as you clearly mention it in your description — a short note at the end is enough.

title: Swift Shafts
description: A very useful "elevator" mod that removes the need for boring stairs and ladders.
body:
# Aren't stairs and ladders just so boring? Say hello to **_Swift Shafts!_**

## What does this mod add?
This mod adds one extremely useful block - the _Transporter Shaft!_ **With this block, you can create elevator shafts in your builds that allow you to teleport from floor to floor without the use of ladders or stairs!**

## How do I make a Transporter Shaft?
**Here is the recipe - easy and great for pregame and endgame bases!**
![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4efd29c823bee0bb29791a577e9d43f238ae92fa.png)

## How do I use the Transporter Shafts?
To use the transporter shafts, just put one above the other (at least 3 blocks away on the Y-axis)
![Recommended layout](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/800dcae1ea4474c29ef018e52c1cffa2fd44ca35.png)
Once they are in place, stand on one of the Transporter Shafts, and you should see particles emit from it!

### **Light blue up arrow particles mean that you can travel up, and dark blue down arrow particles mean that you can travel down**
### 
### Then just look up and crouch to go up, or look down and crouch to go down!
###
###
### _If there is a block covering one of the Transporter Shafts, it will be skipped in the column!_

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/MaOp5uw8kV8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


## Commands
The default range for the Transporter Shaft is 20 blocks up and down, but you can change that with this command:
```
/ss shaftDetectionRange set [number]
```
You can also see the current setting by using:
```
/ss shaftDetectionRange get
```

# _Goodbye forever, stairs and ladders!_

title: Yet Another Elf Origin
description: An Elf Origin intended for players that are less familiar with the game.
body:
Oh, hey. You there. Looking for elf-y stuff, huh? But don't want anything overly complicated? You're not too practiced at the mining and crafting, but still want a fun time with friends? I've got you covered, kiddo. Don't worry.

# Yet Another Elf Origin
Don't be driven off by the name! This was a labor of love towards my fellow, newer miners and crafters. This origin is **intentionally unbalanced, in a way biased towards the Elf player.** It is designed for players who are not exactly confident in their skills, and to help them keep up with their friends of different skill levels.


## Powers
Let's get into why you're actually here- what makes this origin unique?
- [+] As an Elf, you are a pacifist. It's not that you can't *hurt* things, but killing creatures- especially innocent creatures- incurs a bit of karma. On the flip side, though, living in harmony with nature will grant you boons!
- [+] You have a slightly higher jump, which gets boosted even higher in Forest biomes.
- [+] You've got a permanent speed bonus.
- [+] You do not take fall damage.
- [+] Your fairy wings let you glide with ease! <Note: Does not render elytra; intended to let you use your skin (or the Ears mod) for wings!>
- [+] When sneaking in a Forest biome, you turn fully invisible!
- [+] You deal more damage with bows.
- [+] Hitting your target with an arrow will return the arrow to your inventory. If you miss, you still need to go pick it up.
- [+] You have 50% more health than normal players.
- [-] You are vegetarian.
- [-] As stated, your pacifism incurs penalties when one kills for no reason.
- [-] Iron weapons and tools deals far more damage to you, and you cannot bear to wear iron or chainmail.

## How does the Pacifism mechanic work?
It's quite simple- over time, you gain karma. However, upon killing a mob or player, you lose karma- and depending on what alignment the creature has, you may lose more or less karma.
As long as you have about 3/4ths of your karma, you won't suffer any ill effects, and if you're in the top part of your karma bar, you'll gain regeneration.
Beyond the 3/4th point, however, you're slowed. Beyond halfway, you're slowed further, and you gain weakness. If you continue to kill after that, you gradually gain mining fatigue, nausea, blindness, and may even wither away.

Hostile mobs, such as zombies, skeletons, spiders and creepers incur very little penalty- you *are* defending yourself, after all.
Sentient hostiles, such as witches, pillagers, and piglin brutes incur a little more of a penalty, though not much more.
Neutral mobs, such as goats, wolves, polar bears, and zombie piglins incur a bit more of a penalty than that. 
Passive mobs, such as most animals, are a bit more than *that*, then sentient neutrals such as endermen, iron golems, and piglins, then sentient passive mobs and pets... you get the idea.
The only deviations from this formula are bosses, which drain a significant amount of your karma, and other players, which drain _all_ of your karma immediately.

This datapack, alongside the optional dependencies, supports [BetterAnimalsPlus](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/betteranimalsplus) right out of the box. Feel free to suggest new mods to support over on the Issue Tracker!

body:
![Grimwart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21f784029ed677e2ab9b42fc5f5ab390eed424c6.png)

# About

**Grimwart** is a datapack which aims at breathing new life into Minecraft's survival experience by adding a touch of magic. It brings tons of new features that ties into Minecraft core survival gameplay. And as everything in life, it's best experienced with friends !


# Trailer

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/dFX6ff5xd2E" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# Features

### Spells and Wands

You can store spells inside of wands. Casting spells is useful in a lot of different scenarios, even outside of combat. Casting spells costs **mana** that regenerates overtime.

### Trinkets

Items when equipped (by right-clicking) grants an unique passive ability. You can only equip one at a time but you can swap them depending on the situation. 

### Spectres

Little specs of light that spawn during night time. They give either XP, Spells or Trinket Boxes. The more of the moon is exposed the more spectres will spawn.

### Flying Brooms

A new method of transportation, very popular among witches and wizards.

### Item Delivery

Craft delivery boxes to send items to other players wherever they are in the world.

### Waypoints

Waypoints store experience to generate an item called a Teleporter. When the teleporter is used, it restores your exp and teleports you (and other players close by) back to the waypoint. Note : You can't use waypoints to travel between dimensions.

### Duel-O-Lanterns

Once two players place their bet inside a Duel-O-Lantern, a magic duel can start. Use spells, trinkets, invocations and any creative strategies that comes to your mind to get the advantage over your opponent. Winner takes all !

### New Advancements

The Collection and Tutorial advancement tabs will tell you everything you need to know in order to get the full Grimwart experience. So try completing them !

# Gamerules

Grimwart comes with **default recommended gamerules** automatically set when the datapack is installed. For example : `keepInventory` is set to `true` by default.
There are also custom gamerules you can use to customize your experience :

*Use the following commands to change the custom gamerules, replace* `<0/1>` *by either* `0` *for* `false` 
*or* `1` *for* `true`


```
/scoreboard players set #fastCombat world.gamerules <0/1>

> Buffs the attack speed and reduce damage of all players to emulate 1.8 combat (false by default)
```

```
/scoreboard players set #dropExpOnDeath world.gamerules <0/1>

> Players drop their experience points on death even if keepInventory is active (true by default)
```

```
/scoreboard players set #spawnSpectres world.gamerules <0/1>

> Spectres spawn during night time (true by default)
```


```
/scoreboard players set #tutorialWand world.gamerules <0/1>

> Players are given a Tutorial Wand when joining the world for the first time (true by default)
```

```
/scoreboard players set #dailyLoginReward world.gamerules <0/1>

> Give players a reward to claim each day they log in but "function world:server/day" has to be run from the server scheduler (true by default)
```

```
/scoreboard players set #infiniteMagic world.gamerules <0/1>

> Infinite mana. Wands and spellbooks don't get damaged when used (false by default)
```

```
/scoreboard players set #removeTrinketsCooldowns world.gamerules <0/1>

> Trinkets have no cooldowns (false by default)
```

```
/scoreboard players set #useTnTAsSpell world.gamerules <0/1>

> TNT doesn't affect other blocks and inflicts magic damage upon explosion (true by default)
```

```
/scoreboard players set #disableDuelOLanterns world.gamerules <0/1>

> Disables Duel-O-Lanterns (false by default)
```

# Installation

The **Datapack** and **Resourcepack** are both contained in the single download. 

1 > Extract the .zip file

2 > Follow the instructions inside of **ReadMe.txt**

title: Infinitifall
description: Falling, Forever.
body:
# Infinitifall

*Falling, Forever.*

## What does it do?

When any entity takes damage from falling in the void, they get teleported upwards, effectively making them fall forever... or at least until they die of void damage.

## How do I configure it?

| Key               | Type    | Default | Description                                                        |
|-------------------|---------|---------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `tpY`             | double  | -64.0   | Teleports the entity when their Y level is below this level.       |
| `addY`            | double  | 246.0   | How much to add to the entity's Y position.                        |
| `damage`          | double  | 4.0     | How much damage to deal upon teleporting the entity.               |
| `removeNonLiving` | boolean | true    | Whether to remove non-living entities that can't take void damage. |

## How do I use this?

Drop it into the `/plugins` folder of your [PaperMC](https://papermc.io) server.
This plugin relies on Paper or Folia specifically, it won't work on Bukkit or Spigot.

title: Cognata Remaster
description: Brought from the soil, shaped by the earth
body:
![Cognata Remaster Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bdb8b570c1dde4afa8f94b70070f129f55bea31.png)
### ...is a polished survival multiplayer modpack, with advanced progression, civilization and infrastructure building, and warfare!

In the world of Cognata, there are no villages. At least not yet. You won't stumble upon the usual villages that dot the landscapes that you might expect.

Instead, you have to make your own. Take clay, sculpt it, summon villagers from the earth, and create your kingdom.

Join friends in a common world and compete for land and resources. Claim territories, siege enemies, and build infrastructure to grow your empire!

Defeat legendary monsters for legendary rewards, craft unique and powerful weapons, arm your soldiers and grow your strength!

The world is yours. Take it.

![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1346284644205b08ef92744cf7bfeff386ab536f.png)

### This modpack is recommended to play in multiplayer, but is also fun in singleplayer. 

For information on multiplayer scroll down to the "Help" section of this page

This modpack has over 500 custom recipes, many **[fully custom mods](https://modrinth.com/collection/pufs0ulY)** made for it, over 100 new custom-made weapons as well as unique weapons called Artifacts, custom texture packs, armor models, classes, quests, and more!

Cognata is designed in such a way where **you can pretty much progress to any point anywhere just by using the materials around you**. This style of progression is great for multiplayer dynamics especially for anarchy and factions servers (Originally Cognata was played on a factions server).

![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1346284644205b08ef92744cf7bfeff386ab536f.png)

# **Help**

Multiplayer! The modpack includes e4mc so you can play multiplayer super easily. Just open a world to LAN and you will be given a public domain alongside the local port. You can invite other players just by giving them the domain to connect to.

If you want to host the modpack on a server, I don't have a server pack for you, but I do have a list of mods to remove from the server and you should be able to play:

<details>
<summary>List of mods to remove</summary>

- Afterimages
- AmbientSounds
- Better Clouds
- CameraOverhaul
- Cave Dust
- Controlling
- CreateBetterFps
- Default Options
- Dynamic FPS
- Dynamic Lights
- EMI++
- Embeddium
- EnchantmentDescriptions
- Entity Model Features
- Entity Texture Features
- FancyMenu
- FancyToasts
- Fog
- Immersive Overlays
- Item Descriptions
- ItemPhysicLite
- Legendary Tooltips
- Mouse Tweaks
- Oculus
- Presence Footsteps [FORGE]
- Searchables
- Serious Player Animations
- Shoulder Surfing Reloaded
- Tooltip Creator
- no f3

</details>



When playing Cognata, it's important to know that **all of the recipes in the modpack can be found in the recipe book**. Because of the difference from vanilla progression, certain parts of the modpack could be unintuitive for some.

If you want a tutorial on the progression of the modpack, just follow the quests included in versions 1.3.0 and later. The majority of them don't include rewards for completion (although a few later ones do), but they do provide a pretty detailed walthrough of the modpack.

![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1346284644205b08ef92744cf7bfeff386ab536f.png)

# **Content**

Progress through many stages of materials, from primitive wooden tools bound with pitch glue to the precisely crafted gem age all the way to the fantasy-like metals of skysteel and shadowsteel alloys. Mods such as **Create**, **Farmer's Delight**, **More Ores More Gems**, and even **Twigs** have been integrated into progression and carefully attuned to complement each other in a natural way.

Cognata also integrates mods such as Immersive Aircraft and Combat Roll into its progression while keeping both methods of transport balanced with each other and other vanilla methods of transport. 

(You can use certain potions and enchantments to upgrade your rolling abilities!)

As well as material progression, Cognata also introduces an alternate path with similar power having to do with creating your own civilization and cities! In Cognata, the player can almost literally raise a village from the soil. You can create villagers from clay and specialize them into recruits, farmers, bowmen, shieldmen, miners, and much more. Later updates have expanded on this concept more and more and polished it, improving on villager workstations by giving them **new models** and with pack update 1.3.0 adding new siege events to defend your village from.

On top of these changes in progression, both world generation and entity behavior have changed! You can now find many new biomes across the world. Mobs are now smarter and are more formidable enemies. You might also notice that certain mob types have unique relationships with other mobs, giving the world a more natural feel.

Healing has been made somewhat more difficult in favor of allowing the player to heal faster when nearby campfires or when sleeping.

![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1346284644205b08ef92744cf7bfeff386ab536f.png)

# **More**

Note on why all of the versions are called "remaster": The original Cognata modpack is not able to be posted here because it contains CF-exclusive mods. After Akaash's development on it stopped, I (voxelparrot) continued the project on my own as Cognata Remaster, which is what you can find here.

this modpack uses the aseprite font (which is the best pixel font)

**The collection containing all of my public projects that were made for this modpack can be found [here](https://modrinth.com/collection/pufs0ulY).

**The original Cognata was co-created by voxelparrot and AkaashMinecraft**

**Most images in the Gallery were taken in real Cognata-running servers.**

title: Happy Creeper
description: Turn creepers into survival companions by weakening, taming, healing, recoloring, and fighting alongside them.
body:
# **Happy Creeper**
Short summary:

Turn creepers into survival companions by weakening, taming, healing, recoloring, and fighting alongside them.

# **Overview**
Happy Creeper is a NeoForge mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that gives creepers a full companion gameplay loop.

Instead of only running from them, you can approach them safely with a creeper head, weaken them with a special biscuit, tame them, and keep them with you as a combat companion.

This mod is built around survival-friendly mechanics rather than creative-only gimmicks.

# **How It Works**
- Wear a Creeper Head to get close safely.
- Feed the creeper an Anti-Blast Biscuit to weaken it.
- Feed the weakened creeper a Sweet Gunpowder Biscuit to tame it.
- Right-click your tamed creeper with an empty hand to switch between follow and stay.
- Heal it with Gunpowder or another Sweet Gunpowder Biscuit.
- Tamed Creeper Features
- Follows its owner and can be told to stay
- Teleports back if it gets left behind
- Changes dimension with its owner
- Resyncs after the owner respawns
- Defends the owner from hostile mobs
- Attacks mobs the owner is fighting
- Uses a small contact blast attack instead of normal self-destruction
- Dies with a larger non-destructive final explosion
- Has increased health compared to a normal creeper
- Visual Features
- Weakened creepers show a continuous visual effect
- Tamed creepers use a custom happy green texture by default
- Tamed creepers can be recolored with dyes
- Rainbow Biscuit unlocks a smooth rainbow mode that cycles through colored creeper textures

# Items
- Biscuit
- Anti-Blast Biscuit
- Sweet Gunpowder Biscuit
- Rainbow Biscuit

# Current Release Notes
This release is intended as an alpha playtest build.

The full taming loop is implemented and playable, but balance and polish are still in progress.

# License summary
- You may use this mod freely.
- You may include the original unmodified jar in modpacks, launchers, mirrors, and server packs.
- You may not publish modified versions without my written permission.
- Approved derivatives must include credit and a link to the official project page.

# Requirements
NeoForge mod for the Minecraft versions listed on this page.
Requires Java 21.

title: BetterMS
description: Adds a configurable numerical ping display to the player list.
body:
**BetterMS** is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that improves the player list by replacing the default ping bar indicators with the actual ping value displayed in milliseconds. Instead of guessing your connection quality from a set of bars, you get a precise numerical readout that updates in real time.

The mod color-codes each ping value based on latency thresholds, making it easy to identify connection quality at a glance. Low latency values appear in green, moderate values in yellow, and high latency values in red, following a consistent and intuitive color scale.

BetterMS is designed to be completely unobtrusive. It has no configuration screen by default on most versions, requires no setup beyond installation, and adds no overhead to your game. It runs entirely on the client side, meaning it works on any server without requiring the mod to be installed server-side.

**Requirements**

- Fabric Loader
- No additional dependencies required for most versions

**Installation**

Download the release matching your Minecraft version and place the .jar file into your mods folder. Launch the game using the Fabric profile and the mod will load automatically. No additional configuration is needed.

**Author**

Developed and maintained by sjgamer92og. For issues or feedback, visit the project page on Modrinth.

title: LagShield Ultimate (Anti Lag)
description: The intelligent performance modulator for Minecraft Server. LagShield Ultimate uses Arclight-safe async processing to dynamically regulate mob AI, chunk density, and entity speed based on real-time server stress (MSPT). Stops lag before it happens.
body:
LagShield [NeoForge 1.21]
LagShield is a server-side performance mod for NeoForge 1.21. It is designed specifically for hybrid server environments (such as Arclight or Mohist) to ensure compatibility with Forge mods while maintaining server stability.

The mod monitors the server load (MSPT) in real-time and dynamically adjusts mob spawns, entity AI, and movement speeds to keep the TPS stable.

Features
Adaptive Performance
Instead of enforcing static limits, the mod reacts to the current server load.

Stable (<40ms MSPT): No restrictions applied.

High Load (50ms+ MSPT): Mob spawns are reduced, and AI is disabled for distant entities.

Critical (>60ms MSPT): Strict limits on spawns and entity speeds are enforced to prevent crashes.

Asynchronous Processing
To reduce strain on the main thread, calculations such as mob density checks and AI logic are offloaded to a background thread. The system uses data snapshots to ensure thread safety on hybrid servers and to prevent conflicts with other mods.

Speed Limiter
Prevents entities (players or mobs) from loading chunks faster than the server can process them. This is particularly useful for mods that allow very fast movement (e.g., Vampirism, flight items). During high server load, these speeds are automatically throttled.

Mob Limits & Protection
Chunk Limit: Dynamically limits the number of mobs per chunk based on server load.

Protected Entities: Bosses, Villagers, tamed animals, and name-tagged mobs are ignored by the mod and will not be despawned or frozen.

Commands
The main command is /lagshield.

/lagshield status Displays current server information:

TPS & MSPT (Milliseconds per Tick)

Current Stress Level (Percentage)

Status of asynchronous processes (Number of frozen mobs/tracked chunks)

Configuration
The mod generates a configuration file at config/lagshield-common.toml. You can adjust the following settings:

Enable/Disable asynchronous modules.

Adjust speed limits and sensitivity.

Set the maximum number of mobs per chunk.

Edit the list of protected mobs (VIP List).

Installation: This mod is required on the server side only. Clients do not need to install it.

✔ Support & Origins
This mod was specifically developed for the Werewolves vs Vampires modpack to ensure a 24/7 lag-free experience.

Check out my other projects: CurseForge - epicskydex

Support the Developer: Support me on Ko-fi

title: Cobblemon: Glimmering Sculk
description: Obtain Sculk from Glimmet and Glimmora
body:
# Sculk Drops for Cobbleverse

## Summary
Datapack designed for **Cobbleverse** (Peaceful Mode). Assigns the **Sculk** drop to **Glimmora**, a Pokémon whose mineral biology and alien floral appearance visually resemble Sculk Catalysts and Sensors.

## Changes
- **Pokémon**:
  - `Glimmet` (Pre-evolution): Drops **1-3** blocks.
  - `Glimmora` (Evolution): Drops **4-8** blocks.
  - *Visual Reason*: Glimmora looks like a crystalline mineral flower, which fits perfectly with the "organic/mineral growth" aesthetic of Sculk (Catalysts and Shriekers). Its dark and poisonous colors resonate with the Deep Dark theme.
- **Item**: `minecraft:sculk`.

## Balancing and Farm (Pasture Loot)
- **Rarity**: Glimmora/Glimmet are rare spawns in caves, maintaining the block's prestige.
- **Progression**: Evolution is rewarded by significantly increasing the farm's yield (more than double).
- **Production**:
  - In a Pasture Loot farm with **16 Glimmoras**, approximately 96 blocks (1.5 stacks) are generated per cycle.
  - This allows building with Sculk in peaceful mode without breaking the economy.

## Installation
1. Place in the `datapacks` folder (`.minecraft/saves/<World>/datapacks/`).
2. Restart the world (Do not use `/reload`).

title: reMilked
description: Unofficial continuation of A Social Mod based around Bonding with Others!
body:
# 🥛 reMilked

[![fabric](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/fabric_64h.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/remilked/versions?l=fabric)
[![neoforge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/neoforge_64h.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/remilked/versions?l=neoforge)
[![architectury-api](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/requires/architectury-api_64h.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api)

**reMilked** is an unofficial cross-platform continuation of the original **Milked** mod. Built with the **Architectury API**, it brings the unique "milking" mechanics to the modern versions of Minecraft.

---

## 🐄 About the Mod
Have you ever felt that players are... underutilized resources? **reMilked** allows players to be milked just like cows. Every player has a milk storage (10 levels max).

### Key Gameplay Mechanics:
* **Milking Players:** Use an empty bucket on another player to get a Milk Bucket.
* **The Risk:** Each milking action reduces the target's milk level. If a player's milk level reaches zero, they **die immediately**.
* **Self-Sustainability:** You can milk yourself! Just hold `Shift`, look down, and `Right-Click` with an empty bucket.
* **Regeneration:** Milk levels naturally restore over time (1 level every 30 seconds), so manage your "resources" wisely.

## ✨ Improvements in reMilked
This fork focuses on modernizing the experience and fixing long-standing issues:

* **Multi-platform Support:** Native support for both **Fabric** and **NeoForge**.
* **Refined Logic:** Immortal players (Creative mode or Invulnerability) can no longer be milked to death.
* **Creative Freedom:** Removed milking cooldowns for players in Creative mode.
* **Fixes:** Resolved a bug where armor could prevent death even after the player's milk supply was completely exhausted.
* **Localization:** Now includes full **Russian (ru_ru)** support.

## 👥 Credits
**reMilked** is a fork of the original [Milked](https://modrinth.com/mod/milked-koil) mod created by the **Koil** organization.
* **SpiritXIV** — Original Owner
* **bashful** — Sound Artist Lead
* **unluckytokyo** — Contributor

title: Custom Sheep Breeding
description: Allows customization of sheep colors, both after spawning and breeding. Also has optional gameplay features.
body:
This mod changes sheep to have a natural color that is set during birth (or when installing this mod). This color can not be changed.

Sheep can still be colored using dye items, but after shearing the color is reset to the natural color again.

Multiple things can be configured in the server config:
- Enable/disable natural colors (if only the other changes are desired).
- The initial colors of spawned sheep (and the chances of the colors).
- Initial color variants tied to a biome tag.
- The chances for a baby sheep to inherit one of their parents colors.
- The chances for a baby sheep to inherit a blend of their parents colors. This is by default one of the parents colors, but exceptions can be defined.
- The chances for a baby sheep to have a random color (and the chances of the colors).

The default settings allow for gameplay where acquiring sheep in all 16 variations turns into a quest of finding sheep in the wild, breeding the correct colors together and a little luck.

> The config provides all values that simulate vanilla behaviour. Note that not all colors can be permanently acquired using those values.

### Important!
As always, make back-ups of your worlds when using mods!

This mod was inspired by the Hardcore Sheep feature of the legendary Better Than Wolves mod.

body:
# <center>Plains Grass Everywhere!</center>

![Banner showing the effect of the resource pack on different blocks.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/BfFB6fdy/images/6f4d8fdf67839944bc4602af6f518b0c750222b6.png)

This pack changes the **Grass colormap** so that it always matches the color of the **Plains biome(s)**.
The Plains uses the color `#91BD59` in vanilla Minecraft.

<details><summary>List of biomes that use this color in vanilla Minecraft</summary>

* Plains
* Sunflower Plains
* Beach
* Dripstone Caves
* Deep Dark
</details>

<details><summary>Additional Information</summary>

* build_time: `2025-10-06T02:13:38+02:00`
* build_user: `rotgruengelb`
</details>

## Limitations
Some biomes use hardcoded colors that cannot be overridden by resource packs.  
This is a limitation of Minecraft itself, not of this pack.

Download the pack and place it in your `resourcepacks` folder.

A collection of resource packs that change Minecraft’s colormaps.

You can store your angles into the config/locations.json file by adding it in the game. ### !Warning! All your points from old version will not work with 2.21.4 version! To fix this, /add one extra point and then /remove it. New locations file will look like this: ``` { "locations": { "x": [ 1.0, 1.0 ] }, "turnup": true, } ``` Command list:
/add - adds the name of the angle to mod's config file
/remove - removes angle from config file
/locations - displays list of saved angles & it's names
/look - turns you to 's angle
/look - turns you to angle you typed
/toggleturnup - tells the mod whether to turn you up at the end or not

title: Origins-Mobs-Enhanced
description: An Origins Reborn Enhanced origin addon for PaperMC servers, based on the Mob Origins mod by UltrusBot
body:
# Origins-Mobs-Enhanced

## This plugin is deprecated and is now a module in [Origins Reforged](https://modrinth.com/plugin/origins-reforged)

Origins-Mobs-Enhanced is an [Origins Reborn Enhanced](https://modrinth.com/plugin/origins-reborn-enhanced) addon which adds the mob themed origins from the [Mob Origins](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mob-origins) mod by [UltrusBot](https://www.curseforge.com/members/ultrusbot/projects).

Add this to the server plugins folder with Origins-Reborn and restart the server to begin playing with the new origins!

For support join the [Endera](https://discord.gg/9kY4guxtxF) discord server.

## Included origins:

- **Bee**
  - Every 5 seconds, you can hit something to poison it
  - If you're around flowers, you get regeneration
  - Bees don't get angry at you for taking honey
  - You have 2 less hearts than humans
  - You cannot eat meat (it provides no saturation and poisons you)
- **Drowned**
  - Left clicking with nothing or when holding a trident activates an ability where you can use channeling without lightning, and riptide without the rain. This has a cooldown of 60 seconds and lasts for 20 seconds.
  - You can see clearer underwater
  - Guardians don't attack you
  - You deal more damage in water
  - You can breathe underwater
  - You burn in daylight and take more damage from Smite
  - You lose hunger faster
  - You're slower on land
  - You can only eat meat (other foods provide no saturation and poison you)
- **Evoker**
  - You can left click whilst holding nothing to summon evoker fangs
  - You have a 10% chance of your totem of undying not breaking upon use
  - Pillagers and Illagers like you, and villagers don't like you
- **Fox**
  - You move faster when 3 or more other players are around you
  - Berries provide more saturation and hunger
  - Sweet berry bushes don't damage you
  - You can pick up items from further away
  - You move faster than humans
  - You have 2 hearts less than humans
- **Slime**
  - You bounce on all blocks like slime
  - You can left click whilst holding nothing to split and summon a slime that fights for you, using some of your hunger points
  - You deal more knockback but less damage when on low health
  - You do not take fall damage
- **Snow Golem**
  - You take damage in water
  - You lose speed and health if you stay too long in warm biomes
  - Snowballs you throw deal damage
  - You leave a snow trail behind
  - You deal more damage in cold areas
- **Strider**
  - You take no fire damage
  - You spawn in the nether
  - You take damage from water
  - You can walk on lava
  - You move slower on land
  - Other players can ride you
  - You can eat warped fungus for a speed boost
- **Witch**
  - Potions you drink last twice as long
  - You can left click with an empty hand to drink a potion that is useful for the situation you are in
  - You have witch particles
  - Pillagers and Illagers like you, and villagers don't like you
- **Wolf**
  - You have 2 hearts less health than humans
  - You become faster, stronger, and have more health during a full moon
  - Wolves you tame and breed are stronger and have more health
  - You can howl by left clicking with nothing in your hand to give speed and strength to you and nearby wolves
  - If you have 4 or more wolves nearby you deal more damage and are faster
  - You can only eat meat (other foods provide no saturation and poison you)
- **Guardian**
  - You have natural thorns
  - Guardians don't attack you
  - You have natural armour
  - You are weaker on the surface
  - You can breathe underwater but not on land
  - You can see clearer underwater
  - You can break blocks faster underwater
  - You can swim faster underwater
  - You take more damage from Impaling
  - You get air from potions
  - You can become an Elder Guardian by killing one
- **Elder Guardian**
  - This origin is **unchoosable**; you transform into it by killing a natural Elder Guardian when you have the Guardian origin
  - All guardian abilities
  - Your natural thorns are stronger
  - Your natural armour is stronger
  - You are immune to mining fatigue
  - You can left click whilst holding nothing to give mining fatigue to nearby players

# Name Colors
A simple server-side mod that adds a command for changing your name color in chat

With the mod installed on the server, players may run `/color <hex_code>` (e.g. `/color ffff8d`) to change their color (the hex value may optionally be prefixed with `#`), and `/color clear` to reset their color back to the default.

title: PortableChests
description: Allows you to carry multiple chests / barrels
body:
# Portable Chests

> This project is heavily inspired by the mod [Carry On](https://modrinth.com/mod/carry-on)

Crouch + right click on a chest / barrel with both hands empty will pick it up, do it again on a empty spot will place it down (they can stack, so you can pick up multiple containers!)

Known Issues
---

- Chests won't combine into double chests when placed down
- I didn't store the chest content to file, so if you close the server while someone holding a container, it would be gone
  - This is intentional, I don't want people to overrely on this plugin and keep all their stuff in chests instead of shulker boxes

> I'm planning to add a warning when players carry the chests for too long
