</details>

## Dark Forest Village

In Dark Forests you will be able to find a whole new village!

These villages will always spawn with a **Bar.** Bars are where you will find The Beast Unleashed! You will also find Beer and Wine here!


<details>
<summary>Dark Forest Village</summary>

![Dark Forest Village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a476eb9535e7a0b680f5665ba0490f928ed4026.jpeg)
Dark Forest Village

![Dark Forest Bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82c777c69634cef813bca0d033cba14a639e4ab0.jpeg)
Dark Forest Bar

![Bar Interior](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0cdb38079d3b82bc720cb51754b91df683dde8d.jpeg)
Bar Interior


</details>


# Drinking Monster

## Caffinated

![Effects given when drinking a monster](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5defb1dd836a01d216db53398bb4fa98b97882c7.png)

When you drink Monster you will get the "Caffeinated" status effect. The level you get will be based on the size of Monster you drink. You will also be given Haste and Speed (Notably for a shorter period of time than your Caffeinated Effect). If you drink another Monster while you have the Caffeinated Effect, the level of effect you get will increase. If you consume too much Caffeiene in a short amount of time...

## Caffiene Addict

![Caffeine Addict Effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1818e3cccf1632ece217a1ae067721a1ed3769f.png)

You will become a Caffeine addict! If you are not Caffeinated while having this effect then you will randomly get withdrawal symptoms. While you are a Caffiene Addict, you will no longer recieve the Haste and Speed you otherwise would be given if drinking Caffiene.

## Drinking Alcohol

When you drink alcoholic beverages you will first get the Tipsy effect. Tipsy on it's own does not do anything, but if you drink another beverage then you will become drunk

While you are drunk, you will stumble around, occasionally getting nausious. The more alcohol you drink while drunk the higher your drunk effect gets and the more common negative effects are. If you are drunk enough you will become hungover after the drunk effects wear off. Let your drunk status effect get too high and you will begin to overdose and die.

Like Caffeine, if you drink too much alcohol in a short period of time you will become an alcoholic. UNLIKE CAFFEINE this is not tracked by an effect similar to "Caffeinated." This is tracked in the background. While you are an alcoholic you will recieve negative effects from time to time. These effects will be harsher than Caffiene Withdrawal. 

TLDR: don't drink too much Alcohol.

title: Builders Freecam
description: A Legitimate Fork of Freecam, allowing you to travel through semi-transparent / non-culling / water blocks in rendered chunks only, removing hacks like x-ray features. Overcustomizable.
body:
![Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/47qRA7ni/images/48d2c2b07f08ac330f908b0a568075c06ee77dec.png) # Builders Freecam ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.16_onward-green) ![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod_Loader-Fabric-DBD0B4?logo=fabric) ![NeoForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod_Loader-NeoForge-E04E14) ![Forge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod_Loader-Forge-6D3FD3)
- A Legitimate Fork of [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam), allowing you to travel through legimimate blocks, and only when it is specified in configs. This Fork **won't let players go through walls or lava**, neither **won't let players use x-ray and hack features that freecam does have**. All ignorable collision (aka travellable blocks) are defined in the configurations toggles: | Name | Description | Default Value | |--------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------| | Ignore Transparent Blocks | Allows travelling through transparent blocks in freecam. | `true` | | Ignore Openable Blocks | Allows travelling through doors/trapdoors/gates in freecam. | `true` | | Ignore Non-Culling Blocks | Allows travelling through non-culling texture blocks in freecam (hoppers, lecterns, shulkerboxes, mid-air blocks ecc). | `true` | | Ignore Water Fluid | Allows travelling through water in freecam. | `true` | ## What are Non-Culling Blocks? Non-Culling blocks are definied by a function in the code. This function checks whether a block can “cull” (i.e. skip texture rendering) nearby block faces. If it does cull a neighbour face (Piston Head, Solid Block...), it checks if the involved neighbour block can also "cull" the same face (2 Adiacent Solid Blocks, 2 Piston Head front-to-front...), in which case travelling through that block is denied, otherwise it will be allowed (Glass over piston head, mid-air solid block...). If it does not cull every neighbour face (hopper, cauldron...), you can travel through the block. # Why this Fork? First, regardless of your configs, **this Freecam won't let players go through walls or lava**. But it does come with more features: - You can eventually travel through water with a toggle in the config. - Freecam is bounded in player's rendered chunks, avoiding cave x-ray peeks on borders - You can travel through transparent blocks, or eventually non-culling blocks on certain conditions (see **What are Non-Culling Blocks?**). # About As a fork, it means that before reporting any bug you may firstly check the if the issue is present on [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam) mod. Any issue can be reported on the github of this mod, but you must say if it is also an issue related to [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam) mod. This mod allows you to control your camera separately from your player. While it is enabled, you can fly around and travel through blocks within your render distance. Disabling it will restore you to your original position. This can be useful for quickly inspecting builds and exploring your world. This mod works in multiplayer, but may be considered cheating on some servers. It is your responsibility to check **all** relevant rules **before** using this mod. While Freecam should only affect the client, it **may be possible** for servers to detect the mod being installed through various exploits in Minecraft, modding platforms, or this mod. Here's a [real example](https://github.com/MinecraftFreecam/Freecam/issues/196) that exploited translation keys. To paraphrase our license, we are not responsible for any damages or liability related to Builders Freecam. Among other things, **this means it's not our fault if you get banned from a server**. ## Translation (Freecam) You can help [translate the original Freecam mod on Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/freecam), language changes will be inspired by that work. If you're unfamiliar with Crowdin, you can read their [getting started as a volunteer translator guide](https://support.crowdin.com/enterprise/getting-started-for-volunteers). If you'd like to translate a language, on Freecam mod, they don't currently target, please [open there an issue](https://github.com/MinecraftFreecam/Freecam/issues/new) asking them to enable the language. Their language updates will merge then on this fork. ## Keybinds | Name | Description | Default Bind | |----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------| | Toggle Freecam | Enables/disables Builders Freecam | `F4` | | Config GUI | Opens the settings screen. | `Unbound` | | Control Player | Transfers control back to your player, but retains your current perspective (Can only be used while Freecam is active.) | `Unbound` | | Reset Tripod | Resets a tripod\* camera when pressed in combination with any of the hotbar keys | `Unbound` | \*The freecam bind can also be used in conjunction with any of the hotbar keys (`F4` + `1`...`9`) to enter "tripod" mode. This enables you to set up multiple cameras with differing perspectives, and switch between them at will. ## Movement Options | Name | Description | Default Value | |------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------| | Flight Mode | The type of flight used by freecam.

**Options:**
- `DEFAULT` : Static velocity with no drifting
- `CREATIVE` : Vanilla creative flight | `DEFAULT` | | Horizontal Speed | The horizontal speed of freecam. | `1.0` | | Vertical Speed | The vertical speed of freecam. | `1.0` | ## Visual Options | Name | Description | Default Value | |---------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------| | Initial Perspective | The initial perspective of the camera.

**Options:**
- `FIRST_PERSON` : The player's perspective
- `THIRD_PERSON` : Behind the player
- `THIRD_PERSON_MIRROR` : In front of the player
- `INSIDE` : Inside the player | `INSIDE` | | Show Player | Shows your player in its original position. | `true` | | Show Hand | Whether you can see your hand in freecam. | `false` | | Full Brightness | Increases brightness while in freecam. | `false` | | Show Submersion Fog | Whether you see a fog overlay underwater, in lava, or powdered snow. | `false` | ## Utility Options | Name | Description | Default Value | |-------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------| | Disable on Damage | Disables freecam when damage is received. | `true` | | Freeze Player | Prevents player movement while freecam is active.
**WARNING: Multiplayer usage not advised.** | `false` | | Allow Interaction | Whether you can interact with blocks/entities in freecam.
**WARNING: Multiplayer usage not advised.** | `false` | | Interaction Mode | The source of block/entity interactions.

**Options:**
- `CAMERA` : Interactions come from the camera
- `PLAYER` : Interactions come from the player | `CAMERA` | ## Notification Options | Name | Description | Default Value | |-----------------------|---------------------------------------------------------|---------------| | Freecam Notifications | Notifies you when entering/exiting freecam. | `true` | | Tripod Notifications | Notifies you when entering/exiting tripod cameras.
| `true` | ## Requirements ### Fabric - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) (Optional) ### Forge - None ### NeoForge - None

title: Superb Recruits
description: Superb Recruits is a compatibility add-on that bridges The Recruits Mod and Superb Warfare, allowing your NPC recruits to seamlessly operate and interact with ground vehicles from Superb Warfare.
body:
Superb Recruits is a compatibility add-on that bridges The Recruits Mod and Superb Warfare, allowing your NPC recruits to seamlessly operate and interact with ground vehicles from Superb Warfare.

With this mod, your recruits can now drive, ride, and utilize Superb Warfare’s vehicles just like players do — perfect for creating AI-controlled squads, convoy patrols, or mechanized units in large-scale battles.

Whether you’re leading an army of foot soldiers or commanding a fleet of tanks, Superb Recruits brings your military gameplay to life with smarter, more immersive vehicle integration.

title: NPCMega
description: NPCMega is a simple Cobblemon addon that lets NPC trainers automatically use battle gimmicks such as Mega Evolution, Ultra Burst, Z-Moves, Terastallization, Dynamax, and Gigantamax.
body:
NPCMega is a simple Cobblemon addon that lets NPC trainers automatically use battle gimmicks such as Mega Evolution, Ultra Burst, Z-Moves, Terastallization, Dynamax, and Gigantamax.

The mod keeps the original Cobblemon NPC battle AI unchanged. It only adds gimmick activation when an NPC Pokémon meets the correct condition. If a trainer has multiple possible gimmicks, only the first valid Pokémon to appear will use one gimmick in that battle.

MegaShowdown is optional. Without MegaShowdown installed, the mod can still load normally, but gimmick features will not activate.

title: XpBottle
description: XpBottle [1.16+] – Plugin that allows players to store and transfer XP using secure custom XP bottles, perfect for survival, PvP, RPG, and economy servers
body:
![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/014265fc3bd1e10bf495f73b494c36d8da60968a.png)

![XpBottle](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0.0-blue)
![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.21%2B-brightgreen)
![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1463533838704578645?logo=discord&label=Discord&color=5865F2)](https://discord.com/invite/ydn5S7FC7q)

## ✨ Features

- 🧪 **XP Bottle Creation** — Convert your XP into storable bottles via `/xpbottle <amount>`
- 🖱️ **Easy Redemption** — Right-click a bottle to instantly absorb its XP
- ⏳ **Cooldown System** — Configurable cooldown to prevent spam
- 🔐 **Protected Bottles** — Bottles are returned to the player on death instead of dropping
- 🎨 **Customizable Bottles** — Full control over material, name, lore, glow and hex colors
- 🔊 **Sound Effects** — Configurable sounds on withdraw and redeem
- 🗄️ **Database Support** — H2 (embedded) or MySQL via HikariCP
- 🔧 **ItemsAdder Integration** — Optional support for custom items
- 👑 **Admin Commands** — Give bottles to players and reload config
- 🌍 **Configurable Messages** — Full lang.yml with hex color & MiniMessage support

---

![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b859d1899f664c87d8b1b3ff5788ac860fe88991.png)

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/xpbottle <amount>` | Withdraw XP into a bottle | `xpbottle.use` |
| `/xpbottle give <player> <amount>` | Give XP bottle(s) to a player | `xpbottle.give` |
| `/xpbottle reload` | Reload the plugin configuration | `xpbottle.reload` |
| `/xpbottle help` | Display the help message | — |
| `/xp` | View your current level and total XP | `xp.view` |

---

![Perms](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4765db5deedcf5dc9e931f643ce24e1a82da7d2.png)

## 🔒 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `xpbottle.use` | Use `/xpbottle` to withdraw XP | `true` |
| `xpbottle.give` | Give bottles to other players | `op` |
| `xpbottle.reload` | Reload the configuration | `op` |
| `xp.view` | Use `/xp` to view level and XP | `true` |

---

![Placeholders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d5b07dd223181721b1e81148368bf5c2d2f7fcf.png)

## 🔖 Placeholders

| Placeholder | Description |
|---|---|
| `%exp%` | Amount of XP stored in the bottle |
| `%signer%` | Name of the player who created the bottle |
| `%amount%` | Number of bottles |
| `%time%` | Remaining cooldown time in seconds |
| `%player%` | Target player name |
| `%level%` | Player's current level |
| `%xp%` | Player's total XP |

---

title: Cobblemon Fossils Minus☄️☠️ - A Fossils Plus Addon
description: An addon pack for Cobblemon Fossils Plus that restricts the special fossil revival pool to supported Fossil/Artificial species.
body:
# Fossils Minus ☄️☠️ – Controlled Fossil Restoration for Cobblemon 


Fossils Minus is a modular datapack + resource pack suite that restricts [Cobblemon Fossils Plus ✨🦖's](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-fossils-plus) special fossil restoration mechanic to species already supported for revival by the restoration machine. 

# ✴️ About this datapack 

FossilsPlus normally allows its special fossils (Shiny, HA, IV, Perfect) to generate any Pokémon species present in the game, including stage 1 and 2 Pokémon.

Fossils Minus restricts those modifiers so they only work when combined with valid fossil ingredients for thematic consistency. All supported recipes give stage 0 Pokémon.

## ➕ What this pack adds

This project adds over 100 targeted fossil restoration recipes (104–105, depending on ATM x MSD version) while preserving proper restoration tank visuals. It features;

🎯 Support for all base fossil Pokémon found in Cobblemon

🧬 Fully compatible with [Complete Galar Fossilmon](https://modrinth.com/datapack/complete-galar-fossilmon) (Note; uses the new version that replaces Dracodacentro with Dracocerato

💥 Compatible with [ATM x MSD's](https://modrinth.com/datapack/allthemons-x-mega-showdown-legacy) legendary recipes

🏛 Optionally compatible with [Legendary Monuments'](https://modrinth.com/mod/legendary-monuments) Tuft of Mew Hair

📚 Compatible with [Lost Lore's](https://modrinth.com/datapack/poketwo) clone species

👁 Visually seamless with correct fetus display models where supported


## 🎁 Included Modifier Types

For every supported fossil species, the following variants are added:

✨ Shiny Fossil

🌟 Hidden Ability Fossil

📈 Perfect IV Fossil

💎 Perfect Fossil (Shiny + 6×31 IVs)

<details>
<summary>🚫 Standalone use of special fossils is disabled.</summary>

Though still possible through combining the special fossil with a 🚫 barrier block 🚫

</details>


# 👾 Compatible Pokemon

Over 100 Recipes Added

Depending on which optional packs are enabled, this suite adds special fossil support for:


<details>
<summary>Core Fossil Pokémon</summary>

- Omanyte 
- Kabutops
- Aerodactyl
- Lileep
- Anorith
- Cranidos
- Shieldon
- Tirtouga
- Archen
- Tyrunt
- Amaura
- Dracozolt
- Dracovish
- Arctozolt
- Arctovish

</details>


<details>
<summary>Complete Galar Fossilmon</summary>


- Raptorzolt
- Dracocerato
- Dunkleovish
- Arctoplesio

⚠️ If you wish to use Dracodacentro, you'll have to replace the Dracocerato jsons manually. I may add a version to support this in a future update if enough people request it.

</details>


<details>
<summary>ATM x MSD Pokémon</summary>

- Mewtwo
- Genesect
- Type:Null

</details>

<details>
<summary>Lost Lore clone starters</summary>

- Bulbasaurtwo
- Charmandertwo
- Squirtletwo
</details>

Each special fossil modifier × species combination has its own targeted recipe that can be modified as you please.

Note: This pack does not add any new Pokémon, just its restoration recipes; to use an addon pack, you should install the corresponding mod that adds support for that Pokémon as well.



## 🦠 Correct Fetus Display Models

Using the included resource packs, the correct Pokémon fetus grows in the restoration tank for every supported recipe.

## 📋 How to use 

Just simply add the desired special fossil ingredient to the existing fossil recipe! For example;


<details>

![Perfect Aerodactyl](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee9f51f8b27f231bda7a6506c3f7eb730a2207c1.png)
</details>
  
## ⚠️ Hidden Ability Notes

Some Pokémon do not have hidden abilities defined.

The following species currently, by default, do not have hidden abilities:

- Archen
- Genesect
- Type:Null

Hidden Ability recipes are still included for these Pokémon via:

- fp_ha_archen.json
- addon_ha_genesect.json
- addon_ha_typenull.json

These recipes exist to support custom server-side hidden ability additions and modded ability expansions.

If your server does not use custom hidden abilities, these files can be safely removed.

Removing them will prevent the Hidden Ability Fossil from being used to revive those Pokémon, so that nobody wastes a Hidden Ability Fossil unnecessarily.

# ⚙️ Technical details

This release is structured as modular packs:

## 🗃️ Required

- Core Datapack

- Core Fetus Resource Pack

## 🚥 Optional Addons

- Complete Galar Fossilmon

- ATM x MSD (Vanilla version)

- ATM x MSD (LegendaryMonuments version)

- Lost Lore

You can enable only the integrations you use. Using addon packs that add recipes for Pokémon not present in your game may crash the game

### 🏯 Legendary Monuments Support

An alternate ATM x MSD pack is included, where Mewtwo's resurrection requires:

- Nether Star

- Tuft of Mew Hair (LegendaryMonuments)

This overrides the Psychic Gem recipe when enabled for both the default recipe, and any fossils plus recipes. This feature was present in previous LM versions of ATM x MSD but has since been removed.

# 🖥️ Installation

Extract the main download.

Place desired datapack zip(s) into:

world/datapacks/


Place the desired resource pack zip(s) into:

client resourcepacks folder
or

host as server resource pack

Run:

/reload


⚠️ Do not unzip the inner zip files.

## 🔧 Advanced: Combining Packs Into One

If you prefer a single unified datapack and/or resource pack instead of modular zips, you can merge them manually.

### Combining Datapacks

If you wish to combine these packs into one for cleaner organisation;

Unzip the datapacks you want to combine.

Merge their data/ folders together.

Keep only one pack.mcmeta at the root.

Re-zip the folder (do not nest folders).

Final structure should look like:

```
UnifiedPack.zip

├── pack.mcmeta

└── data/

    └── cobblemon/

        └── fossils/ 
```


⚠️ Important:

If combining ATM x MSD variants, choose EITHER the Vanilla or LegendaryMonuments version — not both.

### Combining Resource Packs

Unzip the resource packs you want to merge.

Merge their assets/ folders together.

Keep only one pack.mcmeta.

Re-zip the folder.

Final structure:

```
UnifiedResourcePack.zip

├── pack.mcmeta

└── assets/

    └── cobblemon/

        └── bedrock/
```

## 🌐 Compatibility

Minecraft 1.21.1

[Cobblemon 1.7.3+](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)

[Cobblemon FossilsPlus](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-fossils-plus)

Optional: [Complete Galar Fossilmon](https://modrinth.com/datapack/complete-galar-fossilmon) V 1.3+

Optional: [ATM x MSD](https://modrinth.com/datapack/allthemons-x-mega-showdown-legacy)

Optional: [LegendaryMonuments](https://modrinth.com/mod/legendary-monuments)

Optional: [Lost Lore](https://modrinth.com/datapack/poketwo) 2.0/1.8

# 🤞 Future Plans
1. Dracodacentro support
2. Shiny fetus textures
3. Pre - Combined asset packs
4. Custom special fossil assets (if not supported by Fossils Plus already)
5. More recipe support (reach out on Cobblemon's Discord)

body:
# Overview 

This datapack improves compatibility between Botany Pots and several popular farming mods by adding missing crops and fixing multi-block crop behaviour



# What this datapack does
##  🌾 Adds missing crops to Botany Pots

Enables the following crops to grow in Botany Pots

### Cultural Delights

🌽 Corn (uses upper block)

🥒 Cucumber

🍆 Eggplant

~~🥑 Avocado~~ (V1.1) - Support moved to my [Botany Tree pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/botany-trees-x-farmers-delight-expanded-compatibility), adds axe compatibility.

🌽🌿 Wild Corn

🥒🌿 Wild Cucumbers

🍆🌿 Wild Eggplants

### Cobblemon

🍇 Eggant Berry

🌾 Hearty Grains 

🌰 Galarica Nuts (V1.1)

### Vegan Delight

🫘 Soybeans

🫘🌿 Wild Soybeans

### Pineapple Delight (V1.1)

🍍 Pineapples

🍍🌿 Wild Pineapple Crops

⚠️ Note: As this is simply a datapack, you do not require all of these mods to be present, it will work fine with just the ones you have. If you are concerned, simply delete their recipe folders from the ZIP

## 🌱 Multi-block crop fixes

Some crops (such as corn and rice) are multi-block plants where the harvestable logic lives on the upper block.

This datapack updates Botany Pots recipes to:

Target the upper / harvestable block where appropriate (Currently limited to Rice and Corn, I can't seem to get Hearty grains to support this behaviour, but as Hearty Grains upper block only drops 2 hearty grains instead of 1, and has no other interaction recipes, I figure it's fine to leave out until a future update).

Preserve tool-gated drops and loot conditions (Corn drops corn cobs instead of kernels, and Rice drops Rice Panicles instead of Rice)

Display the correct mature crop visuals inside the pot (Rice displays Rice Panicles block instead of Rice Crops block)


## 🍍 V1.1 Pineapple Delight Support

### Pineapple features

This datapack does a lot to make Pineapple Delight consistent with other delight mods and crops in this datapack, namely

- Wild Pineapple Crops can now be obtained with Silk Touch or Shears (why you'd want to grow these, I don't know, but now you can!)
- Pineapples can be grown on dirt or sand in botany pots
- Added knife harvesting support for fully grown pineapple crops
 - Pineapples harvested with knives drop two pineapple sides and one pineapple crop (as well as a fortune roll for additional pineapple crop drops).

### Why remove Avocado Support?

Simply put, I felt I could better support its compatibility if I kept it with my Botany Tree datapack. Any changes I make to Botany Tree support will be reflected in its inclusion there (like axe stripping support to get stripped jungle logs). If you really want Avocado's but don't want to use botany trees, just pull the recipe from either V1.0 or the Botany Tree pack and merge it with the zip.

## 🔪 Notes on knife usage & straw harvesting

Corn and rice can drop straw when harvested with a knife using this datapack, but Botany Pots does not allow knives in the tool slot by default.

To enable straw drops in Botany Pots, I recommend also installing my companion pack:

[Botany Pots x Farmer's Delight Compatibility Pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/botanypots-farmers-delight-rich-soil-compatibility) (also adds rich soil support).

Using a knife to harvest Rice will also drop Rice instead of Rice Panicles alongside Straw, and will auto-cut pineapples into pineapple sides using these datapacks together!

# Technical
### Compatibility

Requires [Botany Pots](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-pots) - (Fabric version tested)


🧩 **Compatible with:**

[Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated)

[Botany Pots Tiers](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-pots-tiers)

[Botany Trees](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-trees)

[Cultural Delights](https://modrinth.com/mod/cultural-delights)

[Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)

[Vegan Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/vegan-delight)

## 📦 Works well with my other data pack

[BotanyPots × Farmer’s Delight – Improved Compatibility](https://modrinth.com/datapack/botanypots-farmers-delight-rich-soil-compatibility) for proper rich soil support (also adds knives!)


Safe to add or remove from existing worlds.

### Instructions

📥 **Installation**

Download the datapack

Place the ZIP file into:

```
<world folder>/datapacks/
```
Run /reload or restart the world

**Versions**

Im sure this probably works in more versions than just 1.21.1 but thats all I tested it for at the moment! Feel free to test it if you wish.

title: Admin Abuse
description: small Paper/Spigot plugin that lets admins send loud, colorful global announcements and meme-style “ADMIN ABUSE” alerts with both chat messages and titles. It supports legacy & color codes and hex colors, includes a countdown command to hype events, and is
body:
# This plugin will not recieve anymore updates for a longwhile. Due to me being very busy in real life and having a job.
Admin-Abuse is a lightweight Paper/Spigot broadcast plugin focused on flashy “admin abuse” style announcements with full color support.​

Features
Simple commands for global announcements, including a dedicated “Admin Abuse” countdown that hypes up events before they start.​

Supports legacy color codes (&a, &b, &l, etc.) and modern hex colors (like #ff00ff) in both chat and titles for highly customized messages.​​
-# it should also support minimessage format (i think)

Sends synchronized chat broadcasts and on-screen titles to all online players, making sure no one misses important messages.​

Commands

`/broadcast <message>` – Sends a formatted global announcement with full color support.​

`/adminabuse <message>` – Instantly blasts an “ADMIN ABUSE” style alert to everyone.​

`/adminabusestart <message>` – Starts a short countdown (3…2…1…) and then triggers an “ADMIN ABUSE” broadcast.

`/chunkban <player>` Bans someone from the chunk.

`/chunkunban <player>` Unbans someone from the chunk.​​

Permissions
`eee.broadcast` – Allows use of `/broadcast`.​

`eee.adminabuse` – Allows use of `/adminabuse` and `/adminabusestart`.

`eee.chunkban` - Alows use of `/chunkban`.

`eee.chunkunban` - Alows use of `/chunkun~~~~ban`.​

Compatibility
Server: Spigot / Paper

Minecraft: 1.21+ (built and tested on modern Paper/Spigot APIs).​

Ideal for SMPs, event servers, and admin meme moments where you want announcements to look loud, colorful, and impossible to ignore.​

title: Alloy
description: The Alloy mod is an expansion for Minecraft that adds new materials, tools, armor, and unique resource processing mechanics to the game.
body:
# ⚒️ Alloy

**Alloy** is a mod that significantly expands the possibilities of the game by introducing new metals, tools, armor and production units. The mod is aimed at players who want to diversify the process of mining, processing and using resources, as well as gain new experiences from crafting and progression.

---

## ✨ What does the mod add?

### 🔩 New metals and alloys

Unique materials such as **Azurite**, **Bronze**, **Aurum**, **Aquitaine**, **Amethyst**, **Hell Metal** and others are added to the game. Each metal has its own properties, appearance and production methods.

### 🛠️ Tools and weapons

For each new material, a complete set of tools (pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, sword) with unique characteristics of strength, speed and damage are implemented.

### 🛡️ Armor

Each metal allows you to create a complete set of armor, featuring protection and additional effects:

- **Amethyst Armor** — grants Night Vision effect
- **Azurite Armor** — grants Speed effect
- **Aquitaine Armor** — grants Jump Boost effect
- **Hell Armor** — grants Fire Resistance effect
- **Aurum Armor** — grants Regeneration effect

### 🏭 New production units

The mod features a unique block — **Mega Smelter**, which allows you to melt ores and materials more efficiently and quickly, and also has its own interface and animation.

### 📜 Crafting Recipes

Balanced recipes are implemented for all new items and blocks, integrated into the standard Minecraft crafting system.

### 🎨 Unique textures and models

All items, blocks and armor have their own high-quality textures and 3D models that harmoniously fit into the style of the game.

### 🏆 Achievements System

The mod includes a comprehensive achievement system to track your progress:

- **🔥 Embodiment of Fire** — Craft a Mega Smelter
- **⚡ Spark of Progress!** — Create your first alloy in the Mega Smelter
- **🌙 Master of Night** — Craft a full set of amethyst armor
- **💎 First Blood of Earth** — Mine any ore from the mod

---

## 🎯 Key Features

- ⚔️ **Expansion of endgame content** through new materials and improved tools
- 🔗 **Production chains** using new blocks and recipes
- 🎭 **Visual and gameplay variety** due to unique textures and effects
- ⚖️ **Balanced gameplay** — all items are carefully balanced and don't overpower vanilla content
- 🌍 **Rare ore generation** — ores spawn less frequently than diamonds, making them valuable
- 🎮 **Seamless integration** with vanilla Minecraft mechanics

---

## 💡 Why should you download Alloy?

- 🆕 **New impressions:** The mod adds a fresh look at the familiar Minecraft mechanics, making the process of mining and processing resources more interesting

- ⚖️ **Balance and integration:** All items and blocks are balanced and seamlessly blend into the vanilla gameplay

- ✨ **High-quality implementation:** The mod is characterized by high quality of execution, thoughtful textures and stable operation

- 🔄 **Support and development:** The project is actively developing, updates with new features are regularly released

- 🏆 **Progression system:** Achievements provide additional goals and rewards for your journey

---

**Alloy** is the perfect choice for players who want to expand the possibilities of Minecraft, get new challenges and make the gameplay even more exciting!

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.20.1
- **Fabric Loader:** ≥0.16.13
- **Fabric API:** Required
- **Java:** ≥17

---

## 🔧 Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 1.20.1
2. Download and install **Fabric API**
3. Place the **Alloy** mod file in your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

---

*Made with ❤️ by ZDev*

title: Sentinel
description: A lightweight Minecraft authentication plugin
body:
**Sentinel** is a lightweight, powerful and secure authentication plugin for 1.20+ Minecraft servers. Built with simplicity and safety in mind, it ensures that players register and log in before interacting with the world, protecting your server from unauthorized access and potential exploits.

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/338ea973d256041562139204835273254d298d79_0.webp)

## Features
- 🔑 ``/login <password>`` - Log in to your registered account
  - Permission: ``sentinel.login``
  - Aliases: ``/l <password>``

- 🆕 ``/register <password>`` - Create a new account
  - Permission: ``sentinel.register``
  - Aliases: ``/r <password>``
 
- 🔄 ``/changepassword <old> <new>`` - Change your password securely
  - Permission: ``sentinel.changepassword``

- 🗑️ ``/unregister <player>`` - Delete a player account (OP only as default)
  - Permission: ``sentinel.unregister``

- 🔧 ``/sentinel reloadlang`` - Reload server's language from config (OP only as default)
  - Permission: ``sentinel.use``

## Functionalities
- 🚷 **Restricted Mode:** Players who are not logged in are placed in a restricted state.

- 🕒 **Session Support:** Customizable auto-login session window (15 minutes by default)

- 🧱 **SQLite Storage:** All data stored locally in `Sentinel/auth.db`

- 🛡️ **Secure Logging:** Password-related commands are filtered from logs to avoid exposure

- 🧩 **Multi-Version Support:** Fully compatible with Minecraft **1.20+**, including 1.21.x

- 🌐 **Locale-Based Language:** Each player's language is selected automatically based on their client locale. Available translations include:
  - `en-US`, `en-GB`, `es-ES`, `pt-BR`, `pt-PT`, `de-DE`, `ru-RU`
  - Additional locales can be added by placing `.yml` translation files in the `lang/` folder.

- 🆔 **UUID Modes:** Supports flexible player UUID modes via config:
  - `adapt`   - Automatically chooses based on the server’s online mode  
  - `online`  - Use Mojang authenticated UUIDs (accounts tied to Mojang accounts).
  - `offline` - Generate UUIDs based on player names (accounts tied to usernames).

- 🖥️ **Server Language Config:** Defines the server's default language (used mainly for console logs)

## 📢 Planned  / Coming Soon
- Currently no planned features, but open to suggestions and pull requests!

## 🤝 Need Help or Want to Contribute?
Found a bug? Have a suggestion? Want to help improve it?
You can:
- Open [issues](https://github.com/KaianGuedes/Sentinel/issues) for bugs, ideas, or feature requests.
- Submit [pull requests](https://github.com/KaianGuedes/Sentinel/pulls) to improve the code, docs, or features.
- Or start a [discussion](https://github.com/KaianGuedes/Sentinel/discussions) in the GitHub repository.

Thank you for using Sentinel!

title: GoatedFactions
description: A simple and modern factions plugin.
body:
GoatedFactions: Enhanced Factions Gameplay

Want a factions experience that's powerful, feature-rich, yet straightforward?
Introducing GoatedFactions (GFactions for short). We deliver the essential features you love about factions, enhanced with new strategic options and improved stability, all without the bloat. Get your server up and running with a highly engaging team-based PvP and land control system.

Simple. Configurable. Fun.

Lightweight & Optimized: Designed for performance, with robust data handling and refined logic ensuring your server runs smoothly.
Easy to Learn, Fun to Master: Intuitive commands, clear mechanics, and a new in-game /f guide get your players into the action faster.
Core Factions Experience: All the essentials you need, now with added depth like intelligent claim filling and an enhanced outpost system.
Highly Configurable: Tailor power costs, cooldowns, expirations, chat formats, and much more to fit your server's unique style through an easy-to-use config.yml.
Enhanced Player Experience: Automatic player tab list updates with faction tags/ranks and clear claim entry/exit titles improve immersion.
Key Feature Highlights:

🛡️ Team Up & Claim Your Land:

Create factions, invite members, and establish clear roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Associate).
Claim territory chunk by chunk, securing your base with automatic protection against outsiders.
Utilize the new /f claimfill command to intelligently claim surrounded wilderness pockets.
Grant trusted non-members access to your lands.
Establish and manage Outposts that can now merge with your main territory if claims connect.
⚡ Dynamic Power & PvP:

Faction power grows with your members and is spent on strategic actions.
Engage in meaningful PvP where defeating enemies impacts their faction's power.
Overclaim the territory of weakened, zero-power enemy factions with improved logic.
Benefit from hourly power regeneration (configurable online/offline rates) to stay in the fight.
Experience power decay for inactive factions, keeping the landscape dynamic.
🤝 Streamlined Diplomacy:

Declare enemies, initiating a configurable cooldown for peace declarations.
Form alliances through an invite-based system with configurable expiration times.
Break ties with /f unally or /f neutral as your strategies evolve.
🏡 Essential Utilities & Enhanced Gameplay:

Set a faction home for quick teleports (with a configurable strategic warmup, cancelled on movement, damage, or other teleports).
Share resources with your faction through a dedicated /f vault, accessible by all members.
Stay informed with /f who, /f list, and clear, improved help menus.
Utilize the new /f guide for quick access to feature explanations.
🗺️ (Optional) Dynmap Integration:

Visualize your server's political landscape with faction claims on your Dynmap!
Features more accurate data in popups (power/claim limits), improved styling options, and robust claim rendering with fallbacks for complex shapes.
⚙️ Server Compatibility (Minecraft 1.21):
GoatedFactions is built against the Paper API for Minecraft 1.21. (Note: Original said 1.21.5, confirm your target)

✅ Purpur (Recommended)
✅ Paper (Recommended)
✅ Spigot (Paper or forks recommended for best performance)
Bukkit (Not recommended; Spigot or its derivatives are preferred)
Comprehensive Feature & Command List (Version 1.3.0):

Core Faction Management:

Faction Creation:
/f create <name>: Create a new faction (you become Owner).
Membership:
/f invite <playerName>: (Admin/Owner) Invite a player to your faction (invite expires).
/f uninvite <playerName>: (Admin/Owner) Revoke a pending invitation.
/f accept <factionName>: Accept an invitation to join a faction.
/f leave: Leave your current faction (Owners must disband or transfer leadership if other members exist).
/f kick <playerName>: (Admin/Owner) Remove a member from your faction.
Ranks & Roles:
Ranks: Owner, Admin, Member, Associate.
/f setrank <player> <rank>: (Admin/Owner) Set a player's rank (Associate, Member, Admin).
/f leader <newLeaderName>: (Owner) Transfer faction ownership to another member (must be at least Member rank).
Trusted Players (Non-Members):
/f trust <playerName>: (Admin/Owner) Grant a non-member trusted status in your territory (costs power).
/f untrust <playerName>: (Admin/Owner) Revoke trusted status.
Disbanding:
/f disband: (Owner) Disband your faction.
Power System:

Dynamic power based on member count (configurable bonus per member).
Configurable initial power for new factions.
Hourly power regeneration (configurable online/offline rates and interval).
Power costs for claiming, overclaiming, diplomacy, creating outposts, claimfill, and other actions.
Power loss when a member is killed by an enemy.
Configurable power decay for inactive factions.
/f power [faction/player]: View your/target faction's current and maximum power.
Land Claiming & Protection:

/f claim: (Admin/Owner) Claim the chunk you are in (costs power; subject to max claim limit). Claims must be adjacent.
/f autoclaim: (Admin/Owner) Toggle automatic claiming of chunks as you enter them.
/f claimfill: (Admin/Owner) Intelligently claim surrounded wilderness chunks connected to your territory (costs power per chunk).
/f unclaim: (Admin/Owner) Unclaim the chunk you are in.
Overclaiming: Possible if target faction is an enemy and has <= 0 power (costs power).
Automatic protection of claimed land against unauthorized building, breaking, and interaction.
Admin bypass permission (goatedfactions.admin.bypass).
Configurable maximum claims per faction and spawn protection radius.
Outpost System:

/f outpost create: (Admin/Owner) Create an outpost in an unclaimed chunk (costs power). Max outposts configurable.
/f outpost sethome [id]: (Admin/Owner) Set/relocate an outpost's home spawn within its territory.
/f outpost home [id]: Teleport to a specific outpost's home (with warmup).
/f outpost delete [id]: (Admin/Owner) Delete an outpost and all its claims.
Note: Outposts can merge with main territory if claims connect.
Diplomacy & Relations:

Enemies:
/f enemy <factionName>: (Admin/Owner) Declare mutual war (costs power).
Configurable cooldown before neutrality can be declared.
Neutrals:
/f neutral <factionName>: (Admin/Owner) Declare neutrality with a former enemy or unallied faction (costs power if breaking enemy relation; respects cooldown).
Allies (Invite-Based):
/f ally <factionName>: (Admin/Owner) Send an ally request (costs power; request expires).
/f allyaccept <requestingFactionName>: (Admin/Owner) Accept a pending ally request.
/f allyrequests: List pending ally requests to your faction.
/f unally <factionName>: (Admin/Owner) Mutually break an alliance.
Utilities & Player Experience:

Faction Home:
/f sethome: (Admin/Owner) Set your faction's home teleport location in main claimed territory.
/f home [factionName]: Teleport to your own or an allied faction's home.
Configurable teleport warmup (e.g., 5 seconds), cancelled by movement, damage, or other teleports.
Faction Vault:
/f vault: Access a shared 27-slot faction inventory (all members).
Information & Chat:
/f list [page]: Paginated list of all factions.
/f who [factionName] (alias: /f info): Detailed information about a faction.
/f guide: Shows a quick, configurable in-game faction guide.
/f chat (or /f c): Toggle faction-only chat.
/f allychat (or /f ac): Toggle ally-only chat.
Configurable chat formats for faction, ally, and public chat (prefix).
Admin spy permissions for faction (goatedfactions.admin.spy) and ally (goatedfactions.admin.allyspy) chats.
Player Tab List: Automatically updated with faction tag and rank.
Claim Entry/Exit Titles:
On-screen titles display "Wilderness" or Faction Name (with diplomatic coloring) when entering new chunks.
Configurable fade-in, stay, fade-out times, and display cooldown.
Admin Commands (/fa or /facadmin - Requires goatedfactions.admin permission):

/fa help: Displays admin commands.
/fa deletefaction <factionName> (alias: /fa disband): Forcibly delete any faction.
/fa addpower <factionName> <amount>: Add power to a faction (capped by max).
/fa setpower <factionName> <amount>: Set a faction's power to an exact value (capped by max, min 0).
/fa unclaim all <factionName>: Unclaim all land for a specified faction.
/fa unclaim current [factionName]: Unclaim the chunk the admin is in.
/fa vault <factionName>: Open the specified faction's vault.
/fa reloadconfig: Reloads config.yml settings and resets relevant tasks (power regeneration/decay).
/fa dynmapreload: Forces a full update of all faction claims on Dynmap (attempts reactivation if Dynmap was disabled).
Optional Integrations:

Dynmap: Visually display faction claims on your server's web map, with configurable relation-based colors, improved data accuracy in popups, and robust claim rendering.
GoatedFactions v1.3.0 gives you the experience you want from a factions plugin, focusing on performance, stability, and the features that truly matter. Perfect for servers that want action, strategy, and community without getting bogged down.

This plugin is in active development, being improved every day, with the help of your suggestions!

body:
# LoreAnvil

A bukkit plugin for changing name or lore of an item stack with anvil.  
Supports style code starts with `&`, and hex colors starts with `&#` above 1.16.

## Versions

- Paper API is needed.
- ProtocolLib is recommended.

Developing Minecraft Version: **1.21.3**

## Usage

- Modify item name
    - Left: Item
    - Middle: Empty
- Append item lore
    - Left: Item
    - Middle: Paper
- Remove the last item lore
    - Left: Empty
    - Middle: Item

## Permission

**All player have these permissions by default.**

- `loreanvil.rename` —— Rename.
- `loreanvil.lore.add` —— Append item lore.
- `loreanvil.lore.remove` —— Remove item lore.
- `loreanvil.no_too_expensive` —— Remove the too expensive limit.

## Bug report

Submit it on the issues page.

![A banner that says "what is mc.enhance?"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/354M0jC7/images/2dc61063010b370fd87d2290f027885f9d06a37f.png)

---

This modpack aims to provide a balanced mix of performance and quality of life mods, all of which are client-side and multiplayer friendly.

I believe many of the mods in this pack should be included in the base game due to how useful they are. And although each mod may be small on their own, together they succeed in creating an enhanced vanilla-plus experience! Several mods provide information already in the game but in a more practical & appealing manner, making it both easier for new players to learn game mechanics and for veterans to utilize that info.

mc.enhance will be updated weekly with backports arrriving soon!

---

![A banner that says "list of mods:"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/354M0jC7/images/054a529ae14b910d24c97ceeca5023016f919f73.png)

title: SC's Additions
description: Adds a few different mobs to your game, all which fill a niche!
body:
SC's Additions is a mod which aims to add several, mainly ambient mobs to the game. Most of these mobs are meant to fill niches left unfilled by the vanilla game, such as the Nautilus Shell item existing without a Nautilus Mob to go with it. Others were simply added to the mod to flesh out the world more, filling environmental niches such as a lack of desert mobs. All of them try to keep to the "good old vanilla art style", meaning that the mobs won't stylistically clash with any of the vanilla mobs. See more details about the mod's contents below:

## Features Added

### Coyotes
These distant cousins of the wolf can be found in desert, badlands, and taiga biomes at night. They are pack neutral and hunt chickens, rabbits, and mice.



### Wasps
Wasps can be found in desert and badlands biomes, and will attack players in swarms. They somewhat resemble bees, so be careful when trying to identify which is which from a distance. Wasps can also be found spawning from dungeon spawners.



### Nautiluses
Now no longer just a shell item, Nautiluses are rare cephalopods which drop nautilus shells upon death. Despite not being hunted by them, they will avoid Guardians and Elder Guardians.



### Fireflies
Mild Update no more! Fireflies can be found in forests, swamps, and many other biomes during at night. Despite not being their preferred prey, Fireflies are afraid of Frogs. (Or will be when I update the mod to 1.19+)



### Mice
The so-called "Living Mice" of Minecraft OST lore have finally made it to Minecraft! Partially based off of the old bat texture (with a bit of inspiration from the new bat texture, admittedly), Mice are small, ambient rodents that can be found in most forest biomes. While they are skittish, one might be able to breed them with seeds while sneaking. They drop rabbit hides upon death.



### Imps
I decided that, with the addition of the Allay and subsequent Vex remodeling, I didn't want the old Vex texture to go to waste. These feisty Hell-spawn roam the Nether Wastes and Crimson Forests.



### Beelzes
Said to be the offspring of the "Lord Of The Flies" himself, Beelzes are the Nether's answer to Silverfish and Endermites. These aggressive arthropods spawn in packs, in the Nether Wastes.



### Ender Sludges And End Sludge Blocks
### Inspired by the grey mineral sludge pits from Minecraft Dungeons, these leech-like creatures are the End's answer to Slimes and Magma Cubes. Ender Sludges can be found just about anywhere in the End dimension. Clumps of inanimate sludge blocks can also be found in the end, acting as a falling block/gravel equivalent for the End.



## FAQ

### Are you going to make a Fabric port?
I do not plan on making a fabric port, but anyone else is free to do so!

### What's up with the 1.12.2 "Legacy" version?
The Legacy Version is the phrase I use to refer to the lite version of the mod on 1.12.2. It doesn't have all of the features of the main 1.16+ version of the mod, and it isn't meant to. I mainly made it for my upcoming modpack. It can be found with the rest of the mod's files, under 1.12.2. Unlike the other versions, the Legacy Version has yet to be redone from the ground up.

title: SCP When Day Breaks
description: This datapack is a recreation of the ever popular SCP:001, or "When Day Breaks".  This pack is a guaranteed challenge for most, as it makes going out into the sun fatal.  Good luck to anybody who wants to try it :D
body:
## Info:
Do you guys love SCPs, specifically when day breaks. If so then this datapack is for you!

This pack adds SCP 001 (When day breaks) into minecraft, to trigger the event you need to click the bottom text in the reload message, after that you have three days to prepare.

Anything that's outside when it happens will melt into a blob, these blobs drop edible meat, can phase through certain blocks, and can occasionally absorb﻿ projectiles.

If you want to go outside you can either wait for a storm, craft special armor, or use a potion of regeneration.

Lastly, in order to survive you will need to be careful, smart, and ﻿lucky.
Goodluck, and remember "fear the light, embrace the darkness﻿"

### Extra Credits:
Big thanks to timberforge for the custom mobs tutorial, and Galsergey for the custom screen overlay

title: Create: Recipe Everything
description: This mod introduces a variety of new items and blocks specifically designed to enhance and expand the automation capabilities within the already existing Create mod.
body:
# New Blocks and Items Expansion for Create Mod

This mod introduces several new features to enhance the automation and crafting experience within the Create mod. Below is an overview of the additions:

## New Blocks
- **Gravel Wart** 
- ![Gravel Wart - Gravel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6517cde7bba01c5c95ac76f4bc7c793511777c41.png)
- **Cobble Wart** 
- ![Cobble Wart - Cobblestone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1eabe7f596a8c7fbcc44e2e03463bc7e9267f35f.png)

## New Crops
- **Muscari Flower**: Not just a decorative flower, but also a new crop with its own uses.
- **Lily of the Valley**: Traditionally found in gardens, now available as a crop for cultivation.
![Crops](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11450804c85142bd2cc5101bf3852fb874aac29d.png)

## New Items
- **Coal Dust**: A new resource obtained from coal, used in various new recipes.
- **Graphite**: A derivative of coal, used in advanced crafting.
- **Lily of the Valley Seed**: Plantable seeds for growing your own Lily of the Valley crops.
- **Muscari Seed**: Seeds for cultivating the Muscari flowers.
- **Diamond Fragment**: A new item obtained from breaking down less valuable materials, used in crafting diamonds themselves. This provides a new method for players to obtain diamonds, adding depth to resource management and crafting strategies.

## Config
Enable/ Disable all new recipes in the config file (
```
%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\config\createrecipeeverything-common.toml
```
)

## New Recipes
Several new recipes have been added to provide more depth to the game's crafting system. These recipes allow for the creation of new items and block types, further enhancing the mod's integration with the Create mod's automation features.

title: tpHome-Plugin
description: A stupidly simple teleport home plugin for Paper Servers.
body:
The tpHome plugin add a **/tphome** command to [Paper](https://papermc.io/) servers.  The player is sent to their respawn location.

The tphome command is injected into Minecraft's native command system so it can be used in Command Blocks and DataPacks.

Server Operators with the `minecraft.command.selector` permission (as well as Command Blocks and Functions) can supply an optional single player selector.

The command can be restricted by updating the plugin's config.yml file and restarting your server.


**IMPORTANT:** This plugin will only work with servers supporting Paper's plugin loader.


**Permissions:**

`tphome.home` - Allow user to run command when restricted.


**Discord**

If you need help or have comments, please [join my Discord Server](https://discord.gg/ygeqHQyryQ).


**Data Collected**

This plugin utilizes [bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/tpHome) to collect usage statistics, including anonymized data about your server.
If you wish to have your server excluded from this data collection, please edit the `bStats/config.yml` file and set `enabled` to `false`.

title: HeXHub.net optimized | Enhanced
description: Shader- and Distant Horizons–ready client pack, optimized for vanilla multiplayer, with highest practical graphics settings.
body:
# About

This modpack focuses on **Complementary Shaders** and **Distant Horizons** for extended render distance.  
It adds a curated set of performance, visual and quality of life mods (map, HUD, voice chat, VR/controller support) while keeping **vanilla gameplay** and full compatibility with **unmodded survival servers**.  
It is tuned for **HeXHub.net**, but works on most vanilla and Paper-based survival servers.

## Core intent

- **Complementary Shaders by EminGT** enabled and preconfigured.  
- **Distant Horizons** for long-range terrain.  
- Only client-side visuals, performance tweaks and UI/QoL features, no gameplay changes.  
- Helper mods such as the minimap are preconfigured for fair play, avoiding xray-like cave view, mob radar or similar unfair information.  
- No freecam-style spectator mods included.

## Settings policy

- Preconfigured: graphics, shaders, map and a few utility mods (per edition), so everything works out of the box without unfair advantages.  
- Keybinds: only cleaned up to resolve conflicts between mods. Important vanilla and core mod keys keep their usual positions, less important mod keys are moved or unbound.  
- Other options such as sound, mouse and general gameplay settings stay close to vanilla defaults.  
- **Your Options Shall Be Respected (YOSBR)** keeps your own settings on updates. Pack defaults are only applied on fresh installs or when a mod is added and its config does not exist yet.

## Enhanced Edition
Graphics are set as high as they look noticeably better without unnecessary performance cost.  
Tested on a PC with **Ryzen 7900X**, **RTX 3070**, **32 GB RAM**.

## Other Editions
- **[Potato](https://modrinth.com/project/hexhub.net-optimized-potato)** – optimized for very weak PCs and laptops.  
  Tested on a notebook with **i7-7200U** and **8 GB RAM**.

- **[Handheld](https://modrinth.com/project/hexhub.net-optimized-handheld)** – tuned for entry-level gaming PCs and handhelds.  
  Tested on **Steam Deck OLED**.

## Current status
**Alpha**. Active development, frequent updates, possible issues. Feedback via Discord is welcome.

## Licenses and attribution
Third-party mods and resources remain under their original licenses. No relicensing of third-party files is performed.   
The full list of included mods and dependencies appears on this version page.  
Only pack-specific files (configs, assets, texts) are under this project’s **CC-BY-NC-4.0**.

title: Angel Collars
description: Pets now drop collars allowing them to be respawned like players!
body:
When one of your beloved pets die, they will drop a Pet Collar. Pet Collars can be dropped by Wolves, Cats, Parrots, or any other modded pet. 

To respawn your pet, you must use a Pet Collar on a charged Respawn Anchor (or bed if enabled). Right-clicking the Respawn Anchor with the collar will consume the collar and respawn your fallen pet. Make sure you do this in the Nether, or you'll be in for an _explosive suprise_...

Includes an adjustable config to set the collar color  of non-dyeable pets.

<details>
<summary>Isn't this just Pet Cemetery?</summary>
  
**Esentially... Yes.**
  
This mod was created due to how hardcoded Pet Cemetery is, especially on 1.20.1. I personally don’t like the undead pets, and the lack of mod compatibility and storing of wolf variants from Vanilla Backport bothered me. No assets or code were used from the original though. I highly recommend you try out [Pet Cemetery](https://modrinth.com/mod/pet-cemetery) and its addon, [Pet Necropolis](https://modrinth.com/mod/pet-necropolis) before trying Angel Collars, as these may work great for your modpack already. This mod should be used as a last resort!
</details>

All credit for the original idea and concepts goes to Team Abnormals. I highly recommend using  their mods and supporting then on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/teamabnormals/posts) if your aren't already.

_**(Make sure all pets are revived if updating from 1.20.1, as all collars will lose their data.)**_

title: Selective Keep Inventory
description: Per-player keep inventory for vanilla Minecraft. Give keep inventory to selected players only instead of the whole server.
body:
# Selective Keep Inventory

Selective Keep Inventory is a lightweight vanilla datapack for Minecraft Java Edition that enables keep inventory for specific players only.

Instead of enabling `keepInventory` for the entire world, this pack lets you choose exactly which players keep their items and XP after death.

## Features

- Per-player keep inventory
- Per-player XP retention
- Fully server-side
- Vanilla datapack, no plugin or mod required
- Supports Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.2 to 1.21.11

## How it works

Players with the `keepinv` tag keep their inventory and XP on death.

Players without the tag die normally and lose their inventory/XP as expected.

## Commands

Enable for a player:
`/tag <player> add keepinv`

Disable for a player:
`/tag <player> remove keepinv`

Example:
`/tag Steve add keepinv`

Fabric:

# Player Keep Inventory

Server-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that enables keep-inventory only for selected players.

## Command

`/keepinventory <player|selector> <on|off|toggle|status>`

Examples:

- `/keepinventory Steve on`
- `/keepinventory @a[team=vip] on`
- `/keepinventory Steve status`

## Installation

1. Put the ZIP file into your world's `datapacks` folder
2. Run `/reload`
3. Check with `/datapack list`

## Notes

This is a vanilla datapack, so it does not add a custom root command like `/keepinv on Steve`.
Use the player tag system shown above.

title: qModeling
description: qModeling is a block-based modeling mod for Minecraft with a 3D editor workflow. It adds a dedicated Workspace block with freecam editing, Move/Rotate/Scale manipulators, plus Yuushya Modeling import/export.
body:
> **qModeling** is a block-based modeling mod for Minecraft with a 3D editor workflow. It adds a dedicated Workspace block with freecam editing, Move/Rotate/Scale manipulators, BlockState and NBT support, plus Yuushya Modeling import/export.

_**Features**_

- Gizmo tools: Move (X/Y/Z axes), Rotate (axis rings), Scale (axis handles).
- Part list with block icons, selection, copy-focus, and multi-selection.
- Editing modes: Normal, Fine (0.02 step), Numeric (manual value input).
- Mirror on X/Y/Z with proper facing mirroring (west/east, north/south, up/down when the property exists).
- Visibility toggle for selected parts (◎/○).
- Transform history Undo/Redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y).
- Clipboard copy/paste.
- Export to Yuushya Modeling JSON (Y button).
- Import Yuushya JSON from clipboard.
- HEX-based UI color theming with persistence between Workspace sessions.
  
**_Controls_**

- **V** — Move
- **R** — Rotate
- **S** — Scale
- **Ctrl+Z** — Undo
- **Ctrl+Y** — Redo
- **Shift + Left Click in list** — multi-select
- **Double Left Click on list item** — copy-focus
- **X / Y / Z** — mirror by axis
- **WASD + Space + Shift** — camera flight
- **Right Mouse + drag** — look around
- **Middle Mouse + drag or hold P** — pan
- **Mouse wheel** — zoom in/out

A chaotic modpack with every mod imaginable, inspired by CrazyCraft or InsaneCraft. I want to make this modpack as stable and performant as possible, but with the large amount of mods I plan to add, I cannot guarantee that it will work well on lower-end pcs. As of now, this modpack has mostly utility related mods. I plan to update the pack with content related mods in the future. title: CS CINEMATIC
description: Advanced Minecraft camera plugin featuring unlimited positions, smooth animations, sound effects, screen shake, zoom, teleportation, and YAML-based editable cinematic files.
body:
# 🎬 CS Cinematic | Advanced Camera System
**Version: 2.0.0 | Minecraft: 1.21+**

Transform your Minecraft server with **CS Cinematic**, the ultimate tool for creating professional, smooth, and immersive camera sequences. Whether you are building a server lobby intro, a story-driven RPG cutscene, or a map trailer, CS Cinematic handles it all without requiring any client-side mods!

---

## ✨ Key Features

**📍 Unlimited Camera Positions**
Create complex camera paths with as many keyframes (positions) as you need. There is no limit to how long or detailed your cinematic can be.

**🎥 Butter-Smooth Movement**
Forget choppy teleportation! CS Cinematic uses advanced math (interpolation) to glide the player's camera smoothly between points.
*   **8 Interpolation Types:** Linear, Ease-In, Ease-Out, Smooth, Bounce, Elastic, and more.

**📝 Fully Editable YAML Files**
Every cinematic you save creates a file in `plugins/CSCinematic/cinematics/`.
*   You can edit coordinates, speed, text, and sounds manually in the file.
*   Easy to share cinematics between servers.

**🎵 Advanced Sound System**
*   **900+ Sounds:** Built-in tab completion for every Minecraft sound.
*   **Custom Sounds:** Support for resource pack sounds.
*   **Timing:** Play sounds at specific positions or global timestamps.

**💥 Immersive Visual Effects**
*   **Screen Shake:** Add intensity to explosions or dramatic moments.
*   **Zoom & FOV:** Dynamically change the Field of View for dramatic close-ups.
*   **Comedy Mode:** One command to enable fast cuts, funny shakes, and zoom effects.

**💬 Titles & Text Overlays**
Display clear titles and subtitles synced perfectly with the camera movement. Customize fade-in, stay, and fade-out times.

**⚡ Smart Player Handling**
*   **Spectator Mode:** Players are automatically switched to Spectator mode.
*   **Input Blocking:** Movement, chat, and interactions are blocked during the show.
*   **State Restoration:** When the cinematic ends, the player is returned to their original location, gamemode, and inventory exactly as they were.

---

## 🛠️ How It Works

CS Cinematic is designed to be intuitive. You don't need complex coding knowledge.

1.  **Create:** `/cs create <name>` to start a recording session.
2.  **Position:** Fly to a spot and type `/cs pos add`.
3.  **Customize:** Add a specific speed or delay: `/cs pos add 3.0 5.0`.
4.  **Spice it up:** Add a sound or text: `/cs text 1 "Welcome!"`.
5.  **Save:** `/cs save` writes everything to a file.
6.  **Play:** `/cs play <name>` to watch your masterpiece.

---

## 🎮 Command List

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/cs create <name>` | Create a new cinematic. |
| `/cs edit <name>` | Edit an existing cinematic. |
| `/cs pos add` | Add a camera point at your location. |
| `/cs pos list` | View all positions. |
| `/cs sound <id> <sound>` | Add a sound effect to a position. |
| `/cs text <id> <text>` | Add a title to a position. |
| `/cs shake <id> <amount>` | Add screen shake effect. |
| `/cs play <name>` | Play the cinematic for yourself. |
| `/cs play <name> <player>` | Force a player to watch. |
| `/cs save` | Save your work to YAML. |
| `/cs load <name>` | Load changes made in YAML files. |

---

## 📂 Configuration

The plugin is highly configurable via `config.yml`. You can set default speeds, delays, and message prefixes.

**Data Folder:** `plugins/CSCinematic/cinematics/`
*   Each cinematic gets its own `.yml` file.
*   You can copy/paste these files to back them up or share them.

---

## 🚀 Why Choose CS Cinematic?

*   **Optimized:** Lag-free performance even on 1.21+ servers.
*   **User Friendly:** Tab-completion for all commands and sounds.
*   **Professional:** Creates movie-quality transitions.
*   **Free:** Full features with no paywalls.

title: Unnamed Common Library (UCL)
description: A very simple, easy to use configuration library that fits right in your mod!
body:
English

❔ Tell me more about it

Unnamed Common Library (UCL) is my attempt at making a simple, useful, (yet to be) powerful configuration library. Its goal is to be general purpose so that no matter the mod you build or your preferences, you can always use it. This library is obviously not meant to be used on its own,if you do so it will at most serve as an example and a test for its capabilities.

🤩 Why you should like it

  • Very easy to implement and use
  • Optional configuration screen integrations
  • JSON, TOML, and YAML support

🧑‍💻 For developers

Installation

Add the repository to your build.gradle(.kts):

repositories {
    maven {
        url = "https://maven.pkg.github.com/aurorarissime/unnamed-common-library"
    }
}

And in your buildscript, add the dependency (modImplementation for Fabric, implementation for NeoForge):

dependencies {
    (mod)Implementation("from.discorde:ucl:${ucl_version}+${minecraft_version}-fabric")
}
Usage

1. Create your configuration model

MyModConfig.java

import from.discorde.ucl.common.config.annotations.*;

@Configuration(
    name = "mymod"
)
public class MyModConfig {
    @Comment("Enable the awesome feature")
    public boolean awesomeFeature = true;

    @Comment("Maximum power level (0-100)")
    public int maxPower = 50;

    @Comment("Welcome message displayed to players")
    public String welcomeMessage = "Hello!";
}

2. Load the configuration in your mod initialiser

MyMod.java

public class MyMod implements ModInitializer {
    // The wrapper class is auto-generated at compile time
    public static final MyModConfigWrapper CONFIG = MyModConfigWrapper.createAndLoad();

    @Override
    public void onInitialize() {
        if (CONFIG.awesomeFeature) {
            System.out.println("Awesome feature is enabled!");
        }
    }
}
References

Annotations

@Configuration

Add this annotation right above your config class

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description | |------------|-------------------------|----------------|-----------------------------| | `name` | `String` | *required* | Config file or folder name | | `location` | `ConfigurationLocation` | `SUBDIRECTORY` | Where to save the config | | `format` | `ConfigurationFormat` | `JSON5` | File format to use | | `screen` | `boolean` | `true` | Generate YACL config screen |

@Comment

Add this annotation above any field to include a comment in the config file

@Comment("This comment will appear above the field in the config file")
public boolean myOption = true;

Enums

ConfigurationLocation

| Value | Description | |----------------|------------------------------------------------------| | `ROOT` | Save directly in the config folder as `{name}.{ext}` | | `SUBDIRECTORY` | Save in a subfolder as `{name}/configuration.{ext}` |

ConfigurationFormat

| Value | Extension | Description | |---------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------| | `JSON5` | `.json5` | JSON with comments, trailing commas, and unquoted keys | | `TOML` | `.toml` | Tom's Obvious Minimal Language | | `YAML` | `.yaml` | YAML Ain't Markup Language |
Configuration screens integration

If screen = true (default) in your @Configuration annotation and YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) is installed, a configuration screen will be auto-generated and accessible through Mod Menu.
To disable the config screen, just set the screen parameter to false in the @Configuration annotation.

Enjoy 🙂

title: No More Drop
description: Any block mined in the game will not drop an item!
body:
# No More Drop

**No More Drop** turns your Minecraft survival into a minimalist masterpiece! Break any block, and *nothing* drops-no items, no clutter, just pure challenge. Can you conquer the game with no resources from blocks? **Yes, you can still beat the game!**

## Features

- **No Drops, No Problem**: Break any block (stone, dirt, ore) and get *nothing* in return, forcing creative survival strategies.
- **Vanilla-Friendly**: Works seamlessly with vanilla Minecraft and most other mods.
- **Server-Side**: Only the server (or the player hosting the world) needs the mod installed-ideal for multiplayer survival twists!

## Why Play?

This mod is for players who want a brutal, resource-scarce survival experience. Whether you're a speedrunner pushing your limits or a survivalist craving a fresh challenge, **No More Drop** strips Minecraft down to its core, making every decision critical. Can you beat the Ender Dragon with no block drops?

## Try This Too!

Want more chaos? Check out **[Random Break](https://modrinth.com/project/ndpMbtrJ)**, a mod that makes every block drop a *completely random item*, turning every break into a wild surprise!

description: A small, open-source minigame system for minecraft servers.
body:
![CmbMinigamesBanner.png](https://github.com/29cmb/CmbMinigames/blob/master/docs/images/CmbMinigamesBanner.png?raw=true)

# Cmb Minigames
An open source minecraft plugin for playing a variety of minigames with your friends

A video demo can be found [here](https://youtu.be/MwLLYsCOvPg)

## Minigames
- Manhunt
    - Players pick if they want to be a runner or a hunter using the `/runner` and `/hunter` commands
    - Once the game starts after 30 seconds, runners will be placed into survival and put at the world spawn
    - After another 15 seconds, hunters are also put into survival and put at world spawn
    - Hunters win if they kill all the runners
    - Runners win if they kill the ender dragon
    - Hunters have unlimited lives, and runners will be ELIMINATED if they die
- Block Shuffle
    - Players are assigned a block every 5 minutes
    - Everyone must obtain and stand on their assigned block before the timer runs out
    - If you do not find your block in time you will be ELIMINATED
- Death Swap
    - Every 7 minutes, players will be swapped with one another
    - The goal of the game is to kill the other players and be the last man standing
    - If you die, you will be ELIMINATED
- Death Shuffle
    - This minigame is very similar to block shuffle
    - Every 5 minutes you will be assigned a source of death
    - Everyone must die to that source before the timer runs out
    - If you do not die by the proper source, you will be ELIMINATED

title: Jen's modpack
description: Lots of tech, magic, farming, exploration. Exists mainly for a private server.
body:
A modpack for a private SMP server that I generally run for a few months per year and then delete. It's not that I don't like running it, it's just that I'm friends with a lot of people who lose interest in Minecraft servers after a month or so.

The main purpose of this modpack is to include as many mods that my friends have requested as possible. Most of the popular modpacks are missing at least one of the major technology and exploration mods that this one includes, so this may be useful if you also want a slightly silly number of mods. On the other hand, the popular modpacks may well be better tested and more actively maintained.

Version 2.0.0 runs well with 8 GB memory allocation, and has rare problems with 3 GB; I haven't narrowed down what it requires any more specifically than that.

The modpack includes an in-game guidebook which lists the major mods included and gives some information about how to get started with each of them. It includes crafting recipes for in-game mod guides, links to mod webpages and wikis, and overviews of the basic functionality of some mods.

The update schedule for this will generally be:
- A new major version that is not in any way backwards compatible sometime in December or January.
- Minor bug fix versions for any serious issues found in the two months or so after a new version is released.
- Complete and total neglect for the rest of the year.

All the included mods are available through Modrinth, so you can see a full list by looking at a specific version of the modpack.

title: Discord Invite
description: Simple minecraft plugin that allows server owners to provide access to their discord server in a controlled manner.
body:
This plugin provides server owners with a simple method of linking their users to their discord server.

The plugin provides two commands.

/setdiscord <link>

/discord

**setdiscord** is given to OP by default, its associated permission node is **discordinvite.admin**

**discord** is given to everyone by default, its associated permission node is **discordinvite.invite**

Changes made to the link are logged in the history.txt file, in the plugin folder.

title: Celestial Equipment
description: Celestial Equipment is a tool and armor mod. However, this mod was made for the JustVanilla ModPack. This mod still provides custom ore generation along with tools and armor!
body:
Celestial Equipment
Made By VO!DED


Embark on an epic adventure with the Celestial Equipment Mod, a comprehensive expansion that brings a touch of the cosmos to Minecraft. This mod introduces a new dimension of customization and power with the addition of Celestial-themed gear and items, crafted from the rare and mystical Celestium resources.

Key Features:

Celestial Materials: Discover and mine Celestium Ore, a rare resource that allows you to craft powerful Celestial Equipment. Celestium is found deep underground and can be processed into ingots, blocks, and more.

Celestial Armor and Tools: Equip yourself with Celestial Armor and Tools, each crafted from Celestium Ingots. These items offer superior durability and special attributes to help you conquer the toughest challenges Minecraft has to offer.

Unique Recipes: Utilize custom crafting and smelting recipes to create Celestial Rods, Celestial Blocks, and other unique items. The mod also features new recipes for upgrading Netherite gear into Celestial gear using special templates and ingots.

Celestial Blocks: Transform your surroundings with Celestial Blocks and Raw Celestial Blocks. These blocks add a new layer of aesthetic and functional possibilities to your builds.

Enhanced World Generation: Explore the world with new ore generation features. Celestium Ore spawns in deepslate layers, there's also a unique Celestial Gravel, have fun finding it.

Crafting and Upgrades: Use the Celestial Upgrade Template to enhance your equipment, and explore new crafting options that integrate seamlessly with Minecraft’s existing systems.

VOIDED. All Rights Reserved.

# The Legendary Enchantments Datapack
Adds 8 new enchantments.
Some can be obtained by trading with villagers, others by killing mobs, through enchantment tables, or from bosses.

Summon an Ice Illusioner by throwing a book, a lapis lazuli, and an ice block onto the same spot.
### The enchantments are:
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- **Blast:** Launches the opponent high into the air.
 
- **Extendium:** Increases the mining range of pickaxes and axes.
 
- **Freeze:** Freezes the opponent for a short time, making them immobile. Costs 5 levels.
 
- **Lava Walker:** Gives you the ability to walk on lava.
  
- **Lightning:** Strikes lightning on your enemies.
  
- **Range:** Increases attack range.
  
- **Shrink:** Makes you smaller.
  
- **Velocity:** Reduces the attack cooldown.
  
</details>

title: Traveler's Muse
description: A simple modpack focused on saturating the adventures you embark on, through non-invasive Vanilla-like mods.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a3f9da5b85e5d045735f8b1e5fbcc82b779d471.png)A simple modpack focused on saturating the adventures you embark on, through non-invasive Vanilla-like mods.

This modpack has been compiled to offer a more immersive and exciting way of discovering the world of Minecraft. Not only does this pack have mods that improve the visuals of the game, but it also features mods that improve how you explore and traverse the environment. Most mods have highly configurable setting menus and allow extensive customization tailored to every playstyle and experience.

The pack features mods like "Traveler's Backpack" and "Realistic Campfires", turning your trips from point A to point B into something much more intriguing, rather than them feeling like boring chores. When surrounded by nature you can experience high-quality soundscapes provided by mods such as "Ambient Sounds" and "Sound Physics Remastered". At night, the sky lights up with beautiful stars, while the monsters emerge from the ground as seen in the mods "Astrocraft" and "Spawn Animations".

All in all, the pack aims to make Minecraft feel more alive and real, while not adding ridiculous amounts of new blocks and items. I hope you enjoy this pack, however you want.
