title: Rubik's Craft Elected Life
description: A customisable One Life solution.
body:
# Rubik's Craft Elected Life Data Pack



**Rubik's Craft Elected Life Data Pack** allows you to experience a game based off One Life!
Customise your sessions in new and interesting ways, including effects, gamemodes, and utilities!

## Features

 ### Unique Gamemodes
*All our gamemodes are stackable so you can have all or none of the extra effects enabled.*
- **Three Lives** - Players get given three lives.
- **No Bookshelves** - Bookshelves are removed from the world, including in structures.
- **No Anvils** - Anvils are removed from the world, including in structures.
- **No Helmets** - Players cannot equip anything to their head.
##### ... And many more!

### User Interface
*No more confusing code, all our functions are controlled in-game.*
- **Book Selections** - Customise your game how you want it, with easy to use toggles in-game using written books.
- **Share Your Selections** - Send your selections to the in-game chat so all players can see what's on, and what's not!
- **Scoreboard Info** - World border size and other key information displayed in the sidebar.

## Set Up
Set up is extremely easy! Drag, drop and play!
<details>
<summary>Installation Guide</summary>

How to Install:
1. Create a Minecraft world.
2. Add in the Data Pack.
3. Join the world and run /reload.
4. In the books given to you, under "Main Controls", select "Set Up".
5. Customise the game using the other books, and select "start" when done.

</details>

## Version Control
We use the following version control system:
- **+1.0.0** - For each new GUI reconfiguration.
- **+0.1.0** - For each new gamemode/customisation.
- **+0.0.1** - For each new fix/tweak update of an existing gamemode/customisation.

*We will only ever update the latest version of this data pack with changes. Therefore, we can only look at bugs/issues that currently effect the latest version of this project.*

## Credits
- Isman21 - Creative Team
- Pat_Nat - Creative Team

# OpenBucket
**Allows for almost infinite space in buckets for lava and water!**

## Features:​
- Bucket can hold a **configurable** amount of water:
    - Water can be collected and placed in the world, cauldrons and waterlogged blocks.
    - Permission: openbucket.use.waterbucket
- Bucket can hold a **configurable** amount of lava:
    - Lava can be collected and placed in the world and cauldrons.
    - Permission: openbucket.use.lavabucket
- The use as lava bucket and water bucket can be individually disabled in the config all together or by giving players the permissions above.
- Currently you **can't** use the lava bucket as fuel in furnaces, the bucket to collect water after smelting a wet sponge, milk cows or capture fish and axolotls.

* All texts can be customized in the config file!
* Command: /openbucket
    * Gives you an open bucket
    * Permission: openbucket.admin.give

[Default config.yml](https://github.com/ttryy/OpenBucket/blob/master/src/main/resources/config.yml)

## More to come... (you got any ideas? let me know!)

title: Custom Book Author
description: Change the author and name of written books
body:
Discord: The Quin Studios community hub, and semi-regular news
Instagram: Texture-by-texture progress for my resource pack, Immersion, and general Quin Studios news
Patreon: In-depth update and development progress posts for large projects

If you like my work, please consider supporting me on Patreon

About

This datapack allows you to customize and change the author and title of a written book. Supports Minecraft versions 1.18+.

To change the author name of a book, just follow these steps:


     1. Take a Book and Quill, and rename it to "Author" with an anvil.

     2. On the first page, write the author name, however you want it to display.

     3. Put the named book and quill in your offhand, and open a written book that you want to change the author of.

     4. And voila, you're done! The new author name should now display properly.


You can change book titles with this same method, only using a book and quill named "Title" instead of "Author". This method can be used to overcome the vanilla character limit for book titles, allowing you to now make books with titles potentially stretching even beyond the edges of your screen.

Installation

New World:


     1. Select Data Packs in the world creation menu (in 1.19.4+, select the More tab at the top of the screen first)

     2. Drag and drop the download into the Minecraft window, then select Yes to add the pack

     3. Click the arrow on the pack icon to load the pack, and then select Done

     4. Load and play your world


Existing World:


     1. Navigate to your world folder. You can open it from the worlds menu by selecting your world, Edit,
         and then Open World Folder

     2. Go into the datapacks folder, and move the download there

     3. Load your world

     4. Type /reload


Note that if you are installing the datapack into a pre-existing world, you will need to temporarily enable cheats in order to reload the datapack. Cheats do not need to be enabled after reloading, and are not necessary for new worlds.

title: Bundled Up
description: Simply allows you to access Bundles either in creative tab or crafting tables.
body:
As the title says, this mod allows you to access the Bundles like how you can do in the newer snapshots.


In case you don't know, Bundle is an item that allows you to store as many item types as you want in a single inventory slot. This doesn't increase the capacity, however. It can store up to 64 items. Items with smaller maximum stack size will cost more slots in a Bundle to store, Ender Pearls, for example, will take 4(64 / 16) slots to store a single item.


This mod almost do that perfectly, not gonna lie. You can find it in your creative inventory, crafting tables. If it isn't perfect, just tell me how and we can get a step closer to it!
Also, this mod is completely optional on either client or server!

body:
This Datapack adds thirteen advancements (two of which are hidden).

Each advancement comes with a reward banner as a sort of trophy, these banners are not craftable in vanilla survival due to having more than six layers. 

![A screenshot of all the Reward Banners in-game; the A Jack Of All Trees banner depicts a tree with a gnarled twisting truck, the Dedicated Gardener banner depicts vines with splashes of colour, the Bow Before Me banner depicts a sun emblem and a grey background with gold stitches, The Nether's Champion banner is a design invoking flames, The Ocean's Champion banner depicts a Turtle Shell underwater, the For The Record banner depicts a Music Disc designed not to look like any particular in-game disc, the Smited banner depicts Lightning, the Knight of the Realm banner depicts a shield with a golden metal centre, the All-terrain Expert banner attempts to incorporate it's four relevant environments, the Titan Slayer banner depicts a dark monster breaking through a stone wall, the Indiana Jones banner Depicts what is best described as a temple in a forest and finally, the Being Sneaky Are You banner depicts a white potion particle on a blue background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54cb01560cf0ba89c128a6a23fec3e49b81f8361.png)

The reward for the 'An Acquired Taste' advancement is a Bundle containing Music Discs with songs which you can't normally play in a jukebox in Survival. (including Alpha, Chrysopoeia, Dragon Fish, Wet Hands, pokopoko & more).

This Datapack uses the jukebox_song experimental setting, any custom Music Discs lose their sound events (which is what makes them play different songs) when the Datapack is uninstalled.

title: BetterFishing
description: A completely redesigned and improved fishing system. It makes fishing more fun and offers various stages.
body:
![hellomessage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b4d98addb584b0d5d3f152eb429a25f5f7e0a35_0.webp)
   _BetterFishing completely eliminates the slow, repetitive "wait-and-click" mechanic of vanilla Minecraft. Say goodbye to the boring waiting game; every cast is now a skill-based, high-stakes minigame packed with rewards and progression._
> 


![key](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc5196c88e5618bf790908460dfe0ffd34839f6a_0.webp)

- You can access the menu using the **/fish** command. 

- **Action-Bar Minigame:** As soon as a fish bites, hit the Green Zone to secure your catch. Miss it, and the fish gets away!
  
- **Perfect Catches:** Lock in the exact center (|) to trigger a "Critical Shot"—granting +10% Extra Weight and 2x XP.

![catching fish](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9811a4e7c979350fb14187906236801d0c9cd181.png)

- **Dynamic Scaling:** No hard level caps! Everyone has a chance, but as your Fishing Level climbs, your mathematical odds of pulling Epic and Legendary monsters skyrocket.
  
- **Treasures & Lockpicking:** Occasionally hook a Treasure Chest instead of a fish. Pass the minigame 3 times in a row to unlock massive payouts or rare loot!
  
- **Advanced Rod Upgrades:** Spend your earnings to slow down the cursor, widen the Green Zone, or boost your treasure find rate.

- **Zone Efficiency:** When too many fish are caught in an area, that area's productivity starts to decrease. This system encourages the player to be active and prevents AFK.

- **Special Feeds:** Using specialized baits can lead to better fish catches.

- **PlaceholderAPI Support:** Display levels, XP, and record holders directly on your scoreboards, holograms, or chat.

![explore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19feab597b92566c2acee85f092b005914c7a35a_0.webp)
- _How about exploring the fish? The catalog will always help you with that._
- _Some fish can only be caught under specific conditions._
![Explore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2c58e714c01452d000fa61c3017fc337b5aadac.png)

_**NOTE: If you want to activate fish sales, you must use Vault or VaultUnlocked!**_

### _Supported Languages_
- English AND Turkish (It is configured in Config.yml.)

### Placeholder API is supported!

```
%betterfishing_top_level_1_name% (This is used for player level ranking. You can create the ranking by changing the number.)
%betterfishing_level% (Player's current fishing level)
%betterfishing_xp% (Current experience points gained to advance to the next level)
%betterfishing_heaviest_caught% (The heaviest fish the player has personally caught so far)
```
**There is also a dedicated developer API available. Check out the API on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/AsrJXW2cSM) server for deeper integrations!**

body:
# Auto Totem ### By [Kanax01](https://github.com/Kanax01) A simple auto totem mod for Minecraft.
## What it does - Automatically replaces spent totems in your offhand and also can be set to do mainhand too - Adds gapple bind so when u right click on a tool it swaps the offhand or mainhand totem with a gapple to eat and then switches back - Different modes for better results on different servers ## Requirements - Minecraft Java Edition 26.1.2 - [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) ## Installation Drop the `.jar` into your `.minecraft/mods` folder. ## Modes - **Regular** — Only replaces the totem in your offhand - **Legit** — Swaps to a hotbar totem when health is low and replenishes both hands ## Utils - **Damage Predict** — Equips a totem in dangerous situations if totem not on and in legit mode it double hands - **Gapple Bind** — Swaps your offhand with a gapple when holding a selected item and uses it - **Gapple Bind Main** — Swaps the selected item in your main hand with a gapple for quick use ## Misc - Adjustable delay - Hide totem pop animation - Hide totem particles ## Configuration Settings can be configured in-game via [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/mod-menu). | Setting | Description | Default | |---|---|---| | Mode | Regular or Legit mode | Regular | | Legit Health Threshold | Health where Legit mode refills hotbar totems | 10 | | Damage Predict | Auto equip totem in dangerous situations | Off | | Danger Threshold | Effective health threshold for danger checks | 10 | | Gapple Bind | Enable gapple bind | Off | | Gapple Bind Main | Enable main hand gapple bind | Off | | Gapple Trigger | Item type required to activate gapple bind | Sword | | Swap Delay | Delay between swaps in ms | 15 | | Hide Animation | Hide the totem pop animation | Off | | Hide Particles | Hide totem pop particles | Off |

description: Create with addons and Quality of Life features.
body:
Gamingecke Create 2026 is a comprehensive tech and building modpack centered around the Create mod. It combines complex automation, immersive engineering, and breathtaking world generation with essential performance and quality-of-life tweaks for a smooth, highly engaging Minecraft experience.

### Features
- **Engineering and Automation:** The heart of the pack. With Create and its many addons, you'll construct sprawling machinery, design complex train networks using Steam 'n' Rails and Railways Navigator, generate power via Diesel Generators and Crafts & Additions, extract resources with Ore Excavation, and automate everything from food processing (Central Kitchen, Slice & Dice, Confectionery, Bitterballen) to experience management through the Enchantment Industry.
- **Technology and Logic:** Keep your factories running precisely with advanced redstone circuits via Project Red Transmission and fully programmable computers thanks to CC: Tweaked.
- **Building and Decoration:** Give your industrial empire a personality. Create Deco, Interiors, Copycats+, Vibrant Vaults, and Bells & Whistles offer a wealth of architectural options to make every build your own.
- **World Generation:** Tectonic delivers breathtaking, completely overhauled landscapes, while the YUNG's Better series breathes fresh life into familiar vanilla structures.
- **Performance:** Even the most complex contraptions run smoothly, thanks to Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, FerriteCore, and Dynamic FPS keeping framerates stable and servers healthy.
- **Immersive Atmosphere:** Shaders give the world a stunning visual overhaul, while Sound Physics Remastered and Create: Sound of Steam add realistic acoustics and authentic mechanical audio to round out the experience.
- **Navigation and Mapping:** Xaero's Maps makes exploration effortless, and Distant Horizons pushes your view distance far enough to take in your factories and Tectonic's landscapes in their full scale.
- **Information and Claiming:** JEI keeps even the most complex recipes manageable, Jade provides detailed block and entity information at a glance, Lighty highlights mob-spawnable areas, and Open Parties and Claims keeps your hard-built factories safe from unwanted visitors.
- **Quality of Life:** Sophisticated Backpacks, Inventory Essentials, and Mouse Tweaks make managing your inventory a breeze. Carry On lets you relocate functional blocks with ease, Zoomify gives you precise zoom control, and Not Enough Animations adds a layer of polish to character movement.
- **Communication and Social Features:** Simple Voice Chat enables direct in-game voice communication, Chat Heads makes it easier to identify who's talking in chat, and Sit lets players kick back and relax between build sessions.
- **Utilities:** Auto Reconnect Reforged automatically reconnects you to the server after a disconnection, so you can get back to building without the hassle of logging in again.

### Notes

- It's recommended to increase the amount of allocated memory, otherwise Distant Horizons may display warnings.
- Created for [Gamingecke.space](https://discord.gamingecke.space/) but available to anyone seeking a expanded Create experience.

title: Vibrant Lights
description: Removes block shading from light source blocks only, effectively rendering them full-bright for a more realistic vivid pop.
body:
A simple resource pack that removes the default block shading from _only_ light blocks.

Block shading adds a darkening effect to the sides of blocks to mimic directional light. However, this should not apply for actual sources of light. This pack sets `"shade": false` on all affected models.

Popular packs such as _Shadify_ remove shading from ALL blocks, so this pack would have no effect if combined with them. Vibrant Lights only affects light blocks themselves, ensuring they will always be the brightest element in the scene.

Blocks tweaked:
- Beacon
- Copper Bulb (all lit variations)
- End Rod
- Froglight (all variations)
- Glowstone
- Lantern (all variations)
- Nether Portal texture
- Redstone Lamp (lit)
- Sea Lantern
- Shroomlight

# Overview **Clue Scroll HUD** is a lightweight client-side mod for the [**Vulengate**](https://www.vulengate.com/) Minecraft server that displays your clue scroll objectives and progress directly on the in-game HUD. No more opening your inventory and hovering over items to check your tasks!

# Features - 📜 Automatically detects clue scrolls in your inventory. - 🔍 Displays your scroll tiers, objectives, and progress directly on the HUD. - ✅ Tracks task progress in real-time and highlights completed clues. - ⏰ Shows time remaining before scrolls expire. # Dependencies This mod has the following hard dependencies: - [Fabric Loader & API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) This mod also has an optional dependency on the [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) mod.

# Minecraft Bingo Be the first team to collect all required `items`, `mobs` and `advancements` to win the game! ![Bingo Goals Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1f3a00884f50236abcce1b8d85952373779c229.png)
![Scoreboard Goal Types with Icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2c56d715887ef27d65288ae12a6af848350c1f5.png)
Minecraft Bingo lets you and your friends play a game of bingo in Minecraft. Players are divided into teams and must collect all randomly selected items, mobs and advancements to win. The mod is highly configurable and can be adjusted to suit different playing styles. The mod is designed to be played on a multiplayer server, but can also be played without a server. ## Getting Started 1. [Install Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) 2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and put it in the mods folder 3. Download Minecraft Bingo from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-bingo/versions) and put it in the mods folder 4. (Optional - but highly recommended) Use the [Minecraft Bingo Resource Pack](https://github.com/170yt/Minecraft-Bingo-Resource-Pack) ## Commands - `/bingo` or `/b` - Opens the bingo GUI, that shows all items to collect - `/bingo teams` - Opens the team selection GUI - `/bingo settings` - `OP` Opens the settings GUI - `/bingo start` - `OP` Starts a new bingo game with the current settings - `/bingo stop` - `OP` Stops the current bingo game - `/bingo pause` - `OP` Pauses the current bingo game - `/bingo resume` - `OP` Resumes the current bingo game - `/bingo reset ` - `OP` Stops the server and resets the world with a new seed. The random string at the end is used to prevent accidental resets - `/top` - Teleports you to the surface (or to the world spawn if you are in the nether or the end) - `/backpack` or `/bp` or `/ec` - Opens the team backpack ## Teams ![Team Selection](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5703a0e873f093d37af478fc636b00df66b1f8a0.png)
Players can join a team by using the `/bingo teams` command.
Team Management for OPs Teams in Bingo are managed using the standard Minecraft team system. All teams used by Bingo are automatically created and managed by the mod (nine different teams are used). OPs can use the vanilla `/team` command to manage the players in the teams. The following commands are available: - `/team join []` - `OP` Joins the specified team - `/team leave ` - `OP` Leaves the team
## Settings The settings are automatically saved between rounds so you do not have to reconfigure them every time.
![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/736bc10bb49ddacfa9bb9ce71693ef3e031ecf87.png)
All available settings from top left to bottom right: - `PvP` - Enable player vs player combat - `No Damage` - Players do not take damage - `No Hunger` - Players do not lose hunger - `Keep Inventory` - Keep inventory on death - `Allow Flying` - Enable creative flight for all players - `Block Break Speed` - Multiplier for block break speed - `Movement Speed` - Multiplier for movement speed (including swimming) - `Step Height` - Additional step height - `Command Top` - Enable the `/top` command - `Team Backpack` - Enable team backpacks (`/backpack`) - `Goal Amount` - The amount of items, mobs and advancements each team needs to collect - `Goal Type: Items` - Enable items as goals - `Goal Type: Mobs` - Enable mobs as goals - `Goal Type: Advancements` - Enable advancements as goals - Enable/Disable up to 18 Pools (see [Pools](#Pools)) - `Stop Game` - Stops the current game and shows the leaderboard - `Pause/Resume Game` - Pauses or resumes the current game - `Start Game` - Starts a new game with the current settings ## Icons ![Scoreboard with Icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a761ce036ca50338c693d4425af69bdb2e8a870.png)
The scoreboard can display icons for each goal. For this to work, the player (client) needs to have the [Minecraft Bingo Resource Pack](https://github.com/170yt/Minecraft-Bingo-Resource-Pack) installed.
For instructions on how to install the resource pack, see [Minecraft Bingo Resource Pack](https://github.com/170yt/Minecraft-Bingo-Resource-Pack). ## Pools Pools are used to group goals into different categories. Each pool contains a set of items, mobs and advancements that can be selected as goals. Each pool has a config file that can be modified to add or remove goals. You can also create your own custom pools by creating a new config file in the `config/bingo/pools` folder. There you will also find the existing pool config files that you can modify. Bingo comes with the following pools by default: ### Overworld Easy Requires little to no traveling and can be completed in a short amount of time.
Most goals are related to mining, crafting and fighting.
Includes: Coal, Iron, Copper ### Overworld Medium Requires a decent amount of traveling and caving.
Some trading might be helpful to complete the goals.
Includes: Gold, Redstone, Emerald, Lapislazuli, Diamond ### Overworld Hard Requires a lot of traveling.
Includes: advanced Trading, Silk Touch, basic Nether, Bees ### Nether Playable fully in the nether.
Excludes extreme items, like nether stars and armor trims. ### End Playable fully in the end.
Starting gear is recommended for end only. ### Extreme The hardest items from all dimensions.
Includes: dyed Shulker Boxes, aged Copper Variants, Trial Chambers, Beacons ## FAQ - **I see weird textures in the bingo goals inventory and the scoreboard. What can I do?**
![Bingo Goals Inventory without Resource Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1b4ce72e1fcf7f901b5c5ab6ab6f8b4d92d69b3.png)
![Scoreboard without Resource Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c03b63f1649e8ed75d965f158ec844382d0e5de9.png)
You need to install the [Minecraft Bingo Resource Pack](https://github.com/170yt/Minecraft-Bingo-Resource-Pack). - **Do I need to install the mod on the client side?**
No, the mod is server-side only and does not require the client to have it installed if it's already installed on the server.
The mod is designed to be played on a server with vanilla clients and does not require any client-side mods.

title: TrueEssentials
description: A feature-rich alternative to the popular yet junk-filled EssentialsX
body:
Ever grown tired of the junk that EssentialsX provides that overrides vanilla Minecraft commands? With TrueEssentials, that problem is no longer there.

# Why choose TrueEssentials over Essentials?
Compared to EssentialsX, TrueEssentials is:

✅ More compact and optimized than EssentialsX (150kb vs ~4.5mb)

✅ Packed with most of the core features EssentialsX provides, removing most of the junk
 
✅ Easily configurable via a simple YAML configuration file

# Features
### ✅ PlaceholderAPI support (or simple built-in placeholders)
### ✅ Legacy chat color + Mini message support
### ✅ Classic EssentialsX commands (gamemode shortcuts, flight, etc)
### ✅ Command hider/spoofer extension
### ✅ Spawn extension
### ✅ Customizable splash screen on join (title/subtitle customization)
### ✅ Custom join, new join and quit messages
### ✅ Custom chat format
### ✅ Homes extension
### ✅ Customizable & easy-to-use moderation tools
### ...with MORE coming soon!


# What is TrueEssentials?
These days EssentialsX is filled with various "utility" commands which are mostly never used and override vanilla ones. Using this plugin, you only get the basics and you can toggle more features to your liking! This allows you to have the perfect core plugin, to your liking, without missing out on features **YOU** might consider important.

Essentially (pun intended), TrueEssentials is a core utility plugin for your server, packed with useful commands such as gamemode shortcuts (gmc, gms, etc), basic moderation utilities such as /invsee (more coming soon!), and other useful features your server might need.

# Bug reports
Click [here](https://github.com/Nebulations/TrueEssentials/issues) to create a bug report (issue)
Feel free to join the discord server (on the right!) for more extensive support.

# Placeholder support
This plugin has simple built-in placeholders, but using PlaceholderAPI is strongly recommended for the full experience.

# Message formatting
For all messages, [Mini Message formatting](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format) and [Legacy Color Codes](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Formatting_codes) are supported.

# Metrics & data collections
Starting with version 1.1, TrueEssentials will collect anonymous statistics including the number of servers running TrueEssentials, the number of players, etc. using bStats, an open-source statistics service for Minecraft software. You can opt out in /plugins/bStats/config.yml. You can check out bStats' website [here](https://bstats.org/).

![Servers using TrueEssentials & players online](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/TrueEssentials.svg)

# What is planned in the future?
1. ~~Moderation utilities extension (bans, warns, etc)~~ Added in 1.1
2. Economy extension
3. Discord X Minecraft chat extension
4. Item editing extension
5. Chat filter extension

title: ServerLinks
description: A Bukkit plugin shows your server links in the client pause screen.
body:
# ServerLinks
Show your server links in the client pause screen.  
It is the new features in 1.21, but not disclosed in vanilla.  

Now supported both Velocity and Spigot (and its forks).  

## Requirements
- Minecraft >= 1.21
- Spigot only
  - ProtocolLib >= 5.1.0

## Configurations

### Spigot
File name: `config.yml`

```yaml
server-links:
  # Client known types:
  # BUG_REPORT, COMMUNITY_GUIDELINES, SUPPORT, STATUS, FEEDBACK, COMMUNITY, WEBSITE, FORUMS, NEWS, ANNOUNCEMENTS
  - type: WEBSITE
    url: "https://github.com/MeowCraftMC/ServerLinks"
  # Custom type with text
  # Supports formatting codes (like &a) and hex colors (&#66ccff).
  - type: CUSTOM
    text: "&6Custom text"
    url: "https://www.example.com"
```

### Velocity
File name: `config.conf`

```hocon
server-links=[
    {
        type=WEBSITE
        url="https://github.com/MeowCraftMC/ServerLinks"
    },
    {
        label="&bCustom example.com"
        url="https://www.example.com"
    }
]
```

## Command & Permissions

### Spigot
Use `/serverlinks reload` to reload the config.

- `serverlinks.admin`: For admins who can reload the config.
- `serverlinks.user`: For users who can see these links.

### Velocity
Use `/velocity reload` to reload the config.  
No permissions provided.

title: Origins: Verdant Crown
description: A symbiotic peacekeeper left to rust away in the ruins of the Verdant Kingdom. It excels at mitigating conflict with powerful crowd control abilities and a 'safety cannon'.
body:
_"...…we remain, and they do not. My first brother, the Verdant crown, was designed to be necessarily capable of enforcing peace and compliance, in line with the values Verdancy had come to symbolise post-standardization. It was publicly beloved by Verdant citizens, due to its competence in imposing such positive outlooks. However…"_

🟢 Restraint: Targets restrained by the Verdant crown would be significantly slowed, with both their damage dealt and damage taken halved. In this state, targets would spread their restraint to nearby entities, but would be completely freed if the crown was not in close proximity.

🟩 HLSC: The hard light safety cannon implanted in the Verdant crown's body allowed it to restrain threats at a distance. The cannon had to be charged for a considerable amount of time before it could fire, a process that would rapidly drain the crown's internal charge.

🟩 Sanction: In order to selectively restrain threats, the Verdant crown was able to sanction unrestrained entities. Sanctioned entities could not be restrained by any source other than a direct HLSC shot, which was the only way to lift a sanction.

🟩 Restraint Drone: The crown was capable of projecting drones that, while energized, would act as conduits to keep entities restrained even while the crown was out of their range. When first created, a drone would be automatically sanctioned. To remove this sanction and energize the drone, the crown had to shoot them with the HLSC and provide 160 post-standard experience units (PSX).

🟢 Symbiotic Sustainability: The hard light projectors that powered the Verdant crown could only be recharged by siphoning energy from nearby restrained entities. When at maximum energy, the crown's 'safety inhibitors' would reduce its damage output by 25%. When below maximum charge, these inhibitors would deactivate, but the crown would be completely unable to heal.

🟢 Verdant Roots: After its termination, the Verdant crown was left to rust in the buried ruins of an ancient village, awaiting the day it could awaken once more.

🟢 Pearlescent Archives: All three crowns possessed the ability to interface with the Pearlescent Archives from anywhere within the Pearlescent realm, provided they had a suitable antenna.

Whether you want to disable overpowered items, create unique challenges, or guide players toward a specific progression path, CraftDisable provides the essential tools to do so with ease.

---

## ✨ Features

-   **⚙️ Intuitive In-Hand Commands:** Quickly disable or re-enable the craft for any item you are holding. No need to look up item IDs!
-   **📁 Centralized Config Management:** Manage a clean, simple list of all disabled items directly in `config.yml`. Perfect for managing dozens of items.
-   **🛡️ Bypass Permission:** Grant trusted players or ranks the `craftdisable.bypass` permission to allow them to craft anything, ignoring all restrictions.
-   **💬 Customizable Player Messages:** Every message, from the plugin's prefix to the craft denial notice, is fully translatable and customizable in the config.
-   **🤫 Silent Mode:** Choose whether players receive a notification when they attempt to craft a disabled item. Perfect for creating a seamless experience where some items just seem "uncraftable".
-   **⚡ Admin-Friendly Tools:** Includes a `/craftdisable reload` command to apply config changes instantly and a `/craftdisable list` command to see all disabled items in-game.
-   **💡 Tab-Completion:** All commands feature intuitive tab-completion to make management fast and error-free.

---

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

The main command is `/craftdisable`, with aliases `/cd` and `/craftd`.
All management commands require the permission `craftdisable.admin`.

| Command             | Description                                           | Permission             |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| `/cd disable`       | Disables the craft of the item in your main hand.     | `craftdisable.admin`   |
| `/cd enable`        | Re-enables the craft of the item in your main hand.   | `craftdisable.admin`   |
| `/cd list`          | Shows a list of all currently disabled items.         | `craftdisable.admin`   |
| `/cd reload`        | Reloads the plugin's configuration file.              | `craftdisable.admin`   |

**Bypass Permission:**
-   `craftdisable.bypass` - Allows a player to craft items that are on the disabled list.

---

## 🔧 Configuration

The configuration is designed to be straightforward and easy to understand. You can quickly add items to the `disabled-items` list and toggle player notifications.

**Example `config.yml`:**
```yaml
# General plugin settings
settings:
  # Set to true to send a message to the player when they try to craft a disabled item.
  # Set to false for a "silent" block.
  send-craft-denied-message: true

# A list of items that are disabled from crafting.
# Use Bukkit Material names.
disabled-items:
  - "TNT"
  - "ENCHANTED_GOLDEN_APPLE"
  - "DIAMOND_BLOCK"

# All messages sent by the plugin are fully translatable.
messages:
  prefix: "&8[&cCraftDisable&8] &r"
  craft-is-disabled: "&cSorry, crafting this item (&e{item}&c) is disabled on this server."
  # ... and many more!

DANDYCORP Cobblemon Additions

DANDYCORP Cobblemon Additions is the required core mod for The DANDYCORP Pack, packed with exciting features to enhance your Cobblemon experience. Whether you're shiny hunting, managing resources, or diving into post-game content, this mod brings fresh systems and tools to keep your gameplay engaging.

Currently available for Fabric 1.20.1, with plans to break down some features into standalone mods, allowing you to mix and match your experience across multiple versions.

Features

The Grinder and Vendor

  • Introduces the DANDYCORP Industrial Grinder, a machine that converts items into Tickets, a new in-game currency.
  • Use Tickets to purchase rare items, resources, and unique collectibles from the DANDYCORP Vendor.
  • Items are assigned point values using a configurable recursive algorithm, letting you fine-tune how players earn Tickets.

Mega Stones for Mega Evolution

  • Collect Mega Stones to temporarily evolve your Pokémon into powerful Mega forms during battle.
  • Includes a Mega Stone for every currently available Mega Evolution from the mainline Pokémon games.
  • Requires the CobblemonMegas mod for Mega Evolution functionality.

Shiny Hunting Utility Items

  • Two new items, the Shiny Charm and three tiers of Shiny Sandwiches, make shiny hunting more fun and accessible.
  • Shiny Sandwiches grant the new Sparkling Power status effect, boosting shiny odds by 1 roll per level.
  • With a Shiny Charm and a Tier III Shiny Sandwich, you can achieve odds as low as 1/683 from the base 1/4096!

16 Unique Badges for Gyms

  • Features 16 custom badges, each with unique buffs and gameplay-enhancing perks.
  • Adds a new badge slot via the Trinkets API, so badges can act as powerful pieces of equipment.
  • Includes 10 base-type badges and 6 community-designed badges, created by members of the DANDYCORP community.

New Metals for Late and Post-Game

  • Access Chromium, a metal designed as an easier way to craft netherite-tier gear without the grind.
  • Introduces Paragonium, a god-tier post-game metal for advanced tools and equipment. (Commissioned from the very talented Akaleaf)
    • Paragonium does not have a recipe by default but can be configured for your server or single-player balance.

Dependencies

This mod serves as the backbone for a modpack, so it requires several dependencies:

Minecraft and Fabric

  • Fabric API

Key Libraries and Mods

  • Trinkets
  • Alloy Forgery

title: Plugin See For Op
description: Blocks /plugins command for non-OPs.
body:
## **Plugin See for OP**

**Minecraft Compatibility:** 1.21, 1.21.1

**Overview:**  
Plugin See for OP is a straightforward Minecraft plugin designed to enhance your server's security by restricting access to the `/plugins` command. With this plugin, only server operators (OPs) can use the `/plugins` command to view the list of installed plugins, while non-OP players are entirely blocked from accessing this information.

### **Key Feature:**

- **OP-Only Access to `/plugins`:** Plugin See for OP automatically disables the `/plugins` command for non-OP players. If a non-OP player attempts to use the command, they will receive a message indicating that the command is not available to them.

### **Installation and Setup:**

- Download the Plugin See for OP .jar file.
- Place it in your server’s `plugins` folder.
- Restart your server.

### **Future Plans:**

- **Custom Configs:** Future updates will introduce the ability for non-OP players to receive a customizable message or no response at all when attempting to use the `/plugins` command, making it appear as though the command does not exist.

- **Customizable Responses:** We plan to add functionality for server administrators to easily customize the message displayed to non-OP players when they try to access the `/plugins` command. This will allow for personalized server messages that match your server's theme or rules.

- **Complete Alias Protection:** Future versions will include comprehensive protection for all common aliases of the `/plugins` command, ensuring consistent security across the server.

- **Optional Logging:** We aim to implement optional logging to track unauthorized attempts to use the `/plugins` command. This feature will help server admins monitor potential security threats or players trying to explore restricted commands.

- **Enhanced Performance:** Updates will focus on ensuring the plugin has minimal impact on server performance, maintaining its efficiency for servers of all sizes without causing lag or delays.

- **Advanced Configuration:** Future releases will offer an enhanced configuration file (`config.yml`) that allows more extensive customization of the plugin’s behavior to fit your server's needs, including changes to response messages and logging options.

- **Seamless Integration:** Planned updates will ensure the plugin remains fully compatible with other plugins and server configurations, integrating smoothly into any existing setup without causing conflicts.

- **Future-Proof Updates:** We will continue to provide regular updates to ensure Plugin See for OP remains compatible with future versions of Minecraft, guaranteeing long-term reliability and security.

Take control of your server's plugin visibility with Plugin See for OP, ensuring only trusted server operators can access this critical information.

body:
# PlantNerfer PlantNerfer allows for very configurable plant behavior. [![Github All Releases](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/lichenaut/PlantNerfer/total.svg)]() ## Command | Permission | Description > /pn | plantnerfer.command | Use PlantNerfer commands.

Support me and get a superior host half-off at the same time with code: **PLANTNERFER**

![bStatsPlantNerfer](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/plantnerfer.svg) Thank you to all who use PlantNerfer! Contact server :): https://discord.gg/txJDdYcRV6 ## Plant Configuration ### Example #### Biome Group Section > biome-group-list:
>   TestGroup:
>     - "PLAINS"
>     - "SAVANNA"
>   second-group:
>     - "FOREST"
Two biome groups are created, "TestGroup" and "second-group". "TestGroup" contains the biomes "PLAINS" and "SAVANNA", and "second-group" contains the biome "FOREST". [Click here for the list of biomes.](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/block/Biome.html) #### Plant Section > oak-sapling:
>   can-place: true
>   growth-rate: 25
>   death-rate: 10
>   growth-rate-dark: 15
>   death-rate-dark: 20
>   bone-meal-success-rate: 25
>   bone-meal-success-rate-dark: 10
>   needs-hoe-for-drops: true
>   min-light: 9
>   max-light: 15
>   needs-sky: false
>   transparent-blocks-count-as-sky: false
>   no-sky-growth-rate: 10
>   no-sky-death-rate: 25
>   min-y: 0
>   max-y: 200
>   restrict-to-worlds:
>     - "world"
>     - "world_nether"
>   biome-groups:
>     second-group:
>       growth-rate: 100
>       bone-meal-success-rate: 100
>       bone-meal-success-rate-dark: 100
>       needs-hoe-for-drops: false
>       restrict-to-worlds:
>         - "world"
>       max-y: 255
>       needs-sky: false
>       transparent-blocks-count-as-sky: true
>       no-sky-growth-rate: 100
>       no-sky-death-rate: 0
>     TestGroup:
>       can-place: false
>       restrict-to-worlds:
>         - "world_nether"
Oak saplings have poor mechanics normally, but in the biome group "second-group" they have an overall growth rate of 100. In the biome group "TestGroup", they can't be placed, ruling out its biomes. ### Can Place > can-place: true/false Can the plant be placed? ### Growth Rate > growth-rate: # A value of 100 is the vanilla growth rate. A value of 50 would make each progression to the next maturation stage a coin flip. This plugin cannot make plants grow faster. ### Growth Rate Dark > growth-rate-dark: # Similar to growth-rate, but applies to plants in light levels under 8. ### Death Rate > death-rate: # A value of 100 would make the plant disappear whenever it tries to progress to the next maturation stage. A value of 5 would make the plant disappear 1 in 20 growth attempts. ### Death Rate Dark > death-rate-dark: # Similar to death-rate, but applies to plants in light levels under 8. ### Bone Meal Success Rate > bone-meal-success-rate: # A value of 100 would make the plant try to grow whenever bone meal is used on it. A value of 50 would make the plant try to grow half the time. ### Bone Meal Success Rate Dark > bone-meal-success-rate-dark: # Similar to bone-meal-success-rate, but applies to plants in light levels under 8. ### Hoe-Reliant Drops > needs-hoe-for-drops: true/false If true, the plant will only drop its items when broken with a hoe. ### Hoe-Reliant Farmland Retaining > needs-hoe-for-farmland-retain: true/false If true, the Farmland the Farmland-related plant is broken on will turn into Dirt if not broken with a hoe. ### Minimum Light > min-light: # The minimum light level allowed for plant placement, plant growth, and plant bone meal-ing. ### Maximum Light > max-light: # The maximum light level allowed for plant placement, plant growth, and plant bone meal-ing. ### Needs Sky > needs-sky: true/false If true, the plant can only be placed, grown, and bone meal-ed if there are no blocks above it. ### Transparent Blocks Count as Sky > transparent-blocks-count-as-sky: true/false If true, blocks that let light pass through them will not be checked when a needs-sky plant checks for blocks above it. ### No Sky Growth Rate > no-sky-growth-rate: # Similar to growth-rate, but applies to plants with no sky above them. Does not replace any other growth rate, instead adds another chance for the plant to not grow. ### No Sky Death Rate > no-sky-death-rate: # Similar to death-rate, but applies to plants with no sky above them. Does not replace any other death rate, instead adds another chance for the plant to die. ### Minimum Y > min-y: # The minimum y-level allowed for plant placement. ### Maximum Y > max-y: # The maximum y-level allowed for plant placement. ### Restrict to Worlds > restrict-to-worlds:
>   - "example_world_name"
>   - "example_world_name_2" Restrict plant placement to certain worlds. ### Biome Groups > See example under the "Plant Section" header Any settings for a plant can also be defined in this section for per-group configuration, except for this setting. ## Notes Note 0: PlantNerfer exists on top of vanilla mechanics; it does not replace them. Note 1: 'dark' light levels are between and including 0 and 7. Note 2: different plants have different numbers of growth stages, which means the same rate can affect some plants more than others. Note 3: for a successful bone meal fertilization growth, the plant must go through bone meal rate, growth rate, and vanilla bone meal chance checks. Note 4: These are the defaults, for any values not defined by the user: > can-place: true
> growth-rate: 100
> growth-rate-dark: 100
> death-rate: 0
> death-rate-dark: 0
> bone-meal-success-rate: 100
> bone-meal-success-rate-dark: 100
> needs-hoe-for-drops: false
> needs-hoe-for-farmland-retain: false
> min-light: 0
> max-light: 15
> needs-sky: false
> transparent-blocks-count-as-sky: true
> no-sky-growth-rate: 100
> no-sky-death-rate: 0
> min-y: -64
> max-y: 256
> restrict-to-worlds: (empty, so any)
> biome-groups: (empty)
Plants with completely empty config information will use vanilla mechanics. Biome group settings will inherit default values from the plant settings, unless they are defined in the biome group settings. If a biome is in multiple biome groups applied to a plant, only the last group's biome will be used for the plant. The "*" character in plugin messages means "all", or "any".

title: Dimension Update Fixer
description: Unyeets the Nether and End when a world is loaded without a dimension or is upgraded between Minecraft versions with dimension mods installed
body:
# Dimension Update Fixer
A simple mod that unyeets the Nether and End when a world is loaded without a dimension or is upgraded between 
Minecraft versions with dimension mods installed.

This mod does now fix the issue where removing a dimension from a world deletes all other dimensions.

## Jank
The way this mod fixes the dimension-removal issue is by mixing in and overriding the `decode` method in 
`UnboundedMapCodec`. This is somewhat of a janky fix and may break other mods that expect a certain load order for 
DFU classes or that also attempt to fix the dimension-removal issue in the same way.

## Known to Work With
This mod is known to work with:

* [Heart of the Machine](https://heart-of-the-machine.github.io/) 
  [(Github)](https://github.com/Heart-of-the-Machine/heart-of-the-machine)
  [(Modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/heart-of-the-machine)
  [(CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/heart-of-the-machine)
* [Applied Energistics 2](https://ae-mod.info/) 
  [(Github)](https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2)
  [(CurseForge)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/applied-energistics-2)
  (Fabric Build)
* Likely others.

## Thanks to

* `alcatrazEscapee` for providing the [dimension-removal fix](https://github.com/Mojang/DataFixerUpper/pull/55) in 
  the first place.
* `Kneelawk` for packaging the fix into a mixin-based fabric mod.

title: QuickHarvest
description: Right-click to harvest and instantly replant fully grown crops with a built-in, vanilla-balanced seed tax.
body:
# 🌾 QuickHarvest

> The smart, lag-free, and vanilla-balanced right-click harvesting solution for Minecraft.

**QuickHarvest** is a lightweight, server-friendly quality-of-life datapack that completely redefines how you farm. Instead of the tedious cycle of breaking mature crops and manually replanting them, simply **right-click** to harvest! 

Unlike basic harvesting mods that give you "free" replants, QuickHarvest keeps your survival experience authentic by implementing a strict, automated **seed tax** directly from your dropped loot.

---

## ✨ Features

* **⚡ Effortless Farming:** Right-click any fully grown crop to harvest its yields and instantly replant a fresh one in a single click.
* **⚖️ Vanilla-Balanced (Seed Tax):** The datapack intercepts the dropped loot in mid-air and deducts exactly **one seed/crop** as the cost for replanting. If a crop drops only a single seed, it is completely consumed, preventing any item duplication!
* **👥 Multiplayer & Co-op Ready:** The seed deduction logic is bound to the dropped item entity at the exact block coordinates. This guarantees that the correct crop pays the "tax," even if multiple players are farming side-by-side.

---

## 🥕 Supported Crops

| Crop | Mature State | Replant Cost (Deducted from Loot) |
| :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Wheat** | `age=7` | 🌾 1 Wheat Seed |
| **Carrots** | `age=7` | 🥕 1 Carrot |
| **Potatoes** | `age=7` | 🥔 1 Potato |
| **Beetroots** | `age=3` | 🫚 1 Beetroot Seed |

---

## 📦 Installation & Setup

1. Download the `QuickHarvest` datapack.
2. Drop it directly into your world's datapacks directory: `.minecraft/saves/YOUR_WORLD/datapacks/`
3. Launch your world or type `/reload` in the chat.

title: SCP-127, The Living Gun
description: A living firearm that reloads itself with teeth.
body:
The Living Gun adds a new weapon. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-127, also known as The Living Gun.


SCP-127 appears as an ordinary firearm but is in fact organic and alive. It can be found lying on the ground and picked up by right-clicking. The gun has two firing modes: semi-automatic and full-automatic, and regenerates its own ammunition over time. The bullets are formed from biological material, most notably teeth, giving it a disturbing origin. Though its damage is modest, its knockback and self-reloading ability make it a unique and unsettling weapon. 

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-127 spawn?

SCP-127 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-127.
</details>



![SCP-127](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f2b0ae02970d434219bad5992bff7cd98410d54.png)

SCP-127 looks like a normal weapon and can be found laying on the ground. If a player right-clicks SCP-127, he will pick it up. When held, right-clicking fires projectiles depending on its current mode. Semi automatic shoots only one teeth. Full automatic shoots multiple teeths, but a player needs to hold right-click on this mode. Holding sneak while right-clicking switches between modes with an unsettling sound from the SCP itself, while sneaking and right-clicking on a block places it down again. The weapon holds up to 60 shots and regenerates its ammunition after one minute once empty. Its projectiles causes low damage but a bit of knockback.

title: High Noon
description: A Buzzier Bees add-on that tweaks many aspects of Mooblooms and the Sunny effect.
body:
## Overview

While there's certainly more in store for Mooblooms on Team Abnormals's end, this add-on is a bit of a band-aid fix that makes mooblooms less of a danger to themselves, and more of a utility to players. This mod enables greater control over the AoE in which Mooblooms can grant the Sunny effect, as well as various tweaks related to said status effect.


<details>
<summary>Secret Advancement</summary>

They say there is much wisdom to be gained from the Sun herself...gaze upon her visage at a specific hour through a Spyglass and bear witness to incredible knowledge...?

</details>



## Config
### Sunny Behaviors
- Mooblooms have the option to be fed items in the `high_noon:sun_feed` tag in order to grant Sunny in a radius. This tag includes sunflowers (vanilla or from the mod [Spawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/spawn-mod)) by default. The duration for which this lasts is also configurable.
- Mobs in the `buzzier_bees:moobloom_hostiles` tag will only retaliate when burned by the Sunny effect, instead of attacking Mooblooms by default.
- Mobs dependent on an in-game "magic light value", such as Endermen (teleporting more frequently) and Spiders (neutral behavior) will behave as if in the sun when Sunny is active.
- Phantoms still attack players with the Sunny effect (although they still burn when afflicted by said effect).
- Bees afflicted by Sunny can behave as if it were daytime, 24/7.
- Mobs afflicted by Sunny passively emit buttercup particles to serve as an indicator.
### Effect Radius
- The radius for which Mooblooms grant Sunny (whether as a baby or as an adult, as well as whether the radius is dependent on being fed `sun_feed`) can be configured.
### Eternal Youth
- Items in the tags `high_noon:youth_extender`/`high_noon:youth_resumer` behave like 26.1's Golden Dandelions. This only applies to buttercups by default.
- During worldgen, Mooblooms spawn as babies with their aging paused by default.
- Players can configure whether using a youth extender/resumer plays an eating sound, as well as whether the stack size shrinks (using up the item).
### Compat
- Iguanas and Sunfish from [Spawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/spawn-mod) afflicted by Sunny can bask 24/7.
- Living entities standing on a sunstone block incur the Sunny effect.
- Sunflowers from Spawn (very slowly) follow nearby Mooblooms with an active Sunny radius.
- Eyeblossoms from [Vanilla Backport](http://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport) shut when nearby Mooblooms with an active Sunny radius.

---

**Requires [Buzzier Bees](https://modrinth.com/mod/buzzier-bees) and [Blueprint](https://modrinth.com/mod/blueprint).**

Note: this mod is *not* affiliated with the original Abnormals team. Any questions regarding this mod should be directed to my [issue tracker](https://github.com/davidjjung/highnoon/issues), not theirs. Feel free to direct any suggestions (compat or otherwise) towards the tracker as well. (Whether I'll do something about ambersol and the Umvuthana remains to be seen...)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Adds Item Varients Based Off Their **DURABILITY!**

Ever wanted game items that have durability have different looks based on their durability? Well, wonder no more!

Items do not simply remain the same item from 100% durability to 0% durability. No, items will instead flow through many different variations of the items themselves as they take damage.

Take a sword for example. As it deals damage in and out of combat, you will see your sword change from clean and pristine to scratched up and well-used. Or take some wooden tools. See how the axes transition from white paint to chipped and dinged up black paint.

These changes allow you to not only see the difference in your items visually, without having to look at the durability bar, but also allows your items to better fit into the world of the base game.

title: Dark Fantasy: Orcish Depths
description: Adds a deep orcish cave-citadel. Rough mines, dangerous parkour, lava chasms, and a bloody arena. Will you make it out alive from the lair of the green threat?
body:
# **Description**
Adds a deep, multi-level orcish cave-citadel, filled with brute force and chaos. Starting from a small orc camp on the surface, you will encounter seven diverse locations: dark mines, dangerous parkour sections, lava chasms, hanging orc structures, and a bloody arena where you must either fight waves of enemies or find a way to escape!

## **Key Features**
- **A True Challenge:** Thanks to integration with DungeonZ, these dungeons become a fair and honest test. Breaking and placing most blocks is forbidden inside - you won’t be able to “dig” your way to the end. Only your combat skills and ingenuity will help you survive!
- **Hordes of Savage Orcs:** The depths are crawling with brutal orcs and goblins from Wandering Orcs. Aggressive, numerous and bloodthirsty - they will hunt you down without mercy.
- **Immersive Orc Lair Atmosphere:** Descend into a filthy and chaotic orc citadel filled with crude buildings, hanging chunks of meat, piles of bones, skulls and overgrown underground vegetation.
- **Epic Finale:** Deep in the heart of the citadel awaits a powerful orc boss with advanced combat AI. Defeating him will not be easy, but the valuable rewards - unique orcish weapons, armor and rare loot - will make worth it.

## **Required Mods**

### **Forge/NeoForge**
The following mods are required:

- [Sinytra Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector)
- [Dungeonz](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeonz)
- [Wandering Orc](https://modrinth.com/mod/wandering-orc)

_Unfortunately, no equivalent of DungeonZ for Forge has been released yet, so the mod currently works only through the Sinitra Connector._

### **Fabric**
The following mods are required:

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Dungeonz](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeonz)

# CopyFoxies

`CopyFoxies` is an expansion mod for the **Create 0.5.1 + Copycats 2.2.1** ecosystem, focused on providing more flexible, engineering-friendly copycat geometry blocks.

## Highlights

- Adds multiple variable-geometry Copycat blocks with step-by-step right-click parameter editing.
- Complex blocks support staged placement preview (point -> line -> side) to reduce misplacement.
- Built for architectural and mechanical detailing: slopes, edge cuts, layered shapes, and centered/symmetric pieces.

## Main Block Families

- `Edge Cut Prism` / `Edge Cut Centered Prism`
  - Adjustable `U/V` cut-line positions and thickness.
  - Supports positive/negative half switching for chamfers, corner fills, and irregular transitions.
- `Horizontal Variable Slope` / `Horizontal Variable Centered Slope`
  - Adjustable top width, bottom width, and thickness for continuous slopes and directional mechanical detail.
- `Dual Half Layer` / `Dual Half Column` / `Centered Half Panel`
  - Practical base geometry for fast blockout and layered detailing.
- `Quarter Panel` / `Three Band Panel`
  - Finer panel segmentation and layered profile control.
- `Center Variable Cube` / `Corner Variable Cube`
  - Ideal for centered/corner volume tuning and structural transitions.

## Interaction Design

- Key variable-geometry blocks provide visual placement previews.
- Parameters can be increased/decreased directly on the same block, minimizing break-and-replace loops.
- Designed for intuitive click-based shape editing instead of memorizing complex workflows.

## Compatibility & Dependencies

- Minecraft: `1.20.1`
- Forge: `47.3.x`
- Create: `0.5.1.j-55`
- Copycats: `2.2.1`

> The versions above are recommended for full feature compatibility and best stability.

## Who Is This For

- Players who build high-detail structures with Copycats
- Players who need smooth geometric transitions in Create contraptions
- Pack/mod authors extending variable copycat geometry on the legacy Create stack

## Future Plans

- Expand the library of editable geometry families
- Keep improving placement previews and interaction consistency
- Control state complexity and performance cost without sacrificing usability
- Port to Create 6.0+ in approprite timing

title: LoadEmUp
description: Advanced plugin reloader for Spigot — smart, safe, and production-ready.
body:
# LoadEmUp (Beta) — Plugin Reloading, Reimagined

**LoadEmUp** is the culmination of countless hours of development and testing, built to bring you *safe*, *smart*, and *seamless* plugin management for Spigot servers. Whether you're running a small community server or a bustling public hub, LoadEmUp lets you **load**, **unload**, **enable**, **disable**, and **reload** plugins dynamically — no server restarts required.


## 🚀 Why LoadEmUp?

- **Total Control** — Reload only the plugins you want without disrupting your whole server.
- **Rock-solid Safety** — Includes built-in virus scanning, dependency checks, and integrity validation to help prevent crashes and downtime — though some plugins may still cause issues.
- **Smart Dependency Management** — Automatically respects plugin dependencies and their relationships.


## 📦 Easy Installation

LoadEmUp works on Spigot 1.13+ with Java 17+. Just drop the latest `.jar` into your plugins folder and restart your server. That’s it!


## 🛠️ Features at a Glance

- 🛡️ Virus & Threat Scanning support
- 🔗 Dependency and dependant detection  
- 🧩 File integrity and metadata validation  
- ✅ Safe reload execution only if all checks pass  
- ⚡ Full lifecycle support: load, unload, enable, disable, reload  


## 🎮 Who Should Use LoadEmUp?

LoadEmUp is perfect for:

- Server admins who want to update or fix plugins without downtime  
- Developers testing plugin changes on production-like environments  
- Communities demanding maximum uptime and stability  


## 🛡️ Compatibility

Designed for Spigot and its forks (Paper, Purpur, etc.), LoadEmUp plays nicely with most plugins. Complex plugins with heavy state might need special care — always check your reload status!

## 🔍 Under Development Features

There are some features still under development. One of them is adding support for proxy softwares (BungeeCord, Velocity and Waterfall) and Folia, which is currently our main priority. Other feature coming soon are the following:

- Async plugin loading strategy
- Malware/Threat scans before every load
- Support for legacy versions.


## 🧑‍💻 For Plugin Developers

Don’t want LoadEmUp to perform certain actions on your plugin — or prefer it not to run at all? No problem. LoadEmUp provides a simple way to opt out or restrict what operations it can perform on your plugin.

Check out the [Developer Documentation](https://gurwiworks.gitbook.io/loademup-wiki/developer/leu-file) to learn how to:

- Mark your plugin as **non-reloadable**  
- Block specific actions (e.g. disable, unload or reload) 

Give your plugin full control over how it interacts with LoadEmUp — no surprises, no hacks.


## ❤️ Support Development

Love LoadEmUp? Follow us on **Modrinth** and share it with your fellow server admins.

title: Giants of the Cretaceous
description: This project adds unique dinosaur ecosystem, as well as some equipment and vehicles crafted with dinosaur materials.
body:
![All dinosaur models](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/155b2f9ec7b101458c0d3e3ac5fe6abfc0933038_0.webp)

The modification adds dinosaurs to minecraft. However, they are not bloodthirsty monsters or fossils that you need to revive. Predators attack their prey only when they are hungry, herbivores fight back, dinosaur nests and bones can be found all over the world. Each creature has unique custom model, texture and animations. Moreover, there is plenty of equipment, and some weapons have their custom models. 

For now, the mod has no in-game documentation, so let me introduce some key features and mechanics. Also I recommend to install JEI, since there are lot of recipes, and some of them are not that obvious :)

## Dinosaurs

You can meet them always everywhere. For now, there are 11 species (not all of them are dinosaurus, however). Some of them are herbivores, which means they won't attack anyone until someone attacks them. Others are carnivores. Each minute a carnivore creature becomes hungry and kills one prey. After that, the creature's hunger is satisfied for a minute, and it becomes neutral. 

Moreover, most of the creatures has unique abilities to use when attacked. Each ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. Finally, all the creatures are tameable and breedable. When bred, they lay eggs, except the aquatic ones. Now I'd like to present you these creatures in alphabetical order.

**When riding a creature, you can use its ability (if it has one) by pressing R. You can also attack nearby enemies by pressing B.**

### Amargasaurus

![Amargasaurus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8910e287121c260d102fdd66d5295169f45afb6f.png)

A huge herbivorous sauropod with beautiful crests. Spawns in forests and meadows. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Herbivorous Treat

**Ability:** Stomp. Breaks nearest blocks and deals a lot of damage to nearby enemies

**Drop:** Amargasaurus Spike, Dinosaur Hide & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Amargasaurus Trident (hits all enemies in 2x2 area)

### Archelon

![Archelon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/820d6736af58c0852fad9c83f365a63b30345a48_0.webp)

A giant carnivorous aquaitc turtle. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Tropical Fish

**Ability:** no ability

**Drop:** Archelon Shell, Giant Lungs (use underwater to replenish oxygen; it slowly repairs on air)

**Connected Weapon:**: no weapon

### Deinocheirus

![Deinocheirus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1090a4d1bfd9ff4124c77ae088fd3f003b05df1_0.webp)

Though peaceful-looking, this giant theropod is predator. Spawns in forests and meadows. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Honey Block

**Ability:** Overpower. Deals 3 rapid attacks using its giant hands

**Drop:** Deinocheirus Hand, Dinosaur Fur & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Deinocheirus Saw (can be used both for combat and cutting trees)

### Mosasaurus

![Mosasaurus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c3afe8b745e4d6026ab40bf4bb04f009cd4649e_0.webp)

The ultimate oceanic predator which even archelons are afraid of. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Carnivorous Treat

**Ability:** no ability

**Drop:** Mosasaurus Fin, Giant Lungs

**Connected Weapon:** no weapon

### Nanuqsaurus

![Nanuqsaurus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb982a97e832ac5b07470aacaf3fc97a46ed2683.png)

Carnivorous theropod which lives in cold snowy biomes. Its attacks applies Polar Touch effect which slows down entities attack speed and prohibits health regeneration. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Carnivorous Treat

**Ability:** passively applies Polar Touch when attacks

**Drop:** Nanuqsaurus Claw, Dinosaur Fur & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Nanuqsaurus Blade (applies Polar Touch on hit)

### Pachyrinosaurus

![Pachyrinosaurus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98be785084ab7891d53ed89d2f2abc558273b389.png)

Herbivorous ceratopsian living in cold biomes. When defending, it knocks back the enemies. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Herbivorous Treat

**Ability:** passively knock backs the enemies

**Drop:** Pachyrinosaurus Wart, Horn & Collar, Dinosaur Hide & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Pachyrinosaurus Shield (when blocking, applies Thyreophora Grace; deals damage to enemies who attack the owner), Pachyrinosaurus Maul (mines 3x3 and has extra knockback)

### Protoceratops

![Protoceratops](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd1a9542ed7fd6ab0aa983a71806b9792d7587c0.png)

Smalll herbivorous ceratopsian living in arid biomes.

**Tame food:** Herbivorous Treat

**Ability:** no ability

**Drop:** Protoceratops Collar, Dinosaur Hide & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Protoceratops Shield (when blocking, applies Thyreophora Grace)

### Quetzalcoatlus

![Quetzalcoatlus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d661d1d72a1b60304ed4130ae573a53284d7107_0.webp)

Giant pterosaurus living in coastal areas. Carnivorous. Well, it flies, and you can take advantage of it. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Carnivorous Treat

**Ability:** Flight (hold SPACE to fly up)

**Drop:** Quetzalcoatlus Crest, Membrane & Finger

**Connected Weapon:** Quetzalcoatlus Halberd (use it to give temporary Slow Falling effect)

### Saurolophus

![Saurolophus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25836b60f763b674228b64bcd67039bbdbbeeb85.png)

Herbivorous dinosaurus. Spawns in plains and savannas. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Herbivorous Treat

**Ability:** Trumpet. Applies Stun to nearby enemies (this effects prohibits to move and attack)

**Drop:** Saurolophus Horn (right click to use Trumpet by yourself), Dinosaur Hide & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** no weapon

### Tarbosaurus

![Tarbosaurus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2324e4f5ccf8af5a04de72578628b0db54b74977.png)

That's why you are here, right? As cool as TRex, this carnivorous theropod lives in plains and savannas. Rideable.

**Tame food:** Carnivorous Treat

**Ability:** Roar. Applies Fear to nearby enemies (this effects prohibits to move and attack)

**Drop:** Tarbosaurus Tooth, Dinosaur Hide & Meat

**Connected Weapon:** Tarbosaurus Saber (restores you 1 HP when you attack)

### Velociraptor

![Velociraptor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/242ea7376e5ae75c3cd51b27388a6006120c6d23.png)

Little predator living in arid biomes. Thet attack only in groups. They will follow their owner if it has Pack Leader effect on him.

**Tame food:** Insect Abdomen (drops from Silverfish and Bee)

**Ability:** no ability

**Drop:** Feather, Velociraptor Claw

**Connected Weapon:** Velociraptor Dagger (both melee and range weapon)

## Materials

All the dinosaur materials are mentioned above. However, let me also show the recipes of dinosaur treats which are used to tame most of them.

![Treat Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/589867ec177b2df7ad49f34377616e8c81698f09.png)

## Weapons

Basically, I have already mentioned all the combat stuff, so let me just provide all the recipes here. Tooltips and in-game documentation will be released in the nearest future!

![Weapon Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05d2efec48112d019bf2577d996c8047e628e829_0.webp)

## Armor

You can craft Feather Armor using feathers and then upgrade it to Fur Armor, or you can upgrade Leather Armor to Hide Armor and then to Shell Armor. Each armor has its unique buff which is activated when you press V. To purge the buff, press V again. Read more about buffs in the next section. Let me also show the recipes.)

![Armor Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b458a70fd86e7b8b8ce0257221d845c24e3ca91a_0.webp)

## Effects

As you might have guessed, there are some custom buffs and debuffs in the mod:

* Pack Leader. Applied when you eat Insect Abdomen or use the ability of Feather Armor. Increases you movespeed & jump height and make all your tamed velociraptors follow and protect you.
* Fear & Stun. Applied by Tarbosaurus, Saurolophus and by using Saurolophus Horn. They basically are the same and just have different icons. They prohibit you to move and attack.
* Polar Touch. Applied by Nanuqsaurus and Nanuqsaurus Blade. Decreases target entity's attack speed and doesn't allow to regenerate health even if you hunger is full.
* Thyreophora Grace. Applied when you block damage with Protoceratops or Pachyrinosaurus Shield. Gives you extra attack knockback.
* Cretaceous Grace. Applied when you use the ability of Hide & Shell Armor. Increases your maximum health, armor and attack damage, but decreases your movement and attack speed.
* Winter Grace. Applied when you use the ability of Fur Armor. Gives you extra movement & mining speed when you are in a cold biome.
* Underwater Grace. Applied when you use the ability of Shell Armor. Increases your swimming speed and gives you infinite oxygen.

## Vehicles

There are two vehicles in the mod:

* Shell Submarine. Well, it swims fast and looks good.

![Submarine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1bbb655107319412352518b9352cbda140369f2.png)

* Quetzalcoatlus Airship. When you ride it, press SPACE to speed up and move towards your eyes direction.

![Airship](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4daea054491fd5e9cf7892c6cd9cbcfffd4a121a.png)

Crafts of these vehicles are presented below.

![Vehicle recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9c12962cbb16992d93d6eaa9a09571c60701d02.png)

## Outlook

I am planning both minor and major updates for the mod. 

Minors:
* in-game documentation;
* different dinosaur textures.

Majors:
* new dinosaur species;
* new villager profession and related structure (a lab or something like that);
* an option to make dinosaur hybrids (probably, hybrid dragons, but I can't tell exactly for now).

Hope you will enjoy the mod!

## Showcase
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/l60MSPnGIU0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features
* 3 new storage bags, placed in various points in progression
* Access backpack items from any screen, via a new item GUI interaction system
* Lunchboxes, which hold multiple stacks of food and can be eaten from
* Filters, which allow and disallow certain items to enter your backpack
* A new penalty based on the amount of items on your person; too many items will cause debuffs!
* When worn, items will be automatically put into the bag when your inventory is full.
* Storage bags are able to be dyed like leather armor

## Usage
* While cursor is empty
  * Right clicking a bag => Selected item is extracted
  * Shift + right clicking a bag => Topmost item is extracted
* While item is grabbed by cursor
  * Right clicking a bag with an item => Item is put into the bag
* While bag is grabbed by cursor
  * Right clicking + drag with a bag => Items are inserted
  * Shift + right clicking + drag with a bag => Items are extracted
