title: Origins: Pantoslime
description: A mimic-themed Origin for the Origins mod. A rare and unsettling mutation of the common slime, the Pantoslime is a creature of deception.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/2VIHJRJ1iFY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**This data pack is designed for the Origins mod. For the best experience, it is highly recommended to also use Pehkui and Mob Origins, though the data pack should still somewhat function without them.**

[This Origin was suggested by **Nerro** on Discord aka **Lord_Nerro** on Minecraft. If you would like to suggest your own data pack, you can do so over on my Discord server as well.](https://discord.gg/b8jJUQ29Wg)

**Pantoslime:** A rare and unsettling mutation of the common slime, the Pantoslime is a creature of deception. Its oozing form bends with unnatural precision, twisting into familiar shapes to ensnare the unwary. Where its lesser kin mindlessly absorb what they touch, the Pantoslime lures prey into false security, wearing the guise of chests, barrels, and furnaces with chilling accuracy.

**Impact:** 🔴🔴🔴

**🟩 Corrosive Lance [Primary + Guiseless]:** Your body lurches forward, launching a razor-sharp lance of hardened slime. It pierces flesh with a sickening squelch, dealing 3 full hearts of damage and leaving behind a festering wound that melts armor and flesh.

**🟩 Oozing Mimicry [Secondary]:** Fix your gaze upon an interactable object and feel your form ripple, stretch, and collapse into perfect replication. A chest? A furnace? No. A trap. Each stolen guise grants its own slimy advantage. Shift again, and the disguise dissolves back into slime.

**🟩 Cloak in Stillness [Sneak]:** When wearing a stolen shape, you may still yourself entirely, sinking into the world’s grid like a shadow slipping between cracks. Only the keenest eyes will sense the wrongness in your stillness.

**🟢 Bouncy Biology:** Impact holds no terror for you. You descend from great heights only to rebound, your gelatinous form laughing at the earth’s pull. The ground may shatter, but you will not.

**🟢 Tool Engulfment:** Your acidic essence seeps into whatever you hold, dripping with venom. Swords poison, pickaxes corrode stone faster, and every strike leaves behind a lingering rot.

**🟡 Carnivorous Sludge:** Only flesh sustains you. Rotten or fresh, it matters not, for your stomach devours all toxins, leaving you immune to the sicknesses that plague lesser beings.

**🟡 Caustic Presence:** Your very touch is decay. Tools and armor degrade faster in your grasp, eaten away by your corrosive slime. But those who strike you suffer the same fate, their blades dull, their shields crack, all things crumbling in the face of your corrosive essence.

**🟡 Compact Ooze:** You are but a single block in stature; a small, squirming thing. Yet within that frame lies a predator’s patience.

**🟡 Gelid Congregation:** Your kindred call to you. When near lesser slimes, your wounds slowly knit shut with quiet squelches. When another Pantoslime lingers close, the healing is swift, their fellowship mending your gooey flesh.

**🟡 Viscous Movement:** The ground clings to you like tar, dragging at your every step. But leap, and you are free, bounding with unnatural speed.

**🔴 Fractured Guise:** Pain unravels you. When brought below four hearts, your disguise collapses, leaving only a quivering, vulnerable mass of slime.

**🔴 Gelid Flesh:** Your body, though having incredible properties, is fragile. Two hearts fewer than the average mortal possesses, a price for your malleable deceit.

**🔴 Unwelcome Deceit:** No villager will barter with a creature that wears lies like skin. To them, you are not a customer, you are a predator hiding in plain sight.

**🔴 Viscous Fatigue:** Your form strains under repeated manipulation. The use of abilities temporarily liquefies parts of your mass. These compromised sections remain inert, unable to be reshaped, until they slowly ooze back into cohesion.

**🟪 Hide Block Displays [Secondary + Sneak]:** An out of lore ability for the player's benefit. Toggles the rendering of all block displays. Useful in hiding some block displays that cover the screen. Other players will still see the block displays. The Pantoslime itself is unaware of any of this.

<details>
<summary>Stolen Guises</summary>

# Artisan's Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Cartography Table, Crafting Table, Fletching Table, Loom, and Stonecutter.

**🟩 Internal Workshop [Primary]:** Your gelatinous body swirls and churns, forming a perfect crafting table grid within your translucent core.

**🟢 Mender’s Respite:** Every foe felled mends your tools and armor as if their fading essence weaves itself into your gear, stitching fractures and smoothing dents.

**🔴 Creator’s Burden:** This guise lacks the focused force for efficient demolition. Every block resists your efforts, breaking apart 25% slower than normal.

# Gulper Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Barrel, Chest, Ender Chest, Shulker Box, and Trapped Chest.

**🟩 False Maw [Primary]:** Your gelatinous body splits open, revealing a yawning cavity ready to snatch and store. Items placed inside remain in your viscous form when you shift shapes, but only by resuming this hollow guise can you retrieve them.

**🟢 Voracious Pull:** Your slime trembles with unnatural hunger, exerting a faint gravitational pull on loose objects. Trinkets and treasures alike slide helplessly toward your form.

**🔴 Burdened Ooze:** Your expanded carrying capacity weighs down your gelatinous form, reducing mobility by 25%. You ooze forward with visible effort.

# Ironhide Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Anvil, Chipped Anvil, Damaged Anvil, Grindstone, and Smithing Table.

**🟩 Gelid Fortification [Primary]:** Your gelatinous body hardens into a dense, rubbery mass. No attack can pierce you, but you cannot move or strike back until the effect passes.

**🟢 Reinforced Ooze:** Your slimy hide grows unnaturally dense, adding 6 points of armor. Weapons struggle to penetrate your reinforced goo.

**🟡 Seismic Splat:** Every landing from a jump sends ripples into the earth, dealing minor damage to nearby creatures as your heavy body slams down with crushing force.

**🔴 Leaden Sludge:** Your gelatinous form sags with unnatural density. You ooze forward at a crawl, all mobility reduced by 25% under your weight.

# Jester's Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Jukebox and Note Block.

**🟩 Center Stage [Primary]:** You burst into a dazzling performance, commanding all eyes upon you. Nearby creatures freeze, utterly mesmerized, caught in the spotlight of your spectacle.

**🟢 Jester’s Grace:** Your movements become a blur of practiced elegance, dashing 50% faster and leaping 50% higher as if the very air cheers your every step.

**🔴 Marked Fool:** Villagers see through your act. Their whispers turn to shouts, and before you can bow, iron golems already march toward you, fists raised against the trickster in their midst.

# Scorching Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Blast Furnace, Campfire, Furnace, Smoker, and Soul Campfire.

**🟩 Pyroclastic Surge [Primary]:** Your core flares with intense heat, emitting a blistering heatwave. Nearby creatures burst into flames as superheated slime spatter scalds them for 3 full hearts of damage.

**🟢 Molten Core:** This guise renders you completely unaffected by extreme heat. Flames lick harmlessly across your surface, and lava flows around you like warm syrup.

**🔴 Hydrolysis:** Water triggers a dangerous chemical reaction in your heated form. Rain sizzles painfully on contact, and immersion deals continuous damage as your unstable structure begins dissolving.

# Verdant Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Beehive, Bee Nest, and Composter.

**🟩 Verdant Surge [Primary]:** Your gelatinous form pulses with energy, causing nearby plants to shudder and rapidly grow.

**🟢 Photosynthetic Ooze:** Bathed in sunlight, your translucent body thrums with vitality. Your wounds seal as chloroplasts within your goo convert light into regenerative energy.

**🔴 Light-Starved Sludge:** While out of the sun’s reach, your movement speed is reduced by 50%, as your plant-infused slime congeals into sluggish, inert goo.

# Voltaic Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Dispenser, Dropper, and Hopper.

**🟩 Energy Discharge [Primary]:** Your core crackles with unstable power before releasing a concentrated bolt of raw energy towards your target, dealing 4 hearts of damage and leaving victims twitching.

**🟢 Overcharged:** Energy courses through your form, supercharging your movements. You zip across terrain 50% faster and launch yourself 50% higher with each jump.

**🔴 Storm Magnet:** During thunderstorms, ominous rumbles precede inevitable lightning strikes that seek out your conductive form with terrifying accuracy.

# Warlock's Guise
**Mimicked Blocks:** Beacon, Brewing Stand, Cauldron, Chiseled Bookshelf, Enchanting Table, and Lectern.

**🟩 Viscous Hex [Primary]:** You secrete a tar-like curse onto your target. Their limbs grow heavy as your malignant slime infiltrates their being, slowing their movements to a crawl while your acidic magic eats away at them from within.

**🟢 Arcane Ooze:** Magical energies supercharge you, movements become 25% quicker, your jumps 25% higher, and your attacks 25% deadlier as magic thrums through you.

**🔴 Arcane Fragility:** Your magic-infused guise reacts violently to spells. Every arcane strike burns through your gelatinous body with 50% greater effect, as if your own attunement betrays you.

</details>

[If you have any questions, concerns, or bugs you would like to report, my Discord server is a great place for doing so.](https://discord.gg/b8jJUQ29Wg)

# Example Trident CIT
## An example pack for trident CIT that works on both the item and thrown entity models!
[View the pack on my website!](https://ewanhowell.com/resourcepacks/example-trident-cit)

This pack provides examples of how to make CIT tridents. It includes three examples: name your trident "Red Trident", "Quindent", or "Mjolnir". Lowercase versions of these names are also supported. This works by using the new item definitions feature to redefine trident item models to render as items instead of entities. The same item definition files are used to apply the name-based models. This does not actually use OptiFine CIT. Thrown tridents still use entity models, so OptiFine CEM and OptiFine random entities are required to change the model or texture based on the item’s name. Custom atlases are included to allow trident textures from the entity folder to be applied to item models. This is optional and can be skipped if your textures are stored in the "block" or "item" folders. Proper trident CIT was not possible before 1.21.5 and requires OptiFine CEM (or a compatible alternative mod).

title: AutoCompressor
description: Automatically compress items based on custom recipes.
body:
## Features:
- Creating custom autocompressor recipes linked to an activator item
- All players can enable and disable AutoCompressors that they have unlocked for themself
- Admins can give activator items and revoke autocompresors from players
- **Easy setup with no writing in files required!**
##
### Commands:
- **/auc** (or /auc help) - Show all commands
- **/auc create <autocompressor id>** - Create an autocompressor hold the item in your hand that you want to use as the activator item and set the custom autocompressor id for the autocompressor
- **/auc createrecipe <recipe id> [input item amount] [output item amount]** - Create a recipe that can be added to a autocompressor later hold the input item in your main hand and the output item in your offhand the input item amount is how many input items it takes to get the resulting output item amount (defaults to 64 -> 1)
- **/auc asignrecipe <autocompressor id> <recipe id>** - Asign a created recipe to an autocompressor
- **/auc activator <autocompressor id> <player>** - Give yourself or another player an activator item
- **/auc type <AutoCompressor Id> <Permenant/Inventory/Offhand>** - Choose the type of AutoCompressor an AutoCompressor is, **Permenant** (default) - Right click activator item to claim it permenatly player's can toggle it on and off with the /toggle command, **Inventory** - Works only when the activator item is in the players inventory cannot claim the activator item, **Offhand** - Works the same way as the inventory type except the activator item only works when its in the players inventory
- **/auc list** - Lists all the autocompressor id's that you have add to the server
- **/auc listrecipes <autocompressor id>** - Lists all the recipes for a specific autocompressor
- **/auc remove <autocompressor id>** - Delete a specific autocompressor
- **/auc removerecipe <autocompressor id> <recipe id>** - Delete a specific recipe from an autocompressor using the recipe id
- **/auc deleterecipe <recipe id>** - Compltely delte a recipe id and remove it from all autocompressors
- **/auc revoke <autocompressor id> <player>** - Revoke an autocompressor from a player that has already unlocked an autocompressor
- **/auc toggle <autocompressor id> <player>** - Enable or disable an autocompressor that you have already unlocked admins can enable and disable other players unlocked autocompressors

- **/auc listtoggled** - List the autocompressors that you have unlocked and enabled or disabled
##
### Permissions:
- **autocompressor.*** - Get all permissions for the AutoCompressor plugin
- **autocompressor.create** - /auc create command
- **autocompressor.createrecipe** - /auc createrecipe command
- **autocompressor.removerecipe** - /auc removerecipe command
- **autocompressor.remove** - /auc remove command
- **autocompressor.activator** - /auc activator command
- **autocompressor.setactivator** - /auc setactivator command
- **autocompressor.listrecipes** - /auc listrecipes command
- **autocompressor.list** - /auc list command
- **autocompressor.revoke** - /auc revoke command
- **autocompressor.type** - /auc type command
- **autocompressor.deleterecipe** - /auc deleterecipe command
- **autocompressor.toggle** - /auc toggle command (enabled to all by default)
- **autocompressor.listtoggled** - /auc listtoggled command (enabled to all by default)
- **autocompressor.adminhelp** - See the admin help menu when you get sent the help menu
- **autocompressor.help** - /auc help command (enabled to all by default)

body:
# Multiplayer Isolation

A serverside Minecraft mod that aims to hide all relevant information about other online players except for in-game entities.

## Features

- Hides player names in chat (Death messages, join/leave messages, etc.)
- Hides player chat messages (including commands such as `/msg` and `/me`)
- Hides player names in the player list
- Hides player names in chat autocomplete
- Prevents players from brute-forcing player names by using `/msg` or `/tell`
- Keeps player entities visible
- Fully Configurable

## NOTES

- Player skins are **only visible** when installed on the **client** (this is due to limitiations given how minecraft is written)

This mod works well with mods such as ~~[Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)~~, and [Localized Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/localized-chat) (make sure to enable chat messages in the config).

NOTE: VOICE CHAT MODS DON'T HIDE THE NAMES OF PLAYERS IN THE VOICE CHAT UI, A SOLUTION FOR THIS IS IN THE WORKS.

title: itemsauce
description:
Adds rarity to item tooltips... that's it.

Includes configurable colors.
body:
# itemsauce
Adds flavor to your items by giving them purely cosmetic rarity labels.

Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1

Generates a configuration file upon first launch.

```toml
#Use minecraft's default rarity as a fallback
useBakedInRarity = true

[legendary]
color = "LIGHT_PURPLE"
items = ["nether_star", "enchanted_golden_apple", "silence"]

[epic]
color = "GOLD"
items = ["netherite", "elytra", "ancient_debris"]

[rare]
color = "RED"
items = ["emerald", "diamond", "amethyst", "breeze", "golden_apple"]

[uncommon]
color = "DARK_GREEN"
items = ["gold", "ender", "blaze", "trim", "potion"]

[common]
color = "GRAY"
items = ["put_item_names_here"]
```

Colors should follow the name of the color code in the [wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Formatting_codes#Color_codes). (JE Edition codes only)  
Item names put in the items tab should follow their minecraft id. You can see an item's id in-game by using F3+H.  
Items are simply checked to see if they contain the keyword. E.g. if you put 'oak' in legendary, all items with 'oak' in their minecraft id will be legendary.

title: Tree Miner
description: This is a MinecraftMOD that uses trees to produce minerals
body:
A practical MOD developed by CTN Studio (China team)                            

To use this mod you need to download the 1.0.0 version of the attachment or the 1.0.0 version of the API repository[API repository link](https://github.com/Wang-Xiao-Jing/XiaoJinAPI)

## How to play?
This MOD adds tree forms to all minerals from the original, you can collect raw ore and add oak saplings to synthesize lode saplings.                                          

![Synthesis of lode saplings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e307c68a62b70d219439f879596f6bbff2f1fdba.png)

Lode saplings need to be planted on the corresponding ore, and since the trees are relatively large, please give some space.

![put](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/639d2d5a2e67b38fcf9ad91bd50e8359a6a21fb0_0.webp)

After the saplings are mature, you can right-click the mature leaves to obtain the corresponding ore fruit, which can be smelted and smoked, smelted to obtain the corresponding mineral product, and smoked to obtain the corresponding ripe ore fruit.

![Firing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d8e9c7906121c5f36cd709ea290ac439bc34533.png)
![Smoking and blast furnace firing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48c7dda3663ec012f14acda907978911d449634e.png)

You can eat these ripe ore fruit can give you some beneficial effects, you can also make the trunk of the tree into the corresponding boards to make special bowls.

Any number of ripe fruits can be combined with special bowls to make special foods (note: ripe fruits are not repeatable), which are not stackable but are ready to eat and will have the effect of synthetic ripe fruits.
![Special food](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/625049dfc0230d21411e0bb647e0244bf9861971.png)

There are more features for you to find

This is a modpack that aims to find the <ins>best performance and fix mods to achieve the maximum fps and improving your gameplay without reducing your performance. It also has the best options for the best performance.</ins>

This modpack only contains the best performance mods, these mods are also <ins>usually</ins> compatible with any performance mod you want to add by yourself.

<details>
<summary>Included Mods (18)</summary>
  
- **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)**: Powerful rendering engine and optimization mod for Minecraft which greatly improves performance and graphical quality. By **[jellysquid3](https://modrinth.com/user/jellysquid3)**
  
- **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)**: General-purpose optimization mod for Minecraft which works to improve a number of systems with the goal of not changing any vanilla mechanics. By **[jellysquid3](https://modrinth.com/user/jellysquid3)**
  
- **[BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations)**: A collection of mostly micro optimizations that add up to something bigger! By **[thosea](https://modrinth.com/user/thosea)**

title: Scrolls of Mending
description: Repair your gear instantly at the cost of XP!
body:
![Scrolls of Mending](https://github.com/Joshcraft2002/joshs-scrolls-of-mending/blob/main/media/coverartsinglescroll.png?raw=true) # Introduction Scrolls of Mending adds scrolls which repair your armor at the cost of experience. There are different ranks of scrolls that repair different percentages of durability, and the experience cost changes dynamically depending on how much total durability your gear has. # Crafting You first need to craft a blank parchment. This can be done by arranging paper on a crafting table depending on which equipment you want repaired. ![Parchment Types](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qazcgSo2/images/229496f7da03e5f17a5d0b873a0c51934ce1b17a.png) Then, depending on the rank of scroll, you need to create a scroll seal. Surround one of the below materials in 8 gold nuggets at a crafting table: - **Iron Nugget:** Lesser Scroll Seal - **Lapis Lazuli:** Scroll Seal - **Diamond:** Greater Scroll Seal Then, toss a blank parchment, a seal, and an Enchanted Book with mending on the ground to craft a scroll. ![Creating a Scroll](https://github.com/Joshcraft2002/joshs-scrolls-of-mending/blob/main/media/groundcrafting.gif?raw=true) # Usage Right clicking the scroll in either your offhand or mainhand repairs your equipment and consumes the scroll. The amount repaired and experience cost depends on the scroll type: ![Scroll Types](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qazcgSo2/images/7609e10e34ba993c1a943ccbed40dcec8558b1f2.png)
(undamaged equipment is ignored in the cost calculation) If you don't have enough experience levels, a message will appear: ![Not Enough Experience](https://github.com/Joshcraft2002/joshs-scrolls-of-mending/blob/main/media/notenoughexperience.png?raw=true) # Installing Download the resource pack and place it in your resourcepacks folder, and download the data pack and place it in your world or server's datapacks folder. (pretty simple) If you plan to use multiple datapacks and resourcepacks together, you can use [weld](https://weld.smithed.dev/) to easily merge them together to place in your world. (some packs may not be compatible with others, but Josh's More Foods follows smithed's conventions for better compatibility with other packs) To uninstall the datapack, run this command: `/function jmsm:uninstall` Afterwards, you can safely disable then remove the datapack. ## Configuration To open the config menu, run this command: `/function jmsm:config`
Config Options - scroll use cooldown (in seconds, with actual cooldown up to 1 second early) - cost calculation type - `default` bases cost on total durability, in line with the repair always being a % of full durability - `legacy` is the old system, basing only on damage - experience cost of scrolls (in %, and based on cost calculation type)
# Credits Sprites are made by [Bonii](https://twitter.com/ChalkDev) ## Contributing
Translations If you want to help with translations, submit a pull request, message me on PlanetMinecraft, or hit me up on discord: joshmats

You can base off of the US English file here

description: Fabric mod to replicate the Optifine random entities feature set
body:
### The goal of this mod is to replicate the Optifine random entities feature set, but in Fabric.

**Should be fully compatible with Sodium and Iris.**

This project is still in Alpha stage, expect some issues and report them when you can.

![Sample image of Random and Emissive Textures](https://github.com/MrJoshuaT/Fabric-Random-Entities/blob/master/images/sample_image.png?raw=true)

### What can it do?
* Loading and parsing of Optifine packs
* Random textures based upon .properties rules and generic variations
* Emissive textures
* Eyes feature renderer - *this is turned off when Iris is loaded, for now*
* Villager outer layer feature renderer
* Should support modded gameplay, the code should not make any distinctions between vanilla and not

title: Preston
description: Compressed block mod.
body:
Preston is a "compressed block" mod - that is, it provides means of compressing sets of 9 identical blocks into 1 "compressed block" recursively, as well as decompressing them back.

Where it differs from previous approaches, however, is in a few key areas:

* Preston allows you to compress any full-cuboid block in the game, not just a selection of them.
* Preston lets you set the amount of compression levels available. By default, there are sixteen (single, double, triple, ..., sexdecuple), but you can set them all the way from just one (single) to one thousand (..., undemilluple, milluple)!
* Preston allows you to balance block compression by providing an RF/FE-powered machine, the Compressor, to faciliate this. The amount of RF/FE necessary scales with the compression level. (Optionally, you can configure it to allow crafting-based compression.)

Preston also includes mod compatibility with:

* Just Enough Items (0.2.0+)
* HWYLA (0.3.0+) - for properly supporting the Compressor's energy storage
* BuildCraft (0.3.0+) - Minecraft Joules support
* CraftTweaker (0.3.1+) - mods.preston.Compressor.addRecipe(<output>, energy_cost, <input>), mods.preston.CompressedBlocks.createStack(<block>, <amount>), mods.preston.CompressedBlocks.getMaximumCompressionLevel()
* BuildCraft (0.3.3+) - "Has Work" gate support

In addition, Preston includes an API for developers to be able to query, compress and decompress Compressed Blocks in their own machines, as well as define custom recipes for the Compressor.

title: CITX (CIT Extension)
description: A mod that allows easy renaming of CIT items with a custom command.
body:
# CITX (CIT Extension)

**A smart mod that makes renaming CIT items quick and easy with one command.**  
Made for builders, creators, and anyone tired of the anvil clanking.

## 👉 Features

- 🏷️ Rename items with simple commands
- 🔄 Swap CIT extensions instead of stacking them
- 📝 Full rename support for display names
- ♻️ One-command reset to default
- 🛡️ Smart logics, clean-ups, and naming conditions
- 💻 Client-side only, nothing to install server-side

## 🚀 Quick Reference

| Command | Alias | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/citx <input>` |  | Shortcut. Skips "extend" entirely, just adds/swaps the extension |
| `/citx extend <extension>` | `/citx e <extension>` | Adds or swaps a CIT extension, keeps the base name |
| `/citx rename <name>` | `/citx r <name>` | Replaces the entire display name |
| `/citx reset` | `/citx x` | Clears the custom name |

⚠️ **Important: After using any command, open and close your inventory to refresh the renamed item so it displays correctly in the world.**

Unfortunately, this cannot be fixed, as it is a limitation of how Minecraft handles item renames and client-side item updates.

## #️⃣ Commands

<details>
<summary>/citx extend</summary>

#### Adds or swaps an extension

Keeps the item's base name and only touches the extension.

```
/citx extend <extension>
/citx e <extension>          # alias
/citx <input>            # shortcut, no subcommand needed
```

For quick extension changes you don't even need to type "extend" or "e". Just `/citx <input>` on its own works the same way:

```
/citx red
Grass Block → Grass Block_red
```

**Example (full form)**
```
/citx extend red
Grass Block → Grass Block_red
```

Run it again with a new extension and it replaces the old one, it doesn't stack:
```
Grass Block_old
/citx e new
→ Grass Block_new        ✅
→ Grass Block_old_new    ❌ (never happens)
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>/citx rename</summary>

## Replaces the whole name

```
/citx rename <name>
/citx r <name>            # alias
```

**Example**
```
/citx rename Mystic Sword
→ Mystic Sword
```
</details>

<details>
   
<summary>/citx reset</summary>

## Resets item name back to default 

```
/citx reset
/citx x                   # alias
```
</details>

## 🧹 Automatic Cleanup

You don't have to think about formatting. CITX handles it in the background:

- Collapses duplicate underscores
- Keeps only one extension at a time
- Adds a missing leading underscore
- Blocks malformed names before they happen

```
Stone__red → Stone_red
```

## 🔁 Example Workflow

```
Hold: Grass Block

/citx blue           → Grass Block_blue     (shortcut for extend)
/citx green          → Grass Block_green    (swapped, not stacked)
/citx r Emerald Trophy   → Emerald Trophy
/citx x              → Grass Block          (back to default)
```

## 🐞 Reporting Bugs & Issues
Please report all bugs & issues you found in the [github issues](https://github.com/aerhazu/CITX/issues) page.

title: Advancement Multiplier Mod
description: Every advancement doubles your drop multiplier. 120 advancements = 4.6 quintillion drops per block.
body:
# Advancement Multiplier

**Every advancement you earn doubles your drops. Permanently.**

Start with 1x. Kill a mob: 2x. Mine stone: 4x. Craft a diamond pickaxe: 8x. By the time you've cleared the End, you're drowning in millions of items per drop. Get all 120 tracked advancements and you hit **4.6 quintillion** multiplier.

---

## How It Works

Each of the **120 tracked advancements** across Adventure, End, Husbandry, Nether, and Story adds one doubling to your multiplier. The math is simple: `2^n` where `n` is your advancement count.

| Advancements | Multiplier |
|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | 2x |
| 5 | 32x |
| 10 | 1,024x |
| 20 | 1.0Mx |
| 30 | 1.1Bx |
| 40 | 1.1Tx |
| 50 | 1.1Qx |
| 62+ | 4.6Qix (max) |

The multiplier applies to **all loot**: mob kills, block breaks, fishing, chest loot, and more. The more advancements you earn, the more absurd it gets.

---

## Features

- **Exponential scaling**: each advancement exactly doubles your multiplier, no diminishing returns
- **Bossbar display**: always-visible multiplier tracker with clean K / M / B / T / Q / Qi formatting
- **Scoreboard integration**: `adv.count` and `multiplier.max` objectives auto-created for datapack use
- **Cascade drop fix**: beds, doors, and tall plants both drop multiplied (the auto-broken half is covered too)
- **Death protection**: your own death drops are never multiplied
- **Relog safe**: stacks survive save/reload via a codec range patch; nothing disappears on world close
- **Resync command**: `/advmultiplier recalculate` to force a full recount if anything desyncs

---

## Tracked Advancements

All **120 vanilla advancements** across five categories are tracked:

- **Adventure**: 46 advancements
- **End**: 8 advancements
- **Husbandry**: 29 advancements
- **Nether**: 22 advancements
- **Story**: 15 advancements (root excluded)

Root advancements (`story/root`, `nether/root`, `end/root`) are intentionally excluded as they grant automatically without player action.

---

## Stack Size

This mod includes the same codec and container stack-size patches as the standalone [Unlimited Stacks Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/unlimited-stacks-mod). If you're using both, they are fully compatible (the patches are identical and Mixin handles deduplication cleanly).

---

## Compatibility

| | |
|---|---|
| **Minecraft** | 26.1.2 |
| **Loader** | Fabric 0.19.2+ |
| **API** | Fabric API required |
| **Side** | Required on both client and server |
| **Java** | 25+ |

---

## For Server Operators

The scoreboard objectives `adv.count` and `multiplier.max` are created automatically on server start. You can reference `multiplier.max` from datapacks or command blocks to read the current multiplier for the `#multiplier` fake player.

The `/advmultiplier recalculate` command recounts all tracked advancements from scratch, useful after `/advancement grant` commands or if a player's score desyncs.

---

## Known issue (unresolved)

Once your multiplier pushes a drop's true count past what a 32-bit stack can represent (~2.1 billion, around advancement 31+), splitting, dragging, or merging that stack in your inventory can leave the number on the stack not matching what you actually have. Minecraft's stack count is a 32-bit number, and multiplier values in the billions/quintillions blow straight past it. I've been unable to find a fix that doesn't reintroduce other breakage, and there's no ETA on one.

Workaround: avoid manually splitting or dragging mega-stacks in your inventory. Placing/using blocks normally, and picking up fresh drops, is unaffected.

title: NeoLogin
description: Secure NeoForge auth mod with SHA-256, on-screen UI, spectator lock, anti-grief, multi-language (EN/RU) and admin TPS/Ping monitor.
body:
# NeoLogin - Mod Description
# NeoLogin is a lightweight, high-performance, and secure authorization mod for Minecraft servers running on NeoForge 1.21.1. The mod protects player accounts on offline-mode (cracked) servers by requiring authentication upon joining.

It is designed with a focus on stability under load, log security, and ease of administration.

Key Features
Flexible Database Storage: Out-of-the-box support for local SQLite storage (does not require any configuration) and remote MySQL database support for multi-server networks.
Database Backup and Migration: Built-in commands to export and import player databases in JSON format. This allows easy backups and seamless migration between SQLite and MySQL when scaling up the server.
Pre-auth Player Locking: Unauthenticated players are temporarily switched to Spectator mode and their movement is fully restricted. They cannot move, send chat messages, execute commands, interact with the world, or take damage.
Console Log Security: Automatic filtering of player passwords in console logs. During authentication or registration commands, passwords in console outputs are replaced with a secure mask (***).
Offline Player Management: Ability to reset passwords or unregister accounts even when the target player is not currently online.
Automatic Config Migrator: Internal version tracking automatically updates the structure of the configuration file upon mod updates, preventing broken configurations and duplicate parameter bugs.
## Mod Commands
## Player Commands
- /register <password> <confirm_password> - Register a new account.
- /login <password> - Authenticate upon joining the server.
- /changepassword <old_password> <new_password> - Change your current account password.
## Admin Commands (Requires permission neologin.admin or OP Level 2)
##
- /neologin backup - Export the entire player database to a JSON backup file.
- /neologin backups - List all available backup files on the server.
- /neologin restore <filename> - Import player accounts from a selected backup file.
- /neologin unregister <player> - Delete a player account, resetting their registration status.
- /neologin setpassword <player> <new_password> - Forcefully set a new password for a player.
- /neologin reload - Reload configuration file settings without restarting the server.
Database Configuration
The configuration file is located at config/neologin-server.toml. You can configure the database type and connection parameters in the database block:


```
  [Database]
  	Type of database to use. Allowed values: 'sqlite' or 'mysql'.
  	databaseType = "sqlite"
 	Connection parameters (only used when databaseType is 'mysql')
 	mysqlHost = "localhost"
 	mysqlPort = 3306
	mysqlDatabase = "neologin"
	mysqlUsername = "root"
	mysqlPassword = "password"
```

# T28's Universal Veinminer v1.0.2

A simple, lightweight, and highly configurable universal Veinminer mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1.

## Features

- **Universal Veinmining:** Mine entire veins of ores by simply breaking one block while crouching (`Sneak`).
- **Smart Detection:** Automatically detects ores using two methods for maximum compatibility:
  - **By Tag:** Recognizes blocks with the Forge Tag `forge:ores`.
  - **By Name:** Automatically identifies any block with `_ore` in its ID, ensuring out-of-the-box compatibility with most modded ores.
- **Vanilla Integration:**
  - Fully respects **Fortune** and **Silk Touch** enchantments.
  - **Special Ancient Debris Handling:** Drops Netherite Scraps directly, with extra drops from Fortune!
  - Accurately drops the corresponding experience orbs.
  - Properly damages your tool for every block mined (respects **Unbreaking** enchantment natively).
  - Safety first: Automatically stops before your tool breaks (leaves 1 durability point).
  - Applies balanced player exhaustion for every block mined.
- **Highly Configurable (In-Game):**
  - **Toggle Key:** Use a dedicated keybinding (default 'V') to quickly enable or disable the Veinminer functionality on the fly, with on-screen action bar notifications.
  - **Custom Blocks (Commands):** Easily add or remove any block to the veinminer list using in-game commands with native auto-completion (Requires OP Level 2):
    - `/universalveinminer addblock <modid:block_id>`
    - `/universalveinminer removeblock <modid:block_id>`
    - `/universalveinminer listblocks`
  - **Block Limit:** Set a maximum limit of blocks to mine in a single action via the config file (`universalveinminer-common.toml`) to prevent server lag (default is 64, max 1024).
- **Localization Support:** Includes English (`en_us`) and Spanish (`es_es`) translations.

## What's New in 1.0.2?
- **Smart Ore Detection:** The mod now automatically detects any block with `_ore` in its name, providing instant compatibility with most modded ores.
- **Mining Focus:** Veinmining functionality for logs/trees has been removed to focus exclusively on a streamlined mining experience.

## Setup

Simply drop the `.jar` file into your `mods` folder and launch the game.

## Requirements

- Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

Daily Interest: The unique interest system rewards active teams. Teams earn daily passive interest on their bank balance, starting at 0.5% at Level 1 and scaling up to 2.0% at Level 10.

Expandable Team Storage
A shared team vault to store valuable resources.
Level-Based Unlocks: The storage starts small. As the team levels up, more slots in the GUI automatically unlock, giving room for more loot.

Team Headquarters (Home)
Set a central meeting point for your clan.
Team Home: Owners can /team sethome.
Quick Travel: Members can use /team home with a configurable warmup timer to teleport to their base instantly.

⚔️ Powerful Gameplay Perks (Buffs)
Being in a high-level team has real benefits. Members receive permanent potion effects as long as they remain in the team.
Examples: Speed I at lower levels, progressing to buffs like Haste, Resistance, and eventually Strength & Regeneration at Level 10.

✨ Visual Particle Auras
Show off your team's status. Members emit unique particle effects around them. The aura changes and becomes more impressive as the team reaches higher milestones (e.g., Villager sparkles to Flame to Dragon Breath).
⚡ Zero-Lag Performance
Built for modern servers. All data saving (banks, homes, storage) is handled asynchronously to ensure your server TPS never drops, even with hundreds of active teams.

️ Commands & Permissions
ProTeams features a Dynamic Help Menu. Just type /team or /team help.
Normal players only see the commands they can use.
Admins see the complete list, including moderation tools.

Player Commands

/team create <name> Start a new team.
/team join <name> Join an existing team.
/team leave Leave your current team.
/team menu Open the main team GUI dashboard.
/team info [name] View detailed stats of your team or another team.
/team storage Open the shared team vault.
/team bank Check bank balance and deposit/withdraw.
/team home Teleport to the team headquarters.
/team sethome Set the team home location (Owner only).
/team toggleparticles Turn your personal team particle aura on/off.

Admin Commands
(Requires permission: proteams.admin)

/team setlevel <team> <lvl> Super-Power: Instantly set a team's level and refresh all their perks (Storage, buffs, etc.) instantly.
/team delete <team> Forcefully disband and delete any team.
/team storage <team> Admin spy: Open any
team's storage.
/team menu <team> Admin spy: Open any team's main menu.

title: TurtleLib
description: Shared helper library for my and your Fabric/NeoForge mods. I use it in my own mods, but you can use it for your own mods also.
body:
A lightweight helper library for Minecraft mods on Fabric and NeoForge. TurtleLib does not add gameplay on its own — it provides shared technical systems used by other mods.

TurtleLib is a dependency library designed to keep mod code cleaner and more reusable across loaders.If a mod requires TurtleLib, it must be installed in the same `mods/` folder.

## Features ✨

- Locale loading and synchronization (`LangLoader`)
- Localized message formatting (`MessageService`)
- Provider-based update checks (`UpdateChecker`)
- Deterministic version comparison (`VersionComparator`)
- Shared behavior across Fabric and NeoForge modules

## Quick Start (Players) 🚀

1. Download the TurtleLib version that matches your Minecraft/loader version.
2. Put the TurtleLib JAR into your Minecraft `mods/` folder.
3. Add the dependent mod(s) that require TurtleLib.
4. Start the game normally.

> If TurtleLib is missing, dependent mods may fail to load.

## License 📄

Apache-2.0

title: Item Chestshop
description: The only chestshop plugin with items, not $
body:
ItemChestShop
The most flexible item-to-item chest shop plugin - no economy required!

A modern Minecraft plugin for creating chest shops that trade items directly for items. No Vault, no currency, no complicated setup. Just place a chest, add a sign, and start trading. Built with intelligent parsing that understands over 10 different input formats and 200+ item aliases.

✨ KEY FEATURES

No Economy Required - Trade items directly for items, no currency system needed
Ultra-Flexible Parsing - Supports 10+ different input formats for maximum convenience
200+ Item Aliases - Recognizes common abbreviations and alternative item names
Smart Item Recognition - Understands partial names, case variations, and shortcuts
All Minecraft Items - Supports every vanilla Minecraft item automatically
✅ Simple Setup - Just place a chest and sign - no complex configuration
Permission System - Configurable access control for shops
⚙️ Admin Tools - Management commands and statistics tracking
Modern API - Built with Adventure API for future compatibility
Statistics - Track sales, purchases, and shop performance
REQUIREMENTS

Minecraft Server 1.21.4
Paper server (Spigot compatible but Paper recommended)
Java 17 or higher
No economy plugin needed!
No additional dependencies required!




⚙️ INSTALLATION

Download the latest ItemChestShop-1.0.0-shaded.jar file
Place the JAR in your server's plugins/ folder
Restart your server
The plugin will automatically generate a config.yml in plugins/ItemChestShop/
Players can immediately start creating shops!
No configuration needed - it works out of the box!

QUICK START GUIDE

Creating Your First Shop:

Place a chest where you want your shop
Place a sign on or near the chest (within 2 blocks)
Write on the sign:
[SHOP]
YourUsername
Want: 1 Diamond
Give: 64 Bread
The sign will automatically format and validate
Stock your chest with bread
Your shop is ready!
Using Shops:

Right-click the sign to make a purchase
Shift + Right-click (or left-click) to view shop information
You must have the required items to trade
You cannot buy from your own shops
That's it! No complicated setup, no economy plugin, just simple item trading.

FLEXIBLE SHOP FORMATS

One of the most powerful features - the plugin understands MANY different ways to write the same trade!

All These Formats Work for the Same Trade (64 Bread ↔ 1 Diamond):

Want: 1 Diamond Want: Diamond 1 Want: 1 dia
Give: 64 Bread Give: Bread x64 Give: 64x bread

Want: 1*Diamond Want: Diamond*1 Want: DIAMOND
Give: Bread 64 Give: 64*Bread Give: bread x64

Want: 1 x Diamond Want: Diamond * 1 Want: dia 1
Give: 64 x Bread Give: Bread*64 Give: bread 64
Supported Input Patterns:

Space-separated: 1 Diamond or Diamond 1
X-notation: 64x Bread or Bread x64
Asterisk notation: 5*Iron or Iron*5
No amount: Diamond (defaults to 1)
Case insensitive: diamond, DIAMOND, Diamond
Flexible spacing: Extra spaces are ignored
Multi-word items: Oak Log, Iron Ingot, Cooked Beef
Mix and Match:

You can use different formats on each line:

[SHOP]
PlayerName
Want: Diamond 1
Give: 64x Bread
SUPPORTED ITEMS

✅ ALL Minecraft Items Supported

The plugin recognizes every vanilla Minecraft item with intelligent parsing:

Full Material Support:

Blocks: Stone, Cobblestone, Oak_Log, Diamond_Block, Glass, Sand
Items: Diamond, Iron_Ingot, Stick, String, Leather, Paper
Ores: Iron_Ore, Gold_Ore, Diamond_Ore, Emerald_Ore, Coal_Ore
Tools: Diamond_Sword, Iron_Pickaxe, Golden_Axe, Bow, Fishing_Rod
Weapons: Sword, Bow, Crossbow, Trident, Arrow
Food: Bread, Apple, Cooked_Beef, Golden_Apple, Cake
Rails: Rail, Powered_Rail, Detector_Rail, Activator_Rail
Redstone: Redstone, Repeater, Comparator, Piston, Dispenser
Smart Name Recognition:

The plugin is incredibly flexible with item names:

Exact Names (All Work):

DIAMOND_SWORD (uppercase)
diamond_sword (lowercase)
Diamond Sword (spaces)
Diamond_Sword (underscores)
Common Aliases (200+ Built-in):

Wood → Oak_Log
Stone → Cobblestone
Iron → Iron_Ingot
Gold → Gold_Ingot
Dia → Diamond
Eme → Emerald
Cobble → Cobblestone
Pearl → Ender_Pearl
Partial Matching:

Diamond finds Diamond
Dia matches Diamond
Eme matches Emerald
Rail finds Rail
Cart finds Minecart
Pick matches Iron_Pickaxe
Sword matches Iron_Sword
Auto-Completion:

Iron → Iron_Ingot
Gold → Gold_Ingot
Oak → Oak_Log
Cooked → Cooked_Beef
ULTRA-FLEXIBLE FORMATTING

Multiple Amount Formats:

Every format style works:

1 Diamond (space before)
Diamond 1 (space after)
64x Bread (x before amount)
Bread x64 (x after item)
5*Iron_Ingot (asterisk before)
Iron_Ingot*5 (asterisk after)
32 Oak Log (multi-word items)
Oak Log 32 (reversed)
Diamond (no amount = 1)
Case & Spacing Flexibility:

Case insensitive: diamond, DIAMOND, Diamond, DiAmOnD
Space variations: Oak Log, Oak_Log, OakLog, OAKLOG
Extra spaces ignored: 1 Diamond works fine
Underscores optional: Iron_Ingot = Iron Ingot
Common Abbreviations Work:

Dia → Diamond
Eme → Emerald
Cobble → Cobblestone
Pick → Iron_Pickaxe
Sword → Iron_Sword
Cart → Minecart
Pearl → Ender_Pearl
Wood → Oak_Log
COMMANDS

All basic commands are available to players with the itemchestshop.use permission (default: everyone).

Player Commands:

/itemchestshop help - Display all available commands and usage /itemchestshop info - Show plugin version and information /itemchestshop stats - View your personal shop statistics /itemchestshop list [page] - Browse all shops on the server /itemchestshop find <item> - Search for shops selling a specific item

Admin Commands:

/itemchestshop reload - Reload the plugin configuration

Command Examples:

/itemchestshop find Diamond
Lists all shops selling diamonds

/itemchestshop list 2
Shows page 2 of all active shops

/itemchestshop stats
Shows your trading statistics

/itemchestshop help
Displays command help
Command Aliases:

You can use /ics as a shortcut:

/ics help
/ics find Iron
/ics stats
/ics list
PERMISSIONS

&]:eek:dd:bg-bg-500/10">Permission Description Default
&]:eek:dd:bg-bg-500/10">itemchestshop.create Allow creating chest shops Everyone
&]:eek:dd:bg-bg-500/10">itemchestshop.use Allow using chest shops and commands Everyone
&]:eek:dd:bg-bg-500/10">itemchestshop.admin Allow admin commands and breaking others' shops OP only

Setting Up Permissions:

For LuckPerms:

/lp group default permission set itemchestshop.create true
/lp group default permission set itemchestshop.use true
/lp group admin permission set itemchestshop.admin true
For PermissionsEx:

/pex group default add itemchestshop.create
/pex group default add itemchestshop.use
/pex group admin add itemchestshop.admin
SHOP EXAMPLES

Example 1: Basic Food Shop

[SHOP]
PlayerName
Want: 5 Iron
Give: 64 Bread
Trade 5 Iron Ingots for 64 Bread

Example 2: Using Abbreviations

[SHOP]
Steve
Want: 1 dia
Give: 32x cobble
Trade 1 Diamond for 32 Cobblestone

Example 3: Mixed Formats

[SHOP]
Alex
Want: Emerald * 2
Give: Oak Log 128
Trade 2 Emeralds for 128 Oak Logs

Example 4: Tool Trading

[SHOP]
Miner
Want: 10 Diamond
Give: 1 Diamond_Pickaxe
Trade 10 Diamonds for 1 Diamond Pickaxe (enchant it for premium value!)

Example 5: Using Aliases

[SHOP]
Farmer
Want: 16 wheat
Give: 8x bread
Convert raw wheat to processed bread

Example 6: High-Value Rare Items

[SHOP]
Blacksmith
Want: 64 dia
Give: Netherite_Ingot
Premium shop for rare materials

HOW IT WORKS

Shop Creation Process:

Player places sign on/near chest with format: [SHOP], username, Want:, Give:
Plugin parses item names using intelligent matching (checks aliases, partial names, case variations)
Plugin validates amounts and ensures items exist
Sign is automatically formatted with colors
Shop is registered in database with owner information
Shop is ready to use!
Transaction Process:

Buyer right-clicks shop sign
Plugin checks buyer has required "Want" items in inventory
Plugin checks shop chest has "Give" items in stock
Plugin verifies buyer has inventory space for items
Items are safely exchanged between inventories
Shop owner is notified of the sale
Transaction is logged for statistics
Safety Features:

Transaction rollback if any step fails
Automatic validation before any changes
Permission checks before modifications
Stock verification
Inventory space verification
Prevents item loss or duplication
Intelligent Parsing:

The plugin uses advanced parsing to understand many formats:

Tries exact material name match first
Falls back to alias lookup (200+ aliases)
Checks partial name matches
Case-insensitive throughout
Handles spaces, underscores, and special characters
Supports amount-first or amount-last formats
Recognizes x-notation and asterisk notation
⚙️ CONFIGURATION

The plugin creates a config.yml file with customizable options:

yaml
# Maximum shops per player (0 = unlimited)
max_shops_per_player: 10

# Enable debug logging
debug: false

# Message customization
messages:
prefix: "&8[&6ItemChestShop&8]&r "
shop_created: "&aShop created successfully!"
shop_removed: "&cShop removed!"
transaction_success: "&aTransaction complete!"
insufficient_stock: "&cThis shop is out of stock!"
insufficient_funds: "&cYou don't have enough items!"
no_space: "&cNot enough inventory space!"
cannot_buy_own: "&cYou cannot buy from your own shop!"

# Item aliases (add custom shortcuts)
item_aliases:
wood: oak_log
gold: gold_ingot
iron: iron_ingot
dia: diamond
eme: emerald
cobble: cobblestone
Configuration Options:

max_shops_per_player - Limit shops per player (0 = unlimited)
debug - Enable detailed console logging
messages - Customize all player messages
item_aliases - Add custom item name shortcuts
Color codes: &a green, &c red, &e yellow, &6 gold
CONFIGURATION TIPS

Limiting Shops Per Player:

yaml
max_shops_per_player: 5
Custom Server Messages:

yaml
messages:
prefix: "&8[&b&lMarket&8]&r "
shop_created: "&a&l✓ &aShop opened!"
transaction_success: "&a&l✓ &aTrade complete!"
Adding Custom Aliases:

yaml
item_aliases:
log: oak_log
plank: oak_planks
pick: diamond_pickaxe
sword: diamond_sword
cart: minecart
Debug Mode for Troubleshooting:

yaml
debug: true
Shows detailed parsing and transaction logs in console.

TROUBLESHOOTING

Shop Not Creating:

Verify sign format: Line 1 must be [SHOP]
Check Lines 2-4 have username, Want:, and Give:
Ensure item names are valid (try abbreviations like dia for diamond)
Confirm chest is within 2 blocks of sign
Check player has itemchestshop.create permission
Items Not Recognized:

Try common aliases: dia, eme, wood, iron, gold
Use partial names: Diamond works, Dia works, D might not
Check spelling (case doesn't matter)
Enable debug mode to see parsing attempts
Use underscores for multi-word: Oak_Log or Oak Log
Transaction Failing:

Ensure shop chest has items in stock
Verify buyer has required payment items
Check buyer has inventory space
Make sure chest isn't full (for receiving payment)
Review console for specific error messages
"No Permission" Errors:

Verify itemchestshop.use permission is set
Try giving player OP temporarily to test
Check permission plugin is loaded
Reload permissions: /lp reloadconfig or similar
Signs Not Formatting:

Ensure first line is exactly [SHOP]
Check Want: and Give: have colons
Try different item name formats
Enable debug mode to see parsing errors
DEBUG MODE

yaml
debug: true
Debug Output Shows:

Sign creation attempts and validation
Item name parsing (tried names, aliases, matches)
Amount parsing (formats tested)
Transaction steps and outcomes
Permission checks
Stock verification
Inventory calculations
Error messages with details
Using Debug Mode:

Enable in config.yml
Run /itemchestshop reload
Try creating a shop
Check console for detailed logs
Share logs when asking for support
ADVANCED FEATURES

Flexible Amount Parsing:

The plugin accepts amounts in many formats:

64 (number only)
x64 (x-prefix)
64x (x-suffix)
*64 (asterisk-prefix)
64* (asterisk-suffix)
No amount (defaults to 1)
Smart Item Matching:

Priority order for item recognition:

Exact material name match (e.g., DIAMOND)
Alias lookup (e.g., dia → DIAMOND)
Partial name match (e.g., Diam → DIAMOND)
Case-insensitive comparison throughout
Shop Discovery:

/itemchestshop find Diamond
Returns all shops selling diamonds with prices and owner names

Statistics Tracking:

/itemchestshop stats
Shows your:

Total shops owned
Total sales made
Total purchases
Most traded items
️ TECHNICAL DETAILS

Built With:

Paper API 1.21.4 - Core server framework
Adventure API - Modern text components (bundled with Paper)
Gson 2.10.1 - JSON data storage
Maven - Build automation
Architecture:

Command system with subcommand routing
Event-driven shop interaction (sign events, inventory events)
JSON-based persistent data storage
Transaction rollback support for safety
Full Bukkit permission integration
Intelligent item parsing with multiple fallback strategies
Performance:

Lightweight event handling (only active when signs are placed/used)
Efficient shop lookup system
Minimal memory footprint
No database required (JSON files)
Fast item name parsing with caching
Recent Updates:

✅ Modernized to Adventure API (no deprecated methods)
✅ Enhanced item parsing with 200+ aliases
✅ Flexible format support (10+ input patterns)
✅ Improved error handling and validation
✅ Future-proof for Paper updates
✅ Shaded JAR with all dependencies included
SUPPORT

Having issues? Follow these steps:

Check the troubleshooting section above
Try using item aliases: dia, eme, wood, iron
Enable debug mode in config.yml for detailed logs
Verify you're running Paper 1.21.4 with Java 17+
Check console logs for specific error messages
Test with OP permissions first
Common Conflicts:

Other chest shop plugins (uninstall competing plugins)
Protection plugins blocking sign placement (add shop regions)

# 👻 Soulbound: Afterlife Awakened

> _In death, you were chosen._

**Soulbound: Afterlife Awakened** thrusts you into a world where dying is not the end — it’s just the beginning of your second life. Death leads to spiritual awakening. You return as a wandering spirit, free from flesh, bound to the unseen.

---

## ☠️ Key Features

- **Spirit after death**: Death is inevitable. Respawn as a ghostly soul and roam the world in spirit form.
- **Haunting the Living**: As a spirit, you can **possess mobs**, control them, and use their powers — from zombies to skeletons and more.
- **Rich, Atmospheric World**: Graveyards, cursed biomes, and ambient terror await — enhanced by mods like *The Graveyard*.
- **Proximity Voice Chat**: Whisper to other souls... or scream across realms.
- **Play with Friends**: Host your own world, invite friends, and explore the afterlife together — whether as allies or rival spirits.

---

## 🍎 How to Return to Life

Even in death, there is hope.

To become **mortal again**, use a classic ritual — just like with zombie villagers:

1. Drink a **Potion of Weakness**
2. Eat a **Golden Apple**
3. Wait… and rise once more, reborn in flesh.

Other players can also revive you with this method — cooperation or betrayal is in your hands.

---

## 🧿 Recommended For

- Players who love dark fantasy, undead mechanics, and twisted survival experiences
- Roleplay lovers looking for a deep, death-aware world
- Multiplayer servers or friends playing together on LAN / Hosted World

---

**You are bound to the spirit realm...  
But will you break free, or rule from the shadows?**

title: Advanced Teleporters
description: Adds vanilla progression friendly teleporting systems to the game.
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf98a76450d8061a7872cded9fe06f1acd770f89.png)


**Whats new ?**

Now players can craft and place teleporters to teleport and save their coordinations. There are 4+1 teleporters and a remote device that players can use. It's a mod I made with the hope that it will give the player a sense of progress that will not bore them throughout the general progression of the game with useful and easy to understand mechanics.

 ![img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7de64c5d48b2f212f96f0121297ceaf9c581f01e.png) 

**How does teleporters work ? - Main teleporters**

Main teleporters are expensive machines, of which there are 4: copper, gold, diamond and netherite. The player can connect to the teleporter system by clicking on any of the main machines.Player opens the teleporter UI according to the tier of the machine they last interacted with; these levels are important because with each increasing level, you gain +3 save & teleport slots. Forexample diamond teleporter has 9 teleport slots and netherite teleporter has 12.

 

 

**How does teleporters work ? - Side teleporters**

Side teleporters are machines that are cheaper than the main teleporters but do not have any level value. Which means after connecting to a main&host teleporter player can place down these cheaper teleporters to teleport around. Players who doesnt have a main connection will going to have "There is no host connection." message after interacting with it.

 

 

**How does teleporters work ? - Teleporter remote control**

This handheld device works similarly to side teleporters, which means again it doesn't have its own level value so if player didn't interacted with a main teleporter before they will going to have "Teleporter remote control is offline." message after interacting with it. However unlike main&side teleporters,handheld devices cannot save coordinates in order to teleport back to the same place and they consume 1x dimension pearl per teleportation. Dimension pearls can be crafted with 4x ender pearls and 1x lapis luzili in the crafting table.

**Quick Note:** After crafting Teleporter remote control it will be on its "offline" stage which you need to click to a main teleporter with it in order to use. 

**JEI and Netherite Portal Frame Craft bug**

For some reason JEI shows Netherite Portal Frame is crafted with another "Netherite Portal Frame" instead of Diamond Portal Frame. Sorry for the confusion but there is not really much i can that i know to fix that. Craft itself is still correct, it doesnt require another Netherite Portal Frame to begin with its still 1x Motherboard, 1x Diamond Portal Frame, 1x Netherite as always.

title: We Like Those Ores
description: This mod adds new ores with a vanilla+ feel, enhancing the game without breaking its balance.
body:
![We Like That Ores Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/986462ad97cd736c895cf2e95cd5c9e4697ccdef.png)

Why does this mod exist? Aren't there already thousands of ore mods out there? Yes, they exist. But most end up adding elements that unbalance the game and ruin the vanilla Minecraft experience, or have a completely different look than vanilla.

We Like Those Ores is another "expansion", as it aims to enrich the vanilla experience without exaggeration. Each ore or resource is designed to be balanced while staying true to the style of the original game.

Vanilla Minecraft only has a few minerals, and mining is one of the things we do most in the game, this mod fixes that, you mine and then make blocks, armor and tools similar to what you already have in the game.

This mod is also specific to the Forge 1.20.1 version, and another reason is because I like creating mods and I will dedicate myself to bringing something good to the community, just like so many other mods out there.

I recommend using this mod with other very well made mods that modify the terrain and or add ores such as Terralith, Biomes o Plenty, Quark, SimpleOres.

![wulfenite-block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dad94faad5ab9ae320b8268cb7bb4f6d0558189f.png) **ATTENTION! Make sure to always download the latest version of the mod to avoid bugs as much as possible.**

This is the beginning of the mod, more ores will be added soon!

![Lushite Update 0.6](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85241793bb97198731048004e327891f38c83388.png)

New version 0.6 of We Like Those Ores, brings a new ore "Lushite", new items, decorative blocks, a new armor and of course, bugs fixed.

Lushite is a rare ore that can only be found in lush cave biomes, this ore is a type of powder that can be combined with niobium to form an alloy called lushiobium, used to upgrade niobium armor and make decorative blocks. image

![lushite recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4be5930cae69740d173c451492f4aa64e7d2973a.gif)

I'll be honest, I wanted to make the upgrade work like the diamond to netherite upgrade in the game, where you can only find the upgrade form in a certain location, in this case it would be in abandoned mines, but after more than 1 hour trying to make it work in MCreator it didn't work. ![lushite upgrade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/937fce11cf7fc8e7632164a5e1ae5ccd9b3c9165.png)

I got it due to bugs, but at least I did something very similar. Mix niobium ingots and lushite powder on the workbench and make the item to upgrade your niobium armor to lushiobium, place the upgrade on a smithing table along with the armor piece and another lushite powder and that's it, you now have a armor similar to netherite. ![lushite dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1d4c67e9e00e2438b1d960e88ec31ab9665840d.png)

![niobium grid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31596e446d7c2acb7f566e87a2cebaf211f8fcce_0.webp) ![lushite grid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d15362f4f743633c1dc3fa900f6e99a99c1a83bb_0.webp) And also, I bring new decorative grid blocks inspired by the new Minecraft 1.21 update, which I recommend using This Mod to port the update to our 1.20.1 version.

![niobium](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34dbf2f338d9ea234214abf388ba01e58d8341c8.png)

Niobium is an ore that has better enchantment and efficiency than diamond and netherite, but has lower damage and durability.

![niobium recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e706d7d5a01d27377d76a544c92a331de0255c4.gif)

Niobium is rare and can be found in basically the same layers as diamond, and its distribution is also similar to that of diamond. Its whitish-gray appearance is very similar to iron. To find it, look between -60 and 20.

![ignisium](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee9f48e8bc1716f0936dccf9280ad74b50da1e55.png)

Ignisium is a mineral present in the Nether that stands out for its durability, however it does not have much efficiency, damage and enchantability.

![ignisium recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07f27488b4f09bd2cfa2b924590642726f4e9772.gif)

It's not that difficult to find. Its black-orange appearance is very reminiscent of a volcano. Find between layers 0 and 64.

![wulfenite ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68e939ee184340d913d3750504176ad49c937a93.png)

Wulfenite is an orange crystal that is prized for its beauty.

![wulfenite recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/848792e964f42a54a5f70a4bc43e817f460d8057.gif)

Its characteristics are similar to those of iron and gold, it is more efficient and has less durability. You can find it between layers 6 and 47.

![cobaltite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16f54760d3b1f9c444ae5db39cf30d9c8779d7c1.png)

This is an ore similar to iron but has a bluish color, great for decoration and you can also use it as tools and armor. You'll only find it if you go really deep, between -64 and -12.

![cobaltite recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce5b427d5069a41dfeebed0268d8e9ca4314bfa3.gif)

![Small Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91d2dbc7c5160a81fdeda79437198c939047aac8_0.webp) ![Small Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91d2dbc7c5160a81fdeda79437198c939047aac8_0.webp) ![Small Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91d2dbc7c5160a81fdeda79437198c939047aac8_0.webp) ![Small Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91d2dbc7c5160a81fdeda79437198c939047aac8_0.webp) ![Small Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91d2dbc7c5160a81fdeda79437198c939047aac8_0.webp) ![Small Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91d2dbc7c5160a81fdeda79437198c939047aac8_0.webp) ![Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b43afefbb4bd53aea01dcb9475587cf4d1189708_0.webp) ![Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b43afefbb4bd53aea01dcb9475587cf4d1189708_0.webp) ![Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b43afefbb4bd53aea01dcb9475587cf4d1189708_0.webp) [![Our project on Github](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b15f3704c8b02ed29a7e3a9c182f81700686147_0.webp)](https://github.com/Ko3leta/Amethyst-SkyBlock) ![Small Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91d2dbc7c5160a81fdeda79437198c939047aac8_0.webp) [![Donate us on DonationAlerts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed12c73425ac07e8095b8c44801e8167fefd6342.png)](https://www.donationalerts.com/r/ko3leta) ![Small Empty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91d2dbc7c5160a81fdeda79437198c939047aac8_0.webp) [![Installation Guide](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60560bd4702ae201c460fc9952a87de807e185fe_0.webp)](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1seVshTsOhoCcbvGqgUr9E7IurhMomV2-T-2kiYGvJwk/edit?usp=sharing)

## 🦑 About:

The **Amethyst SkyBlock** DataPack provides an ability to play the most complex and hardcore modification of everyone’s favorite skyblock minigame. Here you have to survive on a block of budding amethyst... You won't need anything else. Here you are alone with emptiness, boredom and monotonous repetition of the same actions. Test your strength, endurance and knowledge in the field of crafts, mobs and drops with this datapack.

## 🎮 Gameplay:

You start with one block below you and empty inventory. Get some amethyst shard and place your first block... Expand your platform, build a mob farm and obtain new and new types of resources, exploring the innovations of this DataPack! **Amethyst SkyBlock** provides the opportunity to go through all stages of the game up to going to the Nether, getting blaze rods and defeating the ender dragon in the End.

## 🌺 Multiplayer:

**Amethyst SkyBlock** allows you to play on the same map with friends. You all can start the game together, or some players can join the game even after you started. The choice is yours!

## 📜 How to play:

You only need to create a new superflat world with "The Void" preset and add this DataPack into it... Thats all! If you couldn’t do it yourself, read the [**Amethyst SkyBlock Installation guide**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1seVshTsOhoCcbvGqgUr9E7IurhMomV2-T-2kiYGvJwk/edit?usp=sharing) (ENG/RUS).

## 🎫 FAQ:

Here you will find a collection of possible questions about the **Amethyst SkyBlock** DataPack:

<details>
<summary>Amethyst SkyBlock compatibility</summary>

**Amethyst SkyBlock** is compatible with most client-side mods. But we cannot guarantee that during the survival with this DataPack, you will be able to get all the resources from the mods or that everything will work correctly.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Content about Amethyst SkyBlock</summary>

You can freely write posts, post screenshots or upload videos about this DataPack on a variety of platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube and any others. If possible, write somewhere an authorship or a link to the original page on [**Modrinth**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/amethyst-skyblock) or [**GitHub**](https://github.com/Ko3leta/Amethyst-SkyBlock).

</details>

## 🧭 Future of Amethyst SkyBlock:

The future of this DataPack remains unclear, since the topic is unpopular... Your feedback will help us decide whether to develop it further or not. In any case, we're planning the following innovations in the future:

- More options
- Some easter eggs
- Gameplay customisation
- More unique crafts and loots
- Special creatures and monsters
- It's hiding in the emptiness, don't look back...

![Something is hiding here](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/586e30558ac5def2492a6c9d5cd3b38bb79f2087_0.webp)

## 💖 Special thanks:

Many thanks to [**Specis**](https://www.youtube.com/@specis7524) for giving a permission to use the idea of the **Amethyst SkyBlock**.

Many thanks to [**HappyTimosha**](https://discord.com/users/842623861254127637) for testing and bugfixing the **Amethyst SkyBlock** DataPack.

### Salutations!

I’m okipiak, an amateur content creator. In this project, I’ve made a selection of (I belive) unique items.

<details>
<summary>Some nerd talk</summary>

Totems are just repeating command block with different texture, and different components.

Food items are just bread with different texture, and different components.

Baguette model is not mine, I took it from [23w13a_or_b snapshot](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_23w13a_or_b).

Cheese concept isn't entirely original; it’s inspired by the [Rats mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/rats).
