title: Actually Vanilla
description: A modpack that improves Performance, Audio, Utility, and Visuals without losing the vanilla experience by only using client-side mods.
body:
Have you ever thought that vanilla Minecraft feels too outdated and laggy? But then when you try those vanilla+ Modpacks they change too much of the game that it doesn't even feel vanilla anymore? Well this Modpack is probably what's right for you. This Modpack improves your gameplay without altering the vanilla style by only adding client-side mods. Adds Performance, Audio, Utility, and Visuals with high configurability.

# **Modlist and Features**
Mods marked with 🔧 are highly recommended to be tweaked with the configurations and settings to suit your preference.
<details>
<summary>Audio</summary>
  
- 🔧[Ambient Sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds) - Adds a rich ambiance to the Minecraft world by adding ambient sounds.
- 🔧[Infinite Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/infinite-music) - Allows changing the delay between Minecraft music playing. 
- [Presence Footsteps](https://modrinth.com/mod/presence-footsteps) - Adds a more varied and rich footsteps SFX.
- [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered) - Provides realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks.
- [Sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound) - Adds a variety of new sound effects and improves existing ones that don't quite fit.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Utility</summary>
  
- [Accurate Block Placement Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/accurate-block-placement-reborn) - Makes block placement smarter by timing it for you.
- [Antique Atlas 4](https://modrinth.com/mod/antique-atlas-4) - Adds an unobtrusive map that doesn't give out too much information that ruins the fun of exploration.
- [Better Third Person](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-third-person) - Allows you to freely rotate the 3rd person camera and walk in 8 directions. 
- [Bridging Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/bridging-mod) - Reacharound Placement / Bedrock Bridging for Fabric, Forge & Quilt with a few extra tweaks
- [Cherished Worlds](https://modrinth.com/mod/cherished-worlds) - adds the ability to favorite/pin/bookmark certain worlds.
- [Click Through 2.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/clickthrough2.0) - Allows you to click through signs, item frames, and wall banners to access chests.
- 🔧[Client Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/client-tweaks) - Adds a bunch of optional tweaks to improve the Quality of Life during gameplay.
- ~~[Controlify](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlify) - Adds controller support.~~ **Temporarily disabled due to bug.**
- [Cubes Without Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders) - Allows you to play Minecraft in a borderless fullscreen window.
- 🔧[Do a Barrel Roll](https://modrinth.com/mod/do-a-barrel-roll) - Changes elytra flight to be more fun and semi-realistic.
- [e4mc](https://modrinth.com/mod/e4mc) - Allows you to host your LAN world as a server to the internet.
- [Fabrishot](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabrishot) - Allows you to take 4K screenshots.
- [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam) - Allows you to control your camera separately from your player.
- [Invmove](https://modrinth.com/mod/invmove) - Enables moving, jumping, sprinting, etc. from within inventories. Also adds blur when inventories are opened.
- [Lightweight Inventory Sorting](https://modrinth.com/mod/lightweight-inventory-sorting) - Adds a simple inventory sorting function.
- [Mixintrace](https://modrinth.com/mod/mixintrace) - Adds a list of mixins to classes in the stack trace to crash reports.
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) - Adds a mod menu allowing you to view and configure mods easily.
- [More Chat History](https://modrinth.com/mod/morechathistory) - Increases the maximum length of the chat history.
- [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) - Replaces the standard RMB dragging mechanic, adds two new LMB dragging mechanics and the ability to quickly move items with the scroll wheel.
- [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports) - Makes chat ureportable when possible.
- [No Resource Pack Warnings](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-resource-pack-warnings) - Get rid of the red borders around outdated resource/data packs and skip pop-up warnings when applying them.
- [Polytone](https://modrinth.com/mod/polytone) - allows tweaking various aspects of the game via Resource Packs.
- [Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options) - Replaces Sodium's Options Screen with intention of improving UX.
- [Resourcify](https://modrinth.com/mod/resourcify) - Allows you to browse all resource packs, data packs, and shaders on Modrinth and CurseForge in Minecraft.
- [RyoamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/ryoamiclights) - Adds dynamic lights without the need for shaders.
- [Your Options Shall Be Respected](https://modrinth.com/mod/yosbr) - Provide default options if the corresponding option file doesn't exist.
- [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify) - Adds a zoom function.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Visuals</summary>

**Blocks**
- [Animatica](https://modrinth.com/mod/animatica) - Allows the Fabric mod loader to load the MCPatcher/OptiFine animated texture format.
- [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) - Allows resource packs that use the OptiFine connected textures format, OptiFine emissive textures forma, or OptiFine custom block layers format to work without OptiFine.

**Environment**
- [Cave Dust](https://modrinth.com/mod/cave-dust) - Adds the white ash particle from the Basalt Deltas biome to the underground to simulate dust.
- [Explosive Enhancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/explosive-enhancement) - Adds a cooler-looking explosion animation.
- [FabricSkyBoxes](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabricskyboxes) - Allows resource packs to define custom skyboxes.
- [FabricSkyBoxes Interop](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabricskyboxes-interop) - FabricSkyBoxes Interoperability for MCPatcher/OptiFine Skies
- [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) - Allows the use of shaders.
- 🔧[Particular](https://modrinth.com/mod/particular) - Enhances Minecraft's ambiance with many visual effects.
- [RyoamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/ryoamiclights) - LambDynamicLights unofficial architectury port. A dynamic lights mod for Minecraft.
- [Satin Free Wakes](https://modrinth.com/mod/satin-free-wakes) - Satin free version of the Wakes mod. Which adds splashes and wakes while traveling on water. 3x fps of normal version.
- 🔧[Visuality](https://modrinth.com/mod/visuality) - improves visuals by adding a bunch of new particles.

**GUI**
- [Advancements Plaques](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancement-plaques) - Replaces advancement popups with something flashier.
- [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) - Improves Food/hunger-related HUD.
- 🔧[Auto HUD](https://modrinth.com/mod/autohud) - Dynamically hides parts of the user interface.
- 🔧[Better F3](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-f3) - This mod reduces clutter on the F3 debug menu.
- [Better Mount HUD](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-mount-hud) - Improves the ingame HUD while riding a mount.
- [Better Stats](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-stats) - Replaces the Vanilla statistics screen with an improved statistics screen that is easier to use.
- 🔧[Dynamic Crosshair](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamiccrosshair) - Hides and changes the crosshair depending on the context.
- [Effect Timer Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/effecttimerplus) - Adds a potency and time indicator overlay to status effect icons.
- [Enhanced Visuals](https://modrinth.com/mod/enhancedvisuals) - Provides a more immersive experience by adding effects to the HUD.
- [Flow](https://modrinth.com/mod/flow) - Adds inventory UI transitions.
- [Held Item Info](https://modrinth.com/mod/held-item-info) - Shows information (like enchantments) about the held item under its name.
- [Immersive UI](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-ui) - Adds animated UI components.
- [Optigui](https://modrinth.com/mod/optigui) - Allows custom GUI resource pack.
- [Paginated Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/paginatedadvancements) - Improves the advancements screen.
- [Pick Up Notifier](https://modrinth.com/mod/pick-up-notifier) - Adds a pickup log, a neat list shown in the corner of your screen.
- [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip) - Allows viewing the contents of shulker boxes from your inventory.
- [Smooth Scrolling](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooth-scroll) - Smoothens out the scrolling animation.


**Items**
- [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn) - Re-implements MCPatcher's CIT.
- [Item Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-borders) - Add colored borders to inventory slots to make your rare items stand out.
- [Item Highlighter](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-highlighter) - Highlights newly picked-up items.
- [Legendary Tooltips](https://modrinth.com/mod/legendary-tooltips) - Adds fancier tooltips for items.
- [Variants CIT](https://modrinth.com/mod/variants-cit) - CIT logic for items with standardized variants.

**Mobs**
- [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) - Allows OptiFine format, Custom Entity Model replacement in resourcepacks.
- [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) - Adds Emissive, Random & Custom texture support for entities in resourcepacks.

**Player**
- 🔧[Camera Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/cameraoverhaul) - Adds movement tilt to the camera.
- [Capes](https://modrinth.com/mod/capes) - Lets you use capes from OptiFine, LabyMod and other cape mods.
- [Eating Animation](https://modrinth.com/mod/eating-animation) - Adds sprite animations for edible and drinkable items.
- [First Person Model](https://modrinth.com/mod/first-person-model) - Enables the third-person Model in first-person.
- 🔧[Not Enough Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations) - Bringing first-person animations to the third-person.
- [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers) - Renders the player skin layer in 3D.
- [YDM's Weapon Master](https://modrinth.com/mod/weaponmaster) - Shows hotbar items on your Character.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Performance and Fixes</summary>

- [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations) - Optimization mod that focuses on things other than rendering.
- [Better Beds](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-beds) - Changes the renderer of the bed to use JSON models instead of a block entity render.
- [Concurrent Chunk Management Engine](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) - A Fabric mod designed to improve the chunk performance of Minecraft.
- [Cull Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/cull-leaves) - Adds culling to leaf blocks, providing a huge performance boost over vanilla.
- [Debugify](https://modrinth.com/mod/debugify) - Fixes Minecraft bugs found on the bug tracker
- [Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps) - Reduce resource usage while Minecraft is in the background or idle.
- [Enhanced Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/ebe) - Reduce block entity FPS lag with almost no compromises, and improve their visuals.
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) - Using async path-tracing to hide Block-/Entities that are not visible.
- [Faster Random](https://modrinth.com/mod/faster-random) - A significantly faster Random Generator implementation for Minecraft, with near vanilla parity.
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) - Memory usage optimizations.
- [FeyTweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/feytweaks) - Mod for optimizing signs and beacons.
- [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) - Speed up immediate mode rendering in Minecraft.
- [Indium](https://modrinth.com/mod/indium) - Sodium addon providing support for the Fabric Rendering API, based on Indigo.
- [Language Reload](https://modrinth.com/mod/language-reload) - Reduces load times and adds fallbacks for languages.
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) - No-compromises game logic/server optimization mod.
- [Model Gap Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modelfix) - Fixes gaps in Block Models and Item Models.
- [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix) - Improves performance, reduces memory usage, and fixes many bugs.
- [Noisium](https://modrinth.com/mod/noisium) - Optimises worldgen performance for a better gameplay experience.
- [Remove Reloading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrls) - Makes resource packs load in the background.
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) - The fastest and most compatible rendering optimization mod for Minecraft.
- [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) - A Sodium addon that adds features that shouldn't be in Sodium.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Libraries</summary>

- [Architectuary API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api) - Required by 'Jamlib' and 'Octolib'.
- [Balm](https://modrinth.com/mod/balm) - Required by 'Client Tweaks'.
- [Cicada](https://modrinth.com/mod/cicada) - Required by 'Do a Barrel Roll'.
- [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) - Required by 'Mod Menu'.
- [CreativeCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/creativecore) - Required by 'Ambient Sounds'.
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - Required to use fabric mod loader.
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) - Required by 'Capes', 'OptiGUI', 'Resourcify', and 'Zoomify'.
- [Forge Config API Port](https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port)Required by 'Puzzles'.
- [Iceberg](https://modrinth.com/mod/iceberg) - Required by 'Advancement Plaques' and 'Legendary Tooltips'.
- [M.R.U.](https://modrinth.com/mod/mru) - Required by 'Flow' and 'Sounds'.
- [ObsidianUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/obsidianui) - Required by 'RyoamicLights'.
- [OctoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/octo-lib) - Required by 'Immersive UI'.
- [oωo (owo-lib)](https://modrinth.com/mod/owo-lib) - Required by 'Particular'.
- [Text Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/mod/placeholder-api) - Placeholder and Text manipulation library for your Minecraft mods.
- [Prism](https://modrinth.com/mod/prism-lib) - Required by 'Legendary Tooltips'.
- [Puzzles Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/puzzles-lib) - Required by 'Pickup Notifier'.
- [Surveyor Map Framework](https://modrinth.com/mod/surveyor) - Required by 'Antique Atlas 4'.
- [TCDCommons API](https://modrinth.com/mod/tcdcommons) - Required by 'Better Statistics Screen'.
- [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) - Required by 'Zoomify', 'Debugify', and 'Controlify'.

</details>

# **Resource Packs**
Packs marked with ⚙️ impact your performance. If you prefer better performance then you should remove it. 

### **Lists in the order it should be loaded in Minecraft**:
<details>
<summary>Texture Packs</summary>
  
- ⚙️ [FancyFast Bushy Leaves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancyfast-bushy-leaves) - Optimized bushy leaves and mangrove roots.

body:
## Introduction

A Create focused Minecraft Modpack about using engineering to solve your problems whilst aiming to be a small modpack for low end computers. "Limited Engineers" is designed for players who love creativity and technical ingenuity, centered around the Create mod and its addons. This modpack challenges you to use mechanical contraptions and sophisticated systems to overcome in-game challenges, providing a fresh, innovative experience in Minecraft.

## Why "Limited Engineers"?

Someone might want to use "Limited Engineers" because it *may* run smoothly on *some* low-end computers while still offering a rich and immersive gameplay experience. The modpack combines the complexity of engineering with performance optimizations, making it accessible for all players. With a variety of mods for creativity, transportation, and technical builds, "Limited Engineers" caters to diverse playstyles and ensures a seamless, engaging experience.

## What's included

This modpack is based around the Create mod and some addons like:
* Create Crafts & Addition
* Create Enchantment Industry
* Create Steam 'n' Rails
* Create: Numustatics + Create: Coins Arise

Additionally, there are some fun mods too:
* Automobility
* Minecraft Transit Railway
* Roadworks

and some non-Create based tech mods:
* Applied Energistics 2
* CC: Tweaked

Finally, there are a few added extra mods (for performance and other reasons):
* Entity Culling (performance)
* Lithium (performance)
* Mod Menu (utility)
* Open Parties and Claims (utility)
* ReplayMod (utility)
* Vanilla Permissions (utility)
* Xaero's Minimap / Worldmap

title: Skologram
description: A Skript addon to add compatability with DecentHolograms
body:
# Skologram

A Skript Addon to add support with Hologram Plugins.

We support [DecentHolograms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/decentholograms).

Here are a few examples of how to use this plugin. In a Skript file:
- If you want to edit a line: `set line 1 of hologram "cat" to "meow"`
- If you want to create a hologram:
```
create a new hologram:
  name: "jumpscare"
  location: 1 meter in front of player
  lines: "&cRAHH!", "&7Get jumpscared!"
```
- You can also hide the hologram! `hide hologram "ghost" from player`

More Examples can be viewed directly inside the source code, and labeled.


## Requires [Skript](https://github.com/SkriptLang/Skript) 2.7.0 or higher to function.

Please suggest syntax ideas in the [Github](https://github.com/keishispl/skologram)! It would help a lot.

For suggestions, you can also suggest them in Github as well!

This plugin was made because I am done with console filling with "This line has been set!", I can barely see the important stuff!

body:
# The Eerie Fog
This datapack changes the way you play survival, making it closer to alpha or beta, where you cannot just sprint through night and mobs being a threat. And that thick fog, watching you, always, giving you that feeling, of not being alone...

![The Fog, is always watching...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d277d1404d38e271e4df04c6f0d90b9b4ea579e.png)
### Description
Overhauls the survival, to be more **difficult**, and **slower** that it is today. Reducing number of **structures**, removing certain **drops** from mobs, removing **sprint** mechanic and **hunger** - making it more like in pre-Beta 1.8 but making it more **balanced**. 

These things above? These are just an introduction to a **creepy**, and **lonely** atmosphere. Completly alone, with **no npcs**, and just **animals** and **monsters**. Check out changelogs for more informations!

### Additional information
- This datapack goes best with **_Optifine_** mod, as it changes the **lightmap** and gives light source **dynamic** option.

- Take your time playing this game; it takes **days** for the events to finally unfold, enabling you to **fully** **immerse** yourself in that world.
  
- **Multiplayer** is available, but can cause some **bugs**, as it's not 100% tested.

### How to setup
1. Install Resource pack (The Eerie Fog Resource pack), that is located with the Datapack.
2. Create new world (This Datapack works best with a brand new world) -> More -> Datapacks 
        -> Open Datapack Folder -> Paste The Eerie Fog Datapack
3. PLAY!

### Links
Check out my Youtube for my other creations!
[https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCov3bJf_7TJ98hu2f8api2g](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCov3bJf_7TJ98hu2f8api2g)

title: Evident's QoL Modpack
description: These are my favorite mods using Fabric Launcher. They change the came completely, streamlining hotkeys and great tools for the hard core player.
body:
This Modpack includes all of my favorite Fabric mods, especially for SMP servers. They change the game completely for the better, streamlining hotkeys, leveling up your UI, and some really great tools for any SMP or solo miners and crafters everywhere. I created this mod for the friends on my SMP world, but wanted to share it with everyone. These are all client sided mods only and none of them require any server side mods to work, so they are safe to use on Vanilla servers. 

All of the mods in this pack are part of the Modrinth Library, if you experience issues with this pack feel free to reach out to me on Discord, **Username: Evident**. For issues with a specific mod, please reach out to the mod creator directly as I will only be updating the Mod Pack to ensure compatibility for the entire list. Some mods might get added or removed/replaced over time as the Minecraft updates. 

### Modlist:

 - **Apple Skin** - Add's Food Saturation to your Health Bar. 
 - **BSL Shaders** - Can be enabled in the video settings, for fancy graphics cards only. 
 - **Better Third Person** - Moves the camera angle of 3rd person to a better angle by default, and gives you more 3rd person control over the camera.
 - **Better F3** - An F3 page with additional information and color coordination. 
 -  **Borderless Mining** - Fullscreen Mode is now Borderless Windowed mode, allowing players with dual screens to click out without the game minimizing all the time. 
 -  **Chat Heads** - See player head in chat!
 -  **Cloth Config API** - API used by mods in this pack
 -  **Clumps** - Improve FPS at XP Farms by clumping together all those balls of XP!
 -  **CraftPresence** - Discord Presence Mod (Might get overwritten by Modrinth's own presence, currently testing)
 -  **Dark Loading Screen** - Customize your loading screen colors, but the default looks great!
 -  **Fabric API** - API used by mods in this pack
 -  **Indium** - Sodium addon mods to use the Fabric Rendering API. 
 -  **Inventory HUD+** - Adds your Inventory, Armor, and Enhancements to your HUD. Fully Customizable.
 -  **Iris** - Adds support for Shaders
 -  **Mod Menu** - Stop looking for the hot keys to get into your mod menu's, now they are just part of your regular menu!
 -  **Mouse Wheelie** - Minecraft controls the way they should have always been... Life changing hotkeys for the serious miner and crafter...
 -  **Quick Menu** Menu for your most common / commands
 -  **Sodium** Major GPU improvements, additional video settings.
 -  **Xaero's Minimap** - A mod with customizable minimap. 
 - **Xaero's World Map** - Adds a world map to your M key. Works with the Minimap for a complete experience.

# AdminWhitelist - Allows players who are not on the whitelist to join the server when an admin is online

![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/LakyLuc/AdminWhitelist?style=flat-square)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL%20v3-yellow?style=flat-square)

## Description
AdminWhitelist is a plugin that allows players who are not whitelisted to join the server, but only if an admin is online.
Players that are not whitelisted will be kicked if no admins are online.
This is useful for servers that want to be open to the public, but don't want to be overrun by griefers.

## Installation
- Put the plugin in the `plugins` folder of your server
- Start the server
- Add players to the admin list with `/adminwhitelist add <UUID>`
- Turn on the whitelist with `/whitelist on`
- Add players to the whitelist with `/whitelist add <player>`
- Reload the whitelist with `/whitelist reload` after making changes

## Commands
`/adminwhitelist add <UUID>` (`/awl add <UUID>`) - Adds a player to the admin list

`/adminwhitelist remove <UUID>` (`/awl remove <UUID>`) - Removes a player from the admin list

`/adminwhitelist list` (`/awl list`) - Lists all players on the admin list

The commands must be run in the server console.

## Permissions

`adminwhitelist.update` - Receive a notification when a new version is available

title: SnapStone
description: Use redstone with a snap of your fingers.
body:
This mod adds two Redstone blocks; the Snap Detector and the Toggled Snap Detector. The Snap Detector emits a Redstone pulse when a player presses the configurable keybind ( by default, H ). The Toggled Snap Detector does the same but toggles on and off like a lever.

 

When a player snaps using the keybind, all detectors within 15 blocks trigger. If you place a comparator near a Snap or Toggled Snap Detector, it will output how far away the snap originated.

 

Other players on servers can also hear your snaps.

 

This project requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).


This mod is a Llamarama Team mod. Consider following us on [Github](https://github.com/LlamaramaTeam) and checking out our other mods!

It's yet another modpack that batches a bunch of optimization mods into one with mods that fixes bugs and improve the visual and audio design of the game in ways that suit the way a "modern" style within Vanilla without adding new gameplay content alongside the added bonus of controller support; Thus providing the ideal vanilla experience!

## Will Ideal Vanilla recieve updates be on the latest Minecraft Versions?
In the due time of all the mods included (or alternatives) coming to the latest versions, yes!

This is my goal in the longterm to be capable of providing this modpack for many versions to come for as long as I'm capable of doing so! _afterall... this is a one person developed modpack_

The current plan is release ALPHA builds of the modpack as soon as possible with the "baseline" mods for optimization and visuals, once this has been done a ALPHA build of the latest minecraft version for this modpack will release, as more and more mods release bringing it closer to the prior full "Release" version of this modpack I will then move into a BETA release of that latest Minecraft version and ultimately reach a stage where the latest Minecraft version can have a fully "complete" Release build of this Modpack!

title: Shadow Awakening
description: A mod based on the anime Eminence in Shadow
body:
The mod adds Abilities of Shadow from the anime Eminence In Shadow

To access the abilities you need to obtain the Eminent Apple crafted with 1 Enchanted Golden Apple and 8 Mana Slime, Mana Slime can be obtained from **Mana Ore** found in caves between Y = 0 and Y = 64

There are multiple abilities:
1. Standard Atomic:Destroys everything around the player
2. Recovery Atomic:Seals and Heals all entities around the player including the player
3. Fake Atomic:Seals and gives invisibility to allow the player to escape sticky situations
4. Armor:Slime Armor can be obtained in the ability menu
5. Sword:Slime sword can also be obtained in the ability menu and spawns lightning upon right click


All abilities require Mana to work, Mana can be regenerated by consuming Eminent Apples, it is the only way (can be changed via commands) to regenerate mana.


There are currently 4 commands in the mod:
1. **/Mana** - Changes the default Mana to whatever you want(Below MaxMana)
2. **/MaxMana** - Changes the default Maximum Mana to whatever you want
3. **/ManaRegen** - Changes the Mana Regeneration Rate to whatever you set, by default it is 0
4. **/LOE** - The Commands stands for "Lord Of Eminence" , setting it to true can give access to all abilities and setting it to false revokes access

There are multiple keybinds,
- **Legacy Ability Key** - Allows you to access the legacy menu for ability selection [None]
- **Ability Menu** - Allows you to access the menu for ability selection [R]
- **Nav Left and Nav Right** - it allows you to quickly change abilities using keys [A and D]
- **Ability Key** - Allows you to use selected ability [ \ ]
- **Ability Enable** - Allows you to enable or disable abilities [NumPad 0]

### All keybind are meant to be changed

title: LastLocation
description: A Minecraft Plugin that safes the LastLocation of the Logout. So when they log back in they can do /LastLocation if they are (for example) forced to spawn on the hub. Now they are at their Logout location!
body:
**LastLocation** is a lightweight, safe, and modern **Paper plugin** that stores a player’s **last logout location** and allows them to teleport back to it using `/lastlocation`.

Designed for **Paper 1.20.10+ / 1.21+**, built with **JDK 21**, and focused on **performance, safety, and data integrity**.

---

## ✨ Core Features

### 🚪 Last Logout Location
- Stores **only the logout location**
- ❌ **Does NOT store death locations**
- Supports **server restart / shutdown**
- Default **FILE storage** (one `.yml` per player)
- Ready for **SQLite / MySQL**

---

### ⏱️ Save After X Seconds Online
- Logout location is saved **only after a player has been online for X seconds**
- Fully configurable
- Player receives an **in-game message** once saving becomes active
- Supports **Essentials-style color codes (`&`)**

Example:
```yml
save:
  min-online-seconds: 10
  ready-message: "&aYour logout location is now being saved."
```

### 🧠 Safe Teleport System
Never teleports players into dangerous blocks such as:

Lava 🔥

Cactus 🌵

Powder Snow ❄️

Portal blocks 🌀

Other configured hazards

Checks:

Feet & head are passable

Solid ground below the player

No dangerous blocks nearby

Performance capped (max checks per teleport)

### 🛟 Rescue / Anti-Suffocation System
If a player somehow still ends up in danger:

The plugin automatically searches for a safe location within ±10 blocks

Rescue triggers on suffocation damage

Rescue is active for a short time after using /lastlocation

### ⚔️ PvP / PvE Combat Cooldown
/lastlocation is blocked while the player is in combat

Combat includes:

PvP

PvE

Projectiles

Damage events that are cancelled by other plugins

Cooldown behavior:

Resets every time the player hits or gets hit

No spam messages while in combat

Message is shown only when the command is used

Example:

```yml

combat:
  cooldown-seconds: 15
```

### 🔁 Automatic Data Migration (No Data Loss)
Automatically migrates data from:

Old locations.yml

Old plugins/LastLocation/Data/*.yml

Also supports data/ (lowercase)

Creates automatic backups

Migration runs only once

Clear console summary:

Successfully migrated players

Skipped entries (missing world, invalid UUID, missing data)

### 🧩 Automatic Config Rebuild on Updates
Detects when a new plugin version is installed

Automatically:

Backs up the old config

Rebuilds the config using new defaults

Preserves all existing values

No manual config reset required

### 💾 Storage & Performance
FILE storage (default):

One .yml file per player

Lazy loading

title: LostHorizon
description: LostHorizon is a Minecraft mod designed to enrich the survival experience without altering the spirit of the game.
body:
# LostHorizon [🇫🇷 Version française](https://github.com/malicaeus/LostHorizon/blob/main/README.md) ![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.8-blue) ![Mod Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Forge/NeoForge-FML-orange) ![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/malicaeus/LostHorizon)

## 🧭 About **LostHorizon** is a Minecraft mod designed to enrich the survival experience without altering the spirit of the game. It combines exploration, magic, ancient technology, and RPG immersion through a multitude of new content: enchantments, ores, structures, equipment, and custom mechanics. --- ## 🧪 Mod Content ### 🧙‍♂️ Enchantments - **Veil Of Shadow**: Makes you invisible and stealthy when sneaking in low light. - **Magnetism**: Attracts items around you, with increasing range based on level. - **Lunar Grace**: Provides a speed bonus and allows you to see at night. - **Bloodlust**: Restores 1/2 (per level) heart of health for each kill, but the weapon degrades twice as fast. - **Dimensional Step**: Allows you to perform double/triple jumps. Height varies according to level. ### ✨ Potions - **Furtivity**: Increases speed in sneak mode. - **Fire**: Sets touched entities on fire. ### 🍴 Mystical Food LostHorizon introduces a **mystic food system** offering strategic options for exploration, combat and survival. #### 🍯 Crystallized Honey - **Nutrition**: 6 points | **Saturation**: 0.5 | **Stack size**: 16 - **Always edible**: ✅ Yes - **Effect**: Removes a random negative effect (Poison, Wither, Weakness, Slowness, etc.) - **Obtained**: Found in certain structures or craftable - **Use**: Emergency antidote usable at any time #### 🍄 Mystic Mushrooms - **Stack size**: 64 - **Use**: Crafting ingredient for Onyx Essence - **Obtained**: Found in mystic biomes #### ❄️ Ice Scale - **Nutrition**: 2 points | **Saturation**: 0.4 | **Stack size**: 16 - **Always edible**: ✅ Yes - **Effects**: - Fire Resistance I (45s) - Regeneration I (5s) - ⚠️ Slowness I (8s) — your body cools down - **Obtained**: Rare drop (10%) from mobs in the Ice Tower, or craft with 4 Ice Crystals + 1 raw fish - **Use**: Ideal preparation before exploring the Nether or fighting Dark Blazes #### 🥧 Traveler's Pie - **Nutrition**: 8 points | **Saturation**: 1.2 | **Stack size**: 16 - **Always edible**: ❌ No (requires hunger) - **Effects**: - Speed II (30s) - Enhanced Jump I (30s) - Haste I (20s) - **Recipe**: Bread + Cooked Meat + Carrot + Potato + Mythril (center) - **Use**: Premium exploration food for long journeys #### 🖤 Onyx Essence - **Nutrition**: 1 point | **Saturation**: 0.1 | **Stack size**: 8 - **Always edible**: ✅ Yes - **Effects**: - Strength II (25s) - Absorption I (15s) — +2 temporary hearts - ⚠️ Hunger II (30s) — the corruption eats you - ⚠️ Immediate loss of 1/2 heart - **Recipe**: Glass bottle + 3 Onyx + 1 Red Mushroom + Mystic Mushrooms - **Use**: Desperate combat elixir — sacrifice health for a massive boost. Ideal for critical boss fights. #### ⚡ Thunder Heart - **Nutrition**: 2 points | **Saturation**: 0.3 | **Stack size**: 8 - **Always edible**: ✅ Yes - **Effects**: - Speed III (15s) - Haste II (15s) - Knockback resistance (15s) - ⚠️ Glowing (20s) — you glow as if struck by lightning - **Obtained**: Rare drop (10%) from charged creepers that kill a creeper, or craft with Heart of the Bond + 4 Gunpowder + 4 Redstone - **Use**: Offensive rush item to charge a boss and attack quickly without being knocked back #### ✨ Runic Ambrosia - **Nutrition**: 10 points | **Saturation**: 2.0 | **Stack size**: 8 - **Always edible**: ❌ No (requires hunger) - **Effects**: - Regeneration II (45s) - Resistance I (60s) - Absorption II (45s) — +4 temporary hearts - Luck II (3 min) - Fire Resistance I (60s) - **Complex recipe**: 2 Crystallized Honey + 2 Runite + 1 Golden Apple + 2 Emeralds + 2 Blaze Powder - **Use**: Endgame exploration ultimate food. Extremely costly but grants multiple long buffs to survive the toughest situations. --- #### 🏆 Food-related advancements A full advancement tree rewards culinary exploration: - 🍄 Mystical Cuisine: Taste your first mystic food - 🍯 Curative Sweetness: Eat Crystallized Honey - ❄️ Heart of Ice: Eat an Ice Scale - 🥧 Traveler's Provisions: Craft a Traveler's Pie - 🖤 Willing Corruption: Eat an Onyx Essence *(Goal)* - ⚡ Inner Thunder: Eat a Thunder Heart - ✨ Feast of the Gods: Eat a Runic Ambrosia *(Goal)* - 🍽️ Mystic Gourmet: Taste ALL mystic foods *(Challenge)* - ⚔️ Fighting on the Edge: Kill a boss with ≤2 hearts while under the effect of Onyx Essence *(Hidden challenge)* ### 🧱 Ores - **Basalt Obsidian** *(Nether)*: Solid and dark. - **Onyx** *(Nether)*: Perfect for vicious weapons. - **Runite** *(Overworld)*: Provides powerful equipment with random effects (slowness, explosion...). - **Mythril** *(Overworld)*: Speed bonus with complete armor. Combined with gold → **Mythril Enchanted** (excellent enchantability). - **Starry jade** (layer 100-200): Gives you star jade. A useful gem for making rings. ### 🛠️ Items and Tools - **Anchor Totem**: Sets your home, allows teleportation back. - **Technoblade Totem**: Saves you from death while playing a tribute to Technoblade 🐷👑. - **Climbing Pick**: Climb walls naturally. - **Backpack**: Adds 9 to 15 inventory slots. - **Basalt Edge**: Sword that deals fire damage. - **Lantern Shield**: Shield that automatically illuminates in low light. - **Totem of the Moon**: Night vision + stealth for 2 minutes. - **Knife & Onyx Knife**: Throwing knives (onyx inflicts Wither). - **Frostbite Dagger**: Slows the target and creates snow particles. - **Trap**: Trap that deals damage when stepped on. - **Necromancer's Grimoire**: When held in the off-hand, it increases max health from 20 to 22 hearts. - **Ring infuser**: Block used to give powers to rings (gold or iron) by infusing a gem (ice crystal, mythril or onyx). - **Destiny Dice**: A die that gives a random effect for 10 seconds. The cooldown is 1 minute. - **Heart Activator**: Mystical object used to activate Shrines. - **Link Dagger**: Weapon needed to harvest the souls of the Linked. - **Heart of Link**: Rare item donated by the Heart Guardian on his death. Necessary for infusing rings. ### ✴️ Stellar Artifacts - **Aether Heart**: Rare off-hand item. Grants 2 absorption hearts when HP drops below 4. Cooldown: 90s. - **Shard of the Void**: Instantly teleports you 8 blocks forward in your look direction. Cooldown: 60s. - **Solar Feather**: Grants fire damage immunity. Applies Fire Resistance I when burning. Cooldown: 30s. - **Eye of Hyperion**: Reveals nearby invisible entities and grants Night Vision. Cooldown: 45s. ### 🌕 Relics of the Eclipse - **Eclipse Blade** : Celestial blade slicing through the shadow. - **Moonbell** : Mystical bell with lunar effects. - **Ash of Dawn** : A burning relic dropped by the **Dark Blaze**. - **Lunar Sword** : Forged beneath the full moon, this astral blade reveals what hides in shadow. ### 💍 Infused Rings and Gems The **Ring Infuser** allows you to combine **gold or silver rings** with **mystical gems**. Each combination grants unique effects to the player, balanced with a drawback. To infuse a ring, you also need a Heart of Link. This makes the process more strategic, and rewards players who dare to challenge the Heart Guardian. ---------- #### ❄️ Ice Crystal – Magical Frost Gem **💍 Gold ring infused with an Ice Crystal** Effects: - **Speed I** for 15 seconds every 60 seconds - **Fire Resistance I** for 10 seconds every 60 seconds **💍 Iron ring infused with an Ice Crystal** Effects: - Applies **Slowness I** to enemies within a 10-block radius for 5 seconds every 20 seconds - **Resistance I** for 10 seconds when HP is below 8 hearts ---------- #### 🍀 **Starry Jade** - Gem of astral luck **💍 Gold ring infused with Starry Jade** Effects: - 20% chance to gain **Regeneration I** for 5 seconds after being hit. - **Luck I** temporary (30 seconds) after killing a mob - ⚠️ **Weakness I** for 5 seconds when you break an ore **💍 Silver ring infused with Starry Jade** Effects: - 25% chance to receive **Resistance I** for 10 seconds when HP drops below 5 hearts. - **Luck I** for 30 seconds every 90 seconds - ⚠️ **No effect** if the player is wearing another ring ---------- #### 🌿 Emerald – Nature Gem **💍 Gold Ring infused with an Emerald** Effects: - **Regeneration I** for 5 seconds every 60 seconds - **Resistance I** in forest-type biomes - ⚠️ Suffers **Weakness I** in the Nether **💍 Iron Ring infused with an Emerald** Effects: - Applies **Poison I** to attacked enemies if the player is in a forest-type biome - Slows nearby hostile mobs (**Slowness I** within a 5-block radius) - ⚠️ **Slowness I** in barren biomes (desert, Nether) ---------- #### 🖤 Onyx – Dark and Devious Gem **💍 Gold ring infused with Onyx** Effects: - Inflicts **Wither I** on hit enemies for 4 seconds - **Speed I** for 5 seconds after each kill - ⚠️ Automatically loses **½ heart every 45 seconds** (corruption) **💍 Iron ring infused with Onyx** Effects: - **Invisibility** for 3 seconds when sneaking in darkness - **Resistance I** at night - ⚠️ **Slowness I** in daylight ---------- #### 🪙 Mythril – Gem of Speed and Balance **💍 Gold ring infused with Mythril** Effects: - **Haste II** and **Speed I** while sprinting - **Jump Boost I** for 8 seconds after taking damage - ⚠️ Increased **Hunger** while sprinting (Hunger I) **💍 Iron ring infused with Mythril** Effects: - **Knockback Resistance** - **Slow Falling** while falling - ⚠️ Permanent **Slowness I** ### 👹 Bosses #### 🧙‍♂️ Necromancer - Boss summoned by destroying the Grimoire (block). - Uses melee attacks, fireballs, and can heal during combat. #### 🛡️ Crypt Guardian - Neutral by default, attacks only when provoked. - Capable of melee attacks and using offensive potions. #### 👹 Dark Blaze A rare, variant of the Blaze. - Spawns in the Nether, usually **in small groups (1–2)**. - Drops **Ash of Dawn** upon death. ### 👨‍🌾 Villager Professions **LostHorizon** introduces new immersive villager professions related to the mod's themes (magic, exploration, forgotten technology...). These villagers add an RPG dimension and allow access to unique or rare items through trade. #### 🧟‍♂️ Necromancer - **Profession Block**: Onyx Ore - **Trades** (examples, depending on level): - 💀 8 Onyx → 3 Onyx Knives - 👻 3 Ice Crystals + 1 Totem of Undying → 1 Totem of the Moon - ⚔️ 5 Basalt Obsidian Ores → 1 Basalt Edge #### ⚔️ Hunter - **Profession Block**: Trap - **Trades** (examples, depending on level): - 16 Arrows → 2 Emeralds - 1 Emerald → 1 Trap - ⚔️ 3 Emeralds + 2 Iron Ingots → 3 Knives ### 🌿 Biomes **LostHorizon** also introduces mystical **biomes** with their own atmosphere, resources and ambience. #### ✨ Enchanted Forest A magical, mysterious biome bathed in supernatural light and populated by luminescent vegetation. - **Magic Wood**: Used to make stairs, slabs, buttons, pressure plates, etc. - **Luminous Berries**: Rare fruit that regenerates life and gives night vision. - **Enchanted Blossom**: Can be used in suspicious soup to obtain night vision. - **Unique Ambiance**: Coloured fog, shimmering particles and glowing vegetation. > Many other biomes are in development, each with its own secrets, unique resources and gameplay mechanics. ### 🏠 Generated Structures - **Fisherman Hut**: Small cabin next to rivers (normal or frozen). - **Explorer's Hideout**: Medium structure, shelter of a missing adventurer. - **Mushroom House**: Mystical house in dark forests, swamps, or giant mushroom biomes. - **Ice Tower**: Mysterious icy tower full of secrets. - **Crypt**: Rare and dangerous structure containing precious loot. - **Stone Ritual**: A structure containing loot and a ring infuser, found in the Enchanted Forest biome. - **Shrine**: A mysterious sanctuary found in certain remote areas of the world. By clicking on the central block with a Heart Activator, you summon 4 Linked, aggressive creatures linked to ancient magic. If you kill them with the Link Dagger, you get their souls back. Once you've collected 4 souls, an event is triggered... ### 🧭 Useful Commands - `/sethome`: Sets your home position. - `/home`: Teleports you to your defined home. --- ## 🛠️ Installation 1. Download [NeoForge](https://neoforge.net/) (compatible with your Minecraft version). 2. Place the **LostHorizon** `.jar` file in the `mods` folder. 3. Launch Minecraft, explore... and discover the mysteries of the lost horizon! --- ## 📸 Screenshots > *No images yet* --- ## 💬 Contribution Got ideas? Suggestions? Bugs to report? > Open an issue or make a pull request — all contributions are welcome! --- ## 📜 Acknowledgements - 🐷 **Technoblade** – for the totem inspiration. - 👑 You, curious player, for downloading this mod. - ☕ And all those who love to explore, craft, and dream in Minecraft. --- ## 🔮 Coming Soon - New mystical biomes - Random dungeons - Advanced quest system - More interactions between items and the environment - And much more... > *LostHorizon is just the beginning of an infinite adventure.* --- ## 📜 License This mod is distributed under the **GNU GPL v3.0** license. You are free to: - Use - Modify - Redistribute - Study the code As long as you respect the terms of the [GPL 3.0 license](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html). --- ## 🧠 Author Developed by **Malicaeus** 🧪 Passionate about science, code, and digital mysticism. --- ⭐ If you like the mod, consider giving a ⭐ on GitHub to support the project! --- 🔗 [GitHub](https://github.com/malicaeus/LostHorizon) | 🏗️ Under development | 🎮 Compatible with NeoForge

## Welcome to Alchemistry-Redox!

This is a fork of the 1.12.2 branch of [Alchemistry](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/alchemistry). As I'm currently the maintainer of [Antimatter Chemistry](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/antimatter-chemistry) and [Volcano Block](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/volcano-block), which both utilize Alchemistry as one of their main mods, it was only a question of time before this fork became a reality. I talked to [Arcana](https://www.curseforge.com/members/dark_arcana/projects) (the current maintainer of Alchemistry for newer versions) before, to make sure he doesn't have any interest in what I do with the 1.12.2 of the mod as he is only responsible for 1.18+ versions of the mod. But enough of that let's have a look what changes we achieved in this fork!

![ ](https://github.com/Ender-Development/Alchemistry/blob/1.12.2/assets/info_graphic.png?raw=true)

### Changes

*   back ported the modern textures as they look way better then the current ones
*   fixed Reactor preview in the Alchemistry Patchouli Book
*   overhauled Fusion and Fission Reactors
    *   added Reactor Glass for both of them
    *   the core can now be aligned to all axis
    *   implemented a modifier system depending on the liquids in the core
*   refactored large parts of the mod
    *   updated internal dependencies
    *   redid all GUI textures, so that they properly align
    *   added JEI integration for the Fusion Recipes (no more Item Tooltips)
    *   added a pause button to all machines
    *   added Comparator capabilities to all machines
    *   rewrote the config system to allow editing it in game
    *   added more config options to most machines

title: TCon Tank Nerf
description: Nerfs Seared Tanks to be able to only hold liquids with temperatures less than or equal to 1000C
body:
# What.

This mod is intended for "expert" packs to gate blazing blood (or any other add-on equivalents) to the foundry/alloyer (access to Tier 4 materials) by restricting higher temperature fuels (>1000C) to scorched tanks and preventing them from being using in seared tanks.

# Why?

The goal is to make the late game of Tinkers harder and encourage experimenting with lower tiers for longer.

Blazing blood is fairly easy to obtain and is pretty much the only road block to end game Tinker's materials. Aside from making the raw materials themselves harder to obtain, its not really possible to tweak to challenge of tier 4 materials without having to use other mods to make it more difficult or also nerfing access to the smeltery (access Tier 3 materials) too much.

body:
This mod simply adds a dimension with the purpose of automatic mineration, via Rftools builder or mekanism digital miner. Mining in the overworld, depending on the filters for the machines can make the world ugly, so this mod adds a dimension for mining. I allowed the default mob spawn settings because the intention is for that to be configured on a per modpack basis. To configure that i recommend the [InControl](https://modrinth.com/mod/in-control) mod.

Example on how to disable the mob spawn (config/incontrol/spawn.json):
```json
[
    {
        "hostile": true,
        "dimension": "supernovas_mining_dimension:mining_dimension",
        "when": "onjoin",
        "result": "deny"
    },
    {
        "passive": true,
        "dimension": "supernovas_mining_dimension:mining_dimension",
        "when": "onjoin",
        "result": "deny"
    }
]
```

title: Chestify
description: Chestify allows players to secure chests with PIN codes, enhancing item protection without altering the vanilla gameplay experience.
body:
# Chestify

**Secure your treasures with PIN-protected chests!**

## Overview

Chestify is a Minecraft plugin that introduces a new level of security for your valuable items by allowing players to create PIN-protected chests, known as **safes**. With Chestify, you can store your precious belongings in safes that require a 4-digit PIN code to access, ensuring that only authorized players can open them. This plugin is perfect for servers aiming to enhance player security without drastically changing the vanilla gameplay experience.

## Features

- **PIN-Protected Safes**: Create chests that require a 4-digit PIN code to open.
- **Graphical PIN Entry**: An intuitive GUI allows players to enter their PIN codes using digits from 0 to 9.
- **Player Authorization**: Players who correctly enter the PIN code become authorized and can access the safe without re-entering the code.
- **Configurable Crafting Recipe**: Customize the crafting recipe for safes or disable crafting entirely.
- **Visual and Sound Effects**: Enjoy customizable visual and audio feedback upon successful or failed attempts to access a safe.
- **Destruction Protection**: Safes cannot be destroyed by explosions, fire, or unauthorized players.
- **Custom Messages and Settings**: All messages and plugin settings are configurable through `config.yml`.
- **Damage on Incorrect PIN**: Optionally inflict damage on players who enter the wrong PIN code.

## Installation

1. **Download**: Get the `Chestify.jar` plugin file from [Modrinth](#).
2. **Install**: Place the `Chestify.jar` file into your server's `plugins` directory.
3. **Restart Server**: Restart your server to generate the default configuration files.
4. **Configure**: Edit the `config.yml` file located in `plugins/Chestify` to customize settings as needed.
5. **Reload Plugin**: Use `/chestify reload` to apply configuration changes without restarting the server.

## Configuration

The `config.yml` file allows you to customize:

- **Crafting Recipe**: Define or disable the crafting recipe for safes.
- **Effects and Sounds**: Customize visual and sound effects for successful and failed safe interactions.
- **Messages**: Edit all player-facing messages for localization or personalization.
- **Damage Settings**: Configure damage inflicted on incorrect PIN entry.
- **Crafting Toggle**: Enable or disable the ability to craft safes.

### Example `config.yml`

```yaml
settings:
  enable_crafting: true
  safe_recipe:
    shape:
      - 'III'
      - 'ICI'
      - 'IBI'
    ingredients:
      I: 'IRON_BLOCK'
      C: 'CHEST'
      B: 'DIAMOND_BLOCK'
  damage_on_incorrect_pin: true
  damage_amount: 2.0

effects:
  success:
    sound: 'ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP'
    sound_volume: 1.0
    sound_pitch: 1.0
    particle: 'VILLAGER_HAPPY'
    particle_count: 10
  failure:
    sound: 'ENTITY_VILLAGER_NO'
    sound_volume: 1.0
    sound_pitch: 1.0
    particle: 'SMOKE_NORMAL'
    particle_count: 10

messages:
  safe_placed: '&aYou have placed a safe. Set your PIN code.'
  enter_pin: 'Enter your PIN code'
  pin_set_success: '&aPIN code set successfully!'
  pin_correct: '&aCorrect PIN. Safe unlocked.'
  pin_incorrect: '&cIncorrect PIN.'
  cannot_break_safe: '&cYou cannot break this safe.'
  safe_given: '&aYou have received a safe.'
  safe_given_to_other: '&aYou have given a safe to {player}.'
  no_permission: '&cYou do not have permission to use this command.'
  player_not_found: '&cPlayer not found.'
  specify_player: '&cPlease specify a player to give the safe to.'
  reload_success: '&aChestify configuration reloaded successfully.'
  set_your_pin: 'Set your PIN code'
```

## Commands and Permissions

- **Command**: `/givesafe [player]`
  - **Description**: Gives a safe to yourself or a specified player.
  - **Permission**: `chestify.give`

- **Command**: `/chestify reload`
  - **Description**: Reloads the plugin configuration.
  - **Permission**: `chestify.reload`

- **Permissions**:
  - `chestify.bypass.open` — Allows opening PIN-protected safes without entering the PIN code.
  - `chestify.bypass.break` — Allows breaking PIN-protected safes without authorization.

## How to Use

### 1. Obtain a Safe

- **Crafting**: Create a safe using the customizable recipe defined in `config.yml` (if crafting is enabled).
- **Command**: Use `/givesafe` to receive a safe (requires appropriate permissions).

### 2. Place the Safe

- Place the safe in your desired location in the world.

### 3. Set Your PIN Code

- Upon placing the safe, a GUI will prompt you to set a 4-digit PIN code using digits from 0 to 9.

### 4. Accessing the Safe

- **Authorized Access**: Open the safe without entering the PIN if you are the owner or have previously entered the correct PIN.
- **Unauthorized Access**: Other players must enter the correct PIN code to access the safe.

### 5. Sharing Access

- Share your PIN code with trusted players to grant them access to your safe.

### 6. Breaking the Safe

- Only the owner or authorized players can break the safe.
- Safes are immune to destruction by explosions, fire, and other environmental factors.

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft Versions**: 1.19 - 1.21
- **Server Software**: Spigot, Paper, Purpur

## Requirements

- **Java Version**: Java 17 or higher
- **Permissions Plugin** (optional): For managing user permissions.

## Features in Detail

### PIN-Protected Safes

- Safes function like regular chests but require a PIN code to access.
- The PIN code is stored securely and is associated with the safe's location.

### Graphical PIN Entry

- Players interact with a GUI featuring digits from 0 to 9 to enter their PIN code.
- The GUI is intuitive and user-friendly, enhancing the gameplay experience.

### Visual and Sound Effects

- **Success Effects**: Customizable sounds and particle effects play upon successful PIN entry.
- **Failure Effects**: Different sounds and particles indicate incorrect PIN entry.
- Effects can be customized or disabled in the configuration.

### Damage on Incorrect PIN

- Optionally inflict damage on players who attempt to open a safe with the wrong PIN.
- Damage amount is configurable, adding a deterrent against brute-force attempts.

### Destruction Protection

- Safes cannot be destroyed by non-authorized players, explosions, or environmental hazards.
- Only the owner or authorized players can break and relocate the safe.

## Known Issues

- **Compatibility with Other Plugins**: May require testing if other plugins alter chest mechanics.
- **Damage Settings**: Incorrect configuration may lead to unintended player damage. Ensure settings are correct.

## License

This plugin is released under the [MIT License](#).

## Enhancements and Future Plans

- **Localization**: While messages can be customized, future updates may include built-in support for multiple languages.
- **Extended Authorization**: Potential to add time-limited access or access logs.
- **Customization**: More options for safe appearances and additional security features.

---

**Secure your valuable items with Chestify and bring a new level of security and interaction to your Minecraft server!**

When playing Better With Mods and you have the HarderSteelRecipe enabled crafting a simple stone button becomes a task that involves going to The End to get Endstone that is required to make Ender Slag and a whole slew of other items so you can eventually make a stone cutter to make the stone button. This mod gets rid of that effect, and allows you to craft a stone button by making button clay, forming that into an unfired stone button and then finally cooking that to get a stone button.

 

Currently this is all that the mod provides. I see no reason to circumvent the other recipes provided by Better With Mods as they are all easily craftable compared to the asinine sequence involved with the stone button.

Recipes

 

See the wiki for the amazing recipes! 

 

This mod is now coded in standard McJty-Style.

 

Note

If we begin to add features to this then I'll revisit the 1.11.2 version and recode it as well.

 

Requests

Because we all like the steel recipes but don't like some of the changes that comes with it, to include even the HCRedstone and possibly even the HCLumber, I am willing to take requests that give an alternative to some of the insane recipes for more sensible ones. 

 

When you do submit your request I want you to consider that BWM is a slow progression mod at its core not a Windmill Technology mod. Therefore, submit your requests show with an easier progression chain than that being forced upon us. 

 

An example would be the Piston requires a soul urn, let's replace that with a piston rod that is crafted with 3 iron ingots vertical in the center with slime on the sides. This iron rod would go where the original iron ingot went in the piston recipe. <--- recipe not  yet added

Modpacks

Yes you can use my mod in your pack.

Help a Veteran today

I am Veteran of United States Army. I am not disabled. But I do love to make these mods and modpacks for you guys. Please help me to help you by Donating at https://patreon.com/kreezxil . 

 

This project is proudly powered by FORGE, without whom it would not be possible.Help FORGE get rid of Adfocus at https://www.patreon.com/LexManos.

title: Yet Another Thirst
description: Adds a dynamic thirst bar and customizable hydration mechanics to elevate your survival gameplay.
body:
# Yet Another Thirst

![Yet Another Thirst Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/914b048341d608fd718fb455ff7ac033b4c6dfef.png)

**Yet Another Thirst** is a highly polished survival mod that introduces a realistic hydration and water purification system to Minecraft. Built with modpack balance, visual excellence, and modern design in mind, it adds an immersive layer of survival without being tedious.

Whether you're exploring scorching deserts, dodging dehydration in the Nether, or brewing specialized teas for late-game hydration, this mod integrates seamlessly into your gameplay. The project utilizes a modern multi-loader structure to support both **Forge** and **NeoForge**.

*Note: This project is rebuilt based on the classic [Thirst Was Taken](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/thirst-was-taken) mod (originally created by **ghen-git**). Special thanks to them for the inspiration and codebase reference!*

---

## 💧 Core Survival Mechanics

### Hydration & Exhaustion System
* **Thirst HUD Overlay:** Adds a sleek, custom thirst bar (blue droplets) right above your food bar.
* **Exhaustion & Saturation:** Your thirst drains dynamically based on your physical actions. Sprinting, jumping, and fighting will make you thirsty much faster.
* **Sprint Prevention:** When your thirst bar drops too low, you will no longer be able to sprint, urging you to find water.
* **Halted Regeneration:** Natural health regeneration can be paused if you are dehydrated, making water a top priority during battles.
* **Dehydration Damage:** Running completely out of water triggers custom dehydration damage (`yet_another_thirst:dehydrate`) with unique death messages.

### Alternative Drinking Methods
* **Drink by Hand:** No bottle? No problem. Hold Shift and right-click a water block with empty hands to drink directly from the source.
* **Rain Drinking:** Look straight up at the sky during rainstorms to slowly quench your thirst.

---

### 💧 Thirst HUD & Overlay Preview
![A screenshot showing the blue Thirst droplets HUD overlay positioned next to the hunger bar in-game.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/78724ad206b78dc90204a54c1a77cf4b760e23d0.png)

---

## 🧪 Water Purity & Purification

Not all water in the world is safe to drink. The mod features a comprehensive **Water Purity** system with four distinct tiers:

| Purity Level | Name | Source & Description | Effects When Consumed |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tier 0** | **Dirty** | Surface water, swamps, and stagnant pools. | 100% Nausea, 30% Poison |
| **Tier 1** | **Slightly Dirty** | Underground cave springs and high mountain streams. | 50% Nausea, 10% Poison |
| **Tier 2** | **Acceptable** | Partially filtered or natural clean water. | 5% Nausea |
| **Tier 3** | **Purified** | Processed, boiled, and completely safe water. | None (100% Safe) |

### Environmental Purity
The purity of harvested water is determined by where you collect it. Mountain springs (high altitude) and cave springs (deep underground) yield cleaner water. Flowing water (running streams) receives a purity bonus over stagnant source blocks!

### How to Purify Water
Use heat to sanitize your water containers. You can boil water bottles or terracotta water bowls:
* **Campfire:** Increases the purity level by **1 step** (e.g., Dirty -> Slightly Dirty).
* **Furnace:** Purifies water by **2 steps** (e.g., Dirty -> Acceptable).

---

### 🔥 Boiling and Purifying Water
![A screenshot showing water bottles and terracotta water bowls placed on top of a lit Campfire, being boiled.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/537bc459861f2bfbeb5dfcf8e0549d4d094d3ae6.png)

![A screenshot showing the Furnace UI open with a water bottle or terracotta water bowl in the input slot, actively being smelted.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/0b308e950805ffdb193d33f440f95675608937ce.png)

---

## 🏺 Custom Early-Game Containers

To help you survive your first night, the mod introduces new crafting options:
* **Clay Bowls:** Craftable early-game using clay balls.
* **Terracotta Bowls:** Fire your clay bowls in a furnace or on a campfire.
* **Terracotta & Wooden Water Bowls:** Fill them up with water. They track purity just like glass bottles, allowing you to drink or boil them for safe hydration before you have iron or glass!

---

### 🏺 Crafting & Harvesting Containers
![A screenshot of the Crafting Table UI showing the recipe to craft a Clay Bowl from clay balls.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/3f6f41d2a0b42adadac25259320af46706fafd20.png)

![A screenshot of the Furnace UI showing a Clay Bowl hovered in the input slot, with its item tooltip visible, before being fired into a Terracotta Bowl.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/275a03c0d5c31f9cd699bc3bdd8fcbee42ee1bde.png)

![A screenshot of the Furnace UI showing the resulting Terracotta Bowl hovered in the output slot, with its item tooltip visible, after smelting is complete.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/63560d72bf3b39135fa808794800d49c569e2f09.png)

![A screenshot showing 4 item tooltips side by side for each purity tier — Dirty, Slightly Dirty, Acceptable, and Purified — each displaying its purity label and colored indicator in the tooltip UI.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/84bc7242c175f68614cb65555e0d60e822247d15.png)

---

## ⚙️ Cauldron & Dispenser Automation

* **Cauldron Purity Blending:** Cauldrons dynamically track and average out the purity of the water inside. If you mix purified water with dirty water, the cauldron's water purity shifts dynamically!
* **Dispenser Support:** Dispensers can automate your water processing by filling bottles and buckets, respecting the source block's purity level automatically.

---

## ☀ Biome Climate & Temperature Modifiers

* **Climate Depletion:** Thirst depletion is heavily dependent on the biome you are in. Hot, dry biomes (like Deserts, Savannas, or Badlands) cause rapid dehydration. Cold or humid biomes reduce depletion.
* **Nether Dehydration:** Being in the Nether makes you dehydrate 3x faster.
* **Heat Protection:** Having the *Fire Resistance* effect active completely stops thirst depletion from heat. Armor with *Fire Protection* enchantments also reduces dehydration rates.

---

## 🔌 Rich Mod Compatibility & Integrations

Yet Another Thirst is designed to be the ultimate modpack-friendly hydration mod. It features built-in compatibility with:

* **AppleSkin:** Visually previews how much thirst and hydration saturation a drink will restore directly on your HUD when holding it.
* **Jade:** Adds an in-world tooltip when looking at water blocks or cauldrons, showing their current purity level before you harvest.
* **Cold Sweat:** Seamlessly links with core body and ambient temperature. Your thirst rate adapts dynamically based on how hot or cold your body is.
* **Farmer's Delight & Beverage Mods:** 
  * Water bottles stack up to **64** to fit better in food-focused packs.
  * Consuming stews, meals, teas, or alcoholic beverages from mods like *Farmer's Delight*, *Respite*, and *Brewin' & Chewin'* provides long-lasting hydration.
  * Active food buffs (like Nourishment) pause thirst depletion and slowly regenerate hydration.
* **Let's Do Mods (Bakery, Brewery, Farm & Charm):** Native support for specialized teas, meals, and drinks. Food buffs (like Stuffed, Saturated, Satiation, Sustenance, or Feast) automatically pause thirst drain or restore hydration.
* **Vampirism & Supernatural:** Vampire players do not need water! The thirst mechanic is paused and the HUD is completely hidden if you become a vampire.
* **Tombstone:** The *Ghostly Shape* effect suspends thirst depletion.
* **Tough As Nails:** Configurable coexistence mode (can auto-disable YAT if Tough As Nails is active).

---

### 🍲 AppleSkin & Jade Integrations
![A screenshot showing Jade's in-world tooltip overlay displaying the purity level (e.g. "Purity: Purified") when the player looks at a water block or cauldron.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/ef885b1cab437ec06d7b54d33a0ebddb8ae9dadc.png)

![A screenshot showing AppleSkin's HUD preview while the player holds a drink, displaying how much thirst and quenched saturation it will restore.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/5db29445f19ac22c3149fffe768d2ccd5490a2a9.png)

---

## 🛠 Admin & Server Commands

Manage player thirst easily with commands (requires operator permission):
* `/thirst query <player>` - Check a player's exact thirst and saturation levels.
* `/thirst set <player> <thirst> <quenched>` - Set specific thirst and saturation levels.
* `/thirst enable <player> <true/false>` - Enable or disable thirst depletion for specific players.

---

## ⚙️ Fully Configurable

Almost every aspect of Yet Another Thirst can be customized in the `config/yet_another_thirst/common.toml` config file:
* Adjust exhaustion rates, damage intervals, and sprint thresholds.
* Change purity levels of world-harvested water.
* Customize which foods/drinks restore thirst and by how much.
* Add or remove status effects that pause or regenerate thirst.
* Reposition the HUD overlay to fit your custom UI layout.

### Out-of-the-Box Mod Integration

The default configuration ships **pre-tuned** for all supported companion mods so you get a smooth experience without any manual setup:

| Mod | Default Behavior |
| :--- | :--- |
| **AppleSkin** | Thirst & quenched preview enabled immediately after installation. |
| **Jade** | Water purity tooltips active on all water blocks and cauldrons out of the box. |
| **Cold Sweat** | Body-temperature-based thirst scaling enabled with sensible thresholds. |
| **Farmer's Delight** | Water bottles stack to 64; stews/meals grant hydration by default. |
| **Respite / Brewin' & Chewin'** | Teas and brews restore thirst without any extra configuration. |
| **Let's Do (Bakery, Brewery, Farm & Charm)** | Stuffed / Saturated / Satiation / Sustenance / Feast buffs auto-pause thirst drain. |
| **Vampirism** | Thirst mechanic and HUD automatically hidden for vampire players. |
| **Tombstone** | *Ghostly Shape* effect pre-mapped to suspend thirst depletion. |
| **Tough As Nails** | Coexistence mode pre-configured; YAT auto-disables if TAN is detected. |

> Simply drop the relevant mods into your `mods/` folder — no extra config editing required.

---

## 🗺️ Loot & Exploration

Survival requires searching for resources. You don't have to craft everything:
* **Dungeon Loot:** Clay Bowls and Terracotta Bowls can be found while exploring the world.
* **Chest Spawn Locations:** Injected natively into chest loot tables for **Simple Dungeons, Abandoned Mineshafts, Shipwrecks, Nether Bridges,** and **Bastions**.

---

## 🌟 Status Effects

Yet Another Thirst introduces custom status effects to manage hydration:

| Effect | Type | Registry ID | Color | Source / Trigger | Mechanic | Rate (per level) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydration** | Beneficial | `yet_another_thirst:hydration` | `#21B1FF` (Blue) | Drinking premium teas, beverages, or stews (via compatibility or configuration) | Restores thirst and quenched saturation | +1 thirst & quenched per tick (+20 per second at level I) |
| **Thirsty** | Harmful | `yet_another_thirst:thirsty` | `#B15B2A` (Brown) | Drinking unpurified water (applied for 30 seconds when nausea triggers) | Adds exhaustion | +0.005 exhaustion per tick (+0.1/s at level I; drains 1 point per 40s at rest) |

---

### ✨ Hydration Effect Preview
![A screenshot of the player's inventory/status screen showing the active Hydration effect icon with its blue color and timer.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/678bc5d4a62e82f54eb411f368949d2d8eaf176e.png)

![A screenshot showing the player in-world under the Hydration status effect with blue particle effects surrounding them and the thirst bar visibly restoring.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/c5d83f2ca9e3a19e7e8acf2e68382aeabae72362.png)
* **Hydration Effect:** When active, your thirst and quenched levels are continuously restored, allowing you to sustain activities without depleting your thirst bar.

---

### 🤢 Thirsty Effect Preview
![A screenshot of the player's inventory/status screen showing the active Thirsty effect icon with its brown color and timer.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/3fcee6ffee51fa4ea48c270d33be5f2ccc04316a.png)

![A screenshot showing the player in-world under the Thirsty status effect with brown particle swirls surrounding them and the thirst bar visibly draining faster.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HOl2fYpO/images/10cfd5806f43699e4cf50b931f501ca85ba95426.png)
* **Thirsty Effect:** Increases your exhaustion rate, causing your thirst to drain much faster. Usually contracted from drinking unpurified water.

---

## 🚀 Near-Future Plans

* **Create Mod Integration:** Add blocks and items to support automated water filtration using kinetic machinery.
* **Immersive Engineering Integration:** Add blocks and items to support large-scale water cooking, purification, and storage compatible with industrial themes.
* **Water Storage Expansion:** Add new items and containers specifically designed for storing and transporting clean water.
* **Sophisticated Storage & Backpacks Integration:** Support dynamic fluid storage upgrades inside backpacks and chests, allowing direct drinking and automatic refilling.

---

## 📦 Modpack Policy

* **100% Free to Use:** You are fully allowed to include Yet Another Thirst in any public or private modpack.
* **No Permission Needed:** There is no need to ask or register. All I ask is that you kindly credit me (MinhNH) as the creator in your modpack description.

---

## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Can I play this mod on Peaceful difficulty?
Yes! By default, thirst does not deplete in Peaceful mode. If your thirst is low when switching to Peaceful, it will slowly regenerate (+1 thirst per tick cycle) until full. You can toggle this behavior in the config.

### How is this different from Thirst Was Taken?
Yet Another Thirst is a complete, modern rewrite targeting Minecraft 1.20.1+. It provides multi-loader support for both **Forge** and **NeoForge**, improved stability, more reliable mod integrations (via a dynamic status effect configuration), and fixes common issues with modern rendering pipelines.

### Is it compatible with other thirst mods?
Yes! If you have **Tough As Nails** installed, Yet Another Thirst includes a configurable coexistence mode that can automatically disable YAT to prevent conflict, allowing modpacks to switch between systems easily.

---

## ⚙️ Installation & Requirements

1. Make sure you are using **Minecraft 1.20.1+**.
2. Install the latest version of either **Forge** or **NeoForge**.
3. Download the matching **Yet Another Thirst** jar file.
4. Place the jar in your Minecraft instance's `mods` folder.
5. (Optional) Install **AppleSkin** and **Jade** for the best visual experience.

# Elytra Slot
 
**Wear your elytra and your chestplate at the same time.**

This is a solo-developed passion project. Feedback and bug reports are always welcome, feel free to leave a comment.

MIT

title: CHC | Custom Hit Command
description: Executes a configurable command when hitting an other player with a configurable item group or a single item!
body:
# **Custom Hit Command: Unleash Dynamic Actions on Impact!**
![Curseforge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1308743?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&color=D02F2F&link=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins/chc&link=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins/chc) ![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/eXM4AQg2?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&color=D02F2F&link=https%3A%2F%2Fmodrinth.com%2Fplugin%2Fchc&link=https%3A%2F%2Fmodrinth.com%2Fplugin%2Fchc)  ![Spiget Downloads](https://img.shields.io/spiget/downloads/127038?style=for-the-badge&logo=spigotmc&color=D02F2F&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.spigotmc.org%2Fresources%2Fchc-custom-hit-command.127038%2F&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.spigotmc.org%2Fresources%2Fchc-custom-hit-command.127038%2F) ![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/866268252245590016?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&color=D02F2F&link=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FZ3rrqYSpUE&link=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FZ3rrqYSpUE)


## **❓ What is CHC?**
**Custom Hit Command** let's you trigger specific commands every time you **hit another player** with a **chosen item group** and/or **single item(s)** you marked before with `/chc sethititem`! This **lightweight** and **highly customizable** plugin is built for Paper 26.1, ensuring **fast performance** and **seamless integration**.

## **🌟 Key Features:**

🔧 **Configurable Hit Item**: Define which item group, single item, or external NBT tag triggers the action (e.g., all Iron Swords, marked Blaze Rods, or even plugins like DeluxeHub items via key=value)

🎯 **Dynamic Command Execution**: Set any server command to run upon a successful hit. You can choose whether the command is executed by the attacking player or the console. Use the **`%hitted_player%`** placeholder to automatically insert the name of the player you hit (e.g., `/duel %hitted_player%`)

✨ **Visual Hit Particles**: Configure particle effects to appear at the location of the hitted player, adding a visually dynamic element to your commands

💬 **Customizable Messages**: Tailor nearly all plugin messages to match your server's style

🔎 **Enhanced Logging**: An optional, enhanced logging system can be enabled to provide detailed debug information for troubleshooting

🔔 **Update Notifications**: An automatic update checker can be configured to notify you in the console or directly in-game (or both) when a new version is available. It can be easily toggled on/off in the configuration

**So what are you waiting for? Get Custom Hit Command now and bring a new layer of excitement to your server!**

## ️**🛡️ Commands & Permissions:**
`/chc reload` | `customhitcommand.reload`

`/chc sethititem` | `customhitcommand.sethititem`

`customhitcommand.update` (for in-game update notifications)

`customhitcommand.use` (allows the use of the hit item (default true))

`customhitcommand.admin` (parent permission for all permissions)


## **📆 Planned features:**
- config updater
- minimessage support
- multiple commands
- command delay
- multiple hit item groups
- set for every item group a different command executor and command 
- sound option to play at a successful hit
- folia support


## **❓ Q&A:**
**Why is the compiled plugin (JAR file) larger than the source code on GitHub?**

Our plugin includes dependencies like **bStats** to gather anonymous usage statistics. When the plugin is compiled into a single JAR file, the bStats library (along with all its own dependencies) is packaged directly into the final plugin file. This process, called 'shading', makes the plugin self-contained which naturally increases the overall file size compared to just the raw source code.

## **🆘 Need Help?**
If you encounter any problems, bugs, or have questions about the plugin, please don't hesitate to contact me directly. I'll be happy to take a look and provide support! Your positive experience is our priority.

title: Collapsible gamerules screen
description: Makes the GameRules UI screen collapsible by category. Tired of scrolling? Clean up your world settings.
body:
# ⚒️ Collapsible Game Rules **Summary:** Makes the GameRules UI screen collapsible by category. Tired of scrolling? Clean up your world settings. **No Backports:** This mod strictly targets **Minecraft 26.1.2 ("Tiny Takeover" Release)**. Older versions are unsupported to ensure absolute stability with the modern UI engine. > **Respect the Player's Time, Not the Game's Rules.** **Collapsible Game Rules** makes the GameRules UI screens collapsible by category. Are you tired of scrolling through a massive, unorganized list of game rules every time you create a world or tweak settings? This mod solves the clutter by turning the standard Game Rules screen into a clean, easy-to-navigate interface. _placeholder_do_image_here --- ## ✨ Features ### 🗂️ Collapsible Categories Minecraft game rules are automatically grouped by their default categories (Player, Mobs, Spawning, Updates, etc.). Instead of a giant flat list, you get a clean, organized view. ### 🖱️ Toggle Headers Click on any category header to instantly expand or collapse its contents. Find the settings you need without scrolling continuously! ### 🌎 Global Operations A handy `[ Expand All ]` / `[ Collapse All ]` UI header resides at the very top, granting you instant, one-click global mastery over the entirety of your game rules. ### 🛡️ Client-Side Only Works out of the box on your client. You do not need to install this on a server. Just drop it into your `mods` folder and enjoy a cleaner UI immediately. ### 🧠 Persistent Memory Tired of collapsing the same categories every time you start the game? Collapsible Game Rules saves your exact UI state locally (`collapsible-game-rules-state.json`). Your preferred layout persists continuously across gaming sessions! ### 🔍 Smart Search Integration Seamlessly integrated with the Vanilla search bar. If you type a keyword, any category containing a matching game rule will automatically expand to reveal the results, minimizing clicks while maintaining organization. ### 🧩 Seamless Mod Support Our collapsing logic hooks directly into the game's native Game Rules map. This means **any custom categories or rules added by other mods** will be automatically organized and collapsible out-of-the-box!
