title: Villager Trade Checker
description: A datapack that tracks librarian trades and gives you the ability to reset locked villagers
body:
# Short Overview
This datapack can be used to easily check librarian villager trades without opening them each time. This pack can also be used to reset a villager completely.

# Command Overview
/trigger vtc_enable : Pick the closest villager to you and enables it for use with the pack. The villager will start glowing.
/trigger vtc_disable : Disables your enabled villager
/trigger vtc_scan : If the enabled villager is/will be a librarian, makes it so that when it gets that job, it will output it's enchantment if it has it.
/trigger vtc_menu : Opens the enchantment treshold menu.
/trigger vtc_reset : Prepares the currently selected villager to be reset. Confirmation is needed.

# General Use
At first, you will want to pick a villager by using /trigger vtc_enabled while standing close to your villager. When selected, it will start glowing. You can only select one villager at the time per person.
![Triggering enable](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab7c1515a5db682b30f77329aa65d2420af238f1.png)
![Enabled villager](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82ce2c3d739be8af4bb0f973fbb391ebe096e85f.png)

You can now repeatedly give it a job and it will put his enchant in chat just for you.
![Preview of functionality](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c526a31fdf5703a3c21b99535d6853b6130f3d99.png)
## Setting a treshold
If you want to receive a message for a (max level) enchant on top of the already existing ones, /trigger vtc_menu to open the menu. Here, you can choose which enchantment you want to show and under what treshold. 
(!Note: When you open a specific enchant setting, the slider will always be at 0. You currently cannot see what score you put it on! You setting is safed!)
![Enchantment Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/546a133d5c130a03d00dd59365909ab0c4b22f18.png)
![Specific Enchant Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb887eb38d19f85caa65f65398c3e6731ff36639.png)

## Disabling and Resetting
### Disable
When you are done with a villager, you can run /trigger vtc_disable to stop the pack from interacting with the villager. If you run /trigger vtc_enable on another villager, it will disable the previous. Disabling does not interfere with anything vanilla related.

### Reset
If you have a villager that has locked in their trades, and want to get rid of it, you don't have to remove his existance anymore. You can just totally wipe any happy memory he ever had and make him believe he was born in the cell you put him in, ready for work. All this can be done simple with the /trigger vtc_reset command. The selected villager will glow red and you will be asked to confirm.
![Resetting a villager](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/703778824517c40cdb407d079f3cb55dda7a69cc.png)

### Special thanks to TheBlackSwitch for helping me out with some things!

# Wavy Flags
Wavy flags is a simple mod that adds a flag block and wrenches to adjust those flags

The rotation wrench is crafted with a stick, an item frame and an iron ingot
the rest of the wrenches are crafted by placing the previous wrench in a crafting grid.

you can adjust various aspects of the flag (rotation, speed, eccentricity and offset) using the wrenches.

# NoHeartShaking

> **Stop your hearts from shaking at low HP!**

A minimalistic client-side mod that disables the heart "shaking" animation when the player's health is **2 hearts or less**.
Perfect for **custom maps**, **modpacks**, or **challenge runs** like a 1-heart survival where that constant jitter becomes more annoying than helpful.

![Hearts before installing the mod](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaydanOMGr/NoHeartShaking/refs/heads/screenshots/Before-NoHeartShake.webp)
![Hearts after installing the mod](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RaydanOMGr/NoHeartShaking/refs/heads/screenshots/After-NoHeartShake.webp)

## Why does this mod exist?

The vanilla heart shaking effect is meant to indicate low health, but in curated experiences, like challenge maps or minimal UIs it can be distracting or even immersion-breaking. This mod stops that animation completely, making it ideal for:

* Hardcore challenge modpacks
* Minimal HUD setups
* Custom maps with persistent low-health scenarios

## Requirements

* **Minecraft:** 1.21.5 (tested), may work on other versions, try it out!
* **Loader:** [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/) or [Quilt](https://quiltmc.org/)
* **Java:** 21 or newer

## Need Support?

If you have questions, ideas, or bugs to report, come hang out in the [Discord server](https://discord.com/invite/3vfnvBFRKv).

## Source & License

[![GitHub issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/LuckyLuuk12/LuckyBindings)](https://github.com/LuckyLuuk12/LuckyBindings/issues) 
![License: All Rights Reserved](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-All%20Rights%20Reserved-red)

---

## Overview
**LuckyBindings** is a Minecraft client-side mod that allows players to create **custom keybindings for advanced actions**. Perfect for servers with **many commands, chat interactions, and roleplay mechanics**.  

> ⚠ **Disclaimer:** This mod is **not affiliated** with any server, including [SchoolRP](https://schoolrp.net/). It is a personal project created to enhance gameplay.

---

## Features
- **Custom Keybindings** – assign any key to execute “Actions”.  
- **Execute Commands** – run server or client commands with a single key.  
- **Chat Automation** – prepare messages for quick chat execution.  
- **Pathfinding Actions** – automatically follow a path of specific blocks.  
- **Player Movements** – nod, wave, or trigger custom animations with keybinds.  
- **Dynamic Config** – configure keybinds and action parameters in-game.  

---

## Why LuckyBindings?
- **Highly configurable** – add, remove, or change keybinds and actions on the fly.  
- **Extensible** – new actions can be added by other developers.  
- **Multi-server friendly** – works with different Minecraft servers without modification.  
- **Searchable & discoverable** – supports all standard keybinding and action types.  

---

## Development
Contributions are welcome! Fork on [GitHub](https://github.com/LuckyLuuk12/LuckyBindings) and submit **pull requests**.  
Please ensure **code quality** and test your changes; this is a **personal project** maintained in spare time.

---

## Planned Features
- **Server GUIs** – open in-game screens with:
  - Online player lists & info
  - Server statistics (ping, player count, etc)
- **Automation Actions** – automate repetitive or common tasks  
- **Enhanced Config UI** – dynamic menus for custom keybinds & action parameters  

---

## Keywords / Tags
`keybinds`, `keybindings`, `actions`, `commands`, `minecraft`, `client-mod`, `automation`, `pathfinding`, `player-movement`, `roleplay`, `mod`, `multi-loader`

title: ModereX
description: All-in-one Moderation Plugin for your Minecraft Server! Also includes a customizable AutoMod!
body:
## This plugin is archived until further notice. Do not worry, we are not abandoning this plugin!

# This plugin provides an all-in-one moderation system for your Minecraft server. It includes:

- Open a visual moderation panel (/mx panel) to browse online/offline players, search by name, and launch per‑player actions.

- Warn, Mute, Kick, and Ban via intuitive inventory GUIs—including time adjustments, reason prompts, and confirmation screens.

- View a live Analytics overview of each player’s total warns/mutes/kicks/bans, with one‑click full history.

- Configure an AutoMod system, creating rules for link blocking, profanity filters, alt‑account detection, and custom chat filters—complete with per‑rule enable/disable, whitelists, blacklists, and automated actions.

- Manage a command blacklist/whitelist for any plugin command on a per‑player (or global) basis.

- Enforce global chat slowmode and clearchat, with  bypass permissions.

- Toggle staff‑only chat and vanish mode.
 
- Automatically logs every moderation action!

## Commands List
```
/mx panel               # main moderation panel
/mx chat <enable|disable>
/x reload
/mx warn <player>
/mx mute <player>
/mx kick <player>
/mx ban <player>
/mx analytics
/mx anticheat <enable|disable> | <alert> <enable|disable>
/mx command <whitelist|blacklist|reset> <player|*> <plugin> <cmd>
/mx slowmode <time>      # e.g. 5s, 1m
/mx clearchat
/mx automod              # open Automod GUI
```

## Permissions 
```
Node | Description | Default
moderex.panel | Access /mx panel 
moderex.chatsettings | Toggle chat (enable/disable) 
moderex.reload | /mx reload 
moderex.warn | /mx warn & GUI 
moderex.ban | /mx ban & GUI 
moderex.mute | /mx mute & GUI 
moderex.kick | /mx kick & GUI 
moderex.analytics | Access Analytics Panel 
moderex.automod | Edit AutoMod rules & GUI 
moderex.bypassautomod | Bypass all AutoMod checks
moderex.cmdmanager | Use /mx command
moderex.slowmode | /mx slowmode
moderex.slowmodebypass | Bypass chat slowmode
moderex.chatclear | /mx clearchat
moderex.staffchat | Use /staffchat / see staff messages
moderex.vanish | /vanish
moderex.anticheat | /mx anticheat
moderex.messages | See join/leave messages
```

## Install the Plugin

Put the JAR in your server’s plugins folder and start/restart the server.
Ensure you have the correct permissions assigned (LuckPerms recommended).

### Open the Panel
Type /mx panel to see all players.
Navigate pages, search for specific players, or click a head to see “Options.”

### GUI's
- Ban GUI: Add or subtract time intervals, set reason, choose IP ban. Confirm to ban or unban.
- Mute GUI: Add or subtract durations, set reason, confirm to mute, or unmute.
- Kick GUI: Set reason, confirm to kick.
- Warn GUI: Add or subtract warn duration, set reason, confirm.

## AutoMod Configuration
Layout (per row = one rule):
Name | Enable | Disable | Triggers | Whitelist | Action | Blacklist | Rename | Delete
- Navigation: Next/Prev pages + Create Rule

- Chat Filtering:

- LINK rules block any http:// or https:// (unless whitelisted).

- CHAT rules block terms (unless any whitelist phrase matches).

- ALT_ACCOUNT kicks same IP duplicates (unless username whitelisted).

- Editing via chat: click slot -> type in chat -> GUI reopens with saved changes.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/w4PBIASisCA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Configuration
```
# Chat settings
spamMuteEnabled: true
spamMuteDuration: 180000    # in ms
appeal-message: "Appeal bans at https://example.com/appeal"

# Disconnect messages
banHeading: "&cYou have been Banned!"
bannedBy: "&eBanned By: {moderator}"
reason: "&eReason: &r{reason}"
timeRemaining: "&eTime Remaining: &r{timeRemaining}"
extra: "&bAppeal bans at changeme!"

kickHeading: "&cYou have been Kicked!"
kickBy: "&eKicked By: {moderator}"![AutoMod Configuration GUI]
```

title: Boowomp Harvesting Fail
description: This mod's only purpose is to play the boowomp sound effect whenever you break a block with the wrong tool and do not get the drop from it.
body:
This mod's only purpose is to play the boowomp sound effect whenever you break a block with the wrong tool and do not get the drop from it. It is NOT required on the server and will work if it installed on only the client; however, installing the mod on the server is recommended as it will play the sound in the world at the position of the broken block, allowing other nearby players to hear that a player has made a poor life choice.

The sound file can be replaced via resourcepack! This is the file path to put the sound at if you wish to do so:

```
assets/boowomp/sounds/failed_block_harvest.ogg
```

The mod also has a registered subtitle for the sound event, which defaults to "Boowomp". Should you wish to change this, the path is as follows:

```
assets/boowomp/lang/en_us.json
```

with the entry:

```
{
  "boowomp.subtitle.failed_block_harvest": "Boowomp"
}
```

body:
## Intro
This is a minecraft mod that adds stunning visuals to minecraft. It is recommended to use a modern gpu(amd or nvidia). Integrated graphics are highly not recommended.
### Compatibility
You shouldn't use this mod-pack with any other additional mods or other shader-packs. Only datapacks and recourse packs. If you are, then disable the photonics mod. Need more help? Click [here](https://github.com/PhantomPheonixCreations/Minecraft-LR)!

### Issues
If you encounter issues, they might be caushed by the photonics or the continuity mod.You can try using alternative platforms or disabling some mods. Need more help? Click [here](https://github.com/PhantomPheonixCreations/Minecraft-LR)!

### Performace
This mod is optimised well,however for mid-range and low-range computers its reccomended to have Vsync turned off, render distance at 6-12, simulation distance at 5-6. Fps capped at 20-60.
for higher refresh rate monitors consider either capping the fps higher or changing the refresh rate. This mod was designed for single player, but it has some multiplayer mods on, consider turning off any of those for better speeds when loading up minecraft to play singleplayer.

## **IMPORTANT**
This mod-pack can overheat your pc(very rare) if not used properly so use it at your own risk(what could go wrong?).

title: Spells & Sorcery
description: Datapack that adds Spellbooks, Alchemy, New Items, New Mobs, and even a New Boss!
body:
# Spells & Sorcery

This Datapack adds a 24 new items to the game! 12 of which are new _Spellbooks_! It also adds 3 new Custom Mobs, a new _Alchemy_ system, and even a new boss: _The Necromancer_!

## Alchemy:

This datapack adds a whole new way of crafting... the _Alchemy Pot_!

<details>
<summary>Alchemy Pot</summary>



**Alchemy** is used to brew all of your spells. You can make an _Alchemy Pot_ by placing a soul campfire underneath a water-filled cauldron, then tossing an Amethyst Shard inside. Your finished _Alchemy Pot_ should look like this:

![Alchemy Pot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1aaa9650b806c73deee4189f90b72d1b270350a1.png)

When brewing, you must wait five seconds after throwing in all of the correct ingredients. Most spells require a _Spell Tome_, which is found in Dungeons, Abandoned Mineshafts, and Stronghold Libraries. The _Spell Tome_ acts as a blank spell, which you infuse spells into!
</details>

## Spells:

**Spellbooks** are brewed in the _Alchemy Pot_, and require a _Spell Tome_. Spells use-up _Mana_, which regenerates over time. The default Mana maximum is 10, but can be increased with the _Mana Charm_.

<details>
<summary>Amethyst Bolt</summary>

![Amethyst Bolt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5bf7c724d0ac4d752f1c80a93b4141362d8f0e9.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_ and 1 Amethyst Shard.

This is a simple and cheap spell which shoots forward a burst of purple amethyst, which will damage enemies.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Arcane Dash</summary>

![Arcane Dash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84d643a58adf0449354f22bb5e54aadd7157b53e.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Rabbit Foot, and 1 Block of Emerald.

This spells sends you dashing forward, damaging any enemies in your path.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Inferno</summary>

![Inferno](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6429134d08e6e38f39b4276ba7296e7b26464d01.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Gunpowder, 1 Blaze Powder, and 1 _Scorched Obsidian_.
- _Scorched Obsidian_ can be obtained by trading with Piglins.

This fiery spell casts a wave of fire whichever way the player is looking.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Ascendio</summary>

![Ascendio](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b470cf73e71abe8ea5dc77e6e754fc5554b5c942.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Feather, and 1 _Pixie Dust_.
- _Pixie_ dust is a drop from the new mob: _Pixies_.

**When not sneaking:** This spell sends the player upwards, and provides slow fall.

**When sneaking:** This spell casts out a bolt which will send enemies upward when hit.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Electra</summary>

![Electra](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed1dd48a4705fe3124607539f496cce069ce8951.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Feather, and 1 Nether Star.

This spell creates a field which conducts lightning after a short period.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Hellfire</summary>

![Hellfire](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff7bf30c61bd26ec64aafc976d3d0c890f44a3c6.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Ancient Debris, 1 Blaze Powder, and 1 _Scorched Obsidian_.
- _Scorched Obsidian_ can be obtained by trading with Piglins.

This spell causes fireballs to rain down on the marked area.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Shadowstep</summary>

![Shadowstep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b71ebfa4e1922b40af6ce6107dbc2f9959a0c735.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_ and 1 _Shadow_.
- A _Shadow_ can be obtained by killing _Wraiths_.

This spell creates a shadowy platform under your feet, allowing you to parkour off of it in thin air.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Enlargio</summary>

![Enlargio](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7154e543d5d385510ea9052da195ec4b88a2ebd0.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Blue Candle, and 1 Pufferfish.

**When not sneaking:** Casts a bolt which will make the entity it hits grow in size.

**When sneaking:** Makes yourself grow in size.

* Effects on players only last 30 seconds, however effects on mobs are permanant UNTIL hit with the _Reducio_ spell.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Reducio</summary>

![Reducio](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/984ea66530096ff3f0b558d12c582dc3bea25560.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Orange Candle, and 1 Pufferfish.

**When not sneaking:** Casts a bolt which will make the entity it hits shrink in size.

**When sneaking:** Makes yourself shrink in size.

* Effects on players only last 30 seconds, however effects on mobs are permanant UNTIL hit with the _Enlargio_ spell.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Glacious</summary>

![Glacious](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ea299b924d0dfd121e6bc3720dbe6e015a2357e.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Snow Block, 1 Ice Block, and 1 _Yeti Tooth_.
- A _Yeti Tooth_ is a drop from a _Yeti_.

This spell casts a icy bolt which will cause the area it hits to be a blizzard for a short time, slowing down any entities inside.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Health Spell</summary>

![Health Spell](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34a8d6017d8242d25617c187c40a867c53e7b00c.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_ and 1 Ghast Tear.

This spell generates a temporary field which will give anything inside regeneration and resistance.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Timekeeper</summary>

![Timekeeper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/274f50f6f185dff1008dc834dd14b324677a0324.png)

- Made with 1 _Spell Tome_, 1 Netherite Ingot, and 1 Clock.

This spell creates a location in time wherever you are, and teleports you back to that spot after 5 seconds.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Mana Bottle</summary>

- Made with 1 Bottle and 1 Amethyst Shard.

This brews a smiple Mana Bottle, which will instantly regenerate your mana.

</details>

## Custom Mobs:

This Datapack adds 3 new custom mobs, each with their own unique drops and mechanics!

<details>
<summary>Pixie</summary>

![Pixie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56820592c0b5066b6cb3c07e81900bc32ea8aba7.gif)

_Pixies_ can be found in Birch and Dark Oak Forests. Pixies have a 50% chance to drop _Pixie Dust_, which is used to brew the spell _Ascendio_.

_Pixies_ have two varieties. One is a light yellow color, and the other is a light blue color.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Wraith</summary>

![Wraith](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9b80365c3995c0c2cd38a8c1eacf597327d3ac6.png)

_Wraiths_ can be found corrupting Zombies in the dripstone caves. When spawned, they have white eyes and are invincible to your attacks. You must make them walk through a circle of lit candles, like the one shown above, the make them vulnerable. When weakened, their eyes turn red and they become much faster.

Uppon death, _Wraiths_ can drop their _Shadow_, which is used to make the spellbook _Shadowstep_.

</details>



<details>
<summary>Yeti</summary>

![Yeti](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59347331b833f635187c70ae5a5e107eb365b73e.png)

_Yetis_ are found spawning at night in snowy biomes. A yeti packs a powerful punch, and is very heavy and knockback resistant. Be sure to keep your distance!

If killed, _Yetis_ have a chance to drop a _Yeti Tooth_, which is an ingredient used to brew the spellbook _Glacious_.

</details>

## Items:

- **Pixie Dust:** dropped by _Pixies_.
- **Scorched Obsidian:** traded by Piglins.
- **Shadow:** dropped by _Wraiths_.
- **Spell Tome:** found in dungeons, mineshafts, and libraries.
- **Yeti Tooth:** dropped by _Yetis_.
- **Mana Bottle:** brewed in the _Alchemy Pot_.
- **Cursed Book:** found in ancient cities, also a rare drop from witches.
- **Mana Charm:** dropped by _Necromancer_. When in offhand, doubles max Mana.

- **Wraith Spawn Egg:** operator only item.
- **Pixie Spawn Egg:** operator only item.
- **Yeti Spawn Egg:** operator only item.
- **Necromancer Spawn Egg:** operator only item.

## Necromancer:

The _Necromancer_ is a new boss which will drop the _Mana Charm_, an item which when put in offhand will **double** your max mana level!



<details>
<summary>Summoning</summary>

The _Necromancer_ is summoned using a ritual. You will need three things: 12 Purple Candles, 1 Amethyst Block, and 1 _Cursed Book_.

- The _Cursed Book_ can be found in ancient cities, or is a rare drop from witches.

Place the candles in a circle around the amethyst block, then throw the _Cursed Book_ ontop of the Amethyst. After you then light the candles, the _Necromancer_ will spawn!

Here is how to place the blocks:

![Necromancer Spawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ed73cfb81fec16df9f7f586bb9cd84ca6bedb2f.png)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Attacks</summary>

The _Necromancer_ has 2 modes, attack mode, and vulnerable mode. When he is purple, he is in attack mode. You can not harm him in this phase; you must evade his attacks until he turns red.

When he is red, he is vulnerable, meaning this is the time to damage him. Be warned, when he hits half health he gets much faster!

### Attacks:

_Necromancer_ has 3 attacks.

One of them is the _Amethyst Spiral_, where he will unleash a bunch of _Amethyst Bolt_ spells in a spiral. This attack is indicated by purple particles around him before he casts it.

Another is the _Electra Attack_. In this attack, he will summon _Electra_ spell fields att your feet. It is crucial to stay on the move while he casts this. It is signaled by blue particles around him before he casts it.

Finally, he can cast the _Ascendio_ spell in a spoiral around him, similare to the _Amethyst Spiral_. This attack is signaled by yellow particles before he casts it.

</details>

## Final Notes:

Thank you so much for downloading my datapack! If you enjoyed, please let me know! If you have any more Spellbook suggestions, I would love to hear them and I am open to updating this pack with more books if I get some good ideas!

I have a discord server where you can reach out to me, [here](https://discord.gg/vdfdNqPuQw).

Have a great day :)

title: Immersive Navigation
description: Adds multiple navigation tools to avoid F3 screen.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7eb35d7ca0efd8477cb6798378ae72d796e93e1f.png)
# Immersive Navigation

Immersive Navigation is a utility and quality-of-life mod for Minecraft that enhances exploration and immersion by providing a variety of tools to help navigate and understand the world, without relying on debug screens (F3). These tools simulate semi-realistic navigation and surveying experiences while maintaining gameplay immersion.
## Features

    Depth Meter: Displays the player's current Y-level (height).
    Cartesian Tool: Shows the player's X and Z coordinates or chunk information.
    Digital Clock: Shows the time in modern language. (12-Hour)
    Metal Detector: Detects nearby ores.
    Moist Sensor: Determines if the player is standing in a slime chunk **(My Favorite)**.
    Hollow Scanner: Identifies open areas (2-block tall) beneath the player.
    Terrain Analyzer: Detects if valuable materials exist under the player, summarizes the richness.
   ** Omni-Gauge**: All-in-one tool with switchable modes for multiple functionalities like time display, coordinate checking, and terrain analysis.

## Crafting
    Battery: Crafted using lapis lazuli and iron ingots.
    Solar Panel: Renewable energy component crafted using glass, iron ingots, and sunlight sensor.

### Not-so-near Plans

    Config for ore detection, compatibility with other mods.

### How to Use

    All tools: Right-click to for functionality.
    Omni-Gauge: Shift + Right-click to change mode.

### Installation

    If not from modrinth client:
    Download and install Fabric and Fabric API.
    Place the mod .jar file into your mods folder located in .minecraft.

title: DynamicPlayerCount
description: Changes player count on server list based on the pinged host on Velocity
body:
# Dynamic Player Count

Changes the Player Count on the Server List when pinged based on what host in pinged in your Velocity network, with posibility to set a max player count.

You need to map `config.yml` to match the servers from your network where you want to list a different Player Count.

Example configuration:

```
servers:
  - host: "play.server1.com"
    serverName: "server1"
    maxPlayerCount: false
    type: "dynamic"
    maxPlayers: 100
  - host: "play.server2.com"
    serverName: "server2"
    maxPlayerCount: false
    type: "static"
    maxPlayers: 50
debug: false
```
`host` is the host being pinged, and `serverName` is the server in your network where you want to take the player count. If a host is not mapped here, it will follow your Velocity configuration for player count (shows players in your entire network by default).

`type` is ignored if `maxPlayerCount` is set to false, and `maxPlayers` is ignored if `type` is set to `dynamic`

`static` sets the max player amount in your host to the `maxPlayers` number, while `dynamic` changes it to current players +1 (planning to add more functionality on the `dynamic` type)

**This plugin has not been tested using different plugins setups. Please submit an issue if you encounter any problem with other plugins or in general**

title: Awake
description: The world has gained consciousness through AI! Embark on an adventure and breathe life where you see fit in Minecraft!
body:
# Awake

**Awake** is an immersive Minecraft mod that brings a new level of interaction and adventure to your gameplay. With advanced AI capabilities, Awake allows you to communicate with mobs, embark on unique quests, and explore the world in innovative ways.

## Features

### Mobs
- **Speak with Mobs**: Engage in conversations with mobs. They keep track of various stats such as health, biome, weather changes, time of day, inventory items, and more.
- **Mob Commands**: 
  - Make mobs follow you.
  - Command mobs to attack other mobs or defend you.
  - Organize mobs into attack/defense groups.
- **Friendship Mechanics**: Befriend hostile mobs or make friendly mobs hostile again.
- **Home Commands**: Instruct mobs to return home or wait for you.
- **Pet Hunting**: Ask your pets to hunt food for you (currently supports land animals only).
- **Structure Finder**: Ask mobs to locate nearby structures, such as pyramids, specific villages, monuments etc...

### Quests
- **AI-Generated Quests**: Receive dynamically created quests.
- **Progressive Difficulty**: Quests become harder and more rewarding as you complete previous ones.
- **Unique Player Experience**: Each player gets different quests, making your adventure unique (Note: running this on a server is currently not supported as the game will crash, however once resolved, the Quest Table will enable player specific quests).
- **Repeatable and One-Time Quests**: Some quests can be repeated, while others are one-time challenges.
- **Quest Table Reset**: Reset your quest table at any time using an in-game command.

### World Interaction
- **Image Capture**: Take pictures and store them as images.
- **Share Adventures**: Share your captured images with mobs, showing off your adventures.

## Installation

1. Download the mod's JAR file.
2. Install the mod using the 1.19.4 Fabric modloader.
3. Start your Minecraft world and enjoy the new features!


## Feedback

Your feedback is crucial to me. Please share your experiences, report bugs, and suggest new features. Let's make Awake the best it can be together!

---

Join me on this exciting journey and awaken a new world of possibilities in Minecraft with **Awake**!

title: AE2LT Packaged Pattern Provider
description: Packaged Pattern Provider addon for AE2 Lightning Tech
body:
# AE2LT Packaged Pattern Provider

AE2LT Packaged Pattern Provider is an addon for AE2 Lightning Tech. It connects AE2 / AE2LT autocrafting to special machines, multiblock structures, altars, rituals, and other non-standard crafting systems from other mods.

It adds the **Packaged Pattern Provider** and **Wireless Packaged Pattern Provider**. Insert the matching **Packaged Core**, add patterns just like a normal Pattern Provider, and your ME network can supply ingredients, run the target machine, and return the finished products automatically.

## Features

- Adds the Packaged Pattern Provider and Wireless Packaged Pattern Provider
- Uses Packaged Cores to select the target machine family
- Supports special crafting tables, multiblock crafting, altars, rituals, infusion systems, fusion crafting, mana-based crafting, and machine-based recipes
- Automatically sends ingredients to the target machine
- Automatically returns finished products to the ME network
- Some integrations support fast batch-style processing
- Higher-tier Packaged Cores can cover lower-tier targets where applicable
- Includes in-game AE2 Guide documentation in English and Chinese
- Target integration mods are optional; you do not need to install every supported mod

## Basic Usage

1. Place a Packaged Pattern Provider next to the target machine's main block or core block.
2. Insert the matching Packaged Core into the provider's Packaged Core slot.
3. Encode the target machine's recipe as a pattern and place it in the provider.
4. When AE2 requests the item, the provider handles ingredient dispatch and product return.

The wireless version works with AE2LT's wireless provider systems for more flexible remote automation setups.

## Supported Integrations

This addon currently supports selected machines or crafting systems from:

- Actually Additions
- Ars Nouveau
- Draconic Evolution
- Extended Crafting
- Mystical Agriculture
- Malum
- Occultism
- Mekanism: More Machines
- Botania
- Re-Avaritia

For the full supported machine list, placement rules, and setup notes, check the in-game AE2 Guide section for AE2LT Packaged Pattern Provider.

## Dependencies

Required:
- Applied Energistics 2
- AE2 Lightning Tech

All target integration mods are optional. Install only the mods you want to automate; the matching Packaged Cores and integrations become available when those mods are present.

## Notes

The Packaged Pattern Provider does not bypass the original mechanics of the target mod. Multiblock structures must still be built correctly, and machines still require their normal energy, mana, catalysts, structure, space, or other crafting conditions.

title: Lobby4PvP
description: Enables interactive PvP in your lobby by simply holding a sword — safe, visual, and fully customizable with VIP gear, stats, and PlaceholderAPI support.
body:
# ⚔️ Lobby4PvP — Interactive Lobby PvP System A modern and lightweight PvP system designed for hubs and lobbies. Lobby4PvP lets players enable PvP simply by holding a sword — no commands, no menus, just pure interaction. When the sword is held, players automatically enter PvP mode and receive configurable armor, sounds, and effects. Once released, PvP disables safely after a short delay, returning the player to lobby mode. Everything is handled cleanly, with no duplication issues, plugin conflicts, or item loss. --- ## ✨ Main Features - **Interactive activation:** Enable PvP instantly by holding your sword. - **VIP profiles:** Custom weapons and armor for VIP players. - **Anti-duplication:** Fully protected against exploits and ghost items. - **Visual feedback:** ActionBar, BossBar, and chat notifications perfectly synced. - **Persistent stats:** Kills, deaths, hits, and KDR stored safely in `stats.yml`. - **Config reload:** `/lobby4pvp reload` refreshes all settings live — safely. - **Conflict override:** Works seamlessly with WorldGuard, Essentials, PvPManager, and CombatLogX. - **PlaceholderAPI support:** Full integration for scoreboards and tablists. - **bStats metrics:** Anonymous statistics (ID 27655). --- ## 🔌 PlaceholderAPI Integration Lobby4PvP includes full support for **PlaceholderAPI**, allowing you to display player PvP data anywhere — in scoreboards, holograms, menus, or tablists. All placeholders are automatically registered when the plugin detects PlaceholderAPI at startup. ### Available Placeholders | Placeholder | Description | |--------------|-------------| | `%lobby4pvp_status%` | Shows whether the player currently has PvP mode enabled or disabled. | | `%lobby4pvp_cooldown%` | Displays the remaining cooldown time before PvP can be re-enabled. | | `%lobby4pvp_kills%` | Shows the player’s total kills in the lobby. | | `%lobby4pvp_deaths%` | Shows the player’s total deaths in the lobby. | | `%lobby4pvp_hits%` | Displays how many successful hits the player has landed. | | `%lobby4pvp_kdr%` | Displays the player’s kill/death ratio (KDR). | | `%lobby4pvp_vip%` | Returns `true` or `false` depending on VIP status. | | `%lobby4pvp_version%` | Displays the current Lobby4PvP plugin version. | ### Example usage If your scoreboard or hologram plugin supports PlaceholderAPI (such as TAB, AjLeaderboards, DecentHolograms, etc.), you can directly use these placeholders. --- ## ⚙️ Commands & Permissions | Command | Description | Permission | |----------|--------------|-------------| | `/lobby4pvp` | Display plugin info | `lobby4pvp.info` | | `/lobby4pvp reload` | Reload the configuration | `lobby4pvp.reload` | | *(VIP gear)* | Access VIP sword and armor | `lobby4pvp.vip` | --- ## 💻 Compatibility & Config
config.yml 

# ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║                        Lobby4PvP — v1.8.6                            ║
# ║  Enable PvP in your lobby by holding a sword. Safe, robust, fast.    ║
# ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
#  QUICK HELP:
#  • Reload everything live: /lobby4pvp reload
#  • Text supports both legacy '&' colors and MiniMessage
#  • Hotbar slots are 0..8 (0 = far left, 8 = far right)
#  • Java 17+ plugin build; latest Paper 26.1.x servers require Java 25 at runtime
#  • Invalid sounds, particles, materials, enchantments or out-of-range values warn in console and use safe runtime fallbacks
#  • Empty lore lines like "" are valid and kept as intentional spacing
#
#  REFERENCES:
#  • Materials    → https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Material.html
#  • Sounds       → https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Sound.html
#  • Particles    → https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Particle.html
#  • Enchantments → https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/enchantments/Enchantment.html
#
#  NOTE ABOUT STATS:
#  • Player stats (kills, deaths, hits) are stored persistently in 'stats.yml'.
#  • No configuration is required; the file is created and maintained automatically.
#

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Core & Safety                                                       │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
debug: false                        # Extra console logs (useful for diagnosing conflicts)
check-for-updates: true             # Notify in console if a new version is available
keep-inventory-on-death: true       # Prevent drops/exp on death in the lobby (safe duels)

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ PvP Policy (scope & override)                                       │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
pvp:
  override-others: true             # If true, Lobby4PvP can un-cancel other plugins' PvP blocks
                                    # when BOTH players are in Lobby4PvP mode.
  worlds: ["*"]                     # Where this plugin applies. ["*"] = all worlds.
                                    # Example: ["lobby", "hub1"]
  blocked-message: "&cPvP is blocked here."
                                    # Shown to the attacker when damage is denied by policy.
                                    # Supports legacy '&' colors and MiniMessage.

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Timers (seconds)                                                    │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
timers:
  activate-seconds: 5               # Hold the sword for X seconds to enter PvP mode
  deactivate-seconds: 10            # After releasing the sword, PvP disables after X seconds
  cooldown-seconds: 0               # Wait time before enabling again (0 = off)

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Display (all channels are consistent)                               │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
display:
  actionbar: true                   # Show progress/status in the action bar
  bossbar: false                    # Show progress/status in a BossBar
  chat: true                        # Also print clean, non-spam chat messages
  bossbar-color: GREEN              # GREEN, BLUE, RED, PURPLE, PINK, WHITE, YELLOW
  bossbar-style: SOLID              # SOLID, SEGMENTED_6, SEGMENTED_10, SEGMENTED_12, SEGMENTED_20

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Default Sword (non-VIP profile)                                     │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
sword:
  give-on-join: true                # Give players the lobby sword on join
  slot: 2                           # Desired hotbar slot (0..8)
  material: IRON_SWORD              # Any valid Bukkit material
  display-name: "&aLobby Sword"
  lore:
    - ""
    - "&8-----------------------"
    - "&oHold to enable PvP"
    - "&oFun & safe duels in the lobby!"
    - "&8-----------------------"
  lock: true                        # Prevent moving/dropping plugin items (anti-dup)
  enchantments:
    - SHARPNESS:4
    - UNBREAKING:4

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Default Armor (auto-equipped while PvP is ACTIVE)                   │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
armor:
  helmet:
    material: IRON_HELMET
    display-name: "&aLobby Helmet"
    lore: []
    enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:3"]
  chestplate:
    material: IRON_CHESTPLATE
    display-name: "&aLobby Chestplate"
    lore: []
    enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:3"]
  leggings:
    material: IRON_LEGGINGS
    display-name: "&aLobby Leggings"
    lore: []
    enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:3"]
  boots:
    material: IRON_BOOTS
    display-name: "&aLobby Boots"
    lore: []
    enchantments: ["PROTECTION_FALL:4"]

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ VIP Profile (permission: lobby4pvp.vip)                             │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
vip:
  enabled: true
  permission: lobby4pvp.vip

  sword:
    enabled: true                   # If false, VIPs use the default sword profile
    slot: 2                         # Desired slot for VIP sword (can differ from non-VIP)
    material: DIAMOND_SWORD
    display-name: "&bVIP Lobby Sword"
    lore:
      - ""
      - "&8-----------------------"
      - "&oExclusive VIP sword"
      - "&oHold to enable PvP"
      - "&8-----------------------"
    enchantments:
      - SHARPNESS:5
      - UNBREAKING:3

  armor:
    helmet:
      material: DIAMOND_HELMET
      display-name: "&bVIP Helmet"
      lore: []
      enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:4", "UNBREAKING:3"]
    chestplate:
      material: DIAMOND_CHESTPLATE
      display-name: "&bVIP Chestplate"
      lore: []
      enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:4"]
    leggings:
      material: DIAMOND_LEGGINGS
      display-name: "&bVIP Leggings"
      lore: []
      enchantments: ["PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL:4"]
    boots:
      material: DIAMOND_BOOTS
      display-name: "&bVIP Boots"
      lore: []
      enchantments: ["PROTECTION_FALL:4", "DEPTH_STRIDER:3"]

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Item Flags                                                          │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
items:
  unbreakable: true                 # Make all plugin items unbreakable

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Effects                                                             │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
fx:
  sound: ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP      # Played when enabling PvP
  particle: CRIT_MAGIC              # Spawned around the player when enabling PvP
  disable-sound: ENTITY_ITEM_PICKUP # Played when disabling PvP
  disable-particle: CRIT            # Spawned around the player when disabling PvP

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Kill Celebration                                                    │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
kill-firework:
  enabled: true
  power: 1                          # 1..4 (higher = higher flight)
# Safe-state recovery applied when PvP is manually disabled
safe-state:
  auto-heal:
    enabled: true
    health: 20.0                    # Clamped to the player's max health
  auto-feed:
    enabled: true
    food-level: 20                  # 0..20
    saturation: 0.0                 # 0.0..20.0

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Messages (supports '&' colors and MiniMessage)                      │
# │ {seconds} is dynamically replaced                                   │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
messages:
  prefix: "&aLobby4PvP &8» "
  enable: "&a&lPvP mode enabled.&r &7Prepare for battle."
  disable: "&7PvP mode disabled. You are now safe."
  hold: "&7Hold your sword for &f{seconds}s &7to enable &aPvP mode&7."
  already-active: "&7PvP mode is already active."
  deactivate-progress: "&7PvP mode will disable in &f{seconds}s&7."
  deactivate-cancelled: "&7Deactivation cancelled."
  cooldown: "&7Wait &f{seconds}s &7before enabling &aPvP mode&7 again."
  world-pvp-disabled: "&cWorld PvP is globally disabled here. Lobby4PvP cannot enable combat in this world."

# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ PlaceholderAPI formatting                                           │
# │ Optional visual wrappers for numeric stats (use {value})            │
# │ Supports legacy '&' colors and MiniMessage                          │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
placeholders:
  status:
    enabled: "&aenabled"
    disabled: "&cdisabled"
  vip:
    true: "&btrue"
    false: "&7false"
  stats:
    kills: "&6⚔ {value}"
    deaths: "&c✖ {value}"
    hits: "&e☄ {value}"
    kdr: "&aKDR: {value}"
- **Minecraft:** 1.18 → 26.1+ - **Java:** 17 or higher - **Supported Loaders:** Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Bukkit *(partial)* - **Dependencies:** PlaceholderAPI (necessary), bStats (included) --- ## ❤️ Designed for performance Lobby4PvP was built to deliver a clean, lag-free lobby PvP experience. title: Dynamic Island Mod
description: An Apple-style Dynamic Island music HUD for Minecraft. Control Spotify & more without leaving the game.
body:
# 🎵 Dynamic Island HUD

Bring the sleek, modern aesthetic of Apple's Dynamic Island directly into Minecraft!

**Dynamic Island HUD** is a highly polished, client-side visual mod that overlays a beautiful, interactive media player at the top of your screen. Whether you're building, mining, or PvPing — seamlessly track and control your music without ever tabbing out of the game.

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🎧 Real-Time Media Integration
The mod uses advanced Windows System Media Transport Controls (SMTC) integration. This means it works flawlessly with **Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Chrome, Edge**, and almost any other media player running on your Windows PC.
* Displays the current **Track Name** and **Artist**
* Shows the live **Album Art** directly in-game
* Features a real-time **Progress Scrubber** so you always know where you are in the song

### 🌍 Multi-Language Support
Dynamic Island HUD natively supports **any language**, including full **right-to-left (RTL)** text rendering for languages like **Hebrew (עברית)** and **Arabic (العربية)**. Song titles and artist names display correctly no matter what language your music is in.

### 🎮 Native In-Game Controls
No more pausing your game to skip a bad song! The mod fully integrates with Minecraft's vanilla Controls menu. Easily rebind:
* **Play / Pause**
* **Skip to Next Track**
* **Return to Previous Track**
* **Toggle HUD Visibility**

### 🚀 Ultra-Optimized Performance
Built with performance as a top priority. The mod runs a persistent, ultra-lightweight background process that polls media data in under 10 milliseconds.
* **Zero FPS Drops** — rendering is highly optimized with no allocations in the render loop
* **No Server Join Lag** — unlike other external-integration mods, this won't slow down loading screens or cause thread locks when joining multiplayer servers

### 🎨 Fully Customizable
Access the ModMenu settings to tweak the Dynamic Island exactly to your liking:
* **Position** — place the HUD anywhere on your screen (left, center, right + offset)
* **Opacity** — adjust transparency so it never blocks your vision
* **Animation Speed** — customize how fast the island expands and collapses
* **Scroll Speed** — control how fast long track names scroll

---

## 📥 Installation & Requirements

This is a strictly **Client-Side** mod — install it on your own computer and you're good to go. Works perfectly on vanilla servers, Hypixel, and any other multiplayer network!

**Required Dependencies:**
* [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
* [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)

*(Highly Recommended: Install [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) to access the in-game settings screen!)*

---

**License:**
This mod is protected under the NA111N Non-Commercial License. It is 100% free to use, but may not be sold or distributed for commercial purposes.

# 🚀 Description

Take full control of your playtime with this highly customizable Minecraft timer mod!

This mod adds two powerful in-game timers designed to help you track your gameplay like never before:

- ⏱️ World Timer – Tracks the total time spent in a world or server
- ⏳ Session Timer – Tracks your current play session since joining

Every detail of your timers can be customized:

- Individual colors for every time unit (seconds, minutes, hours, days)
- Fully independent styling for each element
- Rainbow color effect for dynamic visuals 🌈
- Adjustable formatting and display style
- Drag & drop positioning — move timers anywhere on your screen
- Toggle visibility and layout options

By default, the Total Time counter is enabled and displayed in white.

## ⚙️ Easy Configuration (Mod Menu Required)

All advanced settings (like enabling the Session Timer, changing colors, or UI customization) require:

**[MOD MENU](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)**

## 🧩 Commands Included

Control your timers anytime with simple commands:

- /totaltime pause → Pause the Total Time counter
- /totaltime start → Resume the Total Time counter
- /sessiontimer pause → Pause the Session Timer
- /sessiontimer start → Resume the Session Timer

_💡 These commands are client-side focused and do not give gameplay advantages, making them safe for most servers._

## 🌍 Multiplayer & Singleplayer Ready

Works seamlessly in:

- Singleplayer worlds
- Multiplayer servers

_Lightweight, non-intrusive, and performance-friendly._

- [Yet Another Config Lib(YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)

Perfect for players who want to:

- Track grind sessions ⛏️
- Monitor world playtime 📊
- Improve productivity or speedrun tracking ⚡
- Customize their HUD completely 🎯

title: Chunk =  Random Block
description: If you enter a new chunk it will be a new random Block
body:
# Chunk RandomBlock Challenge
A fun and challenging Fabric mod that restricts your movement and survival to a single chunk at a time, while randomizing the world as you explore.
## 🚀 Features
### 1. 🧱 Chunk Randomization
Every time you enter a new chunk, its entire terrain is replaced with a **random solid block**. 
*   **Smart Filtering**: The mod automatically excludes "dangerous" or "fragile" blocks. No more falling into gravel or sand, and no torches or grass floating in the air.
*   **Solid Selection**: Includes full blocks, slabs, fences, walls, stairs, and glass.
### 2. 🚫 Mining Restriction
You are only allowed to break blocks within the chunk you are currently standing in. Trying to break blocks in neighboring chunks is blocked with a message.
### 3. ⏱️ BastiGHG Style Timer
A built-in timer displayed in the **Actionbar** (bottom-center) tracks your challenge progress.
*   Starts and pauses synchronized with the game challenge.
### 4. ⌨️ Commands
*   `/start`: Resumes the timer and activates all challenge rules (randomization and mining limits).
*   `/pause`: Pauses the timer and allows normal block breaking/exploration.
## 📥 Installation
1.  Download the JAR file for your specific Minecraft version.
2.  Install the **Fabric Loader**.
3.  Place the JAR file into your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
4.  (Optional) Install **Fabric API** (Required for the mod to function).

title: [World Generator/Challenge] Start In The Nether!
description: Reverse the gameplay! Spice it up by starting in the nether!
body:
# Introduction:
I'm sure many of you have thought about it: What if we started in the Nether? What if we had to escape to the real world to get resources and survive? Swap the nether with the overworld! Would it be possible? The answer is: yes. Many of us thought about this idea and some of us pulled this through. Some with considerably better results than other but yeah, most of them didn’t really succeed without the usage of either light or heavy mods. Data packs are delicate things. They all depend on the game itself, on the current version of Minecraft. In contrast to mods, either fabric or forge data packs cannot actually add new blocks, items or content to the game because they’re limited to use vanilla assets only… BUT that doesn’t mean a creative mind cannot create something new! Minecraft is HUGE, yes. That is not a question. If you use your mind well enough and the devs AND the game wishes you to succeed you can create new things with data packs for sure. So far this is the only working data pack for 1.18 that I found to be working and does what it is supposed to do. Swap the nether with the overworld safely, thus the player will start in the nether.

# Features:
Nothing much. Really. The nether and overworld dimensions are swapped.
You need to survive. Starting in the nether without any resources to help you survive is a hard job. VERY hard. I’ve done it countless times so I do know that… Good luck!

# Addendum:
There are quite a few data packs for 1.18 that should do the same as this pack. Only that they're outdated and falsely marked to work with 1.18. Most of these wasn't even updated for half a year, deprecated and neglected or was released while 1.18 wasn't released. I've tested the following data packs those do not work at all or are very buggy:

- StuleBackery's Start In The Nether Pack
- Cosmoguy's Nether Escape - Minigame/challenge (It's different kind of data pack but it does work in fact. Just installation is different.)
- paczek654321's nether start
- Yoyousss' Minecraft, But The Dimensions Are Switched...﻿

title: Tab Friends
description: Never lose track of your friends on busy servers - Tab Friends brings them to the top of the player list with eye-catching visual highlights and customizable colors!
body:
# Tab Friends

A client-side mod for Minecraft that allows you to add players to a friends list. Friends are displayed first in the server player list.

## Features

- Adding players to friends list via command
- Automatic sorting of player list: friends are always displayed first
- **Visual highlighting of friends:**
  - Colored background in player list
  - Customizable color and transparency through GUI
- Saving friends list between sessions
- Simple friends list management
- **Integration with Mod Menu** for convenient configuration through the game interface

## Commands

All commands start with `/tabfriend`:

- `/tabfriend add <player>` - add a player to the friends list
- `/tabfriend remove <player>` - remove a player from the friends list
- `/tabfriend list` - show the list of all added friends
- `/tabfriend clear` - clear the entire friends list
- `/tabfriend` - show command help

## Visual Display Configuration

The background color for friends can be configured through **Mod Menu**:

1. Install the [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) mod (optional but recommended)
2. In the game main menu, open "Mods"
3. Find "Tab Friends" in the list and click the settings icon
4. Available settings:
   - **Red, Green, Blue** - color components (0-255)
   - **Transparency** - background transparency level (0 = fully transparent, 255 = fully opaque)
   - **Color Preview** - ARGB color palette for quick selection

Default: dark green color with 50% transparency (`0x80008800`)

Settings are automatically saved to the `config/tab-friends-config.json` file

title: Durability
description: Adds new features to Minecraft's base mechanics and functions
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75fbfd584415b1fe2da18d60e5aa592d47eb939f_0.webp)

Durability is a mod that adds new mechanics to bits of vanilla gameplay.

**- CONTENT -**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

**New Content**

Cloak - Hides the user's nametag. When renamed, changes the player to another with skin and username based on cloak name.

Echoing Bottle - Brewed with Echo Shards and Experience Bottles. Rounds up the drinker's XP to a level.

Gilding Table - Increases a random enchantment's level by 1 up to 3 times. Uses gold.

Echoing Chamber - Transfers enchantments between similar items. Consumes Echo Shards.

New Curses
- Curse of Opacity - armor sets to 25%*level opacity
- Curse of Breaking - item takes increased damage per level
- Curse of Voiding - disables all attributes on item
- Curse of Obfuscation - obfuscates enchantment text

**Modifications**

Smithing Templates - Smithing Templates now have a durability of 4, which lowers when used in a Smithing Table. Templates can be repaired with Diamonds.

Itemstack Durability - Itemstacks now display a durability bar based on their stack limit. Items from Ender Pearls and Stews to Beds and Minecarts have an increased stack size.

Anvil Repairing - Repairing and renaming no longer takes an XP cost. Certain items can be combined in an anvil to change its properties.
- Netherite Scrap - repairs item entirely
- Magma Cream - repairs item by 25% of max durability
- Diamond - adds 32 "Diamond Durability"; cancels breaking based on number of diamond durability
- Player Head - changes player of head
- Dye - changes name color
- Feather - italics
- Ink Sac - bold
- Gunpowder - obfuscation
- Phantom Membrane - hides enchantments and attributes
- Amethyst - adds enchant glint
- Name Tag - sets lore of item to name of nametag
- Prismarine Crystal - undos amethyst, nametag, membrane

Soulbinded Items - Items combined with an Echo Shard in an anvil now respawn in the player's inventory on death, but can only occur once per shard.

Sword Blocking - Swords block now, reducing half damage taken and dealing damage to the sword. Swords can also autoattack. Weapon enchantments can be applied to tools. The Sweeping Edge enchantment enables sweeping on enchanted items.

Bow Inaccuracy - The longer a bow is held, the more the inaccuracy of the arrow increases.

Enchantment Mutex - Enchantments such as Sharpness and Protection have removed mutual exclusivity. 

Fletching - Fletching Tables now have a GUI to combine arrows with potions and craft fireworks.

Enchanting - Enchanting Tables have a new slot for books, which spreads a random enchantment on the book across all options on the table. Amethyst used on an option rerolls the option. Echo Shards in the book slot reduce the enchant requirement by half. Hovering over an option with a Spyglass shows all enchantments given by option.

Etc. - Compass shows coordinates, Clock shows time, Recovery Compass shows distance from death, and Spyglass shows the block looking at and distance. Enchanted Horse Armor. Mobs wearing full enchanted armor have a base enchant glint. Enchantments have roman numerals beyond level 10.

</details>

Join the Redev discord for developments & updates - https://discord.gg/jWN5cduHkT

Happy exploring!

title: StartupCommands
description: Allows you to set commands that run on server startup.
body:
This mod allows you to create commands that run on server startup.

There are 3 ingame commands you can use, /startupcommands, /addstartupcommand, and /removestartupcommad. All 3 have different uses.

/startupcommands allows you to see the current startup commands on your server as a list.

/addstartupcommand allows you to add a startup command to your command list, the command must be inside double quotes and not include a slash, (ex: "time set day").

/removestartupcommand allows you to remove a startup command based on number in the list. So, you can do /startupcommands which will tell you the number associated with your commands, then do /removestartupcommand (number of command to remove).

NOTE:
Commands execute 1 second apart from each other to make it sequential, this is so it is guranteed one takes place after another.

body:
![Background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2nQ7yAHS/images/02f29fd273ff8328d58c7cd2a9aeba102f25ef82.png)

# ItemFrameController

**ItemFrameController** is a Minecraft plugin for Spigot/Paper 1.16.x - 1.21.1 that provides precise control over player interaction with item frames in specified worlds. It’s ideal for protecting custom builds, museum areas, adventure maps, or simply enhancing server security.

## 🎯 Features

- 🚫 Prevent players from rotating item frames while sneaking.
- 🚫 Block placing items into item frames unless in Creative mode.
- 🛡️ Stop players or entities from breaking item frames.
- 🛠️ Restrict item frame placement.
- 🌍 Limit functionality to specific worlds.
- 💬 Customizable messages for each blocked action.

## ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin uses a YAML configuration file with the following structure:

```yaml
restricted-worlds:
  - world
  - custom_world

prevent-rotation: true
prevent-placing-items: true
prevent-knocking-by-player: true
prevent-knocking-by-entity: true
prevent-placing-frames: true

messages:
  rotation: "§cYou cannot rotate item frames in this world!"
  placing-items: "§cYou cannot place items into item frames here!"
  knocking-by-player: "§cYou cannot break item frames here!"
  knocking-by-entity: "§cEntities cannot destroy item frames here!"
  placing-frames: "§cYou cannot place item frames in this world!"

description: 让玩家拥有体力值。| Grant players stamina. By Printernet
body:
## 简体中文
这个数据包能让玩家拥有体力。

### 目前功能：
- 会损失体力的行为有：疾跑、跳跃、游泳、攀爬、攻击、受到伤害、盾牌格挡攻击；
- 潜行可加快体力恢复；
- 体力少于50%时获得饥饿debuff，移动速度、挖掘速度、攻击速度略微减慢；
- 体力少于25%时饥饿debuff提升等级，移动速度、挖掘速度、攻击速度更慢，攻击伤害降低；
- 体力为0%时会过劳，饥饿debuff等级更高且无法移动、挖掘、攻击；
过劳时体力恢复更慢，当体力恢复到50%时解除过劳状态；
- 以及一些适用于开发者（整合包作者、服主、地图作者和本数据包作者）的命令。

### 命令：
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_inf_stamina` 设置命令执行者有无限体力
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/unset_inf_stamina` 命令执行者取消设置无限体力
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_no_re_stamina` 使命令执行者体力无法恢复
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/unset_no_re_stamina` 让命令执行者体力可以恢复
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_max_stamina` 将命令执行者的体力回满
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_to_rest` 将命令执行者的体力清零以让其处于过劳状态

## English
This data pack grants players stamina.

### Current Features:
- Actions that drain stamina: sprinting, jumping, swimming, climbing, attacking, taking damage, and blocking attacks with a shield;
- Stealth increases stamina regeneration;
- When stamina drops below 50%, the hunger debuff is applied, slightly slowing movement speed, mining speed, and attack speed;
- When stamina falls below 25%, the hunger debuff level increases, further slowing movement speed, mining speed, and attack speed, and attack damage is reduced;
- When stamina hits 0%, exhaustion occurs, with the hunger debuff level increasing even higher, making movement, mining, and attacking impossible;
- During exhaustion, stamina recovery slows down, and exhaustion ends when stamina regenerates to 50%;
- Displays stamina icons and percentage in the action bar (in red when exhausted, white otherwise);
- Includes some commands for developers (modpack authors, server owners, map creators, and the author of this data pack).

### Commands:
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_inf_stamina` Set infinite stamina for the command runner
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/unset_inf_stamina` Cancel infinite stamina for the command runner
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_no_re_stamina` Prevent the command runner's stamina from recovering
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/unset_no_re_stamina` Allow the command runner's stamina to recover
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_max_stamina` Fully restore the command runner's stamina
- `/function printernet:stamina/extra/set_to_rest` Deplete the command runner's stamina to trigger exhaustion

When breaking a block guarded by piglins (such as gold block, nether gold ore), piglins admiring gold ingot will immediately toss the result item and finish the barter, which makes it possible for players to make bartering farm and gain a lot loots in a short period of time from piglins.

## Trident Killer

In Bedrock Edition, thrown tridents will cause damage when they are pushed by pistons, while they won't in Java Edition. But now this feature is ported to Java Edition, so you can make a trident killer with this mod.

title: [Template] Simplified WorldGen
description:
Brings back the simple world generation method with as few lines o code as possible instead of the tens of thousands present in 1.18-19.
Easily editable template.
body:
# Introduction:

I've been playing Minecraft since the first release but I only realized that there were in fact data packs. I immediately fell in love with world generation data packs and that how one minor change in the game's code can make the game feel wholly different. A simple replace of a block makes the world golden or makes it that there are PIGS in the place of every single leaves block in the game for every single tree that there is! I learnt, studied and made several world generation data packs for me, my friends and for the public while playing and toying around the Minecraft worldgen code that slicedlime released. But everything has changed with the cave update. Mojang completely rewrote the world generation system and it felt like all my previous studies went down the drain like nothing and I had to start re-learning how world generation works with each new release of Minecraft. They changed so much I could barely stand my ground with the new world generation settings. Back in 1.16 if I wanted jungle trees in a savanna biome I just added as few as 5 lines of code into the savanna biome and poof there now were extra jungle trees in the savanna biome. If you wanted end cities to generate or mansions in the nether? Just as easily as the previous method was. It was simple, easy, with very few limitations. Even someone like me who has absolutely terrible affinity for coding could enjoy himself. With 1.18 the removed this. If you want to add blue orchids to a biome? Forget it. The game will crash. You'd like nether biomes to exist in the overworld? Nope. Crash. You'd like to add some color to cold oceans and you'd want some coral to generate? Nah. As soon as you tell the game that there are corals in cold ocean biomes it'll crash. I really despise this new, overcomplicated, highly limited worldgen that Mojang has implemented with the 1.18 cave update. It made my work much much less enjoyable and much more frustrating with very little sense of achievement.


# What does the data pack do?

Honestly? Not much. You won't notice pretty much anything if you're a layman. Well... except for the new underground biomes that now can generate above ground. Yeah, sorry about that. That wasn't intentional. For some reason they now do generate above ground just as any other biome does. That was an accident. But the main goal of this data pack was to bring back the old kind of world generation. Not in the sense of gameplay but mechanics. Before 1.18 the game used as few as a few hundred, maybe even fewer lines of code to tell the world how and what sort of biomes should it generate. However, all that changed with the cave update. Now the game generates the very same biomes with the few new ones with as much as 200.000 lines of code! That's absurd. Can't even get my head around that. I can't work with that! I cannot easily modify that or change any of that! That's way too much! This data pack tries to make the world generate pretty much the same way as before but with as few lines of code as possible so me and maybe a few other inexpert, clumsy ones can get a sense of what is exactly going on in the data pack, then modify it t other imagination. Now the game generate mostly the same biomes, mostly the same way but with 1423 lines of code instead of the default 205030.

body:
# DragonHelper
DragonHelper is a QOL mod for any sort of Dragon Simulator server out there, designed to make your play experience better!

The mod is designed to be compatible with any sort of dragon simulator server with any sort of features, so it uses a configuration system to define attributes that cause the below features to work.

Current features:
- Rare dragon and golem notifications
- The ability to disable summoning eye placement, other player loot, and loot number texts
- Multiple UI elements designed to track kills and slayer quest progress
- Auto-sell


If you are interested in tracking data on another server that is not specified by default in this mod, you'll need to follow the steps below.
  1. Open your `mods` folder, navigate to the root game instance directory, and find the `config` folder.
  2. Find and open the `servers.json` file within the `dragonhelper` folder, located inside of the `config` folder that you opened in step 1.
  3. Add a new server to the list in JSON format. The server name MUST be lowercased.
  4. Add configuration keys to your new server. Change the values associated with each configuration key to the associated lowercase text/command present on the new server. For example, if I wanted to add a new server where I can auto-sell, and the server's sell command is `/sellallitems`, I would add the following to my server's json: `"auto-sell-normal": "sellallitems"`

Example server.json file:
```
{
  "examplenewserver": {
    "auto-sell-normal": "sellallitems"
  },
  "dragfights": {
    "eye-place-contains-text": "placed a summoning eye",

title: MCAPVR
description: The bare minimum essentials for playing Minecraft in VR!
body:
## Description
MCAPVR is a modpack made to be used as a base (or used as-is for a vanilla experience), for playing Minecraft in Virtual Reality. Normal Minecraft VR can be compared to Skyrim VR in that, yes, it works, but there is a lot of room for improvement. Vivecraft is a wonderful mod, and none of this would exist without it, but it, too, can be improved. 

MCAPVR is a nod to the three Skyrim VR mods PLANCK, HIGGS, and VRIK - the three mods that no Skyrim VR player should play without. All three are capitalized, so Minecraft Capitalized VR is the name.

## Features
MCAPVR's mod list was carefully picked. I've only included mods that aim to enhance vanilla Minecraft's VR experience without breaking the vanilla feel. title: Trial Chambers: More Encounters
description: This datapack boosts the generation frequency of hallways and encounters in Trial Chambers.
body:
In vanilla Trial Chambers, hallways and encounters are quite rare. This datapack increases their generation frequency, creating larger, more complex, and more varied Trial Chambers. It does not add any new room.

![Steve in an encounter.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9z53D68e/images/c4ff489dc5b5df7976d3253a9339c6ea8ae5dc8d.png)

**Note**: Generation remains random; some Trial Chambers may not differ much from vanilla. You may need to explore several Trial Chambers to notice a change.

# Changes
- Increases the generation weight of hallways and encounters relative to chambers
- Adds a cross-shaped hallway piece to allow hallways to branch

# Planned Updates & Feedback
Feedback from players is highly appreciated. Feel free to share your thoughts on hallway and encounter frequency, on specific hallways pieces, or any other aspect you think could be tuned.

Considered updates I would appreciate feedback on:
- Allowing encounters 1 and 5 to occasionally branch into separate hallways
- Making intersections lead to hallways instead of directly leading into a chamber
- Increasing the weight of dead ends (rubble) with chests to make dead ends less frustrating

You can submit your feedback or bug reports on my [Feedback Form](https://forms.gle/vGUBdSqqPh6tTkig9).

No additional content such as rooms, encounters, or hallway pieces will be added.

# Additional Information
If my math is correct, this should be the frequency difference between Vanilla and this datapack:

| Type of room        | Vanilla              | Datapack             |
|---------------------|----------------------|----------------------|
| Chamber             | 97.48%               | 28.24%               |
| Hallway             | 1.30%                | 38.82%               |
| Encounter           | 0.41%                | 23.53%               |
| Dead end            | 0.81%                | 5.88%                |

Contrary to what it might seem, it does not reduce the number of chambers; it only results in slightly longer hallways before reaching one.

Encounters being extremely rare has been reported as a bug ([MC-275407](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-275407)). You can vote for it on the bug tracker so that everyone can experience encounters without the need of a datapack.

title: AdminCraft
description: AdminCraft is a powerful moderation toolkit designed for server admins and moderators who want more control, smoother management, and better oversight of their community.
body:
AdminCraft is a powerful moderation toolkit designed for server admins and moderators who want more control, smoother management, and better oversight of their community. Whether you're running a small survival server or managing a bustling SMP, AdminCraft equips your staff team with everything they need to keep the game fair and fun.

# ✨ Features 
- __(Everything is configurable!)__
- **Tempban system** - Prevent rulebreakers joining the server for a specified amount of time, easilly
- **Spawn Protection** - Keep your server's spawn area safe from griefing and chaos.
- **Mute Mode** - Silence disruptive players without needing them to log out.
- **Freeze Mode** - Prevent suspicious players moving and interacting with the world during your investigations
- **Alt Account Detection** - Identify suspicious players who may be using alternate accounts.
- **Configurable sanction** - Configure sanctions that can be applied quicly with a simple command, depending on the reason and the past sanctions.
- **Discord-based appeal system** - Allow players to appeal their sanction, while still keeping the hand on your sanctions
- **Centralised sanction database** - Store every sanction to easily find a player history
- **Inventory and Enderchest management** - View and edit your players' inventory and enderchest, even when they are offline!
- **Offline management features** - Teleport to offline players, teleport offline players and edit their tags!

## Planned features
- **Staff mode** - Keep your player inventory separated from your admin's one, to switch quickly between moderation and game.
- **World Logging** - Track and review player activity to catch griefers and rule-breakers. (Planned for next version)
- **Word Blacklist** - Prevent players sending inappropriate messages, to keep the chat clean.
- **Staff Prefix** - Help your staff demarcating from other player with a configurable prefix and name/chat color.
- And **much more!**

# 🚀 Why AdminCraft?
Running a server is hard enough —moderation shouldn't be. AdminCraft gives you the tools to:
- Quickly respond to griefing or cheating.
- Detect and deal with alt accounts.
- Protect your spawn with case.
- Manage disruptive behavior on the spot.

This is just the beginning-more features and improvements are on the way to make AdminCraft the ultimate staff
companion mod.

**Discord:** https://discord.gg/uKpPsaYmgk

<details>
<summary>Spoiler: Commands</summary>

**Sanctions**
- `/mute <player> <(reason)>` -> prevents a player from sending messages in chat or placing signs
- `/tempmute <player> <duration> <(reason)>` -> same as above, but temporarily 
- `/unmute <player>` removes a player mute
- `/warn <player> <(reason)>` -> warns a player with a chat message
- `/tempban <player> <duration> <(reason)>` -> temporarily bans a player
-> `/sanction <player> [configuredReason1|configuredReason2|…]` -> applies a configured sanction template on a player (debug in progress)

**Tools**
- `/alts <player>` -> List every players who logged in with the same ip address than the player
- `/freeze <player>` -> Toggles the freeze mode for a player (preventing him moving and interacting with the world, the mode is cleared after each server restart)
- `/history <player>` -> Lists a player’s received sanctions, and reports
- `/reports <player>` -> Lists the reports accusing the player
- `/otp <target> <(destination/player)>` -> Teleports a player to a destination or another player, even offline
- `/otag <target> [add|list|remove] <tag>` -> Edit player tags even offline
- `/editappeal <id> [delay|status] <delay/status>` -> Edit a player's appeal
- `/editduration <id> <duration>` -> Edits a sanction duration
- `/playerinfo <player>` -> Gives some usefull informations on a player (location, active sanctions)

**Player commands**
- `/report <player> <reason>` -> Reports a player to the server staff

**Legend**
- `<argument>` -> mandatory argument
- `<(argument)>` -> facultative argument 
- `[arg1|arg2|…|argN]` -> (mandatory) choose one argument between the list

**Duration argument**
The /temp\* commands follow the following regex:
`^(?:(\d+)d)?(?:(\d+)h)?(?:(\d+)m)?(?:(\d+)s)?$`
Which means that all the temp* commands syntax for duration is `<days>d<hours>h<minutes>m<seconds>s` (without spaces), but if you remove one field it will still works.
Exemples:
- `1d`-> 1 day
- `29d4h` -> 29 days and 4 hours
- `4h35m`-> 4 hours and 35 minutes
- `4h5s`-> 4 hours dans 5 seconds

</details>


<details>
<summary>Spoiler: Special Thanks</summary>

Thank you to everyone who helped me make this mod!

### Code
- Redstone_Dubstep (respawn mechanic debug and ports to new versions)
- bl4ckscor3 (ports to new versions)
- CYB3RCA4T (Gradle troobleshootings)

</details>
