title: Pendulum
description: Client side script executor for Minecraft.
body:
# Pendulum

**Client-side JavaScript executor for Minecraft.** Automate player actions — movement, construction, combat, inventory,
world queries, and `Baritone` supported. Designed for both human players and AI agents.

This mod is partly inspired by `Playwright.js`, which allows agents to control web browsers via JavaScript. Pendulum
brings that same power to Minecraft, enabling complex automation and AI integration through a simple JS API.

## Version Support

| Minecraft | Fabric | Forge | NeoForge | Status          |
|-----------|--------|-------|----------|-----------------|
| 1.20.1    | ✅      | ✅     |          | Fully Supported |
| 1.21.1    | ✅      | ❌     | ✅        | Fully Supported |
| 26.1.2    | 🔨     | ❌     | 🔨       | In development  |

## Features

For detailed documentation, see the [Documentation](https://docs.iafenvoy.com/docs/mod/pendulum/)

### 🧑 For Players

- **`/pendulum execute`** — run JavaScript inline in chat
- **`/pendulum file`** — run `.js` scripts from `.minecraft/pendulum/`
- **`mc.*`** — 80+ API functions: `mc.player.forward()`, `mc.world.findBlocks()`, `mc.inv.hasItem()`, `mc.gui.click()`, and more. Log via `pendulum.log()`, `pendulum.warn()`, `pendulum.error()`.
- **`br.*`** — 45 Baritone functions: pathfinding, mining, farming, building schematics

### 🤖 For AI Agents 

- **MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 over TCP** — native AI agent integration
- **`script/eval`** — execute arbitrary JS and return results
- **`script/status`** / **`script/abort`** — manage script state
- **`gui/enumerateWidgets`** — full recursive widget tree
- **`gui/guiElements`** — read all visible GUI controls
- **`gui/screenshot`** — capture the game view
- **`simulate/click`** / **`gui/clickButton`** — click GUI elements
- **`simulate/typeText`** / **`simulate/pressKey`** — keyboard input
- Compatible with VS Code Copilot, Claude Desktop, and any MCP client

## Quick Start

```js
// Walk forward 1 second
/pendulum execute mc.player.forward(20)

// Mine all pumpkins nearby
/pendulum execute for(let p of mc.world.findBlocks('minecraft:pumpkin',8)){ mc.player.breakBlockAt(p.x,p.y,p.z) }

// Run a script file
/pendulum file farm.js

// AI Agent workflow: screenshot + click
gui/screenshot  →  gui/clickButton("Done")  →  simulate/typeText("Hello", true)
```

## MCP Server

Start the MCP server for AI agent access:

```
/pendulum mcp start      # default port 25566
/pendulum mcp stop       # stop the server
/pendulum mcp status     # check if running
```

Configure your MCP client to connect to `localhost:25566` (default).

title: World Edit Mini
description: A miniature version of WorldEdit... in a datapack.
body:
You can run the command `/function editor:get_items` to get an "Open Editor" tool which, when used, will select the block you are looking at, and enter Selection Mode. (You will also get a "Teleport" tool; this is unrelated and just for utility.)

In Selection Mode (where any number of block positions can be selected), these tools are available:

1. Toggle (gold): Select the block position you are looking at, or de-select it if it is already selected.
2. Exit (wooden): De-select all selected blocks and exit the editor.
3. Convert to Cube (diamond): Find the smallest cuboid containing all selected positions. Select this cuboid (deselecting all positions), and switch to Cube Mode.
4. Set Blocks (stone): Set each selected block to the block you are currently looking at.
5. Move (iron): Move all selected positions by one block in the direction you are looking.

In Cube Mode (where a cube(oid) is selected), these tools are available:

1. More Options (book): Open the secondary Cube Mode menu.
2. Exit (wooden): De-select the cube and exit the editor.
3. Fill (stone): Fill the cube with the block you are looking at.
4. Convert to Positions (diamond): Select one position at each corner of the selected cube. De-select the cube and switch to Selection Mode.
5. Move (iron): Move the cube _by its size_ in the direction you are looking. (For example, if the cube is 2 blocks high and you are looking up, it will move 2 blocks up. If you want to move by 1 block, convert to positions first.)
6. Copy (copper): Copy the selected region to the clipboard. You will get a new "clipboard item" representing the copied structure. While holding the clipboard item, you can right-click to paste, or left-click to discard the copied structure. (Do not destroy the clipboard item through any other means, or you may experience bugs!)

In the secondary Cube Mode menu, these tools are available:
1. Back (book): Return to the main Cube Mode menu.
2. Select Same Blocks (gold): Select each block inside the selected cube which is exactly the same as the block you are looking at, and switch to Selection Mode.
3. Expand (diamond): Expand the selected cube so it contains the block you are looking at.
4. Generate Structure Block (netherite): Create a structure block configured to contain the selected cube.

Have fun! :)


A few notes:
- As the "fill cube" method is relatively inefficent due to command limitations, `/gamerule max_command_sequence_length` (by default set to 65536) determines (approximately) the maximum number of blocks that may be filled. You may wish to set this to a larger value (for example, `/gamerule max_command_sequence_length 16777216`).
- Similarily, `/gamerule max_block_modifications` (by default set to 32768) determines the number of blocks that may be copied, pasted, or filled at once. You can set this to a larger value (for example, `/gamerule max_block_modifications 2147483647`), however the server may slow down or crash if lots of blocks are being modified.
- If you find any bugs, let me know! (I'm on Discord!)



_(**Disclaimer**: I haven't used WorldEdit and have no idea how it works, but I wasn't really sure what else to name this datapack. I just made this because I wanted to be able to use /fill easier, and use copy-paste.)_

title: Enchantments Rebalanced
description: Improves the broader enchanting process in multiple ways.
body:
[!["Minecraft Rebalanced" Collection by RainlessSky](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft%20Rebalanced-2A2B2F?style=flat-square&logo=modrinth&label=part%20of&labelColor=222329)](https://modrinth.com/collection/rWTOiG2z)
![Minecraft Rebalanced sees survival as a survival game, and less of a free sandbox.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jPZFRfGa/images/7ebd705feba2a30b4017405ac475012e475fdcd5.png)
The goal of Enchantments Rebalanced is to improve unbalanced enchantments and to change how some enchantments are obtained, from an experienced player's perspective.

**This datapack needs plenty of constructive feedback, whether it's positive, mixed, or negative. Please join the Discord server and share your thoughts or suggestions!**
****

### A note about the design of Enchantments Rebalanced
Enchantments Rebalanced is created from the standpoint that some enchantments are imbalanced, and that most enchantments can be obtained too easily. While I understand that some may agree with these opinions, many likely don't.

**Don't *expect* your personal opinion to be validated and your own playstyle to be strengthened by Enchantments Rebalanced.**

****

### Changes
- Mending and Unbreaking are now mutually exclusive
  - This change introduces a tradeoff between two choices:
    - Equipment with infinite lifespan, at the expense of needing to go and repair more often, or;
    - Equipment that lasts longer, but will eventually need to be replaced
- All anvil costs for enchantments have been adjusted
  - This, for the most part, makes lower tier enchantments add 1-2 levels, medium tier add 3-4, and high tier add 4-8 levels.
- Anvils are now 8 iron ingots cheaper (31 -> 23)
- Librarian villagers can no longer sell Mending
- Fletcher villagers ask for double the amount of sticks when buying sticks from players
  - This is to reduce the efficiency of wood farms for villager trading

**Suggest more settings you want added in my discord!**
- **PvP** - Allows players to hit other players [`true = enabled, false = disabled`]
- **Name Tag Visibility** - Shows player's names above their heads [`true = shown, false = hidden`]
- **Health Visibility** *(Requires Name Tag Visibility)* - Shows player's health under their nametag [`true = shown, false = hidden`]
- **Heal All** - Fills the health of all players to full
- **Feed All** - Fills the hunger bar of all players to full
- **Clear All** - Clears the inventories of all players, excluding you
- **Glowing** - Applies the glowing effect to all players [`true = glowing, false = not glowing`]
- **Spectators** - Sets player's gamemodes to spectator on death [`true = enabled, false = disabled`]
- **Death Lightning** - Spawns a lightning effect at dead players [`true = enabled, false = disabled`]
- **Chat** - Disables typing for all players who do not have op [`true = enabled, false = disabled`]
- **End Crystal Explosions** - Disables the explosions on end crystals [`true = explodes, false = does not explode`]
- **TNT Minecart Explosions** - Disables the explosions on tnt minecarts [`true = explodes, false = does not explode`]
- **Ender Pearls** - Disables throwing ender pearls [`true = usable, false = unusable`]
- **Wind Charges** - Disables throwing wind charges [`true = usable, false = unusable`]
- **Tridents** - Disables shooting/riptiding with tridents [`true = usable, false = unusable`]
- **Shields** - Disables blocking with shields [`true = usable, false = unusable`]
- **Bows** - Disables shooting with bows [`true = usable, false = unusable`]
- **Crossbows** - Disables shooting with crossbows [`true = usable, false = unusable`]
- **Hunger** *(Will cause ∞ health regeneration)* - Disables the hunger meter going down [`true = enabled, false = disabled`]
- **Nether** - Disables entering the nether dimension [`true = open, false = closed`]
- **End** - Disables entering the end dimension [`true = open, false = closed`]

title: JMG's Better Than Ever (BTE)
description: This mod is a hobby project. Overhaul and harden your usual minecraft gameplay with new features and goals. Inspired by Better Than Wolves. Have fun, but don't die trying.
body:
(**This mod is a solo project made in MCreator**, made as a hobby and for community entertainment, so please **be careful when adding it to already existing packs** due to the drastic features and compatibility aspects. So share your suggestions for the future and report any exploits and bugs (but not the funny ones!))

**Note: JEI, EMI and it's addons are heavily recommended!**

JMG’s Better Than Ever is a survival overhaul mod for Minecraft that transforms most aspects of the game into a horrific experience. From the moment you spawn, you're much more fragile and every step is dangerous. Hunger, thirst, and temperature are your arch-enemies from the beginning, and even simple tasks like chopping wood or mining stone require careful planning. Early tools are weak, and all resources are still there, but can't be gathered like they used to, forcing you to think strategically and make your decisions count much more.

![Dawn](https://i.imgur.com/RTitRUc.png)

As you progress, you gain access to new materials, crafting methods, and forging techniques. Copper, bronze, and eventually steel unlock new tools, weapons, and ways to process materials, while machines like the sawmill and millstone make resource management more efficient. Mobs are more geared and dangerous, and domesticating animals becomes a difficult choice rather than a task.

![Fortress](https://i.imgur.com/SMTnskj.png)

The mod emphasizes a sense of evolution and accomplishment. Each stage, from the primitive Copper Age to the End-Game, rewards careful planning, experimentation, and survival skill. Every decision matters, and progress is earned, giving the game a deeper, more challenging, and chaotic experience.

![Forge](https://i.imgur.com/gmVfDBY.png)

Defeat old foes with new abilities. Unlock materials by travelling in the brutal world and defeating mobs. Make little and huge steps to feel safe once again, but don't die in the way!

Explore new ores in the Nether, which are the equivalents of Overworld's materials. Use new fuels, building blocks, and much more.

![Nether](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c2ce309541c80e681a7d25eb5113b4f6387993d.png)

**(This mod was heavily inspired by FlowerChild's Better Than Wolves mod, so shoutout to him and the BTW community!)**

title: Prism Perms
description: Cross‑platform permissions plugin for Bukkit, BungeeCord, and Velocity. Lightweight YAML storage, simple commands, and rich stats tools (groups/users, ungrouped/missing/list, names cache) with pagination and safe output chunking.
body:
Prism Perms is a lightweight, cross‑platform permissions plugin for Minecraft servers. It provides simple, consistent group and user permission management across Bukkit/Spigot/Paper, BungeeCord, and Velocity without needing a database. Data is stored in readable YAML with built‑in backup/restore and live reload/watch.

- Uniform commands across all platforms for adding/removing groups and permissions
- Per‑user overrides (allow/deny) and group membership management
- Rich stats tools to inspect groups and users, including ungrouped/missing/list
- Pagination and safe chat chunking to prevent message overflows
- Online/offline player name resolution via a cached names store (timestamps persisted)
- Designed for small to medium servers that want a fast, file‑based solution

## Quick Commands
- Version: `/pp version`
- Groups: `/pp group add <name>`, `/pp group remove <name>`, `/pp group list`
- Group perms: `/pp group perm add <group> <perm>`, `/pp group perm remove <group> <perm>`, `/pp group perms list <group>`
- User groups: `/pp user setgroup <player> <group>`, `/pp user removegroup <player> <group>`
- User perms: `/pp user perm add <player> <perm>`, `/pp user perm remove <player> <perm>`
- User info: `/pp user list <player>`, `/pp user overrides <player>`
- Stats: `/pp stats users ...`, `/pp stats groups [members [limit]]`, `/pp stats verbose [group]`
- Backup/Restore: `/pp backup`, `/pp restore`

## Permissions
- Admin: `prismperms.admin`

title: LocatorToggle
description: Allow Users to Toggle the New Locator Bar
body:
## 📋 Overview LocatorToggle is a lightweight Spigot plugin that allows players to locally toggle the newly introduced locator bar. When toggled off, the player is also hidden from other players’ locator bars, providing a more private gameplay experience. ❗ **Gamerule 'locatorBar' must be set to 'true'** ## 🎥 Demonstration ## 🛠️ Commands - **/locator** - Toggles the locator bar functionality on/off for the player. - **/locator radius \** - Sets the locator bar radius (1-60,000,000 blocks). - **/locator reload** - Reloads the plugin configuration and language files. ## 🔐 Permissions | Permission node | Description | Default setting | |-----------------|--------------------------------------------------|-----------------| | locator.toggle | Controls usage of the /locator command | Everyone | | locator.radius | Controls usage of the /locator radius subcommand | Everyone | | locator.reload | Controls usage of the /locator reload subcommand | Operators | ## ⚙️ Configuration
Click to view config.yml ```yaml # Whether new users will have their locator disabled by default. locator-disabled-by-default: false # Maximum radius that players can set using /locator radius. locator-max-radius: 60000000 # Default radius when players enable the locator. # This only applies when the player hasn't set a custom radius yet. default-locator-radius: 60000000 ```
## 🔌 PlaceholderAPI Support This plugin provides the following placeholders: - `%locatortoggle_status%` - Returns "enabled" or "disabled" based on the player's preference - `%locatortoggle_radius%` - Returns the player's custom locator bar radius (if set)

body:
ZyrenAuth

A modern, high-performance, and privacy-focused server-side authentication platform for Paper.

--- ### **Overview** **ZyrenAuth** is a robust account security and cryptographic authentication lifecycle utility engineered explicitly for Paper and Spigot-compatible server environments. It intercepts player network connections to execute mandatory validation challenges, establishing a strict data barrier that protects player states, inventories, and profile configurations until verification parameters are successfully met. --- ### **Key Features** * **Reverse Word Captcha Verification** — Enforces a randomized reverse-string algorithmic challenge instantly upon connection, preventing automated credential stuffing and bot injection vectors. * **Graphical 2FA Initialization** — Features an in-game GUI pipeline (`/za 2fa setup`) that generates and projects local 2FA secret key states and QR code URIs directly to authenticator applications. * **Isolated Space Teleportation** — Seamlessly forces unauthenticated connections onto a locked, safe void coordinate context (`0.5, 0.0, 0.5`), completely suppressing network world interactions and movement events until verification succeeds. * **Persistent State Persistence** — Automatically serializes and caches complete player data matrices—including inventories, vector positions, active status effects, food boundaries, and experience blocks—restoring them seamlessly upon successful lifecycle completion. * **Intelligent Network Profiling** — Dual-mode operation handling: * *Online-Mode Pipelines:* Seamlessly authenticates valid Mojang verification hashes while managing dynamic username updates. * *Offline-Mode Fallbacks:* Automates session persistence for pre-registered users while enforcing strict registration protocols for unrecognized profiles. * **Asynchronous Release Auditing** — Connects non-blockingly to Modrinth asset channels on startup to evaluate, verify, and notify console administrators of available optimization payloads. * **Enterprise Storage Ingestion** — Supports relational MySQL and MariaDB database storage engines for multi-server synchronization, complete with a structured, encrypted file-based archive fallback. --- ### **Quick Start & Deployment** 1. **Deployment:** Drop the compiled `ZyrenAuth` binary archive directly into the active server `plugins/` directory. 2. **Initialization:** Run the server lifecycle to instantiate the primary configuration schema at `plugins/config/zyrenauth/`. 3. **Configuration Extraction:** Utilize the [Online Configuration Generator](https://zyrenauth.wuaze.com/) to easily compile and modify variables within the local `config.json` payload. --- ### **Command Framework Syntax** #### **User Interaction Group** * `/register ` — Establishes a new cryptographically hashed profile record. * `/login ` — Initiates a BCrypt validation challenge to unlock player interaction parameters. * `/captcha ` — Supplies the response payload to the active reverse-string challenge. * `/addemail ` — Connects an SMTP-reachable tracking address to the profile context. * `/emailconfirm ` — Validates email ownership tokens. * `/resetpassword` & `/resetconfirm` — Handles remote recovery routines. #### **Administrative Controls (OP Only)** * `/za help` — Maps the entire executable subcommand tree. * `/za status` — Evaluates localized storage engine metrics and performance health states. * `/za reload` — flushes and hot-reloads configuration matrix parameters directly from disk memory. * `/za migrate ` — Manages data profile migrations across active infrastructure contexts. * `/za delete [confirm]` — Completely purges targeted user authentication blocks. ---

Available exclusively for the Paper and Spigot Server ecosystem.

title: Darbz's EnchantLimiter
description: Darbz’s EnchantLimiter is a lightweight, performance-friendly Paper/Spigot plugin that lets you limit, downgrade, or completely ban specific enchantments using a simple YAML config.
body:
# EnchantLimiter

**EnchantLimiter** is a flexible Minecraft plugin that allows you to limit or ban enchantments on your server, with support for world-specific rules. Control which enchantments are allowed, set maximum levels, or ban them entirely.  

---

## Features

- **Limit enchantment levels:** Set a maximum level for any enchantment.  
- **Ban enchantments completely:** Set `max-enchant: 0` to remove an enchantment entirely.  
- **World-specific rules:** Restrict enchantments to certain worlds, or apply globally with `all`.  
- **Automatic enforcement:** Player inventories are checked on join and adjusted automatically.  

---

## Quick Start

1. **Download the plugin** JAR file and place it in your server’s `plugins` folder.  
2. **Start the server** to generate the default configuration files.  
3. **Open `banned-enchantments.yml`** and define your enchantment limits.  
4. **Apply changes without restarting:** Run the command:

   ```
   /enchantlimiter-rlc
   ```

   This reloads the plugin’s configuration instantly.  

---

## Configuration Example

```yaml
limited-enchants:
  fire_aspect:
    max-enchant: 0        # Bans Fire Aspect completely
    limit-in-world: all   # Applies in all worlds
  sharpness:
    max-enchant: 3        # Limits Sharpness to level 3
    limit-in-world: world_nether   # Only limits in the Nether
```

---

## How it works

1. When a player joins, the plugin scans their inventory.  
2. Any banned enchantments (`max-enchant: 0`) are removed.  
3. Enchantments exceeding the maximum level are reduced automatically.  
4. World-specific restrictions are respected.  

---

## Notes

- `max-enchant: 0` removes the enchantment entirely.  
- `limit-in-world` can be a single world name or `all` to apply restrictions everywhere.  
- Works automatically on player join to ensure all inventories comply with the rules.  
- Reload configuration at any time using:

  ```
  /enchantlimiter-rlc
  ```

**Take full control of your server’s enchantments and customize per world!**

# PVP Arena
inspired by (and approved by) Youtuber Collywabbles, PVP Arena allows you to duel another player with random items.

### HOW TO USE
- run /function pvp_arena:setup/quick_load (note, this will paste a large bedrock box around you, make sure the area is clear)

title: Programmable robots
description: a mod that adds programmable robots, a lunar panel block, a teleporter block and a teleporter item
body:
_(this is my first ACTUAL mod)_
# Programmable Robots

## 📖 What's this mod?
You have a lot of farms which aren't fully automated. You need to do something for each one to work. You don't want to alternate farms every once in a while, as it can be quite inefficient and annoying.

This mod makes it possible to automate farms like this using programmable robots. You can now create a robot by placing a carved pumpkin on top of 2 iron blocks and right clicking on it to open up the action menu. 
For the robot to execute your actions at all, you also need a lunar panel block 35 blocks near the robot.

In the action menu, you can customise speciffically what it does at night.

You can also give it item(s) by either dropping them on the ground near the robot, or by right clicking the robot while crouching and dragging your item from the player inventory to the robot inventory. 

> 💡 **Note**
> 
> **You can only open these menus at daytime.**

The specified actions get ran at night.

To use a teleporter, simply craft a teleporter block,
place it down, charge it by right clicking with a packed ender pearl,
and finally craft and use a teleporter item to teleport to them.

## ✅ Features:
- Robot entity
- Teleporter block
- Teleporter item
- Various actions for automation
- An action type registry for developers to add custom actions


> 💡 **Note**
> 
> **There is a bug where if you spawn a robot in 1.21.10 with a robot spawn egg,**
> 
> **you will get kicked out of the game.**
> 
> **This will DEFINITELY get fixed but I simply just don't know why this is happening.**
> 
> **For now, just spawn it with the block pattern instead (carved pumpkin above 2 iron blocks)**

title: Force Normal Font
description: Replaces the unicode font with the normal Minecraft font in places where it may be forced (eg Patchouli books)
body:
Replaces Minecraft's Unicode font with the standard font seen throughout the game. This doesn't do much in vanilla Minecraft, however modded reference textbooks (especially those reliant on Patchouli) have a tendency to use the Unicode font in place of the normal one. This pack replaces that, and also enables custom fonts to be used in these places as well.

Note: In some cases, the change of font may cause text to overflow where it's supposed to show up. This isn't a fault of this pack, the vanilla font is a fair bit wider than the Unicode font and mod authors can't account for the change. See the Gallery for an example.

Functional versions exist for 1.19.2 and 1.20.1. Will probably work on other versions, but make sure to download whichever of those two is closer to your target version.

title: Rainbow Wood
description: Adds tintable wooden blocks which you can color with dyes
body:
# Rainbow Wood [![discord-singular](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-singular_vector.svg)](https://discord.offsetmonkey538.top/) [![modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/rainbow-wood) [![Requires Fabric API](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/requires/fabric-api_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) **Adds new tintable variants for all vanilla wooden items.** In case the 11 wood types from vanilla aren't enough, now you can have ~16.5 million different ones!¹ ###### ¹ One for each possible RGB color, but most of them look the same and thus are pointless haha
Full list of new tintable items - Log - Stripped Log - Wood - Stripped Wood - Planks - Stairs - Slab - Fence Gate - Fence Gate - Door - Trapdoor - Pressure Plate - Button - Sign - Hanging Sign - Hanging Sign - Boat - Chest Boat
## Acquiring In creative mode, just open the creative menu and there are 76 different colors available in the "Rainbow Wood" tab. When playing survival, you first have to get *uncolored* items before coloring them. To do that, you can drop any normal wooden item into a cauldron filled with water. You can also craft colored items from other colored items (i.e. stairs from planks, fences from planks and sticks), just make sure that the inputs all have the same color.
Colors can be applied in two ways: ### Averaging This is the default way. It gets the average color of the input items, and then applied it to the output. The inputs can contain other tinted items of the same type (i.e. you can't combine stairs with a slab) or dyes. Examples:
Red Dye + Blue Dye + Uncolored Planks

Coloring planks with a Red Dye (RGB of 255, 0, 0) and Blue Dye (RGB of 0, 0, 255) results in colored planks with the color of (127, 0, 127) as that is the average.

Red Dye + Uncolored Planks

Coloring planks with a Red Dye (RGB of 255, 0, 0) results in colored planks with the color of (255, 0, 0) aka red.

Blue Dye + Uncolored Planks

Coloring planks with a Blue Dye (RGB of 0, 0, 255) results in colored planks with the color of (0, 0, 255) aka blue.

Red Planks + Blue Planks

Combining red planks (RGB of 255, 0, 0) with blue planks (RGB of 0, 0, 255) results in 2 colored planks with the color of (127, 0, 127) as that is the average.

Purple Planks + Uncolored Planks

It is also possible to combine uncolored items with colored items, which will result in duplication of the colored items. Combining purple planks (RGB of 127, 0, 127) with uncolored planks results in 2 colored planks with the color of (127, 0, 127).

### Adding To add the RGB values of the inputs, you need to put an **Iron Ingot** into the recipe as a *modifier*. Examples:
Red Dye + Blue Dye + Uncolored Planks

Coloring planks with a Red Dye (RGB of 255, 0, 0) and Blue Dye (RGB of 0, 0, 255) results in colored planks with the color of (255, 0, 255).

Red Planks + Blue Planks

Combining red planks (RGB of 255, 0, 0) with blue planks (RGB of 0, 0, 255) results in 2 colored planks with the color of (255, 0, 255).

   ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8452b6a4-5015-41ad-9a25-cec13c3f90d4)
   ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/08851803-ccb9-4d9a-a590-fc304c70d51c)
  
- **Magic Dust**: Dust infused with magical properties! Used to craft spells, wands and more
- **Concentrated Magic Dust**: Dust with higher magical potential! Used to craft high-tier spells and wands
  
  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6c565cac-ba55-4d53-8960-235e4e7be9e1)
- **Magic Essence**: Pure magic that is ready to be used to harness all magic! Used to craft an ultimate magic wand
  
  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bb8f0b3f-902a-474f-becf-323eff96a9c7)


### Cast Mechanics
- When a wand is used it casts the next spell (which is highlighted with purple in the inventory tooltip)
- Then, it cools down for a base delay (of the wand) plus the cast delay of the spell
- After casting all spells it will recharge for the maximum of the wand recharge time and the cooldown
- Some spells may alter the casting order and these rules

### Spells
- **Fireball Spell** (Tier 1): Creates a fireball than explodes and sets blocks on fire. Power scales with wand tier
  
  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cb00ada3-9d0d-428f-bd7e-d35f6436c754)
- **Exploding Arrow Spell** (Tier 1): Shoots an arrow that explodes on impact. Power scales with wand tier
  
  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ab376466-fcbc-4565-b3ab-96175b0500fc)
- **Reduce Recharge Spell** (Tier 1): Reduces the recharge time by 7 ticks. Can stack

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0c9f444b-217c-4b22-8c72-b0b9778807eb)
- **Random Potion Spell** (Tier 1): Throws a random splash potion

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f8abf159-11b8-4292-b943-0d1124d370a7)
- **Continue Spell** (Tier 1): After the previous spell is cast, the next spell is cast immediately. The total cooldown is the sum of the spell cooldowns

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/582d7a70-0ea1-4a83-ad1a-1d19cc07243c)
- **Teleport Spell** (Tier 2): Teleports the player to block pointed by the mouse if it is within 5 times the interaction range. Otherwise, it teleports the player 5 blocks ahead

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/49b01d24-69cc-4bd7-9fb4-5f9a66e9af4e)
- **Cast All Spell** (Tier 2): Casts all spells in wand, waiting for the cooldown between them. If a continue spell is found, casting stops after it finishes

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/329a9f7e-4f33-4ba2-b6da-2a7b49df7344)
- **No Cooldown Spell** (Tier 3): Removes all cooldown for the remaining spells. Recharge time is unaffected

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/30aba32b-89c2-4b1a-88d9-50cce22dc71d)
- **Lightning Bolt Spell** (Tier 3): Casts a lightning bolt at the block pointed by the mouse if it is within 15 times the interaction range. Otherwise, it casts it 5 blocks from the player

  ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fec5c88d-55a0-4ec7-879d-f02d4aa9b054)

title: Blowgun and Blowdarts
description: Poison Darts! Tranquilizer Darts! Use your Blowgun to fight and surprise enemies!
body:
# Blowgun

## How to craft:

To make a *Blowgun*, use 3 bamboo and 1 feather.

![Blowgun Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9307d37a0ef4f110468592a5b26fafa33db3625.png)

To make *darts*, use 1 iron nugget, 1 stick, and 1 feather in any configuration.

![Dart Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1fb8c05877dadd7df9a106afed3f5f57cef581e.png)

To make *Tranquilizer Darts*, use 8 darts and 1 lilac.

![Tranquilizer Dart Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b48c31252d9da2c1b9d647025ba7359887ab7914.png)

To make *Poison Darts*, use 8 darts and 1 dart frog poison. *Dart Frog Poison* is a new drop from frogs!

![Poison Dart Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9e6f48959f18a5c63d023671ed5bdfb651ae37c.png)

## How to Use:

Simply place your dart of choice in your offhand, and your blowgun in your main hand. Hold right click to aim, and then hold sneak to blow!

## Extra Notes

**Tip**: The Tranquilizer Darts deal no damage to mobs, and last for 30 seconds (Only 10 on players). This makes them an excellent solution for transporting villagers and other mobs!

As a bonus, I have a couple extra settings in the datapack if you type "/function blowgun:settings"

Thank you for downloading!

description: A 1.16 Minecraft mod about armors and potion effect
body: # Magical Gems: A mod for armor and potions. --- Magical Gems is a Minecraft 1.16 mod that lets you define the effects of potions on armor pieces. ### Gems Gems are items that add effects to armor. To add these effects, simply place your piece of armor and the gem in an anvil. ### Alchemy table The alchemy table is used to create gems. First, place a normal gem in the "Gem slot". Next, place the potion corresponding to the gem's effect or "essence". Finally, you'll need to put in enhanced fire powder as fuel. ### Distillery The distillery allows you to create potions that don't exist in the vanilla game, such as the haste potion. First, place an empty vial in the exit slot. Next, place the potion and the required item in the corresponding slots. Lastly, you'll need to use improved fire powder as fuel. --- Please credit me if you use my mod in some videos by adding the download link in the description. Please respect the license. title: TitansBattle
description: Hight customizable battle plugin for Minecraft servers
body:
## Titansbattle

TitansBattle is a plugin that allows you to create all sorts of battle events: server-wide, 1v1, team vs team; anything is possible!

Free for all games and challenges have 3 phases:
- Lobby: Players can join the game or accept the challenge
- Preparation: Players are teleported to the arena, receive kits (if enabled) and have some seconds to prepare (organizing items, picking a position) for the battle
- Battle: PvP is finally enabled and players fight each other until one group/player is remaining.

Elimination tournaments work in a similar manner, except in the preparation time only 2 players/groups are teleported at a time, until the winners are decided (1st, 2nd and 3rd).

Checkout the [Getting started](https://github.com/RoinujNosde/TitansBattle/wiki#getting-started) guide to know how to set it up! Or if you are a Developer, [click here](https://github.com/RoinujNosde/TitansBattle/wiki#developers).

### Features
- Server wide battles
- Challenges between 2 groups/players
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Highly customizable games
- Unlimited game/challenge files
- Title and action bar messages
- Sounds
- Stats (kills, deaths, victories)
- Compatible with SimpleClans and Factions (MassiveCraft or FactionsUUID)
- Different messages per game
- Scheduler
- MySQL and SQLite
- 9 API events
- Kits
- World Border
- Prizes
- Free for all and tournament modes
- Prefix for winners and killer (player with most kills)
- Join/leave messages for winners/killer

### Screenshots

Soon

### Commands

**Admin commands:**\
/tb start - starts a game manually\
/tb cancel - cancels the current game\
/tb setwinner <player> - sets a player as winner of the current game\
/tb kick <player> - kicks a player from the game\
/tb setdestination GENERAL_EXIT - sets the general exit (used for teleporting players who disconnected)\
/tb game|challenge create <name - creates a game or challenge\
/tb game|challenge setkit <name - sets your inventory as the kit\
/tb game|challenge setprize <name <prize LEADERS|MEMBERS - sets your inventory as the prize\
/tb game|challenge edit prize <name <field <value - edits some* fields from the game|challenge prize\
/tb game|challenge edit config <name <field <value - edits some* fields from the config\
/tb game|challenge setdestination <name <destination - sets the destination\*\*\
/tb game|challenge setdestination <name ARENA_ENTRANCE 1|2 - sets the arena entrance***\
/tb reload - reloads the plugin, this will cancel the current game

\* use a text editor to edit all settings\
\*\* you need to set all of them for the game|challenge to work\
\*\*\* entrance 1 is required

**Player commands:**\
/tb join - joins the current game\
/tb challenge player|group <target <arena - challenges a player|group to a duel\
/tb accept [challenger] - accepts a challenge (if the challenger name is not supplied, it will accept the last request)\
/tb leave - leaves from the game|challenge\
/tb watch - teleports to the watch room\
/tb watch <arena - teleports to the watch room of the specified arena\
/tb help - shows the command list\
/tb ranking groups|players - shows a ranking\
/tb winners <game [date] - shows the winners from the specified game\

- titansbattle.kick - Can kick players from a game

- titansbattle.winners - Can use the winners command

title: StaticParticle
description: a datapacking utility mod that adds more useful interactions between the server and the client
body:
# ⚠️ please keep in mind that the description is only maintained for the latest version

# 2 particle types are implemented

<details>
<summary>particles</summary>

## static_particle
- configurable `color`, `alpha`, `size`, `lifetime`, `texture`
- is emissive (glow in the dark)
# 
## static_oriented
- configurable `color`, `alpha`, `sizeX`, `sizeY`, `lifetime`, `rotation`, `post_rotation`, `cull`, `texture`
- is emissive (glow in the dark)
<details>
<summary>note</summary>
important thing to know is that all number arguments are actually string arguments, due to a limitation of minecrafts codebase, its so that the stuff listed below can work
  
  ⠀
  
- all number arguments(the particle parameters) support ranges ("x..y"=random from x to y), rotation arguments also support ~ which will use the command rotation context on the appropriate axis

- all number arguments except `lifetime` support animation sequences ("x->y->z" = animate from x to y to z), any amount of keyframes is supported, you can also add more dashes to control the timing of the keyframes
  
- the rotation arguments support `billboard` as a value, which will cause the particle to face the players camera on he specified axes
  
- also if youre wondering, post_rotation is just a second pass of rotation, technically redundant, just convenient

</details>
<details>
<summary>textures</summary>
currently only 4 textures are implemented:
  
  `dot`
  
  `dither`
  
  `smooth`
  
  `pixel`

  `shockwave`
  
</details>


</details>


# there are 5 standalone commands

<details>
<summary>commands</summary>

> /fov <add|multiply|set|query> <targets> <float> [interpolation type] [interpolation duration]
- changes/gets the client FOV of the targets
# 
> /setperspective <targets> <perspective index|distance> [camera distance]
- changes the client perspective
# 
> /rendertext <targets> <x> <y> <z> <rotation> <text> <alignment> <sizeX> <sizeY> [duration] [opacity] [gui scale independent] [hide with HUD] [overlay] [shadow Color(RGBA HEX)]
- displays text on the targets screens at the inputted position
- boolean argument for making the text size independent of the clients GUI scale setting
- boolean argument for forcing the text to display even if the HUD is hidden (F1)
- boolean argument for the size being multiplied by the client window aspect ratio
# 
> /log <client|server> [targets] <logger name> <message>
  - sends the message under the logger name in the client's/server's console (not in chat)
# 
> /camerarot <targets> <pitch> <yaw> <roll> [duration]
- adds rotation offset to the client camera (linear interpolation)

<details>
  <summary>note</summary>
(roll works perfectly, yaw and pitch technically do too, just a bit un-intuitive, in most cases its better to use actual entity rotation instead)
</details>

</details>



# the mod adds 3 conditions for predicates

<details>
<summary>predicates</summary>


> mouse* condition
```json
{
  "condition": "staticparticle:player_action",
  "action": "attack"/"pick_item"/"use",

}
```
- true when the target of the predicate is holding the respective buttons in the respective context


# 
> key condition
- the mod adds 5 new keybinds that dont do anything, except for tell the server theyve been pressed by a client
```json

  "condition": "staticparticle:special_key",
  "key": 0/1/2/3/4
}
```
- true when the target of the predicate is holding the respective key

# 
> movement input condition
```json
{ 
  "condition": "staticparticle:input",
  "action": "forward/back/left/right/jump/sprint/sneak"
}
```

</details>

title: Console Filter
description: Hides messages from your console logs.
body:
# Console Filter

Allows you to hide console messages that contain configured strings or match configured regular expressions. This mod can be installed on either the client or the server, but it is not required on either side.

## Config

Here is an example of how to use a basic filter in the config to hide all console messages containing "Can't keep up" and "Player moved too quickly":

```
#Any console messages containing any of these strings will be hidden.
basicFilters = ["Can't keep up", "Player moved too quickly"]
```

Here is an example of how to use a regex filter to hide messages like "Running 2156ms or 43 ticks behind":

```
#Any console messages containing any of these regular expressions will be hidden. Uses Java regex syntax. Backslashes must be doubled, i.e. use \\s instead of \s to match whitespace.
regexFilters = ["Running \\d+ms or \\d+ ticks behind"]
```

Here is an example of how to use a logger filter to hide messages from JEI:

```
#Any console messages from loggers with a name containing any of these strings will be hidden.
loggerFilters = ["jei"]
```

## Modpacks

Yes, you can use this mod in your modpack.

## Support

If you enjoy the mod and would like to support the project, feel free to [leave a donation on PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/donate/?business=46ZL2PNVP4XKE). Support is greatly appreciated!

title: Nine Sols Parry
description: Adds the parry system from Nine Sols (precise/imprecise parries, unbounded counter, internal damage)
body:
**Have you ever wanted to become John "Yi" Nine Sols in Minecraft? If so, this mod is for you!**

It adds the parry system from the game. You need to time your parries or else you will perform an imprecise parry, which will deal internal damage. Internal damage builds up the more you do imprecise parries. If you have internal damage and you get hit, the built up damage will be dealt as well as the current damage. Internal damage slowly heals over time or can be healed by using the medicine pipe.

![Parry](https://i.postimg.cc/52MXrd7P/parry.gif)

By holding the parry button, you will perform an unbounded counter. The unbounded counter needs to be released right before an attack in order to parry it and you will be stuck in place while performing the parry. On successful parry, foes will be pushed back and be dealt internal damage. Projectiles will be thrown back at the shooter when parrying with the counter.

![Unbounded Counter](https://i.postimg.cc/VvCN7Djs/unbounded-counter.gif)

Perfect Parries produce Qi, which can be used for talismans. Talismans can deal internal damage to enemies when attached. If you hold down the use button, you can make the talisman explode, dealing a lot of damage and converting all internal damage into actual damage.

On top of the regular talisman, there are 3 different types of talismans that you can craft:

Transmute Unto Life: killing an entity with the talisman heals you

Transmute Unto Wealth: killing an entity with the talisman drops gold, iron, emeralds and more XP

Transmute Unto Qi: killing an entity with the talisman produces 1 Qi charge

**Needs playerAnimator to work!**

**Made with MCreator**

title: PocketDice
description: Dungeons & Dragons (D&D) dice (/roll) with proximity radius. Configurable XdY, color-formatted messages, and anti-spam limits. Supports all 1.21.x. Works on Paper/Folia.
body:
# PocketDice — Proximity /roll for Minecraft 1.21.x
Dungeons & Dragons (D&D) dice rolls for Paper/Folia 1.21.x. Players roll dice with `/roll` (default `1d100`) and results are announced only to nearby players. Fully localized (MiniMessage), configurable caps, and optional Modrinth update checks.

#### Features
- `/roll [NdM]` with shorthand (`d8`) support and configurable defaults/limits.
- Proximity broadcasts (same world, configurable radius).
- Per-player locale detection with MiniMessage styling; easy to add translations.
- Optional roller-only sound effect (configurable sound/volume/pitch).
- Admin command `/pocketdice reload` to refresh config/locales.
- Modrinth update checker with console/admin notifications.

#### Requirements
- Paper (OR) Folia (MC 1.21.x)
- Java 21

#### Configuration (high level)
- `radius`, `default_notation`, `max_dice`, `max_faces`, `allow_shorthand`
- `sounds.roll`: enabled, sound_key, volume, pitch
- `updates`: enable/disable, startup check, interval, console/admin notify
- Locales: `plugins/PocketDice/locale/en_US.yml` (copy to `tr_TR.yml`, etc.)

#### Permissions
- `pocketdice.roll` (default: true)
- `pocketdice.reload` (default: op)
- `pocketdice.update.notify` (default: op)

title: KKS Chat
description: Custom chat with player avatars, whispers, and anti-spam. Fully customizable positioning.
body:
# KKS Chat

Custom chat for Minecraft with player avatars, settings, spam protection, and multi-language UI.

---

## Main Features

### Beautiful Interface

Chat shows player avatars next to messages. Each line is drawn in its own block with adjustable background transparency. You can move the whole chat to different corners or keep it centered (see **Positioning**).

![Hi!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef6d3c683b708fc7bf22735af42a59555f5ee30d.png)

### Positioning

In **Options → Chat Settings**, cycle **Position** to place the chat on screen. Modes:

- **Center (bottom)** — default, above the hotbar area
- **Center (top)**
- **Left top** / **Left bottom**
- **Right top** / **Right bottom**

Message blocks align to the chosen side or stay centered.

### Anti-Spam System

When enabled, **only fully identical** consecutive messages are merged and shown with a repeat counter (e.g. `x3`). You can turn anti-spam off in settings; history regroups or splits accordingly.

![antispam](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5082d492b593e0bc009444203af10d41b273d1ca.png)

### Whisper

Private messages are shown with dedicated formatting (sender / receiver).

![whisper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/641eb308fb5e29f57348cd5046408aeffec1fa23.png)

### Animations

Messages animate in and out of the screen. Choose a separate style for appearance and disappearance in the config:

- **Fade** — smooth opacity transition (default)
- **Slide** — slides in/out from left, right, top, or bottom
- **Bounce** — elastic spring effect on entry
- **None** — instant appear and disappear

---

## Settings

Settings are in **Minecraft → Options → Chat Settings** (KKS Chat section). Values are **saved** to `config/kks-chat.json` and restored after restart.

### KKS Chat On / Off

Toggle between KKS Chat and the vanilla chat interface without restarting the game.

### Background Transparency

0%–100% opacity for message backgrounds.

### Display Time

How long overlay messages stay visible: **1–60** seconds.

### Maximum Messages (history)

Stored history size: **50–500** messages (older lines are dropped).

### Other Options

- **Styling** — turn custom message formatting on or off
- **Anti-spam** — enable or disable identical-message merging
- **Position** — see Positioning above

![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50e4220de59a4246b5bf23012f0de6b5e3b45f05.png)

---

## Supported Languages

The mod ships with **12** language files (`assets/kks-chat/lang/`). UI strings follow the game language when a matching file exists; otherwise **English** is used as fallback.

- 🇬🇧 **English** (en_us)
- 🇷🇺 **Русский** (ru_ru)
- 🇩🇪 **Deutsch** (de_de)
- 🇪🇸 **Español** (es_es)
- 🇵🇹 **Português (Brasil)** (pt_br)
- 🇵🇹 **Português (Portugal)** (pt_pt)
- 🇮🇹 **Italiano** (it_it)
- 🇵🇱 **Polski** (pl_pl)
- 🇹🇷 **Türkçe** (tr_tr)
- 🇰🇷 **한국어** (ko_kr)
- 🇯🇵 **日本語** (ja_jp)
- 🇸🇦 **العربية** (ar_sa)

---

## Message History

Press **`T`** to open chat: full history with scrolling. Grouped repeats can be expanded to show each line.

![Chat history](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04a5669ca2b8ca7c44d1062b1aae2d9a59abb4b0.png)

---

## Configuration

The config file is created automatically at `config/kks-chat.json` on first launch.
All settings are documented with comments inside the file — open it in any text editor.

### Icons

Each message type (system, error, whisper, join/leave, etc.) has its own icon.
You can change any icon to any valid Minecraft item ID:

```json
"iconSystem":    "minecraft:stick",
"iconWhisper":   "minecraft:paper",
"iconJoinLeave": "minecraft:oak_door"
```

### Background Colors

Set a custom background color per message type:

```json
"bgColors": {
  "SYSTEM":      "#000000",
  "ERROR":       "#1A0000",
  "ACHIEVEMENT": "#001A04",
  "CHALLENGE":   "#1A0028"
}
```

### Animations

Configure appearance and disappearance animations independently:

```json
"animationIn":  "BOUNCE",
"animationOut": "SLIDE_LEFT"
```

Available values: `FADE`, `SLIDE_LEFT`, `SLIDE_RIGHT`, `SLIDE_UP`, `SLIDE_DOWN`, `BOUNCE`, `NONE`

---

## Rules

Rules let you automatically transform messages based on conditions — change icons, colors, text, display time, or hide messages entirely. Rules are defined in `kks-chat.json` under `"rules"`.

Each rule has an `"if"` block (conditions) and a `"then"` block (actions):

```json
{ "if": { "type": "COMMAND_BLOCK" }, "then": { "hide": true } }
```

### Conditions

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `type` | Message type: `PLAYER_CHAT` `WHISPER` `SYSTEM` `ERROR` `SLEEP` `ACHIEVEMENT` `CHALLENGE` `COMMAND_BLOCK` `JOIN_LEAVE` `SCREENSHOT` |
| `contains` | Text contains this string |
| `startsWith` | Text starts with this string |
| `endsWith` | Text ends with this string |
| `regex` | Java regex — first capture group becomes `{matched}` |
| `matchType` | `"ALL"` (AND, default) or `"ANY"` (OR) |

### Actions

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `hide` | Remove the message entirely |
| `color` | Tint the full message text — `"#RRGGBB"` |
| `colorMatch` | Tint only the matched fragment |
| `icon` | Override the icon (Minecraft item ID) |
| `displayTime` | Override display time in seconds |
| `replaceText` | Replace the entire message text |
| `replaceMatch` | Replace only the matched fragment |
| `stopAfter` | Stop — do not evaluate further rules |

### Variables

Use `{variable}` placeholders inside `replaceText` and `replaceMatch`:

| Variable | Value |
|---|---|
| `{my_name}` | Your in-game name |
| `{sender}` | Sender's name |
| `{text}` | Full original message |
| `{matched}` | Fragment matched by `contains` or `regex` |
| `{type}` | Message type name |
| `{time}` | Current time — `HH:mm` |
| `{time_s}` | Current time — `HH:mm:ss` |
| `{repeat}` | Repeat counter |

### Example

```json
"rules": [
  { "if": { "type": "COMMAND_BLOCK" }, "then": { "hide": true } },
  {
    "if":   { "contains": "[VIP]" },
    "then": { "icon": "minecraft:gold_ingot", "colorMatch": "#FFD700", "displayTime": 8 }
  },
  {
    "if":   { "type": "JOIN_LEAVE", "contains": "joined" },
    "then": { "replaceText": "→ {sender} joined [{time_s}]", "color": "#55FF55" }
  }
]
```

---

## Support

Questions or suggestions: **ddev14** on Discord.

- 🧩 Vanilla shader based  

Perfect for PvP, building and cinematic gameplay.

---

## 🖥 Compatibility
✔ Minecraft **1.21.x**  
✔ Vanilla  
✔ Iris  
✔ Sodium  
✔ OptiFine

---

## 📦 Installation
1. Download the pack  
2. Move it to `.minecraft/resourcepacks`  
3. Activate it in game  

---

## ❤️ Credits
Created by **EntzuMC**



# ⚙️ Configuration Guide  
Spectrum Outline EntzuMC

All visual effects can be customized directly inside the shader files.

No extra mods or menus required — just edit a few lines.

---

## 📂 Where to edit
Open the pack and go to:

assets/minecraft/shaders/core/

You will find:

- `rendertype_lines.vsh`
- `rendertype_lines.fsh`

At the top of both files you will see the configuration panel.

---

## 🎮 Changing the Mode

Find this line in **both files**:

#define MODE RAINBOW_LOOP

Replace `RAINBOW_LOOP` with one of these:

- `VANILLA` → Default Minecraft outline  
- `RAINBOW_FADE` → Smooth animated color shift  
- `RAINBOW_LOOP` → Colors travel around the edges  
- `CUSTOM` → Uses your selected color  
![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b597339e28a9d42f745b1988813036d210ea004f.png)

⚠️ The mode must match in both files.

---

## 📏 Changing the Thickness

In `rendertype_lines.vsh`:

#define THICKNESS 2.5

Examples:
- `1.0` → vanilla  
- `2.0` → slightly thicker  
- `3.0` → bold  
- `4.0+` → very thick  

---

## 🎨 Custom Color Mode

If you use:

#define MODE CUSTOM

Change this in `rendertype_lines.fsh`:

#define CUSTOM_COLOR vec4(0.2, 0.8, 1.0, 1.0)

Format:
vec4(R, G, B, A)

Values go from **0.0 to 1.0**.

Examples:

White:
vec4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0)

Red:
vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)

Purple:
vec4(0.7, 0.2, 1.0, 1.0)

---

## 🌈 Changing Rainbow Speed

#define SPEED 2000.0

Higher = faster  
Lower = slower  

---

## 🔁 Direction

#define DIRECTION 1.0

- `1.0` → normal  
- `-1.0` → reverse  

---

## 🎚 Smooth Transitions

#define SMOOTH true

- `true` → soft gradient  
- `false` → hard color steps  

---

## 💡 Tips

✔ Restart Minecraft after editing  
✔ Use CUSTOM mode for quick testing  
✔ If nothing changes → make sure both files match  

---

Enjoy your personalized outlines 🔥

title: Smelting Metal - Realistic Metal and Gem Processing
description: A Minecraft mod that enhances metal and gem processing by requiring players to smelt ores into molten metal, mold it, and cool it in water to create ingots.
body:
# Description
**SmeltingMetal** is a Minecraft mod that enhances the metal and gem processing by introducing new system for creating and recycling certain items. Instead of directly smelting raw ores into ingots, player smelt any metal item to create a molten metal, which then can be collected by molds and cooled in water to produce usable ingots. Gem items can be turned into gem dust by using grindstone or crushing wheels from create mod. Tools require single metal/gem unit from an item mold and bigger items, like armor need block mold and 9 gem dust or 1 bucket of molten metal.

Recipes have been added for all metal items to smelt them into molten blocks or items. Including modded items, as long as metal name is in the name of the item. The same applies to grinding gem items.

Added Create support to add crushing recipes for all metal items and support Depot interactions.

Removed smelting recipes for items that are covered by new metal processing. Additionally, metal nuggets create raw ore or crushed metal instead of an ingot, making molds the only way to create ingots. Added option to turn crafting ingot recipes like netherite ingot into a mixing recipe from create.

This mod is designed for Minecraft 1.20.1 and integrates seamlessly with technical mods like Create, encouraging players to build complex automation systems for metal processing. It adds depth to gameplay by making metal production more engaging and rewarding.
 

# New items
## Metal Item Processing
### Molten Metal

![molten metal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f7a456a13d46e6b7ddfeb396058e3008e2974f0.png)

Obtained by smelting a metal item. It can be any item with expected metal in name, excluding blacklisted items.

It cannot be stacked or held in inventory. On collecting from container, if no Hardened mold is present in inventory, it damages the Player and is thrown on the ground. On the ground, it damages player if they attempt to collect it. After couple of seconds, its being turned back into raw metal. Alternatively, when put in water, its cooled immediately.

 

### Clay Mold
![clay mold](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0dd2ebb81809ec3e133e8844dcb49fb711ecbebe_0.webp)

Crafted by using 5 clay balls. 

You can print a shape of a tool or  an ingot to change what kind of result do you want. Supported shapes: ingot, sword, axe, pickaxe, shovel, hoe.

Can be baked into Hardened Mold, by cooking in the furnace or made into Netherite Mold by combiting with netherite scrap. Mold retains its shape after this process.

 

### Hardened Mold / Netherite Mold
![hardened mold](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e08744d4d9a50760f59c830346ebf9aad760bf30.png)![hardened mold filled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31e78341d910bd19d1187453c3fd89dc2a26778c.png)![netherite mold](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b71ae107747218294f47f83ececa542bac96d158_0.webp)![netherite mold filled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c92427607d90f8c3e9e783e46713359289ca0ac1.png)

Necessary for ingot making. When in inventory, Molten Metal can be collected. Both items dissapear and one Filled Mold is added with appropriate metal type. To be turned into a tool or ingot, it needs to be cooled by water or simply dropping it on the ground and waiting for it to cool. If Netherite Mold was used, it drops alongside the ingot. Hardened Mold breaks.

 

## Metal Block Processing
### Molten Metal Block
![molten block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8bec3cd2cae2d3744f95ed882e926de57308113.png)
Obtained by smelting a metal block (as defined in config).

It cannot be stacked or directly put in inventory. On collecting from container, if no empty bucket is present in inventory, it damages the Player and is thrown on the ground. On the ground, it damages player if they attempt to collect it. After couple of seconds, its being turned back into raw metal block. Alternatively, when put in water, its cooled immediately.

If modded version of molten metal fluid is detected, that version is instead deployed on ground.

 

### Molten Metal Bucket
![metal bucket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c2485a9f1568f079c29947109fc6d118a2cce82.png)
     
When bucket is in inventory, Molten Metal Block can be collected, turning it into Molten Metal Bucket. It can be poured into a netherite / hardened block mold by right clicking the block with it.

If modded version of molten metal bucket is detected, that version is used instead.

 

### Clay Block Mold
![clay top](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e6520fddaa8c8472a31fd91f5aa8096de14be03_0.webp)

Crafted by using 8 clay balls.

You can print a shape of a piece of armor or  a metal block to change what kind of result do you want. Supported shapes: block, helmet, boots, pants, armor. (along with their synonyms defined in config)

Can be baked into Hardened Block Mold, by cooking in the furnace or crafted into a Netherite Block Mold, by surrounding it with 4 netherite ingots or upgrading it with a smithing template.

 
### Hardened Block Mold/ Netherite Block Mold
![hardened top](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e370b5663cfd9b3a1364d49ce39db464525c4703_0.webp)![netherite top](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/abb93d7f123bb4b029ff7266fe5e1f40d5e90a9e_0.webp)

Necessary for making metal block or armor. Sides of the block reflect the result item.

Molten Metal can be poured inside, case appearance reflecting its state. Filled case can be then cooled with water bucket to turn into a desired item, unless given metal doesnt have a given item. In that case, it defaults to metal block. Netherite Block Mold then drops on ground, Hardened Block Mold is destroyed. 

Molten metal can be collected back by rightclicking filled Block Mold with a bucket.

## Gem Processing
### Gem Dust
![gem dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0a722f9d035c662bf5486789b7157009a8044ca.png)
Obtained by crushing gem items by grindstone or create crushing wheels. Block items provide 9 gem dusts.
Can be collected into molds by right clicking when holding gem dust and item mold in both hands.
Filed gem mold can be made into an item by right clicking it onto a source of lava.

### Filling Block Molds with Gem Dust
![hardened mold gem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7faf056da7324acb20813be3709a1114ffc19761_0.webp)![netherite mold gem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6e8f136e85d7bad702a0c0c7e16934e3a648d3b_0.webp)
To fill block mold simply right click it while holding 9 or more gem dust. Retrieve it the same way.
Turn filled block mold by right clicking it with lava bucket.

# Configuration
## Metals Section
- **metal_definitions** (def iron, copper, gold, netherite) -  Choose your own metal that should be proccessed into molten metal.
  - Compatible with mod metals, f.e. add "zinc" to be able to smelt Zinc added by Create mod.
  - Currently, metals need metal ingot and metal block to be registered.
  - Metal items like molds, metal bucket, block and item are gonna be tinted by the color set in properties
  - Add your own definition of metal items not following the format. f.e. "andesite,color=B3A294,ingot=andesite_alloy,raw=andesite" 
  - supported keys: color ingot, block, raw, raw_block, nugget, crushed, bucket, molten_fluid
- **gem_definitions** (def. diamond)
  - Like metal definition, compatible with other mods. 
  - main gem item is the only required item
  - supported coloring gem items
  - supported keys: color, gem, block, shar
- **blacklist_keywords** (def nugget, mold, template, scrap) - Choose metal items which should NOT be melted or crushed by providing defining part of their name. Item name that includes one of the blacklist words is not melted.
- **block_keywords** - Keywords that identify block items. Any item containing these, will be treated as a block.
- **block_result_definitions** - add tags to block result categories. f.e. "armor=chestplate,tunic,armor" makes items containing chestplate, tunic, armor to be recognized as a metal armor result type. So you are able to print leather tunic onto a block mold to receive iron chestplate as they are both in armor category.
## Features Section
- **enable_melting_recipe_replacement**- Enable replacement of smelting/blasting recipes with molten metal recipes
- **enable_crushing_recipe_replacement**- Enable replacement of crushing recipes with crushed metal recipes
- **enable_nugget_recipe_replacement**- Enable replacement of nugget->ingot crafting recipes with nugget->raw_metal
- **enable_ingot_crafting_recipe_replacement** - Enable removal of crafting recipes for ingots, f.e. netherite ingot and if create mod is loaded add mixing recipes for them as well

# Compatibility
Mod should be compatible with most of modded metals. They only need to be defined in config and have ingot, block, raw and raw block form

Added specific support for Create with new features

Pairs great with Spelunkery and Create: Metalwork

# Issues
When right clicking Create depot to collect molten metal. Appropriate container item is filled but remains ghost icon of molten metal item that disappears on click… Only visual bug, no gameplay influence.

# Alternatives
There are some mods i was inspired by, that have similar functionalities if you prefer them. those include Hot Iron, Create Weaponry, etc

# What's next?
- RELEASE MOD FOR OTHER VERSIONS OF MINECRAFT
- Consider options how sensible it is to have molds for all gem / metal items not just armor and tools

# 🍷 BreweryX MythicMobs Addon [![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange.svg)](https://www.oracle.com/java/) [![BreweryX](https://img.shields.io/badge/BreweryX-3.6.0-blue.svg)](https://github.com/BreweryTeam/BreweryX) [![MythicMobs](https://img.shields.io/badge/MythicMobs-5.4.0+-purple.svg)](https://mythiccraft.io/) [![Stand With Ukraine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshymanskyy/StandWithUkraine/main/badges/StandWithUkraine.svg)](https://stand-with-ukraine.pp.ua)
> **This is a BreweryX addon, not a standalone plugin!** > It integrates **[MythicMobs](https://modrinth.com/plugin/mythicmobs)** items into **[BreweryX](https://modrinth.com/plugin/breweryx)** brewing recipes, allowing you to use custom items as unique brewing ingredients. ## 🔔 Notice In **[TheBrewingProject](https://modrinth.com/plugin/thebrewingproject)** has already been added native support of the MythicMobs(-Crucible) items from version 2.4.0. I recommend switching to this plugin, but still this addon is supported (although I haven't received any complaints about bugs yet, hehe), at least until BreweryX stops getting support. ## ✨ Features - Use MythicMobs items in BreweryX recipes with the `mythic:` prefix - Automatically validates and matches items (including NBT) - Lightweight & performance friendly ## 🚀 Installation 1. Download the addon 2. Place the `.jar` in `/plugins/BreweryX/addons/` 3. Restart your server ## 📖 Example Recipe ```yaml recipes: magical_wine: name: "Bad Wine/Wine/Good Wine" ingredients: - mythic:EnchantedCorn/20 # 20 Enchanted Corn from MythicMobs - mythic:MysticBread/5 # 5 Mystic Bread from MythicMobs - Sugar/10 # 10 regular Sugar cookingtime: 8 distillruns: 2 distilltime: 30 color: 8B00FF difficulty: 3 alcohol: 7 lore: - "A wine brewed with magical ingredients" - "Grants mystical powers to those who drink it" effects: - REGENERATION/1-2/60-120 ``` ## 🐛 Troubleshooting - Ensure MythicMobs items exist and load correctly - Check spelling & NBT data in recipes - Verify MythicMobs loads before BreweryX 📌 More info & support: [GitHub](https://github.com/Andromedov/MythicMobs-BreweryX-Addon)

title: Local Difficulty Utilities
description: Fixes local difficulty display on the client and syncs inhabited time from the server. Includes configs and commands to easily edit a chunks local difficulty.
body:
# Local Difficulty Utilities **Local Difficulty Utilities** is a lightweight utility mod that: - Fixes the client-side display of local difficulty. - Syncs each chunk's inhabited time value from the server, so the client sees the real difficulty. - Adds commands to view and edit the inhabited time of chunks. - Provides configurable options for debugging, syncing, and modifying local difficulty values. ---
Commands ### `/ldu inhabited chunk get ` Displays the `inhabitedTime` value of the target chunk. --- ### `/ldu inhabited chunk set ` Sets the targets `inhabitedTime` value. --- ### `/ldu inhabited region ` Sets all loaded chunks `inhabitedTime` values in-between the two coordinates at once. --- ### `/ldu inhabited cancel` Cancels any ongoing region commands.
---
Config Options ### `restoreLocalDifficultly: true` If `true`, the Local Difficulty entry in the F3 debug menu will be re-enabled so you can see the local difficulty and the day values. If the server doesn't also have this mod with inhabitedTime syncing enabled, then the local difficulty value will be wrong due. The day value will always be correct. --- ### `syncInhabitedOnF3: true` If `true`, the server will respond to chunk sync requests when the client has the F3 debug menu open. --- ### `syncInhabitedOnNewChunk: true` If `true`, the server will respond to chunk sync requests when the client enters a new chunk. --- ### `regionMaxChunks: 250001` This is the maximum amount of chunks that can be edited at once with the region command. --- ### `regionBatchSize: 100` This limits how many chunks the region command will try to edit per tick.
--- ### Other Information - The `region` command will only select and edit chunks that are loaded into the game's memory. - This mod can be used on servers without this mod, but the client won't be able to get display the correct local difficulty because it doesn't have access to the needed information. --- ### Requirements - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) - [(Optional) ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)

title: Flight Tright
description: Flight Tright is a Minecraft mod that adds the Flatterbird, a flying mob that drops Shards and Feathers used to craft Flatterbird Wings. While the wings don’t function like Elytras, they are a key ingredient in crafting them, adding a new progression path.
body:
**Flight Tright** adds a new progression system for obtaining Elytras through the introduction of the **Flatterbird**, a rare flying mob that spawns in scenic biomes like **Cherry Grove** and **Jungle**. When defeated, Flatterbirds drop **Flatterbird Shards** and **Flatterbird Feathers**, which are used to craft **Flatterbird Wings**—a special item required to craft Elytras, offering a fresh, mid-game path to flight without needing to reach the End.

The mod also introduces a variety of feather-themed decorative blocks, including **stairs**, **slabs**, **trapdoors**, and the softly glowing **Flatterbird Feather Lamp**. A mysterious block called the **Feather Treasure** can transform Flatterbird items into something even more powerful, adding magic and mystery to progression.

**Flight Tright** supports multiple languages, including **English**, **German**, **Spanish**, **French**, **Italian**, **Japanese**, and **Russian**, making it accessible for players around the world.

# Description
This mod currently adds the 'Creeped' effect and a Musket rifle.

See what I'll add in the full version under _**Future Additions**_.

## Added Content
Below is all the content the latest version adds.

### Creep Positions
Brewing the Creep Potions and how they work in the MCreator version

![Brewing a Splash Potion of Creep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7rkrVI0s/images/e203d566458d0a803a7606461caa515a472fcdd5.png)

- **Potion of Creep**: At the moment you can only use a Splash or Lingering potion to brew it since you need Gunpowder. Once you use it on an entity (or yourself, for whatever reason) it will explode with a power of 2 after the effect duration ends (30 seconds) or if they are caught on fire. Milk does work.
- **Potion of Creep +**: Use Redstone on a Potion of Creep. This will increase the potion's duration to 3 minutes (have fun finding a use for this!).
- **Potion of Creep II**: Use Glowstone Dust on a Potion of Creep. This will increase the explosion's power from 2 to 4 while also increasing the duration to 40 seconds.

### Rifles and Pistols
Crafting the Rifles and Pistols and how they work in the MCreator version.\
All of these will be different in the full release.

![Crafting a Musket Rifle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7rkrVI0s/images/9e64a1880875db6eeddb0d32add2b54538826092.png)

- **Musket Rifle**: At a crafting table use a Gold Ingot and 2 Iron Ingots in a line, then any wood slab in the center below and any wooden plank in the bottom left.\
To fire, you need 2-3 Gunpowder (20% chance that you need 3) and an Iron Nugget. Keep clicking to load the Gunpowder until you hear a click indicating that it's now loaded and then click again to fire. It will deal 11 damage on any entity hit. Has a durability of 183.

![Crafting a Snaphaunce Pistol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/7rkrVI0s/images/fbe807caaec73dd21c54d3cec81ef88145bb18ec.png)

- **Snaphaunce Pistol**: At a crafting table use an Iron Nugget and an Iron Ingot to the right of it, then any wooden slab in the bottom left.\
In the full release it's meant to be weaker than the Musket (with lower power and less damage) but will be much cheaper and have a special ability no other ranged weapon has in the base game (including the Musket itself). Currently, it's not well balanced and I only added a recipe so you can try it out in survival.

- - -

## Future Additions
These aren't in the Alpha because of either MCreator's limitations or because I just decided to wait for the beta / full release.\
_*May not add or will be vastly different after balancing_.

**Powder Flask**: A flask that can hold powder by placing it inside a crafting table and surrounding it with the powder. When any of the flasks run out of powder they will be replaced with the Powder Flask.

**Gunpowder Flask (_Powder Flask filled with Gunpowder_)**\
The Powder Flask filled with Gunpowder (the flask in the center surrounded by 8 gunpowder), each Gunpowder will become three uses on the Gunpowder Flask (24 total uses). This is undecided, but it might also take .65s instead of .75s when loading a Musket or Snaphaunce. It can also place the gunpowder onto the ground (takes three uses of the flask).

**Placeable Gunpowder** [_as Add-On_]
It acts similarly to Redstone Dust, except for an infinite distance and a 5-tick delay between each piece of Gunpowder activating. Each Gunpowder will be destroyed after being activated and can only be activated by Flint & Steel (I may add an option for Redstone activation in the config). It can be placed to branch into multiple directions and will activate any Redstone machinery.

***Cannon + Cannonball**\
This is very unlikely to be added, but I may have some ideas for a legitimate cannon that have unique functionality... I just can't think of any right now :|

title: Coffee+
description: Coffee+ adds coffee to Minecraft, the way coffee should be done.
body:
![Beta title banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/58981ae36796dc757b54257a19713479709ab755.png)
# **Coffee+ adds coffee to Minecraft, the way coffee should be done.**

<iframe src="https://github.com/sponsors/linussewell/button" title="Sponsor linussewell" height="32" width="114" style="border: 0; border-radius: 6px;"></iframe>

## **Plants**

**Coffee Tree**

Right-clicking the ground while holding raw coffee beans will plant a coffee tree. Over time it will grow, and right-clicking a fully-grown tree will give you between 1-3 raw coffee beans.

Coffee trees can spawn in any mountain or mutated extreme hill biome - but remember that you can only gather coffee by right-clicking a grown plant, destroying it won't drop anything.

 
## **Blocks**

**Coffee Machine**

Coffee can be brewed by placing ground coffee within the top slot of a Coffee Machine, an empty mug within the bottom one, and pressing the "Brew" button. This will create a 'Full coffee mug', which can be crafted to create different coffee varieties, as listed below.

![Coffee Machine crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/9cef51948da06050a5c07d17a2cbf7afb9801ed6.png)

**Coffee Grinder**

One of the ways that coffee beans can be ground is with a coffee grinder. The coffee grinder must be placed down and does not use up durability over time. To use the coffee grinder, place roasted coffee beans into the grinder and click 'Grind'.

![Coffee Grinder crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/4a3451373a5a4609f2bd10129791a2c0a26bf956.png)
 
## **Items**

### **Coffee varieties:**

After drinking any variety of coffee, an empty mug will be returned to you. Drinking coffee also applies some potion effects for a short amount of time. The potions and amounts of time vary depending on which coffee variant is drunk. These effects slowly wear off over time, e.g., giving you speed two before slowing it to speed one as the caffeine wears off. The insomnia effect is also applied, which will prevent sleeping after drinking coffee.

**Full coffee mug**

The Full coffee mug is obtained after using the coffee machine, details of how to do so are listed above.

**Sugary Coffee**

![Sugary Coffee crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/a668868236f6633afd460b0eb3e69bdeeba259fc.png)

**Milky coffee**

![Milky coffee crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/4ee0bdf5290e01641d0ce94ffebb68ac070f18f8.png)

**Sugary milky coffee**

![Sugary milky coffee crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/1aa93674e2e545af280aec425bd0e72d63f79474.png)
 
### **Coffee beans:**

**Raw coffee beans**

These are the raw coffee beans that you harvest from a coffee tree. Details of how to collect them are listed above, under the 'Coffee Tree' plant.

**Roasted coffee beans**

Raw coffee beans can be roasted in a furnace or a smoker, to obtain Roasted coffee beans. These can then be ground down using any variety of coffee grinders, for use in a Coffee machine.

![Roasted coffee beans crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/23118f5b5176f75189cd153b9701e474a2eb89b3.png)

**Ground coffee**

This can be crafted within a crafting grid using the hand grinder (as shown below), or by utilising the coffee grinder block (as shown above)

![Ground coffee crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/3890f5a298375efbb870200d926789a7ae0db94b.png)
 
### **Mugs:**

**Clay mug**

The coffee mug is obtained by gathering 7 clay and crafting a clay mug.

![Clay mug crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/9676acbb7b5b8be8208b7063504ebd307d3264c1.png)

**Empty coffee mug**

The clay mug must be smelted in a furnace to 'harden' the clay, creating a coffee mug - the item used to hold coffee.

![Empty coffee mug crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/a4b231025efea48618bb992a33fa6829b6affc16.png)

 

### **Other:**

**Hand grinder**

Coffee beans can also be ground with a hand grinder. The hand grinder can be kept in your inventory and loses durability as you use it. To use the hand grinder, place the hand grinder and roasted coffee beans into any shape in a crafting grid. This will use up 1 durability, with a total of 16 uses.

![Hand grinder crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nR1chlv0/images/b2d2db793a00ed522d1d905d1e26efb23527c10c.png)
