body:
# C&C: Sculk ## Sculk Sensors and more!

##### This mod is a concept and doesn't have any crafting recipes or block drops. It cannot be used in vanilla survival. All blocks are available in the vanilla item tabs. ### Features: #### - HIGHLIGHT FEATURE: Sculk Sensors! Sculk sensors are blocks from the 1.17 update, shown at Minecraft Live 2020, that can detect vibrations and movement. They can sense footsteps, block placing, and projectiles!

According to the Minecraft Developers, sculk sensors don't react to *sounds*, they react to predetermined vibration "triggers". That is the way they work in this mod.

Currently, sculk sensors don't react to every kind of vibration. If they aren't sensing something you think they should be sensing, leave an issue on GitHub!

#### - Sculk Blocks! This mod introduces 3 types of sculk themed blocks shown during Minecraft Live 2020. They include Sculk Growths, Sculk Growth Blocks, and Sculk Sources.

Sculk sources will *very* slowly spread sculk growth blocks around them onto stone. #### - Slate! Slate's name has not been confirmed, and it may not even be likely it will generate in the Deep Dark with sculk blocks in 1.17. However, it was shown in the demo of the Warden (which is not included in this mod) along with the sculk blocks and candles, so it has been included in this mod. #### - Candles! Candles are customizable light sources that come in all dye colors, and they can be placed in different amounts to give off different light levels. Their placement works like sea pickles or turtle eggs.

title: Premium Advancements | Custom Achievements
description: Create unlimited custom advancements/achievements with a clean editor or GUI. Vault • +45 Triggers • MySQL • MiniMessage & Hex colors • Webhooks • 1.21+ Support
body:
**Premium Advancements** Create unlimited custom advancements with an in-game & web GUI editor. No config files needed.

[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21+-brightgreen)](https://papermc.io)
[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange)](https://adoptium.net)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-2.1-blue)]()

---

## Why Premium Advancements?

The easiest way to add achievements, quests, and progression to your Minecraft server. **45 triggers**, real-time
tracking, **8 reward types**, **multi-tab system**, **Discord webhooks**, and both an in-game and **browser-based web
editor** with live tree view - all without editing a single configuration file.

---

## Features

- **MiniMessage & Hex Colors** - `&#RRGGBB`, gradients, rainbows, bold/italic/underline, named colors (`<light_purple>`)
  supported everywhere — in-game L menu, GUIs, broadcasts, and the web editor live preview
- **Multi-Tab System** - Organize advancements across multiple tabs, each with its own icon, background, and namespace
- **Vanilla Advancement Viewer** - Minecraft's built-in advancements (Story, Adventure, Nether, End, Husbandry) loaded
  read-only with correct icons, positions, and tree connections
- **In-Game GUI Editor** - 6 screens: main list, tab selector, create wizard, edit, confirm delete, stats viewer
- **Web Editor (Browser-Based)** - Full visual editor with live tree view, drag & drop, undo/redo, import/export JSON,
  icon browser, tab management
- **45 Trigger Types** - JOIN, BREAK_BLOCK, PLACE_BLOCK, KILL, OBTAIN_ITEM, CRAFT_ITEM, SMELT_ITEM, ANVIL_USE,
  GRINDSTONE_USE, ENCHANT_ITEM, ENCHANT, ENTER_DIMENSION, TRAVEL_DISTANCE, FISH, BREED, TAME, CONSUME, EAT, HARVEST,
  TRADE, POTION_EFFECT, DEATH, DAMAGE_DEALT, DAMAGE_TAKEN, JUMP, DROP_ITEM, SHEAR, MILK, COMPOSTER_USE, ARMOR_EQUIP,
  FILL_BUCKET, EMPTY_BUCKET, SNIFF, RIPTIDE, RAID_WIN, TARGET_BLOCK, BELL_RING, CROSSBOW_SHOT, FIREWORK, GLIDE, SWIM,
  CLIMB, SLEEP, CHOP_TREE, **MANUAL** (command-only), **PLACEHOLDER** (PAPI-based)
- **Progression Tracking** - Counter-based progress saved across sessions; cumulative distance (glide/swim/climb/travel)
- **8 Reward Types** - Console commands, Vault money, items (with enchants/name/lore/CMD), LuckPerms permissions,
  PlayerPoints, weighted random reward pools, global broadcast, Discord webhooks
- **Discord Webhook Integration** - Send customizable embeds on advancement completion, per-advancement toggle, custom
  embed with `%player%` and `%advancement%` placeholders
- **Notifications** - Toast popups, chat announcements, action bar progress
- **Dependencies** - Chain advancements with prerequisites for progression systems
- **Filters** - Block/item/entity type filters, world restrictions, permission gates, Custom Model Data (
  ItemsAdder/Oraxen), enchantment type/level, potion effect/amplifier, death cause, villager profession, bed color,
  sheep color, dimension, travel mode
- **Hidden Advancements** - Invisible until all prerequisites are met
- **Visual Tree** - Customizable x/y positions and connection targets for a clean advancement display
- **Database** - SQLite (file-based, easy) or MySQL/MariaDB with HikariCP connection pool
- **Multi-Language** - Built-in English and French; custom language file support
- **PlaceholderAPI** - 14+ placeholders for scores, progress, ranking, and per-tab stats
- **Auto-Migration** - Seamless upgrade from v1.70 with automatic backup
- **bStats** - Anonymous usage statistics (toggleable)

---

## Quick Start

1. Install [UltimateAdvancementAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/95585/) v2.7.1+
2. Drop the plugin in `plugins/` and restart
3. Run `/padv gui` to create advancements OR `/padv editor` for the web editor
4. Press **L** in-game to view them

title: RetroRig: Builder
description: Brings the retro BuildCraft Builder and Filler blocks into modern Minecraft, using FE energy.
body:
FormForge is a standalone mod built around a simple idea: bring back the feel of the old BuildCraft Builder and Filler, but in a modern setup. (Part of the RetroRig mod suite)


The mod adds two machines:

*   **Builder**, which reads a saved blueprint and places the structure for you.
*   **Filler**, which can fill or erase a configurable area using a few preset shapes.

It also adds a **Blueprint** item for capturing structures directly in the world.

## What It Does

The **Blueprint** lets you mark two corners, save the blocks inside that area, and keep that structure on the item. Once it has been written, you can name it so it is easier to sort through multiple builds later.

Put that blueprint into a **Builder**, load the machine with materials, give it FE power, and it will start placing the structure block by block. The preview can be rotated or shifted before you start, which makes lining things up much less annoying.

The **Filler** works a little differently. Instead of reading a captured structure, it generates a shape from its own settings. You can choose the mode, size, rotation, and offset, then either fill the area with the selected block or erase everything inside it.

Both machines render holographic previews before they do any work, support item and energy automation, and are built to survive chunk unloads, reloads, and normal world saves without losing their place.

## Features

*   Blueprint capture with naming support
*   Builder machine for saved structures
*   Filler machine for shaped fill and erase jobs
*   Holographic placement previews
*   Rotation and offset controls on both machines
*   FE-powered operation with speed scaling
*   Item and energy automation support for pipes and modded logistics
*   Resume-safe machine progress across saves and reloads

## Recipes

Builder recipe:

![Builder Recipe Screenshot](https://i.postimg.cc/jCVBm7jQ/craft-builder.png)

Filler recipe:

![Filler Recipe Screenshot](https://i.postimg.cc/13Msnvtb/craft-filler.png)

Blueprint recipe:

*   1 Paper
*   1 Lapis Lazuli

## Notes

This mod is inspired by BuildCraft, but it is not trying to be a one-to-one remake. The goal is to keep the part that made those machines fun in the first place: setting up a job, watching the preview, feeding the machine materials and power, and letting it do the repetitive part for you.

If you liked old quarry-era automation mods and want a Builder/Filler style toolset in a current NeoForge pack, that is the whole reason this project exists.

Get Involved Suggestions, bug reports, and feedback happen over on the Discord: [https://discord.gg/RJqPMHbUh3](https://discord.gg/RJqPMHbUh3)

title: Waterlogged Beds
description: Allow beds to be waterlogged for more immersive underwater builds
body:
# Waterlogged Beds

You like building underwater but always felt like something was missing because there was that nasty pocket of air around your bed?

This mod solves the issue by allowing beds to be waterlogged.

### Usage

This mod is required on both the client & server to function correctly. Just add it to 
both mods folders and you're good to go, no dependencies are required. However we target Java 17 with this mod so you will need at least that.

title: トヨナツちゃんねる銃、冒険MODサーバー参加パック
description:
Einglish
A Forge 1.20.1 client pack for joining the Toyonatsu Channel server, focused on guns, exploration, bosses, survival, lifestyle, and community events.

日本語
トヨナツちゃんねるのForge 1.20.1サーバー参加用クライアントパック。銃、探索、ボス、生活、イベントを楽しめる戦場サバイバル冒険MOD構成です。
body:
# 🎮 トヨナツ Channel Warpack

## 日本語版

## ⚠️ はじめに

このMODパックは、**トヨナツちゃんねるのマルチプレイサーバー参加用クライアントパック**です。

シングルプレイで起動できる場合もありますが、配信と同じ体験にはなりません。  
サーバー側では、構造物・洞窟・ネザー・エンド・ダンジョンなどのワールド生成、敵の出現、経済、PvP範囲、イベント、KubeJS調整を含む専用設定を行っています。

このパック単体では、サーバーと同じ世界・バランス・遊び方は再現できません。

---

## トヨナツちゃんねる 戦場サバイバル冒険サーバー参加用パック

このMODパックは、YouTubeゲーム配信 **「トヨナツちゃんねる」** で使用している、Minecraft Java Edition **Forge 1.20.1** サーバー参加用のクライアントMODパックです。

現代火器、敵勢力、ボス、探索、冒険、生活要素を組み合わせた、戦闘だけでは終わらないサバイバル冒険ワールドを楽しむための構成です。

プレイヤーは、異世界から召喚された「クラフター」として、混沌とした世界に降り立ちます。  
この世界には、銃を持つ敵、危険なモンスター、強大なボス、未知の構造物、そして新たな冒険の舞台が広がっています。

戦い、生き延び、探索し、仲間と拠点を築き、時には平和な生活やイベントも楽しむ。  
ただの銃MODサーバーではなく、戦場・冒険・生活が混ざり合った、トヨナツちゃんねる用の参加型サーバーパックです。

---

## v3.0.0 について

v3.0.0では、以前の構成から大きく内容を見直しました。

旧構成で使用していた一部の大型戦争系、魔法系、ドラゴン系要素を整理し、より遊びやすく、探索や冒険を楽しみやすい構成に調整しています。

主な変更方針：

- 大規模な軍隊要素を整理
- 魔法要素を整理
- 大型ドラゴン要素を整理
- 新しめの冒険・探索・敵・ボス系MODを追加
- TaCZ系の銃・ガンパックを同梱
- サーバー参加に必要な環境を、このパックだけでそろえやすい形に調整

以前よりも「戦争一色」ではなく、探索・冒険・生活・イベントも楽しめる構成を目指しています。

---

## 🧩 主な特徴

- Forge 1.20.1 対応
- トヨナツちゃんねるのサーバー参加用クライアントパック
- 銃MODを中心にした戦闘要素
- PvE、ボス戦、探索、構造物攻略を楽しめる構成
- 戦闘だけでなく、生活・拠点づくり・イベント要素も重視
- マルチプレイ向けの探索・便利系MODを同梱
- 軽量化・安定化を意識した構成
- Modrinth App または Prism Launcher で導入しやすい形式

---

## 🔫 銃・戦闘要素

このパックには、TaCZを中心とした銃MOD環境が含まれています。

銃撃戦、敵勢力との戦闘、PvEイベント、ボス戦などを楽しむための構成です。  
戦闘の難易度やバランスは、サーバー運営の状況に合わせて調整される場合があります。

---

## 🗺️ 探索・冒険要素

v3.0.0では、戦争要素だけでなく、探索や冒険の楽しさを重視しています。

新しい土地、危険な敵、ボス、構造物を探しながら、サーバーの世界を冒険できます。  
ただ敵と戦うだけではなく、未知の場所を見つける楽しさや、仲間と攻略していく遊びも大切にしています。

---

## 🏖️ 生活・イベント要素

このサーバーは、戦うだけの世界ではありません。

拠点を作り、仲間と生活し、イベントを楽しみ、時には平和な目標も目指します。

戦場の中にも、暮らしと遊びを作る。  
それがトヨナツちゃんねるサーバーの大事なテーマです。

---

## 📦 Lite版とFull版について

このMODパックには、環境に応じて **Lite版** と **Full版** があります。

### Lite Version

Lite版は、**Full版からリソースパック、シェーダー、見た目の強化、演出系など、PCに負荷がかかりやすい要素をできるだけ外した軽量版**です。

サーバー参加に必要な最低限のMODを中心に構成しており、  
「まずはサーバーに参加できること」を優先したパックです。

PC性能に不安がある方、動作をできるだけ軽くしたい方、シェーダーや追加演出が不要な方にはLite版をおすすめします。

### Full Version

Full版は、トヨナツちゃんねるサーバーをより雰囲気よく楽しむための推奨構成です。

Lite版の基本構成に加えて、リソースパック、表示改善、演出強化、見た目や雰囲気を高める要素を含みます。

PC環境に余裕があり、よりリッチな見た目や没入感を楽しみたい方にはFull版をおすすめします。

迷った場合は、まずLite版で動作確認し、問題なく遊べるようであればFull版を試すのがおすすめです。

---

## 🔧 サーバー側との差分について

トヨナツちゃんねるのサーバーでは、このクライアントパックに加えて、サーバー側で専用のワールド生成・構造物・イベント・バランス調整を行っています。

特にシングルプレイとの差として現れやすいものは、以下の系統です。

- **ワールド生成・構造物系**  
  Dungeons and Taverns系、YUNG’s Better系、When Dungeons Arise、Incendium、Better Village、Moog’s Structure系など

- **サーバー進行・イベント・調整系**  
  KubeJS、Chunky、経済・ショップ設定、PvP範囲、チームスポーン、敵の出現調整など

- **サーバー専用のバランス調整**  
  敵の強さ、襲撃、ボス、戦利品、通貨、ショップ、イベント進行など

これらはサーバー側の設定や生成済みワールドと組み合わせて機能するため、シングルプレイでは配信と同じ世界・進行・イベント・バランスにはなりません。

---

## ⚠️ 注意事項

- このMODパックは、主にトヨナツちゃんねるのサーバー参加用です。
- シングルプレイでの使用はおすすめしません。
- サーバー参加ルールや最新情報は、トヨナツちゃんねるの配信・概要欄・告知をご確認ください。
- MOD構成は、サーバー運営状況に合わせて変更される場合があります。
- 一部のMODや設定は、マルチプレイ環境を前提に調整されています。

---

# English Version

## ⚠️ Before You Install

This is a **client pack for joining the Toyonatsu Channel multiplayer server**.

It may launch in singleplayer, but it will not provide the same experience shown in the streams.  
The server uses dedicated settings for world generation, including structures, caves, the Nether, the End, and dungeons, as well as enemy spawning, economy, PvP zones, events, and KubeJS adjustments.

This pack alone cannot recreate the same world, balance, or gameplay as the server.

---

## TOYONATSU Channel Warpack

This is a client-side modpack for joining the **Toyonatsu Channel** Minecraft Java Edition **Forge 1.20.1** server.

It is designed for a multiplayer survival adventure server featuring modern firearms, hostile enemies, bosses, exploration, survival, lifestyle elements, and community events.

Players are summoned into a chaotic world as “Crafters” from another world.  
In this world, you will face armed enemies, dangerous monsters, powerful bosses, mysterious structures, and new places to explore.

Fight, survive, explore, build a base with your friends, and enjoy peaceful moments and community events as well.  
This is not only a gun modpack. It is a war, survival, exploration, and lifestyle server pack made for the Toyonatsu Channel community.

---

## About v3.0.0

Version 3.0.0 is a major redesign of the previous server pack.

Some large-scale war, magic, and dragon-focused elements from older versions have been removed or reorganized, while newer adventure, exploration, enemy, and boss-related mods have been added.

Main design changes:

- Reworked the previous large-scale army-focused setup
- Reworked the magic-focused setup
- Reworked the large dragon-focused setup
- Added newer adventure, exploration, enemy, and boss-related content
- Included TaCZ-related guns and gun packs
- Adjusted the pack so players can prepare the server client environment more easily

The goal of v3.0.0 is to make the server feel less like a pure warzone and more like a mix of combat, exploration, survival, lifestyle, and community events.

---

## 🧩 Features

- Built for Forge 1.20.1
- Client pack for joining the Toyonatsu Channel server
- Gun-focused combat elements
- PvE combat, boss fights, exploration, and structure adventures
- Not only combat: base building, survival, lifestyle, and events are also important
- Includes multiplayer-friendly exploration and utility features
- Designed with performance and stability in mind
- Easy to install with the Modrinth App or Prism Launcher

---

## 🔫 Guns and Combat

This pack includes a gun-focused environment built around TaCZ.

The pack is designed for gunfights, hostile encounters, PvE events, and boss battles.  
Combat difficulty and balance may be adjusted depending on the server’s operation and event plans.

---

## 🗺️ Exploration and Adventure

In v3.0.0, exploration and adventure are more important than before.

Explore new areas, fight dangerous enemies, discover structures, and challenge powerful bosses.  
The server is not only about fighting enemies, but also about discovering unknown places and overcoming challenges with other players.

---

## 🏖️ Lifestyle and Events

This server is not only about fighting.

Players can build bases, live with friends, enjoy events, and work toward peaceful goals.

Even in a dangerous world, players can create a place to live, relax, and have fun.  
That is an important theme of the Toyonatsu Channel server.

---

## 📦 Lite and Full Versions

This modpack may be distributed in **Lite** and **Full** versions.

### Lite Version

The Lite version is a lightweight version based on the Full version, with heavier elements such as resource packs, shaders, visual enhancements, and extra atmosphere-related features removed as much as possible.

It focuses on the minimum required mods needed to join the server.  
The main goal of the Lite version is to make it easier for players to connect and play on the Toyonatsu Channel server.

The Lite version is recommended if your PC has limited performance, if you want a lighter setup, or if you do not need shaders or additional visual effects.

### Full Version

The Full version is the recommended version for enjoying the Toyonatsu Channel server with a richer atmosphere.

In addition to the basic server participation setup, it includes resource packs, visual improvements, atmosphere-enhancing features, and other elements designed to improve immersion.

The Full version is recommended if your PC has enough performance and you want a richer visual experience.

If you are not sure which version to use, we recommend starting with the Lite version first.  
Once you confirm that it runs well, you can try the Full version.

---

## 🔧 Differences from the Server Environment

The Toyonatsu Channel server uses dedicated server-side world generation, structures, events, and balance settings in addition to this client pack.

The following categories are especially likely to create differences from singleplayer:

- **World generation and structures**  
  Dungeons and Taverns series, YUNG’s Better series, When Dungeons Arise, Incendium, Better Village, Moog’s Structure-related mods, and similar systems

- **Server progression, events, and adjustments**  
  KubeJS, Chunky, economy and shop settings, PvP zones, team spawn points, and enemy spawning adjustments

- **Server-side balance settings**  
  Enemy strength, raids, bosses, loot, currency, shops, and event progression

These features rely on the server-side setup and the generated server world, so singleplayer will not reproduce the same world, progression, events, or balance shown in the streams.

---

## ⚠️ Notes

- This modpack is mainly intended for joining the Toyonatsu Channel server.
- Singleplayer use is not recommended.
- Please check the Toyonatsu Channel streams, descriptions, or announcements for server rules and participation details.
- The mod list may change depending on server updates and balance adjustments.
- Some mods and settings are adjusted for multiplayer server gameplay.

title: clientside harvest
description: A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that lets you harvest and replant crops in a single right-click. Works on any vanilla server, supports Fortune tools, and automatically selects the correct seed for each crop type.
body:
# Client Harvest

A small Fabric client-side mod that makes harvesting and replanting crops faster by removing the need to break and right-click separately. Works on any vanilla-compatible server — no server-side installation required.

## What it does

Right-clicking a fully grown crop breaks it and replants it in a single action, as long as you have the right seed available. The mod figures out which seed matches which crop automatically, including modded crops that extend vanilla's `CropBlock`.

Supported crops: wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, torchflower, pitcher plant, cocoa beans, nether wart.

## Usage

Hold the matching seed in your main hand (or offhand) and right-click any fully grown crop. That's it.

If you have a Fortune-enchanted tool in your main hand, the mod will use it to break the crop for better drops while still replanting. It will automatically move the matching seed to your offhand if it finds one in your hotbar, so the Fortune tool stays in your main hand throughout.

**Seed placement priority:**
- If a matching seed (e.g. wheat seeds for wheat, carrot for carrot farm) is anywhere in your hotbar or offhand, that takes priority over a generic seed
- Matching seed + Fortune tool: seed moves to offhand, Fortune tool breaks the crop, replant happens automatically
- Matching seed, no Fortune: hotbar switches to the seed slot, break and replant
- No matching seed but any seed in offhand + Fortune tool: breaks with Fortune and replants with whatever seed is there
- No seed anywhere: just breaks the crop, no replant

## Toggle

Press **G** to enable or disable the mod. A message will appear on screen confirming the current state. The setting is saved between sessions.

The keybind can be rebound in Minecraft's controls menu under the *Client Harvest* category.

## Who is this for

Anyone who spends time maintaining large crop farms in survival multiplayer. The vanilla workflow of breaking a crop and separately right-clicking to replant is fine for small farms, but gets tedious at scale. This mod streamlines that without touching anything server-side, so it works anywhere you would normally play.

title: Carpet ROF Addition
description: An optimized Carpet mod that slightly disrupts vanilla features.
body:
**ROF Carpet Addition** is an extension for Carpet that focuses on reducing lag in technical Minecraft servers without breaking normal gameplay, while adding some quality-of-life features.

This mod follows the Carpet style: features are implemented as gamerules that can be enabled, disabled, or tuned individually. Under the default configuration, vanilla behavior is not changed.

### Main features include:

- **Ender pearl cannon optimizations**: aggressive TNT merging, more stable pearl chunk loading, and optimized raycast (Assuming naturally generated blocks’ height stays under a threshold). With all optimizations enabled, average MSPT from pearl launch to landing is reduced by 80%–95%; for very large cannons (>5000 TNT), lag can drop by two orders of magnitude.

-  **Intelligent packet limiting**: restricts packet sending from specific entities in certain areas without affecting normal survival, reducing network and client lag. Used for large-scale sand duplicators and mob farms.

-  **More detailed permission control**: By directly modifying the vanilla command tree, achieve finer-grained permission control, for example, being able to control permissions for subcommands of a command.


- Other small utilities are also included.

**Documentation**: [Rules](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/blob/master/docs/en_us/rules.md)，[Commands](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/blob/master/docs/en_us/command.md)

**Development and snapshot builds** are available through GitHub Actions in the repository.

Note: English translation uses LLM translation.

title: Arctic's Essentials
description: A modern, performance-focused essentials mod for Forge servers. Homes, warps, teleportation, moderation, and more - without bloat.
body:
# 🧊 Arctic’s Essentials
### A modern, high-performance essentials mod for Forge servers  
**Minecraft 1.20.1 · Forge · Java 17+**

> **Arctic’s Essentials** is a fully-featured, highly configurable essentials mod built for modern Forge servers.  
> Lightweight, modular, and engineered for stability — without unnecessary bloat.

---

## 🚀 Why Arctic’s Essentials?

- ⚡ **Performance-focused architecture** — built clean from the ground up  
- 🧩 **Fully modular** — enable only what your server needs  
- 🛠️ **Deep configuration** — per-feature TOML configs  
- 🔒 **Server-first design** — strong admin & moderation tools  
- 💾 **Async data handling** — safe, structured player storage  
- ❌ **No economy lock-in** — standalone by design, extensible later  

> Designed as a modern, lightweight alternative to legacy “all-in-one” utility mods.

---

## ✨ Core Features

### 🏠 Homes
- Multiple named homes per player  
- Optional home sharing  
- Categories support  
- `/home`, `/sethome`, `/delhome`, `/homes`

### 🌍 Warps
- Server warps (OP-controlled)  
- Public player warps  
- Optional sharing & cooldowns  
- `/warp`, `/setwarp`, `/pwarp`, `/warps`

### 📍 Teleportation
- TPA / TPAHere system  
- Warmups with movement & damage cancellation  
- Back history tracking (including death support)  
- `/back`, `/top`, `/jump`, `/tpall`, `/tpcancel`

### 🎲 Random Teleport (RTP)
- Distance-based RTP with configurable limits  
- Safe failure handling (no server crashes)  
- Cooldowns & delay support  
- `/rtp`

### 🏛️ Spawn
- Global or named spawn support  
- `/spawn`, `/setspawn`

### 📧 Mail
- Offline player mail system  
- Persistent JSON storage  
- Join notifications  
- `/mail send`, `/mail read`

### 👥 Player Info
- `/whois`, `/seen`, `/playtime`, `/near`  
- Enhanced `/list` with AFK & vanish states

### 📊 Statistics
- Playtime tracking  
- Deaths  
- Teleport usage  
- Home usage  
- `/stats`

---

## 🔧 Utility Commands

- `/enderchest`
- `/hat`
- `/trashcan`
- `/kickme`

### 🏃 Speed System (Updated)

- `/speed <0–20>` uses a clear multiplier system  
  - `1` = default speed (1x)  
  - Higher values scale logically up to a safe cap  
- Dedicated `/flyspeed <0–20>` command  
- `/flyspeed reset` included  
- Clean separation between walk and fly speed control  

---

## 🛡️ Admin & Moderation

### Admin (OP)
- Gamemode shortcuts  
- Fly, god, heal, feed  
- Vanish system (configurable behavior)  
- Inventory viewing  
- Item repair tools  

### Moderation
- Timed mute system  
- Jail system  
- Player notes  
- `/mute`, `/jail`, `/note`

### 😴 AFK System
- Manual & automatic AFK detection  
- Optional auto-kick  
- Fully configurable thresholds  

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

All features are configurable via TOML:
```
config/arctics_essentials/
├─ general.toml
├─ homes.toml
├─ warps.toml
├─ teleport.toml
├─ rtp.toml
├─ mail.toml
├─ moderator.toml
├─ statistics.toml
└─ admin.toml
```
- Toggle features on/off  
- Configure cooldowns & limits  
- Control permission requirements  
- Adjust teleport behavior  
- Fine-tune moderation systems  

---

## 💾 Data Storage

Player data is stored cleanly as structured JSON:
```
<world>/arctics_essentials/<player-uuid>.json
```
Includes homes, stats, mail, back history, and more.

Designed for clarity, safety, and easier backups.

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the JAR from **Modrinth**  
2. Place it in your server’s `mods` folder  
3. Start your Forge **1.20.1** server  
4. Adjust configs in `config/arctics_essentials/`

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.20.1  
- **Forge:** 47.4.0+  
- **Java:** 17+  

---

## 🛣️ Planned Features

- Kits system  
- Time & weather commands  
- Item / XP utilities  
- Economy integration

- Configurable keybinds  
- Support for Create Config Menu

## 🔧 XE-13 Phobos
### Impact 3

**The crown jewel of it's creators achievements. This origin is retrofitted with the most advanced technology possible, but is not without it's flaws.**


This origin, although introducing many new gameplay mechanics, can still easily turn the tides of battle, being able to deal extreme damage and regenerate almost instantly, although having to manage fuel and avoid close quarters pvp.

## Origin Abilities
### Some complex abilities have been simplified, more info on them can be viewed ingame.

<details>
<summary>ExoFuel</summary>
The hunger system is replaced with a fuel system, with each fuel cannister granting 100 fuel and a total of 10 cannisters. Natural regeneration, eating, and starvation are also disabled, as fuel is regained almost instantly after not using any abilities for 10s. (1000 fuel total, most abilities drain fuel)
</details>
<details>
<summary>Draedon's Arsenal</summary>
When clicking your primary, draw your arsenal, a set of 4 weapons that can be used with right click and cycled with left click. These weapons are extremely powerful, but consume fuel upon use.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Draedon's Heart</summary>
This ability (activated with secondary) converts fuel cannisters to health, with each cannister consumed granting 1 heart, this is your only way to regenerate health.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Triple-Jump</summary>
By clicking your sneak key while in midair, gain up to 2 additional jumps.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Lightweight</summary>
Due to being built from light materials, you are able to land gracefully and with ease. (Fall damage immunity up to 10 blocks)
</details>
<details>
<summary>Unprocessable Liquids</summary>
As you are complete machine, you are incapable of processsing and harnessing most effects.
</details>
<details>
<summary>Unwieldy</summary>
You have grown reliant on your abilities, causing you to struggle to perform well in close quarters combat. (You are unable to make critical hits)
</details>
<details>
<summary>Not-So Fireproof</summary>
Your fuel canisters melt in hot temperatures, causing you to lose fuel passively when on fire in addition to taking +50% fire damage. (This effect can be allievated with fire resistance.)
</details>
<details>
<summary>Mental Lag</summary>
Your reaction time is slowed, causing you to attack considerably slower (-30% Attack Speed).</details>

title: Area Light Up
description: Automatically places torches in dark areas to prevent mob spawning. Preview scan, survival inventory support, and grid-based placement for efficiency.
body:
# LightUp

  Automatically places torches in dark areas within a radius around the player to prevent mob spawning. Uses an efficient grid-based placement system.

  ## Commands

  | Command | Description |
  |---------|-------------|
  | `/lightup` | Preview with default radius (64 blocks) |
  | `/lightup <radius>` | Preview with custom radius (8-128 blocks) |
  | `/lightup stop` | Stop the current task |
  | `/lightup help` | Show all commands |

  ## Features

  ### Preview System
  Before placing any torches, the mod scans the area and shows:
  - **Torches needed** with stack breakdown (e.g., "3840 (60 stacks)")
  - **Inventory comparison** (survival mode)
  - **Crafting materials** if you're short on torches
  - Click **[START]** to begin or do nothing to cancel

  ### Game Modes

  | Mode | Who | Behavior |
  |------|-----|----------|
  | **OP Mode** | Players with permission level 2+ | Unlimited torches |
  | **Survival Mode** | Regular players | Uses torches from inventory |

  ### How It Works
  1. Creates a grid of positions every 12 blocks apart (torch light reaches 14 blocks, ensuring overlap)
  2. Places ONE torch per tick to avoid server lag (~10 torches/second)
  3. After grid completion, does a cleanup scan for any missed dark spots
  4. Progress updates every 50 torches

  ### Torch Placement Validation
  A position is valid if:
  - Position is air
  - Block above is air (prevents underwater placement)
  - Block below is solid
  - Block light level is 0 (actually dark)

  ## Technical Details
  - **Minecraft:** 1.21.11
  - **Mod Loader:** Fabric
  - **Dependencies:** Fabric API
  - **Source:** [GitHub](https://github.com/manchesterjm/Area_Light_Up_Minecraft_mod)

The Lost Menu is a client-side cosmetic mod designed to overhaul the standard Minecraft main menu into a psychological horror experience for modpack developers. title: Verbatim
description: A full featured, open source chat channels mod with a bridge for Discord <-> Minecraft!
body:
# Verbatim - Advanced Chat Mod for Minecraft

Verbatim is a Minecraft server-side mod designed to enhance in-game communication by providing configurable chat channels, direct messaging, Discord integration, and more. It aims to offer a flexible and powerful chat system suitable for various server types, especially those with roleplaying or community focus.

## Features

*   **Customizable Chat Channels:**
    *   Define multiple chat channels with unique names, display prefixes (e.g., `&a[G]`), and shortcuts (e.g., `g`).
    *   **Permissions:** Secure channels with permission nodes (integrates with LuckPerms if available, otherwise uses vanilla OP levels).
    *   **Chat Range:** Set per-channel chat ranges (e.g., for local channels) or make them global.
    *   **Color Customization:** Configure colors for channel names, player names, separators, and messages.
    *   **Always-On Channels:** Designate channels that players are always in and cannot leave.
    *   **Mature Content Warnings:** Option to display a warning when players join channels marked as "mature."
    *   **Special Pre-Made Channel Types:**
        *   `local`: Implements distance-based message fading/obscuring and supports different suffixes (e.g., `!!` for shouting, `*` for whispering) that affect message range and style. (Big shout-out to [MassiveChat](https://www.massivecraft.com/documentation/massivechat-aliases-quick-commands/) for this idea!)
*   **Direct Messaging (DM) / Private Messaging (PM):**
    *   Send private messages to other online players.
    *   Quick reply functionality to the last incoming DM.
*   **Chat Prefixes & Shortcuts:**
    *   Use prefixes to quickly switch focus or send messages to specific channels/DMs without commands (e.g., `g: Hello everyone!` to send to and focus the 'global' channel).
    *   `d:` prefix to focus/reply to the last DM.
*   **Discord Integration:**
    *   Bridge in-game chat (specifically a designated "global" channel) to a Discord channel.
    *   Relay messages from Discord back into the game.
    *   Customizable message prefix for Discord messages shown in-game.
*   **Persistent Player Settings:**
    *   Remembers which channels a player has joined and their focused channel across sessions.
*   **Configuration:**
    *   Extensive configuration via a TOML file (`verbatim-server.toml` in the server's `config` folder).
    *   Define all channels, default channel, Discord bot token, channel ID, and other settings.
*   **Admin Commands & Utilities:**
    *   Reload configuration on the fly (typically requires OP/permission).

## Commands

Most commands are accessible via `/channel` or `/verbatim:channel`.

*   `/channels` or `/channel list`
    *   Lists all available chat channels and your current status in them.
*   `/channel focus <channelName>`
    *   Sets your active typing channel. This will also automatically join the channel if you aren't already in it (and have permission).
*   `/channel join <channelName>`
    *   Joins a specific channel to receive its messages.
*   `/channel leave <channelName>`
    *   Leaves a specific joined channel.
*   `/channel leave`
    *   Leaves your currently focused channel (if it's not an "always-on" channel).
*   `/channel help`
    *   Displays a help message with available Verbatim commands and chat prefixes.

**Direct Message Commands:**

*   `/msg <player> [message]` or `/tell <player> [message]`
    *   Sends a direct message to the specified player. If no message is provided, it focuses your chat on that player for subsequent messages.
*   `/r [message]`
    *   Replies to the last player who sent you a direct message. If no message is provided, it focuses your chat on that player.
*   `/w <player> [message]`
    *   An alias for `/msg`.

**Chat Prefixes (examples):**

*   `g: Your message here` - Sends "Your message here" to the channel with shortcut "g" and focuses it.
*   `d: Your reply here` - Sends "Your reply here" to the last person who DM'd you and focuses DM with them.
*   `d:` (with no message) - Focuses DM with the last person who DM'd you (same as `/r` with no message).

## Configuration

Verbatim is configured through the `verbatim-server.toml` file, typically located in the `config` directory of your Minecraft server after the mod is run for the first time.

Key areas to configure:
*   `defaultChannelName`: The channel players will default to.
*   `channels`: A list where each entry defines a chat channel's properties (name, prefix, shortcut, permission, range, colors, etc.).
*   `Discord Integration`: Settings for the Discord bot, including bot token, channel ID, message prefix, and enabling/disabling the feature.

## Permissions

Verbatim attempts to use LuckPerms for permission checking if it's available on the server. If LuckPerms is not found, it falls back to vanilla Minecraft's operator (OP) levels.

*   **Channel Access:** Channel permissions are defined in the `permission` field for each channel in the configuration file (e.g., `verbatim.channel.staff`). If a permission is set, players will need that node to join/speak in the channel (unless it's `alwaysOn`).

title: Minecraft Extra Keybinds
description: Extra keybinds for commonly used Minecraft settings. Keybinds for distance, sound, zoom and more.
body:
A Minecraft Fabric mod that provides convenient hotkeys for quickly adjusting game settings without opening the settings menu. Perfect for streamers, content creators, and players who frequently need to adjust their game settings on the fly.

![Mod Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2CW4iI4Y/images/5d8ab8d452f0c4bbcbf0d3b6720b985382f5c77d.png)

## ⚙️ Features:

- **🎵 Sound Controls**: Toggle hostile mobs, friendly mobs, music, and jukebox sounds with dedicated hotkeys
- **🌟 Brightness Control**: Adjust gamma/brightness from 0% to 1200% with fullbright support
- **🔍 Zoom Feature**: Hold-to-zoom functionality for better visibility
- **📏 Distance Settings**: Quick adjustment of render distance (2-32 chunks) and simulation distance (5-32 chunks)
- **👁️ FOV Control**: Field of view adjustment from 30° to 110° with 5° increments
- **💾 Smart Config**: Automatically saves user preferences and restores them on game restart
- **⏱️ Debouncing**: Prevents setting spam with 2-second delay for distance/FOV changes
- **🎯 Real-time Feedback**: Shows current values and countdown timers for pending changes

## 📦 Requirements:

- **Minecraft**: 1.21.6
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.16.9 or higher
- **Fabric API**: Compatible version for 1.21.6
- **Java**: 21 or higher

## 🌍 Available Languages:

- **English (en_us)**: Full translation support
- **Vietnamese (vi_vn)**: Complete localization
- **Extensible**: Easy to add more languages via resource packs

## ⌨️ Setting Up Keybindings:

**Important**: This mod does not set any default hotkeys. You need to configure them manually in Minecraft's settings.

1. Go to **Options** → **Controls** → **Key Binds**
2. Scroll down to find the **"Quick Setting Key Mod"** category
3. Assign your preferred keys to each feature:
   - Brightness Increase/Decrease
   - Render Distance Increase/Decrease
   - Simulation Distance Increase/Decrease
   - FOV Increase/Decrease
   - Toggle Hostile Mob Sound
   - Toggle Friendly Mob Sound
   - Toggle Music Sound
   - Toggle Jukebox Sound
   - Toggle Subtitle
   - Zoom (Hold to activate)

*All keybindings are fully customizable to your preference.*

## 📥 Installation:

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/)
2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Download the latest release of Quick Setting Key Mod
4. Place both `.jar` files in your `mods` folder
5. Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

## 🔧 Configuration:

The mod automatically creates a `config/quicksettingkey.json` file to store your preferences. All settings are saved automatically when changed.

title: Labyrythm
description: Labyrythm is a Neoforge mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that challenges players with a procedurally generated, sound-reactive maze and a unique boss encounter.
body:
![file](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2a3c5f16-5173-43a1-8c2d-4f9e4cbc8e2e)

# Labyrythm

**A Minecraft Mod for Neoforge 1.21.1**

Labyrythm is a challenging content mod. The name of the mod combines "Labyrinth" and "Rhythm," reflecting the mod's core features: a dangerous maze and sound-based boss mechanics.

## Description

Prepare to delve into the darkness! Labyrythm introduces the **Minotaur's Labyrinth**, a vast, procedurally generated dungeon. This structure draws heavy inspiration from Minecraft's Deep Dark and Ancient Cities, featuring winding corridors covered in sculk.

Within the heart of this maze lurks the **Minotaur**, a fearsome new boss. Be warned: the Minotaur is blind and hunts using sound, similar to the Warden. Every step you take, every block you place, could alert it to your presence. Stealth and careful planning are key to survival – hence the "Rhythm" in the mod's name.

Those brave enough to explore the labyrinth and confront the Minotaur can discover powerful new items, including the formidable **Minotaur's Axe**, found in chests and as drops from the boss itself.

## Key Features

* **Minotaur's Labyrinth:** A new, procedurally generated underground structure themed after the Deep Dark and Ancient Cities.
* **The Minotaur:** A challenging new boss that is blind and reacts to sounds made by the player.
* **Sound-Based Gameplay:** Navigate the sculk-infested labyrinth carefully to avoid attracting the Minotaur.
* **New Loot:** Discover powerful items, including the Minotaur's Axe, within the labyrinth's chests and as a reward for defeating the boss.

title: BeaconEnhancer
description: "Beacon Enhancer" is a mod that boosts the functionality of beacons in Minecraft by allowing players to increase the beacon's effect radius using Nether stars.
body:
When using a Nether star by right-clicking on the beacon, the mod automatically calculates the new radius of the beacon based on the number of Nether stars used and applies it instantly. This expanded functionality provides players with greater flexibility and control over the range of beneficial effects provided by beacons, allowing them to further customize their gameplay experience and optimize the efficiency of their projects in the Minecraft world. With smart mathematical formulas and seamless integration into the game, "Beacon Enhancer" offers a significant improvement in gameplay for exploration and construction enthusiasts in Minecraft.

The mathematical formula used by the "Beacon Enhancer" mod to calculate the new radius of the beacon is as follows:

​
![NewRadius formula](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d45f5f3f6188cd24acfc4defc9e15f38c72fbf4.png)

Where:

- customRadius: customRadius is the new radius of the beacon.
- baseRadius: baseRadius is the base radius of a beacon without any enhancements.
- netherStarCounter: netherStarCounter is the number of Nether stars used to enhance the beacon.
- additionalArea: additionalArea is the extra area added to the beacon's radius for each Nether star.
- π:  is a mathematical constant representing the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.

This formula calculates the new radius of the beacon taking into account both the base radius and the number of Nether stars used to enhance the beacon. The more Nether stars used, the larger the resulting beacon radius.

title: WE Selection Overlay
description: Make your WorldEdit selections visible, readable, and predictable.
body:
![weaddon](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1592/332/worldedit_selection_overlay_300-png.png)

# WorldEdit Selection Overlay (Fabric) Make your WorldEdit selections visible, readable, and predictable. ![Overview](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1721/646/2026-06-05_18-56-31-png.png) ## What is this? WorldEdit Selection Overlay is a **client-side visual addon** that shows your selection **exactly as it is** before you run any destructive commands. No more guessing shapes. No more wrong sizes. No more accidental `//set air`. You see everything in advance. ## Why you actually need this WorldEdit gives you power, but **almost no visual feedback**. This mod fixes that: * See the real shape of your selection * Read dimensions directly in-game * Inspect blocks before editing * Isolate specific block types inside a selection * Avoid mistakes that cost time ## In-Game Preview ![Selection Overlay1](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1586/93/sphere-png.png) ![Selection Overlay2](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1586/89/cyl-png.png) ![Selection Overlay1](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1586/87/poly-png.png) ![Selection Overlay1](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1586/91/convex-png.png) The overlay renders your selection **directly in the world**: * Exact bounds * Real geometry * Clear corner points ## Built-in Dimension Ruler Measure selections like in CAD tools: * Clean readable size labels * Always visible from your current angle * Can follow your camera or stay fixed ## Overlay Palette Editor Customize how the overlay looks directly in-game: * Full-screen color editor with live selection preview * Per-element color, transparency, and line thickness * Ready-made presets for different visibility needs * Reset controls for one element, thickness, colors, or everything ![Selection Blocks Screen](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1721/651/2026-06-07_12-22-07-png.png) ## Inspect Before You Edit Open the block viewer and see exactly what is inside: * All blocks in the selection, including `air` * Grouped and searchable * Fast filtering with `#air`, `#fluid`, and `#solid` * Chunk-aware loaded/unloaded counts * Fluid entries use bucket icons for easier reading Perfect before using: * `//replace` * `//set` * `//stack` ## Block Isolation Mode Need to find only one material inside a huge selection? Select one or more block types in the block viewer. The mod hides every other block inside the selected WorldEdit region **on the client only**, leaving the real world untouched. Useful for: * Finding hidden ores, liquids, air pockets, containers, or mistakes * Checking what a `//replace` command will affect * Inspecting complex builds layer by layer * Viewing selected blocks with their normal textures Details: * Multiple block types can be selected at the same time * Selected block groups stay pinned above the rest of the list * A reset button clears the isolation selection quickly * Fluids and fluid-like rendered content are hidden when they are not selected * Selected blocks and fluids are rendered full-bright so their textures stay readable * The selection boundary and ruler can stay visible while the internal grid is hidden * Works even when the normal selection overlay visibility is disabled Everything is visual only. Hidden blocks still exist, still collide, and are never changed by the mod. ## Features * Real-time selection overlay * Two render styles: **Blocky / Smooth** * Optional internal selection grid toggle * Full-screen palette editor with live preview * Custom colors, transparency, thickness, and presets * Adaptive performance for large selections * Optional diagonals for cuboid shapes * Built-in dimension ruler * Block inspection screen * Client-side block isolation mode * Fluid-aware rendering and bucket icons * Full-bright isolated blocks and fluids for readable textures * Fully configurable UI ## Supported Selection Types * Cuboid * Polygon 2D * Ellipsoid / Sphere * Cylinder * Polyhedron / Convex Works with everything WorldEdit sends via CUI. ## Controls | Key |Action | | --- |---------------------------- | | O |Open overlay settings | | B |Open block inspection screen | | N |Deselect | All keybinds are configurable. ## Compatibility * Singleplayer * Fabric + WorldEdit * LabyMod/LabyFabric when Fabric mods are enabled * Paper / Spigot / Purpur if WorldEdit CUI data is available * Sodium support for block and fluid isolation rendering If the server does not send CUI data or supported WorldEdit selection updates, the overlay cannot know what to render. ## Important * Client-side only, safe to install anywhere * Does not modify the world * Hidden blocks are only hidden visually * Recommended Minecraft GUI Scale: **2x** * Requires WorldEdit selection data ## Requirements * Minecraft **1.21.11** * Fabric Loader * Fabric API * WorldEdit ## Installation 1. Install Fabric Loader 2. Install Fabric API 3. Drop the mod into `/mods` 4. Launch the game ## Quick Start 1. Make a WorldEdit selection 2. Press `O` to configure the overlay 3. Use the palette button to customize colors and thickness 4. Press `B` to inspect blocks 5. Use the checkboxes in the block viewer to isolate specific blocks ## Troubleshooting * Make sure WorldEdit is installed * Make sure CUI is enabled when playing on servers that require it * Rejoin the world if the overlay does not appear * If using Sodium, restart the game after replacing the mod jar ## [Download WorldEdit](https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/worldedit) # Contact the developer: ngocchaub81@gmail.com

title: FrozenStats
description: The ultimate replica of DonutSMP Stats
body:
> # FrozenStats ❄️

A stats GUI plugin for Minecraft — styled like DonutSMP Stats.  
Built with **Maven**, using the exact same architecture as the original DonutStats source.

---

## Supported Versions
- Minecraft **1.21 – 1.21.11**

## Supported Server Software
| Software | Supported |
|----------|-----------|
| Paper    | ✅ |
| Spigot   | ✅ |
| Purpur   | ✅ |
| Folia    | ✅ (`folia-supported: true`) |

---

## Features
- Stats GUI identical to DonutSMP (Money, Total Money Paid, Kills, Deaths, Playtime, Blocks, Mobs, Shop stats)
- **Shards replaced with "Total Money Paid"** — tracks the lifetime total of all Vault deposits made to the player
- Full `&#RRGGBB` hex colour support in all config text
- PlaceholderAPI support — every lore line runs through PAPI
- Configurable sounds (all keys are registry-safe for 1.21)
- `/stats`, `/stats <player>`, `/stats reload`
- Offline player support + tab completion with offline player cache

---

## Commands & Permissions

| Command | Permission | Default |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| `/stats` | `stats.use` | `true` |
| `/stats <player>` | `stats.other` | `op` |
| `/stats reload` | `stats.reload` | `op` |

---

## Soft Dependencies
- **PlaceholderAPI** — for all `%holorams_*%`, `%donutshop_*%`, `%donutsell_*%`, and `%frozenstats_*%` placeholders
- **Vault** — for current balance display and lifetime total-paid tracking

---

## Total Money Paid — How it Works

FrozenStats tracks the **cumulative total money ever paid/deposited** to each player via Vault.

Data is stored in `plugins/FrozenStats/data/totalpaid.yml` (UUID → double).

### PlaceholderAPI placeholders
| Placeholder | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| `%frozenstats_total_paid%` | Vault-formatted total (e.g. `$1,234.56`) |
| `%frozenstats_total_paid_short%` | Short form (e.g. `1.2k`, `3.4M`) |
| `%frozenstats_total_paid_raw%` | Raw double value |

### Recording payments from another plugin
If you have a custom shop or reward plugin, call FrozenStats' API to record each payment:

```java
Plugin fs = Bukkit.getPluginManager().getPlugin("FrozenStats");
if (fs instanceof FrozenStats frozenStats) {
    frozenStats.recordPayment(player.getUniqueId(), amount);
}
```


## Config Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `config.yml` | Messages & sound keys |
| `gui.yml` | All GUI items (rows, title, slots, materials, names, lore) |
| `data/totalpaid.yml` | Auto-generated — stores lifetime payment data per UUID |

This is the official modpack for the International Coalition of Nations Minecraft server. 

This modpack is currently in **Beta**. Changes should be anticipated, but this is being uploaded as a record of changes. 

Combining the factory-building and mechanical nature of Create with a handful of technology mods, this modpack *Create*s a unique political and economic landscape. # FancyMenuWorldRenderer

An addon for FancyMenu that allows the user to create 3D scenes using blocks

## Description

The user can define custom 3D scenes using blocks, and then they can be renderer as part of FancyMenu's custom UI. Then, the scene can be rotated, scaled and translated using the editor. It also allows to use placeholders to animate these parameters.

## How to use it

### Define the scene

The scene is defined as a json file. An easy way to create the scene is to go into a world and use the command ```fmsr-create```.
This command has two arguments and a third optional argument. The first argument is the position of the first corner of the scene, the second argument is the second corner. Like this:

```fmsr-create 0 0 0 1 1 1```

Once you execute this command, a message will be displayed in the chat confirming the creation, if you click the blue text, the json scene should copy to your clipboard. If you decide to use the third argument, the result will be outputed to a file:

```fmsr-create 0 0 0 1 1 1 scene.json```

The file will be created inside FancyMenu's config folder

### Use the scene inside fancy menu

There will be a new element in FancyMenu with the name *Scene*. When you right-click the element there should be an option to choose between two input options: File and Direct. The first option allows you to use the contents of a file, for example the previously created *scene.json*. The second options allows you to write directly the scene as a parameter.

### Customize the scene

When you right-click the element, there should be a list of options for setting the offset, rotation and scale of the scene. These options can be parametrized using placeholders. If you want to dynamically update them, for example to automatically change them overtime to make an animation, you should enable *Dynamic Rotation*, *Dynamic Offset* or *Dynamic Scale* options inside the right-click context menu.

## TODO
- Render entities
- 3D models
- Particle rendering

A way of imitating entities and models, is to create a custom resourcepack that adds custom models and using those blocks as part of the scene.

title: BackPack Plugin
description:
It's a Minecraft Plugin that adds Backpacks to the game.
It works with all 1.21 versions, Tested on 1.21.5 and 1.21.8. Fully customizable.
You can get them by Crafting, or with a command.
body:
# BackPack Plugin:
# 
Overview

The Backpack plugin allows players to have personal portable storage in Minecraft that can be opened like a chest but is persistent across server restarts. Each backpack is unique and linked to its owner, with features to prevent nesting backpacks inside each other and control inventory access. It's fully customizable. 


The plugin also provides commands for giving, viewing, and managing backpacks, as well as full configuration support for customization.

Features
1. Backpack Items

Players can receive backpacks via command (/backpack give) or (optionally) through crafting.

Each backpack is linked to a UUID and the player's name.

The item lore shows:

Owner name

Backpack number

Contents count (filled slots / total slots)

Instruction: "Right click to open"

2. Commands
/backpack give <player> [rows] [item]

Gives a backpack to a player.
!["Backpack give" Command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9820105d20aa5779efbe66f60c45d84a7d6802be.png)

Optional:

rows: Size of the backpack (e.g., 2x9, 3x9)

item: The type of item to represent the backpack (e.g., CHEST, SHULKER_BOX)

/backpack seeinside <player> <number>

Allows a player to view a specific backpack of another player by his number.
!["Backpack seeinside" Command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8faffc2e8b61af9cbd5e351b66eca4a6454dc77f.png)

/backpack reload or /bp reload

Reloads the plugin configuration (items, crafting recipes, language settings, etc.) without restarting the server.
!["Backpack reload" Command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd58ffd4a2cc2c0ebf79583535ac7340203e5ceb.png)

3. Crafting

A default backpack recipe exists (configurable).

Can be fully customized in the config: shape, ingredients, and result item.

Crafting can produce real functional backpacks or dummy items depending on the settings.

4. Inventory Behavior

When a backpack is opened:

Players can move all items except the backpack itself.

Other backpacks can be moved but cannot be placed inside the open backpack.

Inventory contents update dynamically in the item's lore.

5. Persistence

All backpacks are saved to backpacks.yml:

Contents

Size

Owner

Display name

Data is loaded automatically on plugin enable.

6. Configuration Options

Backpack Item: Set which item represents a backpack.

Default Rows & Max Rows: Control size limits of backpacks.

Crafting Recipe: Fully configurable, including shape and ingredients.

Language Settings: Support for English and German messages.

Comments: All config settings include English comments for clarity.

7. Plugin Compatibility

Compatible with Paper/Spigot 1.21+

Java 17+ recommended

Works with UUID-based persistence for multi-server and offline player support

8. Development Notes

Uses PersistentDataContainer for linking items to inventories.

Uses a custom BackpackInventoryHolder to track which inventory belongs to which backpack item.

Designed to prevent server errors from nested backpacks or accidental item loss.

Commands and crafting are fully dynamic via the configuration.

# Dispenserfarm Mod Introduction

Dispenserfarm is a lightweight yet powerful Minecraft mod that enhances dispensers, turning them into versatile tools for automated farming. This mod allows dispensers to plant a wide variety of crops and items, from wheat, carrots, and potatoes to unique plants like mushrooms, sugar cane, cave vines, and Nether Wart, using their corresponding items.

### Key Features:
- **Automated Planting**: Dispensers can place seeds, saplings, flowers, and other plantable items on suitable surfaces like farmland, soul sand, or nylium.
- **Wide Crop Support**: Supports basic crops, tall flowers (e.g., sunflowers, lilacs), mushrooms, sugar cane, and special plants like Nether Wart and cave vines.
- **Optimized Bone Meal Use**: Bone meal accelerates Nether Wart growth, produces glow berries on cave vines, and boosts sugar cane development, with visual particle effects on success. Notably, the mod disables sound and smoke effects when bone meal is not used, ensuring a seamless experience.

Dispenserfarm is perfect for players looking to streamline farming automation in Minecraft, saving time and enhancing redstone creativity. Try it now to transform your dispensers into ultimate farming tools!

1.20.1 is the newest version of Create at the moment. I will try to keep this modpack up to date when Create decides to update

title: Pug's Cobblemon
description: Pug's Cobblemon combines the best mods for new biomes, structures, combat, and Pokémon! Explore diverse landscapes, decorate with unique furniture, and catch and train Pokémon with Cobblemon for an epic adventure.
body:
Welcome to Pug's Cobblemon, a carefully curated compilation of some of the best Cobblemon mods out there, designed to offer a whole new way to experience the game! This modpack is all about combining amazing biomes, structures, new gameplay mechanics, and exciting combat features to create a rich, immersive world full of adventures. Please note: I did not create any of these mods myself, I’ve simply compiled them so you can enjoy them together in one seamless experience!

Biomes & Structures:
With this modpack, you can explore a stunning variety of landscapes and structures, thanks to Terralith and Tectonic. These mods transform the world’s biomes into breathtaking terrains with new geological formations and vibrant ecosystems. The pack also includes Dungeons and Taverns Modline, adding exciting dungeons to discover, taverns to visit, and loads of loot to find. Structory offers even more custom structures to fill your world, while Better End and Better Nether upgrade the End and Nether with new villages and pillages, offering more opportunities for exploration and engagement. There’s always something new to uncover around every corner!

Combat:
Prepare for epic battles with Better Combat Mod, which overhauls the combat system, adding new mechanics for a more immersive and strategic fighting experience. With combat reworked, you’ll also need to check out new weapons, armor, and powerful mobs from the new structures and dungeons.

Decoration & QOL Mods:
Decorating your world has never been so fun! With mods like Handcrafted, Clutter, Supplementaries, and Amendments, you can fill your homes with realistic, cozy furniture, tiny details, and all sorts of cute and functional decorations. Looking for something a bit more Pokémon-related? Pokeblocks and Plushables add delightful plush toys and blocks related to the Pokémon universe. Additionally, Paladins Furniture adds even more styles to your interiors.

To make life easier in Minecraft, this pack also includes Quality of Life mods like Decaying Leaves, 3D Skin Layers, and Better Animations. These tweaks improve the overall game experience, from visual polish to small gameplay improvements that enhance immersion.

Pokémon:
For all the Pokémon fans out there, get ready for an unforgettable adventure! Cobblemon adds a massive roster of Megas, Legendaries, and more Pokémon to catch, train, and battle. You can now ride your Pokémon, hatch eggs, collect badges, explore Pokémon-themed structures, and engage in battles with TMs and HMs. And with the addition of Pokémon-related décor, your world will truly feel like a Pokémon Trainer’s dream!

title: hammer
description: Basic yet customizable plugin for your Minecraft server. Everything, everywhere, all at once.
body:
### [Our website](http://hamium.xyz/hammer/) | [Documentation](https://hamium.xyz/hammer-docs/) | [Donate](https://ko-fi.com/unium) --- ### A Basic yet customizable plugin for your Minecraft server. An extremely simple and lightweight plugin, that's SUPER customizable!
Some of it's notable features are: 1. **Minimal and speed in mind** - Built with the most minimal things required to achieve things. 2. **TPA** - TPA and TPAHere requests, which allow players to ask to TP to someone else. 3. **Homes** - Allows players to set homes which they can teleport back to. 4. **Teams** - Allows players to create teams! 5. **Chat formatting** - Allows the server owner to change how the chat looks. Supports [LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/) for prefixes and suffixes! Few things we're working on: 1. **More server administrating utilities** - Hammer is sort of supposed to be like EssentialX, but it's missing many features. These features will slowly be added over time 2. **Economy with vault** - We are planning to implement an economy module to hammer. However, this will probably be added wayyy down the road, as we are focusing on implementing more important features first. 3. **Even more customization** - Hammer is meant to be "fully" customizable, but it's not quite there yet. 4. **Documentation** - We are also writing documentation for hammer, which will be published soonᵗᵐ. Andddd, that's pretty much it! You can check out some examples of what the plugin looks like in the [gallery tab.](https://modrinth.com/plugin/hammermc/gallery) Also to be clear, we WON'T give full support for hammer *yet!* For now, you will have to rely on the comments in the config file(s). However if you do encounter a bug or want to suggest something, you can DM **leunium** on discord.

title: ForeverFantasy
description: Explore, level up, and immerse yourself in our modpack. Adventure awaits in a world filled with mystery and skill progression.
body:
# **Early Alpha Version!**
- This Modpack is still being play-tested.
# Why this modpack?
In my quest for the perfect Minecraft experience, I've been on the lookout for a modpack that just gets it—something that captures the heart and soul of what I've always wanted this game to be.

Most of what I stumbled upon, though? Well, it was either a hot mess of half-baked ideas with mods that left me scratching my head, or it was so jam-packed with stuff that it lost that simple, pure Minecraft essence.

But hey, here’s the modpack I've put together. It’s not trying to be all fancy with crazy tech stuff; it's just about good ol' adventure, gathering what you need, some decent fights, and exploring like it's a laid-back RPG MMO.

Imagine wandering through this chill Minecraft world, where every day is a new little adventure. No crazy machines, just you and the blocks. The mobs? They're there, but not in a way that makes you want to tear your hair out. It’s more like a gentle nudge to keep you on your toes.

This modpack is like your favorite comfy sweater—simple, reliable, and perfect for those lazy afternoons of mining and exploring. No need for overthinking; just dive in, swing your sword, grab some resources, and see where the day takes you.

So, if you're tired of the modding madness and just want to kick back with Minecraft the way it was meant to be, this one's for you. It might not be the flashiest modpack out there, but it’s got that cozy, familiar feeling that I've been craving for a long, long time..

# Simple Display Items
A simple datapack that allows you to disable interaction with an item, make it float, and make it immune to fire.

## Showcase
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/QJ9RBMGaqn0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>

*(Watch on YouTube for better quality)*

## Usage
First run the following command:
```
/function sdi:craft/craft_papers
```
This will give you two papers, one called "Display On" and one called "Display Off". 

To put an item in "display mode", throw the item on the block you want, then throw the "Display On" paper on top. If you see green particles, then it worked.

To take an item out of display mode, simply throw the "Display Off" paper at the item, and you can immediately pick it up.

### ❗WARNING❗
Items are *not* immune to explosions for now. This may change in the near future.

## ⚙️ Optional Crafting Recipe
There is a built in crafting recipe that is disabled by default. To enable it, unzip the datapack and navigate to:
```
data/sdi/recipes/papers.json.disabled
```
Rename the file to just "papers.json". (If you are on windows, you may need to enable file extensions. You can learn how to do so [here](https://www.howtogeek.com/205086/beginner-how-to-make-windows-show-file-extensions/))

Once you finish this and reload with "/reload", the papers can be crafted by all players with the following recipe:\
![Crafting Recipe](https://file.garden/YK55Rqs3-AHC5Tk9/simple_display_items_recipe.png)

You can also replace the recipe with any recipe you want, as long as the file is still called "papers.json".

body:
A Client-Side mod for Hypixel Skyblock that highlights the area where a Trapper Animal could be, based on the height and angle the Theodolite tells us. **DISCLAIMER:**
The accuracy of the mod varies. This is because in the message you get from the Theodolite, **_all values are rounded_** to a multiple of 5. You could be one block below an Animal and it would tell you that the mob is 5 blocks above.
You _can_ counteract this by setting the angle and height margins to 2.5, but it would highlight a much larger area as a result. # Features - Highlights a circular area when using the Theodolite, red circle for center, green circles for margin of error - Circles get removed when the Animal is killed (or when you leave the lobby/server) - Config - currently only changeable in the JSON file... (within the standard MC config folder) - That's it for now... ## Planned - Config Menu - Fancy Shapes ## Issues - There is an Issue while using Shaders using the Iris mod which prevents the rendering of... anything, really. From what I can read on the Iris Docs, this is unfixable. - You can use Shaders perfectly fine, but you will need to turn them off to see anything drawn by this mod

The resource pack can be independently downloaded [here](https://github.com/CarsonWebb/Terraria_Items/releases/download/Textures/TerrariaTextures.zip).

## About:

This plugin adds in many different items and features from both Terraria and the Terraria Calamity mod. It adds weapons, accessories, tools, armors, materials, new crafting recipes, mob drops,and a crafting station. It also replicates Terraria's Mana system for magic weapons.

---

![Some of the items that have been added in.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/I5PNUeKt/images/beee9454b580178e229944285f56db5ceb913fa9.png)

---

**In total this plugin adds in:**
- Hardmode
- 72 Weapons
- 21 Tools
- 4 Potions
- 16 Materials
- 1 Crafting Station/Block
- 10 Sets of Armor
- 17 Enemies
- 63 Accessories
- 8 Fishing Crates
- Vanity System
- 3 Bosses
- Rogue weapons and mechanics from Calamity

---

### Hardmode:

A world enters hardmode after the Ender Dragon has been defeated. If it has already been defeated then killing it again will also enter it into Hardmode.

---

### Vanity System:

For older versions 2.1 and before, for the Vanity system to work [ProtocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/) MUST be installed. This is not necessary for the plugin to function and only to use the vanity function.

This feature is still a WIP

---

### Commands:

| Command | Usage | Permissions |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
|/ti give [ItemName]| Gives item | Op |
|/ti toggle_prehardmode | Toggles Pre-Hardmode features|Op |
|/ti toggle_hardmode | Toggles Hardmode features |Op |
|/ti toggle_blood_moon | Toggles if Blood Moons can occur |Op |
|/ti summon_blood_moon | Summons a Blood Moon |Op |

### Languages:

Terraria Items currently supports English, Spanish, Russian, and Chinese(Simplified). In Order to change the language, in the server files go to plugins/TerrariaItems/config.yml to change the language.

- en_US - English

title: PMweather Aeronautics compat
description: This mod allows sable objects to be influenced by the wind and weather from Protomanly's Weather mod
body:
# PMWeather Aeronautics

PMWeather Aeronautics connects **ProtoManly’s Weather** with **Sable / Create Aeronautics** physics contraptions.

It allows Sable physics objects and Create Aeronautics contraptions to react to PMWeather wind, storms, and tornadoes using exposed surface pressure instead of a simple fake push. Wind is sampled from PMWeather, converted into physics wind, applied across exterior faces, and then passed into Sable so the normal physics engine handles movement, rotation, collision, mass, and inertia.

## Features

* PMWeather wind affects Sable / Create Aeronautics physics objects.
* Quadratic surface-pressure wind model.
* Larger exposed faces naturally catch more wind.
* Stronger storm and tornado winds scale much more realistically than light wind.
* Exterior surface patch sampling for sealed builds, walls, roofs, large ships, irregular shapes, and exposed undersides.
* Uneven pressure can create natural yaw, roll, and tumbling instead of only pushing from the center.
* Local airflow lift support for lift providers.
* Tornado updraft support using bottom-facing exterior surfaces.
* Configurable wind strength, tornado lift, sampling limits, and debug options.
* Debug commands for checking wind and sample usage.
* Compatible with Sable/Create Aeronautics simulated contraption diagrams.

## Version 0.8.0 Highlights

Version 0.8.0 reworks the main body wind system. Older versions used a less realistic wind push behavior that made light 10–15 mph winds too strong while tornado winds did not feel strong enough by comparison.

The new system uses quadratic surface pressure, meaning wind force scales more like real wind pressure:

```text
wind force ∝ wind speed² × exposed surface area
```

This makes normal wind less overpowering while still allowing storms and tornadoes to move contraptions much more naturally.

Version 0.8.0 also fixes a Create Aeronautics / Sable diagram crash caused by PMWeather Aeronautics wind forces. Thanks to **@michardy** for the detailed report in issue **#2**.

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge
* ProtoManly’s Weather / PMWeather
* Sable

## Commands

All commands are under:

```text
/pmaero
```

Check PMWeather wind at your current position:

```text
/pmaero wind
```

Check current wind sample usage:

```text
/pmaero samples
```

Enable live sample monitoring:

```text
/pmaero samples live on
```

Disable live sample monitoring:

```text
/pmaero samples live off
```

Start detailed wind debugging:

```text
/pmaero winddebug start
```

Stop detailed wind debugging:

```text
/pmaero winddebug stop
```

Check whether detailed wind debugging is running:

```text
/pmaero winddebug status
```

## Config Notes

The default 0.8.0 body wind influence is:

```toml
[body_wind]
windInfluence = 0.06
```

This value is tuned for the new quadratic surface-pressure system. Raising it makes all body wind stronger, including normal wind and tornado wind. Lowering it makes contraptions less affected by wind overall.

Tornado lift can be adjusted separately:

```toml
[tornado_updraft]
tornadoUpdraftStrength = 0.35
tornadoUpdraftPressureStrength = 1.0
```

If updating from older versions, the mod will back up older generated configs once and regenerate a fresh config with the new 0.8.0 defaults.

## Notes

PMWeather Aeronautics does not directly fake contraption movement or force objects along preset tornado paths. It calculates wind pressure, lift, and torque from PMWeather wind and exposed contraption surfaces, then lets Sable handle the final physics result.

This mod adds 1 item, the link relay. It is a compact utility block for Create’s Redstone Link system that lets you remap wireless frequencies. 

Set an input frequency pair and an output frequency pair, and any signal received on the input will be transmitted on the output. You can stack unlimited bindings in a single relay block.

This item stemmed out of frustration for not being able to fit the controls on my small aeronautics engine, and having ground relays meant that the controls would break down when I flew further than 256 blocks.

title: no_mobs_destroy_block
description: Prevent the destructive behavior of organisms and entities towards blocks.
body:
# Mod Introduction
This mod aims to precisely prevent specific mobs and entities in "Minecraft" from causing block destruction to the environment, while fully retaining all their other characteristics in the game. Simply put, it ensures that the attacking, moving, and other behaviors of specific mobs and entities remain unaffected, while eliminating their ability to destroy blocks.

## Mob Restriction List
| Mob/Entity | Anti - destruction Type | Retained Behavioral Characteristics |
| ---- | ---- | ---- |
| Creeper | Explosion does not destroy blocks | Retain explosion damage, sound effects, particle effects, knockback, and the ability to ignite other entities |
| Ghast | Fireball explosion does not destroy blocks | Retain fireball damage, sound effects, flight trajectory, and fire - igniting effects |
| Wither | All forms of destruction are prevented | Retain attack damage, adjusted health regeneration (not relying on block destruction), flight, and sound effects |
| Ender Dragon | Cannot destroy any blocks | Retain combat AI, pouncing attacks, crystal summoning, and perching behavior |
| Enderman | Cannot pick up and remove blocks | Retain teleportation ability, angry state, attack behavior, and sound effects |
| Ender Crystal | Explosion does not destroy any blocks | Retain explosion damage, the ability to heal the Ender Dragon, and sound effects |

## Configuration File
This mod supports flexible configuration through the `config/no_mobs_destroy_block.toml` file (not yet implemented).

```toml
[general]
# Disabled entity list (can be customized to add/remove)
disabled_entities = [
    "minecraft:ender_dragon",
    "minecraft:creeper",
    "minecraft:ghast", 
    "minecraft:wither",
    "minecraft:ender_crystal",
    "minecraft:enderman"
]

# Whether to enable explosion visual effects
enable_explosion_effects = true

# Whether to prevent Endermen from picking up blocks
prevent_enderman_pickup = true

# Whether to prevent the Wither from damaging blocks
prevent_wither_block_damage = true

# Enhanced Ender Crystal detection (fix special bugs)
aggressive_end_crystal_detection = true

# Debug logging (enable for troubleshooting)
debug_logging = false
```
