title: CombatLogPlugin
description: A lightweight combat logging plugin for Minecraft Paper servers that prevents players from escaping fights unfairly.
body:
# ⚔️ CombatLogPlugin

A lightweight combat logging plugin for Minecraft Paper servers that prevents players from escaping fights unfairly.

CombatLogPlugin tags players when they fight, shows an action bar countdown, and punishes players who log out while still in combat.

---

## Features

- 🗡️ Combat tagging when players hit each other
- 🏹 Supports melee, bows, and tridents
- ⏳ Action bar countdown timer
- 🚫 Punishes players who log out during combat
- 💬 Clean messaging with less spam
- ☠️ Combat ends when the tagged player dies
- 🛫 Can block Elytra usage while in combat
- ⚙️ Configurable settings
- 🔄 Reload command support
- 🧩 Compatible with TogglePVPCustom combat checks
- 🧱 Current release support for Paper 26.1+

---

## Version Support

The current version of CombatLogPlugin supports **Paper 26.1+** and should be built or used with **Java 25**.

| Target | Java | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Paper 26.1+ | Java 25 | Current version |
| Paper 1.21+ / 1.21.11 | Java 21 | Check release `1.2.1` |

For Paper 1.21+ / 1.21.11 support, download release `1.2.1` here:

```txt
https://github.com/Frwostella/CombatLogPlugin/releases/tag/1.2.1
```

The output should show Java version 25.

---

## Installation

1. Download or build the latest `.jar` file.
2. Put it in your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start or restart your server.
4. Configure `config.yml` to your liking.
5. Use `/combatlog reload` after editing the config.

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/combatlog reload` | Reloads the plugin configuration |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `combatlog.reload` | Allows use of the reload command | OP |

---

## Configuration

Example `config.yml`:

```yml
combat-time: 15
logout-action: "kill"
logout-command: "kill %player%"

messages:
  tagged: "&cYou are now in combat! Do not log out."
  safe: "&aYou are no longer in combat."
  actionbar: "&cCombat: &e%time%s"
```

Config options may vary depending on your current plugin version.

---

## TogglePVPCustom Support

CombatLogPlugin can be used with Frwostella's TogglePVPCustom plugin:

```txt
https://github.com/Frwostella/TogglePVPCustom
```

When TogglePVPCustom's CombatLog hook is enabled, players cannot disable PvP while they are combat tagged.

---

## Requirements

- Paper 26.1+
- Java 25

---

description: MullV Earthworks is the official mullv.studio modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge, featuring custom 1:1 terrain, extensive Create addons, Sodium performance, Iris shaders, and multiplayer QOL for immersive survival on their servers.
body:
**MullV Earthworks** is a **vanilla‑plus engineering and exploration modpack** for **Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge)**. It’s built around a custom 1:1‑style Earth‑inspired world, Create‑powered infrastructure, and performance‑tuned survival for long‑term worlds on the mullv.studio network.

![banner.png](https://github.com/mullvstudios/survival-2026/raw/main/banner.png)

You spawn in a **procedural 1:1 terrain world** used on the official MullV servers. You start small: simple shelter, and a rough base carved into the landscape. As you progress, you **industrialize entire regions with Create**, lay down **rail corridors between cities**, and build **persistent infrastructure** that feels grounded in the terrain instead of floating above it.

*This is a world for players who like big, permanent projects — rail networks, factories, ports, and cities that grow over months, not days.*

## Features

- 🗺️ **Custom 1:1‑style world** – Play on a carefully crafted large‑scale terrain designed for long‑term exploration, survival, and infrastructure projects, as used on the official MullV servers.
  Mods like **Antique Atlas**, **Ecologics**, **Repurposed Structures**, **Traveler’s Titles**, **Surveyor Map Framework**, **Surveystones**, and **Realistic Bees** deepen exploration and navigation so every journey feels like a real trip, not a quick teleport.

- ⚙️ **Create‑driven engineering sandbox** – Core **Create** plus a focused ecosystem of addons (e.g. **Big Cannons**, **Crafts & Additions**, **Diesel Generators**, **Create: New Age**, **Steam ’n’ Rails**, **Create: Nuclear**, **Railways Navigator**, **Train Physics**, **Threaded Trains**, **Train Utilities**, **Bells & Whistles**, **Structures Arise**, **Waystones Recipes**) let you design **factories, power grids, rail systems, and automation** that integrate naturally into the world.

- 🤝 **Survival and co‑op friendly** – Built with multiplayer in mind using **Simple Voice Chat**, **Hardcore Revival**, **Gravestone Mod**, **Waystones**, **Tom’s Simple Storage**, **Carry On**, **Double Doors**, **FallingTree**, **Easy Anvils**, **Steve’s Realistic Sleep**, and more for **smooth, cooperative survival** without heavy hand‑holding.

- 🧰 **Quality‑of‑life tools** – UI and utility mods such as **EMI**, **Jade** and addons, **AppleSkin**, **Better Advancements** + **Advancement Plaques/Screenshot**, **Highlighter**, **Item Borders**, **Legendary Tooltips**, **Visual Workbench**, **Pick Up Notifier**, **Searchables**, **Chat Heads**, **ChatAnimation**, **Just Zoom**, **Controlify**, and **BetterF3** keep information accessible while preserving a mostly‑vanilla feel.

- 🎧 **Polished visuals, audio, and UI** – **Iris** (shader support) plus **AmbientSounds**, **EnhancedVisuals**, **Immersive Thunder**, **Sound Physics Remastered**, **Blur+**, **ImmersiveUI**, **SpiffyHUD**, **Tiny Item Animations**, **WaveyCapes**, **Entity Texture/Model Features**, **NotEnoughAnimations**, **FirstPerson**, **oωo** and others create a **modern, cohesive presentation** without straying into ultra‑fantasy aesthetics.

- 🚀 **Performance‑first modpack** – **Sodium**, **Sodium Extra/Extras**, **Sodium Dynamic Lights**, **Lithium**, **Distant Horizons**, **ImmediatelyFast**, **ModernFix**, **FerriteCore**, **CreateBetterFps**, **Saturn**, **Dynamic FPS**, **ThreatenGL**, **EntityCulling**, **GPUTape** and supporting libraries are tuned to keep large bases, trains, and big views playable on a wide range of hardware.
  Support mods like **Crash Assistant**, **Modpack Update Checker**, **Global Packs**, **Load Support**, and **Euphoria Patcher** improve **stability and long‑term maintenance**.

***

## What kind of experience?

- Long‑term: Designed for **persistent worlds** (SMP or solo) where you slowly build out infrastructure over weeks or months.
- Grounded: Focuses on **engineering, logistics, and realistic terrain**, not magic progression or quest lines.
- Social: Out‑of‑the‑box support for **voice chat, co‑op survival, and shared projects** on the mullv.studio network or your own servers.

***

## Technical

```
Loader: NeoForge
Minecraft: 1.21.1
Purpose: Official mullv.studio modpack for custom 1:1 terrain servers
Recommended: 6–8 GB RAM allocated (more for heavy bases), SSD strongly recommended
Multiplayer: Built for use on official MullV servers, but works for self‑hosted worlds as well
```

title: Pixelmon Ranger Gigaremo
description:
A mod adding Gigaremo units to the Pixelmon Reforged mod.
Also adds custom field moves, NPCs, equipment, and an economic system.
body:
**For MC 1.21.1, NeoForge**

Having a passion for the Ranger series of games, I've created a side mod for the Pixelmon Reforged mod.

This mod adds Gigaremo units to the game, a custom Flood Move Skill, multiple new NPC Presets, multiple new armours, and an entire new economic system for your reputation with the Rangers.

When activated, Gigaremo units run a silent command that detects any Pixelmon entering within a 24 block radius, and sets them to have maximum aggression. This means that any Pixelmon that have been in range of a Gigaremo's effect will actively hunt down survival mode players to engage in combat. Config settings are also available to change the effect range to as small as 10 blocks, or as large as 60, and Pixelmon can also be set to emit particles when affected (off by default)

Gigaremo units come in four different colours, and can all be crafted with their corresponding Concrete and Elemental Evolution Stone.

When placed by players, the Gigaremo will be in an inactive state. Gigaremo can be activated by using Black Tumblestone on them, and when activated will feature an animated model.

Before they are activated, Gigaremo can be broken with a pickaxe to drop themselves. However, once activated, Gigaremo will no longer drop themselves and will instead drop a Broken Gigaremo when broken with a pickaxe. Additionally, Activated Gigaremo take a long time to break with a pickaxe, as the intention is that they be broken by Move Skills (which break them instantly).

- Blue Gigaremo can be broken using the Lightning Bolt Move Skill.
- Green Gigaremo can be broken by the Ignite Move Skill.
- Yellow Gigaremo can be broken by the Rock Smash Move Skill.
- Red Gigaremo can be broken by the Flood Move Skill, introduced in this mod.

The Flood Move Skill is usable by any Pixelmon knowing any appropriate water attack (hydro pump, water gun, water sport, etc). This move creates a water source block at the target location, and can waterlog blocks and fill cauldrons. In the Nether, this move skill produces unique results.

Players will gain (or lose!) reputation with the Ranger Union based on actions interacting with this mod, tracked through Ranger Points. Activating Gigaremo hurts a players reputation, while destroying them, fighting DimSun members, and calming enraged Pixelmon will help their reputation. The Ranger Union has quartermaster NPC's that will supply players with items based on their reputation - players with better reputations will have access to more items, while players with particularly bad reputations will be seen as criminals themselves.

Players can trade Ranger Points for new custom armours, the best of which even have special inherent effects.

NPCs spawn in relevant structures - Rangers will spawn in Ranger Stations found in Plains Villages, while villain teams have their own structures in the wilderness (needs to be enabled in config).

This mod requires the Pixelmon Reforged mod for full functionality, however if you do not have Pixelmon this mod will still load (although commands, NPCs, some structure elements, block state changes, and the custom Move Skill will not work).

**Known Issues**

- Destruction of Gigaremo through methods other than Move Skills award points to the nearest player, not necessarily the player who caused the destruction.
- The icon for the Flood move skill is a placeholder.
- NPC battle teams and rewards aren't necessarily properly balanced.
- All container loot tables are placeholders.
- The new plains village road piece doesn't convert to oak planks in water.
- I know the models are a little ugly, I am focusing on functionality.


**Future Plans**

- More World Gen!

title: Vermilion
description: A vanilla+ mod adding Warhammers, Daggers, Mini-Bosses, Ruby Ore, Swamp/snow additions, Illusioners, Sieves and more.
body:
![Night](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9413f979bb01ec5ce40d55d6c1a35e5a339e6401.png)
# Overview
Vermilion is a vanilla-friendly mod that adds Warhammers, Daggers, new mini bosses in the swamp and snow, Rubies with armor and tools, a jigsaw structure underground, New crops and mob variants.

# Features

## Daggers
![Dagger Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1d5c31a80ee7e805b554c9ef26d86bef75b1bde.png)

Daggers come in all material tiers and are a fast but weak weapon, with sneaking giving bonus damage.
### Dagger Dash
![Dashing with a Dagger](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6555da2de8f5517c3853c1be417ed6420618ad2d.png)
When right clicking, the dagger can dash the player forward in the direction they are facing, however it takes up a lot of durability. The dash strength does not change with dagger tier. Zombies and its variants can also spawn with iron daggers and can use its dash to get to the player.
### Enchantments
![All Dagger Enchantments](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2f3da4e09bf507c752c441ba828c7483256ace3.png)

The dagger has 2 enchantments, the first being Fleet which has 3 levels and increases the strength of the dash, however it can only be gotten in structure chests. The second is Sneak Strike which also has 3 levels and increases the damage of the sneak attack.

## Ruby
![Mining Ruby in a Cave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ade046788b1e9270a75868ee73eec81a97bc4c90.png)
Ruby Ore can be found uncommonly in any biome starting from Y25 but it does have increased spawn rates in deserts. It can also spawn in basalt deltas.

### Ruby Gear Upgrading
![Upgrading Iron armor to Ruby Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/192aa4aba4399e25409270c689760b158b825728.png)
To obtain Ruby armor/tools you must find a Ruby Smithing Template located in a few select structures. You can then apply the template alongside a ruby to any iron equipment and get the resulting ruby equivalent.

### Ruby Armor and Tools
![Wearing a full set of Ruby armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/782f6297d62596b873d0e46b6820b5ecfb198557.png)
Ruby is in between iron and diamond alongside having higher enchantability. When wearing a full set of ruby armor the player can occasionally get instant health, and the effects of the ruby jewel and ruby lamp are amplified as well. However when the ruby armor grants health it uses hunger. All skeleton and zombie variants (including wither skeletons) can spawn with ruby armor and tools.
### Ruby Item Gallery
![A gallery of all ruby items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e78a67c133da7585fb03ecf6c966a68a576cefa.png)
All current ruby items.

## Yew Tree and Woodset
![Image of a Yew house in a plains](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/76f41bbdc0f2b5d84d9daf71753e828ad2ed4f9b.png)
Yew trees can be found in a few humid biomes, and behave similar to other woodsets.
## Structures

### Snow Labyrinth
![Inside a Snow Labyrinth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc1e4f189d6adf92ca1f35bcc37a40e343dd6707.png)
Cartographers can now sell new explorer maps one of which leads here. The snow labyrinth is a large underground structure comprised of hallways and rooms, some of which with mobs, others with puzzles. With it being randomized.

### Swamp Villa
![Looking at a Swamp Villa in a swamp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef4fd20c9105c57098bfcec20375dc82903c8607.png)
The Swamp Villa too has an explorer map and is found in either normal or mangrove swamps. On the bottom floor are witches, alongside a few chests. But these aren't the main reason you'd come here.
![Inside a Swamp Villa](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/176321662879d3c9cf1d958802e4d6fa9ab16ea2.png)

### Woodland Estate
![Looking up at a Woodland Estate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d5514baf48a5346c359c74d1a8e336b53ab30b3.png)
The Woodland estate is a large spruce structure similar to woodland mansions found in mega taigas, inside are vindicators alongside randomized rooms. On the top floor, the illusioner can spawn, with it having a new drop.

## Mini-Bosses

### The Thawed
![Fighting a Thawed in a snow biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f12e8d29d3f2f0d18c6ecc0ad1dea115bcbe195.png)
The Thawed can be summoned similarly to how iron golems/the wither are summoned and it has a rage system, the higher the rage the stronger attacks it will use. Things like attacking it, touching it, it missing its projectiles ect will increase its Rage. Once killed it will drop the Frost Shard.

### The Plague Witch
![Fighting a Plague Witch on the top floor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ab7d339223a489d3b87ee4662fb22721db1c7d1.png)
The plague witch spawns on the top floor in the swamp villa, once it sees the player it will start throwing potions, the lower the plague witches health gets the stronger potions it will throw. It also will spawn mobs such as witches, zombies, skeletons, silverfish and spiders. Once killed it will drop the heart of the swamp.

## Boss Rewards

### Warhammer
![Hitting a mob with a Warhammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cca499435657578622f70c11736169d954fd4087.png)
The Warhammer is crafted with a frost shard and 2 coffer, it deals aoe damage when the player crits a mob to all enemies around the critted mob.

**Enchantments**

![All Enchantments for the Warhammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03384bc3f5f38a2a1d8e93e02a115cbc6a73e971.png)

The Warhammer has 2 main enchantments. The first being Rampage, this has 3 levels and will increase the damage of the Warhammer aoe for each consecutive correctly timed hit and this has no cap. The second is Shackle, this also has 3 levels and will give slowness to all entities in the aoe radius.

### Famine Totem
![A Famine Totem Growing Crops](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12c4ea4459be054df3c8d53785e37bb5f0b1034f.png)
The Famine Totem is crafted with the heart of the swamp and on its own it wont do anything, but if powered by emerald or ruby it will grow crops adjacent to it over time. 

## Utilities
### Pouches
![A display of pouches](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6afce9876761d6b5b9576f395584b25ebd976d8d.png)
Pouches are small portable storage. Regular Pouches have 5 slots and Bejewelled Pouches have 12. All 3 can also be dyed.

### Soul Hook
![Using Soul Hook](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8bf14933c581980c96e40043032c5a5184cf1e75.png)
The Soul Hook is a weapon that when right-clicked will pull any nearby mobs to the player.

## Miscellaneous Additions

### Frostbit
![A Frostbit at Night](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b064c4783aba683a29253e6ad997c9b76a46af4.png)
The Frostbit is a zombie variant that spawns in cold biomes similar to strays upon being hit by it the player gets inflicted with weakness. When a zombie is in powder snow it converts to a Frostbit

## Mushroom Fields Changes
![An Updated Mushroom Fields](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2229236f0018f6c0c6f35ac04cd25bd198b2660e.png)
Mycelium Sprouts can be found on the ground alongside tall brown and red mushrooms.

## Small Additions
- Algae and Cattails in swamps
- Tallow dropped from pigs when killed
- Water Sieve block
- Small additions to the swamp biome
- Candy item
- Creepshroom Mob
- Dynamite/New Explosives
- Witches Hat Item
- New Potions
- Item Stand Block

title: ExtraGreetings
description: A feature-rich greeting plugin for Minecraft servers with customizable particles, titles, subtitles, action bars, boss bars, chat messages, and more.
body:
# 🎉 ExtraGreetings

A feature-rich greeting plugin for Minecraft servers with **Folia support**, **Adventure API**, **MiniMessage**, and optimized for **Minecraft 1.20.1+**.

## ✨ Features

- **🎭 Customizable Join Greetings** - Welcome players with titles, subtitles, action bars, boss bars, particles, sounds, and chat messages
- **🎪 First-Time Join Detection** - Different greetings for new players vs returning players
- **👑 VIP Support** - Special greetings for VIP players with permissions (now includes quit messages!)
- **🚪 Permission-Based Quit Messages** - VIP and regular quit messages with different effects
- **⚡ Folia Compatibility** - Full support for Folia's scheduler
- **🎨 MiniMessage Support** - Rich text formatting with gradients, colors, and effects
- **🔧 PlaceholderAPI Integration** - Support for custom placeholders
- **⏰ Cooldown System** - Prevent spam with configurable cooldowns
- **🎯 Command Execution** - Run commands on join/quit events
- **📊 Built-in Statistics** - Track player joins and active features
- **🔄 Live Reload** - Reload configuration without restarting
- **🛠️ Config Updater** - Automatic configuration updates with backup system
- **🧪 Enhanced Test Command** - Actually test greetings instead of just logging

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft 1.20.1+**
- **Folia** or **Paper** server
- **Java 17+**
- **Optional**: PlaceholderAPI for additional placeholders

## ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin generates a default configuration file at `plugins/ExtraGreetings/config.yml`. Here's an example:

```yaml
# ExtraGreetings Configuration
settings:
  enableJoin: true
  enableQuit: true
  cooldownSeconds: 60
  debug: false
  joinDelay: 1

join:
  firstTime:
    title: "<gradient:#FF55FF:#55FFFF>Welcome</gradient>"
    subtitle: "<italic>%player% has joined for the first time!</italic>"
    actionbar: "<rainbow>Enjoy your stay!</rainbow>"
    bossbar:
      enable: true
      text: "Welcome, %player%!"
      color: BLUE
      style: SOLID
      duration: 10
    particles:
      enable: true
      effect: "HEART"
      count: 50
      offset: {x: 0.5, y: 1.0, z: 0.5}
      speed: 0.1
    sound:
      enable: true
      effect: "ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP"
      volume: 1.0
      pitch: 1.0
    message: "<bold><gold>[+]</bold> <white>%player%</white> joined for the first time!"
    commands:
      - "give %player% diamond 1"
      - "broadcast &aWelcome new player %player%!"

  recurring:
    title: "<yellow>Welcome back!</yellow>"
    subtitle: "<gray>Enjoy your stay!</gray>"
    message: "<gray>[+]</gray> <white>%player%</white> returned!"

  vip:
    enable: true
    title: "<gradient:#FFD700:#FFA500>VIP</gradient> <gold>Welcome!</gold>"
    subtitle: "<yellow>%player% the VIP has joined!</yellow>"
    # ... more VIP settings

quit:
  # VIP quit greeting (for players with extragreetings.vip permission)
  vip:
    message: "<bold><gold>[VIP]</gold></bold> <yellow>%player%</yellow> has left the server!"
    particles:
      enable: true
      effect: "DRAGON_BREATH"
      count: 30
      offset: {x: 0.5, y: 1.0, z: 0.5}
      speed: 0.15
    sound:
      enable: true
      effect: "ENTITY_ENDER_DRAGON_FLAP"
      volume: 1.0
      pitch: 1.2
    commands:
      - "say VIP %player% has left the server!"
  
  # Regular quit greeting
  regular:
    message: "<gray>[-]</gray> <white>%player%</white> left the server."
    particles:
      enable: true
      effect: "SMOKE_NORMAL"
      count: 20
      offset: {x: 0.0, y: 0.5, z: 0.0}
      speed: 0.1
    sound:
      enable: true
      effect: "ENTITY_HORSE_SADDLE"
      volume: 0.8
      pitch: 1.0
    commands: []
```

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/extragreetings` | Show help menu | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings reload` | Reload configuration | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings info` | Show plugin information | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings stats` | Show plugin statistics | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings debug [on/off]` | Toggle debug mode | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings reset [data/cooldowns]` | Reset plugin data | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings test [join/quit]` | Test greetings (actually triggers them!) | `extragreetings.admin` |
| `/extragreetings update` | Update configuration to latest version | `extragreetings.admin` |

**Aliases**: `/eg`

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `extragreetings.admin` | Access to admin commands | `op` |
| `extragreetings.vip` | Receive VIP greetings (join AND quit) | `false` |
| `extragreetings.bypass.cooldown` | Bypass greeting cooldown | `op` |

## 🛠️ Configuration Updater

### ✨ Features:
- **Automatic Updates**: Updates configuration on plugin startup
- **Comment Preservation**: Maintains all your configuration comments
- **Backup System**: Creates timestamped backups before changes
- **Manual Updates**: Use `/extragreetings update` to force updates
- **Validation**: Checks for invalid sound/particle effects

### 📁 Backup Location:
Backups are stored in `/plugins/ExtraGreetings/backups/config.yml.timestamp.bak`

### 🔄 How It Works:
1. **Startup**: Plugin automatically checks for missing config options
2. **Updates**: Adds new options with default values
3. **Cleanup**: Removes obsolete configuration options
4. **Preservation**: Keeps all your custom settings and comments

### 📝 Console Messages:
```
[ExtraGreetings] Added missing config option: quit.vip.message
[ExtraGreetings] Configuration updated successfully!
[ExtraGreetings] Config backed up to: config.yml.1234567890.bak
```

## 🎨 MiniMessage Formatting

ExtraGreetings supports full MiniMessage formatting:

```yaml
title: "<gradient:#FF55FF:#55FFFF>Welcome</gradient>"
subtitle: "<italic><yellow>%player%</yellow> has joined!</italic>"
actionbar: "<rainbow>Enjoy your stay!</rainbow>"
message: "<bold><gold>[+]</gold></bold> <white>%player%</white> joined!"
```

**Available Tags:**
- `<bold>`, `<italic>`, `<underlined>`, `<strikethrough>`
- `<color:#hex>`, `<red>`, `<green>`, `<blue>`, etc.
- `<gradient:#start:#end>`, `<rainbow>`
- `<click:run_command:/command>`, `<hover:show_text:text>`

## 🏷️ Placeholders

### Built-in Placeholders
- `%player%` - Player name
- `%player_displayname%` - Player display name
- `%player_uuid%` - Player UUID
- `%online_players%` - Online player count
- `%max_players%` - Maximum players
- `%server_name%` - Server name
- `%current_time%` - Current time
- `%server_uptime%` - Server uptime
- `%plugin_version%` - Plugin version

### PlaceholderAPI Support
When PlaceholderAPI is installed, you can use any available placeholder:
- `%player_level%` - Player level
- `%vault_eco_balance%` - Player balance
- `%luckperms_prefix%` - Player prefix
- And many more!

## 🎆 Particle Effects

Supported particle effects include:
- `HEART`, `VILLAGER_HAPPY`, `FLAME`, `SMOKE_NORMAL`
- `EXPLOSION_LARGE`, `FIREWORKS_SPARK`, `ENCHANTMENT_TABLE`
- `SNOWFLAKE`, `WATER_BUBBLE`, `REDSTONE`
- **NEW**: `DRAGON_BREATH` (used in VIP quit greetings)
- And all other Bukkit particle types

## 🔊 Sound Effects

Supported sound effects include:
- `ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP`, `ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP`
- `ENTITY_ENDER_DRAGON_GROWL`, `ENTITY_HORSE_SADDLE`
- `BLOCK_ANVIL_USE`, `ENTITY_FIREWORK_ROCKET_LAUNCH`
- **NEW**: `ENTITY_ENDER_DRAGON_FLAP` (used in VIP quit greetings)
- And all other Bukkit sound types

## 🎯 Boss Bar Configuration

```yaml
bossbar:
  enable: true
  text: "Welcome, %player%!"
  color: BLUE    # BLUE, RED, GREEN, YELLOW, PURPLE, PINK, WHITE
  style: SOLID   # SOLID, SEGMENTED_6, SEGMENTED_10, SEGMENTED_12, SEGMENTED_20
  duration: 10   # Duration in seconds
```

## 🔧 Advanced Configuration

### Custom Commands
Execute commands when players join or quit:
```yaml
commands:
  - "give %player% diamond 1"
  - "broadcast &aWelcome %player%!"
  - "tp %player% spawn"
```

### VIP Configuration
Special greetings for VIP players (both join AND quit):
```yaml
vip:
  enable: true
  title: "<gradient:#FFD700:#FFA500>VIP</gradient> <gold>Welcome!</gold>"
  # Players need extragreetings.vip permission
```

### Permission-Based Quit Messages
Different quit messages based on permissions:
- **VIP Players** (`extragreetings.vip`): Special quit effects with dragon particles
- **Regular Players**: Standard quit messages

### Cooldown System
Prevent greeting spam:
```yaml
settings:
  cooldownSeconds: 60  # Cooldown in seconds
  joinDelay: 1         # Delay before showing greeting
```

## 📊 Statistics

Use `/extragreetings stats` to view:
- Total players who have joined
- Active cooldowns
- Active boss bars
- Plugin status

## 🧪 Testing System

### Usage:
- `/extragreetings test join` - Tests join greetings (shows actual effects!)
- `/extragreetings test quit` - Tests quit greetings (shows actual effects!)

### Features:
- **Actual Triggering**: Shows real greetings instead of just logging
- **Permission Detection**: Automatically detects VIP status
- **Feedback**: Shows which type of greeting is being triggered
- **Error Handling**: Provides clear error messages if something fails

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

1. **Greetings not showing**: Check if join/quit events are enabled in config
2. **Particles not spawning**: Verify particle effect names are correct
3. **Sounds not playing**: Check sound effect names and volume settings
4. **PlaceholderAPI not working**: Make sure PlaceholderAPI is installed and loaded
5. **Config not updating**: Use `/extragreetings update` to manually update

### Debug Mode

Enable debug mode to see detailed logging:
```yaml
settings:
  debug: true
```

Or use the command: `/extragreetings debug on`

## 🔄 Migration

### From Other Greeting Plugins

1. **Stop your server**
2. **Remove the old plugin** and its data files
3. **Install ExtraGreetings**
4. **Configure** the new plugin using this guide
5. **Start your server**

## 🤝 Support

- **Discord**: [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/WPYVPGbKZc)

title: Deodorant Mod
description: Adds a fun new deodorant item that has cool effects.
body:
# Deodorant Mod (for Fabric)

![GitHub license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/ILikeFood971/Deodorant-Mod)
![GitHub issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/ILikeFood971/Deodorant-Mod)
![GitHub tag](https://img.shields.io/github/tag/ILikeFood971/Deodorant-Mod.svg)

The Deodorant Mod is a free and open source mod that adds a new deodorant item
and changes the behavior of mobs depending on whether you have applied deodorant.

⚠️ If you run into any bugs please file an issue in the GitHub repo.

## What is it

The Deodorant mod adds a new deodorant item to the game. In the current release it is only
obtainable through the creative inventory or commands. You will become "stinky" if you
either sleep in a bed, or if it is a new day. Each player will need to use the
deodorant item at the beginning of every day or when they get out of a bed or else there
will be effects given to them.

### When stinky

All entities will have the same movement behavior as when you attack them. They will run around
in panic. This will not override other behavior unless it usually would. For example if you attack
a pig, it will start running around in panic for 5 seconds, but if you attack a zombie it will
continue to walk towards you. This behavior will still be the same except the stinkiness will not
apply any actual damage to the pig.

All neutral entities will get angry at the player. For example, endermen will attack the player until
the player applies deodorant or dies.

## Installation

You will need the fabric loader installed to load the mod. If you need help installing the mod, check out [this](https://fabricmc.net/wiki/install) link.

You can download the latest release from either [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/deodorant-mod) or from [GitHub releases](https://github.com/ILikeFood971/Deodorant-Mod/releases). I will likely update
this mod as new version of Minecraft come out and include new features, but understand that I am free to
change my mind at any later date.

I meaaaaaaaaaaaaan.. you *can* but please don't bother me if your modpack takes too long to load. I warned you.

title: simple mob stacking
description: a simple mob stacking plugin with a simple config
body:
# mob-stacking

stacks newly spawned mobs in a radius "distance" to one singular mob, when you kill one of the stacked mobs it spawns itself again but with one less mob 

## config example
### for 1.0.0-1.0.7
config file needs to be called mob-stacking.json

```
{
    "distance":30,
    "mobs": ["minecraft:creeper"]
}
```
### for 1.0.8+
```
{
    "killall":true,
    "distance":{"x":10, "y":5, "z":10},
    "mobs": ["minecraft:creeper"]
}
```

## distance

distance takes a x, y and z so if i want them to stack in a 10x10x10 i would put 10, 10, 10 very straight forward

## mobs

title: [TFB] Anthro Origins
description: Anthro themed Origins add-on
body:
# THE FERRET BUSINESS PRESENTS

## AN ANTHRO ADDON FOR ORIGINS (FABRIC) 1.17.1 and 1.18.1

### REQUIRES ORIGINS AND PEHKUI

(See Notes Below)

 

**OVERVIEW**

This add-on adds over 20 Origins themed around Anthros / Furries. They range in difficulty from Impact 1 (Easy to play, detriments are minor) to Impact 3 (Quite difficult, big benefits but big detriments as well!)

 

Almost all Anthro origins are sized differently than the base Steve. Smaller Anthros have less health, less attack power, and run a bit slower, but they can fall greater distances and fit into smaller spaces (Such as mice fitting through slab high gaps), while larger Anthros run a bit faster, and have more health and attack power, but they take more damage from falls and have harder times fitting in areas.

 

Every Anthro has an Active Ability as well, which can range from simple Speed Boosts to Slow Flying to charging Leaps. They also have a variety of good, bad, and balanced boons. For example, Maned Wolves work slower around other players, but they run faster as well due to their anxious nature. Wolves who are alone have a bit of bad luck, but when with other players or wolves, they fight better. 

 

Each Anthro also has a diet that leans towards their real life counterparts : wolves eat primarily meat, rabbits eat primarily plants, and coyotes can eat both. Eating outside of your diet won't kill you, but it won't really fill you either!

 

**IMPORTANT NOTES**

For the best experience, I suggest changing the following settings for Pehkui, in /config/pehkui/config.json : 

 

"scaledReach": false

"scaledItemDrops": false

 

When you get below 1 block size, the Reach scale gets extremely short, to the point where Zombies and other creatures will hit you WELL before you can even hit them. Which, while making sense, is not fun 

 

Item Drops is your item pickup radius. Again, getting below one block in size makes this scale extremely short. Not as much of a problem as the hit range, though.

 

**FOR MODPACK MAKERS**

 There are a few custom tags included, for sorting out food into the different categories. I've sorted the Minecraft vanilla food already, but you'll have to use KubeJS or a datapack to add other modded foods to these tags. 

 

The tags are as follows : 

- origins:meat (built into origins already)
- origins:non_meat (vegetables, fruits, nuts, etc)
- origins:mixed_food (food that has a combination of meat and non_meat. Also where I've been putting stuff with eggs)
- origins:food_with_apples (All apple varieties and foods that has an apple in the ingredients)
- origins:food_with_chicken (Same as above, but with chicken)
- origins:food_with_berries (Same as above, but with berries. This includes raspberries, strawberries, etc)
- origins:food_with_fish (Same as above. Sushi goes here)
- origins:food_with_fruitnut (for Frugivores, any foods that primarily contain fruit or nuts)

 

FOR AN EXAMPLE KUBEJS SERVER SCRIPT, CHECK THE GITHUB IN THE ISSUES LINK ABOVE

 

**PLANNED UPDATES**

- Many more species!
- Rebalancing of some powers/boons
- Datapack version
- Custom icons (possibly)
- Forge version (possibly)

 

**LESS LIKELY UPDATES**

Fabric versions 1.16.5 and earlier : 1.17 was a big update for Origins and changed/updated a bunch of functions and abilities I have implemented currently. Going back to a 1.16.5 version means I have to figure out how older version did a lot of these things, which I don't have the time/energy for currently

 

Forge versions : Making an origins addon for Forge seems to be a bit more involved than Fabric and its 'just put the fabric text file and data files into a jar, with proper versioning and dependencies and its good". This is another time/energy thing. Datapacks will probably be the 'middle ground' here.

title: ImageFrame Fabric Port
description: High-performance, server-side Fabric port of ImageFrame. Place HD images & animated GIFs on maps and walls with zero client-side mods required!
body:
# ImageFrame (Fabric Port)

A high-performance, server-side-only Fabric port of the popular Spigot plugin **[ImageFrame by LoohpJames](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/106031/)**. Put images and animated GIFs on maps and walls!

This port has been modernized and optimized for Minecraft 1.21+ (Fabric) while retaining 100% data compatibility with Spigot maps.

---

## Important Disclaimer & Maintenance

*   **Support & Maintenance:** This port was created for a private server with friends. As such, **do not expect regular updates, active maintenance, or guaranteed bugfixes**.
*   **Future Updates:** While support is not guaranteed, critical bugs or compatibility updates might be released if they are needed for our personal server.
*   **Original Creator Invitation:** If the original author (**LoohpJames**) wishes to adapt, use, or merge any part of this Fabric port code into the official project, they are warmly welcomed and encouraged to do so!
*   **Fabric Port Developer:** Developed and optimized for Fabric by **[reyhe66243](https://github.com/reyhe66243)**.
*   **Credits:** Huge credits to [LoohpJames](https://github.com/LOOHP) for the original Spigot plugin design, asset loaders, and architecture.

---
![GIF Placement](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5934bedbc2ce8d3b38460b3f9476c76d5910f034.gif)

## Features & Optimizations

This Fabric port is designed to be **incredibly lightweight** and **server-safe**, running entirely on the server-side with no client-side mods required:

1.  **Dynamic Map Color Engine:**
    *   Uses a pixel-perfect Mojang NMS color matching system to map image RGB colors to Minecraft's built-in map colors dynamically.
    *   No hardcoded palette files or inaccurate colors. Parity is absolute.
2.  **Network Visibility Cache:**
    *   Optimized for large multiplayer servers! Maps and animation frames are only sent to players holding a map or standing within 32 blocks of an active map frame.
    *   This eliminates network packet overhead, dramatically reduces bandwidth usage, and prevents clients from lagging due to off-screen animation updates.
3.  **Invisible Item Frames:**
    *   Supports placing maps on invisible frames.
    *   Integrates seamlessly with splash potions of invisibility or area effect clouds containing invisibility. Throwing them on item frames turns them invisible, while breaking or modifying them updates the state correctly.
4.  **No Client-Side Mod Required:**
    *   Works entirely server-side! Vanilla clients can connect and enjoy the custom map paintings.

![IMAGE Placement](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/818a94bbe653ab3aa18a07730c7753f0ddb1a942.gif)

---

## 📄 License & Original Work

This project is a derivative work of **ImageFrame** by LoohpJames. In compliance with the original project's license, this port is licensed under the **GNU General Public License v3 (GPLv3)**.

*   You are free to use, modify, and redistribute this software.
*   Any derivative works must also be open-source under the GPLv3 license.

description: A lightweight Forge client mod for toggle sneak, auto-sprint, HUD status display, and configurable movement options.
body:
ToggleSneak is a lightweight Forge client mod that adds toggle sneak and auto-sprint behavior for Minecraft.

Features:
- Toggle Sneak support
- Auto Sprint support
- Minimal HUD display for Sneak/Sprint status
- Forge Mods menu config screen
- Option to hide the HUD
- Option for the Sprint key to untoggle Sneak
- Optional creative-mode fly boost
- Configurable HUD position and display style

Default Controls:
- G: Sneak function enable/disable
- V: Sprint function enable/disable

Once the Sneak function is enabled, press your normal Sneak key to toggle sneaking on or off.

Once the Sprint function is enabled, sprinting is automatically engaged while moving forward.

Controls can be changed in Minecraft’s Controls menu under the ToggleSneak / Toggle Sneak&Sprint category. Settings can be changed from the Forge Mods menu config screen.

title: SCP-131, The Eye Pods
description: Cute little eye pods that will stare at you
body:
The Eye Pods adds a new creature. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-131 also known as Eye Pods. 


These small, friendly creatures can spawn in groups, and are not hostile. There are four different color variants of SCP-131, but they share one common trait, their large, watchful eyes. Though SCP-131 is non-aggressive, it can be picked up and carried. They will watch the player with their large eyes, which could give you a sense of being constantly observed. 

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-131 spawn?

SCP-131 can spawn mostly in groups anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-131.

► Does SCP-131 Mod work with SCP-173 Mod?

Yes! Since version 1.2 the SCP-131 mod works with the SCP-173 mod.

</details>



![SCP-131](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9839f7cb666200562709e798722d13d9bdab3bc8.png)

SCP-131 are small, drop-shaped creatures with a large eye. They are friendly and come in red, yellow, green, and blue. SCP-131 often spawn in groups, and they enjoy watching players and running around. They are quick and will flee if attacked. You can pick them up and place them again. A special benefit of SCP-131 is that SCP-173 within a 10-block radius will freeze, unable to move or attack. However, SCP-131 will also be immobile in this state.

 

- Config File not inculed.
- You are all allowed to use this mod in your modpacks!
- Do not port my mods without permission!

title: Water World
description: A data pack version of the classic Survival Island adventure map genre.
body:
## __SUMMARY__ **A data pack version of the classic Survival Island adventure map genre.** You spawn on a small bamboo jungle island in a world of only oceans. Rather than a small custom-made area that you cannot exit, this pack changes world generation to only include ocean and cave biomes. The Nether also recieves a similar treatment, consisting of lava ocean and small islands. Some otherwise unobtainable items can be found around the world. ## __CHANGES__ * World Generation is limited to Ocean and Cave biomes, besides a Bamboo Jungle island at spawn * The Nether generates as an infinite lava ocean with small islands throughout * Saplings are distributed as loot across many structures * Otherwise unobtainable items can be found in chests, suspicious blocks, and trial vaults * Sniffers dig up flowers that are unobtainable in an Ocean world * Wandering Traders sell various animals * Husks spawn in Warm Oceans and drop Sand (or Red Sand when killed by fire) * Trail Ruins generate in Deep Oceans and Deep Cold Oceans * Sugar Cane and other plant blocks can be fished as junk * Buried Treasure does not generate * Removed Herobrine ### __World Generation__ * Only the following biomes can generate: * Deep Frozen Ocean * Frozen Ocean * Deep Cold Ocean * Cold Ocean * Deep Ocean * Ocean * Deep Lukewarm Ocean * Lukewarm Ocean * Warm Ocean * Lush Cave * Dripstone Cave * No longer needs tall land biomes above to generate * Deep Dark

* A single Bamboo Jungle island is at the World Spawn. This is the only generated island of its kind on the map. * Nether terrain generation is limited to small islands on an infinite lava ocean. Structures spawn as normal. * Trail Ruins can be found in Deep Oceans and Deep Cold Oceans poking out of the sea floor. * Buried Treasure does not spawn. As such, Buried Treasure Maps can not be found in Shipwrecks or Ocean Ruins. * Minimum distance between Ocean Monuments is increased. ### __Loot__ * Wandering Traders are completely overhauled. They now sell 'animal vouchers'. When purchased, the associated animal will pop out of the ground. - __Common (3 per trader)__ * Chicken * Cow * Pig * Sheep - __Uncommon (2 per trader)__ * Armadillo * Donkey * Goat * Horse * Rabbit - __Rare (2 per trader)__ * Allay * Camel * Fox * Mooshroom * Wolf * Saplings can be found as loot in a variety of structures: - __Common__ * Oak - Mineshaft & Dungeon Chests * Birch - Mineshaft & Dungeon Chests * Spruce - Mineshaft & Dungeon Chests - __Uncommon__ * Jungle - Warm Ocean Ruins (Suspicious Sand) * Acacia - Warm Ocean Ruins (Suspicious Sand) * Dark Oak - Cold Ocean Ruins (Suspicious Gravel) - __Rare__ * Pale Oak - Trial Chamber Vaults * Mangrove - Stronghold Chests * Cherry - Ancient City Chests

* More plant blocks, including Sugar Cane, Firefly Bushes, and Dry Grass can be fished as junk. * Nautilus Armor is found in Dungeon chests rather than Horse Armor. * Other unobtainable items such as Pottery Sherds, Goat Horns, and Hearts of the Sea are found in a variety of structures. The full list of loot table modifications can be found at the bottom of this page. ### __Sniffers__ * Sniffers dig up the following flowers, which otherwise cannot be found in the world: * Allium * Blue Orchid * Lily of the Valley * Orange Tulip * Pink Tulip * Red Tulip * White Tulip * Lilac * Peony * Rose Bush * Sunflower * *(Note: Poppies, Dandelions, Cornflowers, Oxeye Daisies, and Azure Bluet are not included as they can be grown in Dripstone Caves and Deep Dark biomes)* ### __Frogs & Turtles__ * While Frogs and Turtles do not spawn naturally, Turtle Eggs and Frogspawn can be found in the world: * Turtle Eggs - Warm Ocean Ruins (Suspicious Sand) * Frogspawn - Cold Ocean Ruins (Suspicious Gravel) ### __More Underwater Music__ * A separate resource pack that adds remixes of Minecraft's soundtrack that only play underwater. * Download at [More Underwater Music](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/more-underwater-music).
LOOT TABLES ## LOOT TABLE CHANGES ### Fishing - Added: * Sugar Cane * Short Dry Grass * Fern * Firefly Bush * Wildflowers * Pink Petals * *(Note: These items are fished when the player rolls a “junk” pull)* ### Shipwrecks - Removed: * Buried Treasure Map - Added: * Lily Pad * Dead Bush * Cactus * Arms Up Pottery Sherd ### Ocean Monuments - Added: * Heart of the Sea (Elder Guardian) ### Warm Ocean Ruins - Removed: * Buried Treasure Map (Chest) - Added: * Turtle Egg (Sand) * Acacia Sapling (Sand) * Jungle Sapling (Sand) * Cocoa Beans (Sand) ### Cold Ocean Ruins - Removed: * Buried Treasure Map (Chest) - Added: * Frog Spawn (Gravel) * Dark Oak Sapling (Gravel) ### Trail Ruins - Added: * Sweet Berries * Bush ### Mineshaft - Added: * Spruce Sapling * Birch Sapling * Oak Sapling * Miner Pottery Sherd * Prize Pottery Sherd ### Dungeon (Monster Room) - Removed: * All Horse Armor - Added: * Spruce Sapling * Birch Sapling * Oak Sapling * Heart of the Sea * Regular Goat Horn * Skull Pottery Sherd * All Nautilus Armor (excluding Netherite) ### Ruined Portal - Added: * Golden Nautilus Armor ### Trial Chamber - Added: * Archer Pottery Sherd (Chests) * Pale Moss (Chests) * Hanging Moss (Chests) * Closed Eye Blossom (Decorated Pots) ### Trial Vault - Added: * Pale Oak Sapling (3 to 6) * Screaming Goat Horns ### Ominous Vault - Added: * Creaking Heart ### Stronghold - Added: * Mangrove Propagule * Heart of the Sea * Brewer Pottery Sherd ### Ancient City - Added: * Cherry Sapling
HOW TO INSTALL 1. Download 'Water World Pack v1.1.zip' 2. Extract the file 3. In Minecraft, click 'Create New World' 4. Under 'More', click 'Data Packs' 5. Click 'Open Pack Folder' 6. Move 'Water World Pack v1.1' to that folder 7. Back in Minecraft, click the arrow symbol over the pack icon to select it 8. Click 'Done' 9. If Minecraft warns you that you are using Experimental Features, click 'Proceed' 10. You can now configure your world settings 11. When you're ready, click 'Create New World' 12. Your spawn island may generate in an odd location. If that is the case, you may want to try again and create a new world with the data pack.

## ⚔️ ZenoDuels - Clean Duel System

A straightforward duel plugin that actually works well. Challenge players, fight in dedicated arenas, and let the plugin handle the rest.

## 🎮 What it does

Players can challenge each other with `/duel <player> <gamemode>`. The challenged player gets clickable accept/deny buttons in chat. Once accepted, both players teleport to the arena, fight until someone dies, and the winner gets configurable time to collect items before everyone returns to their original spots.

The arena automatically resets after each duel, so you don't have to worry about cleanup.

## ✨ Key features

- 💬 Simple `/duel` command system
- 🖱️ Clickable chat responses (no typing commands)
- 🎯 Custom gamemode support (nodebuff, crystal, sumo, etc.)
- 🔄 Automatic arena restoration
- ⏰ Configurable winner collection time
- 🎨 Fully customizable messages
- ⚙️ Easy admin setup

## 🤔 Why use this?

Most duel plugins are either overcomplicated or missing basic features. This one focuses on doing duels right - clean interface, reliable teleportation, and automatic cleanup. Perfect for PvP servers that want organized 1v1s without the hassle.

Set your arena points, create some gamemodes, and you're done. No complex configuration needed. 🚀

## 🎯 Perfect For

PvP servers, practice servers, tournament hosting, and community servers wanting organized, fair dueling with automatic arena cleanup.

# JJK Silent Achievements

**JJK Silent Achievements** is a simple yet effective mod that completely removes the clutter of achievement pop-ups and chat notifications in Minecraft.

Sometimes you just want to play without the constant "Achievement Get!" interruptions breaking your immersion or spamming the chat. This mod silences those notifications efficiently.

## Features
- **No Toasts**: The pop-up notifications (toasts) for advancements, recipes, and system messages are completely disabled.
- **No Chat Spam**: Achievement announcements are removed from the chat.
- **Plug & Play**: No configuration needed. Just install and enjoy the silence.

## Installation
1. Install Minecraft Forge for 1.20.1.
2. Drop the `jjksilentachievements-1.0.jar` into your `mods` folder.
3. Launch the game!

---

**Downloading the** [Resourcepack](https://www.mediafire.com/file/zofd0m56ww10m5x/AutomagicTextures.zip/file) is required for the best experience.

Everything in this plugin is a work in progress, everything will be changed/polished as we push out updates. Feel free to contact **petepoo** for suggestions/bug reporting

title: Happy Ghast Tiers
description: Are your Happy Ghasts getting you down? Well wipe those tears away with Happy Ghast Tiers! This datapack adds five new tiers of harnesses each providing a small but noticeable speed boost. And as an added bonus we've added Ghast Treats!
body:
TL:DR - [Gallery](./happy-ghast-tiers/gallery)
### Happy Ghast Tiers
Expands Minecraft’s Happy Ghasts with a fully upgradeable harness system, allowing players to give their Happy Ghasts a much-needed speed boost in a way that feels natural to vanilla gameplay.

Harnesses can be upgraded through multiple tiers(~~Vanilla~~Leather, Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite), with each tier providing a small but noticeable increase to flying speed.

Upgrades can be applied sequentially, or players may craft Reinforced Upgrades to skip directly to a desired tier. Players craft the initial harness just like in vanilla. Players can even still dye vanilla harnesses like normal, but once a vanilla harness is upgraded, its color becomes locked to prevent Minecraft from accidentally overriding the custom NBT data of upgraded harnesses. Every future upgrade automatically preserves harness color.

Netherite-tier harnesses & upgrades are fireproof, behaving like vanilla Netherite items when dropped into lava or fire.

-------------------
### **Other features:**
- Happy Ghasts with no rider will be slowed automatically to default speeds
- Happy Ghast Treats can be crafted with snowballs and blaze powder
  - Treats provide a temporary boost just like rockets do for the elytra

-------------------
### **Planned Update:**
- Custom Enchantment granting a 5% flying speed bonus per level (I–III)

_This enchantment is planned for a future release. It has been intentionally delayed while the core Minecraft mechanics remain experimental and subject to refinement. Once added to the base game, I'll be adding a custom enchantment for the harnesses_

-------------------
### **Stretch Goals:**
- Add the ability to dye upgraded tiers from one color to another
- Add an in-game Admin config to toggle if Harnesses are chest loot instead of craftable
- Add an in-game Admin config that allows for custom tier speeds
- Add more variants and 3D model harnesses (a texture pack rework. I'm not an artist)

title: Elytra Disabled
description: Disable Elytra in worlds and configure it however you like.
body:
# Elytra Disabled ![elytra-disabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7907c56a4d21a5dd8f9b597c67351adbc42bcb0d.jpeg) **ElytraDisabled** - A comprehensive solution for controlling elytra usage on your server. The plugin completely disables elytra in specified worlds, providing maximum protection against bypasses. **Features**: - Complete blocking of equipping and flying with elytra - Auto-removal when entering restricted worlds - Advanced anti-bypass protection with tick-by-tick monitoring - Smart cooldown-based notifications to prevent spam - Multi-language support (English, Russian, Ukrainian) - Configurable sound effects for blocked actions - Protection against dispenser armor equip exploits - Optimized performance with efficient cooldown management Perfect for servers that value fair gameplay, stability, and absolute control over elytra mechanics. ElytraDisabled ensures predictable player behavior and eliminates any possibility of unwanted flight exploits. ## Main config
config.yml ``` # =================================================== # ElytraDisabled - Основные настройки / Main Settings # =================================================== settings: # Включить плагин? / Enable plugin? enable_plugin: true # Проверять наличие обновлений плагина при запуске # Check for plugin updates on startup check_updates: true # Язык плагина (ru, en, ua) / Plugin language (ru, en, ua) # ru - русский, en - english, ua - українська language: en # Кулдаун между сообщениями игроку (в миллисекундах) # 3000 = 3 секунды, чтобы не спамить при повторных попытках # Cooldown between messages to player (in milliseconds) # 3000 = 3 seconds, to avoid spam on repeated attempts message_cooldown: 3000 # Список миров, где запрещены элитры # List of worlds where elytra is disabled disable_in_worlds: - world_the_end # Запретить надевание элитр в запрещённых мирах # Если false - игроки смогут носить элитры, но не смогут летать # ВАЖНО: Для работы при false необходимо также установить force_unequip_on_enter: false # # Prevent equipping elytra in disabled worlds # If false - players can wear elytra but cannot glide # IMPORTANT: For this to work when false, you must also set force_unequip_on_enter: false prevent_equip: true # Автоматически снимать элитры при входе в запрещённый мир # Automatically remove elytra when entering disabled world force_unequip_on_enter: true # Останавливать активный полёт на элитрах в запрещённых мирах # Stop active elytra flight in disabled worlds stop_existing_glide: true # Грубый анти-байпас: проверять каждый тик (может нагружать сервер) # true - максимальная защита (проверка каждый тик), false - экономия производительности # Rough anti-bypass: check every tick (may affect server performance) # true - maximum protection (check every tick), false - performance saving check_every_tick: true # Воспроизводить звук при блокировке элитр # Play sound when elytra is blocked play_sound: true # Тип звука (список звуков: https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Sound.html) # Sound type (sound list: https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Sound.html) # Популярные варианты / Popular options: # - ENTITY_VILLAGER_NO # - BLOCK_ANVIL_LAND # - ENTITY_ENDERMAN_TELEPORT # - BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_BASS sound_type: "ENTITY_VILLAGER_NO" permissions: # Игроки с этим пермишеном могут использовать элитры в любых мирах # Players with this permission can use elytra in any worlds bypass: "elytradisabled.bypass" ```
## Other config
en.yml ``` # Message when trying to equip elytra equip_blocked: '&cYou cannot equip elytra in this world!' # Message when trying to glide glide_blocked: '&cElytra flying is disabled in this world!' # Message when elytra is automatically removed removed_on_enter: '&eYour elytra has been removed upon entering this world.' # Messages when reloading plugin reload_success: '&a&l[ElytraDisabled]&r &aConfiguration successfully reloaded!' reload_error: '&c&l[ElytraDisabled]&r &cError reloading configuration!' # Command help message help_reload: '&e/elytra-disabled reload &8- &7Reload configuration' # No permission message no_permission: '&cYou don''t have permission to use this command!' ```

title: Stack 'Em
description: A FoxLoader (ReIndev) mod that adds support for stacked (multiple) texturepacks
body:
# StackEm (Stack 'Em)

A FoxLoader (ReIndev) modification which allows to load and use several texturepacks simultaneously and adds customization features!

This is achieved by replacing a standard `ITexturePack` instance with custom one that handles multiple zip files `I/O` operations. All injections & source code manipulations are done within Mixins.

### Features:
- **Texturepack stacking and ordering:** several texturepacks can be enabled simultaneously and ordered, and the game will respect the order during resource fetching.
- **Additional description file:** The mod adds support for own additional texturepack description file `stackem.json` that aims to add more information on top of `pack.txt`. [Check the guide page for more information!](https://github.com/tracystacktrace/StackEm/tree/main/docs/Additional%20Description)
- **Custom item textures swap:** Like in `Optifine`, you can put a different texture into an item based either on its' display name or its' metadata value. Also, you can change the armor texture with this way. [Check the guide page for a tutorial and more information!](https://github.com/tracystacktrace/StackEm/blob/main/docs/Custom%20ItemStack%20Textures/README.md)
- **Texture _gluing_:** the mod will try to combine textures that's been changed by texturepacks by comparing against vanilla texture (see list of textures below). This is very helpful for micro texturepacks that change HUD textures, such as `Transgender Hearts Texturepack` and `Square (Aim) Dot`, etc., as they change the same texture file!
  - `/textures/gui/effects.png`
  - `/textures/gui/gui.png`
  - `/textures/gui/icons.png`
  - `/textures/gui/web_buttons.png`
  - `/textures/gui/hud/hud.png`
  - `/textures/gui/stats/slot.png`
  - `/textures/environment/particles.png`
- **Expanded moon and sun textures:** The mod provides an expansion for moon and sun textures, allowing for custom cycles, cycle ordering and a celestial scaling. [Check the guide page for more info!](https://github.com/tracystacktrace/StackEm/blob/main/docs/Expanded%20Moon%20Textures/README.md) 
- **Patched some GUI textures:** `Forge` and `Dimensional Chest` now have their own dedicated GUI textures:
  - `/textures/gui/container/forge.png`
  - `/textures/gui/container/dimensional_chest.png`
- **Patched sound reloading:** Now sound files withing texturepacks are fully reloaded on update, which fixes some audio related bugs.

### Screenshots (more in `Gallery` section):

![Texturepacks menu GUI](https://github.com/tracystacktrace/StackEm/raw/main/docs/showcase_1.png)

## Installation

Ensure you have [FoxLoader](https://github.com/Fox2Code/FoxLoader) installed. Click at the link and follow instructions (`Installation` section). Or in a nutshell, grab `*-mmc.zip` file and export it to MultiMC/PrismLauncher.

Simply download a `.jar` file and put it inside `mods` folder. That's all.

## Sources & License

The mod's sources are publicly available and licensed under `Apache License 2.0`. Just check the right side of this page for `Links` section.

title: LogCleaner
description: Deletes old server logs and crash reports
body:
## 🧹 LogCleaner

**LogCleaner** is a lightweight and efficient plugin that automatically cleans up your server's `logs/` and `crash-reports/` folders — so you don't have to!

I originally made it because I was tired of my WinSCP almost crashing every time I opened the logs folder — now it's public, and maybe it can help you too.

### 🔧 Features

- Automatically delete old log files
- Supports two cleaning modes:
  - **By days**: delete logs older than a defined number of days
  - **By amount**: keep only the most recent X log files
- Optional cleanup of crash reports
- Fully configurable via `config.yml`
- Java 8 compatible — works on **all Minecraft versions from 1.7+**

### 📂 Example use cases

- Keep your server clean and tidy
- Prevent lag when opening folders via FTP clients like WinSCP
- Automate annoying manual cleanup work

This pack was designed for my personal Create Fabric SMP server, and released here for the convenience of my players. Other people looking for a (mostly) Vanilla + Create experience might find this enjoyable as well. It has the usual optimization mods, as well as Iris (so shaders are pre-supported). I threw in Krypton and Alternate Current for that almost-Vanilla tweaking of networking and redstone.

Worldgen is fairly basic: Create, Mo'Structures, Profundis, Repurposed Structures, and Waystones are all that add to the Vanilla experience. I was looking for a very lightly tweaked experience (beyond Create, of course), and this does nicely.

There are some QOL tweaks, too, of course, along with some other enhancements (mostly expanding block types, block usage, and so on. Hopefully the surprises (if any) are pleasant ones. I'm aiming for Vanilla + Create with a little extra spice on top.

title: Get UUID
description: Simple UUID conversion library
body:
# Simple UUID Converter

## Disclaimer
**This pack was originally written by [gibbsly](https://github.com/gibbsly) and ported to MC-Build by [SnaveSutit](https://github.com/SnaveSutit). I simply cleaned up the code a bit, created a logo, and
uploaded the project to modrinth for convenience. This does not violate
copyright, as the original data pack is licensed under [The Unlicense lincense](https://unlicense.org). I'm also aware that this library has [already been uploaded to modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/get-uuid), but the site does not seem to be maintained anymore.**

## About

This is a basic library to just generate the hex UUID of an entity

## Use

- `gu:generate` - writes the UUID of the current entity to storage `gu:main out`

- `gu:convert` - converts the UUID you input as the function argument `{UUID:[I;0,1,2,3]}` and writes it to storage `gu:main out`

## Credits

- Original author: [gibbsly](https://github.com/gibbsly)
- Original MCB rewrite: [SnaveSutit](https://github.com/SnaveSutit)

title: Brand New Day
description: 🌅 Shows an animated day counter and statistics whenever a new Minecraft day starts!
body:
Brand New Day is a client-side mod that shows a screen at the start of each day. The screen displays an animated day counter and statistics of what the player has done that day. It's a nice transition between night and day, and an easy way to keep track of how many days you've played.

The statistics it currently shows are:
Blocks broken, blocks travelled, deaths, items crafted and monsters slain.

Any statistic can be enabled/disabled inside the config. The header image that's shown at the top of the screen, by default the sun and a cat, can be changed as well in ./config/brandnewday/header/.







   All available config options:

Show Spoiler

showHeader  default true
If the header image should be shown at the top of the new day screen.

showDayCount  default true
If the current day number should be shown on the new day screen.

showStats  default true
If a summary of the previous day should be shown. Each line can be toggled individually below.

playSound  default true
If a sound plays when the new day screen appears.

newDayScreenDurationTicks  default 200, min 1, max 1200
How many ticks the new day screen stays on screen in total. 20 ticks = 1 second.

newDayScreenFadeInTicks  default 20, min 1, max 200
How many ticks the screen takes to fade in. 20 ticks = 1 second.

newDayScreenFadeOutTicks  default 20, min 1, max 200
How many ticks the screen takes to fade out before disappearing. 20 ticks = 1 second.

guiScaleModifier  default 1.0f, min 0.1, max 5.0
Scales the day number, stats text, and header image together, based on the player's GUI scale. 1.0 matches the configured sizes at GUI scale 4; higher makes everything bigger.

headerImageWidth  default 64, min 0, max 2000
The width in pixels the header image is rendered at on screen.

headerImageHeight  default 64, min 0, max 2000
The height in pixels the header image is rendered at on screen.

headerImageYOffset  default 10, min 0, max 1000
How far down from the top of the screen the header image is drawn, in pixels. 0 is flush against the top.

dayFontScale  default 3, min 1, max 8
How much bigger the day number text should be rendered. 1 is the normal font size.

dayTextRGB_R  default 218, min 0, max 255
The red RGB value for the day number text.

dayTextRGB_G  default 164, min 0, max 255
The green RGB value for the day number text.

dayTextRGB_B  default 40, min 0, max 255
The blue RGB value for the day number text.

showMobsKilled  default true
If the monsters slain line is shown in the day summary.

showBlocksBroken  default true
If the blocks broken line is shown in the day summary.

showDistanceTraveled  default true
If the distance traveled line is shown in the day summary.

showDeaths  default true
If the deaths line is shown in the day summary.

showItemsCrafted  default true
If the items crafted line is shown in the day summary.

statsKeyTextRGB_R  default 216, min 0, max 255
The red RGB value for the stat labels (the key text).

title: Cursed Fate: Custom Open Domain Compatibility
description: Allows custom addon CT open domains to register as real Cursed Fate open domains
body:
Makes open domains built with Voidcrawler's public custom open domain template register with Cursed Fate's normal open domain checks.

Without this, those domains can still run their own visuals and effects, but Cursed Fate does not see them as real open domains. That means nearby base domains may ignore them, and closed domains can be opened inside them.

With this installed serverside, the template's CustomOpenDomain data is picked up by Cursed Fate's open domain detection, so template-based domains can block nearby base domain expansions the same way the base mod's open domains do.

If you use a different template and still want to use this mod, make sure it uses the same CustomOpenDomain tag and it will register automatically.

Works automatically for any addons using the template, which can be found in the Cursed Fate Addon Hub Discord's addon-guide channel.

Serverside mod.

title: SenseSwap
description: A 3-player roleplay challenge — Blind, Deaf & Mute. Can you survive together?
body:
SenseSwap is a Fabric mod for Minecraft that turns any multiplayer session into a chaotic and hilarious social challenge. Players are assigned secret roles — Blind, Deaf, Mute, and optionally Dizzy — each with a unique handicap that forces the team to communicate and cooperate in creative ways.

## 🎮 How it works

An admin runs `/ss start` and the mod automatically assigns roles to each player:

🔴 **Blind** — your screen is covered in darkness. You can see almost nothing.
🔵 **Deaf** — all voice chat audio is completely blocked. You cannot hear your teammates.
🟢 **Mute** — your microphone is silenced. You cannot speak at all.
🟣 **Dizzy** *(optional, 4th player)* — a pulsing border effect distracts your vision.

The catch? You still need to work together to survive or complete objectives. Figure out how to communicate when one of you can't see, one can't hear, and one can't talk.

## ✨ Features

- Automatic random role assignment with `/ss start`
- Full **Simple Voice Chat** integration — Mute blocks your mic, Deaf blocks incoming audio at the engine level
- Roles are **server-authoritative** — clients cannot spoof or change their own role
- Roles **persist across reconnects** — rejoin and your role is automatically restored
- Roles saved per-world in `senseswap_roles.json`
- In-game **HUD overlay** showing your current role with animated badge icon
- Animated **role popup screen** shown when you receive a role
- Animated **wheel spin** when roles are assigned
- **Day summary screen** with scores and confetti at the end of each round
- Full **settings GUI** (press K) — adjust HUD position, scale, fog intensity, and more
- **ModMenu** support — configure the mod from the mods list
- Config saved to `config/senseswap.json`

## 🆕 New in 4.0.0

- Improved GUI animations — popup, HUD, summary screen all have new effects
- Score counter animation in the summary screen
- Champion effect for 1st place in the summary screen
- Danger mode — timer flashes red in the last 60 seconds
- HUD now shows role badge icon alongside the role name
- New **CountdownScreen** (3→2→1→GO!) before the game starts
- `/ss swap` — instantly shuffle roles between players mid-game
- **Dizzy role** — optional 4th role with pulsing screen-border effect
- **Score system** — players earn points each round based on their role
- `/ss score` — view leaderboard | `/ss score reset` | `/ss score add <player> <pts>`
- Configurable minimum player count

## 🏆 Scoring

Points are awarded automatically at the end of each round:

| Base reward | Role bonus |
|---|---|
| 10 pts (configurable) | +5 Blind, +3 Deaf, +2 Mute, +1 Dizzy |

Scores are saved to `<world>/senseswap_scores.json` and persist across server restarts.

## 🌍 Languages

🇬🇧 English · 🇷🇺 Русский · 🇰🇿 Қазақша

## ⚙️ Requirements

- Fabric Loader ≥ 0.15.0
- Fabric API — Required
- Simple Voice Chat — Required
- ModMenu — Optional

## 💻 Commands *(requires OP level 2)*

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/ss start` | Start the game and assign roles randomly |
| `/ss stop` | Stop the game and clear all roles |
| `/ss swap` | Randomly shuffle roles between current players |
| `/ss setrole <player> <BLIND\|DEAF\|MUTE\|DIZZY>` | Manually assign a role |
| `/ss clearrole <player>` | Remove a player's role |
| `/ss status` | Show current role assignments |
| `/ss score` | Show leaderboard |
| `/ss score reset` | Reset all scores |
| `/ss score add <player> <pts>` | Add or subtract points manually |

---

*Made by ChaldS · [GitHub](https://github.com/ChaldS-mods/SenseSwap)*

body:
# Announcement!
I've made the tough decision to stop using MCreator and halt development on all of my projects made with the software. It was a great software, but it's halting my learning in JavaScript. Don't worry, many of these features will be revived in the future, but this mod will be archived, and development stopped. Thank you for all the support.

## For the best experience, please install [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat)!

Die Schmiedewerkstatt (The Blacksmith's Workshop in German) features weapons for various playstyles (also known as classes), items to enhance gameplay, and tools to craft and break objects. It also includes some QOL and difficulty tweaks.
## Goal:

This mod is mostly a continuation of my now-defunct and archived mod of [Beyond the Horizon](https://modrinth.com/mod/tgg-beyond-the-horizon). The goal, just like in Beyond the Horizon, is to expand your options for items, tools, etc. I wanna add more types of tools for different purposes (like breaking more blocks, climbing more blocks, things like that).

## The title?:

First off, what does the title even mean? Well, _Die Schmiedewerkstatt_ (pronounced "die shmeedeverkstaht") is German for The Blacksmith's Workshop. I chose this title because there are practically no other good titles available that haven't already been taken in English, so why not in German? (Plus, it sounds pretty cool.)


## Items and changes:

Planned or currently added items and tweaks are:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
- Daggers: Faster, but weaker swords.
- Battleaxes: Slower, but much stronger axes. They're more weapons than tools.
- Revolvers: New ranged weapons that are much more powerful and long-ranged than bows and crossbows.
- Copper Gear: Gear weaker, but longer-lasting than iron. The mining level is iron level, with defense slightly below.
- Rose-gold Gear: Gear with the enchantability of gold, and the durability of copper. The mining level is diamond level, with defense slightly below.
- Steel Gear: Gear equivalent to diamond, but for the Nether. Unlike diamond, however, it has 1,128 durability instead of 1,561 durability, since it's a bit more common.
- And various tweaks! Those include: Retexturing the diamond tools, weapons, and armor, retexturing the spyglass, and changing several recipes to be easier or harder, among others.
  
</details>

Later in development, more special items with unique mechanics will be introduced to deepen gameplay.

Please note: This is an early development version. I’d really appreciate it if you report any glitches you encounter while playing.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Currently Included:
- 3 Events
- 4 Biomes
- 1 Mob found in The After
- 1 Dimension
- 3 Structures — first 2 currently identical, but located in different dimensions and subject to change. One structure is used to exit The After and can be found roughly near (0 ~ 0), though this may be updated.
- New trades for the Wandering Trader and Cartographer

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
**How To Get To The After:**
Currently to get to the after you need to find a scroll traded by a cartographer or wandering trader, then you will be able to go to the coordinates where you then need to activate the ritual circle there by lighting the candles and interacting with the main block with a Totem of Undying.

**Shader Note:**
If you're playing with shaders, I recommend Hysteria or Insanity, as most other shaders reduce fog density. This can make The After feel too open and less atmospheric.

**Update Early Access:**
You can get access to upcoming updates to the mod a week prior to public release by supporting me on my patreon (which is linked here on the mod page), you obviously don't have to, as the update will always come out a week after unless some gamebreaking bug is found.

**CURRENT EARLY ACCESS UPDATE:**
NONE

![Resource  Wiki](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b026ece906aa9934d51925091f622e85f270abee.png)
## 
### **The way to generate valuable items**
![Resource](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d63acb92761688f00096733ad6b6047b78b3312.png)


## Features
- Tons of Resources like Diamond, Emerald, Dye, Clay and more
- Mod Compatibility
- Transforming Armadillos to the Resources you want
- Breeding Armadillos
- Harvisting Scutes


![Resource Roost](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/761be84bb23d1310cc917585f1a3e318a1f45a0d_0.webp)

Roost
The Roost is used to transform a normal Armadillo into a Resource Armadillo. If you want to create a Diamond Armadillo, you will need:

1 diamond
1 iron scute
Furnace fuel
A regular Armadillo
Once you have all the materials, the Roost will transform the Armadillo into its resource variant. You can view all recipes in JEI or EMI.

 

Armadillo Hive
The Armadillo Hive is used to breed Resource Armadillos of the same type. For example:

Two Diamond Armadillos → Baby Diamond Armadillo
Special recipes like the Netherite Armadillo: A Gold Armadillo and an Obsidian Armadillo will produce a Baby Netherite Armadillo.
However, breeding will only occur if the hive contains at least two Armadillo food items like Spider Eyes.

 

Nest
The Nest acts as a storage unit for Armadillos and has the following features:

It picks up Armadillos just like other containers.
If the Nest contains a brush (of any kind), it will automatically brush the Armadillos and collect their scutes if they have any left.
 

Centrifuge
The Centrifuge is used to convert scutes into essence. It works in two ways:

Manually inserting an item will add one to all slots.
Using a hopper will fill an entire stack in one slot (up to 64 items).
