title: Shields Of Existence
description: A simple mod that adds some shields and enchantments for said shields into existence.
body:
# Shields...That Exist!
![Armor stands showcasing the two shields types added by the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c8fe5289f3125c498f007996d7cbdbc06373f9d_0.webp)
This mod adds 2 new shield types, each with unique properties and 5 variants following minecraft material progression (wood-netherite), 3 normal shields for those just wanting something slightly different from the normal shield, and 9 unique shields with their own effects, totaling 22 shields in total. In addition, this mod adds 7 enchantments, 3 for each shield type and 1 universal shield enchantment. It also adds consumable lava and ice bottles, if you want that.

The two shield types are **Bucklers** and **Greatshields**.

**Bucklers** - Can parry, but have low durability

**Greatshields** - High durability and briefly stuns enemies, but slow the user down

It's worth noting that the golden variations of the shield types have the same durability as iron, but have an additional effect; _Golden Bucklers_ have an increased parry window, while _Golden Greatshields_ don't slow the user down.

Some of the unique shields you can get include the _Slime Shield_, which, depending on how you hold it, can send either you or enemies flying, and _Eternal Damnation_, which burns anything foolish enough to exist around the user.

The enchantments include:
- **Intuition** (bucklers) - Increases parry window.
- **Attraction** (bucklers) - Pulls ranged attackers towards the user on successful parry.
- **Counter** (bucklers) - Increases strength gain and slows attackers on successful parry.
- **Breaker** (greatshields) - Damages melee attackers and applies weakness to shield breaking attackers.
- **Immutable Defense** (greatshields) - Grants a small amount of armor, armor toughness, and knockback resistance to the user.
- **Revitalize** (greatshields) - Heals the user upon blocking.
- **Blocker's Revenge** (universal) - Applies Hunter's Mark to the attacker. If the attacker is killed within 10 seconds, the user will have some of their health restored. Has a 15 second cooldown.

All shields are craftable except for _Eternal Damnation_, which can be found in Bastion treasure chests, _Kiritori_, which can be found in Nether Bridge chests, and _Disposition_, which can be found in End City chests.

title: Studded Armor: Lost Tier & Chainmail Rework
description: A Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that resurrects the forgotten Studded armor set and finally gives Chainmail the recipes it deserved.
body:
[![License: LGPL v3 or later](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-LGPL%20v3%2B-blue.svg)](https://github.com/Hand-Lock/studded-armor/blob/master/LICENSE)
# Studded Armor: Lost Tier & Chainmail Rework  
*A Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that resurrects the forgotten **Studded** armor set and finally gives Chainmail the recipes it deserved.*

## ⚔️ Why This Exists

Between **December 31 2009** and **February 6 2010** the Indev branch of Minecraft contained a fourth armor set—**Studded**—whose sprites were lifted wholesale from *The Legend of the Chambered 2*. Every new world spawned a full set in the player’s inventory, yet the items offered no protection and could not be equipped. When real armor mechanics arrived a few weeks later, both the items and their textures were deleted, leaving a “missing tier”.
This mod restores that tier with balanced stats, authentic recipes, and progression.

---

## 📜 Historical Timeline

| Java Edition build                   | Date (UTC)              | Event                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Indev 0.31 20091231-2**            | 2009-12-31 22:57        | Studded textures added to *items.png* and granted in the starting inventory. |
| **Indev 0.31 20100204-1 → 20100206** | 2010-02-04 → 2010-02-06 | Studded items removed in preparation for armor mechanics.                    |
| **Indev 20100206-2034**              | 2010-02-06              | Studded textures stripped from *items.png*—the set disappears entirely.      |

**Quick facts**

* **Availability (Indev):** Spawned in the starting inventory only; could not be crafted or found.
* **Functionality:** Purely cosmetic inventory items—could be moved but not worn.
* **Sprite origin:** Directly copied from *The Legend of the Chambered 2* where they were named *studded helmet/shirt/pants/boots*.
---

## 🛠️ Crafting & Progression

### 1 ️⃣ Studded Armor (Smithing Table)
Combine **any Chainmail piece** with a **Studded Upgrade Smithing Template** and a **Stud**:

![Studded Upgrade Smithing Template + Chainmail Armor Piece + Stud = Studded Armor Piece](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03c160c0cde18a0b1402cbb6006c9c491ba66007.png)

---

#### 🔧 Crafting a Stud

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/227c978354a81feeec780b82f6dce0db982d6db1.png)

```

[N] [N] [N]
[N] [L] [N]
[N] [N] [N]

```
* **L** = Leather Strip  
* **N** = Iron Nugget  

---

#### 🔧 Crafting a Leather Strip

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/331bf4ba6d039bfca99e242943512ab84bbab20b.png)

```

[ ] [ ] [ ]
[L] [L] [L]
[ ] [ ] [ ]

```
* **L** = Leather  

---

#### 📜 Studded Upgrade Smithing Template
Found while **brushing suspicious sand or gravel** (Archaeology). Gives archaeology real purpose, beyond pottery shards...

Clone it like any vanilla template, using a **Leather Strip** as the central material:

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70ac929f1e61cf2bbf36c6853689dec3df8bca71.png)

```

[D] [S] [D]
[D] [L] [D]
[D] [D] [D]

```
* **S** = Studded Upgrade Smithing Template
* **L** = Leather Strip
* **D** = Diamond

---

#### 🛡️ Stat Overview
| Set | Armor (points) | Toughness / piece | Durability (chestplate) |
|-----|---------------|------------------|--------------------|
| Iron | 15 | — | 240 |
| **Studded** | **17** | **+1** | **384** |
| Diamond | 20 | +2 | 528 |

*(Values respect the vanilla ratios between individual pieces.)*

---

### 2 ️⃣ Chainmail Rework
Chainmail is now obtainable **through crafting**:

#### 🔧 Chains

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/caff5a957b71f2351cacc24a12571883de793384.png)

```

[ ] [N] [ ]
[ ] [N] [ ]
[ ] [N] [ ]

```
* **N** = Iron Nugget → **1 × Chain**

---

#### 🔧 Chainlinks

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fdeeec99f385c0262a01049f860506be5a754f3.png)

```

[ ] [C] [ ]
[C] [ ] [C]
[ ] [C] [ ]

```
* **C** = Chain → **2 × Chainlinks**

---

#### 🔧 Chainmail Armor Pieces  
Use **Chainlinks** in the standard vanilla armor shapes.

<details>
<summary>Show patterns</summary>

##### Helmet
```

[CL] [CL] [CL]
[CL] [  ] [CL]
[  ] [  ] [  ]

```

##### Chestplate
```

[CL] [  ] [CL]
[CL] [CL] [CL]
[CL] [CL] [CL]

```

##### Leggings
```

[CL] [CL] [CL]
[CL] [  ] [CL]
[CL] [  ] [CL]

```

##### Boots
```

[  ] [  ] [  ]
[CL] [  ] [CL]
[CL] [  ] [CL]

```
* **CL** = Chainlinks  
</details>

---

## 🧩 Modpack-Friendly by Design
* **No-Enchant Packs:** This mod was primarily made for modpacks that disable enchanting and assign intrinsic enchants per tier.

* **Designed for Weight Systems** – Studded armor intentionally finishes the **Light Armor** branch (Leather → Chainmail → Studded) so it can keep pace with the **Heavy Armor** branch (Golden/Copper → Iron → Diamond). 
  In setups like my upcoming [CAVEGAME.EXE](https://discord.gg/NhWG6YdSq7) modpack:
    * Studded = final **Light** tier  
    * Diamond = final **Heavy** tier  
    * Netherite = sole **Medium** end-game tier

* **Old-Beta Animal Logic** – gives leather an end-game use and value when breeding is disabled.

> ⚠️ *In a straight-vanilla playthrough—without intrinsic-enchant perks or an armor-weight system—the extra Studded tier may feel like “bloat”; yet it remains a nostalgic gem for legacy-feature aficionados.*

> 🎨 *Every texture—vintage Indev originals and brand-new additions alike—is drawn in the Programmer Art style, so it shines when paired with the vanilla “Programmer Art” pack and retro packs like [Golden Days](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/golden-days) or [PACP](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pacp).*

---

## ⚙️ Technical
* **Minecraft:** 1.20.1  
* **Loader:** Forge 47.4.0 or newer  
* **Mod ID:** `studdedarmor`

---

## 🖇️ Credits
* **Original Textures:** *The Legend of the Chambered 2* & Indev 0.31  
* **Additional Art:** *damikdevv*  
* **Research:** Minecraft Wiki contributors  
* **Code & Balance:** *HandLock_*  

> *“Revive the lost armor of legend, and let your adventurers sparkle.”*

title: Souls Forge
description: Use the souls of your enemies to create new Weapons and Armour.
body:
This datapack introduces a whole new style of magic to your Minecraft worlds, with access to Soul Shards, a unique system that enhances gameplay through experience-based mechanics and combat.

# What To Expect:
### Soul Shards
Collect experience points inside an Amethyst Shard. This converts your XP into Soul Shards, which can then be used for crafting new materials and weapons.

### Soul Shard Blocks
A unique feature of the datapack, Soul Shard Blocks shatter when a player falls from a height of more than 4 blocks, scattering a random amount of Soul Shards.

### Soul Silver Ingots
Soul Silver is created by combining Soul Shards, Echo Shards and Iron Ingots. Use it to craft the new weapons and armour.

### Silver Armour
Crafted from Soul Silver, this armour provides strong protection (slightly weaker than Netherite without knockback resistance) and gives the unique ability to make nearby Illagers neutral. It can be repaired with Soul Silver.

### Soul Totem
This item is craftable from Soul Shards and Soul Silver Ingots an will save you from death! When used it will break, losing its lush and colour. You can recharge it by crafting it with a single soul shard to breathe new life into it, and yourself!

## Soul Weapons
This pack adds a range of weapons made from Soul Shards and Soul Silver. These weapons come with unique abilities and are repairable using Soul Silver:

**Soul Spear:** A long-range melee weapon with moderate attack power.

**Soul Sword:** A generic, straightforward soul weapon.

**Soul Axe:** A powerful weapon that can also chop down trees.

**Soul Hammer:** The strongest of the soul weapons, capable of dealing AoE damage and breaking fragile blocks.

### Soul Enchantments
Absorb XP with your Soul Weapon to fill a Soul Bar. When the bar is full, the weapon receives a random Soul Enchantment that enhances its stats or grants special abilities.

# FAQ's
Any questions asked in other channels will appear here. (Feel free to join the discord to ask a question! The discord also comes with Wiki pages for all new packs.)

- Customizable Prefixes & Prefix Weight
- Translations inside the configuration file
- Message Broadcasting

title: noteblock-assistant
description: Utility mod for making note block songs.
body:
# Note Block Assistant

Note Block Assistant is a utility mod for making note block songs. It's designed to automate the manual steps in the way
I personally make note block songs, particularly the compaction step. If you also find it helpful, wonderful!

Note Block Assistant provides three commands:
- `/nba generate` generates a template with the specified parameters for length and meter, as well as instrument blocks
  (the blocks that go underneath the note blocks).
- `/nba select` loads the completed song and validates it, preparing it for compaction.
- `/nba placeCompact` places a compacted version of the song into the world. You can specify the length of the compacted
  version, or let the command choose a length that gets the result as close to square as possible for optimal listening. (See the Gallery for a screenshot of a compacted song!)

Note Block Assistant requires Fabric API to work. It doesn't need any configuration; you can just add it to your client
(for single-player) or server and use it!

## How to use
Note: It's a good idea to have WorldEdit installed alongside Note Block Assistant. Litematica is also useful 
(practically necessary) to build the final song in survival.

Note Block Assistant works best in a superflat-style world.

### Generating a template
To start a new song, use the `/nba generate` command to generate a template. This command takes the form: `/nba generate
<measures> <beatsPerMeasure> <subdivisionsPerBeat> <subdivisionDelay> <instrumentBlock> [additional instrument blocks...]`

The timing parameters are used as follows:
- `measures`: This controls how many musical measures/bars to generate in your song template.
- `beatsPerMeasure`: This controls how many beats to generate for each measure. This is generally the top number of the
  time signature in music notation; for example, if your song is in 3/4 time, you would enter `3`. For certain time
  signatures it may be useful to choose a different number -- it's traditional in 6/8 time, for example, to use two
  beats per measure with three subdivisions per beat.
- `subdivisionsPerBeat`: This controls how many times to divide each beat of the measure. It represents the *shortest*
  note that you can have in your song. For example, in 3/4 time, if your shortest note is an 8th note, you would use
  `2`; if your song has 16th notes, you would use `4` instead. If you're using a compound time signature like 6/8,
  you'll need to adjust your subdivisions accordingly: with 2 beats per measure, if you want to include 16th notes,
  you would use `subdivisionsPerBeat` of `6`.
- `subdivisionDelay`: This controls the length of each subdivision -- and therefore the tempo of your song. Note Block
  Assistant generates songs that are rows of note blocks (or placeholder blocks) with repeaters in between controlling
  the time between each note; therefore, this number is the number of ticks each generated repeater is set to. This can
  be set to `1`, `2`, `3`, or `4`, with each repeater tick equal to 0.1 seconds. Examples:
  - With `subdivisonsPerBeat` of `2` and `subdivisionDelay` of `2`, each subidivion is 0.2s long and each beat is 0.4s,
    so the final tempo is 150 bpm.
  - With `subdivisionsPerBeat` of `3` and `subdivisionDelay` of `1`, each subdivision is 0.1s long and each beat is
    0.3s, so the final tempo is 200 bpm.

  This system does limit the tempos that can be achieved, but that is generally unavoidable. You'll need to choose your
  subdivision delay to get as close as possible to the desired tempo.

Although Note Block Assistant only generates templates with a single subdivision delay, the selection and compaction
system will preserve modifications that you make to the repeater timings. So, if your song has predominantly eighth
notes as the subdivision and only a couple of shorter notes, it may be possible to generate a template based on the
eighth note and then adjust in one spot to add the shorter notes. Remember that if you shorten one repeater, you'll
need to either lengthen the next one to make up for it, or shift the remainder of your template over (WorldEdit is
useful for this sort of change).

After the timing parameters, you can enter up to nine instrument block parameters. These are Minecraft blocks that will
be generated under the places where the note blocks go. If you wanted a song with a xylophone and flute sound, you could
use `minecraft:bone_block minecraft:clay` to generate two tracks, one for xylophone and one for flute. Note, each track
can only play one note, so if you wanted the xylophone to play chords, you might need to add additional
`minecraft:bone_block` to get more tracks. You can always use `minecraft:air` to generate a track without any instrument
block.

Although the template generator is limited to one instrument block per track, you can switch out the instrument blocks
to temporarily change the sound, and the selection/compaction system will preserve these changes. So if you want to
have percussion, for example, you may be able to use only one or two tracks even if you use several instruments. A beat
that alternates between bass drum and snare drum could be done on one track: generate the track using `minecraft:stone`
for the bass drum, then replace the snare drum beats with sand, then repeat the pattern to the end of the song
(WorldEdit's `//stack` command is excellent for repeating patterns).

### Creating your song
After you generate your template, a row of blocks will appear in front of you. This is your *marker line*. It functions
as a timeline that shows you where the measures and beats line up, to make it easy to keep track. Diamond blocks mark
the first note of each measure, and gold blocks mark the first note of each subsequent beat within that measure.

To the right of the marker line, your tracks are generated. Tracks are generated in groups of three, with repeaters
along the center track to carry a redstone signal. The smooth stone blocks on the second layer are the note blanks;
replace these with note blocks to add your notes. Note that within each group, the first track is generated in the
center, then the second track is generated on the left, and the third is generated on the right. This is because if
a group has only one track, it needs to be in the center where the repeaters are. So, if you generated a template
with nine tracks, the layout will be:

```
M   2 1 3   5 4 6   8 7 9
```

This might be surprising at first, but it gives the most efficient final layout after compaction.

To listen to your song, simply use redstone wire to connect a button to the first note block or blank of each center
track. Press the button, then fly along above the song to stay where you can hear it. (When you're done, the compaction
feature will generate a version of the song that you can listen to standing in one place.)

### Compacting your song
When you have everything just the way you want it, Note Block Assistant can take your completed song and generate
a compact version of it by folding the tracks together so that the note blocks interlock, and placing each group of
three tracks on a separate layer. This way, your song goes from a long, unwieldy (but easy to edit) line to a 3D build
that takes the smallest space practical and can be built in survival mode if desired. (This is possible to do with
WorldEdit, but it takes some math and a great deal of trouble, which is why this mod was originally created.)

To compact your song, first stand on top of the first diamond block on the marker line, and face the other end of the
marker line. Then, use the command `/nba select <tracks>`, where `tracks` is the number of tracks in your song. Note
Block Assistant will scan the marker line in the direction you're facing to calculate the length of the song, then 
scan and store all the note blocks, instrument blocks, repeaters, and blanks.

> For this reason, while you can swap out instrument blocks and shorten/lengthen the song while you're creating it,
your marker line must remain unbroken and you *cannot* change the locations of the tracks relative to the marker line.

Note Block Assistant will tell you the length of the song it found. If that's correct, then fly up to a nearby location
and run `/nba placeCompact` to generate the compact version. To reduce the resources needed to build in survival, Note
Block Assistant will automatically remove any unneeded note blanks and instrument blocks from the compact version, so
there's no need to do this manually beforehand. By default, a glass floor will be generated for each level, to make
building more practical and to hold any falling instrument blocks like sand or gravel. You can use WorldEdit to replace
the floors with something else or remove them if you like. You can also replace the smooth stone blocks with any other
solid block that can be powered at this stage.

By default, Note Block Assistant generates a compacted song that is as close to square as possible, so that you can
stand in the center and all the note blocks will be at a minimum distance and can be heard. If you have a specific area
the song needs to fit into, however, it may be useful to generate a different rectangular shape instead. If this is the
case, you can use `/nba placeCompact <length>` to specify the length in blocks of one side of the rectangle, and the
song will be automatically made as wide as it needs to be to accommodate that length. Note that extra length is needed
in one direction for the redstone wire to loop around at the end of each row, so while the note blocks will be fit into
the dimension you specify, the final shape will be slightly different based on which side of the rectangle you choose
for `<length>`.

Once you're happy with the shape of your compacted song, you can use it as a reference to build in survival (the 
Litematica mod is by far the best way to do this). Then, hook up a redstone circuit to power the first note block on
each layer simultaneously. There are many ways of doing this, and it depends on how you want the song to be triggered
as well as the place you're building it in, so Note Block Assistant doesn't generate this part.

title: ItemLocator
description: ItemLocator helps players track and locate items in Minecraft chests by marking their locations with glowing beacons, making organization and retrieval easier.
body:
# ItemLocator
ItemLocator is a useful Minecraft plugin designed for server administrators and players, providing an intuitive way to track and locate items in containers like chests, barrels, shulker boxes, and more. With advanced item tracking, players can easily find and organize their items with minimal effort, utilizing glowing beacons to mark item locations.

### Key Features:
- Track Item Locations: Automatically track the locations of items placed in chests or other containers.
- Glowing Beacons: Visualize item locations with glowing beams that can be seen through blocks, making it easy to find your stored items.
- Player-Specific Views: Each player can view their own tracked items in containers, ensuring that no one else can see your chest's contents.
- GUI-Based Searching: Players can open a custom GUI that displays all tracked items, allowing for quick navigation and retrieval.
- Command-Based Search: Players can search for specific items using a simple command and view their locations instantly.
- Customizable Permissions: Server administrators can configure who has access to item tracking and searching features, maintaining control over player actions.
### Commands:
- /itemlocator gui – Opens a GUI displaying all tracked items for the player.
- /itemlocator locate <material> – Searches for a specific item by name and displays its locations.
### Support and Contributions:
If you encounter any issues or would like to contribute to the development of this plugin, feel free to visit the GitHub repository and follow the contributing guidelines.

title: Better Weapons
description: Adds new weapons, artifacts and structure to our cubic world.
body:
# **Introduction**


We present to your attention a new modification from **GCM Studio (GuildCraftsMen)** under the guidance of player **RusmayXD**, which adds various artifacts, weapons and structures. Let's talk about everything in order!



# **Structures**


In total, there are only **10 structures** in the mod: 9 of them appear in the normal world, and another 1 in the land of ender. Inside each structure there is a chest containing a unique artifact or weapon for your player character, more on these later.

Some structures will be safe, however, there will also be those where you will have to show strength and ingenuity. For example, there is an air structure in the form of a cloud (it consists of a cloud block that was added with this modification), if the player stands on this cloud, it will fall to the ground, also the blocks will cause the air block to “break”, be careful!

We will not go into details of each structure, since we will lose interest in studying the modification, but we can show examples of these dungeons.



# **Weapons**


In this mod, weapons are divided into two types: ordinary and magical, for each type you will receive certain achievements. Let's look at each one.

• **Macuahutl** is a legendary weapon of the Aztecs. Has 6 damage and 0.7 attack speed. It will need to be crafted from four stones and three boards.

• **Khopesh** is a strengthened version of the iron sword. 9 damage and 1 attack speed, has a craft of two iron swords and one ingot of the same material.

• **Idol of the Dead Dux** is the very first weapon that was added to this mod. This is a short range spear that deals 10 damage with an attack speed of 0.7. It cannot be created, it can be found in special structures. If you press RMB while holding the idol, you will gain the ability to run intensely for a certain time. Please note that such weapons can gradually break with each active ability, use wisely.

• **Scythe of Justice** - a weapon of the upper world, coming straight from the abyss, look for a certain structure. Deals only 4 damage per attack, but has a speed of 3 units. RMB to activate stealth mode.

• **The Phoenix Sword** is one of the most powerful weapons in this mod. Deals 10 damage and has an attack speed of 0.8, cannot be created, can only be found. RMB to accept the Phoenix's gift! When you activate this ability, you receive a large number of buffs, including regeneration and maximum fire resistance. The effects are accompanied by new sounds.

• **The Storm Axe** is the most powerful and interesting weapon of this project. Has 10 damage and 07 attack speed. When you activate the ability, you enter spatial movement mode and gain flight for two seconds. Sounds too good? Truly! However, to get this weapon, you will need to find a floating structure in the ender world.

• **Sarkabans** are the only ranged weapon from this mod. They are long tubes for hunting with darts (regular and poisonous). All types of sarcabans and darts can be created and also found while traveling around the world.




# **Artifacts**


In this mod there are only 6 artifacts that can be found in structures. They are divided into two types: **passive and active**:

**Passive artifacts** simply need to be kept in your inventory for them to work (for example, the Anemo artifact, which gives a smooth fall as long as it is in your inventory).

**Active artifacts** must be held in your hand, for example, Athena’s shield, it protects against some negative effects.




# **Other things**


In fashion, we haven't covered **bags and backpacks** yet. There is nothing surprising here: the bags are made from leather and thread. Backpacks are the same, but now with the addition of craft bags. Used for storing and carrying things.

**Cloud is a block** that is only available in the creative menu. It will form an air structure in the ordinary world. If you break it in survival, you can get a bottle of experience.

**The Pipe** is another craftable mod item that can be lit using the right mouse button. When smoking, you get the effect of strength, nausea and a little speed.

# 🤖 Bot設定ガイド

このガイドでは、ボットの基本的な設定方法を説明します。以下の2つの主要なステップに従って設定を行ってください。

## 1️⃣ ボットトークンの設定

ボットを操作するためには、正しいトークンが必要です。このトークンはボットの識別子として機能し、APIアクセスの際に使用されます。  
**手順**:
1. [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications) にアクセスします。
2. 作成したボットを選択し、`TOKEN` セクションに移動します。
3. `Copy` ボタンをクリックしてトークンをコピーし、適切な場所にペーストします。

## 2️⃣ チャンネルIDの設定

チャンネルIDは、特定のDiscordチャンネルを識別するためのものです。  
**手順**:
1. Discordクライアントを開きます。
2. `設定 > トピックの詳細` を選択して、特定のチャンネルのIDを表示します。
3. 表示されたIDをコピーし、必要な場所にペーストします。

---



# 🤖 Bot Configuration Guide

This guide will walk you through the basic steps of setting up your bot. Please follow the two main steps outlined below.

## 1️⃣ Setting Up Your Bot Token

The bot token acts as an identifier for your bot and is used for API access.  
**Steps**:
1. Go to the [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications).
2. Select your created bot and navigate to the `TOKEN` section.
3. Click the `Copy` button to copy the token and paste it in the appropriate place.

## 2️⃣ Configuring Channel ID

The Channel ID serves as an identifier for a specific Discord channel.  
**Steps**:
1. Open your Discord client.
2. Select `Settings > Advanced` to view the ID of a specific channel.
3. Copy the displayed ID and paste it wherever necessary.

---

title: Blackstones Runic
description: A great Enchantement mod with Custom Enchanting System
body:
# Attention: This project is discontinued. A new mod based on this for Fabric 1.21.1 is in development by me as of now.

This is Runic. A Mod that adds a custom Enchantement System with Books in 7 rareties, a Sacrifice Altar and a Rune Altar.

We were recently made aware of a Bug which allows for multiple curses of one type to be on a weapon due to an issue with the Enchantement-failing function. We are currently working on a Fix.

The mod Adds 21 new Enchantements  to spice up your PVP and Survival.



The Blackstone Studio Discord where we maybe launch pre releases and Early Access versions so consider joining to never miss a Update again 



_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Rune Books                           



Rune Books are the modded Versions of Enchanted Books. They come in 7 Rareties (from most common to most rare): Common, Uncommon, Curse, Rare, Nether, Legendary, Ender. The Books have 5 Durability, from which most will lose one for each use of the Book (Higher Level Enchants can also instantly destroy your Book)





Common: Dodge, Extra Durable 

Uncommon : Lightfoot, Owleyes, Immense Grace

Curse: Enderscurse, Curse of Fragility, Exhausting

Rare: Doublestrike, Coldedge, Antidamage, Lumberjack, Adrenalin Rush, Blighbane, Thunderstrike

Nether: Lavawalker, Flamecaller

Legendary: Rustededge, Jack o´ Lantern, Berserker, Lifestream

Ender: Obsidianforged, Shulkers Feet



Post Ideas for new runes here

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Sacrifice Altar



The Sacrifice Altar is one of the two Blocks in this Mod. This Block allows you to Create Runes from Empty Rune Books. You can also use a Sacrifice Orb to Higher your Chances for Better Runes and lower your chances of getting Curses. To Sacrifice you need a Empy Rune Book, something to Sacrifice (tagged in #sacrificeableflesh) and (optional) A Sacrifice Orb (No need for XP).









_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Rune Altar

This Block allows you to add Runes to the Accepted Items. All Runes exept Obsidian Forged have a nearly 100% Chance of applying, but somethimes you get Curses. Applying Runes also costs no XP.



______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Sacrifice Orb

The Sacrifice Orb highers your chances of getting Better Runes when Sacrificing. It also lowers your chance of getting Curses.





______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



We hope you have fun with this small enchanting Mod.

Please also Consider Following us to never miss updates for our amazing Projects

description: A little thing I decided to do to give back to the Minecraft community. I love Minecraft but it 100% needs something different, so that's what I did.
body:
![Vanilla Re-Envisioned Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0a1a37f1dca4ce1e686c9a585d6c63fc5d431f4.png)

### Inspired by Raspberry Flavored, Bottom of the Barrel, and Detour

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/FURfTfpV4WI" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## WELCOME TO VANILLA RE-ENVISIONED!
This pack aims to change most to all aspects of the game and make the game more interesting for everyone with funny secrets hidden throughout!

Things such as...


**Performance!**       
I tried my best to optimize the pack as best I could but, do let me know if you have any good optimization mod suggestions. while this pack is optimized, its highly recommended that you allocate at least 6gb of ram for this pack and that you have a semi powerful cpu as it is intensive cpu/gpu wise as well as take reqular breaks as prolonged play will cause your performance to dip after around an hour or two of play. sorry low end gamers :(
        (Do I need to list every single performance mod?!)


**Fishing!**    
New mechanics and reels to pull in. fine additions revolving around fishing have been updated as well as new ways to use your fishing rod and quite a strong way to get certain gear. Warm, Cold, and Temperate biomes now have specific loot tables for their temp.
        (**[REDACTED]**, Multiline Mastery, Enchancement, etc.)


**World Gen!**     
Existing structures have been heavily revamped in order for a more interesting experience as well as more biomes and structures added to increase your level of fun and intruge while you explore your new and vast world. some structures have been untouched or reverted due to being way too crazy or over the top. 
        (Trial Towers, CliffTree, Dungeons and Taverns, etc.)


**Mobs!**    
Mobs have been added from the vote along with improving or adding things to older mobs. even adding new variants around the world and making the surface overall safer. Currently no mobs spawn on the surface but you can disable that by disabling the mod, Peaceful Nights.
        (No Enderman Grief, Friends & Foes, Creeper Confetti Plus, etc.)


**Inventory**   
Your inventory problems are (mostly) solved! upgraded bundles are the main storage solution to carry all your junk around as well as sort your chests with a click of a button. Bundles also have fun features and tools that can help with the collection of items.
        (Client Sort, Metal Bundles, Braver Bundles, etc.)


**Combat!**   
Harness the power with new weapons and abilities to abliterate your enemies and protect your land with you beautiful 2nd amendment rights! Whether you are a melee or ranged fighter, there is something for you to play with.
        (Enchancement, Starbound, **[REDACTED]**, etc.)


**Music & Sound!**   
Embrace the land with tunes for just about anyone with it being more frequent and being able to control how loud everything is so you can either enjoy the game with everything to the max or chill, quiet vibes.
        (Sounds, Discs where discs shouldn't be, Miku additions, etc.)


**Progression!**    
Have iron gear that you deeply love and want to hold onto, well you can now upgrade any iron piece to diamond (so long as you have a diamond, your selected gear, a basic upgrade template, and a smithing table on hand) as well as getting to the end being a bit harder as you have to explore your world in order to access the end but not too far. well technically speaking its easier but ill leave that for you to discover)
        (**[REDACTED]**, Enchancement, Enderscape, etc.)


**The End?!**    
Ill leave that for you to explore :)


**Silly Secrets**    
Lets see if you can find them all :3

title: PetarLib
description: A library mod used by PetarMc1's mods. It provides essential tools for chat handling, logging, networking, and task scheduling.
body:
# PetarLib
PetarLib is a utility library for minecraft mostly used by PetarMc1's mods. It provides essential tools for chat handling, logging, networking, and task scheduling.

## Key Features

- **Chat Module** - Adds chat pattern matching.
- **Log Module** - Adds a simple logging system that helps debugging.
- **Net Module** - Handles network requests like talking to APIs
- **Task Module** - Provides task scheduling and management tools to handle async operations.
- **Notification Module** - Allows mods to display notifications in the action bar.


## Why a Library When Code Can Be in the Mod Itself?

By centralizing essential utilities in a dedicated library, mods built with PetarLib are cleaner and easier to update/work on. This means cleaner code and not having the need to rewrite the same code multiple times

## Are you a developer?

If you're a mod developer looking to integrate PetarLib into your project you can check the [dev docs](https://docs.petarmc.com/petarlib/development). There you can find detailed documentation, usage examples, and dependency setup instructions.

3300+ survival-friendly decorative and functional heads with crafting recipes

![header image with lots of example heads](https://def9a2a4.github.io/HeadSmith/assets/header.png)

title: Our Inventory
description: It's not your diamond. It's our diamond. This mod removes the privilege of having a private inventory. Every single item in your inventory is now shared across all players on the server.
body:
It's not _your_ diamond. It's _our_ diamond.

**Our Inventory** does exactly what it says on the tin: it synchronizes the inventories, hotbars, and armor slots of all online players into one shared space.

When one player picks up an item, everyone gets it. When another player uses a tool, its durability drops for the entire server. This simple concept transforms Minecraft into a true cooperative or chaotic experience.

The mod respects the keepInventory gamerule, but for the ultimate challenge, try playing with it off. When one player eventually meets their end in the lava, the entire server's inventory burns with them. Also, good luck fighting over the hotbar slots.

Perfect for team-based challenges, building communities from scratch, or just seeing how long your friendships can last.

The mod is 100% server-side. Works on dedicated servers and in LAN games. No client mod is required for players to join. Also, there are no teams or setup requirements, everyone is equal. Just drop it in the mods folder and enjoy. ;)

description: Blocks elytra use in liquids, applies environmental penalties, and enforces cooldowns. Fully configurable through server gamerules.
body:
# Drenched Wings

Fabric mod that blocks elytra use in liquids, applies environmental penalties, and enforces cooldowns. Fully configurable through server gamerules.

## Core Mechanics

**Environmental Nerfs**

- **20-second cooldown** for elytra in rain, water, or lava.
- **Firework boosts disabled** during rain.

**Splash-Water Cooldown**

- Hitting a player with a **splash water bottle** disables elytra for **up to 20-seconds**, scaled by proximity.

**Server-Side Control**

- All effects configurable via server game rules.
- Fully **vanilla-compliant** using Minecraft’s `ItemCooldowns` system.

## Game Rules

- `doElytraNerf` – Global toggle for all elytra nerfs (default: true)
- `disableElytraInRain` – Disables elytra in rain (default: true)
- `disableElytraInWater` – Disables elytra in water (default: true)
- `disableElytraInLava` – Disables elytra in lava (default: true)
- `disableRocketsInRain` – Prevent firework rockets boost in rain (default: true)
- `applyElytraCooldownFromSplashWater` – Apply cooldown when hit by splash water bottle (default: true)

## Inspiration

Inspired by **cubfan135’s “[Minecraft’s Elytra Problem](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fBbtP9GZITM)”** 

This mod implements his proposed liquid-based Elytra limitations as a configurable, server-side Fabric mod.

title: Common's Content
description: Adds missing recipes and uses for vanilla materials, as well as extra progression tiers, weapons, and utilities.
body:
This mod adds content in a few different areas of the game, and providing uses for existing materials that I felt were missing from the game, as well as silly extras to have some fun with.

Suggestions, bug reports, and other questions can be taken to the Discord. We'd love to have you over!

Two new tool path types exist alongside vanilla's tools; Durability-Focused sets, and Efficiency-Focused sets.

**Durability**:
- Carbon Steel; Tier between iron and diamond. Boasts increased durability and damage.
- Titanium; Tier between diamond and netherite. Very durable, sharp, and protective. Can be used to upgrade to netherite as well without the need for diamond gear.

**Efficiency**:
- Silver; Gold tools rebalanced for the iron tool tier. 64 Durability, diamond-mining capabilities, and a tad bit sharper than gold.
- Amethyst; Put all the extra geode material to good use. Has similar durability to iron, but is capable of mining ancient debris, and fairly quickly as well. Not the worst for combat, but there's better options.

Basic medical supplies exist as well, giving more common resources more of a use.
- Bandages; Simple, made of string and oxeye daises. Restores some HP over time.
- Medkit; Uses bandages, copper, and some dye. Restores a lot more HP over a longer time period.

The mod also adds miscellaneous uses for vanilla materials in the form of new recipes, plus some end-game weapons and gadgets with complex crafting recipes, if you find yourself with some spare time.

I intend to add more content over time, but life has a way of thwarting my plans. Curses!

body:
# Adjustable Sound Limit

## 🇺🇸 English

### Description
**Adjustable Sound Limit** is a simple yet essential mod that expands the maximum number of simultaneous sound channels in Minecraft.
By default, Minecraft limits sound channels to around 250. In heavily modded environments with many machines, farms, or entities, this limit is easily reached, causing sounds to cut out abruptly.

This mod increases the default limit to **1024** (configurable up to **4096**), ensuring a rich and uninterrupted audio experience.

### Features
*   **Expanded Sound Limit**: Default 1024 channels (Vanilla is ~250).
*   **Configurable**: Adjust the limit between 64 and 4096 to suit your hardware.
*   **In-Game Config GUI**:
    *   Works standalone (Native simple GUI included).
    *   *Note: A game restart is required after changing settings.*

### Verified Versions
*   **Minecraft**: 1.20.1 (Forge)
*   *If you confirm this mod works on other versions (e.g., 1.20.2, 1.20.4), please report it!*

### Requirements
*   **Minecraft**: 1.20.1
*   **Loader**: Forge
*   **Side**: Client Side Only (Installation on server is not required)

### License & Modpacks
*   **All Rights Reserved.**
*   **Modpacks**: You **ARE** permitted to include this mod in any modpack.
*   **Redistribution**: You are **NOT** permitted to redistribute this mod on other websites. Please link to this page instead.

### ⚠️ Notes & Troubleshooting
*   **Server Incompatibility**: Do **NOT** install this mod on a dedicated server. It is a client-side mod and may cause crashes or unexpected behavior if installed on a server.
*   **Hardware Limitations**: If the sound limit increase is not reflected in the F3 debug screen (still shows ~247), your hardware or sound driver (OpenAL) may be limiting the channels. Please try **lowering** the `maxSounds` value in the config file.
*   **Mod Conflicts**: This mod modifies the sound engine core. It may conflict with other mods that also modify the sound engine.

---

## 🇯🇵 Japanese

### 概要
**Adjustable Sound Limit** は、Minecraftの同時再生可能なサウンドチャンネル数の上限を拡張するModです。
バニラのMinecraftでは、同時に再生できる音の数が約250に制限されています。工業Modの機械音や大規模なトラップタワー、大量のMobがいる環境では、この上限に達してしまい、重要な音が聞こえなくなる（音が途切れる）ことがよくあります。

このModを導入することで、デフォルトの上限を **1024** （最大 **4096**）まで引き上げ、音が途切れる問題を解消します。

### 特徴
*   **サウンド上限の拡張**: デフォルトで1024チャンネル（バニラは約250チャンネル）確保します。
*   **設定可能**: PCのスペックに合わせて、64〜4096の範囲で調整可能です。
*   **ゲーム内設定画面 (GUI)**:
    *   Mod単体で簡易的な設定画面が利用可能です（Mod一覧の設定ボタンからアクセスできます）
    *   *注意: 設定を変更した後は、Minecraftの再起動が必要です。*

### ⚠️ 注意事項・トラブルシューティング
*   **サーバーへの導入について**: このModはクライアントサイド専用です。**サーバーには導入しないでください。** 不具合やクラッシュの原因になる可能性があります。
*   **設定が反映されない場合**: Modを導入してもF3画面の「Sounds」の分母（最大数）が増えていない場合、お使いのPC（サウンドカード/ドライバ）がその数値をサポートしていない可能性があります。設定ファイルの `maxSounds` の値を **少し下げて** （例: 512など）試してみてください。
*   **競合について**: サウンドエンジンの根幹を変更するため、同じ箇所を変更する他のサウンド系Modと競合する可能性があります。

### 動作確認済みバージョン
*   **Minecraft**: 1.20.1 (Forge)
*   *もし他のバージョン（1.20.2, 1.20.4など）での動作を確認できた場合は、報告していただけると助かります！*

### 動作環境
*   **Minecraft**: 1.20.1
*   **Loader**: Forge
*   **Side**: クライアントサイドのみ（サーバーへの導入は不要です）

### ライセンス・Modpackについて

*   **再配布**: 他のサイトへの無断転載・再配布（二次配布）は **禁止** です。このページへのリンクをお願いします。

body:
# What it is...
Want to play with _only_ Pokémon from your favorite generation? You've come to the right place!

This datapack manipulates the spawning mechanics for Cobblemon by replacing the spawn files with only Pokémon from this generation.

Fun fact: My favorite Pokémon from this generation is Lugia, and Soul Silver is one of my top favorite games of all time.

**NOTE**: All regional-form spawns have been moved to their respective generations:
- Alolan = Gen 7
- Galarian = Gen 8
- Hisuian = Gen 8
- Paldean = Gen 9

## Mix and match!

Want to include multiple generations? Just add any of my other spawn-filtering datapacks to include them in the spawn pool. It's that easy!

For example, if you want a special playthrough of generations 1-4 (my favorite ones, by the way), just add all four datapacks to your world and you're all set.

- [Gen 1: Kanto](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-1-kanto)
- Gen 2: Johto
- [Gen 3: Hoenn](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-3-hoenn)
- [Gen 4: Sinnoh](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-4-sinnoh)
- [Gen 5: Unova](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-5-unova)
- [Gen 6: Kalos](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-6-kalos)
- [Gen 7: Alola](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-7-alola)
- [Gen 8: Galar](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-8-galar)
- [Gen 9: Paldea](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-9-paldea)

# How it works...
## What this datapack **DOES** affect:
- All natural spawns (...when they just _pop_ into existence)
- Fishing spawns (via Cobblemon fishing mechanics)

## What this datapack **DOES NOT** affect:
- Cobblemon structures (example: Gimmighouls spawning from the chests in Gimmighoul towers)
- Structure loot tables (example: fossil loot tables from sus sand/gravel in fossil archaeology structures)
- Cross-gen evolutions (example: Pichu > Pikachu, Magneton > Magnezone)

# Setup
1. Add datapack/s to your Modrinth profile or modpack
1. Copy/move the datapack/s to your world's datapack folder
    - NOTE: Datapacks in `./datapacks` (base folder) don't apply globally to all your worlds, this is why you must include it in the world-specific datapack folder (`./saves/<your_world_name>/datapacks`) for this to work. More info on the [Minecraft Wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Data_pack#Usage).
1. Join your world and enjoy the filtered spawns!

# Disclaimer
Currently, this is *ONLY* confirmed to work with the base Cobblemon mod. I plan to add support for modpacks that have their own spawning rules, such as Cobbleverse, in the future.

# Contact

title: BanMenu
description: BanMenu is a powerful Minecraft moderation plugin featuring a GUI, ticket system, Discord integration, and comprehensive punishment management for Spigot and Paper
body:
![# BanMenu – The Ultimate Minecraft Moderation Plugin](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766948684.png)

# BanMenu – The Ultimate Minecraft Moderation Plugin

**BanMenu** is a powerful, modular moderation plugin for **Spigot, Paper and Bukkit** and fully supports **Geyser / Bedrock cross-platform servers**.

It provides a **complete all-in-one moderation solution** including punishments, tickets, Discord integration, role synchronization, security systems and detailed logging — all configurable and scalable.

**Current Version:** **1.4.2**

---

## 🎯 Main Features

### ![✅ Moderation System](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941875.png)
- Ban, Mute & Kick (temporary & permanent)
- Flexible **ID-based punishment system**
- Automatic expiration for temporary punishments
- Undo actions (Unban / Unmute)
- Admin & bypass permissions

### ![🎨 GUI Menu](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941867.png)
- Modern, user-friendly moderation GUI
- Visual player overview
- Fast moderation without command spam

### ![🎫 Ticket System](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941943.png)
- GUI-based ticket creation & management
- Cooldown system to prevent abuse
- Ticket states: Open, Closed, Reopened
- Discord notifications for staff

---

![## 🤖 Discord Integration](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941923.png) (Extended in 1.4.0)

### ![📜 Discord Rules Bot](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941844.png)
- Quiz runs **directly in the Rules channel** (no DMs)
- Ephemeral questions & final summary only
- Verified users skip the quiz automatically
- Multilingual messages (DE / EN)
- Fully configurable via `discord_rules_bot.yml`

### ![🏷️ Discord Role Management](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941838.png)
- Role management via **Discord Slash Commands**
- Admin / Moderator permission groups
- Configurable role permissions
- New config: `discord_role-permissions.yml`
- Slash Commands:
  - `/role give`
  - `/role remove`
- Minecraft command:
  - `/discord-role`

### ![🔄 Role Synchronization](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941850.png)
- **Bidirectional sync**: Minecraft ↔ Discord
- Priority modes: `minecraft`, `discord`, `both`
- Manual sync command:
  - `/dc-sync`
  - `/dc-sync <player>`
- Fully configurable sync messages

### 📝 Discord Slash Commands
- All Rules Bot commands available as Slash Commands
- Channel-restricted execution
- Commands registered even if modules are disabled
- Multi-line embedded help messages

---

## ![🛡️ Security Features](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941892.png)
- IP tracking (alt account detection)
- Optional automatic IP bans
- Optional VPN detection
- Chat filter with blacklist & regex
- Chat delay / anti-spam system

---

## 📊 History & Statistics
- Full punishment history per player
- Detailed stats (bans, mutes, kicks, tickets)
- Deletable history with reasons
- Complete logging of moderation actions

---

## ![🔧 Technical Features](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941897.png)
- **MySQL & SQLite** support
- Full proxy support (BungeeCord / Velocity)  **(Comming Soon)**
- **Geyser / Bedrock compatible**
- PlaceholderAPI integration
- LuckPerms & GroupManager support
- Multi-language (EN / DE)
- Modular system (disable unused features)
- YAML-based configuration
- Hot-reload without restart

---

## ![📋 Commands](https://www.endcrystal.eu/uploads/post_images/1-1766941827.png)

| Command | Description |
|-------|------------|
| `/banmenu` | Main command (reload, update, stats) |
| `/ban <player> <ID>` | Ban a player |
| `/unban <player>` | Unban a player |
| `/mute <player> <ID>` | Mute a player |

title: D3K Legacy
description: Optimized Minecraft for SMP
body:
## **D3K Legacy**

The D3K Legacy Modpack offers a range of enhancements that significantly improve both the performance and gameplay experience in Minecraft. Designed with a variety of mods, it enhances the game with quality-of-life features, visual upgrades, and performance optimizations, providing a tailored experience for players seeking an immersive world.
## 
## **Features:**

- **Built-in calculator**
 
- **Search for texture packs in Minecraft**
 
- **Enhanced performance**
 
- **Optimization improvements**
  
- **Built-in freecam**
  
- **Map with minimap and waypoints**
  
- **Additional cool features**


One of the key aspects of the D3K Legacy Modpack is its ability to dramatically improve the game's performance. With mods like Sodium and FerriteCore, the game runs smoother, particularly on lower-end systems, while Entity Culling reduces unnecessary calculations to further boost performance. For players seeking smoother visuals, Iris Shaders and Complementary Shaders - Reimagined bring a stunning visual overhaul, making the Minecraft world look more dynamic and engaging.

Navigation is also made easier with the addition of Xaero's Minimap and Xaero's World Map, which provide intuitive mapping and waypoint systems to help you explore the world. MiniHUD also offers customizable overlays to display important information like coordinates, FPS, and other stats right on your screen.

The modpack also integrates several quality-of-life improvements. Freecam allows for more freedom when exploring the world, while Resourcify enhances resource management by making it easier to gather and utilize materials. CalcMod even adds a calculator for in-game computations, making certain tasks more efficient.

For a better user experience, Mod Menu and Options Profiles provide quick and easy management of installed mods and configuration settings, ensuring that your gameplay remains smooth and tailored to your preferences.

Importantly, the D3K Legacy Modpack is fully compatible with Lunar Client, extending its capabilities by adding performance enhancements, improved visual effects, and streamlined features to enhance your overall experience. Whether you're playing solo or with friends, this modpack ensures that your Minecraft world runs beautifully, with better performance and more immersive features than ever before.

description: An API aimed to simplify the development of Bukkit plugins (please use Paper or any Paper fork)
body:
# Obsidian

An API aimed to simplify the development of Paper plugins [![Available in Modrinth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/refs/heads/v3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/obsidiancore) [![Available in HangarMC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/refs/heads/v3/assets/cozy/available/hangar_vector.svg)](https://hangar.papermc.io/devadri/Obsidian) # Info This API is aimed to simplify the development of Paper plugins, providing a lot of utilities that will make your life (and mine) easier Even though a standalone plugin version is available, it's recommended to shade this API into your plugins, as this API changes frequently and depending on the standalone version may cause some issues if server owners install some plugins that depend on different versions of this API > ❗ You need Java 17+ to use this API/Plugin. If you are using a lower version consider upgrading > ⚠️ You need to set your plugin to use Spigot mappings in order to preserve compatibility with > Paper forks that are still using Spigot mappings. > More information in the [PaperMC documentation](https://docs.papermc.io/paper/dev/project-setup/#plugin-remapping) > ⚠️ Only Minecraft 1.17 or superior is officially supported. Versions below 1.17 will not receive any support ### It's mostly used in my plugins, but you can use it on your own plugins if you want, just make sure to give proper credit! # How to import ## Gradle ````kotlin repositories { maven { name = "devadri" url = uri("https://repo.devadri.es/repository/releases") // Use dev repository for beta builds } } dependencies { implementation("me.devadri:obsidian:{VERSION}") // Replace {VERSION} with the desired version } ```` ## Maven ```xml devadri https://repo.devadri.es/repository/releases me.devadri obsidian {VERSION} ``` # Credits - Thanks to [Byteflux](https://github.com/Byteflux) and [AlessioDP](https://github.com/AlessioDP) for creating the [Libby](https://github.com/AlessioDP/libby/tree/gradle) library, which is used to manage dependencies at runtime. - Thanks to [CryptoMorin](https://github.com/CryptoMorin) for creating the [XSeries](https://github.com/CryptoMorin/XSeries) library, which is used to preserve compatibility with older and newer versions of Minecraft, as IDs and APIs can vary between versions.

This mod allows you to resurrect your friends in Hardcore mode. There are two items available to you for this: the Resurrection Altar and the Resurrection Catalyst.
By using the Catalyst on the Altar, when there are players nearby in Spectator mode, you instantly resurrect them, putting them back into survival mode.

 

The mod adds the following items:

The Altar of Resurrection. This item is useless by itself, but if you use a Resurrection Catalyst on it, all players in Spectator mode will be switched to survival mode.

The catalyst for Resurrection. This item must only be used on the Resurrection Altar to resurrect friends.

 

The mod was created specifically for the Clash of Epochs modpack, but you can use it in your builds. Theitems don't have creation recipes, so you need to add them yourself (For example, through CraftTweaker). This is done so that you candetermine for yourself how difficult it will resurrect your friends.

title: Undertaker's Attributes
description: Become the hero you were meant to be with U'Attributes.
body:
FurAttributes is a Minecraft mod that adds a deep layer of customization to your gear. With countless attribute combinations, you can create a playstyle that's uniquely yours. Deal devastating blows with increased damage, defend yourself with enhanced armor, and outpace your enemies with incredible speed. Equip your gear with attributes like life steal, crit chance, crit damage and duplex to create the perfect build for any situation. With total of 17 new attributes, whether you're exploring dangerous dungeons, battling fierce mobs, or simply building your dream home, FurAttributes will enhance your Minecraft experience. 
- LIFE STEAL: Simple lifesteal function. Scales from 0% to 100% (1 to 1 healing).
- ARMOR SHRED: Ignores armor, up to 66% at max (won't nulify armor). Scales at a rate of 0.66% every 1 attribute value, to a max of 100 attribute value/66%. Applies to all damage from attackers, NOT other types of damage, like falling, or void.
- CRIT CHANCE: A basic crit chance modifier, similar to landing airborne attacks with a sword or axe; basic crits are disabled otherwise. Default 5%, max 100%.
- CLEAVE: Melee attacks deal AoE damage in a 3 block radius from the target, up to a max of 50% of the initial damage. Scales 1 to 1; max of 50%/50 attribute value.
- CRIT DAMAGE: Increases the damage dealt from critical hits. Default: 25%, max 500%.
- DUPLEX: Chance to fire an additional arrow, max of 400 (400% chance to fire 1 arrow = +4 arrows)
- PROJ DAMAGE: Increases the damage of ranged attacks (arrows, tridents). Max of 500 (500%). Word of warning: Bows already scale very well with Power Enchants, as Power increases the damage of each arrow by a percentage. Use this attribute sparingly, or Archers will outdps everything.
- PROJ SPEED: Increases the velocity of arrows and tridents.
- EVASION: Dodge chance, follows this exactly formula: ((evasion * 0.05) / (1+evasion * 0.05) * 0.8).
- PASSIVE REGENERATION: Restores percentage of your max HP every 50 ticks. This is very powerful on its own. Default 0 (0%), max 25 (25%). Use this attribute VERY sparingly.
- LOOT LUCK: Think of it like Fortune, but as an attribute. Increases the chances of receiving extra drops from mobs, up to 100%. Default 0.
- DEBUFF TIME: Modifies the duration of negative effects on the player. Negative values increase duration of Debuffs on player. From -1000 to 100. 
- BUFF TIME: Like Debuff Time, but for positive effects; increases the effectiveness of buffs from -100% up to 1000%.
- SPRINT SPEED: Increases your sprint speed; default attribute value of 25 (+25% speed) and up to a max of 1,000 (10x default sprinting speed).
- DAMAGE RESISTANCE: Reduces damage at a rate of 0.66% per 1 attribute point; max 66%/100 attribute value.
- HUNGER RESISTANCE: Reduces hunger cost from sprinting and other actions at a rate of 1 to 1, and can completely remove the need for food at absolute max. Default 0, max 100%/100 attribute value.
- CRIT RESISTANCE: Basically reduces enemy crit chance against you, particularly smart in PvP. Max of 100 attribute value, though the minimum is hard set to 1.1 damage (a 10% increase).
RUNIC SHIELD: Consumes damage from attacker, creating runic shield around you. After broken - it need 7.5 seconds to start regen again.

- MINING SPEED: Self explainatory. From -100% to 200%. Yes, you can slow down mining.

- BOW DRAW SPEED: Increase draw speed of any type bows/crossbows. From -50% to 200%.

- MANA LEECH: Works only for Ars Noveau and Iron's Spells. 1 attribute = 1% of mana leech from your max mana.

- HEAL AMPLIFIER: Increase incoming healing up to 1000%

- GLOBAL DAMAGE: Increase any outcoming damage up to 10000%. Calculates BEFORE Damage Resistance.

Previous Versions of this mod included stolen assets from the Create Mod. I have since patched this out, but I would like to apologize. Create is my favorite mod and me stealing textures from it was a disservice to the developers I have so much respect for.
# Sewage
### IMPORTANT: THIS DUNGEON IS MADE TO BE TAKEN ON WHEN THE PLAYER HAS AQUIRED IRON ARMOR AND TOOLS!
**(You should also use a shield :P)**
## Sewers
Sewage adds new dungeon called the Sewers, with monsters to fight and loot to obtain.
## New Blocks/Items
Sewage adds a Stone Tiles block set, based on the Cut Copper textures.
Sewage also adds Pizza, which has very high saturation. It also adds a new weapon called a Splintered Cane, which has long reach and moderate attack speed.
## Mobs in the Sewer Trial Spawners:
-Slime  
-Zombie  
-Skeleton  
-Spider  
-Witch  
-Bogged

# -Lore-
Long ago, in the time of heroes, the Witches of the overworld used Iron Golems corrupted by The Orb of Dominance to build the Sewers, a containment where they could dump their potions without having negative environmental effects, creating the Runoff. 

Later on, a patrol of Illagers discovered the abandoned Trial Chambers, a training ground used to strengthen the forces of the Heroes. They reported back to the Arch Illager, who then instructed the Witches to reverse engineer the Trial Spawners. They put the newly created Trial Spawners into the Sewers as a way to punish the villagers they captured in Raids.  

Captured Villagers would be knocked into the Runoff by the monsters created by Trial Spawners, and they would mutate into the Ravagers. The Ravagers would slaughter remaining Villagers, and then be taken back to Illager bases, creating a cycle of torture for unfortunate Villager souls. Villagers that managed to escape into the tunnels of the Sewers would construct Hideouts, with delicacies such as Pizza being cooked as a way to stay happy under the stressful circumstances, with them obtaining ingredients from the Trial Spawners. Unfortunately, the door to the Hideouts would be broken down by the Ravagers, and the Villagers were killed.

After the Arch Illager was defeated, the Sewers would be abandoned, with all of their treasure left inside...

title: XDeathsBans
description: Configurable death-based ban system for Minecraft servers. Set death limits, enable temp bans, and manage bans easily.
body:
# XDeathsBan

**XDeathsBan** is a mod designed for Minecraft servers that introduces a ban system based on the number of times a player dies. With this mod, server administrators can set a maximum death limit before a player is banned, configure whether only PvP deaths count, and customize the ban duration.

This mod is perfect for **hardcore** or **advanced survival** servers where death has real consequences, forcing players to be more strategic to avoid getting banned.

---

## 🛠️ Key Features
✅ **Automatic Bans**: Players will be banned upon reaching the configured death limit.  
✅ **PvP Mode**: Allows you to configure whether only PvP deaths count towards the ban.  
✅ **Temporary Bans**: Option to enable bans with a custom duration in ticks.  
✅ **Ban Management**: Commands to unban individual or all players.  
✅ **Configurable Settings**: Adjust ban settings in-game without restarting the server.  

---

## 🎮 Commands and Usage

### 📋 Mod Configuration
Administrators can modify the mod settings in real time using the following commands:

📌 **Check the current settings:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban settings status
```
💬 Displays the allowed death count, whether bans are temporary, ban duration, and if only PvP deaths count.

📌 **Set the maximum number of deaths before a ban:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban settings maxdeaths <number>
```
💬 Defines how many times a player can die before being banned.

📌 **Enable or disable PvP-only death counting:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban settings onlypvp <true|false>
```
💬 If enabled (`true`), only PvP deaths will count towards banning a player.

---

### 🚫 Ban Configuration
📌 **Enable or disable temporary bans:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban ban bantemp <true|false>
```
💬 Activates or deactivates temporary bans. If set to `false`, bans will be permanent.

📌 **Set the temporary ban duration:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban ban bantime <ticks>
```
💬 Defines how long a player will remain banned before they can rejoin.

_(1 second = 20 ticks, 1 minute = 1200 ticks)_

---

### 🔓 Ban Management
📌 **Unban a specific player:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban unban <player>
```
💬 Removes the ban for a specific player.

📌 **Unban all players:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban unban all
```
💬 Lifts the ban for all currently banned players.

📌 **List all banned players:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban util listbans
```
💬 Displays a list of all currently banned players.

📌 **Reload the mod configuration:**  
```plaintext
/xdeathsban util reload
```
💬 Reloads the settings from the JSON file without restarting the server.

---

## 🎯 Ideal Server Types
✔ **Hardcore and Semi-Hardcore**: Where death should have serious consequences.  
✔ **Competitive Survival**: Encouraging strategy and caution.  
✔ **PvP and War Servers**: To enforce bans on players who lose too many battles.  
✔ **Survival Events**: Eliminating players from an event after a set number of deaths.  

---

title: Custom Creations
description: A plugin which lets you create custom abilities for items without writing a single line of code!
body:
# MCCustomCreation
A minecraft plugin for creating custom items abilities without touching even 1 line of code!

Have you ever thought about an item, an ability which does not exist yet. Which should be created and will be so fun to use, yet, holded back because you couldnt create it? If that is the case, this plugin is just for you! It will let you create any ability you have ever thought of without touching a single line of code!

The plugin uses GUIs and components named "Nodes" that the player can combine together to make his own custom abilities to sepcific events. The sum of all abilities in a single item are called a "Creation".

![Custom Events!](https://github.com/ODINN555/MCCustomCreation/raw/main/PageImages/Events.jpg)
![Custom Events!](https://github.com/ODINN555/MCCustomCreation/raw/main/PageImages/actions_preview.jpg)


# Setup
Download the plugin and put it in the server's plugins folder. This plugin requires ProtocolLib, so download it and put it in the server's plugins folder as well.

# Commands
- /CustomCreation Help - shows the list of commands and their detailed description.
- /CustomCreation Create - creates a new Creation.
- /CustomCreation Remove - deletes a Creation.
- /CustomCreation Duplicate - creates a new creation with the abilities of the duplicated creation.
- /CustomCreation test - for tests purpuses (BETA), not in use in general.
# Settings
The settings listed in the config:
- FileManagerType - The file manager which saves the creations. YAML by default. (Do not change this unless - there is another FileManager of a different type).
- MessageLogging - If error messages to players should be logged in console. By default - true.
- NodeBlacklist - The list of blacklisted nodes which won't be registered by the plugin. By default- empty list.(NOTE: To list a node, you will need it's key name. By default, most of the keys are the node's name but with caps, for example, TELEPORT_ENTITY. For further information, see the guide on the github page)
# Guide
See the "Aspect of The Creation" guide on the [GitHub Page](https://github.com/ODINN555/MCCustomCreation#walkthrough---aspect-of-the-creation).

# Contact
If you need help, or you wanna leave a suggestion, bug report, an idea, a review or just a good note. Feel free to DM me on discord (send a message request, do not friend me), username: odinn555, or write it on the github page.

This mod patches the calls to the Mojang API, which have moved since 1.7, making vanilla calls invalid, and thus making any skin or cape request invalid. This mod transforms the calls to the new ones, allowing skins and capes to display again

title: Lightfooted
description: Adds an enchantment to tread carefully
body:
Lightfooted adds an enchantment that allows you to walk without triggering effects such as slime bouncing, falling through powder snow, activating sculk sensors, lighting up redstone ore, and being damaged by magma blocks. It also prevents Frost Walker ice from interrupting flowing water, which can disrupt all sorts of Vanilla mechanisms and item transfer systems.
 
Requires Minecraft 1.19 snapshots.
 
Gif of the mod in action: https://gfycat.com/felinelegalicelandichorse

title: Valcon
description: An addon and core mod for the Starfell modpacks. Let the stars guide you!
body:
Valcon is an addon mod for Starfell: Rise of The Valcon Knight for Neoforge 1.21.1. This mod is not gaurenteed to work with any other pack, suggestions are welcome though!

Feature List:
- Lembas bread, the new best food made out of honeycomb, flowerss, gold, dough, and eggs.
- Soul forge, a new station capable of reforging your equipment to be unbreakable at the cost of soul steel.
- Bast statue, a block that provides resistance to nearby players, acting as a mini beacon.
- Star Taker Disc, made by SociopathicFungusGirl.
- Devil Trigger disc by Casey Edwards, instrumental.
- A new weapon, the Soulborn Blade.
- A few crafting materials, such as souls and enchanting guides, made to slow down progression dealing with enchantments.
- A new effect that makes you unable to crit.
- A new material called Ashen Steel.

This mod is still a work in progress!
Enchanting guide and lembas textures by Noelledotjpg.

title: Mad Pixels 16x
description: The 16x version of Mad Pixels. Make your Minecraft world simpler and more cheerful with the Mad Pixels resource pack!
body:
![Mad Pixels](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bddfd47c8e29c4cd40bfafbba82a5b8dc7cae938.png)

**Make your Minecraft world simpler and more cheerful with the Mad Pixels resource pack! It is a pack that can be used for any purpose - from adventuring to modern building.**

The idea of this pack is to make your world more cartoon-like and more vibrant with textures that go easy on the eyes but at the same time are not too minimalistic.

Many textures, although different in style when compared to the default ones, look familiar. At the same time, many textures are more experimental and diverge from the norm, for example, the robot-like iron golem or the loading-style block destroying animation. Altogether, in this pack you'll see many surprises.

![Sharp and clean textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10a814f2b593ba54d08fda3f2002a09c56048757.png)

These are the words that best describe the 16x version of this pack. The 64x version has more rounded textures, but still in a pixelated retro style, while 1024x is pushing the limits of how far this pack can go.

![Carefully handcrafted simplicity](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cebba98e95615150dc0d68088c36873dbb24eac1.png)

Originally Mad Pixels was released as a 16x pack in 2015. The core idea of this pack has always stayed the same, but over the years there have been many small tweaks, adjustments and additions. Everything is made "by hand" without AI or any other sort of external assistance.

![Available in different resolutions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20b7558ad51b67a3c4e325c54bd98bd34e580cea.png)

Here are the links if you want to check out the other versions of Mad Pixels:

- [Mad Pixels 64x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mad-pixels-64x)
- [Mad Pixels 1024x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mad-pixels)

title: Legendary SMP Utilities
description: ALL-IN-ONE utility plugin for SMP servers!
body:
# **LEGENDARY SMP UTILITIES**

## FEATURES
- Anti-combatlog
- Items cooldowns (pearls, gaps, mace etc.)
- Dimension control
- Enchant limit
- Explosion damage (in %) control
- Hide invisible player name in kill message
- Item limit
- Mace crafting limit
- Netherite block
- Potion limit
- Tipped arrows control
- Damage limit for mace and carts
- Everything fully configurable
- Commands for everything

## Anti-combat log

### Config:
```
combatlog:
  enabled: true
  time: 15

  block-elytra: true
  block-riptide: true

  command-block:
    enabled: true
    whitelist:
      - msg
      - tell
```

### Commands:

/lsu combatlog block <elytra, riptide> <on/off>
/lsu combatlog set <time>
/lsu combatlog <on, off, reload, status>

## Item cooldowns:

### Config:
```
cooldown:
  enabled: true

  items:
    MACE: 0
    SPEAR: 0
    ENDER_PEARL: 0
    WIND_CHARGE: 0
    GOLDEN_APPLE: 0
    ENCHANTED_GOLDEN_APPLE: 0
    GOLDEN_CARROT: 0
    TNT_MINECART: 0
```

### Commands:
/lsu cooldown set <enchanted_golden_apple, ender_pearl, golden_apple, golden_carrot, mace, windcharge> <time>
/lsu cooldown <on, off, reload, status>

## Dimension contorl

### Config:
```
dimension-control: # true = ALLOWED false = BLOCKED
  enabled: true

  nether: true
  end: true
```

### Commands:
/lsu dimensioncontrol set <end, nether> <enable, disable>
/lsu dimensioncontrol <on, off, reload, status>

## Enchant limit

### Config:
```
enchant-limiter:
  enabled: true
  downgrade-to-max: true

  limits:
  (here will be enchants you limited)
```

### Commands:
/lsu enchantlimit set <enchant> <max>
/lsu enchantlimit <on, off, reload, status>

## Explosion control

### Config:
```
explosion-control:
  enabled: true

  damage-multipliers: #!IN PROCENT!
    TNT: 100
    TNT_MINECART: 100
    BED: 100
    RESPAWN_ANCHOR: 100
    END_CRYSTAL: 100
```

### Commands:
/lsu explosioncontrol set <tnt, tnt_minecrart, bed, respawn_anchor, end_crystal> <damage %>
/lsu explosioncontrol <on, off, reload, status>

## Invisible kill

### Config:
```
invisible-kill:
  enabled: true
```

### Commands:
/lsu invisiblekill <on, off, reload, status>

## Item limit

### Config:
```
item-limit:
  enabled: true

  limits:
  (here will be items you limited)
```

### Commands:
/lsu itemlimit set <item> <max amount in inventory>
/lsu itemlimit <on, off, reload, status>

## Mace limit

### Config:
```
mace-limit:
  enabled: true
  max-crafted: 5
  crafted: 0
```

### Commands:
/lsu macelimit <set> <mace craft limit (can be 0)>
/lsu macelimit <on, off, reload, status>

## Netherite block

### Config:
```
netherite-block: # true = ALLOWED false = BLOCKED
  enabled: true

  armor:
    helmet: false
    chestplate: false
    leggings: false
    boots: false

  tools:
    sword: false
    axe: false
    pickaxe: false
    shovel: false
    hoe: false
```

## Commands:
/lsu netheriteblock set armor <helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots> <enable, disable>
/lsu netheriteblock set tools <axe, hoe, pickaxe, shovel, sword> <enable, disable>
/lsu netheriteblock <on, off, reload, status>

## Potion limit

### Config:
```
potion-limit:
  enabled: true

  limits:
  (here will be effects you limited)
```

### Commands:
/lsu potionlimit set <effect> <max effect level>
/lsu potionlimit <on, off, reload, status>

## tipped arrows control

### Config:
```
tipped-arrows:
  enabled: true
```

### Commands:
/lsu tippedarrowscontrol <on, off, reload, status>

title: Avariterra
description: Explore a burnt land filled with deadly enemies, new structures, and unique items to discover
body:
###                                       **ABOUT THIS MOD**
![Lost the way](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2bce443f74b28cbf82a8e24e7c85c860b38f343_0.webp)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   The barren plain stretched onward, vast beyond reckoning, unto the very edge of the horizon 
an illomened monument standing sentinel over the extinguished glory of some antediluvian age, where only the ruins of the "Empire" yet loomed, terrible in their magnitude.


   The earth below lay black as the void between the stars, stained with the blood of untold centuries, and veiled beneath a shroud of ceaseless ash that fell without end a pallid, unnatural snow that smothered the sun and left the land in perpetual gloom. This was no mere wasteland, but the residue of history itself: a scripture inscribed in treachery and the wreckage of some war fought in an age before ages. Here, vengeance, anguish beyond comprehension, and the last deranged fragments of hope had fused together and burned, until all that remained were blackened stumps pitiful, charred remnants of what once had been.
   

   Among the living and the dead alike, every soul in that place had been reduced to the same wretched communion: the Eyeless. Their sockets gaped, hollow as bottomless abysses, dark wounds without end. Some had had their eyes seared away by the apocalyptic fires of ages past; others had taken the blade to their own sight, unable to bear witness any longer to the horror of shattered expectation laid bare before them.

   They wandered without purpose amid the ruin, like specters bound by some curse to a cycle from which there was no release.

Some were filled with a hope so deluded, so hollow, that it betrayed nothing but the feeble wit of fools.
Some dreamed, in their sin, that they were purifiers of some sacred order.
Others believed themselves saviors of the lost, liberators of trapped souls.

And from these twisted spirits, given form and voice, was born a belief most aberrant turning, ever turning, in a wheel that knows no end.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
