title: Crallusion Critter Collector
description: A mod that adds several fantasy creatures to the game that you can collect and train!
body:
Have any suggestion? Want to report a bug? We have a Discord server! You can join and ask anything you want!

Crallusion is a mod inspired by Pokémon and Digimon while still being its own thing. This is a creature collector mod where you can hatch, train, and collect your creatures, while learning about them! You can craft items that you can use on them, give them food, explore the world and find new special creatures!

 

Click here to inform yourself about the creatures added in this mod

 

Getting started

When joining into the world, you're gonna obtain several items. These items are only given to you at the very start of the world, you won't receive this starting pack again in a world that was already created.

Creature Egg: This is how you will obtain most creatures. You need to give this egg Hatching Sigils for making it hatch into a baby creature. Baby creatures will then be able to grow up and evolve depending on the elemental sigil you give it! Creature eggs are also obtained rarely when killing wild creatures.

 

Hatching Dream: This is how you obtain Hatching Sigils! These sigils are used for making Creature Eggs hatch into babies! Hatching Dreams are also obtained from killing wild creatures.

 

Dreamy Meat: This is a basic healing item that you can give to your creatures. It doesn't recover much HP, but it's useful for the start! You can also obtain this item from killing wild creatures.

 

Exquisite Dreamy Meat: This is the healing item that heals the most HP of the entire mod. It's dropped very rarely by wild creatures. There are more reliable sources of food, though.

 

Battling

Creatures can be used to battle other creatures or even vanilla mobs and other players, each creature have their own magic skill that they can use on their own while battling. There is an elemental system and a typing chart, the elements are: Elementless, Fire, Water, Grass, Ice, Earth, Wind, Electric, Light & Shadow. Here's an image showing what the typing chart looks like:

 

The only thing that exists for this mechanic is ''strong against''! This means that there are no elemental resistances or immunities, only strong against!

 

Creature drops

When killing wild creatures, you can obtain several different kinds of items from them. The most important item that you need to remember are the elemental sigils. Elemental sigils are used for making your own baby creatures evolve into the element you give it. Use the following image as an example:

 

 

The egg will have a 10% chance of hatching into a specific baby if you give it the specific baby's hatching sigil. This baby will then have a 20% chance of evolving into Nyarice if you give it ice sigils. Nyarice will then have a 10% chance of evolving into Kitrick if you keep giving it ice sigils, and so on.

''What is that strange item at the very end of the image?'' - You may ask. That is a Leviester. The Leviester is like the "soul" of the creatures. All creatures have a Leviester inside of them, and in some cases, their Leviester can resonate within them and let them get upgraded in some way. Not every creature is capable of resonating with their own Leviester, but those that do can get to experience something truly magical

 

List of Leviester forms

Type change: Changes the typing of the creature to another and its magic skill changes to one that matches that of the type it converts into.

 

HIT!: +8 ATK to the creature.

 

CHUB!: +15 HP to the creature.

 

Holy: The creature becomes Light type and adds +5HP & +5ATK to the creature.

 

Fallen: The creature becomes Shadow type and adds +5HP & +5ATK to the creature.

 

Armor: Adds +20HP & +7ATK to the creature and the magic skill becomes Armor Point.

 

 

Spawning

Each element is attatched to Minecraft biomes. You can edit with datapacks what elements belong to what biomes, as they work purely with tags. Here's a chart showing all the spawning biomes that come from default:

Other information

How are creatures obtained?

Creatures can be obtained in two ways: hatching them from creature eggs, or catching them with a dreamcatcher.

Creature eggs are the main method of obtaining creatures. They are obtained rarely whenever killing wild creatures, and can also be obtained through breeding Adult stage creatures. Once you have a creature egg, you need to give it hatching sigils to hatch it into the baby creature you want. These baby creatures will then need elemental sigils in order to evolve into the Baby II stage creature of the element you want it to evolve into. Sigils are obtained from killing wild creatures.

 

About the dreamcatcher...

It is a rare item to get, and it only has a 4% chance of successfully catching wild creatures. Its obtaining method is through crafting. This is meant to be just a secondary way of obtaining creatures, not a main one. The main way for obtaining creatures is meant to be through creature eggs.

 

What is that weird looking pink item next to the evolution trees?

That is an item called Leviester! It's a special gimmick item obtained rarely when killing wild creatures. A Leviester makes Adult creatures transform into special variants of themselves! For example, Trichat becomes a FireTrichat when exposed to a Leviester. The change is not only typing, it comes in multiple more variants, they're listed above!

 

What happens when my creature dies?

When your creature dies, it will become a creature egg! You don't forever lose your creature, it will just go back into being an egg, so you'd have to raise it from the start again.

 

Is there anywhere I can inform myself about the creatures this mod adds?

Yes! By clicking here, you can get to a document that tells you about the creatures in this mod!

![https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/15a7256849674e7decaee7696910db75e4aea7c4.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/15a7256849674e7decaee7696910db75e4aea7c4.png)

</details>


<details>
<summary> Printing Location </summary>

Can be obtained using **/function give:print_location**.
Place down to select the spot where you would like to have your print. There will be a preview to see the area the print will be made. Left-Click the printing location to remove the location and to remove the selection. Right-Click the printing location to start printing. 
### ![https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/ca0f05de83a81d8674e1ae98551e28aa78e4aab6.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/ca0f05de83a81d8674e1ae98551e28aa78e4aab6.png)

</details>


<details>

<summary> Print Remover </summary>

Can be obtained using **/function give:print_remover**.
Place down to remove any print made on that block.
![https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/3b38158cd9f7cada4249f59179e0ab34d6878d7b.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2VwwWx2r/images/3b38158cd9f7cada4249f59179e0ab34d6878d7b.png)

</details>

The prints are made out of **block displays**, which are entities. With small prints, such as 16x16x16, this won't produce any lag. However, large prints using the 64x64x64 printer may result in lag, and may take hours to complete.

## ⚠️  Bugs
If you notice any bugs report them in the **[bugs]** text channel in [my discord server](https://discord.gg/eZEHeNbzUE)

## Download
To download the datapack, you have two options to add it to your world:
- **Creating a new world:**
  1. Download the **Printer_Datapack.zip file**
  2. Click **Create new world** in minecraft
  3. Click **Data Packs**
  4. Drag the **Printer_Datapack.zip file** into there, and make sure you put it on the 'selected' side (right side)

- **Add to existing world:**
  1. Download the **Printer_Datapack.zip file**
  2. Select your world in the single player menu
  3. Click **Edit** at the bottom of the screen
  4. Click **Open World Folder**
  5. Click on the **datapacks** folder
  6. Drag the **Printer_Datapack.zip file** into there

title: CustomCoords
description: Customise your coordinates so they mean something to you!
body:
Coordinates are an essential part of the multiplayer experience. There's no other way to efficiently communicate the location of something to someone who doesn't share your knowledge. This information, being so essential, does not belong in the debug screen, along with information that is either useless or potentially oppositional to a positive user experience. As such, we the community have created a vast number of mods to display your coordinates through other means over the years. This mod's niche in this sea of coord mods is that of customisability, hence its namesake.

Originally being a backend function, coords struggle to hold meaning, especially after the introduction of -64 < y < 0. You can now be in control of that meaning. For example, you can change Y 0 to be sea level, so your Y-coord can communicate where you are regards to it. Importantly, this is only visual, so it doesn't effect how the game operates in the background.

/cc share and automatic chat coord interpretation allows you to communicate with others who don't share the same customisations as you, without any unwarranted confusion.

This mod also comes with integration with [Xaero's minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap), the custom coords are shown in the info display.

This mod is still in development. Please be aware that it may not work as intended. Post any bugs, queries, or gripes to the [Issue page](https://github.com/Hxrlio/CustomCoords/issues).

title: Death Curse
description: Gone are the days of resurrecting for free. Don't you know bringing someone back to life comes with a price? It's about time you learn. For every subsequent life you live, you will find life to be increasingly unstable. Enjoy.
body:
GitHub | Planet Minecraft | CurseForge

Gone are the days of resurrecting for free. Don't you know bringing someone back to life comes with a price? It's about time you learn. For every subsequent life you live, you will find life to be increasingly *unstable.* **Enjoy.** Death Curse is a Minecraft datapack that applies a curse to players that respawn. For every respawn, the curse worsens. Some of the features require particles to be enabled so be sure to turn them on! I've made this page and the in-game guide book intentionally vague so that you can have fun learning the mechanics. If you'd like more details, see the [GitHub project page](https://github.com/antD97/DeathCurse). There is also a complimentary resource pack for the datapack. It is not required, but it improves the experience by adding textures for custom items and adds one unique sound effect.
Design, Objectives, and Balance Here are some notes on the thought process I had when balancing the datapack. I'm pretty happy with what I ended up with, but I'd love to hear about your experience and any balance ideas you may have. ### Objectives - Create a stronger incentive for the player not to die. It doesn't matter if you're conveniently at your base or your inventory is empty, death should always be avoided! - Effects should be challenging and not annoying - Level X curse level should be a playable experience - Effects should feel like a worsening curse ### Curse Effects - Nausea is used in tiny to small amounts to portray feelings of dizziness and fatigue - Poison effect will decrease player health to 3♥ at most (2½♥ at curse level VIII+) - Hunger will not be applied when player food is 3🍗 or less to allow afk-ing - To see exactly how the effects are applied, see the [GitHub project page](https://github.com/antD97/DeathCurse) ### Relief Items - Curse cookie recipe was designed with gold farms in mind - For a detailed descriptions on item mechanics, see the [GitHub project page](https://github.com/antD97/DeathCurse)
Curse Effects Every death your curse level increases by one. The following lists the effects for each curse level: ### Death Curse I - ***nausea*** ### Death Curse II - ***-1♥*** - nausea - ***fatigue*** ### Death Curse III - -1♥ - nausea - fatigue - ***curse leak*** ### Death Curse IV - ***-2♥*** - ***heavy nausea*** - ***heavy fatigue*** - curse leak ### Death Curse V - -2♥ - heavy nausea - heavy fatigue - curse leak - ***poison*** ### Death Curse VI - ***-3♥*** - heavy nausea - heavy fatigue - ***heavy curse leak*** - poison ### Death Curse VII - -3♥ - heavy nausea - ***intense fatigue*** - heavy curse leak - poison ### Death Curse VIII - ***-4♥*** - heavy nausea - intense fatigue - heavy curse leak - ***heavy poison*** ### Death Curse IX - -4♥ - heavy nausea - intense fatigue - heavy curse leak - heavy poison - ***mob aggression*** ### Death Curse X+ - ***-5♥*** - heavy nausea - intense fatigue - heavy curse leak - heavy poison - mob aggression - ***fear*** Curse level will continue to increase past level ten, but no new effects are added.
Curse Relief
Curse Cookies Curse Cookie I Crafting Recipe ![Curse Cookie I Crafting Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antD97/DeathCurse/v1.0.0/img/curse_cookie.png) Curse cookies are the most cost effective way to reduce the negative effects of the Death Curse. Eating a curse cookie will reduce your curse level by one for 30 minutes. When dropped on the ground, curse cookies prefer to morph together. If four curse cookies are left on the ground together, after 10-20 seconds, they will combine into a more potent cookie.
Curse Wards Curse Ward I Crafting Recipe ![Curse Ward I Crafting Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antD97/DeathCurse/v1.0.0/img/curse_ward.png) Curse wards are the next step up in both curse relief and cost. Instead of needing to be consumed, a curse ward will decrease your curse level just by being in your inventory. They also have the added bonus of being tougher than your average item. Curse wards are immune to despawning, fire, and lava, but are not immune to explosions. Similar to curse cookies, four curse wards can be combined to create a stronger version. They are combined in the same way as curse cookies but, unlike curse cookies, have an additional requirement of heat.
Resurrection Abominations Resurrection Abomination Crafting Recipe ![Resurrection Abomination Crafting Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antD97/DeathCurse/v1.0.0/img/resurrection_abomination.png) Resurrection abominations are the final form of curse relief. With one, you can can start the resurrection ritual which will *permanently* undo death. Once the resurrection ritual has begun, players will not be able to sleep until it is complete. To complete the ritual, any players taking part must stand outside at midnight. If this criteria is not met, the ritual will fail and the item will be lost. It is *strongly advised* to empty your inventory before midnight. I bet there's a way to make these even more powerful. I just need to find a place that can handle that much heat.
Player Triggers Player triggers are available to all players. `/trigger death_curse_level` Tells the player their current death count and curse level. `/trigger death_curse_intro` Resends the Death Curse introductory message. `/trigger death_curse_book` Gives the player another copy of the Death Curse guide book.
Operator Functions Operator functions are only available to players with operator level permissions. `/function death_curse:op/uninstall` Removes all scoreboard objectives, scheduled functions, and entities with custom tags. The next time the datapack is reloaded, the datapack will run like it did the first time. `/function death_curse:op/disable_for_player` Used to disable the Death Curse for a specific player. `/function death_curse:op/enable_for_player` Used to enable the Death Curse for a specific player (default enabled for everyone).

title: Truss
description: A single block to replace signs in technical builds
body: In Vanilla Minecraft, sign blocks and open fence gates have the useful properties of being "solid" blocks, while having no hitbox, which makes them invaluable in certain builds for purposes like interacting with falling blocks or fluids.  However, both of these blocks have downsides that make them annoying to use - signs require support, fence gates react to redstone and clicking, and both of them are tedious to place in large quantities, for different reasons.  This mod adds a single block, the Wood Truss, that has the same useful properties - it is solid but has no hitbox - without the downsides of signs or fence gates that come up when using them for this purpose.

title: TexturesToMap
description: Turn block textures into maps for fake blocks, hidden bases, pranks, and illusion builds.
body:
# TextureToMap

**TextureToMap** is a unique Minecraft utility mod that lets you turn block textures into maps with a simple right-click system.

Right-click a supported block while holding a map, choose one of the detected block textures, and instantly copy that texture onto the map. You can then place the map in an item frame to create fake blocks, hidden entrances, illusion builds, prank setups, and creative Minecraft tricks.

## How it works

1. Hold a map in your hand.
2. Right-click a supported block.
3. Choose the texture you want from the selection menu.
4. The selected texture is copied onto your map.
5. Place the map in an item frame to create a fake block effect.

TextureToMap makes map-based fake blocks much easier than building huge pixel art manually.

## Features

* **Block texture to map conversion** – copy block textures directly onto maps.
* **Texture selection menu** – choose from detected block textures when right-clicking.
* **Smooth map output** – creates clean map versions of block textures.
* **HD item frame rendering** – improves fake block visuals when the mod is installed.
* **Vanilla block support** – works with many standard Minecraft blocks.
* **Modded block support** – can work with many modded blocks that use normal Minecraft block models.
* **Invisible item frame utility** – use an Invisibility Potion to hide nearby item frames without wasting the potion if none are nearby.
* **Invisible Support Block** – a solid, placeable, invisible block for survival-friendly map illusion setups.
* **Survival crafting support** – designed to be useful outside creative mode too.
* **Vanilla-friendly utility design** – adds powerful illusion tools without overcomplicating gameplay.

## Invisible Item Frame Utility

Hold an **Invisibility Potion** and right-click to make nearby item frames invisible. If there are no item frames nearby, the potion will not be consumed.

This makes it easier to create clean fake block builds without commands.

## Invisible Support Block

TextureToMap also adds an **Invisible Support Block** for map illusion setups.

It is invisible in the world, solid, placeable, and useful behind item frames when normal blocks would ruin the illusion. It is especially helpful for fake walls, hidden entrances, glass areas, open spaces, and survival-friendly illusion builds.

## Modded Block Support

TextureToMap can work with many modded blocks as long as they use standard Minecraft block models and textures.

title: Player Capes
description: A beautiful client-side Fabric mod to wear any premium player's cape or elytra with an interactive 3D preview GUI!
body:
# 🌟 Player Capes

Have you ever wanted to wear your favorite Minecraft player's cape, or preview how an Elytra looks on your skin before buying or earning it? **Player Capes** is a premium, client-side cosmetic mod that lets you customize your cape and elytra textures in real-time using a beautiful, interactive 3D GUI!

---

## ✨ Features

* **🎭 Premium Cape Redirection**: Apply any premium Minecraft player's cape (e.g., Mojang, Minecon, OptiFine) to your character instantly just by typing their username!
* **📦 Local Custom Capes**: Load any local custom `.png` cape file directly from your computer using a LWJGL-native file picker!
* **🧍 Interactive 3D Preview Pane**: Features a 360-degree continuously rotating 3D preview of your player skin!
  * **Drag-to-Rotate**: Click and drag your character horizontally to rotate them and inspect your cape from any angle. Releasing the mouse smoothly resumes the automatic rotation!
  * **Upright Head Alignment**: The preview model's head remains completely straight and forward-facing, unaffected by where your in-game player is looking.
  * **Nametag Hidden**: The floating nametag above the character is completely hidden for a clean, professional outline preview!
* **⚡ Instant Elytra/Cape Toggle**: Seamlessly swap between a flat cape and a full 3D Elytra in the preview. 
  * In **Cape Mode**, standard chestplates (Netherite, Diamond, etc.) you are wearing in-game are preserved and rendered beneath the cape!
* **⭐ Favorites Naming Modal**: Save your favorite capes to a local favorites list. When saving, a beautiful naming dialog prompts you for a custom name, keeping your main control panel clean and uncluttered.
* **🟢 Active Highlight**: Applied favorites instantly light up in vibrant green in your sidebar list so you always know which custom look is active.
* **🚀 Native Drag-and-Drop / File Pickers**: A robust dual file-picking system that seamlessly falls back to LWJGL text fields to ensure file picking works on all platforms and launchers.

---

## 🛠️ How to Use

Simply launch the game and open the configuration screen:

* **Open the GUI**: Use the client command `/pcapes` (or `/pcapes info`) to open the customized tri-pane configuration screen.
* **Add a Cape**: Type a premium player's username in the text field and click **Apply Cape**!
* **Save to Favorites**: Click **Save to Favs**, type a custom name in the dialog popup, and hit Enter.
* **Reset**: Click **Reset Original** (or run `/pcapes reset`) to return to your default in-game look.

---

## 💻 Commands

* `/pcapes <premium_username>` - Instantly sets your cape to that player's cape.
* `/pcapes favourite` - Saves the current cape to your favorites.
* `/pcapes reset` - Resets your cape back to your default skin look.
* `/pcapes info` - Opens the interactive split-pane 3D Preview GUI.

Includes optimization mods, essential APIs and carefully selected QoL features.
body:
# Fast & Better Vanilla

## Overview

**Fast & Better Vanilla** is a **lightweight client-side modpack** designed to enhance the raw Vanilla Minecraft experience. It focuses on **performance optimization**, **improved usability**, **UI clarity**, and **practical in-game tweaks**. This pack aims to make Vanilla Minecraft **faster, cleaner, and more enjoyable**, without altering core gameplay mechanics or server interactions.

Unlike feature-heavy modpacks or aggressive optimization packs, Fast & Better Vanilla takes a **balanced approach**: every included mod is carefully selected to improve the Vanilla experience, from performance enhancements and chat tools to optional visual improvements and quality-of-life tweaks.

---

## Important Notice

**This modpack is intended for private use only.**

Use on public servers may result in bans. The modpack creator assumes **no responsibility** for damages, data loss, or issues caused by usage. Use at your own risk.

---

![In-Game view](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b5d5cf066c9f5611ac7134b7ebc77af06254b69.png)

## Design Goals

* Enhance overall performance and game responsiveness
* Improve user interface (UI) and chat readability
* Provide practical in-game enhancements, e.g., zoom, durability tools, chat animations
* Include optional visual enhancements such as shaders and item/tooltip improvements
* Preserve Vanilla gameplay without interfering with server rules or game balance

> The goal is to make Vanilla Minecraft **better, smoother, and more refined** while retaining its authentic feel.

---

## What This Modpack Provides

* Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay across all systems
* UI and HUD improvements, including clear and organized chat messages
* Useful in-game tweaks such as Zoomify, DurabilityTooltip, and Chat Animations
* Optional visual improvements including shader support
* Better item and block information via Roughly Enough Items (REI) and Jade
* World management enhancements and stability improvements

All features are **subtle**, **non-intrusive**, and **Vanilla-friendly**, providing an enhanced gameplay experience without compromising the original feel.

title: Durability warning mod
description:
Durability Warning

A lightweight client-side mod that alerts you when your tools are about to break.

Never accidentally destroy your favourite pickaxe again — get a clear warning when an item drops below 2.5% durability.
body:
🛠️ Durability Warning

Never break your tools by accident again.

Durability Warning is a lightweight client-side mod that alerts you when your tools are about to break — right when they drop below 2.5% durability.

Simple, clean, and designed to feel like vanilla.

⚡ Features
⚠️ Low durability alert
Get a clear warning when your tool is about to break
🔊 Subtle sound cue
Plays a quick alert sound so you don’t miss it
💬 Action bar message
No chat spam — clean and unobtrusive
🔁 Smart re-triggering
Repair your tool → it will warn you again next time
🧩 Client-side only
Works on any server (including vanilla)
🎮 Why use this?

Breaking a max-enchanted tool is one of the most frustrating things in survival.

This mod gives you just enough warning to react — without adding clutter, UI spam, or unfair advantages.

It fits seamlessly into vanilla gameplay.

⚙️ Requirements
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Minecraft 1.21.1
🧠 How it works

The mod monitors the durability of items in your hands and triggers a warning when they drop below 2.5%.

It only alerts once per low-durability event to avoid spam, and resets automatically if the item is repaired.

💡 Design Philosophy
Vanilla-friendly
No gameplay advantage
No unnecessary features
Just solves a real problem
🚀 Future Plans (optional)
Armor durability warnings
Configurable threshold
Custom sounds / visual alerts
📦 Lightweight & Efficient

Minimal performance impact, no background overhead — just a simple check each tick.

❤️ Made for Survival Players

Whether you're mining, building, or exploring — this mod has your back when your gear is about to give out.

A unique take on the classic Skyblock experience, this modpack revolves entirely around the Create mod and its ecosystem of addons. Starting from almost nothing, you are challenged to build up your world using creativity, engineering, and clever automation instead of traditional progression paths.

Rather than relying on magic or overpowered tools, your journey is driven by mechanical power. Generate rotation, transfer energy through shafts and belts, and design increasingly complex contraptions to process resources. What begins as simple hand-cranked machines quickly evolves into fully automated production lines, where efficiency and design become key to your success.

Every resource must be earned through thoughtful setups and smart engineering. Expand your floating island, optimize your systems, and experiment with different Create addons that introduce new mechanics, machines, and possibilities. Whether it's precision crafting, bulk processing, or large-scale automation, the modpack encourages you to think like an engineer.

With a strong focus on progression, creativity, and satisfying automation, this Skyblock experience offers a rewarding challenge for players who enjoy building, optimizing, and watching their machines come to life high above the void.

| `/sethome create <name>` | Create teleport point at current location | `sethome.create` |
| `/sethome delete <name>` | Delete specified teleport point | `sethome.delete` |
| `/sethome list` | List all teleport points | `sethome.use` |
| `/sethome reload` | Reload configuration file | `sethome.reload` |

Aliases: `/sh`, `/home`

## Permissions

- `sethome.use` - Use teleport function (default: all players)
- `sethome.create` - Create teleport points (default: all players)
- `sethome.delete` - Delete teleport points (default: all players)
- `sethome.reload` - Reload configuration (default: OP)
- `sethome.admin` - Administrator permission (includes all permissions)

## Configuration

The configuration file is located at `plugins/SetHome/config.yml` and supports customization of:

- Plugin prefix and messages
- Teleport delay time
- Require standing still option
- GUI title and size
- All prompt messages

Use `/sethome reload` after modifying the configuration.

🪄 Prologue
The world of Modland has never been simple. But now the very fabric of reality has thinned, opening pathways for ancient energies. Magic oozes from cracks in stone, spirits awaken in forgotten forests, and pages of lost grimoires whisper in the depths of caves.

Arcanum Concordia is a call to those who sense the call of the wondrous. This is a story you will write together with your friends. Become an archmage studying dusty tomes, a druid forging an alliance with an ancient forest, or a dark alchemist using forbidden rituals. Here, everyone will find their own path to power, but the greatest secrets will be revealed only to those who can combine their powers.

✨ Schools of Magic (Choose Your Path)
This collection is built around four great magical traditions that complement rather than contradict each other:

Ars Nouveau (New Art): Elegant and intuitive magic of spells and automation. Craft unique spells, tame charming magical force-fellows, and build ritual chambers where energy itself will work wonders. A path for aesthetes and inventors.

EvilCraft (Evil Craft): Magic emerged from the shadows. Work with blood, corruption, and dark gems. Create fearsome weapons, command the undead, and erect gloomy towers. A path for those who are not afraid to pay the price for power.

Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks (Books of Conspiracies): Classic combat magic in the spirit of RPGs. Explore dungeons in search of ancient grimoires, learn and combine powerful spells—from a lightning shield to an icy prison. A path for adventurers and battle masters.

Roots Classic: Ancient, shamanic root magic. Connect with the spirits of nature, perform complex rituals under the stars, and create living staves that channel the power of the earth. A path for contemplators and guardians of balance.

🌍 A world full of wonders and dangers
Magic has changed not only you, but the entire world around you.

Explore the grand dungeons of When Dungeons Arise! and YUNG's Better Caves, filled with traps and treasures.

Venture into the magical yet dangerous Twilight Forest—an entire dimension with progression, puzzles, and epic boss battles.

Meet dozens of new creatures from Alex's Mobs: from cute cabbage snails to fearsome orcacoders. Some can be tamed, while others can yield rare alchemical components.

Decorate your tower with hundreds of parts from Supplementaries and establish a network of Waystones for instant travel around the world.

⚙️ Technology? No, High Art!
Even the creation of complex mechanisms is subject to magic here. The Create mod in this build is not just engineering, but kinetic sorcery. With it, you can build a truly moving artifact: a rotating observatory, an automatic ritual platform, or a secret portal that opens according to a complex algorithm. This is the magic of logic and movement.

🤝 Play Together
Arcanum Concordia is designed for co-op.

Combine forces: a druid's ritual can enhance a mage's spells, and one player's dark artifact can be the key to solving another's mystery.

Specialize or become a generalist. Share resources and knowledge.

Challenge powerful bosses and conquer dungeons shoulder to shoulder.

Build a shared Mage Citadel—the greatest monument to your alliance.

🔧 Installation and Requirements
Minimum Requirements:

Game RAM: 6 GB (8 GB recommended).

Server RAM: 4 GB (for 2-4 players, 6 GB recommended).

Forge: Version 47.2.0 or later for 1.20.1.

Recommended client mods (included in the build):

Embeddium/Canary — for high performance and shader support.

JourneyMap — for cooperative navigation.

JEI (Just Enough Items) is an indispensable encyclopedia of all recipes.

Almost Unified removes duplicate resources.

Wise Mage's Advice: Don't try to master all the schools at once. Choose one and become a master of it.

title: RPlay
description: RPlay is a customizable Minecraft plugin designed to enhance roleplaying experiences on your server.
body:
# RPlay Plugin

**Description:**
RPlay is a versatile and customizable Minecraft plugin designed to enhance roleplaying on your server. With features such as local and global chat commands, random rolls, and action attempts, RPlay adds depth and immersion to your gameplay. Easily configurable through the `config.yml` file, you can tailor message formats, colors, and language to suit your community's needs.

**Features:**
- **Local and Global Chat:** Differentiate between local and global roleplay messages with `/me` and `/gme` commands.
- **Customizable Messages:** Configure message formats, colors, and language (Russian or English) via the `config.yml` file.
- **Random Rolls:** Use the `/roll` command to generate random numbers, perfect for in-game decisions.
- **Action Attempts:** Add a layer of chance to your actions with the `/try` command, which determines success or failure.

**Commands:**
- `/me [message]` - Send a local roleplay message (visible within 200 blocks).
- `/gme [message]` - Send a global roleplay message (visible to all players).
- `/do [message]` - Send a descriptive roleplay message.
- `/roll` - Roll a random number between 1 and 100.
- `/try [message]` - Attempt an action with a chance of success or failure.
- `/rplay reload` - Reload the plugin configuration.

# Zombie Game Configuration

A comprehensive Minecraft mod that provides advanced configuration options for zombie gameplay. Customize every aspect of zombie behavior, evolution, and abilities through an intuitive configuration interface.

##  Key Features

** One-Click Configuration**
- Press `B` key to open the configuration screen
- Real-time configuration changes
- User-friendly interface with scrolling support

** Multi-Language Support**
- Complete English and Chinese localization
- Easy language switching within the interface

** Detailed Configuration Categories**
- **Basic Settings**: Evolution days, max zombies, evolution multipliers
- **Spawning Settings**: Group sizes, spawn chances, daylight/water spawning
- **Equipment Settings**: Armor/weapon chances, material preferences, enchantments
- **Behavior Settings**: Door breaking, wall climbing, target priorities
- **Special Abilities**: Reinforcement summoning, infection, explosions, fire immunity
- **Evolution Stages**: Multi-stage progression system (up to 5 stages)

** Evolution Stage System**
Each stage includes configurable:
- Activation day requirements
- Health/Damage/Speed multipliers
- Equipment probabilities and types
- Special abilities and reinforcements
- Block breaking capabilities

##  Usage

1. Install the mod
2. Press `B` in-game to open configuration
3. Adjust settings as desired
4. Save configuration
5. Restart game for changes to take effect

##  Technical Details

- **Mod ID**: `zombieconfig`
- **Supported Minecraft**: 1.20.1
- **Required**: Forge 47.4.10+
- **Client-side only**: No server installation required
- **Configuration Files**: Automatically generated in `config/zombieconfig-common.toml`

##  Configuration Highlights

**Basic Settings:**
- Zombie evolution day threshold
- Maximum zombies per player
- Evolution type (normal/fast/slow/adaptive)

**Spawning Control:**
- Minimum/Maximum spawn group sizes
- Spawn chance multipliers
- Daylight and water spawning toggles

**Equipment Customization:**
- Base armor and weapon probabilities
- Enchanted gear chances
- Preferred material types (leather, iron, diamond, etc.)

**Behavior Modifiers:**
- Door breaking and opening capabilities
- Wall climbing ability
- Player and villager target priorities

**Special Abilities:**
- Reinforcement summoning chances
- Infection probability and duration
- Death explosion chances
- Fire immunity

**Evolution Stages (1-5):**
- Stage activation days
- Attribute multipliers (health, damage, speed)
- Equipment probabilities and types
- Special ability unlocks
- Reinforcement counts

##  For Server Owners

This mod is client-side only and doesn't require server installation. Players can customize their zombie experience individually without affecting others.

# Mobmanity
_Mobmanity is a Minecraft datapack that makes mobs behave more like players.
They can spawn with a wide variety of vanilla items—and they know how to use them. From pickaxes and blocks to ender pearls and elytras, every mob encounter becomes unpredictable and intense.
On top of that, mobs can gain one of six unique behavior patterns, making each fight feel dynamic and challenging._

### All items mobs can spawn with:

- Wind Charge (if version allows) – Thrown at player
- Fire Charge – Thrown at player
- Cobweb – Placed near/on player
- TNT – Placed near/on player
- Iron Pickaxe – Used to mine toward the player
- Iron Axe – Used for melee attacks
- Flint and Steel – Sets player on fire
- Ender Pearl – Thrown away from or toward player
- Splash Potion – Thrown at player or self
- Goat Horn – Rallies nearby mobs to target the player
- Lava Bucket – Placed near/on player
- Water Bucket – Placed near/on player
- Totem of Undying – Prevents death
- Golden Apple – Consumed when health is low
- Firework Rockets – Shot from crossbows
- Cobblestone – Used to build up to the player
- Elytra – Used to glide toward the player
- Turtle Helmet – Just for fun :D

### What mobs can ride on:

- Horse
- Zombie horse
- Skeleton horse

### Mob behavior types:

- Athletic: The mob will be faster, run up cliffs easy (if version allows it), do less damage and jump over deep cliffs to get to the player.
- Aggressor: The mob will do more damage, be a bit slower and jump at players that are near him.
- Stalker: The mob will be a bit faster, be fully silent and do more damage on a backstab to players.
- Leader: The mob will make mobs around him stronger depending on how many mobs are around him.
- Tank: The mob will be slower, have a lot of armor and get less damage from far away (far bow shots, far trident shots, ...)
- Frightened: The mob will run away from the player to regenerate health when on low health.

description: Official plugin used for the "Speedrun" variant of the Molehunt game by Piffin380.
body:
# MolehuntSpeedrun
Official Minecraft plugin used in the Molehunt Speedrun youtube videos

Molehunt Speedrun is one of Piffin380's game series, and is better explained
[in the videos themselves](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4I6DrKDet7w). This readme will be more focused on plugin
setup.

To install, just plop the file into a bukkit fork (spigot, paper, etc.) server and start the server. This will generate
the configuration file to edit values for the plugin. The configurable values go as follows:
- The `moles` value changes the amount of moles that the game starts with.
- The `borderSize` value changes the size of the world border upon starting. The border always centers around 0, 0
- The `spreadDistance` value determines how far players will be teleported from spawn.
- The `irisMode` boolean defaults to false and should be set to true if your players are adamant about using Iris or
  some other shader mod that replaces Minecraft's default rendering system. If this value is false and players use Iris,
  the locator bar looks like it does in the video linked above.

Be sure to reload your server after modifying any of these values!

This plugin requires the use of a resource pack for the locator bar. The below values can be set in the
`server.properties` file to have players automatically download the pack upon joining the game. If you prefer to
download the pack manually, it is `molehuntSpeedrun.zip` in the github repo.

````
require-resource-pack=true
resource-pack=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pm7-dev/MolehuntSpeedrun/refs/heads/main/MolehuntSpeedrun.zip
resource-pack-id=
resource-pack-prompt=
resource-pack-sha1=c64b781855d7011af72210535a317453e941db72
````

Before starting, Have every player switch to the same skin (or use a skin swapper plugin), and unbind player list keys so nobody accidentally views the tab list. The moles, once selected, can rebind their tab key. Also remember to add the empty end portal at the center of the world you are using.  

As of update 1.1, this plugin disables joining and leaving messages, so make sure to coordinate once all your players are online lol

To start the game, run `/startmolehunt` from an operator account.  
To reset the game when finished, run `/resetmolehunt`.

title: Expected
description: Expected is a modification for Minecraft focused on the selective reworking of various game mechanics.
body:
### About

**Expected** is a modification for Minecraft focused on the selective reworking of various game mechanics. The goal is to improve balance, increase difficulty, and update forgotten or overly powerful features. The mod carefully preserves the vanilla atmosphere while introducing systematic and logical changes—especially regarding elytra usage, mending, anvils, and brewing.

### [Give me a dollar (ko-fi)](https://ko-fi.com/swproducts)

### Changes to Elytra Mechanics

#### Disabling Mending Enchantment on Elytra
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/Ugkxw-lwWD1mf5ugfZTDetbeLBI7tWd-teS4?si=Y_oUAvC-fWnTtCEQ)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35384f5aa6efc1f513da5234f0a39588c25af27f.png)

Elytra can no longer be enchanted with Mending. This prevents their unlimited use and reinforces the value of the resource.  

#### Cooldown for Firework Use During Flight  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxkRhE7lCgeTjDInCF-_teGIXU9vP5Ay7N?si=Saql7Rg4xsxWGk-d)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9bf917b02f9b7221250954e28af7fa2374bd34d.png)

When using a firework while flying with elytra, the player must wait before using it again. This limitation encourages more deliberate and mindful movement.  

#### Reduced Elytra Durability
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxmuE4jcPZ7jCpP6_e_DCg23G_cfBOGCqx?si=Nm116V2vbcbmm9xV)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19d6bf17425cad5240de67857723941ed36b0cf1.png)

The base durability of elytra has been decreased from 432 to 312 points, prompting users to be more cautious and strategic in their use.  

#### New Enchantment for Elytra  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxAkuS4_CWXNI-LMSTp7p3s611DF4-SCj9?si=qL8zpDmsd4GLPxUl)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/261e77168f912d05ac406c65c80f2a6236a15cac.png)

A unique enchantment has been added that reduces the cooldown between firework uses. This enchantment is exclusive and can only be found in End structures—specifically in End Cities.  

### Changes to Mending Mechanics  

#### Durability Loss During Mending via Anvil  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/Ugkx9WLsUm-BMYNZUKmVNi6QKmAa5Xm8pqTU?si=vVnD6Lubc-dMzSyh)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3b547cac0b58ca53eaab31712a4ef0e76fcc7a2.png)

When using an anvil to apply the Mending enchantment, the item loses 50% of its maximum durability. This change makes the decision to repair more significant and diminishes the previously overpowered effect of this enchantment.  

#### Modified Anvil Repair Principle  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxQgS2TU5ujOxmAH6RXs-cgpi7opjS2iq0?si=FqQwU1Kle2w87Qw5)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3ec2f1d0a785ab8d00d33fe6102c5052658a3bc.png)

The maximum repair cost for any item via the anvil is now capped at 25 levels.  

### New Potions  

#### Gravity Potion  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/Ugkxpb0AsbOkwY-hYwFO07seNx_cyAlHinng?si=CZ4Hiq5zv2earb9c)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a163ba592a218eef8890ed8353f982fba6277cf0.png)

Brewed by adding a Wither Skeleton’s bone to a Potion of Leaping in a brewing stand—effectively inverting its effect.  
**Effect:** Complete immunity to knockback and suppression of the Levitation effect.  

#### Levitation Potion  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxpI98BFQnyfBIeTVRCBVW79D8hOCbtY84?si=3GCBCz_SOKfZU971)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0a61b2f29b8ddfa54856528b66a1814fde5f78e.png)

Created through the standard brewing system using a Shulker Shell fragment.  
**Effect:** Grants the player levitation, allowing them to overcome obstacles, take flight, and cross deep chasms. Its combination with the Gravity Potion is especially useful when traveling in the End.  

#### Chorus Potion  
[Video clip](https://youtube.com/clip/UgkxwAXj1gtL2w8S_Yc5222M8zRrRTEMfvlY?si=GHD2h2a5UW_yMQKj)

![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2777f2ab4e57a3f1c7d4ffee1a2d547ad13c724b.png)

Prepared from roasted chorus.  
**Effect:** When the player takes damage, they are teleported a short distance, mimicking the effect of a Chorus Fruit. This potion can be lifesaving in dangerous situations or help in avoiding encirclement.

title: Block Chat
description: A simple plugin that disables chat. Easy to use.
body:
**ChatBlocker** is a lightweight and easy-to-use chat control plugin for Spigot and Paper servers. It lets you quickly enable or disable the server chat, making it perfect for staff announcements, events, or keeping things calm during busy moments.

**Features**
- **Instant toggle.** Turn the chat on or off instantly with a simple command.
- **Custom message.** Set a personalized message that players see when chat is disabled.
- **Saves your settings.** Remembers chat state and message across restarts.
- **Lightweight and efficient.** No dependencies, minimal performance impact.

**Commands:**
- ```/blockchat``` — Toggle the chat on or off.
- ```/blockchat message <text>``` — Change the message displayed when chat is disabled.

**Example:**
```
/blockchat
> Chat has been disabled!

/blockchat message Chat is currently off for maintenance!
> Disabled message has been updated!
```

body:
# Creative Faces

A creative plugin that allows Minecraft servers to show the face of players in the chat, scoreboard, tab, signs, items and everywhere you can write text!

`creative-faces` uses [creative-central](https://modrinth.com/plugin/central), *the plugin that unifies
resource-packs*, and a placeholder system like [MiniPlaceholders](https://modrinth.com/plugin/miniplaceholders)
or [PlaceholderAPI](https://spigotmc.org/resources/6245/)

![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ghzB8Af7/images/2e8ac856ec4b13ec9c29703e8a075e45f26edac9.png)

Shared Everything is a Fabric multiplayer mod that **links all online players together** — what happens to one, happens to all. Health, hunger, experience, effects, and inventory are fully synchronized across every player on the server in real time.

---

**📷 Media**

*Screenshots coming soon!*

---

<details>
<summary>⚙️ What gets shared?</summary>

❤️ **Health**  
Damage taken by one player is instantly distributed to all others. Healing works the same way — recover together or die together.

🍗 **Hunger & Saturation**  
Food levels are constantly averaged across all players. Eating feeds everyone. Starving hurts everyone.

⭐ **Experience & Levels**  
Every XP gain is shared in real time. Kill a mob, gain XP — and so does every other player online. Level up as a team.

🧪 **Status Effects**  
Drink a strength potion? Everyone gets strong. Get poisoned? Everyone suffers. The most powerful active effect always applies to all players.

🎒 **Inventory**  
Every item picked up, crafted, or moved is immediately mirrored to all connected players. One inventory for everyone.

<details>

This mod is perfect for players who:

• Want a **true shared survival** experience with friends

• Enjoy **experimental and chaotic** multiplayer scenarios  

Whether you're carefully coordinating every move or descending into beautiful chaos — Shared Everything makes multiplayer feel like nothing else.

# 🧲 Magnet, Let me get that! ### 🎮 Version Compatibility & Parity This mod is active and fully supported across both major version streams: * **Minecraft 26.2+**: Current public release — **`v1.1.8`** * **Minecraft 26.1.2**: Current public release — **`v1.0.10`** Both versions are designed to run fully server-side with vanilla client compatibility, though newer performance fixes and thread-safe packets are standardized on the 26.2+ release. > **"If you can see it, you should have it."** **Magnet, Let me get that!** is an intrinsic extension of your will. It creates a constant, powerful vacuum that pulls items and XP orbs directly to you. No items to hold, no energy to charge — just pure convenience. Part of the **Instant Gratification Collection** — mods that respect the player's time. --- ## ✨ Features ### 🌪️ The Vacuum Field Command the materials around you with surgical precision.

- **Intrinsic Magnetism**: No need to craft, hold, or equip a special item. The vacuum effect is tied directly to your player. - **Phase Shifting (NoClip)**: Items don't get stuck on walls or under floors. They phase through terrain to reach your inventory. - **LOS Awareness**: Magnetism respects Line of Sight to keep exploration challenging. - **Terminal Velocity**: Items accelerate smoothly but aggressively towards you. - **XP Sync**: Experience Orbs obey the same physical laws. Leave nothing behind. ### 🎯 Individual Player Toggles You have full control over your personal vacuum field. - **Dedicated Hotkey**: Press **`\` (backslash)** to instantly toggle your magnet on or off in-game. Fully rebindable via the standard Minecraft Controls menu. - **Chat Command**: You can also use the `/magnet toggle` command to switch your status. - **Save State Persistence**: Your preference is saved directly to your player NBT save file (`level.dat`). It persists through deaths, dimension travel (Nether/End), and server restarts. - **Login Auto-Sync**: The server automatically synchronizes your toggle status to your client upon joining, keeping HUD overlays in perfect sync. ### ⚙️ Pure GameRules Control Configure every aspect of the vacuum field via the vanilla **Edit Game Rules** screen or commands.

- **Radius Control**: Adjust the pull distance (Default: 12 blocks). - **Instant Warp Mode**: Toggle between smooth flight or instant teleportation to inventory. - **Visual Trails**: Optional cosmetic particles to track magnetized items. - **Occlusion Settings**: Configure whether the magnet is blocked by transparent blocks, flora, or interactive furniture. --- ## ⚙️ Configuration (Native Game Rules) No messy config files. The mod uses the **Native Minecraft Game Rules** system. All mod parameters are grouped into a dedicated **"Magnet"** category in the official UI. ### 📋 Quick Commands ```sql /gamerule ig:magnet_range 24 → Double the range /gamerule ig:magnet_instant true → Warp items directly to inventory /gamerule ig:magnet_los_only true → Require line-of-sight /gamerule ig:magnet_affects_xp false → Disable XP magnetism ``` --- ## 💻 Server-Side Optional & Client Gating - **Server-Side Optional**: "Magnet, Let me get that!" is fully compatible with vanilla clients! Vanilla clients can connect to servers running the mod without installing it. - **Dedicated Server Support**: Client-only rendering logic is isolated to prevent classloading crashes on headless dedicated servers. - **Performance Hardened**: Scan algorithms are highly optimized. ## Overview

Transform your Minecraft world with special slime blocks that propel players through the air! This lightweight plugin adds custom launcher blocks that send players soaring in their facing direction when stepped on, opening up exciting possibilities for parkour courses, adventure maps, and creative gameplay experiences.

## Features

- **Custom Launch Blocks**: Special slime blocks that propel players in their facing direction
- **Configurable Physics**: Fine-tune launch power and height to create the perfect trajectory

- **Permission System**: Control who can create and use launchers

- **Mini-Games**: Design unique race courses and obstacle challenges
- **Transportation Systems**: Build fun and creative ways to travel across your builds
- **PvP Arenas**: Add vertical elements to combat with strategic launch points

Players can place special slime blocks that function as launchers. When stepping on these blocks, they'll be propelled forward in their facing direction with a slight upward boost. The physics are fully configurable, allowing server owners to create the perfect feel for their specific needs.

title: SinceDungeon
description: Advanced instanced dungeon plugin for Paper 1.21+. In-game GUI editor, party system, and randomized gacha loot.
body:
# 🛡️ SinceDungeon - The Ultimate Instanced Dungeon System

**SinceDungeon** is a high-performance, premium-grade instanced dungeon plugin designed natively for modern Minecraft servers (Paper 1.21+). It empowers server owners to create seamless, isolated adventure experiences with zero-trust security, advanced RPG mechanics, and professional-tier optimization.

Unlike traditional dungeon plugins, SinceDungeon is built for **stability, absolute customizability, and extreme replayability**. From dynamic rogue-like generation and PAPI-conditional command executions to a fully interactive In-Game GUI Editor—SinceDungeon is the only framework you need to build epic mob arenas, intricate storylines, or competitive speedrun challenges.

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🌌 Professional Instancing & Zero-Trust Security
* **Isolated Async Worlds:** Every dungeon run is a fresh clone of your template, generated on a separate thread to ensure **zero TPS drops**, then automatically deleted after completion to keep your server clean.
* **Deep-Clone Inventory Protection:** Players' inventories, armor, and EXP are securely deep-cloned into RAM upon entry, then completely wiped. This guarantees no one can smuggle OP items into the dungeon or bring dungeon-exclusive quest items out.
* **Exploit Prevention:** Natively blocks teleportation (Ender Pearls, Chorus Fruit), item dropping, and unauthorized command usage while inside an instance.

### ⚡ Conditional Lifecycle Automation (NEW)
Automate your dungeon's flow without messy Command Blocks. Execute console commands automatically at specific lifecycle triggers:
* **On-Start / On-Finish / On-Stage-Complete:** Trigger commands dynamically as players progress.
* **First-Time Clear Hook:** Define commands that strictly execute *only* when a player beats a dungeon for the very first time (Perfect for granting exclusive Titles, Milestone Ranks, or unique Lore items).
* **PAPI Conditional Logic:** Format your commands as `[condition] command_here`. The plugin evaluates PlaceholderAPI logic before running it! Example: `[%vault_eco_balance%;>=;500] eco give %player% 100`

### ⏱️ Persistent Cooldowns & Gacha Tickets (NEW)
* **Per-Player, Per-Map Cooldowns:** Prevent endless grinding by forcing players to wait a configurable amount of time before re-entering a cleared map.
* **Interactive Cooldown Tickets:** Monetize your server or reward active players with NBT-protected Gacha items:
  * **Cooldown Reset Ticket:** Instantly wipes ALL active dungeon cooldowns.
  * **Time Skip Ticket:** Reduces all active cooldowns by a specific amount of time.
* **PlaceholderAPI Tracking:** Display remaining cooldown times live on scoreboards via `%sincedungeon_cooldown_<map>%`.

### 🛠️ Revolutionary In-Game Editor
* **No YAML Hassle:** Create stages, spawn waves, set conditions, and configure rewards entirely through a beautiful, paginated In-Game GUI.
* **Dynamic Actions:**
  * **Spawn Waves & Mythic Bosses:** Vanilla or MythicMobs integration (Supports scaling with party size and mixed random mob pools!).
  * **Control The Zone:** Hold a specific area as the radius shrinks over time, fighting off interference mobs.
  * **Unlock Door & Find Key:** Give players a tracking compass to hunt down a physical key and unlock a sealed path.
  * **Breakable Barriers:** Magical walls that crumble asynchronously when a trigger block is destroyed.
  * **Loot Chests:** Reward players mid-run with randomized loot.

### 🎲 Rogue-like Progression & High Stakes
* **Randomize Stages:** Shuffle the middle stages of your dungeon on every run to make speedrunning dynamic and unpredictable.
* **Percent Chance Stages:** Create rare, hidden treasure rooms or traps that only spawn a certain percentage of the time.
* **Action Time Limits:** Add high-stakes pressure by forcing players to complete objectives within a strict time limit, or face heavy life penalties.

### ❤️ Lives & Immortality System
* **RPG Mechanics:** Limit how many times players can enter a dungeon. Players lose lives when dying or failing action time-limits.
* **Passive Regeneration:** Lives regenerate over time based on custom or global intervals, even when offline.
* **Soul Crystals:** Distribute special consumable items that restore lives, complete with modern 1.21+ item components, sounds, and particles.

### 🏆 Interactive Leaderboards & Statistics
* **Fully Automated Tracking:** Natively tracks **Fastest Clears**, **Most Kills**, and **Most Clears** for every single dungeon.
* **In-Game GUI (`/dungeon top`):** Players can view rankings through an interactive, paginated GUI. Admins can wipe specific maps using `/sd top reset <map>`.
* **Optimized Database:** Powered by HikariCP, supporting both SQLite (Local) and MySQL (Network).

### 👥 Advanced Party & Dynamic Commands
* **Conflict-Free Dynamic Commands:** Core commands (`/party`, `/dungeon`, `/sincedungeon`) are no longer hardcoded! Fully rename them or assign custom aliases in `config.yml` to prevent conflicts with plugins like MMOCore.
* **Smart Entry Checks:** Automatically verifies every member for level, money, lives, and proximity before pulling the party in.
* **Cross-Server (Experimental):** Built-in Redis and BungeeCord/Velocity support to route players from a Lobby server to dedicated Dungeon Node servers.

### 🎁 Gacha Reward System
* **Time-Based Tiers:** Reward faster completions with more loot chests.
* **Randomized Pool:** Support for Vanilla items, MMOItems, and Console Commands.
* **Instanced Looting & Auto-Claim:** Each player gets their own personal reward GUI. If they disconnect or their inventory is full, rewards are auto-claimed and dropped safely at their feet.

---

## 🚀 Compatibility
* **Paper/Purpur:** 1.21 & 1.21.x (Native support) / 1.20.x (Legacy NMS fallback)
* **MythicMobs:** Create epic boss fights.
* **MMOItems:** Reward players with custom tier equipment.
* **PlaceholderAPI:** Custom entry conditions, lifecycle command logic, and stat tracking.
* **Vault:** Economy-based entry fees.
* **MySQL & Redis:** For large networks and cross-server setups.

---

## 📖 Useful Links
* **📚 Documentation (Wiki):** [Explore the Wiki](https://gitlab.com/sincerpg/SinceDungeon/-/wikis/home)
* **💬 Support & Community:** [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/zbMPtcM3wq)
* **🎮 Showcase:** [Watch on YouTube](https://youtu.be/Ff64QpAuU8M)

---

## 📄 Permissions
* `SinceDungeon.admin` - Access to the editor, reload, spectate, cooldown resets, and all admin commands.
* *Player commands (`/party`, `/dungeon join`, `/dungeon top`, `/dungeon lives`) are enabled for everyone by default.*

title: Xaero Seedmap
description: completes the map using the world's seed
body:
This mod enhances Xaero’s World Map by intelligently filling in unexplored areas using the world’s seed. Instead of the default black or empty regions where the player hasn’t traveled yet, the map is dynamically generated to display terrain as if it had already been explored.

By leveraging the world seed, the mod can accurately predict and render biomes, terrain shapes, and even certain naturally generated structures. This creates a seamless, fully populated map experience from the very beginning, allowing players to plan journeys, locate interesting areas, and understand their world at a glance—without needing to physically explore every chunk first.

In addition to terrain generation, the mod also visualizes select structures (such as villages, temples, or other seed-determined features), giving players valuable insight into potential points of interest. The result is a more informative and immersive mapping system that feels complete, responsive, and far more useful for exploration, navigation, and strategy.

title: AdminToolbox
description: Effective Minecraft moderation tools designed to prevent cheating.
body:
Effective Minecraft moderation tools designed to prevent cheating, maintaining staff integrity and community trust.

**AdminToolbox supports [Folia][folia].**

## Features & Commands

### Spectate

`/spectate`, `/admin`, `/target`

Enter admin mode, which creates a separate temporary inventory that is deleted when exiting. The player is placed in
Spectator Mode until they reveal or exit admin mode.

While spectating, the player can use the command again to exit admin mode. The player will be teleported back to their
original location, placed back into survival mode, and their original inventory will be restored.

#### Target Locations

- `/target` - Enter admin mode at current location
- `/target <player>` - Enter admin mode at a specified player's location
- `/target <x> <y> <z> [world]` - Enter admin mode at specific coordinates
- `/target <x> <z> [world]` - Enter admin mode at specific coordinates (uses the highest Y-level block at that location)

#### Targeting Spawn

`/spawn`, `/targetspawn`

- `/spawn` - Enter admin mode at the current world's spawn point
- `/spawn <world>` - Enter admin mode at the provided world's spawn point

#### Navigation

- `/back` - Move to previous location in teleport history
- `/forward` - Move to next location in teleport history

### Reveal

`/reveal`, `/show`

While spectating in admin mode, running this command places the player into survival mode at their current location.
This makes the admin visible to players during confrontations while maintaining:

- Temporary inventory
- Immunity to damage
- No mob targeting

#### Fullbright

`/fullbright`, `/nightvision`

- `/fullbright` - Toggle fullbright for the current admin session
- `/fullbright <on|off>` - Enable or disable fullbright for the current admin session

### Yell

`/yell <player> <message>`

Forcibly displays a large red title on the targeted player's screen.
Use the pipe character (`|`) to separate title and subtitle: `title | subtitle`.

Legacy ampersand [color codes] are supported. (i.e. `No stealing! | Did you read the &e/rules&r?`)

![A large red title displays within Minecraft: "No stealing!" A smaller subtitle below it reads "Did you read the /rules?", and "/rules" is highlighted in yellow.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ModernBetaNetwork/AdminToolbox/refs/heads/main/.assets/demo-yell.jpg)

### Freeze

`/freeze <player>`

Stops the target player from moving until released.

Frozen players:

- can look around freely
- can fall downward
- can use containers
- cannot place or break blocks
- cannot take any damage
- cannot hurt other entities (including players)
- cannot be targeted by mobs

To release a frozen player, use `/unfreeze <player>`

### Streamer Mode

**Requires LuckPerms.**

`/streamermode <duration>`, `/pausealerts <duration>`

Allows players to temporarily disable certain permissions (i.e. those that give them staff-only alerts), intended for
use when screen sharing or live-streaming gameplay.

#### Placeholder

When PlaceholderAPI is available, a placeholder is made available to display when a player has streamer mode active.

- ``%rel_streamermode_tag%``: Displays a `⬤` tag in red when streamer mode is active.
- ``%rel_streamermode_prefix%``: Displays the tag followed by a space when streamer mode is active.
- ``%rel_streamermode_suffix%``: Displays the tag preceded by a space when streamer mode is active.

## Permissions

| Permission                                   | Description                                                                                       |
|----------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `admintoolbox.target`                        | Use `/target` at current location                                            |
| `admintoolbox.target.player`                 | Use `/target <player>`                                                       |
| `admintoolbox.target.location`               | Use `/target <x> [y] <z> [world]`                                            |
| `admintoolbox.reveal`                        | Use `/reveal`                                                                          |
| `admintoolbox.yell`                          | Use `/yell`                                                                              |
| `admintoolbox.freeze`                        | Use `/freeze` and `/unfreeze`                                                          |
| `admintoolbox.spawn`                         | Use `/spawn` in current world                                                 |
| `admintoolbox.spawn.all`                     | Use `/spawn [world]`                                                          |
| `admintoolbox.fullbright`                    | Use `/fullbright` while in admin mode                                              |
| `admintoolbox.broadcast.receive`             | Receive alerts about others' targets actions. |
| `admintoolbox.broadcast.exempt`              | Do not send alerts to players with `admintoolbox.broadcast.receive`                               |
| `admintoolbox.streamermode`                  | Use streamer mode                                                               |
| `admintoolbox.streamermode.unlimited`        | Bypass maximum streamer mode duration. (Set in config.yml)                                        |
| `admintoolbox.streamermode.placeholder.wear` | Wear the streamer mode status placeholder.                                                        |
| `admintoolbox.streamermode.placeholder.view` | View other players' streamer mode status placeholders.                                            |

## Integrations

- **[LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/)**
    - Required for streamer mode.
    - **New in version 1.4.0:** Custom context for conditionally applying permissions based on admin state.
        - **`admintoolbox:state`** can be any of `spectating`, `revealed`, or `normal` (not in admin mode).
- **[BlueMap](https://bluemap.bluecolored.de)**
    - The plugin will hide admins who are revealed from the map.
- **[PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi)**
    - The plugin provides a placeholder for players' streamer mode status.
    - Players must have the appropriate permissions to wear and view the placeholder.

## Analytics

**Added in version 1.4.0.**

For us to better understand how many servers are using AdminToolbox, by default we collect anonymized analytics via
bStats. Server administrators can disable this functionality on their servers by setting `enabled: false` in
`plugins/bStats/config.yml`.

The anonymized collected data is viewable publicly at https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/AdminToolbox/26406.

[folia]: https://papermc.io/software/folia

title: Lib99j
description: Another useful library mod for server-side development.
body:
## About
This is a mod used as a base for all my mods. Feel free to use it if you wish.

### Library Features
- VFX including locking camera, overlays, and more
- Server-side gui textures
- Server-side particles
- Hide bossbars
- Custom effects
- Pondering
- Easy config creation
- And more...

## Usage
**On mod initialization, please run Lib99j.ensureLoaded(). This forces the library to load before yours, which allows all the features to work correctly**

### build.gradle (Version number from modrinth)
```
repositories {
	maven { url = 'https://dj.ucc.asn.au/maven/' }
}

dependencies {
  implementation include("com.daniel99j:djutil:1.1")
  implementation include("com.daniel99j:lib99j:VERSION")
}
```



### Ponder (Server-side)
This is a re-creation of Create Mod's ponder system, now server-side. See [https://modrinth.com/mod/ponderplus](https://modrinth.com/mod/ponderplus) for an example.

Features:
- No client mods
- Skip, rewind, and pause
- If installed alongside Polydex or Booklet, click once to open a ponder
- Fast
- Does not change the player - neither the server or client know you are pondering, everything happens at the network level
- Fully self-contained
- No real-world changes
- Works with Polymer and server-side mods (and client ones too!)

Controls (in-game hud shows these):
- F: Identify - fly around and it will show what you are looking at
- SPACE: Pause/play
- Q: Exit
- L: Open menu
- S: Restart scene
- D: Next scene (if possible)
- A: Previous scene (if possible)
- SCROLL: Select step to skip to
- W: Skip to selected step

Commands:
```
/ponder all <id>
/ponder item <item>
/ponder item <item> scene <id>
/ponder item hand
/ponder item hand <id>
/ponder scene pause
/ponder scene unpause
/ponder scene exit
```


Dev commands:

```
/ponder dev ui_creator -> Opens the UI creator.
/ponder dev ui_creator_from <ponder command> -> Opens the UI creator after running the specified ponder command
/ponder dev toggle_free_movement -> Toggle free movement in a ponder scene
/ponder dev get_edits -> Lists all interactions made with the world in free move mode
```


UI creator:
- Stained glass shows safe area
- Open menu [L] to start editing
- If on the client hold shift in the menu to see what ponder ui coordinate the cursor is over, CTRL-C to copy

Demo video:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/AFEpMs1cQRs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### Game properties
- enableHideableBossbar() makes yellow bossbars white, and using BossBarVisibility you can make any bossbar invisible
- enableCustomEffectBadLuck() makes the unluck effect show as "Custom Effect (/polymer effects)" and have a custom sprite
- enablePonder() enables ponder (see above)
- enableAddingAssetTranslationsToServer() makes all lang files in the assets folder be treated as a server translation in Nucleoid Server Translations API

### Configs
- Lib99j also provides an easy to use config api
- Per-world, common, client only, and server only configuration options
- Optional client syncing
- Uses cloth config for screen
- In-game server side dialog re-creation of cloth config (/lib99j config {modid})
- Mod menu support
- JSON serialization through GSON
- Supports primitives, identifiers, vec2, vec3, colours automatically in all config screens and config files
- Use ConfigManager.addConfig(modid, modconfig) to add configs. Each ModConfig contains a nullable ConfigHolder for each context. Just supply a config class and you're done
- Use ServerConfigCopy.getConfigOption(modid, serializedName, optionClass, fallback) to get a synced option from the server (option must be annotated with sync = true)

Example config class:
```
public class ExampleConfig {
    @ConfigEntry
    public boolean testBool = true;

    @ConfigEntry(sync = true)
    @SerializedName("wavy_ui")
    public boolean wavyUi = false;

    //Object primitives work too!
    @ConfigEntry(min = 0, max = 10000)
    public Integer explosionDamage = 10;

    @ConfigEntry(displayType = ConfigDisplayType.SLIDER, max = 50, min = 0)
    public int explosionSize = 10;

    @ConfigEntry(displayType = ConfigDisplayType.COLOUR_PICKER)
    public int worldTint = 0xff00ff;

    @ConfigEntry(displayType = ConfigDisplayType.COLOUR_PICKER_ALPHA)
    public int overlayColour = 0xff0000ff;

    @ConfigEntry
    public Identifier packId = Identifier.withDefaultNamespace("test");

    @ConfigEntry
    public Vec2 spawnRotation = Vec2.ZERO;

    @ConfigEntry
    public Vec3 spawnPos = Vec3.ZERO;

    //ChatFormatting is an Enum
    @ConfigEntry
    public ChatFormatting formatType = ChatFormatting.RED;
}
```

### Mod install status
- Use ModInstallManager.syncInstalledStatus(modid) to mark your mod to have its install status synced, then use ModInstallManager.isInstalled(modid, player) to check if the mod is installed on the client

### Gui Utils
- By default, Lib99j generates a font space range of -256 to 256 (Note, when using eg, space=270, it uses a combo of 256 and 14!). Use GuiUtils.getSpace() and related functions
- GuiUtils.nextPage(), GuiUtils.previousPage(), and GuiUtils.head() create player heads for use in guis
- GuiUtils.doesPlayerHaveMods() allows you to see what mods are installed, read the documentation for more info
- GuiUtils.toast() displays an advancement popup with a custom item and text
- **Now for the meat of it!**
- GuiUtils.generateTexture() and GuiUtils.generateColourableTexture() creates a GuiElementBuilder that has an auto generated item model and definition. Texture format: "examplemod", "ui/test/image". Note that other base paths are accepted, but it is recommended to use /ui/ as other functions use this solely
- GuiUtils.generateBarTexture() creates a vertical bottom to top filling bar with a base, fill, and overlay.
- BackgroundTextures are a basic inventory-based font background generator, eg: new BackgroundTexture(Identifier.fromNamespaceAndPath(MagmaNetworkMod.MOD_ID, "test/test_ui"), 176). Uses /ui/ for texture references.
- 

### VFX
- VfxUtils.shake() causes a camerashake effect similar to bedrock edition
- VfxUtils.addGenericScreenEffect() adds many other client-side effect such as:
- RED_TINT - Red worldborder tint
- SNOW - Powder snow overlay
- FIRE - Self-explanatory
- NAUSEA - You get it.
- BLACK_HEARTS - Withered hearts
- GREEN_HEARTS - Poisoned hearts
- GREEN_HUNGER - Green hunger haunches
- BLINDNESS - The blindness effect
- NIGHT_VISION - The night vision effect
- CONDUIT_POWER - The conduit power effect
- DARKNESS - Warden darkness effect
- LOCK_CAMERA_AND_POS - More complicated, explained next.
- 
- **Camera Locking**
- To lock the player's camera and movement, add the LOCK_CAMERA_AND_POS effect
- setCameraInterpolation, setCameraPos, setCameraPitch, and setCameraYaw control varius aspects of the locked camera
- Due to technical reasons, the player is unable to see the hotbar, and the game looks like it is in spectator mode
- registerCameraLockHandler registers a camera lock handler for a source id, which supplies camera rotation and player
- 
- **MISC**
- VfxUtils.clientSideExplode() causes a client-side explosion destroying blocks (ONLY ON THE CLIENT). Use only for cinematics, as ghost blocks are buggy
- VfxUtils.fireworkExplode() creates a firework explosion as if a firework actually spawned
- VfxUtils.sendFakeEntity() sends a client side entity. Note it will never be removed normally, so it is only recommended to use this with lightning bolts or other entities that will be auto-removed
- 

### Particles
WORK IN PROGRESS FEATURE, may experience heavy server lag.
Rework will happen soon when I have time.
### Misc
- PlayPacketUtils contains a list of all PLAY packets
- ConfigUtils has some basic configuration functions
- GameProperties has some toggles and information about the game



This project has no affiliation with Create Mod, Ponder, or any similar mods.

title: Proper Fletching
description: Adds proper utility to the fletching table, allowing arrows and potions to be crafted into tipped arrows.
body:
# Proper Fletching

**Proper Fletching** gives the fletching table real functionality in vanilla-style gameplay.

Instead of being mostly decorative, the fletching table can now be used to craft **tipped arrows** using arrows and potions — no crafting table clutter, no custom items, just a clean and intuitive interface.

---

## ✨ Features

- Adds a **custom fletching table interface**
- Combine **arrows + potions** to create tipped arrows
- Supports:
  - Regular potions
  - Splash potions
  - Lingering potions
- Uses **vanilla tipped arrows** (no duplicates or replacements)
- Returns empty **glass bottles** when using potion bottles
- Vanilla-friendly and lightweight

---

## 🏹 How It Works

1. Open a **Fletching Table**
2. Insert:
   - **Arrows** in the top slot
   - **Potion** in the bottom slot
3. Take the **tipped arrows** from the output slot

### Output Amount
- **Regular potion** → up to **32** tipped arrows
- **Splash or lingering potion** → up to **16** tipped arrows

The potion’s effects are transferred directly to the arrows.


![Potion Bottles work on up to 32 arrows at once](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f7ee066e468587ec8238e4566b588653a059909_0.webp)
Potion Bottles work on up to 32 arrows at once, returning an empty bottle

![Splash Potions work on up to 16 arrows](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7a2bbb4f56f9127d6d17b08b22b185c6cc67c73_0.webp)
Splash Potions work on up to 16 arrows and are used up when crafted

![Lingering Potions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fd38d8f1e4b07607317c67d785ea8f3f9d6971a_0.webp)
Lingering Potions work the same way as splash potions

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility

- Designed for **vanilla-style progression**
- No recipe conflicts
- Works alongside other mods that don’t replace the fletching table
- Server-side safe (clients only need the mod for the UI)

---

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.9-1.21.11**
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

title: Orbital's Radish Mod
description: A basic food mod that adds radishes, radish blocks, a radish weapon, and more!
body:
Adds a fully-featured radish crop and item set to Minecraft (Forge 1.20.x). Designed to behave like vanilla potatoes/carrots villagers can harvest, replant, and trade; zombies can drop radishes, pigs can be tempted and bred with radishes, stonecutter and smelting recipes, and radish block building variants (stairs/slabs/walls).

![Orbital radish mod logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46aff2651dd3136e83d7fbaa1a285bc768335994_0.webp)



# Features
- Radish crop block (8 growth stages) and radish item (raw & cooked).
- Villager integration: farmers harvest and replant radishes; radishes usable in trades.
- Pig integration: pigs are tempted by radishes, can be fed to grow or breed.
- Zombie loot: zombies can drop radishes; drops are cooked if zombie is on fire.
- Recipes: stonecutter, smelting, smoking and campfire cooking; shapeless radish stew recipe.
- Building blocks: radish block, stairs, slabs, walls, and radish bricks.
