title: SkinSpice
description: Spice up your skin with more customization!
body:
# SkinSpice

[![github](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/github_vector.svg)](https://github.com/jirisitera/skinspice)

SkinSpice is a Minecraft resource pack that allows you to customize your skin a bit more with the help of Vanilla core shaders. That's right, no mods are required to use SkinSpice features!

## Features

- **Blinking Eyes**: Make your character blink by adding a frame with closed eyes to your skin. You can even customize the blinking speed and whether the animation is interpolated or not.

- **Custom Damage Tint**: Change the color of the red tint that appears when your character takes damage.

## Downloading SkinSpice

Installing the resource pack is simple, and the same as with any other resource pack:

1. Download the latest version of the resource pack on Modrinth and place it into your Minecraft `resourcepacks` folder.
2. Enable the resource pack in Minecraft.

Now, when you encounter any player with a skin that uses SkinSpice features, you will see the effects.

## Adding SkinSpice features to your skin

Before we begin, you'll need to have your skin image. You can download your current skin from [minecraft.net (Edit Skin Page)](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/msaprofile/mygames/editskin) or use any skin you have saved locally.

### Easy route: Using the web tool

This part can get a little tedious. Fortunately, I have created a web tool to add SkinSpice features to your skin. You can find it here: [https://skin.golmc.cz](https://skin.golmc.cz) (or click the badge below)

[![website](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/documentation/website_vector.svg)](https://skin.golmc.cz)

### Harder route: Manually edit your skin

To add SkinSpice features to your skin manually, you'll need to edit the skin image using an image editor that supports transparency (like Photoshop, GIMP, or Paint.NET).

> If you get lost along the way, you can refer to the example image of the Steve skin with SkinSpice features provided below nearly at the end of this README.

#### Blinking Frame

You must add a frame of your face with closed eyes. This can be done by just copying the front face texture and modifying the eyes to be closed.

Then, place this new frame between these two coordinates on your skin image: [24, 0] and [31, 7]. This area is located above the back texture of the head and on the right size of the bottom texture of the head.

Next, do the same for the overlay layer of the head (if your skin has one). The area where you need to place this frame is the same as for the base layer, relative to the overlay layer. But just for completeness, the coordinates for the overlay layer are between [56, 0] and [63, 7].
 
> Unless your skin does not have an overlay layer for the head, you must add the blinking frame to both the base layer and the overlay layer of the head. Not doing so will result in visual glitches during the blinking animation.

#### Control Pixels

All of these pixel **must** be fully opaque, meaning they must **not** be transparent at all.

- A pixel located at coordinates [0, 0] (top left) needs to have exactly the values of this HEX color code: `#00c0ff`.
- Another pixel located at [1, 0] (to the right of the previous) is used to customize blinking values.
  - The **red** channel value sets the duration of the first (vanilla) frame of the face. The values is in 1/10th of a second, which means a value of 40 will be 4 seconds.
  - The **green** channel value sets the duration of the second (custom) frame of the face. The values is in 1/10th of a second, which means a value of 40 will be 4 seconds.
  - The **blue** channel decides if the animation should be interpolated. If the value is exactly 0, then no interpolation will be done, otherwise the animation will be interpolated.
- Additionally, if you want to customize the damage tint, a pixel located at [2, 0] is used for that. The color of this pixel is directly used for the new color of the damage tint.

#### Reference Image

Here is a reference image showing where to place the blinking frame and control pixels:

![Example Skin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21a2b95697fadd9f99dde32e2bba58cf28b8f8e3.png)

## License

SkinSpice is licensed under the MIT License. Feel free to use and modify it as you see fit!

title: CaveBlock - Underground Survival
description: Extreme underground survival. Start deep in a cave with nothing - dig, mine, and build your way to the surface.
body:
# ⛏️ CaveBlock — Can You Dig Your Way Out?

You wake up deep underground. No sky, no trees, no surface. Just stone in every direction.

CaveBlock flips the SkyBlock formula upside down — literally. Instead of starting above the void and building down, you start buried underground and must mine, dig, and tunnel your way toward the surface. Every block you break is progress. Every cave you discover is an opportunity.

## 🎮 How It Works

- 🪨 **Start underground** — surrounded by stone, deepslate, and darkness
- ⛏️ **Mine everything** — resources are earned through digging, not generators
- 🔦 **Discover caves** — natural cave systems, ores, and lava await
- ☀️ **Reach the surface** — break through to the sky and build above ground
- 👥 **Teams** — work together to excavate faster

## ⚙️ Features

- **Inverted SkyBlock** — a fresh take for players tired of void islands
- **Configurable world** — set the depth, block types, cave frequency, and ore distribution
- **Full protection system** — island boundaries, team permissions, and protection flags
- **All BentoBox addons** — challenges, levels, warps, and more work with CaveBlock
- **Free and open source**

## 📦 Installation

Requires **BentoBox** on a **Paper** server.

1. Install [BentoBox](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bentobox)
2. Place `CaveBlock.jar` into `plugins/BentoBox/addons/`
3. Restart
4. `/cave` to start playing

📖 Docs: [docs.bentobox.world](https://docs.bentobox.world) | 💬 Discord: [discord.gg/BentoBoxWorld](https://discord.gg/BentoBoxWorld) | 🐛 Issues: [GitHub](https://github.com/BentoBoxWorld/CaveBlock/issues)

title: Mansioneer
description: Adds biome-specific variants for Woodland Mansions; easily expandable with data packs!
body:
# Mansioneer

Have you ever wondered why Woodland Mansions were only built in Dark Oak Forests? Have you ever wanted a vanilla-flavored incentive to go exploring? With Mansioneer, Woodland Mansions will generate in many biomes scattered around your world! Each mansion seamlessly blends into its environment, making exploration more rewarding and interesting. 

## Where do Woodland Mansions generate? 

Mansioneer currently expands Woodland Mansions to generate in swamp, savanna, taiga, jungle, desert, forest, birch forest, icy, snowy, plains, and mountain slope biomes, along with variants thereof. It also allows them to generate in Cherry Grove and Pale Garden biomes. Each biome type will have its own block palette and theme! 

## What do Woodland Mansions look like?

Take a look at the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/project/mansioneer/gallery)! It features a selection of the many variants that Mansioneer adds. 

## Can I move into a Woodland Mansion? 

Yes, as long as you can evict the Pillagers! Some variants of Woodland Mansions may require some renovations, while others - like the vanilla one - only need some more torches to be added. Alternatively, you can tear them down for a plentiful source of materials and build your own mansion!

## How does this work?

Mansioneer modifies the default logic for Woodland Mansions. When Minecraft places one, Mansioneer will swap out the block palette using a datapack-defined "block transformer". This means that it should be instantly compatible with mods or datapacks that change the look of Woodland Mansions. 

## Why are the chests still giving Dark Oak Saplings?

Mansioneer doesn't change chest loot - the "block transformer" system isn't currently fine-grained enough to change the loot tables of chests. Instead, it directly swaps out one block for another. 

## I'm making a modpack; how does this work with other mods? 

Mansioneer should play nicely with other mods that edit the vanilla Woodland Mansion by default! If you want to add specific variants for modded biomes - or variants that use modded materials - take a look at the data files in `/data/___/mansioneer`. You can create new block transformer palettes, new biome-to-block-transformer mappings, or both!

The mod is designed for optimization, mobs will not spawn further than you have limited.

```
#Limit Far Spawn settings
#Radius in chunks around the player where entities can spawn (0-32).
#Range: 0 ~ 32
spawnRadiusChunks = 8
#List of entity IDs to ignore spawn radius restrictions (e.g., 'minecraft:villager').
ignoredEntities = ["minecraft:villager", "minecraft:pillager", "minecraft:vindicator", "minecraft:evoker", "minecraft:ravager", "minecraft:illusioner", "minecraft:ender_dragon"]
```

title: Auto 1e-7 Stepping
description: Little mod that helps using 1e-7 stepping mechanics!
body:
Auto 1e-7 Stepping

Little utility mod to make 1e-7 stepping mechanics easier to use

If you don't know what 1e-7 stepping is, here's quick (and not the most accurate) explanation to understand the basic principals of this mechanic:

If you move along any axis less than the hardcoded value of 1e-7 (or 0.0000001) — the movement gets canceled. This brings us to the collision checks. When you're about to collide with a block — Minecraft doesn't let you do it and sets your position next to the edge of a block so the distance to it is about 1e-8. Then the game squares the movement vector and if the result is less than 1e-7 — movement gets canceled.
But if you're about to step (for example, from the slab, or to the slab, or otherwise move up half a block or less), the checks will run like that:
First check — sees your movement is greater than 1e-7 -> sees you're about to collide with the block -> sees that you need to make a step -> sets your position to 1e-8 from the block and makes a step (moves you half a block higher).
Second check — sees that your movement vector squared is greater than 1e-7 (since you're also moving upwards) and doesn't do anything.
Then the game checks the collision with the top block. If there's nothing — the game lets you move further. If there's a block, it again sets your position next to the edge, but still thinks that you're standing on the block that gives you a little time gap to make a jump.

Here you can find more detailed explanation of how this mechanics works (*click*).

ATTENTION

This mod requires Fabric API and Yet Another Config Lib to work correctly!

HOW TO USE

To position yourself you have to hit a wall first.

Then press positioning key

``` By default keybind is set to "O" ```

Or run the command

``` /auto1e7 positioning ```
First positioning mode Second positioning mode

You have two positioning modes:

- Packet (sends packet on server with exact position you need to be moved)
- Script (performs series of actions that player can perform manually, but does it a bit faster)

You can switch between positioning modes by opening the config screen in modmenu tab or by using the command

``` /auto1e7 config ```

Languages supported

- English
- Russian (may be not 100% accurate)
- Simplified Chinese (may be not 100% accurate)

If you want to help with mod translation — you can contact me on discord scany_alt


If you found a bug — please report it on GitHub's Issues page

**Example**:
```
/dutil simple PlayerName "&eSafari Zone" &eGood Luck {player} &aCatch what you can before your timer runs out. Add more time with &e/safari buy #
```
### CHOICE DIALOGUE: `/dutil choice <player> <configId>`
**Description**: Send a choice menu to a player using a pre-configured dialogue in `dialogues.yml`. Choices can be configured to run commands, have pokedollar costs, and/or permission requirements.  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.choice`  
**Example**:
```
/dutil choice PlayerName shop
```
![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1188003/description_3bd3afe8-c6cd-4c17-b00f-6c294a7b0915.png)
### INPUT DIALOGUE: `/dutil input player|console escape|stay <targetPlayer> <title> <message> <command>`
**Description**: Create an input dialogue for the target player, allowing them to input text.  
**Options**:
* `player|console`: Execute the command as the player or the console
* `escape|stay`: Determine whether the menu closes when "Escape" is pressed
* `title & message`: Put in quotes if more than 1 word
* `command`: Can use {player} and {input} for placeholders  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.input.player` or `dialogueutil.input.console`  
**Example**:
```
/dutil input player escape Player123 "&9What's your favorite color?" "Please provide feedback:" msg {player} {input} is a good choice!
```
![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1188003/description_8ed1e467-5689-4735-bac3-f362c1571960.png)
### NOTICE COMMANDS
The notice system allows you to display overlays with various types of content.
#### TEXT NOTICE: `/dnotice direct text <player> <duration> <lines>`
**Description**: Display a text-based notice overlay  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.notice.text`  
**Example**:
```
/dnotice direct text PlayerName 10 "&6Welcome!\n&eEnjoy your stay"
```
#### POKEMON NOTICE: `/dnotice direct pokemon <player> <layout> <duration> <pokemon> <use3d> <lines>`
**Description**: Display a notice with a Pokémon sprite or 3D model  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.notice.pokemon`  
**Example**:
```
/dnotice direct pokemon PlayerName LEFT_AND_RIGHT 10 "pikachu growth:ginormous" true "&6Special Pikachu!\n&eCheck it out"
```
#### ITEM NOTICE: `/dnotice direct item <player> <layout> <duration> <lines> <itemWithNbt>`
**Description**: Display a notice with an item  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.notice.item`  
**Example**:
```
/dnotice direct item PlayerName LEFT_AND_RIGHT 10 "&6Master Ball\n&eUltimate catching power" "pixelmon:poke_ball{PokeBallID:\"master_ball\"}"
```
#### NOTICE FROM CONFIG: `/dnotice config <player> <configId>`
**Description**: Display a pre-configured notice from notices.yml  
**Permissions Required**: `dialogueutil.notice.config`  
**Example**:
```
/dnotice config PlayerName welcome
```
#### OTHER NOTICE COMMANDS:
* `/dnotice hide` - Hide the current notice
* `/dnotice list` - List available notice configurations
* `/dnotice reload` - Reload notice configurations
* `/dnotice help` - Show notice command help
### RELOAD COMMANDS
* `/dutil reload` - Reload dialogue configurations
* `/dnotice reload` - Reload notice configurations
## CONFIGURATION FILES
### `config.yml`
Controls general settings and default messages.
```yaml
# Enable/Disable Debug messages
debug: false
messages:
  noMoney:
    title: "§cNot Enough Money"
    message: "§cYou need {price} to select this option!"
  noPermission:
    title: "§cPermission Error" 
    message: "§cYou don't have permission: {permission}"
```
### `dialogues.yml`
Define configurations for choice menus.
```yaml
dialogues:
  shop:
    title: "&6Shop Menu" 
    message: "&eWhat would you like to buy? &7Use &6/money &7to check your balance"
    choices:
      - text: "&aRare Candy &7($1000)"
        commands:
          - "[console]broadcast {player} got some candy"
          - "[console]give {player} pixelmon:rare_candy 1"
        price: 1000
        permission: "shop.rare_candy"
        failureTitle: "&cNo Permission"
        failureMessage: "&cYou need the &6shop.rare_candy &cpermission!"
```
### `notices.yml`
Configure different types of notices.
```yaml
notices:
  welcome:
    type: text
    duration: 10
    lines:
      - "&6&lWelcome to the server!"
      - "&eThank you for joining us"
      - "&aEnjoy your stay"
  
  professor_pikachu:
    type: pokemon
    layout: LEFT_AND_RIGHT
    duration: 12
    pokemon: "pikachu growth:ginormous form:phd"
    use3d: true
    lines:
      - "&6&lBalance:"
      - "&e%vault_eco_balance%"
  
  master_ball:
    type: item
    layout: LEFT_AND_RIGHT
    duration: 8
    item: "pixelmon:poke_ball"
    nbt: "{PokeBallID:\"master_ball\"}"
    name: "&dMaster Ball"
    lines:
      - "&6&lMaster Ball"
      - "&eThe ultimate Pokeball"
```

## PERMISSIONS
### Dialogue Permissions
* `dialogueutil.simple` - Use simple dialogues
* `dialogueutil.choice` - Use choice dialogues
* `dialogueutil.input.player` - Use input dialogues as player
* `dialogueutil.input.console` - Use input dialogues as console
* `dialogueutil.admin` - Access administrative commands
### Notice Permissions
* `dialogueutil.notice.text` - Use text notices
* `dialogueutil.notice.pokemon` - Use Pokémon notices
* `dialogueutil.notice.item` - Use item notices
* `dialogueutil.notice.config` - Use configured notices
* `dialogueutil.notice.admin` - Access notice admin commands
## DEPENDENCIES
*   NeoForge: 21.1.172 or later
*   Minecraft: 1.21.1
*   [Pixelmon](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/pixelmon): 9.3.16 or later
*   PlaceholderAPI (Optional) - For placeholder support
*   LuckPerms (Optional) - Give command access to non-op players
## FEATURES & NOTES
* Color codes with & are supported in all text
* PlaceholderAPI placeholders are supported in all text (%placeholder%)
* Multiple notice layouts available: LEFT_AND_RIGHT, LEFT, RIGHT
* NBT data support for item notices
* Command execution after notice display
* Configurable duration for all notices
* 3D model support for Pokémon notices

title: DupePlusPlus
description: An advanced and easy to use plugin that allows players to duplicate the item they're holding.
body:
![DupePlusPlus title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92f5ce035524c423d04984375b3f5ddf15ba08b0.png) The future of duping is here! > This is a remake of the popular dupe plugin DupePlus
> This plugin fixes the biggest glitches in DupePlus.
## Commands: ``` /dupe : dupes your item /blacklist : add an item to the blacklist. /blacklist list: open a gui that shows all blacklisted items, click the item to remove it from the blacklist and click an item in your inventory to add it to the blacklist. /blacklist enchants: blacklist all enchants of the item you're holding. (ignores level) /nondupeable: apply custom data to make the item you're holding not dupeable /maxdupe : set the amount the players can dupe (defaults to 1). This gets overriden by the dupeplusplus.dupe. permission. /dupeoptions: view all options from the config in game and reload the config ``` ## Permissions: ``` dupeplusplus.edit: allows you to edit the blacklisted items dupeplusplus.blacklist: allows you to view the blacklisted items dupeplusplus.maxdupe: allows you to change the max dupe dupeplusplus.nondupe: allows you to blacklist one certain item by adding data to it dupeplusplus.dupe.: allows you to bypass the normal max dupe dupeplusplus.dupeconfig: gives access to the /dupeoptions command dupeplusplus.dupe: allows you to use /dupe ``` ## Features: - Easily blacklist items! - Able to blacklist items by adding custom data to them! - Configure the amount that players can dupe by using /maxdupe or the dupeplusplus.dupe. permission (max can be configured in config)! - You can make items undupeable based on their enchants (ignores level) - Configure the cooldown of the dupe command > make sure to join my [discord](https://discord.gg/D2nBxCeHyH) to know when a new update releases! > Details: > this plugin works by checking the itemtype and lore, everything else gets ignored. description: A Fabric HUD mod that displays your armor and item durability with item counts directly on screen.
body:
🛡️ DuchArmorHUD

Never break your armor mid-fight again. DuchArmorHUD adds a clean, fully customizable HUD that shows your armor and weapon durability — plus item counts for anything you want to track — right on your screen at all times.
✨ Features

Armor & Weapon Durability HUD
See the remaining durability of your helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, and held weapon in real time. The sword/tool can be pinned to the top or bottom of the list.

Item Count Tracker
Track the count of any item in your inventory — arrows, potions, food, totems, you name it. Add any item ID and it shows up automatically.

Color-Coded Durability
Items change color as they wear down — green when safe, orange as a warning, red when critical. All thresholds are configurable.

Low Durability Warnings
Optional bounce animation and red pulse background when an item is about to break. Customizable speed, strength, and threshold.

Fully Configurable Layout

    Anchor to any corner of the screen (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right)
    Custom X/Y offset and scale
    Row spacing and icon spacing
    Optional semi-transparent background with rounded corners and adjustable opacity
    Text shadow toggle

ModMenu Integration
All settings are available through a clean in-game config screen — no need to edit any files manually.

    Fabric API
    ModMenu (optional, for in-game config)
    Duchessentials

🎮 Designed for Survival & SMP

Built for players who want to stay focused on the game without constantly opening their inventory to check gear. Lightweight, minimal, and stays out of your way.


Raw Text if you can't see the images:

Damien Eltzwright is a smart stalker that behaves in a very unique way.  This Mod has been in the works for over **1.5+ years!** (i forgot about it for half a year)  This Mod is in beta so report any bugs in the discord server!


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Damien intelligently cycles between states based on distance, line-of-sight, light level, and randomness:
1. WATCHING — observes from 20-40 blocks away in darkness, behind cover, out of line-of-sight

2. STALKING — follows silently from behind (no footsteps), opens/closes doors, steals items from your hotbar and drops them nearby, finds cover when spotted

3. HIDING — finds dark spots behind walls, extinguishes torches/lanterns, shatters glass windows/panes/iron bars near the player, places cobwebs & soul sand as environmental terror, peeks at player periodically with creepy sounds
   
4. CHARGING — screams on entry, charges at 2.2x speed, breaks obstructing blocks via raycast (with adjacent soft block tunneling), teleports when stuck, swims at extreme speed using forced velocity (Dolphin's Grace level), detects water ahead and jumps over it, attack cooldown every 15 ticks at 2.5 block range

5. IMITATING — 3-phase behavior: scans player buildings, teleports, then builds a corrupted mirror copy of their structures with twisted block mappings (see below); also disguises as passive animals

6. JUMPSCARE — rapid strafing around player at 1.5-3 blocks, relentless attacks every 10 ticks, stinger sounds every 20-60 ticks, ambient smoke/soul particles, extinguishes torches/lanterns in 4-block radius

7. MEGA DAMIEN — velocity-pulled toward player (no pathfinding), progressive block destruction with damage stages, 4-hit/second attacks (8 damage each); never transitions — stays until despawn

</details>

Hard Mode is recommended for videos or if you aren't up for a slow-burner It primarily makes damien more active during night time

title: Towering Heights
description: This mod increases the world height limit (to a maximum of ±16384, less by default).
body:
This mod greatly pushes minecraft's maximum world heights (upto ±16384, not this by default), at the cost of X axis (±16.8m blocks) and Z axis (±8.4m blocks). To my knowledge, this is the only mod for newer versions which can reach this sheer scale.

This mod can be used with large terrain generation but generally, heights over 2032 (which is much easier to get) are not very useful.

Warning: This mod uses a lot of ram, allocate around 4-6gb and preferably use ZGC for a smooth experience, and allocate more depending on the other mods used along side this.

Note: Distant horizons breaks above ~6000 blocks and Voxy doesn't work very high up either, and this is a issue I can't fix with just my mod. You will need a custom Distant Horizons or Voxy fork for those extreme heights

title: Slash Dupe
description: A simple, configurable item duplication plugin.
body:
# SlashDupe

 Adds a configurable `/dupe` command that lets players duplicate the item currently in their hand.

Without any restrictions, item duplication can completely break your server's economy and progression. SlashDupe gives you full control — blacklist specific items, block or scan shulker boxes for blacklisted items, cooldowns between 2 dupes.

**Features:**
- Duplicates the exact amount of the item in your hand
- Configurable cooldown between uses
- Full item blacklist to block specific materials from being duped
- Shulker box protection — block all shulker duping or scan contents for blacklisted items
- All messages customizable with color codes
- Console logging of every dupe action
- Live config reload via `/dupe reload`

  
<details>
<summary>Default Config.yml</summary>

```yaml
# ================================
#     SlashDupe Configuration
# ================================

settings:
  # Enable or disable /dupe entirely
  enabled: true

  # Allow duping the item in offhand
  allow_offhand: true

  # Max stack size override (-1 = Minecraft default)
  max_stack_size: -1

  # Cooldown in seconds (0 = no cooldown)
  cooldown: 5

  # Block duping shulker boxes entirely
  # true  = shulker boxes cannot be duped at all
  # false = shulker boxes can be duped but contents are checked for blacklisted items
  block_shulker_dupe: true

# ================================
#       Permission Defaults
# ================================
# true  = everyone can use
# false = OP only
permission_defaults:
  dupe.use: true
  dupe.bypass.cooldown: false
  dupe.bypass.blacklist: false
  dupe.admin: false

# ================================
#          Permissions
# ================================
permissions:
  use: "dupe.use"
  bypass_cooldown: "dupe.bypass.cooldown"
  bypass_blacklist: "dupe.bypass.blacklist"
  admin: "dupe.admin"

# ================================
#           Blacklist
# ================================
blacklist:
  # Enable or disable the blacklist
  enabled: true

  # Items that cannot be duped
  # Use Minecraft material names (all caps, underscores)
  items:
    - BEDROCK
    - BARRIER
    - COMMAND_BLOCK
    - CHAIN_COMMAND_BLOCK
    - REPEATING_COMMAND_BLOCK
    - STRUCTURE_BLOCK
    - ELYTRA
    - TOTEM_OF_UNDYING

# ================================
#           Messages
# ================================
# Supports & color codes
# Placeholders: {player} {item} {amount} {cooldown}
messages:
  no_permission: "&cYou don't have permission to use this command."
  nothing_in_hand: "&cYou must be holding an item to dupe it."
  item_blacklisted: "&cThis item cannot be duped."
  shulker_blocked: "&cYou cannot dupe shulker boxes."
  shulker_contains_blacklisted: "&cThis shulker box contains a blacklisted item and cannot be duped."
  success: "&aSuccessfully duped &e{item}&a!"
  cooldown_active: "&cPlease wait &e{cooldown}s &cbefore duping again."
  inventory_full: "&cYour inventory is full!"
  plugin_disabled: "&cThe dupe command is currently disabled."
  reloaded: "&aSlashDupe config reloaded!"

# ================================
#            Logging
# ================================
logging:
  # Log every dupe action to console
  log_to_console: true

  # Placeholders: {player} {item} {amount}
  log_format: "[SlashDupe] {player} duped {item} x{amount}"
```

</details>

title: Better Mob Heads
description: Better Mob Heads gives supported vanilla mobs without an existing vanilla head item a decorative custom head when they die.
body:
Better Mob Heads

Mob Heads is a server-side Minecraft Java Edition datapack that gives supported vanilla mobs without an existing vanilla head item a decorative custom head when they die. The pack uses real minecraft-heads.com textures from the public MinecraftHeads CDN and applies simple score-driven loot logic with Looting support.

What It Does

  • Every supported mob in this pack can drop a decorative custom player_head that matches that mob's texture.
  • Looting increases the drop chance, bosses can be guaranteed, and charged creepers trigger a best-effort guaranteed-drop pulse for nearby mobs.

body:
With this data pack, you can count dropped items in 2 ways:

### 1

You can name an armor stand 'itemcount<radius>', where radius is the radius around the armor stand where the data pack will try to find items (for example: itemcount12). Clear indicators will be given to signify a recognised item counter.

### 2

Doing '/trigger global_item_counter' and then clicking 'On' will make the data pack ignore the item counters and count all loaded items.

Bundles, shulker boxes and other items containing items have their contends extracted after counting them. '/trigger item_count_sidebar' can be used to view the counted items in the world. # Refined Patchwork ![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c489b72ac1ddae75d17760db6c795392026166b0.png) This datapack adds and tweaks many vanilla recipes and behaviors. It aims to enhance the Minecraft experience without breaking the game's balance. --- ## 🛠️ Features
Edited Vanilla Crafts ### ▶️Grindstone can be crafted with stone, sandstone, or red sandstone slabs.

### ▶️Carrot on a Stick and Warped Fungus on a Stick are shapeless.

### ▶️Stonecutter can be crafted with stone, deepslate, granite, diorite, or andesite.

### ▶️All Redstone items that use cobblestone in their crafting recipe can also be crafted with cobblestone, cobbled deepslate, or blackstone *(e.g., Piston, Observer...)*.

### ▶️All Redstone items that use stone in their crafting recipe can also be crafted with stone, deepslate, granite, diorite, or andesite *(e.g., Comparator, Repeater...)*.

### ▶️Daylight Detector can now be crafted with any type of glass (except tinted glass).

### ▶️Crafting wood from logs gives **4** wood *(instead of 3 in vanilla)*, and this works with any wood variant.

### ▶️Crafting a quartz block gives **4** quartz blocks.

### ▶️Crafting a trapdoor gives 6 trapdoors *(exept for bamboo)*.

### ▶️Blast Furnaces can be crafted with smooth stone, smooth sandstone, or smooth red sandstone.

### ▶️Leads no longer require slimeballs *(like newer Minecraft versions)*.

New Crafting Recipes ### ▶️Podzol can be crafted using dirt and any type of leaves.

### ▶️1 wool gives 4 string

### ▶️All utility tables *(cartography, smithing, fletching, loom)* can be crafted using a crafting table + specific item.

### ▶️Anvils can be crafted with iron blocks and chipped anvils *(chipped anvils can be crafted the same way, but using damaged anvils)*.

- Leaves can be converted into any other type using a sapling. - You can craft and convert torches and soul torches. - Craft light blocks with levels 1, 7, 10, and 15. - Craft invisible and glowing item frames. - Add many new ways to obtain dyes. - `[1.21.10+]` You can craft a Copper Torch by combining a regular Torch with one Copper Nugget. - `[1.21.10+]` You can craft a Copper Lantern by combining a regular Lantern with one Copper Nugget.
New Uncrafting Recipes - Honeycomb blocks can be uncrafted into 4 honeycombs. - You can uncraft a chest boat to retrieve both the boat and the chest. - You can uncraft a minecart chest to retrieve both the minecart and the chest. - You can uncraft a minecart furnace to retrieve both the minecart and the furnace. - You can uncraft a minecart hopper to retrieve both the minecart and the hopper. - You can uncraft a minecart TNT to retrieve both the minecart and the TNT.
Duplication - You can duplicate cobbled deepslate by combining 1 cobblestone with 1 deepslate. - Banner patterns can be duplicated using paper - Sherds can be duplicated using 4 bricks
Stonecutter - All wood types, including bamboo, can be used in the stonecutter. - Deepslate provides all deepslate variants in the stonecutter. - Light blocks can be converted to any light level - Paintings can be placed in a stonecutter to select the desired variant. - You can choose different armor stand variants by placing them in the stonecutter.
Smithing Table ###

🔴`[1.21.11+]`

▶️Lets you upgrade Nautilus Armor using Nautilus Shells, the current armor piece, and the materials of the next tier. **You must upgrade step by step** — for example, you can’t go directly from iron to diamond; you have to go through the golden tier first.

Furnace - Smelting copper, iron, or gold raw blocks gives copper, iron, or gold blocks. - Ancient debris cannot be smelted in a standard furnace but only in a blast furnace *(with a longer cooking time)*.
Miscellaneous - Eating a melon slice gives one melon seed. - `[1.21+]` Trial spawners will give more food when they drop it. - Frogspawn can be obtain with silktouch - Many new ways to obtain dyes - Combine colored wool to create new colors *(not all combinations are supported)*. For example, `red + white = pink`. - Throwing wet sponge into the Nether dries it - Holding a clock shows the time **(customizable format**). Use `/trigger rfpw.clock.toggle.display` to toggle the display, and `/trigger rfpw.clock.toggle.format` to change the time format. - Holding a compass shows your coordinates. Use `/trigger rfpw.compass.toggle.display` to toggle the display. - Holding a recovery compass shows your death location. Use `/trigger rfpw.recovery_compass.toggle.display` to toggle the display. - `[1.21+]` Having a Heavy Core in your inventory gives Slowness II - Normal potions and banner patterns stack up to 16 - Splashing a water potion on lava transforms it into cobblestone. - `[1.21.2+]` Throw a plant named `Placeable` to place it on any full block - Wet sponge can also dry on a campfire - Climbing speed on climbable blocks *(ladders, vines, weeping vines, twisting vines, and scaffolding)* is enhanced by sneaking, jumping, and looking *(up = climb, down = descend)*. title: EssentiaX Chat Addon
description: Clear chat and slowchat addon for EssentiaX
body:
# ChatAddon for EssentiaX

**ChatAddon** is a useful addon for **EssentiaX** that makes your server chat more manageable and organized.  

## Features

- **Slowchat**  
  - Prevents players from sending messages too quickly.  
  - Configurable cooldown in seconds.  
  - Players with the permission `essentiax.slowchat.bypass` can bypass slowchat.

- **ClearChat**  
  - Manually clear the chat with the `/clearchat` command.  
  - Broadcasts a message when the chat has been cleared.  
  - Automatic chat clearing at configurable intervals.  
  - Both the command and auto-clear can be enabled or disabled in the config.  
  - Permissions:  
    - `essentiax.clearchat` for using the command  
    - `essentiax.slowchat.bypass` for bypassing slowchat

## Installation

1. Place the `ChatAddon.jar` file in the following folder:  
plugins/EssentiaX/addons
2. Start or reload the server.  
3. The configuration file will be automatically created at `plugins/EssentiaX/addons/chataddon.yml`.  
4. Adjust slowchat and clearchat settings in the configuration file.

## Configuration

- **Slowchat**  
```yaml
slowchat:
 enabled: true
 cooldown_seconds: 5
 
clearchat:
  enabled: true
  auto:
    enabled: true
    interval: 60 # minutes
```

Notes

- This addon is compatible only with EssentiaX.
- No additional dependencies required.

# EZWireless
## A simple, lightweight wireless redstone mod.

EZWireless is a simple, lightweight wireless redstone mod. The mod adds two blocks, the Transmitter and the Receiver. You can right click on each of these to set which channel they're on, and all Receivers on a certain channel will output a power level of 15 if at least one Transmitter is powered. Comparators reading a Receiver will output the power level of the Transmitter on the channel with the highest power. The mod also adds an item called the Wireless Linker, which just simply sets a Transmitter and Receiver pair to a random channel. This is not required to set channels, it's just a convenience tool.

title: No Trample+
description: Protect your farmland from being trampled. No matter how high you fall, your crops stay safe.
body:
![No Trample+](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/242f6e36bace5d7606698841a5b48b2c532e8c50.jpeg)

**Protect your farmland from being trampled.
No matter how high you fall, your crops stay safe.**

Protect your farmland from being trampled.
No matter how high you fall, your crops stay safe.



No Trample is a simple and lightweight data pack that prevents farmland from being destroyed when stepped or landed on.

Unlike some data packs, **this one does NOT use Feather Falling or modify fall damage**. Players will still take full damage when falling from height — only the farmland is protected.

Whether you’re farming, exploring, or building, you no longer have to worry about accidentally ruining your crops. Even from great heights, farmland will remain intact and plants will not break.

The data pack works for both players and entities, with separate options to enable or disable each behavior.

## Features
- No Fall Damage Changes - Fall damage remains completely vanilla
- Farmland Protection - Prevents trampling from any height
- Player Toggle - Enable or disable trampling prevention for players
- Entity Toggle - Enable or disable for other entities (animals, mobs, etc.)
- Load Message Toggle - Turn the startup message on or off
- Reset Option - Restore all settings to default

## Requirements:

Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.5-26.2

Installation:

Singleplayer
- Open Minecraft
- Create a new world and click on "More", "Data Packs"
- Drag the data pack into the Minecraft window
- Click "Yes" on the confirmation screen
- Move the data pack to the right-hand side of the screen by clicking the triangle on its icon
- Click "Done" and continue creating your world, then click on "Create New World"

Multiplayer
- Download the data pack
- Open your server folder, then open the folder of the world
- Put the data pack into a folder named datapacks
- Restart your server, and you can use your new data pack.

Permissions:
None

Commands:
/trigger trample.options

body:
Dieses Modpack wurde für den deutschen Rollenspielserver [Aeternum-Roleplay](https://aeternum-roleplay.de/) erstellt.

Es beinhaltet bereits voreingestellte und auf den Server zugeschnittene Chatfilter, Performanceoptimierungen, eine erhöhte Render-Distanz sowie die Möglichkeit, das servereigene Ressourcenpaket auch außerhalb des Spielbeitritts herunterzuladen.

## Features:
* **Aeternum Texturepack Download**
  * ![Aeternum Texturepack Download Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8200e85d5d0aa581bfe6dd186de4e54d26e3df36.png)
* **Performance**
  * **Sodium**
    * Eine stark optimierte Mod, die dabei hilft, das Beste aus Minecraft herauszuholen und für ein flüssigeres Spielerlebnis zu sorgen.
* **Vision Enhancement**
  * **Voxy**
    * Diese Mod stellt eine Alternative zu Distant Horizons dar und nutzt eine LoD-Technologie, um die Sichtweite deutlich zu erhöhen.
* **Chat Enhancement**
  * Vorkonfigurierte und auf den Server zugeschnittene Einstellungen, darunter Chatfilter und Chattabs.
* **Figura + Figura-Scripte**
  * **Figura** ermöglicht es dir, dein Spielermodell umfangreich anzupassen und anderen Spielern deinen Avatar anzeigen zu lassen, ganz ohne zusätzliche Server-Mods.
  * Im Ordner `aeternum_figura_scripte` sind zwei Figura-Scripte enthalten:
    * `aeternum_afk_indicator.lua` - Zeigt an, wenn ein Spieler AFK ist.
    * `aeternum_show_typing.lua` - Zeigt an, wenn ein Spieler aktuell im Chat schreibt.
    * Zum Anzeigen der Funktionen müssen die Figura-Berechtigungen des jeweiligen Spielers auf die maximale Stufe gesetzt sein.
  * Weitere Informationen sind der `readme.lua` zu entnehmen.


## English:
This modpack was created for the German roleplay server [Aeternum-Roleplay](https://aeternum-roleplay.de/).

It includes preconfigured chat filters tailored specifically to the server, performance optimizations, an increased render distance, and the ability to download the server's custom resource pack even without joining the server.

## Features:

* **Chat Enhancement**
  * Preconfigured settings tailored to the server, including chat filters and chat tabs.
* **Figura + Figura Scripts**
  * **Figura** allows you to extensively customize your player model and lets other players see your avatar without requiring any additional server-side mods.
  * The folder `aeternum_figura_scripte` includes two Figura scripts:

title: kaqvuMusic
description: kaqvuMusic is a lightweight and professional MP3 player mod for Minecraft Fabric that lets you listen to your own music directly in-game. It features full playback control, real-time action bar progress, playback history, and independent volume settings.
body:
# kaqvuMusic

A professional and lightweight MP3 player mod for Minecraft Fabric 1.21.1+.
Manage and enjoy your music library directly in-game with real-time feedback.

--- ## 🎵 Features

Music Control | Action Bar Progress | History Tracking | Looping

- **High-Quality Playback**: Smooth MP3 streaming with minimal performance impact. - **Dynamic Action Bar**: Displays song name, progress time, and queue position in real-time. - **Customizable Looping**: Play songs once, multiple times, or set it to `infinity` for endless loops. - **Playback History**: Saves your last 3 played songs with timestamps and settings. - **Independent Volume**: Adjust mod volume from 0% to 100% without affecting game master volume. - **Easy Management**: Simple file system — just drop your MP3s into the config folder. --- ## 🚀 Getting Started 1. **Install Requirements**: Ensure you have **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API** installed. 2. **Mod Placement**: Drop the `kaqvumusic.jar` into your `.minecraft/mods` directory. 3. **Add Your Music**: - Launch the game once. - Go to `.minecraft/config/kaqvuMusic/`. - Drop your favorite `.mp3` files there. 4. **Enjoy**: Use `/kaqvumusic list` and start playing! --- ## 💻 Commands

All commands are available via /kaqvumusic

| Command | Argument | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `help` | - | Displays the command list and usage. | | `list` | - | Shows all available MP3 files in your library. | | `history` | - | Displays the 3 most recently played songs. | | `play` | ` [count \| infinity]` | Starts playing. Use `last` for the previous song. | | `pause` | - | Pauses the current track. | | `resume` | - | Resumes from where you left off. | | `stop` | - | Completely stops playback. | | `volume` | `<0-100>` | Adjusts the output volume. | --- ## 💬 Interface & Messages ### 📺 Action Bar (Real-time Feedback) The status bar appears above your hotbar while music is playing: > `§b§l♪ §fSong_Name.mp3 §8| §a1:24§7/§23:15 §8| §ekolejka §61/∞` - **♪ Icon**: Indicates active playback. - **Progress**: Current time vs. total duration. - **Queue**: Displays how many repetitions are left. ### 💬 Chat Messages The mod provides clean and colorful chat feedback for all actions: - **Library List**: Categorized list of all your songs with bullet points. - **History View**: Shows song name, playback mode, and the exact date/time it was started. - **Alerts**: Instant feedback in the center of the screen (above action bar) for volume changes or status updates. ---

Developed by kaqvu

title: F5 Blocker
description: A simple mod that provides the ability to disable the third-person view
body:
## Русский
Мод Disable F5 добавляет в Minecraft игровые правила, позволяющие полностью контролировать использование вида от третьего лица (F5) на сервере. Основное правило — disableThirdPersonView. Когда оно включено (/gamerule disableThirdPersonView true), игроки не могут переключать перспективу каким-либо способом. Дополнительно доступно правило restrictOpsThirdPersonView, которое позволяет ограничить использование вида от третьего лица даже для операторов сервера (OP). Если на сервере установлен мод Superb Warfare, становится доступно правило SBWEnableF5Driver. При его включении игрок, находящийся на водительском месте техники, сможет использовать вид от третьего лица, несмотря на глобальные ограничения. Мод предназначен для создания более иммерсивных, соревновательных или сложных игровых сценариев, где контроль камеры играет важную роль.

## Українська
Мод Disable F5 додає до Minecraft ігрові правила, які дозволяють повністю контролювати використання виду від третьої особи (F5) на сервері. Основне правило — disableThirdPersonView. Коли воно увімкнене (/gamerule disableThirdPersonView true), гравці не можуть жодним чином перемикати перспективу. Додатково доступне правило restrictOpsThirdPersonView, яке дозволяє обмежити використання виду від третьої особи навіть для операторів сервера (OP). Якщо на сервері встановлено мод Superb Warfare, з’являється правило SBWEnableF5Driver. Коли воно увімкнене, гравець, що перебуває на водійському місці техніки, зможе використовувати вид від третьої особи, незважаючи на глобальні обмеження. Мод буде корисним для створення більш імерсивних, складних або змагальних ігрових сценаріїв.

## English
The Disable F5 mod adds gamerules to Minecraft that allow full control over the use of the third-person view (F5) on a server. The main gamerule is disableThirdPersonView. When enabled (/gamerule disableThirdPersonView true), players are completely unable to switch perspectives in any way. An additional gamerule, restrictOpsThirdPersonView, allows server operators (OPs) to be restricted as well, preventing them from bypassing the limitation. If the Superb Warfare mod is installed on the server, a new gamerule called SBWEnableF5Driver becomes available. When enabled, a player occupying the driver’s seat of a vehicle will be allowed to use the third-person view despite global restrictions. This mod is useful for creating more immersive, competitive, or challenging gameplay scenarios where camera control is important.

---

With 🤍 by. [@lava_frai](https://lavafrai.ru)

## About

**Controlled Insomnia** changes the spawning of phantoms to make sure they only spawn when you want them to.

Phantoms now only spawn when the player has the **Insomnia** effect applied.
A **Potion of Insomnia** can be brewed with an eye blossom or an eye of ender depending on the version of Minecraft.

title: AbilityMania
description: Ability Mania is a server-functional plug-in that adds super powers.
body:
# Abilities Plugin ⚡

Unlock **8 powerful superpowers** and dominate your Minecraft server!

## What is this?

Abilities gives players incredible powers activated with a simple key press. Each ability has unique mechanics - some even have hidden secondary functions waiting to be discovered.

## Available Powers

Choose from **8 distinct abilities**:
- **Lightning Strike** - Call down thunder on your enemies
- **Telekinesis** - Control entities with your mind
- **Tamer** - Turn hostile mobs into loyal companions
- **Pyromancer** - Master the flames
- **Cryomancer** - Freeze your foes
- **Windwalker** - Speed and mobility
- **Necromancer** - Command the undead
- **Healer** - Support yourself and allies

## How to Use

1. Type `/ab <ability>` to select a power (e.g. `/ab lightning`)
2. Look at your target
3. Press **F** to activate
4. Try **Sneak + F** on different abilities to discover secret moves!
5. Switch abilities anytime with `/ab <different_ability>`
6. Turn off with `/ab off`

**Tab completion** makes browsing abilities easy - just type `/ab` and press Tab!

## Commands

- `/ability` or `/ab` - Show all available abilities
- `/ab <name>` - Select an ability  
- `/ab off` - Disable current ability

## Perfect For

- PvP servers looking for unique combat mechanics
- Roleplay servers with different character classes
- Survival servers that want extra powers
- Anyone who wants to feel epic!

## Technical Details

- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1+
- **Server Software:** Paper, Spigot, Bukkit
- **Performance:** Optimized and lightweight
- **No Dependencies:** Works standalone

---

Experiment, discover, and find your favorite power! 🔥

title: Campfire Enchanting
description: Brings an early game way to enchant, using campfires
body:
This datapack/mod aims to make enchantments easier to access at the early and mid-game, while not overshadowing enchanting tables in their current state.

## Features include
- **Throwing yourself into a campfire/soul campfire is actually a good thing now!** (if you have lapis-lazuli, and enough levels).
- Normal campfires **require 5 levels** and one lapis. They enchant your items at **level 15**, compared to a enchanting table, but have a small chance of applying a curse.
- Soul campfires **require 15 levels** and also one lapis. They enchant your items at **level 30+**, compared to a enchanting table, but they always apply curses.
- Tools that could only receive enchantments through anvils - like flint and steel, shears, carrot on a stick and brushes -, work with campfires!

title: Minecraft: Frog Edition
description: A fun and cute adventure modpack
body:
## Minecraft: Frog Edition is a _**cute**_ survival adventure modpack with something for everyone, designed for a casual-friendly experience for new players and veterans as well.

Featuring "cute" wildlife creatures, [Mythic Mounts](https://modrinth.com/mod/mythic-mounts), [Beautiful Nature](https://modrinth.com/mod/natures-spirit), expanded sea life, plenty of home decorative options, collectible plushies, cosmetic hats, and many ways for social interactions.

And, of course, [cute frogs](https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits).

Additionally, featuring [Better Combat](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-combat), allowing you to choose and become one of many classes such as **Paladin**, **Priest**, **Rogue**, **Ranger**, **Warrior**, **Wizard**, **Death Knight** and more, with a large skill tree, many magical abilities, and naturally also having awesome **dungeons** and **bosses** as well, all optional of course.

This modpack also includes the mod [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric), which enables players to create mechanical contraptions and automation, like for example windmills, trains, elevators and much more.

And thanks to the mods from the [Let's do](https://modrinth.com/mod/lets-do-farm-charm) series, the modpack has immersive and expansive cooking and food making.

This modpack supports shaders!
You can access the shader menu in settings, or by pressing **F9** while ingame and clicking Enable at the top center.

We hope you enjoy!


**Default Keybindings:**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

**K** Skill Tree
(The skill tree do NOT use normal experience, and is instead using its own experience leveling system, that does not vanish upon death)

**M** = World Map

**N** = Create Waypoint Marker

**R** = Combat Roll               (4 second cooldown on use)

**F** = Swap Item with Offhand    (same as vanilla)

**Q** = Drop Item    (Hold Q to throw item further, hold it longer for greater throw distance)

**B** = Access Equipped Backpack

**Z** = Use equipped Spyglass (you can use scroll wheel to zoom in or out)

**Left Shift + Right-Click** (with both hands empty) to pick up small mobs, players, chests etc.

**F7** = Enlarge Minimap

**F8** = Mod Menu

**F9** = Shaders Menu

(Disclaimer: the shader graphic settings are set to **Potato** by default, it is recommended to change it to **Medium** for best immersive experience)

Hold **Left Shift** while in inventory to compare items.

**G** spell 1

**V** spell 2

**C** spell 3

**Y** spell 4

**H** Signature Spell

**X** Ascendancy Spell

</details>

**How to Play (Starting Tips)**:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

First of all, if playing on **Multiplayer**, you will want to create a **Party**, so that magical abilities do not harm friends, and making sure healing abilities actually heal friends.

You can create a party by typing in chat the following command:

**/openpac-parties create**


After creating a party, you can invite others with the following command:

**/openpac-parties member invite [player name]**



While in the **inventory**, you will see a **search bar** to the right, as well as items above it.
You can search for individual items, then **left-click** the item to see how **to craft** it, or **right-click** the item to see what you **can craft** from said item.
You can also use @ on the search bar, followed up by a mod name, to see all items from said mod, for example **@waystones** or **@sophisticatedbackpacks** (remove space between mod name)


Second, while at the **Inventory**, you will see a small button next to your player model in the center, and while hovering over it should say "open accessories", pressing it will take you to your **accessory menu**

The **accessory menu** is where you equip stuff like **backpacks**, **cosmetic hats**, **spell books** and much more.

You can also **hide** the visual part of accessories by pressing the **tiny button** on the top right corner of each slot, hidden accessories will still function, they are just invisible.



**Waystones** will randomly appear all over the world, and sometimes on top of large towers, and sometimes there will also be one inside a village.

Players can **right-click** to activate a **Waystone**, and can then **Teleport** between **Waystones**.
(Players riding mounts will teleport said mount as well)



**Backpacks** are awesome external inventories that a new players should seek to obtain as soon as possible.

**Backpacks** can be equipped in the **accessory menu**, and you can open the backpack by pressing **B**.


**Spyglass** no longer need to be equipped, **Spyglass** can now be used from your inventory by pressing **Z**.


A **Lantern** can be placed in the **Belt** slot in your **Acceessory Menu**, giving you a constant light source around you.



</details>

**How to Play (Combat)**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


You can access the **Skill Tree** by pressing **K**, and you will earn **Skill Points** by slaying enemies, and can then spend said points on upgrades.

Now, to obtain and be able to use **Spells**, you will need to create a **Spell Book**, and you can do this by:

First, crafting a **Spell Binding Table**, placing it down, and surround it with **Bookshelfs**, similar to a **Enchantment Table**.

Placing a regular book inside a **Spell Binding Table** will allow you to turn the book into a **Spell Book**, for example: **Book of Fire**.

You can then upgrade your **Skill Book** by placing it inside the **Spell Binding Table**, and selecting a **spell** that you want, which costs **Lapis Lazuli** and a large amount of regular **Experience Levels**

You can then equip your **Spell Book** inside your **Accessories Menu**, and will then be able to use said abilities while wielding a **weapon**.

**Spells** requires a specific **Rune** each time when cast, for example: if having **Book of Fire**, you will need **Fire Runes** to cast the fire spells.



Also, killing Monsters will sometimes drop **Hat Bags**

These **Hat Bags** can be opened by **right-clicking** whilst holding it, to obtain a random **cosmetic hat**, which can be equipped in your **Accessory Menu**



</details>


**Additional Information:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Upon **Death**, you will now keep **Weapons**, **Armor**, **Ammo**, **Trinkets** and **Gadgets** for example **Backpacks** or **Cosmetic Hats**, however you will still **drop blocks, gems etc** upon death, as well as loose all experience.


Dropped items will now decay after **10 minutes**, instead of the normal **5 minutes**.


Items with the [Mending](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Mending) enchantment can now be manually repaired by simply **holding** the item, **Sneaking** and **Right-Clicking** to directly transfer some of your experience into repairing the held item.


You can now place a enchanted item on a **Grindstone**, and a regular book, to **transfer** the enchantments from the item into the book.


You can change the **Enchantment Color** on enchanted items now, by simply typing the following command:

**/glint_color [color]**

Additional glint commands can be found [here.](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-more-purple)


</details>


**Known Bugs/Issues:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

[Bug] If textures appear **black**, for example the top side of chests, use the following command in-game:

**/flywheel backened instancing**

That command should fix the issue.
This bug "should" not appear while using **Shaders**.


[Bug] Sometimes the "item frame" around the item name will glitch out, this happens sometimes when going in/out of the **Accessories Menu**.

Simply go to the **Accessories Menu** again, and look at an item in your own inventory, then exit the **Accessories Menu**, and it should be fixed.

 
[Issue] Sometimes the loot beams will bug and glitch out, there is no known fix :c


[Issue] While in the **Accessory Menu**, using the **mouse scroll wheel** while hovering over equipped items will **Unequip them**, keep this in mind as it is very easy to accidentally unequip gear when using the mouse scroll wheel.


</details>

title: Toggle-Chat
description: A PaperMC plugin allowing players to toggle chat visibility via /togglechat. Blocks standard chat and a configurable list of commands (like /me, /say) when toggled off, with all feedback messages customizable in config.yml using MiniMessage.
body:
**Control Your Chat Experience with ToggleChat!**

Ever feel overwhelmed by chat messages when you're trying to focus, build, or fight? ToggleChat provides a simple yet effective solution, giving individual players control over their personal chat visibility.

**What does ToggleChat do?**

*   **Simple Chat Toggling:** Players can use the straightforward `/togglechat` command to turn their chat messages on or off just for themselves. System messages and direct messages (like `/msg`) will still come through, ensuring you don't miss crucial information.
*   **Block Distractions:** When chat is toggled off, not only are regular chat messages blocked from being sent, but specific commands often used for public chat (like `/me` and `/say`) are also prevented, helping players maintain focus.
*   **Fully Configurable:** Server administrators have full control!
    *   All messages sent by the plugin (toggle confirmations, notifications, errors) can be customized in the `config.yml` using the powerful MiniMessage format for colors and styles.
    *   The list of commands that are blocked when chat is toggled off can also be easily modified in the `config.yml`.

**Why should you download ToggleChat?**

*   **Player Empowerment:** Gives players a direct way to manage chat clutter without needing server-wide changes. Perfect for busy servers or players who prefer less distraction.
*   **Server Admin Flexibility:** Easy to install and configure. Customize the look and feel of messages and define exactly which chat-related commands should be blocked when a player toggles their chat off.
*   **Lightweight & Simple:** Focuses on doing one job well without unnecessary features or performance overhead.

**Critical Information:**

*   **Command:** `/togglechat` - Toggles your personal chat on or off.
*   **Permission:** `togglechat.use` - Grants access to the `/togglechat` command. (Defaults to `true`, meaning everyone has access unless changed by a permission plugin).
*   **Configuration:** Edit `config.yml` in the `/plugins/ToggleChat/` folder to change messages (using MiniMessage) and the list of blocked commands. Reload the server or use a plugin manager for changes to take effect.
*   **Compatibility:** Designed for PaperMC 1.21 and newer.

Download ToggleChat today and give your players the power to control their chat!

title: Dimian's Vanilla Plus
description: A list of mods i compiled together that make my ideal way to play minecraft. Aims to enhance the experience by adding quality-of-life and better performance while maintaining the vanilla experience intact. I did not make the mods.
body:
# **Description:**
A list of mods I compiled together that make my ideal way to play minecraft. Aims to enhance the experience by improving the game's performance, adding to the gameplay with quality-of-life changes and new visuals to make the game more digestible and feel more modern while maintaining the vanilla experience mostly intact.

# **Performance:**
These are mods intended to improve the games performance.

- **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium):** A modern rendering engine for Minecraft which greatly improves performance.
- **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium):** No-compromises game logic/server optimization mod.
- **[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra):** A Sodium addon that adds features that shouldn't be in Sodium.
- **[Indium](https://modrinth.com/mod/indium):** Sodium addon providing support for the Fabric Rendering API, based on Indigo.
- **[Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling):** Using async path-tracing to hide Block-/Entities that are not visible.
- **[More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling):** A mod that changes how multiple types of culling are handled in order to improve performance.
- **[FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core):** Memory usage optimizations.
- **[Memory Leak Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/memoryleakfix):** A mod that fixes random memory leaks for both the client and server.
- **[ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast):** Speed up immediate mode rendering in Minecraft.
- **[Let Me Despawn](https://modrinth.com/plugin/lmd):** Improves performance by tweaking mob despawn rules. Say bye to pesky unintentional persistent mobs. 

# **Quality-of-Life:**
These are mods that not only add extra information and visual feedback to your actions, but also some gameplay tweaks to make the experience more convenient and feel more modern.

- **[Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei):** JEI - View Items and Recipes.
- **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu):** Adds a mod menu to view the list of mods you have installed.
- **[Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks):** Enhances inventory management by adding various functions to the mouse buttons.
- **[Eating Animation](https://modrinth.com/mod/eating-animation):** A mod that adds sprite animations for edible and drinkable items.
- **[AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin):** Food/hunger-related HUD improvements.
- **[Enchantment Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-descriptions):** Provides a way to get enchantment descriptions from enchanted books.
- **[Advancement Plaques](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancement-plaques):** Replace those boring advancement popups with something flashier.
- **[Legendary Tooltips](https://modrinth.com/mod/legendary-tooltips):** Give your rare items a fancier tooltip! Also adds additional tooltip configuration options.
- **[Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations):** Make your game like the trailers! Dynamic animated entities to freshen your Minecraft experience.
- **[Better Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-advancements):** Better Advancements tries to improve the UI and UX for the advancements system in minecraft 1.12+ in a modded environment.
- **[Dynamic Crosshair](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamiccrosshair):** A mod that hides or changes the crosshair dependent on context.
- **[Item Highlighter](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-highlighter):** Highlights newly picked-up items. Simple and convenient.
- **[Pick Up Notifier](https://modrinth.com/mod/pick-up-notifier):** Be notified about all the things you've just collected.
- **[Tiny Item Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/tiny-item-animations):** Adds little animations when you pick up or insert items with your mouse.
- **[Leaves Be Gone](https://modrinth.com/mod/leaves-be-gone):** Quick leaf decay from cutting down trees. Built for fast performance and mod compat!
- **[Traveler's Titles](https://modrinth.com/mod/travelers-titles):** Epic, RPG-like titles when entering biomes & dimensions!
- **[Minecart Turning](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecart-turning):** MC-201 fix; player camera turns with minecart (and other uncontrolled entities).
- **[Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered):** A Minecraft mod that provides realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks.
- **[LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights):** A dynamic lights mod for Fabric.

# **Gameplay additions:**
These are mods that change or make additions to gameplay, such as new features and tweaks.

- **[Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap):** Displays a map of the nearby world terrain, players, mobs, entities in the corner of your screen. Lets you create waypoints which help you find the locations you've marked.
- **[Keep Some Inventory](https://modrinth.com/datapack/keep-some-inventory):** Don't lose equipment but drop resources when dying.
- **[Nyf's Spiders 2.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/nyfs-spiders):** Vanilla spiders are not yet creepy enough for you? You wish spiders would actually climb properly?! Spiders 2.0 enables regular spiders and cave spiders to walk along walls and ceilings and it also improves their AI such that they can find their way around almost any obstacle.

# **Visuals:**
Mods that directly change the graphics and visuals of the game.

- **[Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones):** Minecraft with the style of the trailers.
- **[Complementary Shaders - Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined):** Preserving the elements of Minecraft with exceptional quality, detail, and performance.
- **[Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity):** A Fabric mod that allows for efficient connected textures.
- **[Barebones Better Leaves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/barebones-better-leaves):** Creates holes on leaves in a style that fits the barebones resourcepack.
- **[Colourful containers GUI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/colourful-containers-gui):** A container GUI replacement mod that hopes to match the menu to every one of Minecraft's colourful interactable blocks.

# **Credits:**
I did not make the mods themselves but simply put them all together in a modpack, all the credits go to the respective creators.
The mod descriptions are taken from the pages of the respective mods.

title: Slashbridge
description: serverside utility mod aiming to add in minecraft commands that I think the base game lacks, bridging datapack and mod function.
body:
### Slashbridge

## What does it do?

Slashbridge was started because there are functions that I was like "Really? You can't do that with commands?" In its current state it adds commands, but the plan is to expand it to other serverside features that will be used my own datapacks and data-driven mods, and hopefully yours too!

## Commands

<details>
<summary>/motion</summary>
Entitymotion allows you to smoothly move an entity and edit its current velocity in different ways.
  
Movement subcommands:

> set (vector) - Changes the entity's velocity to a new vector.
> 
> add (vector) - Adds a new vector to the entity's current velocity.
> 
> seek (number) - Moves targets towards an entity (or away from with a negative number).
> 
> mult (number) - Multiplies a target's current velocity by a number.

Vector movement formats:

> world - Movement corresponds to in-game coordinates. <x> <y> <z>
> 
> local - Movement relative to where the target entity is facing. <forward/back> <up/down> <right/left>
> 
> zx - Movement rotates only horizontally but not vertically. Y is always up in the game world and not up relative to where an entity is facing. <forward/back> <y> <right/left>
</details>

 
<details>
<summary>/status</summary>
Entitystatus lets you modify the health, hunger, and absorption values of an entity. 

Subcommands:

> seek lets you transfer any of these stats from one entity to another, such as giving an entity hunger by removing another's health.
> 
> The rest of the subcommands +|-|*|/|= are just math operators. 
</details>


<details>
<summary>/despawn</summary>


  
Despawn lets you despawn entities without technically killing them. They won't drop items or xp or anything. Currently made to ignore players.

Subcommands:

> recursive - Despawns the entity targeted alongside all of its passengers.
>
> single - Despawns only the entity targeted.
</details>

<details>
<summary>/after</summary>

After lets you run a command after a number of ticks. Can be stacked with other commands. For example `/execute at @p run after 100 kill' could be a command. 

</details>

<details>
<summary>/during</summary>

During lets you run a command during day, night, or a specific moon phase. 

</details>

<details>
<summary>/Ignite & /Extinguish</summary>

Set entities on fire or put it out. The ignite command lets you set the number of ticks entities are on fire for.

</details>

## Tags

These will have some degree of command functionality, but they partially use minecraft's command system and can be added & manipulated with the /tag command.

<details>
<summary>Damage Resitance and Vulnerability</summary>
sb.dx.<damageType>+<multiplier>
  
> This adds in damage multipliers for a specific damage type. These are done in camelcase, as that's what's displayed in minecraft. So instead of writing indirect_magic you'd write indirectMagic.
> 
> sb.dx.mob+0.5 would mean you take half melee damage from mobs
> 
> these tags are not intended to stack, and the math will work out weirdly if you try and stack them.
> 
> you can put negative multipliers to heal on damage.

sb.damageheal

> This tag is added when an entity heals instead of taking damage. It does not get removed at the moment, with the assumption that whoever's using the tag for tracking purposes can remove it on their end.
</details>


## Plans for the future

<details>
<summary>Player Animation Command(s)</summary>
  
Idk how plausable this is, but I want to be able to queue up player animations available in vanilla game such as swinging a hand or sitting. Whether or not this would be possible, especially at my current skill level, only time will tell.
</details>

title: No more keybinds
description: One menu instead of thousands keybindings
body:
**No more keybinds** is a unique solution for managing numerous keybinds in Minecraft, especially useful for large modpacks. This mod allows users to open and interact with a convenient menu of all available keybinds without needing to assign separate keys.

#### Main Features:
- **Keybind Menu**: Press `Alt` to open an automatically generated menu with all available keybinds in the game.
- **Menu Control**: Hold the middle mouse button to move the menu to a convenient spot on your screen.
- **Interactive Control**: You can trigger keybinds directly through the menu, even if no specific key is assigned to them, simplifying interaction with a large number of keybinds.
- **Mod Support**: The entire interface can display keybinds from other mods. This mod is specifically designed for modpacks with many mods where the number of keybinds can grow quickly.

#### Future Plans:
- **Interface Editor**: In future updates, users will be able to customize the appearance of the menu to suit their needs.
- **Full Keypress Emulation**: There will be an option to fully simulate keypresses through the menu, further expanding the mod's functionality.

#### What Makes This Mod Unique?
**Keybind Menu Mod** is the first and only solution that allows you to manage keybinds efficiently through an intuitive menu without manually assigning them to individual keyboard buttons. This makes it indispensable for modpacks with many mods and keybinds.

The mod is in active development, and more customization and usability improvements will be added in the future.

## ✅ Pack Features

- Adds intensity and a border to budding amethyst, making it much easier to distinguish from regular amethyst!

## ℹ️ Frequently Asked Questions

**Q:** What Minecraft versions is this resource pack compatible with?

**A:** This resource pack should be compatible with Java Minecraft versions 1.17 and up, and does **NOT** require Optifine. If you are playing in a version below 1.21, you can safely ignore the "made for a new version of Minecraft" warning (unless you're playing on a version below 1.17 of course).

**A:** When excavating amethyst geodes, I've always struggled with distingushing regular amethyst from budding amethyst, often resulting budding amethyst accidentally being broken. title: CastleGuard
description: A Custom Whitelist and Join Suite Plugin
body:
# CastleGuard
## Powerful Join Suite with Customizable Whitelisting

CastleGuard started off as a simple whitelist plugin. After using it and hearing feedback from other admins, we've decided that we could have done it better. Now Castle Guard can have customizable whitelist options set in your config as well as custom on-join commands.

As we're releasing a major 2.0 release so quickly we understand your configs will break. We've included the default config for the 2.0 release below for those that were early adopters.
```yaml
config-version-dont-change: 1
join-commands:
  enabled: false
  commands:
    - command: whisper %player% Hello World!
      as_player: true
  prefix:
    enabled: false
    prefix: "BR_"
whitelist:
  enabled: false
  mode: admin
  verbose: false
  modes:
    - name: whitelist
      message: "You are not whitelisted on this server."
      permission: "castleguard.whitelist"
    - name: staff
      message: "Server is limited to staff-only."
      permission: "castleguard.whitelist.staff"
    - name: admin
      message: "Server is in admin-only lockdown."
      permission: "castleguard.whitelist.admin"

```

For more details, see our [Wiki](https://loungemc.net/wiki)

title: ItemGator
description: Prevent players from having/using specific items until they have a certain tag!
body:
Looking for an easy way to prevent players from having *anything* to do with an item until they've made it further through progression? Then look no further! ItemGator allows you to use datapack-style recipes in order to prevent players from being able to have an item until some other process - be it an FTB Quest Reward, a Per-Tick `mcfunction` or some other means - adds a tag to the player.

When the tag isn't present on the player, the item will turn into whatever item is defined as a substitute and all of the data for the original item will be stored on the substitute as NBT.

When the tag *is* present, the mod will use that NBT data on the item to revert it back to its original form, allowing you to push the use of an item to a later time.


## Datapack examples:

### Disallow access to an entire mod until the tag `test123` is given to the player

In this example, the mod Immersive Engineering is being gated from any player that doesn't have the tag `test123`. When a player without that tag obtains *any* Immersive Engineering item, it'll turn into a stick until they are granted that tag.

```json
{
  "type": "itemgator:mod",
  "mod": "immersiveengineering",
  "substitute": { "item": "minecraft:stick" },
  "tag": "test123"
}

```

### Disallow an item or item tag until the tag `test123`is given to the player

In this example, any `minecraft:planks` will be turned into a stick until the player is granted the tag `test123`:

```json
{
  "type": "itemgator:ingredient",
  "input": { "tag": "minecraft:planks" },
  "substitute": { "item": "minecraft:stick" },
  "tag": "test123"
}
```

title: Reverscore
description: Reverscore is a mod for the Revers Modpacks which adds various items and bosses.
body:
Reverscore is a mod which adds items, armors sets, tools, boss fights and other assets for the Revers: Reverse Collapse and Revers: Continuum Turbulence modpacks.

It will not work properly outside of it.

Nearly everything in Reverscore has no recipe of its own since the items are supposed to be obtained by using other mods, in a modpack.

Reverscore currently adds seven armor sets, four items that grant various buffs while in the inventory or offhand, several bosses and miscellaneous items.

**Armor Effects**
Deluge: Absorption IV, Luck, Speed, Strength, Haste, Fire Resistance, Saturation II
Archaeologist: Absorption III, Resistance II, Regeneration II, Saturation, Weakness, Slowness II
Soleipse: Speed, Strength III, Fire Resistance II
Lunepse: Speed III, Strength I, Haste II

**Pocket Items Effects**
Pocket Elisa: +100 Damage, Speed II and Resistance II
Double Tap Root Beer: +20 Damage
Ashes of Divine Winter: Permanent Fire Aspect and inflicting Slowness
Wheel-Dice of Fate: Grants random effects when hurting mobs
Ars Automatica: Grants various items when killing mobs with potion effects.

**Bosses**
Avar - an evil manifestation of greed, will summon his mercenaries against you and run away.
Kintoru - an evil manifestation of control who has mimicked a small ghast, will summon her puppets and accursed minions against you.
Netamo - an evil manifestation of rage who has mimicked a giant wolf, will rush towards you and fight you.
Gorge - an evil manifestation of gluttony. He will lifesteal off your damage.
Enzukai - an evil manifestation of jealousy who has mimicked an enderman, will fight you and steal your damage inflicted to him.
Hybrice - an evil manifestation of pride. Hybrice was too prideful to not have minions like Kintoru and so will attack you alongside an army of arthropods.
Yuma - the evil manifestation of rebirth. After defeating all previous evil, Yuma will end the world and restart everything anew. Yuma is the strongest boss of Reverscore and is almost impossible to defeat in Vanilla Minecraft circumstances.


**Continuum Turbulence Exclusive**
Ice Armor Set and Tools: A very frail but powerful early game option. Grants regeneration 1.
Ice Pick: A pickaxe specially made to mine ice.
Frozen Ice Armor Set and Tools: An upgraded expensive version of the Ice Set. Grants various effects.
Godly Stick: A stick which grants various buffs upon the player.


A small thanks to Superwibr for helping out for the bosses and textures.

Wiki: https://revers.fandom.com/wiki/Revers_Wiki
 
Revers: Reverse Collapse: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/revers-reverse-collapse

Revers: Continuum Turbulence: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/revers-continuum-turbulence
