body:
**TridentboxRooms | The Ultimate Automated 1v1 PvP Arena Solution**

**High-performance, fully automated 1v1 PvP system designed for modern Minecraft servers.**

[GUI Showcase](https://youtu.be/luSAMKpa948)

---

## Overview
TridentboxRooms removes the need for manual duels or complex lobby setups. Players simply walk into a designated area, and the plugin handles everything—from sealing the perimeter with dynamic glass cages to managing win/loss states and teleportation.

## Why Choose TridentboxRooms?
Whether you run a **BoxPvP, Factions, or KitPvP** server, providing a seamless 1v1 experience is essential. This plugin is a **"Set and Forget"** solution. With high-performance indexing and a built-in GUI editor, you can deploy professional combat rooms in minutes without touching a single configuration file.

**Arena Editor GUI**
![arenaeditor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52adaa4b0f3d1f97a7266c85b28278cbd0f69952.png)
*Configure everything in-game with zero file editing required.*

---

## Unique Arena Modes
1.  **Glass Mode:** Perfect for open-world zones. When a fight starts, a temporary glass perimeter seals the area.
2.  **Portal Mode:** Ideal for lobbies. Players step into 3D zones and are teleported to a private arena.

**Arena Showcases**

| Glass Arena in Action | Portal Arena Entrance |
| :---: | :---: |
| [![Glass Arena Video](https://img.youtube.com/vi/ISyjzpbwj9A/0.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ISyjzpbwj9A) | [![Portal Arena Video](https://img.youtube.com/vi/4c4BFEQo3qc/0.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4c4BFEQo3qc) |

---

## Key Features
- **Advanced Potion System**: Apply any of the 30+ Minecraft potion effects per arena.
- **Intelligent Session Management**: Winner stays feature allows back-to-back challenges.
- **Built-in Anti-Escape**: Automatically blocks Ender Pearls, Chorus Fruit, and Flight during combat.
- **PlaceholderAPI Support**: Display arena status and fighter statistics on your scoreboard.

**Potion Configuration Menu**
![potioneditor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/543839d30ba949bf0d2055ae4c0d5085c2698948.png)

---

## Technical Excellence
- **Zero-Lag Design**: O(1) Spatial Indexing for instantaneous player detection.
- **Professional Aesthetics**: Custom Unicode font mode for all in-game messages.
- **Dynamic Action Bar**: Real-time countdowns for winners and session status.
- **Flexible Storage**: Native support for YAML, H2, and MySQL.

| Clean Small Font Style | Action Bar Countdown |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![Small Font]![buildingoff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6cc95e8c0e5dc9e826b551a78d734db869d26855.webp) | ![Action Bar]![glassdissapear](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94ddfc60d3e27a4dca5477a14964737737267cf7.webp) |
![potion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/728f208a3ad15f9666bdf052f8d6de0781ef4194.webp)

---

## Commands & Permissions

| Command | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/arena wand` | `tridentbox.admin.wand` | Get the region selection wand |

| `/arena reload` | `tridentbox.admin.reload` | Reload config and messages |

title: CosmicUtilities
description: CosmicUtilities is a utilities mod that improves gameplay. Specifically made for CosmicPrisons, brought to you by the Minecoin team.
body:
# 🛠️ What is CosmicUtilities?
CosmicUtilities is a mod that was developed by the Minecoin team to bring back many useful aspects of Cosmic Client. Take advantage of useful QoLs like Peaceful Mining, Cooldown hud, Satchel HUD, and much more to come!

## ✅ Features
### Peaceful Mining
Tired of people getting in your way whilst mining? Well now when you hold out your pickaxe, players will become translucent so you can mine freely!

![Peaceful Mining Demo](https://imgur.com/Kj0gN3j.png)

### Cooldown HUD

View all of your cooldowns in one place- This HUD gives you a screen overlay so you know when your cooldowns are up!

**Supported Cooldowns:** Adrenaline, Feed, Fix, Home, Jet, Powerball

![Cooldown HUD Demo](https://imgur.com/vSrMb85.png)

### Satchel HUD
Easily view on-screen all of your satchels and how full they are so you know just when to sell!

![Satchel HUD Demo](https://imgur.com/Fe3wIeb.png)

### Easy-view Number Overlay
Easily glance and see the amount of a certain item you have without hovering over it!

**Supported Items:** Cosmic Energy, Money, Gang Points, Charge Orbs, Black Scrolls

![Number Overlay Demo](https://imgur.com/4Z9QAsW.png)

### Mod Customization Menu
Customize and toggle different aspects of the mod.

![Mod Customization Menu](https://imgur.com/8JIc3WP.png)

### Other Features
- Chat Mention & Message Notifications
- Pickaxe Drop Confirmation
- Right click while mining for Powerball

## ❓ How to add the mod to Lunar Client:
- Open Lunar Client's version selector and click on the version you wish to use
- Press the ⚙️ button at the bottom right, then select the Mods tab at the top
- Drag the mod into the window

title: Skyrim Harvest and Hearth

body:
# 🍞 Skyrim Harvest and Hearth

**Bring the flavors and flora of Tamriel to your Minecraft world!**

Experience the rich culinary traditions of Skyrim with this comprehensive food mod that adds over 60 authentic foods, drinks, and cooking mechanics directly inspired by The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim.


## ✨ Features

### 🥘 **Authentic Skyrim Foods**
- **Sweet Rolls** - The iconic pastry that guards are always asking about
- **Garlic Bread** - Provides disease resistance, just like in Skyrim
- **Mammoth Steak** - Hearty meat from the frozen tundra
- **Nordic Cheeses** - Sliced Goat Cheese and Eidar Cheese
- **Regional Vegetables** - Ash Yams, Leeks, Cabbage, and Tomatoes
- **Exotic Fruits** - Jazbay Grapes, Juniper Berries, and Snowberries

### 🍺 **Skyrim Beverages**
- **Nord Mead** - The drink of choice for true Nords
- **Black-Briar Mead** - Premium mead from Riften's finest brewery
- **Alto Wine** - Sophisticated wine for refined tastes
- **Argonian Ale** - Exotic brew from the marshlands
- **Skooma** - The infamous Khajiit beverage (use responsibly!)

### 🔥 **Advanced Cooking System**
- **Oven Recipes** - Bake bread, pastries, and roasts in custom ovens
- **Special Effects** - Many foods provide beneficial effects:
  - Sweet Rolls grant Absorption
  - Garlic Bread cures diseases
  - Raw meats may cause hunger (just like eating questionable food!)

### 🌱 **Farmable Crops**
- **Garlic** - Essential cooking ingredient
- **Tomatoes** - Fresh vegetables for soups and stews
- **Cabbage** - Hardy northern vegetable
- **Ash Yams** - Exotic Morrowind import
- **Berry Bushes** - Harvestable Jazbay, Juniper, and Snowberry bushes

### 🏺 **Cooking Ingredients**
- **Flour** - Ground from wheat for baking
- **Butter** - Rich dairy for cooking
- **Salt Pile** - Essential seasoning for most recipes
- **Specialty Items** - Pearls, eggs, and other rare ingredients

### 📦 **Loot Tables**
- Find all your common ingredients, seeds and more in various loot tables around the world!


## 🍳 Recipe Examples

**Sweet Roll** (Oven)
- Butter + Egg + Salt Pile + Flour + Milk Bucket

**Garlic Bread** (Oven) 
- Butter + Garlic + Flour

**Apple Pie** (Oven)
- Flour + Salt Pile + Butter + Egg + Apple

**Beef Stew** (Cooking Pot)
- Beef + Vegetables + Salt Pile


## 🎮 Gameplay Integration

- **Balanced Nutrition** - All foods provide realistic hunger restoration
- **Survival Friendly** - Perfect for hardcore survival gameplay
- **Quest Rewards** - Use foods as rewards or trade goods
- **Roleplay Enhancement** - Run taverns, become a chef, or trade in exotic foods


## 📋 Requirements

- Forge Config API Port
- Common Network


## 🔧 Compatibility

This mod is designed to be compatible with:
- Most cooking and food mods
- Survival mods (Tough as Nails, etc.)
- Farming mods (Pam's HarvestCraft, etc.)
- Village and structure mods


## 🎯 Future Plans

- Additional Skyrim foods and recipes
- Integration with brewing mechanics
- Custom food effects and buffs
- Compatibility patches for popular mods
- Texture improvements and animations


## 💝 Support the Developer

If you enjoy this mod, please consider:
- ⭐ Leaving a positive review
- 💬 Sharing screenshots of your creations
- 🔄 Recommending to friends
- ☕ [Buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/ryankshah)

---

title: XMod Additions XL
description: A collection of additions made to give unloved items more use, bolster lackluster aspects, and use unique quirks as inspiration for new features in this Vanilla expansion! Think of it as sprinkling a little zest and flavor over every aspect of the game :D
body:
![mod overview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c907e9bfff72a541edf57432ced2247bf67ffe35.png)

_Nether brick is the only stone type that has fences... why aren't there any wood types with walls?_
_Why are saddles only ontained through loot tables?_
_Why is there a Hell, but not a Heaven?_
_Why is redstone so extensive, but inventory management so limited?_
_Why is the game bloated with so many items that only have a single use?_

These questions and more are what prompted the creation of this pack!

# Welcome to XMod Additions XL

[GitHub Repo for bug reports, reviews, and more!](https://github.com/revisiony2k-debug/XMod-Additions-XL)

[MMC Reviews](https://mmcreviews.com/all/mods/xmod-additions-xl/)

This mod brings with it a series of improvements, addons, and features to the Vanilla Minecraft experience, including the revival of recipes that used to exist, imaginative new items and blocks to bring some added life and variety to existing areas, and even a whole new dimension!
Think of it as a Vanilla+ expansion, rather than a mod with a core central theme. I've been working on it on and off for a couple of years, and I am rather pleased to finally publish it. I will not be explaining every minute detail, as I feel leaving some mystery is good fun, but I will be doing my best to explain everything that is needed to get a good experience out of this pack, with or without helper mods like JEI. So, without further ado, let's jump right in!

## Blocks
Starting with the basics, let's talk about all the various blocks that have been added to the game. There's a lot to get through so I will try to categorize them into groups for discussion.

### Wood Types
![Wood Types](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23e8f2af5c5a8a7d9502d6a8497ca0c60eb7fae2.png)
Here are all of the new wood types added to the game. All of them can be found in various new biomes and each has something unique about them. From left to right they are as follows:
- Rosetta. This dark-log pink-plank wood type is the most standard wood type added into the game. It can be found growing in the Cloud Tundra.
- Enlightened Timber. This saturated green wood type is another standard wood type found in the Ethereal Hills.
- Hardwood. This is a very odd wood type that has some unique recipes and block choices. It is found in the Spoopy Forests. Breaking it does not drop logs, but instead drops _Hardwood Chunks_, which can be used to craft the various Hardwood Planks recipes.
- Rotten Wood. This wood type speaks for itself, can only be found in the Deadlands, and is incapable of sustaining plants.

**NOTE that all custom trees you see in this mod cannot be replanted, making the quantities of these new types a distinctly finite resource that must be explored for.**

Hardwood Planks Recipe

![Hardwood Planks Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ac778055ed4a2799eef8f89f22ab04cbc91b37b.png)

Additional Hardwood Recipes

![Hardwood Planks Stonecutter Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7023e1595b367d9102441c66602c13f24d568ce.png)

Rotten Planks Recipe

![Rotten Planks Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/506a3d08046a91999dd20f4f294bf481b368dfe1.png)

Rotten Wood Fence Recipe

![Rotten Wood Fence Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bd916b1d48282bfa0d0860f9fe32030b8cef463.png)

Rotten Wood Slab Recipe

![Rotten Planks Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebf64d63c2dc210dc0e6187afe280fd25f919bde.png)

Rotten Wood Stairs Recipe

![Rotten Wood Stairs Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dddfc9bee76d23ada0fc9075f18d50eda39fad36.png)

Sticks Recipe Using Rotten Planks

![Rotten Wood Sticks Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40249d2bf1e85b420b46e977d7df55e46fb3baf1.png)

### Terrain Blocks
With multiple new biomes in the mod, there comes with it a lot of new blocks to bring those biomes to life. 99% of these blocks cannot be crafted, barring some specific exceptions. There's a lot to cover, so I'll be brief:

**Shale, Silt, Encrusted blocks, and Etherium**

![Shale](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/027aaa97aeff2af35e2f7eb9aaaf26c67c818920.png)

Etherium Recipe

![Etherium Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ea66d0d3c049813c361351177865ca42167cd03.png)

Shale Variants

![Shale Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81729de1a52eee70ca1c2bcc254d343e6e15ff61.png)

What to do with encrusted blocks?

![Encrusted Shale Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfbde7d445e91ce227990ac0696277e0a7bcc1af.png)

**Cloud Block, Cloud Stone, Condensed Cloud Block**

![Cloud Stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe7c3ca6918268044a9d66297d14a7baa7731e76.png)

Cloud Stone Variants

![Cloud Stone Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0103c1272fef3bc94caaa56387b228d123e1dac.png)

Condensed Cloud Rod

![Condensed Cloud Rod Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/685a4cdb1c992049df96601de03a43c4d18cbbcf.png)

Condensed Cloud Trapdoor

![Condensed Cloud Trapdoor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9490868759312dc4a710a5cadead2bf83e43a98.png)

Cloud Pane

![Cloud Pane Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/593df169239e189c3fbb645dd18d98e1e20a5868.png)

**End Stone Sand, Meurclia**

![End Terrain Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64065bc5f58409adbfd213eefce77fd47e000999.png)

**XP Ore**

![XP Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e918b6184129e96c43e11bb13994f382af121a2f.png)

### Function Blocks
Thse blocks that add various useful features and utilities to the world :)

**Recycler**
The Recycler is a useful block that solves the problem of what to do with all of the junk clogging up your system. Normally the solution is to dump it into lava, but then that is quite a waste. Instead, this machine block allows for a very easy way to recycle them into... XP!

![Recycler Powered State](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a10c54308dafccf3535a878b2c572bc9c4a0ee5e.png)

Firstly you want to be sure that the block is enabled, which is done by feeding it a Redstone signal. Then all you need to do is feed into it one of two categories of items via a hopper (or other direct inventory insertion block, depending on what other mods you are using). Those two categories are as follows:
- Stackable items, in a full x64 stack, will be recycled into XP nuggets.
- Non-stackable items will also be recycled into XP nuggets.
**NOTE that there is only a single inventory slot on the machine, so feed items into it with care. Also, items that stack to less than 64 will not be recyclable**

![Recycler In Action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72b75cd13e5e5bc07ed12f4385b3b2ede79552e6.png)

![Recycler Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be0f546072ef277aaa29f51df1e82f7bc50229e5.png)

**Truss Block**
The Truss block is a simple utility block that is completely pass-through when unpowered, and a solid block when powered. This should allow for some useful redstone contraptions, and also some other uses...

![Chicken Suffocation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4848311a51acdd3e41c03325065b8c4a5e334913.png)

![Truss Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/314a6ad186fca19d56c4c79d32a8bd7f60d12f1e.png)

**Redstone Sand**
Redstone Sand does what it says on the tin: it's a gravity block that provides redstone power. It's weaker than most other redstone power sources, but it should still offer some utility in various contraptions.

![Redstone Sand Power Level](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8720e327e9b9b32e3b0810034678eb4857ca4779.png)

![Redstone Sand Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32c293abb356eeac23fef7149bffa56fe4e75855.png)

**Flint Wire***
Flint Wire is a mostly-decorative block that hurts anything it touches.

![Flint Wire Cow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/643196b521cb3e9d8a10248023cfb229839126e1.png)

![Flint Wire Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ce830934eb9461ff60eca3a2acbf44355a9963f.png)

**Instant TNT**
Simply put TNT into a crafting grid to turn it into this variant. Light with _extreme_ care

![Instant TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/189558a526d80c3fad867f133bb3b2d9e8def43c.png)

**Message Alarm**
This simple block spits out a global message in chat when powered by redstone. Placing a block directly on top of it will label the message with that block, which should offer some customization and opportunities for unique mechanisms and contraptions.

![Message Alarm Function](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e3d5b47dcceab98c8239f8bc0ac4ca833e8bfd0.png)

![Message Alarm Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e85a562b0d7062900f6c4bb6acee13d095e01ca.png)

**Spikes**
Spikes are mostly-decorative blocks that hurt anything they touch. Spikes are affected by gravity, so they should be great fun to use.

![Spikes Cow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3765a7a131d96cd92fa61f6c2126b08b3ce2149.png)

![Spike Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4e75c693de07a015b1595bebe7a954a4b93d66c.png)

**Mining Explosive**
This strong explosive has a helpful delay with messages, so you can all be warned before you die :D

![Mining TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbc7d949c535e6080a6c19b4a12888d9e62099ea.png)

![Mining TNT Detonation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/022f6abda71ceaeb2b38a02626defd1405f004cc_0.webp)

![Mining TNT Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/543db7ba4a3a01f1c9a7a3f8c546d93b7fa5e4bd.png)

**Sifters**
Sifters are a block that allows you to look through ordinary materials such as sand or gravel and recover small bits of useful resources. Different sifters offer different focuses and improvements. I won't spoil those; best to experiment instead hehe

![Sifters](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1530f87591e7dda6d7006c0f5ebd19e3e8a7cd8.png)

As you can see, the blazing sifter (the most expensive one) requires a heat source for full functionality (Magma being used here). The Blazing Sifter also is made by upgrading the Diamond Sifter, not the regular Sifter.

![Sifter Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e60c2fdc79f8dafc90c7650b093b7a096e560c43.png)

![Diamond Sifter Smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d50cab2433e73e1646bfb6a57c502f64e47ef65.png)

![Emerald Sifter Smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16210163eb6e497ef488c02a7626ba1911d6c9c5.png)

![Blazing Sifter Smithing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/faa0874fa6cf3910254bdcf2f0c04f96a75d30d2.png)

**Clear TNT**
This niche but handy block wipes the inventory of the closest player.

![Clear TNT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c7207ba74ad0dd2c80e0cfb889400527e3fd3b5.png)

![Clear TNT Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f94de79a03e99cd2fa5f445ebcb7bb65597da71b.png)

**Hardwood Storage Drum**
This storage-compacting block allows you to store 54 slots of items (the same as a double chest) in a single block, with the downside being that there is no GUI menu to access the items from. Items must be funneled into and out of via hoppers or other direct-inventory-accessing blocks.

![Hardwood Storage Drum](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73915614ad546d7574ea6a844885ee0c837b3a14.png)

![Hardwood Storage Drum Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7bd18b610fb1fc7b46ed2f2f8b453bf068965ac.png)

**Condensed Light**
Condensed Light is the block that you will need to make to create the portal for the new dimension in this pack: The Ethereal Dimension. We'll discuss the dimension more later.

![Condensed Light Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5ecba132e07f8657f42d2b159c02aa741204f51.png)

## Plants
Adding vibrance to the world is always important, and the spices and garnishes of any good gaming dish are flora and fauna. To that end, let's talk about plants! There's a large variety of them, some with unique and special features. I won't talk about absolutely all of them here; just some highlights.

![Plants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa92a34a54228b4b98bcd7ccddf8c218f9d2e491.png)

**Pearlesco**
This is an End-based plant that spawns in some of the biomes (yes the End in vanilla Minecraft does have multiple distinct biomes; this mod hopes to add just a little variety to them). Be very careful when touching them. You have been warned...

![Pearlesco](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70197715572ecb2b999d4ae7c6b6447b769f5c34.png)

**Stickweed**
A plant typically found in several Overworld biomes, the Stickweed is a simple and cute plant with a unique utility to drop a stick as a random chance upon breaking it.

![Stickweed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c666899b9abc8e867af93a187d9924a2c5bc956e.png)

**Ethereal Capsule**
A vessel with untold mysteries long-trapped, released only by breaking it to reveal it's contents. Not a "plant" per se, but it spawns inside of the Ethereal Dimension and can be a source of useful goodies... or unpleasant surprises...

![Ethereal Capsule](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27ce4f92a3f2e060fbacf1fc021cee964a8e9302.png)

## Items
There's not a lot of additional items in the game; most additions have been made in an attempt to integrate existing blocks and features in new ways. However, there are still some interesting ones, so let's go through them:

### Misc. Items
Normally this is at the end, but I'm weird so let's start here first! These are various items added to the game that are only here for very specific purposes or functions (mostly to assist with other block or items added by the mod). They are likely uninteresting on their own, though some do have unique uses that may prove helpful at times.

**Ethereal Shards**
Can be eaten to regain 2 full hunger bars. Has a saturation level of 10. Can only be found in the Ethereal Dimension. It drops from Enriched Shale, is used to craft Etherium (recipe shown earlier), occasionally drops from the Ethereal Stray upon death, and can also be obtained from the Ethereal Stray by bartering with it for a few items (more on that in the Entities section). You can also obtain it from Sculk Sensors.

![Ethereal Shards](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9dbfab9cdb350561d3baf09bd1d01431db692b43.png)

![Sculk Smelting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41c4d6a16a596617f0b2b30b6afe325f1dfaff54.png)

**Dimension Orbs**
Dimension Orbs are items that are obtained and used to create Condensed Light blocks, which you need in order to enter the final dimension: Ethereal. Each one of them is obtained a different way, as shown below. The final orb, the Ethereal Orb, is only obtainable by chance after killing an Ethereal Golem.

![Overworld Orb Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3242ab8837b30167903dbbb0388410e9fc4af63d.png)

![Nether Orb Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50c522790d7580a4ea2f0276088b7cea209cdf37.png)

![End Orb Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/514fa9947aee27770ba20966f950fb50fe2267ab.png)

**Seedling Gun**
The Seedling Gun is a fast-firing weapon that does low damage but hits with great knockback. It's ammunition of choice is... seeds, of course. It will burn through them immensely, but hey -- we know you will have tons of them by the time you can make this weapon.

![Seedling Gun Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f58f04b68a1fea905c066f658d55d72c4b061f9.png)

**Moon Orb**
Drops from the Moonflower upon breaking it. It can be used to tame and breed the CloudPuff.

![Moon Orb](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c02f8c5e478bddb69122134251819afa94ffff15.png)\

**XP Gem & XP Nugget**
Drops from XP Ore. Can be crafted into XP Blocks (shown earlier) and also used to brew Bottles of Enchanting. XP Nuggets can be turned into XP Gems.

![XP Gem Brewing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f744eafc23d17a193bace19998087d23041ef8d5.png)

**Killsword**
The Killsword or "/Kill" is a Creative-Only item that instantly despawns any entity hit with it. This should hopefully be a useful addition to your toolset

![Killsword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf1895ebe8b9e666346a52019b2f735cd900f7c8.png)

**Glass Sword**
The Glass Sword is a sword that is made of glass. Duh. BUT, there is one unique thing about it: It is a potion sword. Yep, you can apply any of the vanilla level 1 potion effects to a Glass Sword and create a weapon with that effect. It's durability is very small (only 10 uses), but it basically gives you a potion effect you can weild. It should offer some very interesting combat options ;)

![Glass Sword Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1e45d441a40f67ed9638a5430be2fcbc38eda57.png)

![Glass Sword Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6db119a8e09bd558406e8dc69acb3d5416f2ff5.png)

![Example Glass Sword Brewing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8ff2f22d6e4a81d795bd58699e10d8bac718853.png)

**Ethereal Portal Igniter**
The item by which you ignite your portal to the Ethereal Dimension.

![Potal Igniter Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9396ca31097e58cf3d9966b1ebdef47a7551722.png)

**Flint Chopper**
A simple item that is cheap, hits slow and weak, but also has a nasty status effect. Great early-game weapon and also used to make the Glass Sword.

![Flint Chopper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9038ba116d011f40f7cffa67589f77535ee16e0e.png)

**Glow Juice**
This is the only fluid in the game, which you can also put into a bucket. It pulls you in rather than pushes you away, and has an insane amount of buffs it provides you. It is only found in the Ethereal Dimension, as a direct fluid or encased within Glow Crystals.

![Glow Juice](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3b3939d53a67b261a79c5bb567b463af0262a0e.png)

**Yoink**
This is a bit of a silly device. What it does is it takes an item at random from any of the slots in the hotbar of whomever you with with it. It's not particularly useful but it can be annoying to defend against and something to have fun with friends :)

![Yoink Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4cb714b2a740f1e1ac11097193cb388895fd98be.png)

**Slapstick**
Another silly weapon, this is all knockback and no damage. A hassle to deal with, but otherwise nothing more. Use this to deeply annoy your friends (or other mobs).

![Slapstick Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d287e495e99380c311eb6438cb73991fa215f87a.png)

### Weapons, Armor, and Tools
These are the triditional Swords, Pickaxes, Shovels, Hoes, and Axes that you're all familiar with. Here you can see all of the new ones added to the game. All crafting recipes are "traditional" unless shown differently.

From left-to-right, the new weapon and tool sets are: Amethyst, Scale, Lapis, Redstone, Prismarine, Crystal

![New Weapons & Tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8444acb20858d6aad48f62930272d0b64e5bfb86.png)

From left-to-right, the new armor sets are: Lapis, Emerald, Redstone, Crystal, Prismarine, Scale, Amethyst

![New Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6103e4043ae20a6bd8917944128edbb45d5d8027.png)

**Lapis Armor**
Made by combining Chain Armor and lapis in a crafting table. Very simple and inexpensive.

![Lapis Armor Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c854991afe554d20455483477e813745810a29b.png)

**Emerald Armor**
Made by cutting each piece from an Emerald Block in a Stonecutter.

![Emerald Armor Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30be4bbcb776eab0559b859272ecbe1a6dce45db.png)

**Redstone Armor**
Made by brewing redstone on Iron Armor.

![Redstone Armor Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0682f13360b33dac1a28676977148f2851f790e8.png)

**Crystal Armor**
Made by smithing Glow Crystals with Diamond Armor.

![Crystal Armor Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/749b3d01deeec9a5d2ff0737d918ee6e2804e6ed.png)

**Amethyst Armor**
Made with a unique crafting recipe for each piece. Also requires Leather Armor as a base.

![Amethyst Helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49e865ea5bc1108b5352c1f0285bccdd2dc76e45.png)

![Amethyst Chestplate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6c02471095cd6046f7a29cbe85858b63f4fbf49.png)

![Amethyst Leggings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbe9ffdcc12f3d5307fe5949fe4cf3dd2a556484.png)

![Amethyst Boots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1798024b3e66812014dd0ca61793afe5c45ee19.png)

## Recipes
Here are some recipes that seek to either bring back old craftable items or make new recipes for previously-uncraftable items and blocks. Hopefully these additions will contribute to an enhanced gameplay experience :)

**Leather Smelting**

![Rotten Flesh Smelting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66f784b51a120c82afd7526c29cbd4e6f7d90afa.png)

**Water Bucket Juicing**
This recipe should work with pretty much all small flowers in Vanilla.

![Small Flowers to Water Bucket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3d771a10f83d17aed45cac08090c71abad0fa2c.png)

**Craftable Flint (in two ways)**

![Flint Stonecutter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78f4cc91368a89f43bc715ff91ef89dc6807d7d8.png)

![Flint Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83d3909f2985725547de322909ca49e12d54d06e.png)

**(Some) Mob Eggs**

![Zombie Egg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69928cce35cc27ebca949eddeabf6d9898c663b9.png)

![Wither Skeleton Egg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4902124a1827275e25800c8866ece0bfcad38cd9.png)

![Creeper Egg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4542a0e81b5b018f5f3896fb4484d149c818b4ed.png)

![Dragon Egg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e66427742f231b2d19a1536e479129446b6c7956.png)

**GOD Apples**

![God Apple Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97589567b7c9da298317ae9b17612b4ed73a9c88.png)

**Soul Sand / Soul Soil**

![Soul Sand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b3df6a54c7908cd401c3f55a0ef02b89f213d76.png)

![Soul Soil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/74b7cf6e2bb21b121b3ef5f85bfef1020c9875f0.png)

**End Portal Frames**

![End Portal Frames](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/209e2870df9a96599a6f91b527d87c24f7461876.png)

**Horse Armor**

![Iron Horse Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c88ab00d2c7a75ec51555f12e4d80997065e51c.png)

![Gold Horse Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb7a9e25f7e961280661a2cfe9c2db3cd5d7a817.png)

**Name Tag**

![Name Tag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52db29592afabe2722f863be80ee7fcfe7f05c5c.png)

**Chain Armor (Revised)**

![Chain Helmet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9dfb70660a8d3abea71b5b8b59b3ac6ee8f546e1.png)

![Chain Chestplate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5bca0b6cbd98e5c7cb049f2b025cbe0ce8be5d6.png)

![Chain Leggings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05dadd0456f1f37338abdb22bca919d925af4e89.png)

**Craftable String**

![String From Cobwebs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0974db6f38887c1264bc20d3d01aad60c8721f5b.png)

**Copper Nuggets**
And yes, you can turn them back into Ingots.

![Copper Nugget Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/017742ef688270540d2a5b5fd91fd3575d06b644.png)

## Biomes And Dimensions
In the world of Minecraft, Biomes are the true spice of life. Most of the ones created for this mod were made for the new Dimension, Ethereal, but a couple still ended up in the Overworld as well.

### Overworld

**Deadlands**
This biome is made up of darkened, rough terrain. Filled with coarse dirt, mossy Cobblestone, Dripstone caves, Dungeons, and forests that rot away before your very eyes, it is not a nice place to be. Here is where you will also find the Dying Flower.

![Deadlands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f48b57167ba84e46d51f185f439b326e8ff4ecb_0.webp)

**Spoopy Forests**
This biome is prety much what it sounds like. Trees made of Hardwood and cobwebs, the ground littereed with Wispyreed and Sticky Grass, eery particles wafting around -- even the sky a perpetual orange. Mycelium coats the landscape, with coarse dirt yet again making it's presence known. Here is where you might get lucky with gold and emerald, or unlucky if you happen across this place at night.

### Ethereal
The penultimate dimension, the Ethereal plane is one of great reward and discovery. Contained within are unique creatures, fantastic treasures, and beautiful vistas. It also provides opportunities for new lovely decoration blocks that you cannot get anywhere else!

![Ethereal Dimension Portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b9b3d69e920344942836fd1a2067cbf12fe92da.png)

![Ethereal Dimension Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/131b61250433203451df1d5bb1edae67bd7fadd1_0.webp)

## Creatures
In this mod there aren't a lot of new additions, and all of them can be found in the Ethereal Dimension. Let's take a look at each one\

**Ethereal Golem**
This is the only hostile mob in the mod. This nasty guardian flies around the world, and sends you flying with a nasty ranged attack if he spots you. It has 100 Health and is equipped with strong armor and weapons. Good luck!

![Ethereal Golem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28667c26c949472c604f93184eed1000cf6df4e1.png)

**CloudPuff**
The most passive mob added, this cute little goon is a new companion for you. It likes Moon Orbs, which you can also use to breed it, and they will often congregate around Moonflowers. You can ride them, granting you no jump but quite a lot of speed, and you can also tame them. Easily distracted, afraid of conflict, and with only 10 Health, the CloudPuff is a friend best kept safe elsewhere (although do be aware that once tamed, they will follow you around for LIFE).

![CloudPuff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a13a83b465b2f7d7488141fb01e5c0a71d59c5a.png)

**Ethereal Stray**
A passive mob whose function serves as the closest thing to a sentient life form, a master of strange transmutation abilities. With 250 health they aren't too easily slain, and they also have a passive to regenerate their health, but they won't hurt you. Right-clicking on them with the item you wish to offer in your main hand initiates the transmutation process. The available options are the following:
- Giving Amethyst Shards, Prismarine Shards, or Prismarine Crystals transmutates into Ethereal Shards (instant)
- Giving a Bucket of Glow Juice transmutates into a Glow Crystal (20 ticks)
- Giving a Nether Star transmutates into an End Crystal (100 ticks)
- Giving a Block of Coal transmutates into a Diamond (20 ticks)
- Giving a Heart of the Sea transmutates into a Beacon. (100 ticks)
- Giving a Dragon Egg transmutates into a Mob Spawner Cage (200 ticks)

![Ethereal Stray](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6f01f89c2d942f917792a09285bf1406b220890.png)

title: DAClearLag
description: The DAClearLag mod is a Minecraft mod for servers using Fabric, designed to improve performance by automatically removing ground objects at regular intervals. It is inspired by the well-known Bukkit plugin “ClearLagg”.
body:
**🔧 Intelligent server optimization! 🔧
**
Boost your performance with this revolutionary mod that automatically cleans up objects on the floor every 5 

minutes, preventing excessive accumulation of useless entities. But don't panic! An alert is broadcast 30 

seconds before deletion, allowing you to recover your precious objects before they disappear.

🌍 Multi-world compatibility ensures smooth, consistent item management, no matter what universe you're in.

**🔥 Why adopt this mod? 🔥**

✅ Increased performance: Reduces server load by eliminating superfluous entities.  

✅ Enhanced security: Warnings before deletion to avoid any loss of objects.  

✅ Total automation: Operates autonomously, with no need for manual commands.

🚀 Mod Loader: **Fabric** 
🛠 Version: **1.20.1**

This mod guarantees a smoother, faster and better organized server. Efficient management for optimized gameplay!

title: InGame Info Reborn
description: In-game HUDs and GUIs done with structure — reactive, declarative, composable, and built to handle the rest.
body:
InGame Info Reborn

"In-game HUDs and GUIs done with structure — reactive, declarative, composable, and built to handle the rest."


[![Versions](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/game-versions/1171541?logo=curseforge&label=Game%20Version)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ingame-info-reborn) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1171541?logo=curseforge&label=Downloads)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ingame-info-reborn) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/ingame-info-reborn?logo=modrinth&label=Downloads)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ingame-info-reborn) This is a _Work-In-Progress_ spiritual successor of [InGame-Info-XML](https://github.com/Lunatrius/InGame-Info-XML), **not a fork**. If you like this project, don't forget to give it a star⭐! Suggestions/PRs are welcome ## Overview This is a library mod that helps you to create in-game overlaid (or focused) GUI with ease. ![Snipaste_2025-01-12_12-53-07](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/581f0727-bba8-4ff5-9780-8fdbfaf587fd) (Nothing will pop up with the default configuration!) ### Architectural Modules Chart
Click to Expand | Module | Role | Status | |------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------| | **MVVM Base** | Separates logic (ViewModel) from rendering (View) | ✅ Done | | **XAML-Style DSL For View** | Declarative XAML-style layout to build static UI trees | ✅ Done | | **Reactive Binding** | View reacts to changes in ViewModel automatically | ✅ Done | | **Compose (Injected via Slot)** | Immediate-mode UI embedded in ViewModel | ⚠️ Partially | | **Snapshot Diffing** | Virtual tree diffing for Compose-based UI | ✅ Done | | **Shared Context** | Shared runtime context between ViewModel and Compose blocks | ✅ Done | | **DOM-Like Event System** | Input propagation and event capturing/bubbling | ✅ Done | | **Interactable Control** | Captures input, intercepts propagation (works with Event System) | ✅ Done | | **Fixed / Render Update** | Dual update loop for logic vs render | ✅ Done | | **Annotation Driven Auto-Interpolation** | Utility for smooth interpolation during render updates | ✅ Done | | **Render Op Queue** | Abstract draw commands for controls | ✅ Done | | **UI Decoration** | Draw custom visuals on existing controls | ✅ Mostly Done | | **Transition API** | Externally trigger view transitions | 🚧 Planned | | **Theme Manager** | Global theme system (colors, font scale, etc) | ✅ Mostly Done | | **Modal Layer** | Stack-based modal / dialog system | 🚧 Planned |
### Example ```xml ... ``` ```java // snippet from View and ViewModel classes @Reactive(targetUid = "fps", property = "text", initiativeSync = true) public ReactiveObject fpsText = new ReactiveObject<>(){}; EventCenter.gameFpsEvent.addListener((fps) -> { fpsText.set("FPS: " + fps); }); ``` ```java // registration entry point @SubscribeEvent public static void onIgiRuntimeEntryPoint(IgiRuntimeEntryPointEvent event) { event.runtime.initPhase .registerMvvm("example", ExampleViewModel.class) .openGuiOnStartup("example"); } ``` ## Wiki - [WIP Wiki](https://tttsaurus.github.io/Ingame-Info-Reborn-Wiki/) ## Implementation Todo List / Overview
Click to Expand _**Currently working on the architecture.**_

title: Lyumix Discord Auth
description: Server Side Mod for Authentication of Players via Discord
body:
# 🔐 Lyumix Discord Auth – Secure Minecraft Authentication  

Lyumix Discord Auth is a **lightweight and secure** authentication mod for Minecraft servers that uses **Discord for two-factor verification**. Keep your server protected while providing a **seamless** login experience for players.  

## ✨ Features  
- 🔒 **Discord-Based Two-Factor Authentication** – Ensure only verified players can join.  
- 🕐 **Auto-Login System** – Configurable auto-login for trusted players.  
- 🌍 **Multiple Database Support** – SQLite (default), MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.  
- ⚡ **Lightweight & Performant** – Minimal impact on server performance.  
- 🎮 **Seamless Player Experience** – Easy-to-use authentication flow.  
- 🛡️ **Advanced Security Features** – Configurable login timeouts, IP-based auto-login, and more.  

## 📦 Installation  
1. Download the latest release.  
2. Place the `.jar` in your server’s `mods` folder.  
3. Start the server to generate configuration files.  
4. Edit `config/lyumix-discord-auth/config.hocon` to set up your database and Discord bot.  

## ⚙️ Configuration  
The mod generates two configuration files:  
- `config.hocon` – Main mod settings (database, Discord bot, authentication).  
- `messages.hocon` – Customizable messages.  

Supports **SQLite (default, no setup), MongoDB, and PostgreSQL** for authentication data storage.  

## 📝 Commands  
- `/lda reload` – Reload the configuration.  
- `/lda force unlink player <name>` – Unlink a player’s Discord account.  
- `/register <username>` – Players link their Minecraft account via Discord.  

## 🚀 Compatibility  
✅ Works with **Minecraft 1.21 - 1.21.1**  
✅ Requires **Fabric API**  
⚠️ **Not compatible with other authentication mods.**  

## 🔧 Planned Features  
✔️ More database support (MySQL, etc.)  
✔️ Multi-factor authentication options  
✔️ Extended developer API  

## 📄 License  
Licensed under **MIT**. Free to use and modify.  

🔗 **[GitHub Repository](https://github.com/MatterMoulder/Lyumix-Minecraft-Discord-Auth-Bot)** | 💬 **[Support Discord](https://ds.mmldr.tech)**

# 😴 So Tired
So Tired is the ultimate optimization modpack for Minecraft.  
Tired of low FPS and lag? Our carefully curated collection of mods, including Sodium, Lithium, and Iris Shaders, will boost your game's performance and enhance your visual experience. Whether you're building massive structures or exploring vast worlds, So Tired ensures smooth gameplay. Best of all, it's easy to install and highly customizable.

## 😎 Key Features:

* **Ultimate Performance**: Experience significant FPS boosts, optimized rendering, and reduced memory usage. Our carefully selected mods, including chunk loading optimizations, ensure smooth gameplay even on demanding systems.
* **Server-Side Optimizations**: We've designed So Tired with servers in mind, offering optimizations that reduce server load and improve overall performance.
* **Shader Support**: Use your favorite shader mod
* **NVIDIA Optimization**: If you're an NVIDIA user, benefit from exclusive optimizations that take full advantage of your graphics card. For other users, these features are automatically disabled.
* **Dynamic lighting**: Enjoy a more immersive experience with blocks and entities that emit light, illuminating their surroundings without the need for interaction.
* **Texture Connection**: So Tired connects the textures of similar blocks, creating a visually appealing and clean aesthetic, especially for blocks like glass.
* **OpenGL 4.6**: Get higher performance with the latest version of OpenGL.
* **Automatic mod installation**: If your Fabric mod server supports it, So Tired will automatically install the required mods for you, saving you time and effort.(default disabled)
* **Ping Display:** Displays ping as a number for easy viewing.

title: Vanilla Seasoning
description: A personalized modpack that focuses on QoL enhancements and various other fancy tweaks while still not breaking the vanilla experience.
body:
# Vanilla Seasoning

Vanilla Seasoning is a personalized modpack that focuses on QoL 
enhancements and various other fancy tweaks while still not breaking the
vanilla experience. This modpack is mostly focused on what I genuinely like to play with, and I'm open to any and all suggestions for what to include. :)

# FAQ

## What can I expect?
A wide variety of mods, ranging from performance improvements (e.g. [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)) to QoL enhancements (e.g. [Mouse Wheelie](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-wheelie)) to fancy adjustments and additions (e.g. [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered)).

## What exact mods does this include?
If you click on whatever version you're using, underneath it is a list of "embedded" mods. There's also some resource packs included, so make sure to enable and mess around with those if you desire!

## How the hell do I install this?
`.mrpack` is Modrinth's amazing modpack format. Please visit [this](https://support.modrinth.com/en/articles/8802250-modpacks-on-modrinth) article for more information on what they are and how to use them.

## My game won't open D:
Please make a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/mariospicross/vanilla-seasoning/issues) if you have any compatibility issues, suggestions, etc. :D

## Why are some of the mods disabled?
Whenever a mod becomes incompatible, I simply just disable it. If you have any suggestions for what to replace these with, please let me know.

## Do I need to install anything server-side?
No! Some mods may provide additional functionality when installed server-side, but everything will work as expected installed purely client-side.

## Can I use this on any server I join?
While probably true, **this modpack is not designed with this in mind.** Please run the mod list by the server owner before playing. I'm not responsible for server admins punishing you.

description:
FairyTab is the forefront of tablist management, offering a plethora of features from dynamic prefixes to intricate
sorting capabilities. The ideal tool to deliver a polished and immersive tablist experience for your server members.
body:
# FairyTab

The ultimate tablist manager for your server.

*FairyTab is the forefront of tablist management, offering a plethora of features from dynamic prefixes to intricate
sorting capabilities. The ideal tool to deliver a polished and immersive tablist experience for your server members.*

## Features

- **Plug and play**: Zero configuration required.
- **Lightweight**: Only the features you need.
- **LuckPerms support**: Tailor your tablist based on user groups, and set individualized prefixes, colors, and
suffixes.

## LuckPerms Configuration

FairyTab auto-fetches necessary data from LuckPerms.

### The hierarchy for prefixes is:

- User's `tab-prefix` meta value
- User's `prefix` meta value
- Group's `tab-prefix` meta value
- Group's `prefix` meta value

*The same hierarchy applies for suffixes, using the tab-suffix and suffix meta values respectively.*

### Sorting

Group-based sorting is determined by group weight.

### Team Color

Team color is determined by the user's or group's `tab-color` meta value.

You find all available color values [here](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html#color).

Default is `gray`.

## Installation

1. Download the latest version from the [releases page](https://github.com/rexlManu/FairyTab/releases/latest)
2. Put the plugin into your plugins folder
3. Restart your server

## Other permission systems

If you are using another permission system, feel free to open an issue for it. I will try to add support for it as soon
as possible.

## Support

If you need any help with FairyTab, feel free to join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/bM8NtsJVeb).

For bug reports and feature requests, please open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/rexlManu/FairyTab/issues).

## License

title: STR OreGen
description: Bukkit plugin that randomly adds extra ores to a Minecraft server world as new chunks are generated.
body:
This Bukkit plugin will randomly add extra ores to new chunks as they are generated.  At this time, only the default Minecraft ores are supported.  Currently, the ore generation only works in the Over World.  Even though the generation only takes place in the Over World, ores from any dimension may be used.


The ores are generated in spherical blobs based on a configuration file.  The default configuration file will be created after the plugin's first run.  For best use, this plugin should be used with brand new worlds.  A reproducible seed value is generated for each ore in the configuration and per each individual chunk.  If the world is deleted and regenerated and no changes have been made to the world seed or configuration, the ores will generate in the exact same locations.  Changing the world seed will change the locations where the ores generate.  Making any changes to the configuration for an ore will change the locations where the ore generates.


Here is a quick explanation of the configuration file:

```
oreGenSettings:
  - ==: OreGenSettings
    percentChancePerTry: 40.0
    maxPerChunk: 2
    ore: CLAY
    triesPerChunk: 4
    percentChancePerBlock: 80.0
    radius: 5.5
    logAttempts: 'true'
    replacedBlocks: SAND,DIRT,COARSE_DIRT,GRASS_BLOCK,GRAVEL
```

* __ore__: This is ore that will be added to the chunk.
* __radius__: The radius of the sphere to be generated.  Minimum is 0.5 and the maximum will typically be 16 but is computed on the fly and if the configuration value is larger than the computed max then the computed max will be used.
* __triesPerChunk__: This controls how many times the plugin will attempt to add the ore to the chunk.  There are several reasons why adding the ore will fail.  Minimum is 1, maximum is 50.
* __maxPerChunk__:  This is the maximum number of successful attempts to add the ore to the chunk.  Even if only one block is converted to the ore, this is considered a success.    Minimum is 1, maximum is 50.
* __percentChancePerTry__:  This is a percent value (i.e. 40 is 40%.)  If this check fails, the attempt is not successful.  This is a double sized value and can be very small so as to make some ores very rare.  Minimum is 0, maximum is 100.
* __percentChancePerBlock__:  This is a percent value (i.e. 80 is 80%.)  If this check fails, the block will not be converted to the ore.  Minimum is 0, maximum is 100.
* __replacedBlocks__:  *Optional*.  If not specified, the default list of replaced blocks will be:  GRANITE, STONE, ANDESITE, DIORITE, CALCITE, DEEPSLATE, TUFF
* __logAttempts__:  *Optional*.  If specified as 'true', both failed and successful attempts to generate the ore will be added to the server's logs.

title: KillC
description: This plugin allows to /kill for the player if my /stuck doesn't work!
body:
# KillC Plugin
A Minecraft plugin for Paper/Folia 26.2 that provides kill commands with configurable options.

##  Features
- **Single file implementation** - All functionality consolidated into one Java file
- **Folia compatible** - Fully supports Folia server software
- **Configurable** - Enable/disable plugin functionality via config
- **Multiple commands** - Separate commands for different use cases
- **Permission-based** - Proper permission system with op defaults
- **Tab completion** - Smart tab completion for player names and commands

##  Commands

- `/kill` - Kill yourself (no arguments) or another player
- `/kill <player>` - Kill a specific player (requires permission)
- `/kill reload` - Reload the plugin configuration (ops only)
- `/suicide` - Kill yourself (alternative to `/kill` with no arguments)

##  Permissions

- `killc.use` - Basic permission to use kill commands (default: true)
- `killc.others` - Permission to kill other players (default: op)
- `killc.reload` - Permission to reload plugin config (default: op)
- `killc.*` - All permissions (default: op)

##  Configuration

The plugin creates a `config.yml` file with the following options:

```yaml
# Set to false to disable the plugin functionality
enabled: true
```

##  Compatibility

- **Minecraft Version**: 26.2.0
- **Server Software**: Paper, Folia, Spigot, Fabric, Velocity
- **Java Version**: 26+

title: Ore Apples
description: This mod adds in some apples based off of Minecraft ores, as well as, some random but fun apples.
body:
Welcome to the Ore Apples mod, a mod that aims to completely change the way that you view apples in Minecraft, from apples that give you fire resistance, or strength, to apples that make you explode, enchant the armor your wearing, or turn you into an undefeatable player inside of your game, you will be able to find an apple to help in almost any situation that you will find yourself in.

Apples:

Coal Apple: The Coal Apple will give you Night Vision and Fire resistance.


Enchanted Coal Apple: The Enchanted Coal Apple will give you Night Vision, Absorption, and Fire Resistance.


Iron Apple: The Iron Apple will give you Strength, Absorption, and Resistance.


Enchanted Iron Apple: The Enchanted Iron Apple will give you Strength, Absorption, Resistance, and Fire Resistance.


Diamond Apple: The Diamond Apple will give you Strength, Absorption, Resistance, Water Breathing, speed, and Fire Resistance.


Enchanted Diamond Apple: The Enchanted Diamond Apple grants more powerful versions of the Diamond Apples Buffs.


Emerald Apple: The Emerald Apple will give you Luck, Speed, Haste, and Hero of the Village.


Enchanted Emerald Apple: The Enchanted Emerald Apple will give you Luck, Speed, Haste, Jump Boost, and Hero of the Village.


Redstone Apple: The Redstone Apple will strike you with lightning before effecting you with Strength, Resistance, and Fire Resistance.


Enchanted Redstone Apple: The Enchanted Redstone Apple will cause an explosion as well as multiple lighting bolts all while giving the player resistance to help them to survive.


Lapis Apple: The Lapis Apple will provide some enchantments to the armor you are currently wearing.


Enchanted Lapis Apple: The Enchanted Lapis Apple will provide more powerful enchants to any armor that you are wearing.


Netherite Apple: The Netherite Apple will give you, Strength, Fire Resistance, Absorption, Water Breathing, Jump Boost, Speed, Regeneration, Haste and Instant Health.


TNT Apple: The TNT Apple will cause any player that eats it to explode, as well as gain Resistance to help their character survive the explosion.


Obsidian Apple: The Obsidian Apple will give you Absorption, Strength, Fire Resistance, Regeneration, Water Breathing and Resistance.


Apple of the Gods: The Apple of the Gods will give the player such powerful effects that it will be impossible for them to have their character die, as well as so much strength they can defeat the Warden in four punches.


Bunny Apple: The Bunny Apple will give you jump boost for a few minutes.


Super Bunny Apple: The Super Bunny Apple will allow you to take one huge jump, while providing enough resistance for your character to survive the fall.

For crafting recipes it's suggested you use a mod like JEI which shows the crafting recipes of every item.

title: ZzaiClear
description: This mod provides entity cleaning function
body:
**Zzclear** is a lightweight, highly intelligent entity clearing and server optimization mod for Minecraft Fabric.
It silently operates in the background to automatically sweep up dropped items, abandoned entities, and lag-inducing objects based on a highly configurable frequency timer. With a powerful in-game command system and hot-reloadable configuration logic, it eliminates server lag from its absolute source!

---

## ✨ Core Features

- 🕐 **Automated Scheduled Clearing:** Customize the sweeping cycles (down to the exact minute); when the timer strikes, lingering entities are flawlessly eradicated.
- 🛡️ **Smart Whitelists & Filters:** Say goodbye to "one-size-fits-all" wipes! Whether it's dropped items, specific monsters, or individual entity types, Zzclear supports precise bypassing and explicit targeting via its blacklist/whitelist arrays.
- 🐴 **Rider Protection:** Entities currently being ridden by players (horses, boats, minecarts, etc.) are automatically protected from clearing.
- ⏱️ **Item Drop Immunity:** Newly dropped items can be given a grace period to prevent them from being immediately swept up.
- 🌍 **Dimension Filtering:** Exclude specific dimensions (e.g., The End) from the sweep cycle entirely.
- 📊 **Sweep Threshold:** Skip the clearing cycle when the number of target entities is below a configurable minimum, avoiding unnecessary empty runs.
- 🌐 **Bilingual Config:** Config file comments support Chinese and English, controlled by the `language` field. Takes effect after `/zzclear reload`.
- 🪓 **Total Entity Management:**
  - **Standard Clearing:** Dropped Items, Experience Orbs
  - **Mob Clearing:** Hostile/Neutral Monsters, Passive Animals
  - **Vehicles/Decorations:** Boats, Paintings, Item Frames
  - **Physics/Projectiles:** Fired Arrows, Thrown Tridents, Falling Blocks, Primed TNT, Shulker Bullets, Firework Rockets, and more.
- 🔄 **Hot-Reload Commands:** Changing the configuration data file? No need to restart the server! A single built-in command applies the new rules instantly.

---

## ⌨️ In-Game Commands

The primary root command is `/zzclear`:

### 1. Configuration Reload (Admin)
` /zzclear reload `
- **Function:** Re-reads the `config/config.json` file from disk and immediately applies all new clearing filters, timer periods, and refreshes config comment language.

### 2. Check Clear Countdown (All Players)
` /zzclear status `
- **Function:** Shows the remaining time (minutes and seconds) until the next automatic sweep.

### 3. Manual Immediate Sweeping (Admin)
If you do not want to wait for the background timer intervals, use these commands to instantly wipe specific entity categories:
- `/zzclear items` — Instantly clears all dropped items on the ground.
- `/zzclear monsters` — Instantly clears all hostile and neutral monsters.
- `/zzclear animals` — Instantly clears all friendly, passive animals.
- `/zzclear xps` — Instantly clears all floating experience orbs.
- `/zzclear others` — Instantly clears miscellaneous entities (e.g., Paintings, Boats, Falling Blocks, Projectiles).

### 4. Item Whitelists (Admin)
Hold an item in your main hand and instantly register it into the whitelist filters to prevent the sweeper from ever consuming it:
- `/zzclear white item add`  — Adds the **currently held item** into the global whitelist.
- `/zzclear white item del`  — Removes the **currently held item** from the global whitelist.

### 5. Entity ID Whitelists (Admin)
If you need to meticulously protect or exclude a specific living organism or object (e.g., `minecraft:zombie`), utilize these endpoints:
- `/zzclear white entity add <Entity ID>` — Adds a specific entity registry ID into the whitelist.
- `/zzclear white entity del <Entity ID>` — Un-registers a specific entity registry ID from the whitelist.
  > *Note: These commands fully support in-game Tab autocompletion suggestions!*

---

## 🔑 Permission Nodes

Without LuckPerms, admin commands require OP level 4. With LuckPerms installed, use these permission nodes for fine-grained control:

| Permission | Description | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `zzclear.command.admin` | Reload, whitelist management | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.items` | Manual item clearing | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.monsters` | Manual monster clearing | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.animals` | Manual animal clearing | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.xps` | Manual XP orb clearing | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.others` | Manual other entity clearing | OP only |
| `zzclear.command.status` | View clear countdown | All players |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration Setup

After launching the game once, the mod automatically generates the config file at:

```
<game root>/Zzclear/config/config.json
```

The config file includes comments in Chinese or English (controlled by the `language` field).

### Common Settings

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `language` | `"zh"` | Config comment language, `zh`=Chinese, `en`=English. Takes effect after reload |
| `sweepIntervalMinutes` | `4` | Sweep interval in minutes |
| `warningTimeSeconds` | `20` | Warning time before sweep (seconds) |
| `finalCountdownSeconds` | `5` | Final countdown duration (seconds) |
| `countdownMessage` | Chinese text | Countdown warning message template, supports `{0}` placeholder |
| `sweepCompleteMessage` | Chinese text | Sweep complete summary template, supports `{0}`~`{3}` placeholders |
| `statusMessage` | Chinese text | `/zzclear status` message template |
| `ignoreNamedEntities` | `true` | Ignore entities with custom names |
| `ignoreRiddenEntities` | `true` | Protect entities being ridden by players |
| `newItemImmunitySeconds` | `0` | Item drop immunity (seconds after drop), `0`=disabled |
| `minEntityCountToSweep` | `0` | Minimum entity count to trigger sweep, `0`=no limit |
| `dimensionBlacklist` | `[]` | Dimensions excluded from sweep, e.g. `["minecraft:the_end"]` |

### Item Settings

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sweepItems` | `true` | Enable item entity sweeping |
| `useItemWhitelist` | `false` | Whitelist mode (protect listed items) |
| `useItemBlacklist` | `false` | Blacklist mode (only sweep listed items) |
| `itemWhitelist` | `[]` | Item whitelist |
| `itemBlacklist` | `["minecraft:diamond"]` | Item blacklist |

### Mob Settings

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sweepLivingEntities` | `true` | Enable living entity sweeping |
| `dropExp` | `false` | Drop experience when killing mobs |
| `sweepPassiveAnimals` | `false` | Sweep passive animals |
| `sweepHostileMonsters` | `true` | Sweep hostile monsters |
| `useMobWhitelist` | `true` | Enable mob whitelist mode |
| `useMobBlacklist` | `false` | Enable mob blacklist mode |
| `mobWhitelist` | Villagers, Iron Golems, etc. | Mob whitelist |
| `mobBlacklist` | Villagers, Iron Golems | Mob blacklist |

### Other Entity Settings

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sweepExperienceOrbs` | `false` | Sweep experience orbs |
| `sweepFallingBlocks` | `false` | Sweep falling blocks (e.g. sand) |
| `sweepArrows` | `false` | Sweep arrows |
| `sweepTridents` | `false` | Sweep tridents |
| `sweepProjectiles` | `false` | Sweep projectiles |
| `sweepShulkerBullets` | `false` | Sweep shulker bullets |
| `sweepFireworks` | `false` | Sweep firework rockets |
| `sweepItemFrames` | `false` | Sweep item frames |
| `sweepPaintings` | `false` | Sweep paintings |
| `sweepBoats` | `false` | Sweep boats |
| `sweepPrimedTNT` | `false` | Sweep primed TNT |

> **Tip:** After tweaking the JSON config, jump right back into the game and fire `/zzclear reload`. Done instantly, with absolutely zero delays!

title: Herobrine011840's Cave Biomes
description: This mod adds new biomes and resources to overworld caves.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/tpj8gGsJC0I" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


![Logo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/213/herobrine011840s-cave-biomes.png)


Curseforge page is [Here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/herobrine011840s-cave-biomes)

**_THIS MOD REQUIRES GECKOLIB_**

Herobrine011840's Cave Biomes adds new cave biomes to the overworld. These are semi-rare and occur in all regions of the Overworld.



New Additions:

# Blocks

Grimslate:

-This stone type is found in the Grimslate Caves biome. It can be crafted into chiseled and brick variants.

Climbing Moss:

-A common plant found in the Grimslate Caves that can be used for food.

Gloom Tubes:

-These plant blocks are found in Grimslate Caves. They are a purely decorative block.

Forbodum Vines:

-These are a common vine block found on the ceiling of the Grimslate Caves. They behave similarly to Weeping Vines.

Abyssum:

-This block is a small tree-like plant found in the Grimslate Caves. They can be used as a source of planks.

Old Speleothic Stone:

-This is a stone block found in the Archaic Caves. It does not have many uses.

Ancient Leaves:

-This block can be found occasionally in Archaic Caves. It is a decor block.

Grotto Daisy:

-A common flower found in the Archaic Caves that can be crafted into Light Gray Dye.

Redstonial Bloom:

-This uncommon flower that is found in Archaic Caves emits a redstone power of 13 and can be crafted into Redstone Dust.

Archaica Marigold:

-A rare flower found in Archaic Caves that can be crafted into Solar Dust, which is used for a Framed Lamp.

Framed Lamp:

-This decorative block is crafted from Solar Dust, Iron, and Glass. Any undead mob that walks on it will be set on fire.

Concave Syenite:

-This stone makes up the majority of the Hollow Fracture biome. It has many decorative variants, as well as a Hollow variant.

Hollow Flesh:

-These blocks are found growing on the floor of the Hollow Fracture biome. The Hollow Flesh blocks make the player unable to jump over them.

Anchor Chains:

 -A functional block crafted with Chains and Shrapnel. Placing this block or powering it with Redstone will create a long line of chains extending downward from the block.

Ancient Lootbox:

-This block can be found within Broken Fortresses in the Hollow Fracture. Clicking on them with a Hollonite Pearl will make it drop some loot. They have a chance of breaking when you do this.

Dacite:

-This block can be found in the Dacite Caves, in Dacite Ruins, or crafted with Andesite and Nether Quartz. It has a very large amount of decorative variants.

Dacite Sand:

-This block is found in Dacite Caves and Dacite Ruins. It can be smelted into Dacite Glass.

Dacite Glass:

-This is a frameless version of Glass made by smelting Dacite Sand.

Clearwater:

-This block is a variant of Water found in the Dacite Caves.

Limestone:

-This stone is found in Limestone Caves. it has a lot of decorative variants, and it can be used to craft Stone items.

Cave Frond:

-A tall flower found in the Limestone Caves. it can be made into Orange Dye.

Lumenshroom Soil:

-A variant of dirt found in the Lumenshroom Caves. It can be smelted into a smooth variant.

Lumenshrooms:

-These block are a light blue version of Mushrooms found in the Lumenshroom Caves.

Glimmershale:

-This decorative stone is found in the Glittering Caves. It has a few decorative brick variants.

Glittering Crystals:

-These crystals are found in the Glittering Caves. They are purely decorative.

Glittergrass:

-This plant is found in the Glittering Caves. It drops Glittering Dust when broken without shears.

Glittering Lamp:

-This light block can be crafted with Glittering Dust and Iron Nuggets. It has no functional use, other than looking good.

Gemslate:

-This is a rare stone found in Woodland Mansions and the Diamond Mines.

# Items

Moss Loaf:

-This item is a decent food source crafted from Wheat and Climbing Moss. it can be found in Mining Shacks and Broken Fortresses.

Hollonite Shield:

-This gear item is a stronger version of a Shield. It has 2048 durability and gives the holder 2 seconds of Strength I when an attack is blocked.

Spirit Essence:

-This rare item is dropped by the Lumenshroom Spirit. It is a vital crafting ingredient for the Ban Hammer.

Ban Hammer:

-This weapon is crafted from Spirit Essence, Shrapnel Scraps, and Sticks. It has extremely high attack damage, but is incredibly slow.

Glittering Dust:

-This item can be obtained from Glittergrass and can be used to make Glittering Crystal Blocks or Glittering Lamps.

Copper Tools:

-This tool set is in between stone and Iron. The tools have 187 durability.

Magentrosite:

-This rare resource can be used to upgrade either Netherite or Irisite Tools. It is crafted with A Netherite Scrap, A Malevolium Ingot, and an Irisite Gemstone on a Smithing Table.

Spelunker's Pickaxe:

-This super rare item can only be obtained once in your world, as it is a reward for completing every Herobrine011840's Cave Biomes advancement. it can be combined with existing Netherite or Magentrosite Pickaxes in order to transfer their enchantments. The pickaxe is purely cosmetic and does not provide any additional benefits.

Smithing Templates:

 -There is a new Armor Trim in this mod, and it is called the Caverns Armor Trim. It is found occasionally in Mining Shacks.

 -3 new upgrade templates are also a part of this mod:

  -The Malevolium Upgrade can be obtained in Mining shacks or by killing Evokers

  -The Irisite Upgrade can be found in Mining Shacks or in Dacite Fountains

 -The Magentrosite Upgrade can be found in Mining Shacks or from killing a Wither

 -One last Smithing Template found in this mod is the Hollonite Shield template found in Broken Fortresses. It is used to craft a Hollonite Shield.

Music Discs:

 -There are 3 new discs in this mod:

  -Descension is found in Mining Shacks

 -Deepest is found in Ancient Cities

 -Hollowing is found in Broken Fortresses

# Ores

Malevolium:

![Malevolium Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/254/2025-01-22_17.png)

This ore can be found in Grimslate Caves. it can be used to make Malevolium Gear, which is about as strong as Diamond. There is a decorative bar variant as well.

Hollonite:

![Hollonite Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/255/2025-01-22_17.png)

This is a semi-common ore found in the Hollow Fracture. It is used to craft Hollonite Shields and to obtain loot from Ancient Lootboxes.

Shrapnel:

![Shrapnel Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/256/2025-01-22_17.png)

This uncommon ore can be found in the Hollow Fracture. It is used to make the Ban Hammer.

Irisite:

![Irisite Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/257/2025-01-22_17.png)

This is an uncommon ore found in the Dacite Caves. It can be used to make Irisite gear, which is between Diamond and Netherite.

Amazonite:

![Amazonite Ore](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/258/2025-01-22_17.png)

This is a very common ore found in the Limestone Caves. It is used for decoration.

# Mobs

Hollowed:

![Hollowed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4b5d478e91f0df62755158231109d7a373b21a6.png)

This mob will spawn rarely in the Hollow Fracture. It will watch the player from a distance, but if you get too close to it, then it will burrow and start to approach the player. You can tell when a borrowing Hollowed is near due to them giving players the Darkness Effect. When it gets close enough, it will emerge from the ground and begin chasing the player.

Stats:

Hp: 1000

Atk: 15

Def: 5



Lumencap:

![Lumencap](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/261/lumencap.png)

This mob is a relatively peaceful creature residing in the Lumenshroom Forest biome. It will approach a player when it spots them, as they are very curious creatures. Killing one has a chance to inflict the Fungal Curse effect for 5 minutes.

Stats:

Hp: 5

Atk: 0

Def: 0



Lumenshroom Spirit:

![Lumenshroom Spirit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e818c6c1a923b9c6b5aeebac628e124c19a5a74b.png)

This large and intimidating creature will only spawn if a player with the Fungal Curse effect has said effect wear off. They are very strong and will be a difficult foe.

Stats:

Hp: 260

Atk: 13

Def: 0

Drops:

 -1 Spirit Essence

# Enchantments

Blinding Light:

-An enchantment similar to Thorns, this will light any undead that attack on fire. It can be found in any structure with randomly enchanted books, Mining Shacks, or by enchanting. Maximum level is three.

Double Ban:

-This rare enchantment can only be found in Mining shacks. It will give the wielder Strength III for 12.5 seconds when they smash something. Maximum level is one.

Elytra Veil:

-This uncommon enchantment can be found in Mining Shacks, enchanting, or anywhere that randomly enchanted books are found. The enchantment is basically an Elytra's version of protection. Maximum level is three.

Experience Gain:

-This uncommon enchantment can be found in Mining Shacks, enchanting, or anywhere that randomly enchanted books are found. Each level makes your pickaxe drop +1 experience per block mined. maximum level is three.

Hammer:

-This rare enchantment can only be found in Mining Shacks. It allows the pickaxe to mine a 3x3x3 area. Maximum level is one.

Recoil:

-This rare enchantment can be found in Broken Fortresses. It give the holder's Shield a chance to inflict damage upon the attacker. Maximum level is two.

Reinforced:

-This very rare enchantment can be found in Dacite Ruins or Mining Shacks. It is pretty much just Unbreaking X for tools. Maximum level is one.

# Biomes

Grimslate Caves:

![Grimslate Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/266/2025-01-22_17.png)

This is a semi-common cave biome that is usually found near Forests, but it can be found in many different places.



Archaic Caves:

![Archaic Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/267/2025-01-22_17.png)

This rare cave biome can most often be found under Jungles and Warm Oceans.



Hollow Fracture:

![Hollow Fracture](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/268/2025-01-22_17.png)

This rare cave biome is most often found beneath Swamps and Windswept Hills.



Dacite Caves:

![Dacite Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/269/2025-01-22_17.png)

This small and rare cave biome is most often found beneath Mangrove Swamps and Jungles. Dacite Ruins on the surface can indicate that a Dacite Caves may be nearby.



Limestone Caves:

![Limestone Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/270/2025-01-22_17.png)

This very common cave biome is most often found beneath Deserts and Badlands.



Lumenshroom Forest:

![Lumenshroom Forest](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/272/2025-01-22_17.png)

This very rare cave biome can be found under Mushroom Islands and in oceans near where a Mushroom Island might generate.



Glittering Caves:

![Glittering Caves](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1075/271/2025-01-22_17.png)

This semi-common cave biome is most often found beneath Badlands.



Diamond Mines:

![Diamond Mines](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1275/239/2025-08-02_18-31-32-png.png)

title: Better Piglin Trades
description: Data-driven piglin bartering! Define custom trade items and loot tables via datapacks. Includes tiered trades for gold nuggets, ingots, and blocks with JEI support.
body:
## Features

**Better Piglin Trades** transforms piglin bartering into a fully data-driven system that modpack makers can customize without writing any code.

### Tiered Trading System

The mod includes three default trade tiers:

| Trade Item | Reward Quality |
|------------|----------------|
| **Gold Nugget** | Basic rewards - iron nuggets, soul sand, fire charges |
| **Gold Ingot** | Standard rewards - ender pearls, potions, obsidian (vanilla-like) |
| **Gold Block** | Premium rewards - netherite scrap, diamonds, enchanted books |

### Fully Customizable

Create your own trades by adding JSON files to your datapack:

**Trade Definition** (`data/mypack/piglin_trades/emerald.json`):
```json
{
  "item": "minecraft:emerald",
  "loot_table": "mypack:gameplay/piglin_bartering/emerald",
  "priority": 0
}
```

Then create a matching loot table with your desired rewards!

### JEI Integration

When JEI is installed, press "U" on any trade item to see all possible barter rewards. The display shows:
- The input item required
- All possible output items with average quantities

## For Modpack Makers

- **Add new trades**: Create trade definitions for any item
- **Override existing trades**: Use the `priority` field (higher wins)
- **Remove trades**: Point to an empty loot table
- **Balance rewards**: Full control over loot table weights and quantities

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1+

## Optional

- JEI (Just Enough Items) - For viewing possible barter outputs
